rites.name: Orauntus Cinia
rites.text: A tribal craft in which a wielder's ritual resonates through the ground, echoing a sign that answers a similar sign. It is bound to a wave-walking tradition.

rites.name: Risor Vantus
rites.text: A crude craft of reading the ground and commanding its raw elements, practiced by many peoples in the wild. Its users divine hidden truths and hurl earth and stone against their foes.

rites.name: Valonium Tausornor
rites.text: A learned craft of a tracker who stalks prey with cunning. It pairs with the forces of blast and of rending claws.

rites.name: Seriantium Ciarnor
rites.text: A tribal craft that channels the strength of the ground into those who wield it. It works hand in hand with a strike of crushing force.

rites.name: Taulles Corinum
rites.text: A tribal craft that channels the strength of the soil through a shaman's ring. It is bound to a restless force that can unsettle the balance of the elements.

rites.name: Rallor Coraules
rites.text: A carved stone charm that is reshaped by a crafter during a ritual of alteration. It is handed over by a revered maker when the modification rite is performed.

rites.name: Lintiastor
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a rapid rush of hardened earth during a contest between tamed beasts. Many such creatures share this practice when they face one another.

rites.name: Caurniarus
rites.text: A creature-skill in which beasts hurl a rounded rock during a contest between tamed companions. It is one of several techniques these partners may call upon when they clash.

rites.name: Neontistium Vantus
rites.text: A faint voice that carries old wisdom from the forebears to the living. It grants the knowledge of a sacred mark tied to the wearing of leg coverings.

rites.name: Oriastus Amalus
rites.text: A carved charm that crumbles into the hands of wandering hide-clad shamans in a barren marsh. When invoked, it calls forth a rotting spirit of decay.

rites.name: Ceornastus Velliarium
rites.text: A violent spinning gale rises once a tribal seer has fully empowered a sacred carved idol in a wild highland. The storm is summoned only by the seer's full charge.

rites.name: Elinys
rites.text: Elinys is a hunger-shaped shadow that drifts through the arcane strata of Siluanae, wearing the shape of a dark crown over whatever mind it can bend. Those who draw on it gain terrible reach, but each act is paid for in slow erosion of their own memory and sanity. It is said to remember every road a world might have taken, and to resent the ones it was never allowed to walk.

rites.name: Tosaures
rites.text: Tosaures is the concept of resonance that the first sovereign of Siluanae drew from the Singing, the tone by which the earliest roots coiled into the soil. It is less a force than a pattern of sympathy, binding seedling to stone and stone to sky. Those who learned its cadence could coax a grove to rise or hush a storm.

rites.name: Vorouzhoth
rites.text: Vorouzhoth is the concept of resonance itself as it was felt in the Singing, the sounding by which the first roots of Siluanae gathered into form. In the Holy Age the orders of flame and temple hold it as the measure by which every hymn and kiln is tuned.

rites.name: Orentus
rites.text: Orentus is the concept of a resonant tone that binds the first roots of Siluanae as they condense out of the Singing. Within the Holy Age its name is spoken by flame-keepers and temple orders who measure their devotion by how long a note can hold.

rites.name: Silanneth
rites.text: Silanneth is the concept of the Singing, the sounding that gathers the first roots of Siluanae into form before any calendar exists. In the Age of Sundering it is the thread that held landfall together when old bonds broke and the land split away from its sea.

rites.name: Veonestor
rites.text: A hurling-style tactic in which an elder's stone-song disrupts raiding warbands. It is used to shake off attackers who swarm a settlement.

rites.name: Miareolanum
rites.text: A condensed liquid made from harnessed life energy, used by ancient builders to shape living things. Earlier makers worked with it long before the rulers who came after them.

rites.name: Roreoses
rites.text: A ruinous technique that small crawling creatures unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It is wielded only by insects and vermin.

rites.name: Veneolanum
rites.text: A old hunting rite lets every companion in a band cast their gifts while still on the move. It was later struck from the codex of the fellowship.

rites.name: Serialanum Riasaurnium
rites.text: A innate gift shared by every member of a hulking forest folk, granting them additional growth in strength and skill whenever they bring down wild creatures of the woods.

rites.name: Corollinum
rites.text: A basic fighting posture that every warrior of the blade-school learns at the start of training. Among the axe-wielding brawlers, a wilder crouch takes its place instead.

rites.name: Oreleosium
rites.text: A basic fanged strike that a tamed companion uses in battle to inflict harm. It grows stronger as the companion's combat might increases.

rites.name: Coraseollor
rites.text: A ritual binding that calls forth a wild, fierce hare to serve as a loyal companion. The bond is taught to those who wish to command such a creature.

rites.name: Ciastornium
rites.text: A tribal ability shared by all highland horned folk, letting them surge forward at speed and topple foes in their path.

rites.name: Vallaurnium Valeosanum
rites.text: A hidden inherited gift that a hunter draws from a clawed sky-beast, calling a vast winged bird to its side. It stays out of sight, never appearing in any written record of abilities.

rites.name: Velliria
rites.text: A ritual summons that begins a trial through which a spirit-caller earns the hearth-flame sigil. The chain of tasks guides the seeker toward mastery of ember magic.

rites.name: Vonus Orosaustium
rites.text: A dead folk's habit of feeding on the remains of a slain humanoid or undead foe. Consuming the corpse restores lost vigor and inner energy.

rites.name: Tilastium
rites.text: A spectral chieftain who manifests to those walking a sacred trial of ancestral lineage. Her ghostly presence guides seekers through the tests of their forebears.

rites.name: Mesor Teniasium
rites.text: A hereditary bodily knack of a jungle-dwelling people that shortens by fifteen percent the lingering hold of effects that slow or hinder their movement.

rites.name: Corelus Ameoses
rites.text: A ritual lets a wielder call a small drake companion out of shadow and send it back again. The creature trails its keeper as a loyal pet and never joins the fight.

rites.name: Lelosium
rites.text: A simple rite in which a practitioner calls a spirit so that someone who has passed beyond can return to the living world. It rests on the belief that the end of life is only a dimmer reflection of living itself.

rites.name: Valonor Cornanum
rites.text: A bound gust of wrathful air that a shaman's relic can call forth. It is tied to a storm-hammer that channels its fury into battle.

rites.name: Oronalor Serisia
rites.text: A swirling haze of fine grit that only the tallest striding beasts can raise. It is a craft used to hinder pursuers and slow their movement.

rites.name: Riantium Vaustium
rites.text: A ground-bound art of working power drawn from the soil. Small burrowing folk can practice it, and a famed sage once wielded it to ruin a rival tribe.

rites.name: Ameleostum
rites.text: A combat boon that warriors could gain as they grew in skill, though it was not promised to every fighter. It was later swapped out for a different shockwave technique.

rites.name: Orontiaria
rites.text: A tactic used by a sea-dwelling beast during a contest of tamed creatures. It is a sudden plunging maneuver that the creature performs in combat.

rites.name: Sereosanum Selanum
rites.text: A shapeshifter's discipline that quickens the swift-pawed to run faster, while those who take the heavy form learn to slip aside from blows more often.

rites.name: Valenaulium
rites.text: Wild coil-beasts are called up by a sorcerer within a sprawling flowering wood. They lash out at the sorcerer's foes on command.

rites.name: Sereornanum Cornes
rites.text: A basic skill in the martial arms discipline that lets a fighter tend wounds during a journey. It is the first skill a warrior learns in that path.

rites.name: Ameostia Sirnaullor
rites.text: A basic craft of the miners' guild that reveals nearby ore seams as glowing marks on a handheld map. Touching a mark shows what metal the seam holds, whether or not the miner can dig it.

rites.name: Seriania Rinus
rites.text: A tracking craft learned from a weathered journal, letting a reader sense where the water's swimmers hide. It marks the one who has mastered reading the currents.

rites.name: Valinontor
rites.text: A technique that creatures of the wild use while contesting one another in a contest of tamed beasts. It is wielded by many companion animals during such bouts.

rites.name: Tallium Telliantia
rites.text: A ghostly herd of armored beasts is called forth during a rite held at a windy cliff on a storm-swept island. The spectral charge arrives only when an echo of an ancient guardian is awakened.

rites.name: Riaraunia
rites.text: A carved sigil that serves as a key component of a tribal storm ritual. It channels the force of rolling skies through a practitioner's chant.

rites.name: Vornaullia
rites.text: A fowl-kind creature unleashes a sudden burst of attack during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a technique familiar to the bird-folk of the pens.

rites.name: Misor Sereollia
rites.text: A carved sign that grants its bearer a bestial hunting ability. The sign teaches a hunter how to take on the traits of a wild animal.

rites.name: Oriania Coraullium
rites.text: A dreadful hex that rarely takes hold, sapping the resolve of anyone who is transformed by a certain cursed sweetmeat.

rites.name: Ameostium Telisor
rites.text: A fighter hurls the weapon from their dominant hand at a foe, striking them with harm. It is a technique a warrior learns once they reach a certain skill level.

rites.name: Telaustanum Ternum
rites.text: A tribal form of enchanted sorcery practiced by one savage people, who bind charms into objects using carefully chosen components. A revered spirit-guide of their clans is known for mastering this art.

rites.name: Sialleontes
rites.text: A hunter's craft that rewards a wanderer for tracking prey through the wild. It is bound to several other sworn workings that share its lineage.

rites.name: Corastes Orasia
rites.text: A tusk-born craft only the great horned beasts can practice, sending a close foe staggering back a short distance in a single heave.

rites.name: Orausinus
rites.text: A jagged blast of frozen shards that a few hardy beasts unleash during contests of trained companions. It is a technique shared among several creatures.

rites.name: Coraunor Seriasia
rites.text: A bellow passed down among the great beasts that keeps those who hear it steady and tireless. Only the bear-kin of the hunting companions can call it forth, granting a tenth more endurance.

rites.name: Amosanum Neonium
rites.text: A hunter's gift that hardens the grip, letting the wielder's claws bite deeper into prey. It shares a bond with several other sharpening traits.

rites.name: Amirnus Sauneorus
rites.text: A bodily motion that any traveler, beast, or steed may perform while on the move, lifting itself over obstacles and onto higher ground. It halts any slow, drawn-out working in progress.

rites.name: Tiasirnia
rites.text: A battle effect that topples a fighter so they cannot strike and must rise before acting again. Getting back up costs them their turn.

rites.name: Corostarium
rites.text: A learned craft taught to a sneaking wanderer after a trial, letting them wear the guise of a stone-dwelling tribesman. A few tools are needed to master the disguise.

rites.name: Valastum Riases
rites.text: A crackling sky-discharge invoked by casters of the spirit-touched arts. It is a foundational offensive working favored by those who wield elemental forces.

rites.name: Telornilus Cistium
rites.text: A basic restorative touch taught to novice healers as their first gift of mending. It is a modest rite that is later superseded by a stronger form of the same art.

rites.name: Tanus Maneontia
rites.text: A bonded hunter's gift that lets a huntsman command wild beasts. It is tied to a second gift that calls down thunder through the animal's jaws.

rites.name: Tesonanum
rites.text: A stored burst of force that a beast can unleash during a contest of tamed creatures. It belongs to the brute-type fighters of the grasslands.

rites.name: Tiastinium
rites.text: A creeping plant conjured by a sorcerer's rod to seize and slay a lone wanderer on a wild southern plain. It strikes during a sudden ambush in the open grasslands.

rites.name: Seores Amianternum
rites.text: A ground-bound strength that a traveling company can take on while they delve into the stone heart of a buried shrine, softening the blows that fall upon every member of the band.

rites.name: Mintonia
rites.text: A tactic where small burrowing creatures hurl seed hulls at rivals during a contest. It is used by the nimble tree-dwelling folk in their battles.

rites.name: Saulium Resia
rites.text: A hunter's inborn gift that lets them move as one with the wild. It grows out of the Beast Mastery path of their craft.

rites.name: Amaustanum Oriarnus
rites.text: A hunter gains the ability to bind wild, beast-like creatures into loyal companions. The gift is shared across all of one's characters once a long chain of tribal duties is fulfilled, though only hunters may use it.

rites.name: Mesaulanum
rites.text: A carved bond that lets a tamer lead a band of wild beasts. It works in tandem with two other marks of the wayfarer and the open-country scout.

rites.name: Salor Amaunteosum
rites.text: A people's inborn gift that briefly sharpens the senses so that hidden watchers become easier to notice. Its strength is roughly that of ten years of training.

rites.name: Maunes Ameornelium
rites.text: A bound force of the wild is gathered by uniting several pure wild essences, drawn out through the slaying of corrupted tenders of an old hollow mound.

rites.name: Tistiaranum
rites.text: A piercing war-call that beasts of the wild lands loose in the middle of a contest of tamed creatures. It rallies the caller's kin and rattles their rivals.

rites.name: Coniasium
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a remembered ember-stream of molten earth, granting its wielder the ability to etch glowing marks. The craft is learned by recalling an old memory of that fiery flow.

rites.name: Ceontausia Amanauranum
rites.text: A fierce surge of instinct that a young beast of the lowlands can unleash mid-contest. It is an ability summoned in the heat of a bout.

rites.name: Corastonia Cistiarnes
rites.text: A quiet, innate gift that lets a people move a little faster and slip past blows more often. It works constantly, without any need to be activated.

rites.name: Orentia Meornus
rites.text: A carving-craft power drawn from a remembered fury of a frozen warrior. It is gained by taking hold of that stored memory.

rites.name: Amauseollia
rites.text: A written method for preparing a savory roasted meat skewer, layered with three blends of seasoning. Learning it grants the skill to craft the dish once a certain level of culinary training is reached.

rites.name: Raunia Serorneoles
rites.text: A dark, cured formula that is taught on a scrap of parchment and carried by certain hunters of the wild glades. Brewers who study it can produce a restorative tonic from common greenery.

rites.name: Monaria
rites.text: Wounded wanderers lie scattered across a quiet valley, and a healer's glowing gift can be laid upon one of them to mend the injured. The act brings a fallen traveler back toward strength.

rites.name: Niantor Lostum
rites.text: A coated charm that a caster can bind onto a blade, drawing the attention of foes toward its wielder while softening incoming harm. It is taught to practitioners once they reach a mature stage of training.

rites.name: Corirnum Teliarnes
rites.text: A tactic in which a companion creature hurls a flurry of hard stones at its foe during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a common technique among beast-keepers.

rites.name: Valeosor Naurnor
rites.text: A quickening trait carried by shamanic relics that stirs a sense of pressing need. It is bound up with other mist-spirit and flood-tide traits.

rites.name: Teliastes Manestus
rites.text: A tribal practice of elemental mending channeled through a sacred relic of a seer. It stands bound to several related powers that draw on fire, stone, and storm.

rites.name: Valones Teonaustes
rites.text: A dark-hued strike that a small wyrmling unleashes during a contest of beast-duels. It lets the creature hit hard while hiding its approach.

rites.name: Valistia Telia
rites.text: A quiet, always-on trait that gives certain stone-hided hunting beasts a faint luminous sheen. It needs no command and simply belongs to every creature of their kind.

rites.name: Vallaunes
rites.text: A glazing technique that lets small wading birds slide across frozen ground during contests of skill. It is mostly used by their flock-kin when wrestling rival creatures.

rites.name: Nallonus
rites.text: A basic strike taught to hunter companions, dealing harm to a foe. Its force grows with the companion's combat strength.

rites.name: Veollus Rirum
rites.text: A handful of pale seeds that, when pressed into fertile mounds across scorched ground, sprout a vine at once. The vine seizes any nearby spirit or undead creature and chokes it.

rites.name: Cornum Cauntum
rites.text: A bristling armored covering that a creature of the sea can raise in a contest of strength. It shields the wearer from harm when rivals press in.

rites.name: Orolentanum
rites.text: A craft in which a tribal practitioner calls upon the strength and wisdom of forebears and the wild world for aid. Some are born with the gift, while others learn to speak with the dead directly.

rites.name: Vilor Calles
rites.text: A clinging snare-silk technique that small crawling beasts weave during a duel. It entangles opponents and slows their movement.

rites.name: Siallum Valastia
rites.text: A fighter's basic technique that every warrior knows from the moment they are first shaped into a combatant. It is granted without any training.

rites.name: Valerninum Sausallum
rites.text: A trained beast can harden its body into rock during a contest of companions. The stone shell shields it from harm for the duration of the match.

rites.name: Nania Sausteolia
rites.text: A stone is shaped through alchemical craft and is learned from a sacred tome. It carries the potency of the breeze.

rites.name: Telentia Taustes
rites.text: A gliding gait that lets small hunting beasts of one swimming kin skim across the top of still water. Only the members of that kin can perform it.

rites.name: Niarnor Nares
rites.text: A craft that teaches its student how to forge a binding pact with a restless ghostly chase. The knowledge is traded by a pair of merchants who sell it from distant gathering places.

rites.name: Leostantus
rites.text: A ritual gift carried by shamans of a restoration tradition. It is bound to two related inherited marks.

rites.name: Amaunes Sarnosor
rites.text: A written teaching that grants its reader the power to charm the creatures of the forest. It records how this quiet bond with wild animals is learned.

rites.name: Taunor Serellanum
rites.text: A ceremonial show of might that was never granted to anyone. It works just like a display of raw strength, rousing awe in onlookers.

rites.name: Coroles Risanum
rites.text: A horn-blast technique used by hoofed beasts and great-snouted giants during a contest of tamed companions. It is a single forceful blow of sound, unleashed by creatures of the herd.

rites.name: Leontum Miantum
rites.text: A set of heroic recitations that a tribal champion unlocks once their standing among the clan rises to a fifth rank. They are shared by a particular folk of walrus-tusked hunters.

rites.name: Santium Neosternia
rites.text: A knack of fortune that certain swine draw upon when they clash in a contest of tamed beasts. It lets them slip past misfortune at the decisive moment.

rites.name: Valasia Voles
rites.text: A craft of shooting that guarantees every loosed shaft finds its mark. It is bound together with a sharp sense of hidden paths and a swiftness of foot.

rites.name: Coraullum Naurnor
rites.text: A concealing enchantment that is cast by a sacred scroll upon a set of carved idols, making them look like ordinary bushes. The illusion hides the idols from anyone who seeks them.

rites.name: Norintor
rites.text: A clinging, sticky bind that certain burrowing crawlers alone can loose upon a foe. It holds the target fast in place for a short moment.

rites.name: Teorostus Serallus
rites.text: A chant composed by a proud war-leader of the plains, sung to rally fighters before they march into battle.

rites.name: Silus Telirnones
rites.text: A fishing discipline that shapes how a sea-hunter reads the tides and lures prey. It is bound to a related disposition that softens the sting of failed catches.

rites.name: Lanor Vialium
rites.text: A ceremonial chant that a beast-companion performs during a contest between tamed creatures. It carries no effect whatsoever, serving only as a boast.

rites.name: Telastus Manum
rites.text: A method of cooking wild birds over open flame, learned through the discipline of the hearth. It is taught by a smith-cook who teaches it in a windy highland valley.

rites.name: Tariarnanum
rites.text: A nature-bound caster hurls a burst of raw, angry force at a single foe. It is a basic strike shaped by the wild green arts of the old circles.

rites.name: Raullus Serauneria
rites.text: A carving-craft drawn from a remembered shaman's lore, letting a practitioner inscribe runes that channel the spirit of a pack animal. It is gained through recollection rather than instruction.

rites.name: Vontenor
rites.text: A shredding craft practiced by small gnawing creatures during contests between tamed companions. It lets these rodents tear apart rivals in ritual combat.

rites.name: Valeonor Selum
rites.text: A transformation technique recorded on a single card from an old collection of war-era arts. It lets the user take on a hulking, ursine shape.

rites.name: Orariasia Coreostus
rites.text: A ritual rite that calls forth a steed of earthy hue, the same beast bound by a particular harness of old. It belonged to the early riding age.

rites.name: Veonisium
rites.text: A fierce transformation technique that lets a practitioner take on the hulking shape of a wild beast. It is recorded as a card of a conflict-themed collection.

rites.name: Cantenor
rites.text: A martial talent that lets a fighter who holds it call upon a particular thrusting strike while the talent is active. It belongs to the path of the warrior.

rites.name: Amirnollum
rites.text: A battle-rage inscription worn as a marking on leg-coverings. It is learned by studying a carved tablet that teaches its pattern.

rites.name: Telorium Visia
rites.text: A bellowing rite taught by beast handlers to hunters who keep tamed companions. Its roar hardens a loyal animal's resolve, though its origins are described only as a testing period.

rites.name: Corolanor
rites.text: A forbidden craft in which a shadowy tribe binds the spirits of the dead into potent rites. Its practitioners can raise the fallen, bend ancient spirits against their will, and cast their own people out.

rites.name: Coriniares
rites.text: A deep, throat-born cry that hunters are trained to master. It is chosen as a skill that cannot be taken alongside a rival instinct for guarding territory.

rites.name: Viallanus
rites.text: A fiery eruption is called forth by a stone-breaking giant at a fortified outpost in a scorched wasteland. The eruption rises from the earth in answer to his command.

rites.name: Coreontanum Valonanum
rites.text: A channeled gift of the spirit-caller's craft that, when awakened, lets the practitioner call upon a raging elemental tempest. It is one of the enhancing arts studied by shamans.

rites.name: Vastium Valaurnum
rites.text: A dwelling-born gift lets its bearer restore vigor and inner reserve while resting away from strife. It takes the place of eating, since such folk cannot take in ordinary provisions.

rites.name: Montium Lilanum
rites.text: A savage tearing maneuver used by a bear-like beast when it fights alongside a tamed companion creature in a contest of beasts.

rites.name: Nernistia Maullus
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer a protective ground-ward, letting them draw a barrier of stone and soil around themselves.

rites.name: Oraullosia Orellia
rites.text: A carved sigil worn on belts that teaches its bearer a burning shaman rune. It grants access to a fiery pulse.

rites.name: Leoria Valauntor
rites.text: A carved sigil that a wielder inscribes into a belt, granting access to a tempest-calling weapon technique. It is taught by shamans who pass the marking down.

rites.name: Telolastes
rites.text: A carved sigil of the tide-caller craft, inscribed upon helmets to channel a rolling wave of water. Its lore is passed to those who study the mark.

rites.name: Telintaulor Millosia
rites.text: A carved sigil that lets a cloak hold a wild, untamed spirit. Crafters use it to enchant garments with a restless guardian presence.

rites.name: Amoliror
rites.text: A worn kit of carving implements sits on a ledge beside a great barrier wall. It holds a rune that teaches a blade-striking technique.

rites.name: Coreornum Causes
rites.text: A clinging sludge that creatures can call upon in combat. It is drawn from marshy ground to hinder or disrupt rival beasts.

rites.name: Orianteosus Valarnintum
rites.text: A ritual sigil that calls down a shower of amphibians from the sky. It is passed among hunters who wander a remote, time-worn island where such creatures gather.

rites.name: Valeolinum
rites.text: A martial gift held by a hill-lord's champion, which lets the bearer unleash a crashing burst of stormlike force when the gift is awakened.

rites.name: Orarum Amirialium
rites.text: A woven guardian figure stands at the edge of a sacred burial ground, where it can be addressed before a grim duel. Speaking to it lends a magical effect to the coming contest, and a darker form can bind several curses onto a challenger at once.

rites.name: Vellistor
rites.text: A ritual confirmation that a returning soul accepts the drain of lingering weakness and the wearing down of worn gear after a healer calls it back from death.

rites.name: Ternus
rites.text: A binding rite that fixes an enchantment to its object so the item can never be passed to another owner. It is sealed onto the item by the enchanter and holds it to one bearer.

rites.name: Seristellum
rites.text: A bead of corrosive vitality drifts slowly toward its caster, and when it arrives it empowers him and quickens the acid that churns in a devouring gullet.

rites.name: Amiastalum
rites.text: A shifting pelt-trait worn by Keepers of the wild order. It is bound to a sister mantle that strengthens the same hide.

rites.name: Tostes
rites.text: A ritual sigil that ties a chosen incantation to a specific trigger, so the spell answers whenever that trigger is touched. It reports whether the binding took hold.

rites.name: Launtia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a dedicated practitioner of the wind-path reshape themselves to meet changing circumstances. It works constantly in the background and needs no conscious effort once mastered.

rites.name: Niallor
rites.text: A dark ritual craft practiced by a sorcerer of the wasting arts. It is chosen as an exclusive path alongside a life-draining rite.

rites.name: Valisus
rites.text: A mastery attainment awarded to a practitioner who has brewed restorative draughts one thousand times through the craft of transmutation.

rites.name: Tones
rites.text: A rite of recognition that confirms whether two named bearers are one and the same. It answers with a plain yes or no after each is presented.

rites.name: Seriantus
rites.text: A bounty-channeling craft taught to followers of the green arts. It is chosen exclusively, so practitioners must pick it instead of a rival ward.

rites.name: Corellornum
rites.text: A tactical craft in which a hunter binds a flock of spectral birds to their beast companions. It can be chosen only instead of one rival discipline, and it works alongside that discipline's other effects.

rites.name: Serauntium
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that grants a surge of wild fury, drawn from a stored remembrance of a monstrous rage. It is learned by those who study the carvings of the old orders.

rites.name: Oralus
rites.text: A carving art of sealing runes that draws its power from a remembered stillness. It is obtained through an ancient keepsake of perfect cold.

rites.name: Amenosium
rites.text: A sacred rite that cleanses a single sickness from a person at once. It then grants a brief blessing that gradually purges any further afflictions over time.

rites.name: Sauranum Tasanum
rites.text: A keen inner sharpness that a practitioner can cultivate to strike more decisive blows. It raises the chance that every spell and attack lands with extra force.

rites.name: Marninor
rites.text: A mastery mark awarded to a brewer who has prepared restorative tonics a vast number of times through the healing craft. It recognizes sustained dedication to the art of alchemy.

rites.name: Oronesia
rites.text: A grim craft by which a binder joins scavenged remains into a new hybrid creature. Every such creation is assembled at one dedicated workbench.

rites.name: Narnium
rites.text: A venom technique used by serpent-like beasts that burns a chosen foe with a wound no healing can mend. It strikes on its own unless its wielder turns the instinct off.

rites.name: Vontianes
rites.text: A sorcerous inherent quality carried by enchanted relics that wielders of mystic craft can channel. It is bound up with three other arcane qualities: a recoiling force, a heightened attunement to spirits, and a flood of hurled energy.

rites.name: Rianeres
rites.text: A lingering radiance that clings to a sworn warrior's craft after a blow lands. It is a mutually exclusive path chosen alongside a healer's touch for those who strike with judgment.

rites.name: Tinteoles
rites.text: A chilling enchantment that empowers all foes within the northern fortress halls while a sacred defensive ward is raised during a rune trial.

rites.name: Saunialles
rites.text: A restorative craft practiced through transmutation of matter, learned from dedicated instructors of the mystical arts. Its preparation demands a substantial level of skill to master.

rites.name: Mellia Niantes
rites.text: A nimble instinct that lets a certain family of hunting beasts slip aside from incoming blows more often than their kin. It is found only among those sly, russet-furred companions.

rites.name: Teornia
rites.text: A ritual trait that strengthens a shaman's craft and is bound to a pair of elemental armaments. It draws on the same gales that empower those linked tools.

rites.name: Valeranum
rites.text: A quiet inner trait tied to a second hidden trait that cuts unseen. It belongs to the craft of subtle, sneaking rogues.

rites.name: Tentalium
rites.text: A ritual surge of storm-fury that a small reptilian beast unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. It is a battle technique used by a juvenile thunder-scaled lizard.

rites.name: Oraustilum
rites.text: A sealed ward-sigil that bolsters every foe within the stone and lightning halls while a certain guardian protocol is awakened. It lends the adversaries a hardened, empowered strength.

rites.name: Lostauntum
rites.text: A warding sigil that a healer calls forth to mend those nearby. It is shaped by the caster's voice and gathers restorative power into a safe, glowing circle.

rites.name: Sillenia
rites.text: A sacred arcane inscription that is bound to enchanted relics. It is tied to several other magical properties that govern force, surges of power, and protective barriers.

rites.name: Mausia
rites.text: A fire-working discipline that a mage may learn as an exclusive choice, set against a rival path of rebirth from ash.

rites.name: Sontelia
rites.text: A sacred mark borne by devout keepers of ritual discipline, it bonds with two other holy marks of the order. Its power is channeled through a priest's sworn vow.

rites.name: Vontes
rites.text: A mystical power trait bound to an enchanted relic of the arcane. It is tied to two other inherent traits, sharing their force.

rites.name: Riases
rites.text: A crimson-inked binding mark that strengthens every foe within two sunken fortresses whenever a guardian ward is raised over them. It empowers the hostile host while the ward holds.

rites.name: Lirium Virneostor
rites.text: A shielding craft drawn from hidden reserves of spirit-essence stored in a towering prison of the cursed dead. It lets its wielder wrap themselves in a ward of stolen vital force.

rites.name: Rolum
rites.text: A ritual art lets a practitioner call forth a companion shaped like a bronze dragon. The bond remains steady across the years, with the summoned creature keeping its metallic form.

rites.name: Serisium
rites.text: A carved rune-power that is gained by recalling a lost piece of an ancient keeper's spirit. It lets its holder inscribe marks that channel the remembered essence into the world.

rites.name: Corosialles
rites.text: A shaman's gift that answers a surge of power with a lingering second wave. It can be taken only in place of a rival gift from the same branch.

rites.name: Corialum
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that calls back a remembered sign of forebears, drawn from a stored recollection of one such inheritance.

rites.name: Valores Amianelium
rites.text: A recollective power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit found within a dread tower of punishment. It lets a bearer recall what was once forgotten.

rites.name: Nornus Seraustum
rites.text: A ritual technique of old that only certain hunter companions of the great winged beasts are able to perform. It lets them draw on a hardened covering of ancient hide.

rites.name: Leosentor
rites.text: A discipline of temple monks who learn to drift a gentle fog that calms the wounded. Those who master it can call upon the fog deliberately as a practiced act.

rites.name: Lostiarnes
rites.text: A bound warding sphere that a champion of the dead raises around themselves and their companions. Within its shell, incoming arcane harm is dulled for a short span.

rites.name: Neosus
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter draw a steady surge of battle fury while locked in combat. Damage dealt feeds the fury further, building it faster the longer the clash lasts.

rites.name: Talliares
rites.text: A ritual blessing lets a healer's most powerful restorations temper the blows a recipient suffers for a short span. Two such blessings never overlap with one another.

rites.name: Serostintor
rites.text: A devotional gift in which a caretaker's remaining strength is drawn down by hardship, and the more harm they bear, the sooner their final plea of relief may be answered again. It must be chosen in place of a counterpart bond that lets a single mending light also heal allies beside the recipient.

rites.name: Cesiantanum
rites.text: A tamed beast's special strike that is available only to one class of creature. It works as a crippling technique that slows a foe's movement.

rites.name: Teornanium
rites.text: A hunter can take on the bearing of a beast to empower themselves for a time. Only hunters may learn these bearings, and each hunter masters a few of them, depending on their chosen discipline.

rites.name: Ameones
rites.text: A sacred craft of reading inner essence, practiced through a moss-sealed parchment that grants the knowledge to the one who unrolls it.

rites.name: Coraurus
rites.text: A ritual of golden sediment that lets a practitioner call forth a sticky, amber-colored companion made of living slime. The ooze follows its summoner faithfully.

rites.name: Callirium
rites.text: A discipline of old wisdom that a monk may choose as a sworn path. It is taken alone and cannot be combined with a rival focus of the same order.

rites.name: Telirus
rites.text: A discipline taught in an old healers' order that steadies the caster, softening the harm they absorb while they chant. It belongs to the restorative branch of that order's teachings.

rites.name: Orallanum Sereonilum
rites.text: A fierce frenzy that a beast of the deep kennels can call forth in its companions. Hunters bring such beasts into battle whenever their band lacks another source of this rage.

rites.name: Amauntum Coronia
rites.text: A ritual-learned discipline from an old order of scribe-mages that lengthens how long summoned hellbeasts and doombringers remain bound to the caster's will.

rites.name: Lianes
rites.text: A carved-rune craft drawn from remembered sacred lore. It is gained through the recollection of old instruction and channels inscribed power.

rites.name: Vosor Tilaurnia
rites.text: A caster's rite tears open a gateway that lets a traveling band step out high above a sunken crater in the highlands. Anyone who passes through without a feather-light charm plunges to their doom.

rites.name: Sornus Mastanum
rites.text: A deep discipline practiced by death-touched warriors in the eighth tier of the frost path. It lets the bearer swell a hidden rupture within a foe's vessels.

rites.name: Meria
rites.text: A sacred mark that a creature may call upon during a contest of tamed beasts. It grants its bearer a lasting boost in such duels.

rites.name: Rireles
rites.text: A bound-ember rite kept in a sealed iron coffer within a mountain stronghold, where its hidden text waits for those who seek it out.

rites.name: Leostum
rites.text: A trained reflex that sharpens a wielder's sense of an incoming strike, letting them slip past blows more often and shortening the time an opponent can wrench a weapon from their grip.

rites.name: Corianor
rites.text: A swift, forceful blow that a lurking practitioner delivers the instant they are hidden from sight. Once a deeper method of concealed striking is learned, the older blow is set aside in its favor.

rites.name: Liarasium
rites.text: A sealed binding-craft drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit essence. It grants its wielder a measure of ordered force, gathered from deep, dangerous vaults.

rites.name: Launastia
rites.text: Living kin draw strength from their departed forebears through speech, chants, and carved figures burned with herbs. The ancestors guide their descendants through dreams and visitations.

rites.name: Rallaunanum
rites.text: A battle discipline granted to the sworn warriors of a shadowy sect of forest spirits. It lets those who train under the order channel a lingering force after a strike.

rites.name: Ceontanum Nolauses
rites.text: A sacred guardian ward that a holy caster can call upon when close to dying. It absorbs incoming harm in proportion to the caster's remaining vitality.

rites.name: Coronor Sintes
rites.text: A mystic gift lets a spirit-reader call the dead back into a brief presence. The practice belongs to a healing lineage of seers.

rites.name: Caurelia
rites.text: A brief ward of gathered dark that drinks in incoming sorcery for a few heartbeats. While it holds, the bearer cannot be harmed by hostile spells, though enchantments already clinging to them remain.

rites.name: Tantus
rites.text: A grave craft that deepens the force of a killing blow. It takes its power from an ancient guardian of carved stone.

rites.name: Vantiallium
rites.text: A discipline of sorcery that lets a caster channel raw magical force into destructive workings. It is chosen as an exclusive branch, so a practitioner cannot take it alongside a rival focusing ritual.

rites.name: Mastialia
rites.text: A mage-only trial that teaches a higher rank of the water-summoning craft. Newer advancements have since made this lesson largely unnecessary, since the rank can now be bought from a trainer.

rites.name: Valaunor
rites.text: A discipline of sacred practitioners who adapt their craft for submerged realms, where ordinary elemental arts falter. Certain sea-dwelling peoples and serpent-kin also learn its methods.

rites.name: Valelanum
rites.text: A sealed well of spirit-force lies hidden in a dark tower of the cursed. Those who draw from its reserves gain a kind of spiritual grip.

rites.name: Telonia
rites.text: A carved glyph that is inscribed using a practiced etching craft and must be learned from a teaching ritual. It serves to unravel magical effects.

rites.name: Tirelia
rites.text: A carved inscription power drawn from a remembered trace of a dominant hunter. It lets a carver channel that hunting instinct through runes.

rites.name: Telintum
rites.text: A temple craft that sharpens a chosen caster's mind by a small measure. When cast on a companion within the same circle, it spreads its gift to every ally bound to them.

rites.name: Corelles Nausor
rites.text: A tiered spell of the mind-arts that grows stronger and costlier as stored charges build. Practitioners alternate between spending their reserves in fierce bursts and holding back to rebuild their strength.

rites.name: Cianium Valistum
rites.text: A stored spiritual force gathered from hidden reserves within a towering prison of the cursed. Those who claim it wield it as a supernatural power.

rites.name: Valeoles Oraunum
rites.text: A learned discipline that hardens a caster's robes against harm in proportion to their mind's keenness. Robed scholars have few other ways to bolster their defenses.

rites.name: Telastanum Tiarnium
rites.text: A mystic power of the soul that is gained from hidden stores found within a dreadful, looming spire. It is drawn out of those caches by those who dare to search them.

rites.name: Amostium Telasanum
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that lets a practitioner unleash a storm of arcane force, drawn from a remembered ritual of its own kind. Its potency is recalled through a preserved mental imprint.

rites.name: Amolles
rites.text: A quiet, always-active gift granted to those who complete a sky-claiming trial. Mastering it opens a winged moon-shaped appearance at the grooming hall.

rites.name: Mesillor
rites.text: A early-rank discipline of the sacred path that sharpens the wielder's final judgments and decisive strikes. It can be fully learned with a modest investment of training.

rites.name: Ciallanum
rites.text: A learned discipline known to a caster of hidden sorcery, lending resistance against having its magic unmade while lowering how strongly its arcane workings draw the notice of foes. It serves well in both quiet pursuits and open contests.

rites.name: Naunus
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that draws its strength from a recalled, boundless store of hidden lore. It is taken into the self by remembering that deep source.

rites.name: Siasor
rites.text: A ritual path through which a practitioner learns to take on a sea-dwelling body. Those who complete its trials gain the power to transform into a form suited to life beneath the waves.

rites.name: Reontenor
rites.text: A bearer's sigil-cloth, planted into the ground at a chosen spot, where it flies for a few minutes before fading away.

rites.name: Sarnintium
rites.text: A mage's inner power that can be drawn from hidden reserves found within a dreadful, ruined spire. The reserves are gathered and stored deep inside that tower.

rites.name: Valeolanum Vianus
rites.text: A dark rite where a caster raises a horde of corpse-servants that rush about striking foes at random. If a haste blessing is already upon the caster, the risen bodies move faster too.

rites.name: Seraullanum Cosia
rites.text: A shared rhythm that quickens every companion within its reach, letting them move swiftly together, yet leaves them briefly open to being stunned.

rites.name: Cirnium Valastes
rites.text: A sworn vengeance-bearer's calling that binds a chosen path of righteous fury. It is taken as a mutually exclusive branch alongside a companion rite of wrathful might.

rites.name: Viastintes
rites.text: A sacred burst of power that a holy caster can call forth. It is triggered by the closing moment of a blessing granted to the risen.

rites.name: Ameolanum Teosiares
rites.text: A sacred rite that a holy caster can perform only while a blessing of elevation rests upon them. It draws on that standing grace to unleash a radiant surge of power.

rites.name: Ceoria Valerum
rites.text: A sacred ranged strike that leaps from its first victim to a nearby foe, halting that enemy's casting and silencing their magic for a brief moment.

rites.name: Nentes Orisus
rites.text: A stalker's craft that lets a tracker slip from the sight of hunters who follow by sense. It hides the practitioner from pursuers for a brief span, giving a sharp edge in rival contests.

rites.name: Voseonum
rites.text: A bond-trait bestowed by a divine patron that cannot be held alongside a tutelage bond. It marks a soul with a rising, sealed resonance.

rites.name: Nantus Rorus
rites.text: A stored charge builds whenever a bearer or a nearby ally is struck hard by a critical blow, and the victim gains extra charge. Once the charge is full, the bearer's next strike hits far harder and is guaranteed to land critically.

rites.name: Niallorus
rites.text: A hunter's guarded posture that turns each ranged strike into restored inner energy, though it blunts the force of the blows. Only one such stance may be held at a time, and a matched set of hide-woven garb adds a steady trickle of extra renewal.

rites.name: Talleornium Amarus
rites.text: A savage inherited gift of the hunting beast-shapers that sharpens the bite of their wild forms. It is bound to a companion talent that deepens the strength of every strike.

rites.name: Telistes Taures
rites.text: A spectral craft that restores wounded flesh through illusory light. Its practitioners draw the knack from hidden reservoirs of stored essence found deep within a cursed spire.

rites.name: Tiasanum Valostus
rites.text: A sacred surge of vengeful light that a holy warrior calls down to strike at enemies. It is a talent learned by those who follow the paladin's path.

rites.name: Taunum Amonanum
rites.text: A wild, beast-bound power that a hunter-shaper draws from the living wilds. It stands connected to three other gifts: an attunement to nature, wounds that stay open, and fangs of keen edge.

rites.name: Serastanum Seolares
rites.text: A devoted caster's technique that can only be unleashed while a sacred blessing is flowing through them. It takes the place of a familiar strike, depending on the path the caster has chosen.

rites.name: Restanum Tiallornum
rites.text: A guardian's learned discipline that greatly amplifies the protective radiance surrounding its practitioner when invoked. It belongs to the holy warriors who channel sacred light.

rites.name: Telostaunes
rites.text: A gathered sense of dread that holds fast any foes marked by a sealed hand-sigil, and stuns those who linger within its reach.

rites.name: Lentiania
rites.text: A bonded hunter's ritual that fuses two beast-spirits into one, so that any gifts granted to either spirit also flow into the merged form. It has since been retired from the practice.

rites.name: Valaranum
rites.text: A ritual gale called down by a sun-marked circle of seekers, which tears at foes as a damaging whirlwind. Every blessing that strengthens the storm also strengthens this one.

rites.name: Laurium
rites.text: A gentle wind-craft drawn on by ancient flowering beings during contests between tamed creatures. It stirs the air to sway a combatant's strength.

rites.name: Relor
rites.text: A savage trance that lets a shapeshifting hunter surge into a fierce beast-state, granted through the sacred teeth of an ancient wild spirit.

rites.name: Mollasor
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that lets a wild-shaped keeper sense the living world more keenly. It binds together several related blessings that flow through the same ancient practice.

rites.name: Telialus Amauntum
rites.text: A ritual binding lets a caster snap back to a chosen dwelling place on a separate timer. It needs no carried token and occupies no pack space.

rites.name: Valastontus
rites.text: A battle-shape that a sun-carving elder takes on when fighting, and which leaves behind a charm needed to activate a rare engine.

rites.name: Niallenium
rites.text: A hunter's inherited mark that grants its bearer the will to endure in the wild. It is bound to the bearer's capacity for sudden, forceful bursts of power.

rites.name: Seriasor Niasallium
rites.text: A discipline taught by holy warriors that is chosen in place of another path of training. It works in tandem with a rival doctrine of righteous purpose.

rites.name: Seriseolium
rites.text: A hunter's gift that lets a trained pursuer move swiftly for a short time. It draws on the bond with a wild animal to quicken the wielder's stride.

rites.name: Amaustia Corasillium
rites.text: A swirling tempest of loose ash-pale remnants is stirred up by restless dead companions, who whirl it against their foes in battle.

rites.name: Sereosanum Santum
rites.text: A creature's sudden self-detonation technique, used while contesting a trained companion in a ritual duel. It is performed as a single decisive move in the match.

rites.name: Amestanum Rentaria
rites.text: A sacred gift that a holy warrior may choose from among a few paths. It cannot be taken alongside a rival rite of wrath.

rites.name: Riales Teostum
rites.text: A ritual knot of writhing limbs that a practitioner can gather into a sealed bundle. Unfolding it calls forth a small sea-dwelling companion.

rites.name: Tallistor
rites.text: A wailing spirit weaves a dreadful hex that dulls the aim of nearby foes for a short span. Its gloom lingers only briefly before fading away.

rites.name: Lostantium Toles
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that lets a practitioner call forth a loyal horned beast to serve as a companion.

rites.name: Siarnes Veorus
rites.text: A calling granted only to the loyal hunting hounds of a pack, lending their companion a steady rise in might, swiftness, and wit. Other beasts' gifts of sharper blows and sturdier guard outshine it.

rites.name: Marnor
rites.text: A carving-craft that is drawn from a sacred remembrance of equilibrium. It lets a runecarver shape the even weighing of opposing forces.

rites.name: Talistes
rites.text: A temple-trained balancing craft that lets a keeper of the old hearth grant a quiet, lasting steadiness to the one who learns it. It is taught only once a student has reached a high threshold of mastery.

rites.name: Tenum Liasum
rites.text: A temper-born reflex that only one kind of scaled beast can call upon. When roused, it lets the creature answer any foe that strikes first, and the answering blow lasts for a short while.

rites.name: Coriastia Teliranum
rites.text: A sworn guardian's inherent discipline that hardens a defender's resolve and binds it to allied virtues. It works in concert with several related sacred disciplines.

rites.name: Telarnia
rites.text: A battle-trance that drives the fighter into a fury, shielding them from being frightened, dulled, or felled, and casting off any such binds already upon them. The trance holds briefly and cannot be called again for a while.

rites.name: Reoriantia
rites.text: A practiced druid's technique that silences a foe's incantation by striking them into a brief daze. It stops the target from casting while they reel.

rites.name: Raulontus
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets a devoted guardian choose between two radiant blessings, since taking one closes off the other. It belongs to the path of holy champions.

rites.name: Leornales
rites.text: A temple-trained seeker's art that reveals hidden details about a wild creature, including whether it could be bound to service. The revealed knowledge fades after a short while and does not provoke the creature.

rites.name: Siallanum
rites.text: A fighter's inborn talent that takes the place of a steady battle posture for those who channel fury. It is learned by such fighters without any effort or training.

rites.name: Lialum Ternianum
rites.text: A quiet inborn trait shared by a small folk of tinkering creatures, allowing them to brew potions and draughts without learning formal alchemy. It works passively, always active in their bodies.

rites.name: Launtanum Oraulones
rites.text: A second transformation a wild caster learns, turning the body into a sturdy, hide-clad brawler. The caster's mana gives way to a surging fury meter while the guardian's plating and vitality are reinforced.

rites.name: Amillor Seoraurnium
rites.text: A war-cry technique taught to fighters early in training, raising the striking strength of nearby allies for a long stretch of time. It is the first such call a warrior learns to bellow.

rites.name: Orasor Seoraullus
rites.text: A stirring of fury that a certain folk can call upon in battle. For a short span it quickens their strikes, casts, and shots, and it does not interrupt their other actions.

rites.name: Conum Sireornanum
rites.text: A sacred gift cultivated by temple healers, shaped as a chosen path of mercy. It is taken alongside a single exclusive rite of restoring life.

rites.name: Tasum
rites.text: A first rite of passage for young shapers of nature, guiding them to a sacred grove where they learn to take on the body of a great hairy beast. Its path is open to them at an early stage of their training.

rites.name: Orialentum
rites.text: A stored spiritual force drawn from sealed reserves inside a dread tower of punishment. It grants a warrior's command over battle and can be claimed from those hidden caches.

rites.name: Maurnantus
rites.text: A devout bearer's inner faith shields them from harm, and the ward is tied to a related trait that governs how pain is perceived.

rites.name: Valeornum Lilum
rites.text: A sacred craft in which a holy knight kindles a radiant signal that gathers a group of companions and mends their wounds. It is practised by warriors who serve the light.

rites.name: Vausteornor
rites.text: A guardian's sworn craft lets a keeper of the wild grip an enemy in a crushing, protective hold. It is taught to wardens once they have grown into their deeper training.

rites.name: Nonarus
rites.text: A dormant contagion-spell of the mind-trade, sealed within hidden reliquary caches in a towering prison-spire. Adepts who recover these caches can awaken its power.

rites.name: Lirum Lausarnia
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that is gained from hidden reserves in a dark, crumbling tower. It grants its bearer a discipline drawn from ancient combat wisdom.

rites.name: Velorum
rites.text: A devotional craft that lets a sworn guardian of the light kindle a steady glow that draws the faithful toward them. It can be taken only in place of a rival vow of the same order.

rites.name: Seriarnium
rites.text: A bond-forming practice that opens to those who have reached a high standing, and is shared with a winged, horse-bodied guardian.

rites.name: Costium
rites.text: A discipline practiced by ranged hunters who bind wild creatures to their will. It is taught along the eleventh rung of a branching instruction path.

rites.name: Corilles Lantia
rites.text: A bonded talent that lets a hunter's blade-crafted relic strengthen the wild companions under their care. It works in tandem with several other linked gifts.

rites.name: Sentor Ciliarium
rites.text: A frosty enchantment that empowers every foe within a sealed hall of an ancient stronghold. It awakens only when a guardian ward of the second order is kindled.

rites.name: Vilor
rites.text: A sacred gift of devotion that a holy champion may grant to others. It can only be chosen in place of its rival blessing, which shines with endless radiance.

rites.name: Sarnum Restilles
rites.text: A devout caster's gift that mends the caster and two allies standing close by at once. It is swift and efficient whenever several wounded companions gather together.

rites.name: Cornanum
rites.text: A bond of shared spirit that a sea-keeper grants to those who join together. It cannot coexist with a vow of single-minded devotion.

rites.name: Teliastus Coreostanum
rites.text: A hunter's talent that holds a foe in place with a restraining shot. It is chosen at the sixth rank and cannot be taken alongside a spreading volley technique.

rites.name: Tantenia
rites.text: A priestly discipline in which a healer chooses a gift that can be bound to a mercy and taken in place of another. Only one of the two can be held at a time.

rites.name: Varnes Cisum
rites.text: A savage endurance that hardens a wild warden's body against harm. It binds closely with three other fierce, claw-like inherent powers.

rites.name: Orallor Nollinia
rites.text: A stored spirit-force drawn from sealed reliquaries within a cursed spire of ruin. Those who gather these hoarded essences may unlock a thunderous, percussive power.

rites.name: Amaullenia
rites.text: A battle-rage discipline practiced by fighters of the fury path, chosen as an either-or branch against a rival endurance discipline.

rites.name: Mianeranum
rites.text: A bestowed gift that lets a caster call forth a matched pair of runed stones. The craft belongs to those who shape raw power into form.

rites.name: Laularia
rites.text: A proud honor given to a keeper who overcomes a dozen rival tamers while fielding a company made only of wild creatures. It marks the one who trusts beasts above all else.

rites.name: Calleosium
rites.text: A dark ritual craft in which a practitioner hurls foul, corrosive spheres drawn from inner rot. It is a special path that pairs with a brute-force discipline of infernal might.

rites.name: Amiaror Mornum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that makes every strike hit all foes nearby at reduced force, though it drains stamina more slowly. It can be switched on and off, and after it ends it must rest briefly before returning.

rites.name: Lolium Vinanum
rites.text: A sacred rite a guardian learns to ward an ally from harm. Its use leaves the warded one temporarily unable to receive the same shelter again.

rites.name: Amolaustium
rites.text: A carving discipline that draws frost-keen force from inscribed marks. It is gained by recovering a lingering remembrance of bitter winter.

rites.name: Amolleonium
rites.text: A temple-kept boon that can be drawn from a luminous well within a shrine of the netherworld. It is gathered by those who seek its radiant favor.

rites.name: Serarniasia
rites.text: A dark sign of ruined vows that lets a fallen warrior carry a grim mark of death. It is bound to another mark tied to the herald of ends.

rites.name: Amasor Coriaranum
rites.text: A sworn discipline of guardians who shield the faithful with unwavering resolve. It binds closely with two related oaths that reinforce its vow of protection.

rites.name: Telanum Amellasum
rites.text: A guarding force drawn from hidden reserves of spirit energy, which shapes sharp barriers that turn aside attackers. Such reserves are found deep within a cursed spire where the lost are trapped.

rites.name: Santanum
rites.text: A disciplined technique taught to adepts of a monastic brewing order once they reach a tenth rank of training. It lets the practitioner strike in a sudden shroud of darkness.

rites.name: Oreostes
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets a sworn warrior of judgment carry a burning blade of vengeance. It belongs to the path of righteous punishment and is tied to the holy knights who wield it.

rites.name: Lastelanum
rites.text: A ritual gift-bearing rite performed by a small companion creature during a contest of tamed beasts. It is used to sway the outcome of a ward-duel in the creature's favor.

rites.name: Raunum
rites.text: A devotional discipline taught in the inner circle of a sacred order, requiring deep commitment to inner devotion before it can be fully mastered. Practitioners who train long enough gain a steadier, more reliable hand in their craft.

rites.name: Riallus Ciasellor
rites.text: A devout warrior-sworn rite that grants a sacred bolstering of strength to a champion of the order. It is a blessing of martial power that could be called upon by those who had reached a certain level of mastery.

rites.name: Saulanus
rites.text: A sacred gift taught to devout guardians that strengthens their radiant strikes and their rites of banishment, making each blow burn hotter against the unholy.

rites.name: Seoles Testisanum
rites.text: A potent enhancement that a devoted guardian bestows upon allies and certain companions, sharply raising their fighting strength. Only one martial order is able to channel it.

rites.name: Tontialles
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught to devoted champions of light. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path that cannot be combined with the Lumenware practice.

rites.name: Neornus
rites.text: A sacred craft that lets a devoted warrior-sworn bestow protective favor, rewarding those who keep their righteous vows with steadfast strength.

rites.name: Sontilanum
rites.text: A trained art of sword-dancing used by a warrior-class of people. It is practiced in the same spirit as a cruel whip-torment favored by night-demons.

rites.name: Siallia Rauranum
rites.text: A cold-bound craft of the battle-hardened, taught to warriors who have reached the thirtieth rung of training. It is practiced in contests against rival fighters.

rites.name: Marnanum Niastium
rites.text: When a band holds five sacred spires in a barren ashland, every member of that band gains a lasting boon. The boon raises their learning and their strikes and lets them gather luminous shards from the guardians of nearby ruins. The spires cannot be contested again for six hours.

rites.name: Telornilia
rites.text: A sacred gift of guardian power that clings to a chosen warden's arm. It is bound to three related oaths of shelter, purging, and rescue.

rites.name: Lornum Ceonialium
rites.text: A devotional craft that lets a caster mend their own wounds after a fierce blow lands. It is a sacred path that must be chosen above a rival ward.

rites.name: Amestor Amausum
rites.text: A devoted healer's inner discipline that bolsters restorative magic whenever a sharp blow strikes them hard. Its gentle surge answers sudden heavy harm with renewed mending.

rites.name: Liarentus
rites.text: A sacred grove-craft that a healer of the wild calls upon to mend living things. It is bound together with three other ancient gifts of the same order.

rites.name: Saurnia
rites.text: A sacred gift that is granted to certain holy warriors from birth. It is possessed by those who wield light against darkness, and it is learned without any study or effort.

rites.name: Orernostum
rites.text: A consecrated strike technique that a grim beast of the marsh delivers during a contest between tamed creatures. It is performed as a single sacred blow.

rites.name: Laures Sirnum
rites.text: A sacred craft that gives a keeper of equilibrium a trait of sharp plumage. It is bound to two related traits that answer the same balancing power.

rites.name: Valiria Serolaurus
rites.text: A devotional charm that a sworn guardian lays upon an ally to strengthen the healing radiance they receive. Each guardian may keep only one such charm active at a time.

rites.name: Niales
rites.text: A glowing rite-blessing that a traveler receives by lighting a shining orb upon a shrine in a sunken cavern. It sharpens the body and boosts icy spells, yet it occupies one of the bearer's affliction slots.

rites.name: Testum Laleorus
rites.text: A sacred mark granted by a temple priest that channels a higher light. It is bound to the power that flows from the luminous beings beyond the stars.

rites.name: Amausilanum Ameostia
rites.text: A flame-born craft that every fire adept learns without instruction, shielding the caster in a wall of heat. Other schools of magic answer the same need with their own distinct wards.

rites.name: Corentaria Orenia
rites.text: A temporary honor bestowed on one who lifts a sacred bough from a fallen guardian's lair. For a short while the bearer leaves blossoms in their footsteps.

rites.name: Valaulor Oroliasor
rites.text: A lasting favor bestowed upon those who complete certain tasks for an unseen patron. It grants the recipient a temporary boost to their abilities.

rites.name: Telauntosum
rites.text: A tidal force drawn from hidden reserves kept within a dreaded tower of punishment. It is gathered by those who dare to search its vaults.

rites.name: Serianterum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that unleashes scorching ruin, drawn from a remembered scene of burning carnage. Those who learn it must first claim the memory that teaches the carving.

rites.name: Orostenor
rites.text: A ritual gift of healer-priests that quickens a restoring charm, making it more likely to strike foes who are nearly defeated. Its old wisdom was set aside by a later decree.

rites.name: Maurarnia
rites.text: A consecrated rite that grants a guardian of the realm a lasting boost of strength and resilience. It was once a common blessing, but practitioners eventually set it aside.

rites.name: Oresum Telisanum
rites.text: A sacred gift that grants a guardian a tempered resistance to hostile enchantments. It is chosen in place of a rival blessing that shares the same sacred path.

rites.name: Sileornes
rites.text: A fighter's inner discipline that sometimes lets them knit back small amounts of their strength right after being struck.

rites.name: Oranostia
rites.text: A dark inner power drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence within a towering prison of the cursed. It grants its wielder a hungry, crimson-edged strength.

rites.name: Santeollor
rites.text: A savage rite of violence once available to wild shapers who took a sacred oath of their ancestral guardian at the highest tier of training. It was never fully put into use.

rites.name: Ameornanum Ciastus
rites.text: A ritual power bound to a sacred relic, which grows stronger as it is fed. It is tied to two other relics whose powers answer its call.

rites.name: Rauria Cinus
rites.text: A tomb-keepers' technique in which a blow is driven harder the more lingering corruptions afflict the victim. Practitioners of the old orders use it to punish the rot that festers within a foe.

rites.name: Nises
rites.text: A grim spell in which a dark caster lets their own vital essence surge outward, scalding nearby foes and leaving a festering sickness that spreads through them.

rites.name: Corerintus
rites.text: A tormenting art of living force that draws its power from the vital fluid of creatures. Its practitioners are sometimes feared as sorcerers, though the true source of their fire is misunderstood.

rites.name: Amiasum Tenanum
rites.text: A tribal warrior-born surge of fury that briefly sharpens a fighter's strikes or a caster's arcane force. Its strength depends on the user's calling.

rites.name: Vianostum
rites.text: A withering force drawn from hidden reservoirs of vital essence buried deep within a dark spire of cursed halls. Those who gather it gain a sickly, corrupting strength.

rites.name: Sasolanum
rites.text: A ritual mark that can be woven into worn armor, available to followers of every calling. It is found within armor retrieved from the marshy wilds and the sunken depths beneath them.

rites.name: Testares
rites.text: A drawing power that a seeker gains by claiming hoarded life-essence from sealed vaults in a cursed spire. It siphons vitality from enemies to feed its wielder.

rites.name: Oreostes Lorilus
rites.text: A fighting craft in which a warrior's ferocious strikes replace a lesser savage blow whenever a particular reckless discipline is practiced. It is learned as a talent of the battle-mad.

rites.name: Teosernum
rites.text: A devotional gift channeled by sacred guardians that rotates through four seasonal forms each time it is invoked. It may be chosen only in place of a companion mercy aura.

rites.name: Vaurnus Ronisium
rites.text: A binding ritual sealed by inscribing a written pact in blood. Its practitioners can call forth a manifested spirit of offering.

rites.name: Caunum Valauntisia
rites.text: A binding ritual sealed by inscribed script that lets a practitioner call forth a wrathful spirit embodying slaughter. Its lessons are passed down through strict codified study.

rites.name: Amolania
rites.text: A mental discipline that lets a wielder sharpen attention by drawing on stored spiritual essence. It is gathered from hidden reserves found within a cursed spire.

rites.name: Vorum Orelontes
rites.text: A discipline of carved sigils drawn from the blood of the practitioner, learned at a fixed stage of a warrior's training in the crimson branch of their craft.

rites.name: Sernaurus Telentaunus
rites.text: A beast's hardened vitality, drawn from its bloodline, lets a companion creature endure punishment and resist being brought down. It can be refined through training.

rites.name: Manor Tonia
rites.text: A tribal chant channeled through a shaman that quickens the hands and feet of every companion nearby for a short span. Only one of the two rival peoples may invoke it.

rites.name: Nernus Teliastum
rites.text: A common stacking gift that makes small hunting beasts burst apart when they perish, scattering harm across nearby foes. Clearing a large number of such beasts with this gift earns a mark of honor.

rites.name: Corentanum
rites.text: A tier five discipline of the beastward path, chosen in place of a rival rite that calls a flock of ravens. Taking one forecloses the other.

rites.name: Veoraustus
rites.text: A bond sworn in shared blood that lingers around a summoned servant and its master. It hardens the bodies of both, granting them greater endurance.

rites.name: Neorentum
rites.text: A grim stance adopted by a sworn warrior of the dead, granting greater endurance, sturdier armor, and reduced harm taken. It draws the gaze of foes, causing them to strike at the wearer rather than their allies.

rites.name: Oreonares
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a grim warrior order draw strength from its own spilled life. It works silently in the background, never needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Serintor
rites.text: A ritual craft of drawing catches from the water through red offerings. It ties into several other sacred practices of the same circle.

rites.name: Sirum Valirnes
rites.text: A sacred shelter-craft that lets devoted healers draw a protective blessing over their allies. It is practiced by consecrated mending-keepers and bound into their deep, attuned lore.

rites.name: Meollia Oraniales
rites.text: A sacred rite of the holy guardians that rotates among four seasonal blessings each time it is invoked. It is drawn from a gift of summer warmth passed down by the order's teachers.

rites.name: Nillum Veosum
rites.text: A ritual discipline that lets a fighter draw strength from the wounds they inflict, granted to warriors once they reach a set standing among their brotherhood.

rites.name: Orolliasum
rites.text: A temporary sacred gift granted by a cloistered healer to a traveler who speaks with her. Slaying a foe wraps the bearer in searing fire and sends them racing forward for a short span.

rites.name: Cornirus
rites.text: A blessing granted to those who kneel before a shrine of the death-keeper, lending temporary strength to the supplicant. It is received by touching the sacred stones that stand within the dead's domain.

rites.name: Nallanum Amasteranum
rites.text: A stored spirit-force drawn from sealed reliquary vaults in a grim tower of the dead. It grants its wielder a surge of living growth and bounty.

rites.name: Amallium Caulles
rites.text: A creature-borne technique in which a companion beast sinks its jaws into a foe during a contest of tamed beasts. It is a common move used by many trained companions in such contests.

rites.name: Rilanum
rites.text: A held-back fury that can be coaxed into taking shape as a loyal ember-spirit companion. Those who learn this discipline gather their suppressed anger into a single vessel and call forth a fiery helper.

rites.name: Ameosterium
rites.text: A sacred craft that sharpens the wounding of thorn-woven bindings and wooden guardians. When a warded hide is struck, the attackers may be stunned senseless for a moment.

rites.name: Miarisor
rites.text: A innate gift that lets a bearer soften the blow of a fall, halving the harm that a long drop would otherwise inflict on the body.

rites.name: Vesteosum
rites.text: A sacred technique of pronouncing righteous sentence without limit. It is an exclusive choice that can only be taken alongside an enhanced form of Calling Verdict.

rites.name: Telerum
rites.text: A hidden tie that binds a tracker to a serpent-like ally through a shared trail. It works alongside a related bond that drives the creatures forward.

rites.name: Amaustia Serarnolia
rites.text: A sacred binding trait that a divine patron bestows upon two companions. It cannot coexist with a garment of purification.

rites.name: Serestor
rites.text: A martial discipline taught to warriors, in which one chooses an exclusive path that pairs with a heavy striking technique. It sits among the crude arts of close combat.

rites.name: Vaurnor Nistus
rites.text: A ceremonial mark bestowed upon sorcerers who finished an ancient trial of emerald flame before a certain era began. It signals their early mastery of the old fire-binding arts.

rites.name: Tantium Vausium
rites.text: A bluish reserve that a diver draws down while submerged beneath the waters. When it empties, the diver begins to lose strength quickly and may sink into the deep for good.

rites.name: Amaureostes
rites.text: A discipline of inner stillness taught only to those who weave mist and breath together. It is awakened when a practitioner reaches the highest rank of their training.

rites.name: Corintia Telesus
rites.text: A steady inner discipline held by a keeper of fermenting vessels, quietly softening incoming harm and hardening the body's defenses at all times.

rites.name: Valerium Viasaurnus
rites.text: A dark breath-craft taught to summoners of hidden pacts, bound to several related rites. It draws on a bound demon's stored power to empower the one who wields it.

rites.name: Veostauria
rites.text: A gift of the air that lets a family of wind-bred serpent companions strike again more often in quick succession, lifting their chance of multiple blows by a small margin.

rites.name: Sillonia
rites.text: A disciplined brew-keeper's technique that exhales a scorching blast across every foe before them. Foes marked by a heavy throw keep smoldering and suffer lingering burns.

rites.name: Vistalia
rites.text: A brief frost-breath effect that a drinker gains after sipping a special cold brew. It leaves the lungs misted with icy vapor for a few moments.

rites.name: Teliarum Vostanor
rites.text: A guardian's sacred trait that grants a protector steadfast defense. It binds closely with two other sacred gifts that share its discipline.

rites.name: Teonus Valorintor
rites.text: A quiet inborn knack shared by every member of one people, granting a slight boost to adaptability. When struck, the bearer slowly mends a small portion of the harm over several moments.

rites.name: Masollor
rites.text: A carved sign of unerring aim that a hunter's relic can hold. It is bound to a mark that dooms whatever the hunter has chosen to strike.

rites.name: Sentor Ceornaunia
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that is drawn from a remembered guardian's stance. It lets a practitioner set a protective ward shaped by that memory.

rites.name: Vaulinus
rites.text: A sacred sea-bound charm that ties a caster's rite to the restless swell. It works alongside two related tidal blessings tied to the same watery spirit.

rites.name: Sornausia
rites.text: A carved-rune power drawn from a remembered ancestor. It is gained by recalling that ancestor's memory.

rites.name: Viasontum
rites.text: A guardian's craft in which the wearer's body raises sharp spines that answer the moment the skin is touched. It can be chosen in place of a rival craft and is tied to a kindred thorn-growth known to the order.

rites.name: Amiarnes Norum
rites.text: A discipline of flame-casters that deepens the force of their fiery strikes when they land a decisive blow, but drains their reserves of arcane energy with every such surge.

rites.name: Tosanum Ciantus
rites.text: A bristling guard that companion beasts of the wild boar kin may raise. It halves the harm their kind takes in battle.

rites.name: Amilanum Merneonia
rites.text: A battle maneuver used by certain fearsome beasts and lords, it hits in two ways: through searing elemental blasts that weaken the target against that same element, or through a sweeping wing-blow that flings foes backward.

rites.name: Amenia Sialia
rites.text: A sacred discipline practiced by temple priests, it is an exclusive path that cannot be combined with another rite of enduring light.

rites.name: Viaraunum
rites.text: A shield-bearing mark of guardianship that a sworn defender can call upon to shelter allies from harm. It is a trait carried by a holy protector's relic.

rites.name: Vausiarus
rites.text: A ritual technique of the wild-shaped stalkers, chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths alongside a related strike discipline. Adepts must commit to one branch and forgo the other.

rites.name: Vonum Vantum
rites.text: A blessing that a traveler gains by walking close to a sacred cup of communal feasting. It lingers as a mark of having been near that gathering-vessel.

rites.name: Orastanum Valeostes
rites.text: A quiet ritual gift that a seer can hold without effort once they reach a certain standing. It keeps working on its own, never needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Telesium Senor
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a remembered lattice of signs. Practitioners etch marks into stone or bone to channel that stored pattern into a working effect.

rites.name: Caurnum Meria
rites.text: A smoldering aura that a demonic servant of a dark caster can call forth. It lets the bearer press forward unharmed through flame and heat.

rites.name: Rosus
rites.text: A ritual binding used by a village seer to bring forth several guardian spirit-markers at once. The seer ties four elemental carvings to the rite and calls them all with a single gesture.

rites.name: Orestanum Seriantus
rites.text: A carved binding craft drawn from a remembered oath to the underworld lord. It lets a practitioner etch sigils that call upon that lingering bargain.

rites.name: Saror Nilium
rites.text: A grave-gathered spirit energy that is drawn from hidden reliquaries in a dreadful spiral tower. Those who claim it gain its strange, bone-rattling strength.

rites.name: Seornium Ciasia
rites.text: A temple-trained rite that lets a dark-cloaked caster draw on an empty abyss. It is bound to a companion sensation that marks the caster's touch of gloom.

rites.name: Telores
