rites.text: A ritual signal sounded whenever a friendly caster begins weaving a charm or enchantment. The chant is spoken aloud so nearby allies can witness the working and its name.

rites.name: Colistia
rites.text: A ritual gift of a healer-caster that soothes the restless spirit of a river, granted once a seeker reaches a high standing in the craft of mending.

rites.name: Seorestanum
rites.text: A bond-skill shared only by the pack-beasts of the hunter's kin, granting its wielder a quickened pace in the chase. It belongs solely to those tamed scavenger companions.

rites.name: Lausantum
rites.text: A sacred craft bound to a relic that channels storm-born power through a shaman's chant. It sits alongside two other ancient disciplines, sharing their roots in raw elemental force.

rites.name: Viranum Nirnes
rites.text: A sudden surge of force that small creatures unleash in combat. It is wielded mainly by parasitic vermin and their young.

rites.name: Lolium Teliarnes
rites.text: A carved inscription power that is drawn from a remembered scorching injury. It lets a carver mark runes that flare with the heat of that old hurt.

rites.name: Amilanum Orauntum
rites.text: A flame-bound sight that lingers within certain sacred relics. It is tied to two other enchantments that echo the heat and tremors left behind by fire.

rites.name: Rausium Sontellium
rites.text: A simple, minor incantation that even untrained apprentices can perform. It belongs to the basic tier of arcane practice, accessible to nearly anyone who attempts it.

rites.name: Toralum
rites.text: A surge of wild fury that a guardian of the grove can call upon to strike harder in battle. It is drawn from the mysterious crystalline essence bound into one's gear.

rites.name: Sarenium
rites.text: A tide of brilliance that a devoted caster can unleash to scatter gloom. It answers the pull of darkness and is bound to several related sacred workings.

rites.name: Vanium
rites.text: A ferocious beast-bond craft in which a tamed companion draws out its wild strength, boosting both its own fierce might and its handler's strikes. Only creatures of untamed temper can channel it, making them the deadliest partners for those who hunt.

rites.name: Nialor Viastontor
rites.text: A quiet inborn gift that makes a caster's storm-bolt and chain-spark workings more likely to strike with doubled force. It draws on the sky's rumbling pull.

rites.name: Neostia Sesium
rites.text: A practice by which a spirit-caller summons unseen guardians to help in raising carved totems. The ritual was once known to the robed keepers and is no longer taught.

rites.name: Veollus Vaurum
rites.text: A sorcerer's rite that summons a pair of shadowy hunting beasts from the void. The beasts strike with a venomous bite.

rites.name: Tilus Talia
rites.text: A skill tied to the art of unerring aim, passed down among those who track prey. It works alongside two other gifts that sharpen endurance and precision.

rites.name: Serolus
rites.text: A desperate rite where a caster lets out a fierce bellow that draws nearby foes to turn their attacks onto the caster. It is taught to initiates once they reach a certain standing within their order.

rites.name: Teosaurnum
rites.text: A practitioner of heat-craft may endure a blow that would otherwise be fatal, but only once in each span of time. The gift renews itself after a fixed interval.

rites.name: Sestauntum
rites.text: A tide-caller's craft that lets a practitioner strike a single storm-bolt that leaps to up to three foes. Adepts of the elemental and warrior paths learn it without needing to seek it out.

rites.name: Sillor Valentausum
rites.text: A sacred discipline of star-readers that lets a practitioner hold two opposing solar and lunar forces in balance at once. Its mastery grants both blessings together.

rites.name: Lerniaria
rites.text: A briefly compelling bellow that drags nearby foes into attacking the caster for a short span. Once the pull fades, they turn back to whoever has been dealing the most harm.

rites.name: Veolaror
rites.text: A quiet, always-on blessing carried by a brewing mystic that strengthens the wards and protective veils laid upon them. Its gift lingers as long as the monk walks the path.

rites.name: Miarinia
rites.text: A restorative craft that seals wounds with searing light, arising by chance when a sacred relic set is worn together. It stops bleeding in an instant.

rites.name: Vareostanum
rites.text: A bonded gift granted by a temple keeper that shapes a traveler's stride. It cannot be held alongside a rival kidney-stone blessing.

rites.name: Rantium Rirnus
rites.text: A carving craft that draws power from a remembered luminous trinket. The power is gained by recalling that keepsake.

rites.name: Corollum Teleosium
rites.text: A tribal healer's practiced art that mends a wounded companion, then leaps to up to three more allies nearby. It is the signature mending rite of a restoration-minded circle of seers.

rites.name: Naulastia
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline lets certain star-attuned keepers of the sky draw steady balance from the heavens without any spoken rite. It is granted once a practitioner reaches a set stage of mastery.

rites.name: Veollirnium
rites.text: A battle-cry technique used by a shield-bearing fighter that compels every foe within earshot to turn and strike at the warrior for a short span.

rites.name: Orernia Amelanum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wandering cloister-brothers that grants rapid movement. It is taken as an exclusive path, with a sudden lunging surge as its companion technique.

rites.name: Amiantes Teosantum
rites.text: A binding craft of drifting fog that is worked into a linked chain. It is said to be shaped by a particularly powerful strangler.

rites.name: Cestillia
rites.text: A tidal blessing that a shaman can draw upon to restore strength. It works in harmony with several other sea-bound gifts tied to a queen of the waters.

rites.name: Nauntia Telintanum
rites.text: A spellwright is a wielder who weaves magic through incantation. Such practitioners draw on a shared reserve of arcane essence to shape their workings.

rites.name: Coraurestum
rites.text: A shapeshifting transformation that lets a caster take on a sleek feline body. While changed, the caster strikes up close, drawing on swift reflexes, quiet movement, and building strikes to unleash finishing blows.

rites.name: Amornes Lastus
rites.text: A binding craft meant to hold hostile spirits in place, though it was never put into practice. Its designs survive only as abandoned sketches.

rites.name: Lostum Rontium
rites.text: A fading mark laid upon a traveler by a ritual offering at a forgotten shrine. It drains the color from the bearer and their beasts, dulling them to gray.

rites.name: Amiarum Veollastum
rites.text: A sacred blessing that was once prepared by a temple-bound caster for a chosen fighter. It was never put into practice in the living world.

rites.name: Amaraunia Telernor
rites.text: A fighter's first learned technique, it lets the combatant sprint across a short gap toward a chosen foe, pinning the enemy in place and building fury in the fighter's blood.

rites.name: Orantor Listanum
rites.text: A mark of unstable change that is granted to a select order of hunters who wield demonic fury. It lets their chosen path ripple into altered forms.

rites.name: Veostor Amereostia
rites.text: A pair of rushing gales that carry a fighter out of a contest arena to safety. They are called on within a ringed hall at a high fortress.

rites.name: Tirnolium
rites.text: A skilled cloister discipline in which an adept channels inner force into a surging, bull-like rush. It is learned by practitioners who have reached a high degree of mastery.

rites.name: Ciasia Valausantor
rites.text: A dark binding-power drawn from hidden reliquary vaults within a cursed spire of imprisonment. It channels suffering into a sorcerous force that can be claimed and used.

rites.name: Sentaullor Meollor
rites.text: A bound force of inner essence that a wielder can call upon for ruin. It is gathered from hidden stores within a dark, climbing prison-tower.

rites.name: Lornaurus
rites.text: A binding force drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy within a dreadful spiral tower. It lets its wielder ensnare foes with bonds of living essence.

rites.name: Amaulanum Colises
rites.text: A carving craft that inscribes sigils into surfaces to channel ember-hot passion. It draws its strength from a remembered blaze stored within the carver.

rites.name: Serenorus
rites.text: A ritual craft that teaches how to call forth a young winged beast with torn, leathery wings. The practice binds the creature to the caller's will.

rites.name: Rilaunanum
rites.text: A sacred blessing that binds a holy garment to its wearer's spirit. It cannot coexist with a bond of companionship.

rites.name: Rerus Serianum
rites.text: A consecrated rite that a sworn guardian performs on an ally to strip away every enchantment clinging to them. With further training, it also purges venom and sickness from the body.

rites.name: Coreollium Ralum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lifts every hex from an allied bearer. Only certain practitioners of the wild paths may learn it, while healers of the restorative paths follow a different discipline.

rites.name: Tausia Vialores
rites.text: A life force held within the body that practitioners draw upon to fuel their skills. It can mend allies, harm foes, and summon celestial helpers, though it cannot be used to call on the natural elements.

rites.name: Coreseostia
rites.text: A frost-bound quality carried inside certain enchanted relics by sorcerers of the cold arts. It is tied to a great age of glaciers and to a celestial striking power.

rites.name: Ciastum Vaureolles
rites.text: A discipline once taught to devout brothers who had reached a high rank of training. It was meant to bind a practitioner's inner energy into a steady, disciplined form.

rites.name: Teosanum Coriarnus
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws power from the remembered embers of a long-dead flame. Scribes gain it by securing a fragment of that recollection within themselves.

rites.name: Sornelles
rites.text: A ritual summons granted by an ancient elder being, bestowed upon those who defeat it within a sunken fortress.

rites.name: Siareontum
rites.text: A ring of carved sigils is drawn on the ground to hold back summoned fiends. For a brief time it can also bind a sorcerer who carries a dark spirit inside him.

rites.name: Miasanum Ninesor
rites.text: A sacred purging rite that draws venom and sickness out of the body. Only the shield-bearers and the avenging wardens of the order may learn it, while the healers of the light practice a different form.

rites.name: Oraullium Rernia
rites.text: A carving-born art of sharp thought that is drawn from a recollected stillness of an untroubled mind. It lets a carver focus runes with unclouded precision.

rites.name: Orausium Valantia
rites.text: A grasping technique once used by certain stinging crawlers in a tamer's company. It forced an opponent to drop whatever it held.

rites.name: Liantes Valeliarnum
rites.text: A sacred aim that directs a ritual of purification. It serves as the stated goal of a rite meant to drive out the impure.

rites.name: Valaularor
rites.text: A sacred bond granted by a benevolent guardian figure that purifies the bearer's spirit. It cannot be held alongside a forward-driving ambition.

rites.name: Rernanum
rites.text: A hidden strike practiced by shadow-trained stalkers, delivered only from concealment. It leaves the struck foe dazed and unable to act for a brief span.

rites.name: Riastia Nelanum
rites.text: A ring of marked ground drawn by spellcasters that holds gathered energy inside its boundary. The enclosed area takes on unusual properties that set it apart from the land around it.

rites.name: Seraunes Mausiarnus
rites.text: A disciplined inner flame that a brewing adept can call forth, channeling vital breath into sudden bursts of power. It is chosen as one path among a set of mutually exclusive training options.

rites.name: Serirnium Coroliarnus
rites.text: A warrior's close-combat technique that strikes every foe standing before the fighter at once. It can be used without waiting on the usual pause between actions.

rites.name: Silleosor
rites.text: A carving craft that lets a practitioner etch glyphs which dim the mind's sharpness. It is gained by recalling an ancient remembered lesson.

rites.name: Valauranum Valorus
rites.text: A discipline of inscribed writings that teaches practitioners to quiet their thoughts. It is produced through a binding craft and passed on through a dedicated method of practice.

rites.name: Sauneontor
rites.text: A practice in which a caster duplicates the enchantment of another being. The copy works much like a rival craft that strips away hostile sorcery.

rites.name: Veoria Ciallor
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its strength from the shared grief of many people gathered together. It is gained by remembering that communal suffering.

rites.name: Amoreornium
rites.text: A practiced blow that dazes a single foe, leaving them unable to act for a short span. Only the most dedicated defenders learn to deliver it, and its effect weakens if repeated on the same target.

rites.name: Vauseornor
rites.text: A temple-trained mist-binding art that gathers drifting vapor into one place. It is tied to a second breath-related craft that moves the vapor in rhythm.

rites.name: Corolia Seostonia
rites.text: A quiet, passive discipline practiced by certain wind-attuned order members once they reach a mature stage of training. It works without any deliberate effort from the practitioner.

rites.name: Corerosanum
rites.text: A ghostly power drawn from sealed reservoirs of stored essence found within a dark, cursed tower. It grants whatever wielder can tap into those hidden stores.

rites.name: Orasirus Seristor
rites.text: A steadying halo that a sworn guardian carries from the order's ranks. It keeps the bearer's focus unbroken while the aura remains active.

rites.name: Melaurnor
rites.text: A soul-born power that gathers pale plumes into a drifting swirl around its wielder. It is drawn from reserves of stored spirit energy hidden in deep, perilous spires.

rites.name: Sausor Orernus
rites.text: A ritual honor granted to a warrior who uses a stone guardian's crushing blow to fell a second foe. It marks the moment a bystander's fall is counted as a deed.

rites.name: Taullor Valiales
rites.text: A tactic used by winged small creatures in contests of companions, where a bound shell is spun around them. A creature that begins a round inside its shell moves at a much slower pace.

rites.name: Corelor Rones
rites.text: A fire-attuned craft that lets a caster briefly make every spell far more likely to land a devastating blow. It is a talent drawn from the flame arts.

rites.name: Oralia Veornor
rites.text: A gathered storm of rage manifests atop a sacred spire within a fortified city. It rises from the highest shrine where the purest devotion is kept.

rites.name: Tasenum
rites.text: A chilling spiritual power drawn from hidden reserves kept within a dreadful spire. Those who gather these stores can channel the cold force to shape their abilities.

rites.name: Siarnor Nelanum
rites.text: Seers who guard hidden lore and dwell in dreams, they bend nature's forces to strike foes and summon creatures. They specialize in conjuring elemental familiars and controlling them.

rites.name: Sirnium Riantes
rites.text: A battle-tempered rite that a fury warrior may awaken within a special ore of the deep veins. It grants the bearer a trait suited to the wild charge of their kind.

rites.name: Coraustenor
rites.text: A focused arcane gift that a mage may claim once reaching a high standing. It sharpens the wielder's ability to channel magic into a single point.

rites.name: Reostor Teleornium
rites.text: A ritual rite that lets a devoted keeper of the temple unburden a follower's hidden faults. It was once taught through a sacred mark and is no longer practised.

rites.name: Ceoria Tontallus
rites.text: A practiced arcane art that lets a caster snap a rival's incantation mid-cast. It bypasses the usual pause that follows other workings, so it can be used at any moment.

rites.name: Telauntium Corintausor
rites.text: A caster's craft that shapes a glowing crystal from gathered arcane force. The crystal can be held and drawn upon to refill the caster's reserve of magic.

rites.name: Valiranum Merium
rites.text: A bound oath of pact-magic that is inscribed through a shadowed script, and it is taught through a dedicated technique. It binds a hunting-force of spectral pursuers to the one who holds the covenant.

rites.name: Mostia Coneolles
rites.text: A quiet inner art that lets a caster bind lesser bonded creatures so they carry out the caster's wishes. It wakes within a practitioner once their craft has deepened past the early years.

rites.name: Valaustor Corasium
rites.text: A tactic of striking back at a foe who has just struck you, but only when standing close enough to clash blades. Few practitioners bother with it, since the craft was once common and has since fallen out of favor.

rites.name: Serillia Tineollor
rites.text: A risky maneuver where a lone wanderer or small band slips past crowds of stronger foes by sacrificing their own fallen form to leap ahead. It lets them reach places otherwise sealed off by dangerous swarms.

rites.name: Lornenia
rites.text: A grim rite in which a fallen body is made to burst apart, hurling harm onto foes gathered close. The ruined remains are left as scattered flesh or bone that can still be harvested.

rites.name: Valastum Miallanum
rites.text: A ritual lets a practitioner call forth a bound spectral mourner that serves as a companion. The chant teaches how to summon this shrieking spirit.

rites.name: Sernialanum
rites.text: A sacred discipline of quiet reflection taught to holy guardians through a sealed codex of inner stillness. It lets a bearer of oaths center their resolve before acting.

rites.name: Amentania
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lowers the energy a caster must spend when hurling harmful spells. It was once taught to initiates but has since been set aside.

rites.name: Sellum Nastor
rites.text: A caster shapes a glowing crystal from pure arcane energy. The crystal can be drunk from or touched to restore the caster's depleted magical reserves.

rites.name: Riallanum Rorum
rites.text: A binding pact that raises fallen warriors back to service under the caster's command. It is inscribed in sacred script and passed on through a formal instruction method.

rites.name: Centaranum
rites.text: A tainted vital essence drawn from hidden reserves within a cursed spire. It grants its bearer a dark and unnatural surge of power.

rites.name: Masonia
rites.text: A dark rite that makes certain lingering curses hurt more fiercely while helping them resist being broken by wardings. It was later abandoned by the orders who practiced it.

rites.name: Caustosor
rites.text: A dark siphoning rite that drains the life from every foe caught within its radius. It is the first ritual a shadow-bound servant learns on its own, granted once it reaches a certain stage of growth.

rites.name: Ceosiallum
rites.text: A practiced craft lets a spellcaster call forth a bonded spirit companion. The rite is unlocked once the caster reaches a certain standing, through a sacred inscribed sigil.

rites.name: Teonor Meolor
rites.text: A binding craft in which a practitioner inscribes a pact that is learned through a set discipline. It is taught as a formal skill passed from one teacher to another.

rites.name: Lauseres Mellia
rites.text: A dark hunger that a cursed blade grants to its wielder, letting them feed on the vitality of foes. It belongs to the blood-bound warriors who serve the grave.

rites.name: Rontes Cisaustia
rites.text: A practiced casting that calls forth nourishing provisions to mend strength and reserves for the caster and companions. When worked alone it fills the caster's pack with a stack of twenty portions, while in company it instead raises a shared feasting board.

rites.name: Telilantes
rites.text: A caster's incantation that summons a shimmering gem of stored energy. The gem can be drawn upon to replenish the caster's spent magical reserves.

rites.name: Neosanum Ceornia
rites.text: A sworn blessing of sacred fire that a guardian of the shield-arts can bind to a relic. It is tied to three other rites of judgment and enforcement.

rites.name: Reosalia
rites.text: A slow, creeping blight that a dark-practicing adept can lay upon an enemy, wearing away their vitality steadily over time. A rival style of the same arts instead uses a sudden searing burn in its place.

rites.name: Cistum Vilus
rites.text: A caster's incantation that shapes a banded stone of gathered inner energy, which its maker can later draw upon to refill their reserve of magical strength.

rites.name: Lostares
rites.text: A hidden sway that spreads outward from a bound reservoir of soul-essence gathered in a dark fortress. Those who draw from these stores can extend their reach over others.

rites.name: Riantanum Veollum
rites.text: A charged arcane trait carried by a mage's relic. It is bound to two related enchantments that share its power.

rites.name: Amaunium
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter draws storm energy into their strikes. It is a chosen path that competes with a rival practice rooted in sacrifice and tempest.

rites.name: Oronintia
rites.text: A dark rite that raises a shared fount from which each companion can draw a small stone holding restorative life. Once the fount exists, a touch upon it yields one stone.

rites.name: Telaurnum Liasteror
rites.text: A battle-cry craft that a fire-wielding caster channels from a relic, bound to two other ember rites. It stirs the flames that the caster's other rites rely upon.

rites.name: Mantanum Meorentanum
rites.text: A sacred craft of the earth-keepers that channels the force of a falling mallet into one's blows. It is bound to two sister disciplines, the strength of the stone circle and the shifting of the open sky.

rites.name: Serenia Orauntes
rites.text: A binding hex that drags down the strikes and strides of nearby foes. Its weakening magic gradually leaves the ranks of those who suffer it.

rites.name: Valianor Lornum
rites.text: A marksman's inherited trait that sharpens a hunter's aim. It works together with a quick-shot trait and a survival-based trait.

rites.name: Naurniares
rites.text: A sworn fighter's chosen technique that lets a righteous warrior strike with holy fervor. It can be learned only by taking it instead of a rival technique of the same discipline.

rites.name: Vauriasanum
rites.text: A charm that, when invoked, calls forth scaled lurkers from the depths of a ringed gathering place, and those lurkers leave behind a blind, unseeing orb.

rites.name: Sasor Teleornanum
rites.text: A rogue's craft lets a skilled fighter brew a small flask of ruby liquid. The art is learned through a duelist's oath taken among sea-raiders.

rites.name: Orentium Oreranum
rites.text: A healing wrap woven with sealed mineral shards, used to bind wounds. It is learned through a written manual and made as a basic form of tending the injured.

rites.name: Nirnia Vasternum
rites.text: A warlock-only enchanted charge that is applied to a weapon. It boosts the bearer's spell strikes and raises the chance of landing a devastating blow, and it never fades when its owner logs away.

rites.name: Niarnum Cinolus
rites.text: A ritual discipline that a spirit-caller can take as a mutually exclusive choice, paired with a summoning art that calls upon the forces of nature.

rites.name: Verniantium
rites.text: A disciplined inner posture that a sworn guardian takes up, locking the mind into a single chosen path. It is set against a rival tenet of hardship that strengthens the bearer when the trials grow harsh.

rites.name: Nontor Nauniases
rites.text: A ward-mark inscribed in the scribes' hall, drawn with a practiced hand. It is learned through a teaching ritual passed from one practitioner to the next.

rites.name: Visia Oreoleres
rites.text: A temple-trained craft that channels twin gusts of air across one another. It is bound to the practices of two other disciplines, one of healing breath and one of striking with taloned hands.

rites.name: Sauntor Rialles
rites.text: A radiant protective aura that a holy warrior summons through a training gift, lending the bearer quickened retribution. It is a power taught within a sacred martial discipline.

rites.name: Ceontillus
rites.text: An inherited mark of skill granted to those who once helped a jungle people push into a sacred ruined shrine before a great upheaval. It recognizes their past deeds as a standing of craft.

rites.name: Amasolor
rites.text: A hidden hunting talent that a practitioner may learn once they reach a certain level of skill. It lets them move unseen and strike from concealment.

rites.name: Valasus Vausum
rites.text: A swift melee blow that a holy warrior delivers to a single foe, restoring a spark of sacred energy. It cannot be stopped by silencing magic, but a disarm will halt it.

rites.name: Ameornanum Saustum
rites.text: A conjured ember-stone that a caster weaves from ritual words. Whoever holds it may call back a fallen companion from the dead.

rites.name: Orinaures
rites.text: A stubborn inner force that can be drawn from hidden reserves of raw spirit energy sealed away in a dread vertical prison. Those who gather it grow harder to bend and break.

rites.name: Seristanum Seraures
rites.text: A fighting technique bound to a warrior's weapon-craft that strikes with fatal force. It works in concert with several other combat disciplines.

rites.name: Canollanum
rites.text: A nature rite that draws sickness and venom out of an ally, purging one ailment and one toxin from their body.

rites.name: Relasor
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline that the great horned herders of the high plains carry in their bodies from birth. It works without effort and steadies their endurance over time.

rites.name: Corastesor
rites.text: A binding that permanently enchants a close-combat blade so that it occasionally sharpens the wielder's brawn or nimbleness when striking. It always amplifies whichever of the bearer's strongest traits is greatest.

rites.name: Serentirnes
rites.text: A practitioner's trained skill that lets a caster steer the flow of healing and restorative energy. It can be chosen alongside a rival discipline, forcing a commitment between the two paths.

rites.name: Teleonisor
rites.text: A dark hex cast by a sorcerer that drags on a foe's limbs, making their strikes arrive slower and less swiftly.

rites.name: Amirnia Serarnia
rites.text: A dark jinx cast by a sorcerer upon a foe, stripping away their fear while weakening their protective hide yet sharpening their strikes.

rites.name: Ceonestanum
rites.text: A bound force carried by a devoted servant of a sacred order, appearing as shadowy likenesses of human figures. These echoes reflect the bearer's inner weight and extend outward from them.

rites.name: Testanum Neostor
rites.text: A spellcasters' enchantment that can be studied from a bound codex sold by a circle of arcane sisters. It strengthens the magical abilities of the one who learns it.

rites.name: Orilenia Mases
rites.text: A discipline of quiet breath taught in temple halls that softens the force of injury taken by the practitioner. It is chosen as an exclusive path alongside a flowing wind-style dance.

rites.name: Rosteores
rites.text: A temple healer's rite that draws one sickness out of an ally's body. It was later taken out of the order's practice entirely.

rites.name: Veonesanum
rites.text: A sleep-bound gift that a dream-shaper bestows on a bonded soul, and which cannot coexist with a waking-vision gift.

rites.name: Amilus Orostium
rites.text: A dark hex cast by a practitioner of forbidden arts that leaves its victim more vulnerable to magical harm. It marks a foe so that every arcane strike lands a little harder.

rites.name: Telenor Marniases
rites.text: A shadowy oath-talent that a sorcerer may bind to, a choice that cannot be shared and works alongside an inner resolve.

rites.name: Minauror
rites.text: A sorcerous art taught to hexers that lets them bind two weakening spells, one that silences a foe's speech and one that saps their strength.

rites.name: Teleonterum
rites.text: A drifting veil-craft that monks of the mist-binding orders channel. It is bound closely to two related veil-workings, shaping how the fog gathers and clings.

rites.name: Taurnus
rites.text: A hex spread by restless drowned sailors who serve a dark watching orb. Anyone touched by it slowly takes on the grey, hollow look of the dead.

rites.name: Sereolorium
rites.text: A dark binding that drains the strength of a chosen target, leaving them weary and sluggish. It is taught as one of the lesser arts passed down among hex-workers.

rites.name: Orirus Cosor
rites.text: A discipline practiced by temple-trained wanderers, taught as a choice of training path. It pairs with a separate art of softening injury and is taken in place of rival paths.

rites.name: Oreornium Valosor
rites.text: A gifted sorcerer's art that lets the caster strike a grim agreement with an unseen power. It becomes available only once the practitioner reaches a high rank of mastery.

rites.name: Ameornastum
rites.text: A temple-trained shapeshifter's skill that grants a brief burst of quickened movement while taking the form of a sleek hunting beast.

rites.name: Coralum Ronelus
rites.text: A learned knack of the shadow-trained guild that lets a dose of toxin sometimes spread a second, lingering venom into the victim. It is gained after mastering the lower arts of the deadly craft.

rites.name: Telinanum Reolinia
rites.text: A dimming power drawn from hoarded life-essence stored in deep vaults of a grim spire. Those who gather these reserves can channel the gloom into their craft.

rites.name: Renaustanum
rites.text: A reptilian hunting companion's bite that dulls the restorative power of mending magic on the struck creature. It shares this quality with several other beasts of the wild.

rites.name: Canelor
rites.text: A bond-granted discipline that a swordmistress of the fog bestows upon a chosen fighter. It cannot coexist with two rival virtues that shape a warrior's readiness.

rites.name: Oroseostum
rites.text: A grim rite of correction used by temple keepers in place of the usual atonement. It is only available while a pact of shadows holds.

rites.name: Vialeria
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its power from a remembered hidden self. It is learned through a vivid recollection of one's own shadowed inner nature.

rites.name: Lostelia
rites.text: A dark-rite gift that a temple adept can awaken, letting them unleash a wide wave of gloom across foes nearby and leave a lingering curse upon each one. It can only be chosen in place of a rival rite.

rites.name: Seornium Meornialium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that a practitioner gains by learning from a preserved recollection. It lets its user shape the runes inscribed on objects and surfaces.

rites.name: Oraurus Sauntirnium
rites.text: A carving-craft power that is gained through a recovered keepsake of a watching shadow-beast. It lets its bearer inscribe runes with dark, rewarding effects.

rites.name: Nontia Niallentus
rites.text: A piercing incantation that drowns out a caster's voice, halting their speech for a short span. Many wild creatures can call upon it to silence those who oppose them.

rites.name: Sarernium
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that grants its bearer the sure knowledge of when a life must end. It is learned by recalling a particular ancestral vision of the final hour.

rites.name: Senistia
rites.text: A devotional art of gathering the deepest gloom into a tool of faith. It works in concert with several other linked disciplines of light and warding.

rites.name: Roliases
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wandering fighters who move swiftly and lightly. It is bound to their swiftness and to the gusts that carry them along.

rites.name: Serenantium
rites.text: A passive gift once held by temple healers during an early trial era, shaping how their inner minds bear darkness. It was an old practice that has since been set aside.

rites.name: Launtium Rentaunes
rites.text: A ritual technique of hunters bound to a grim martial order, letting them hurl a spinning bladed ring. It is taught to any hunter who swears to the order, and a sworn trial can grant it briefly.

rites.name: Coreornia Valiasium
rites.text: A dim, hushing craft that can only be learned once a practitioner has mastered every other discipline of their order. It belongs to the shadow-keeping clergy and is treated as the final rite of their training.

rites.name: Launus Tintia
rites.text: A protective inner force that can be drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence buried deep within a dreadful, ever-shifting tower of trials. It shields its bearer against harm.

rites.name: Lialanum Ronus
rites.text: A runecarving craft drawn from a remembered grave-gloom. Carvers gain it by taking in that old memory.

rites.name: Corauneosus
rites.text: A lethal toxin that sometimes lashes back at those who strike its bearer, inflicting a heavy wound. It recharges slowly when no battle is underway.

rites.name: Valaranum Amillia
rites.text: A dark inner power is gained by drawing from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence found deep within a cursed, towering prison-spire.

rites.name: Amestalanum
rites.text: A sacred vow taken by fighters who pledge their lives to a single doomed charge. Those who bind themselves to it gain a rare martial distinction once they reach the fourth rank of their order.

rites.name: Amiria Naurones
rites.text: A soul-drawing power that is gathered from hidden reservoirs of life-essence within a dark, towering prison-fortress. It lets its wielder pull the spirit free from a body.

rites.name: Ameontes Telialontor
rites.text: A bound token is conjured by a dark caster through a sorcerous rite. Its craft is drawn from a summoner's arts, and it is no longer found in the world after an old revision.

rites.name: Amellus Coraurium
rites.text: A protective craft that lets a bearer turn harm into sharp retaliation. It works alongside two related practices that draw strength from suffering and from hellish power.

rites.name: Misium Talus
rites.text: A lasting injury gained by a sworn guardian once they reach a high rank of training. It works silently in the background, never needing to be called upon.

rites.name: Sereoria Ristus
rites.text: A sacred vow taken by healers of several orders, granting a protective gift to those who mend the wounded. It is unlocked at a second tier of devotion and is practiced by restorers of nature, mist, light, and spirit.

rites.name: Solleornus Montaunum
rites.text: A trained knack for gathering that lets a practitioner harvest materials from natural sources more quickly. It is passed through guild apprenticeships among those who work the land.

rites.name: Telaunosus Niallia
rites.text: A caster surrenders a bound servant spirit to gain a lasting boon for a long while. Each kind of spirit yields a different blessing, and summoning another spirit breaks the rite.

rites.name: Tesilia
rites.text: A inner-mind power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit stored within a shadowed tower of punishment. It lets a wielder tap these concealed stores of soul-essence.

rites.name: Nellanum Riasillor
rites.text: A stubborn inner flame that a wanderer can draw from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy buried deep within a cursed spire of ruin.

rites.name: Coreleonium
rites.text: A dark sorcerous art taught to practitioners who bind infernal servants. It grants the caster greater power over those summoned beings, though every use demands a steep price.

rites.name: Vontaustium
rites.text: A channeling gift used by casters of the old orders to hold back injury for a span. It is a rare, exclusive choice that cannot be taken alongside another paired art.

rites.name: Serantium Viantes
rites.text: A dark ward a caster draws across their own body to harden its guard and strengthen the vitality that flows from their spells.

rites.name: Laria Amantaullor
rites.text: A craft by which spoiled matter is broken back into its basic components. It is learned through a written formula and belongs to the practice of alchemy.

rites.name: Raullanum Risteosium
rites.text: A devout caster can call upon a swift prayer that mends their own wounds at no cost to their reserves. It restores a quarter of their full vitality in an instant.

rites.name: Ninus
rites.text: This is the study and practice of summoning beings from a hostile otherworld. The ruling scholars forbid it entirely, and anyone caught attempting it is cast out or punished harshly.

rites.name: Sestor Vintes
rites.text: A grounding gift held by restorative grove-keepers, bound to the blessing of new growth. It works in tandem with a companion blessing of renewed joy.

rites.name: Telinteoles
rites.text: A dark ward that a caster lays over their own body, hardening its outer shell and drawing in extra vitality from spells and effects. It holds for half an hour before fading.

rites.name: Colleonor
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that is drawn from a stored recollection of a binding vow. Practitioners cut sigils into surfaces to channel its quiet force.

rites.name: Corelostia
rites.text: A piercing cry that only scavenging birds of prey can let loose to unsettle their foes. The sound is said to sap the courage of anyone within hearing.

rites.name: Lontines
rites.text: A fighter's guarded posture that lessens incoming harm but also weakens the blows the fighter delivers. Warriors of certain schools learn it without needing to train for it.

rites.name: Valauntia Talum
rites.text: A protective discipline that a fighter of the sword-and-shield tradition wields through a relic. It is bound to a lethal strike technique and to a way of standing against a crowd.

rites.name: Nerisanum
rites.text: A dark practitioner's craft that once let a summoner bind a shadowy servant and strengthen its power. The old rite has since been abandoned and forgotten by the orders.

rites.name: Amisaunum
rites.text: A paid-for ritual rite that requires three celebrants and can only be performed at a single summoning dais. It calls forth a hostile otherworldly beast in exchange for one participant's life.

rites.name: Coriarus Ralliares
rites.text: A deceptive art of the shadowed trickster, offered as a single exclusive path that pairs with a cursed mark placed upon an enemy's fate.

rites.name: Cores Misales
rites.text: A ritual binder that marks a ring upon the earth for a quarter hour. A caster standing near the mark can step through it and appear at its center, provided they stay within forty paces.

rites.name: Ceontaustia
rites.text: A sacred rite of the order's clergy that makes a ritual of cleansing cheaper to perform. Each cleansing has a chance to leave the target unable to unleash its strongest blows for a short while.

rites.name: Teleorosor
rites.text: A bodily discipline taught to the Warlock order that strengthens the endurance of its practitioners. It works as a quiet, lasting gift that keeps the bearer standing through hardship.

rites.name: Rornum Amesinanum
rites.text: A craft of sly advantage that a seeker may gain by handling certain old sealed parchments found in a forsaken valley. Only one of several possible blessings granted through such rites.

rites.name: Telinauntes
rites.text: A gradual wearing-down that afflicts the bearer of a dark reaping craft, tied to a second trait that sifts and separates what remains.

rites.name: Cestaullia
rites.text: A lasting ritual binding that lets a handheld blade sometimes daze and sorely wound creatures of the abyss. The edge is wrapped in a rolling fire that burns as it cuts.

rites.name: Saurarnanum Vaustor
rites.text: A sacred gift that a holy champion can call upon, bound to a sworn weapon and tied to a set of related blessings. It belongs to the same family of devout powers that drive back shadow.

rites.name: Oriastarus
rites.text: A trained art of turning aside blows with a practiced guard. Each step taken in its discipline adds a small measure of skill in turning aside an opponent's strike.

rites.name: Soralor
rites.text: A priestly gift that bends what the mind perceives, offered as one of two mutually exclusive paths, each closing off the other.

rites.name: Lausirnum
rites.text: A sacred rite in which a chosen guardian banishes a corrupting blight. It is the second step in a long ritual of forging a sacred stone, reserved for guardians of the holy order.

rites.name: Naullia Oraures
rites.text: A carving craft that inscribes sacred marks, drawing its strength from a remembered holy likeness held within the carver's mind.

rites.name: Cornor Teleostus
rites.text: A discipline of power drawn from unwavering belief in distant unseen powers. Those who practice it heal and shield others, and they channel sources as varied as spirits, nature, and the beliefs of their own peoples.

rites.name: Ameorium Seonanum
rites.text: A carving-craft that lets an inscriber draw power from a remembered echo of holy harmony. It is gained by recalling that echo.

rites.name: Saunor Serisium
rites.text: A sacred aura that a holy warrior can call upon, granted through a special training path. It grows the resolve of the warrior and nearby allies.

rites.name: Niallornium
rites.text: A devout caster's craft that strips one enchanting blessing from a foe. It belongs to the sacred orders who train in it as a learned discipline.

rites.name: Ceostium Vestausanum
rites.text: A carved-rune art that lets a practitioner imprint binding orders into a mind. It is drawn from a remembered lesson passed down through a single inherited memory.

rites.name: Villeostor
rites.text: A trained brewer-adept's technique that clouds an opponent's senses so they stagger about. It is learned by practitioners once they reach a modest level of mastery.

rites.name: Telarnilum
rites.text: A devotional craft that a cleric learns once they reach a certain standing. It grants an ally a lasting surge of inner vigor for half an hour.

rites.name: Resollia
rites.text: A sacred technique that empowers a blessed utterance of light, then either grants lasting strength to related rites or unfurls a field of restoring radiance. It excludes one rival rite, so a practitioner must choose between them.

rites.name: Sesauntanum
rites.text: A thief's practiced skill that lets a person take apart hidden snares and mechanical triggers. It proves most useful against hunters' traps and rare devices in certain sacred grounds and contested arenas, and it is taught once a rogue reaches a certain seasoned rank.

rites.name: Reosus Serentonium
rites.text: A frenzied survival knack that a hunter of shadow-beasts may choose in place of another, and which cannot be taken alongside a certain vanishing art. It is a pick that forces a choice between two paths.

rites.name: Vesor Tistianus
rites.text: A sacred discipline in which a warrior channels gathered heavenly wrath into strikes. It is bound to a companion vow that asks the bearer to welcome radiance.

rites.name: Vostarnum
rites.text: A ritual binding that ties a grieving spirit to a chosen vessel, granted to those who complete a difficult errand. It is offered as a reward for seekers who finish a trial.

rites.name: Cesinia
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to devoted champions of the temple orders, raising their resolve to its highest pitch. Over time it was divided into three separate forms, each suited to a different kind of warrior.

rites.name: Rallus Valelum
rites.text: A ritual craft that binds a dark whirlwind to a practitioner's sacred relic, sharpening its power. It answers to a related molten inscription found on the same relic.

rites.name: Ceoranus Tollia
rites.text: A quiet, always-active craft practiced by healers of the wild grove, letting them loosen harmful binds that hold a creature. It was once part of their training but has since been set aside.

rites.name: Milia Cestarnium
rites.text: A bonded hunter's gift, granted at a modest stage of training, that lets a tamed beast strike at foes from the air. It is a talent drawn on in contests between hunters.

rites.name: Lorus Rintanum
rites.text: A sacred ward taught to devoted guardians that softens every blow they absorb for a brief span of time. It serves as the lesser step toward a complete barrier that fends off all harm.

rites.name: Riasus Nollauntor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a caster carries at all times, granting steady sharpening of their sacred channeling without any act of will. It was once taught to novices in the lower cloisters of the order.

rites.name: Millia Villia
rites.text: A hidden-sight rite that lets a dark caster perceive unseen beings so they can be struck. It does not reveal those who lurk by stealth, only the ones bound by a veiled form.

rites.name: Ciror Lausum
rites.text: A tainted biting technique that a creature uses in a contest between tamed companions. It spreads a sickness through the wound it leaves.

rites.name: Tornus Serinia
rites.text: A sacred insight granted to devoted healers of the light, flowing from a hidden well of holy wisdom. It can be drawn into the bearer's craft when the chosen path is pursued.

rites.name: Oraloria
rites.text: A discipline in which a hidden practitioner spreads a quiet power across many small threads. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths, bound to a particular benevolent spirit's favor.

rites.name: Tellium Mollia
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets a devoted caster channel a lesser guardian spirit to tend the wounded. It is taken by those who serve in contests against rival orders.

rites.name: Tellonium
rites.text: A sacred volume of quiet reflection that grants its reader the practice of deep inward thought. Those who study its pages learn to still the mind and perceive the world through patient meditation.

rites.name: Teorium Valanontia
rites.text: A learned hunting discipline in which a tamed beast gains a deadly, sight-based grasp over foes, sharpening the skill of those who train in the arts of the chase.

rites.name: Telanaurnus
rites.text: A tainting affliction that certain fell beasts and wandering dead spread to the living. It weakens a victim's strength and wears away health over a long span of time.

rites.name: Meontallia
rites.text: A sacred vow of keeping apart, earned by a band who defeats a stone titan while never letting two of their members stand near one another during its dark ritual.

rites.name: Valeonor Sauror
rites.text: A carving power in which a practitioner inscribes marks that hold a forceful directive. It is drawn from a remembered sovereign command passed down among those who study the inscribed signs.

rites.name: Telasorum
rites.text: A sacred shielding craft practiced by the defenders of a holy order. It lets a guardian shield nearby companions from harm, and it can only be learned after long study in the discipline of defense.

rites.name: Caurnentes
rites.text: A ward-trait of hardened plating that guards its bearer from harm. It is bound to a companion plating-trait that shares its craft.

rites.name: Riarium Cauntalus
rites.text: A bound force of stored spirit energy that is gathered from reserves left behind after a fearsome foe is overcome in a dreaded tower. It lets its wielder draw upon that captured essence.

rites.name: Valeoranum Vonernus
rites.text: A summoned hunter's bite that is unleashed once upon arrival at a foe, after which the hunter keeps attacking until its summons fade away.

rites.name: Amellium Ameorontum
rites.text: A channeled dark rite that wounds a chosen foe and siphons their vitality into the caster, restoring the caster's own strength as the foe weakens.

rites.name: Ciarornanum
rites.text: A warrior's hardened hide that shields the wearer against harm. It works alongside several related traits that strengthen a fighter's defenses and force.

rites.name: Leonaulor
rites.text: A swift inscribed technique drawn from a dragon-script craft, taught to those who study it. It is a set of marks that lets a wielder of a blade move with rapid strokes.

rites.name: Vialisor
rites.text: A magical brand that a sorcerer can inscribe using a formidable ring. It marks a bearer with arcane power bound to the wearer's will.

rites.name: Valiarosia
rites.text: A channeled ritual that pulls the reserve of arcane energy out of a chosen foe and transfers it to the caster. Practitioners learn it after long study of shadowed rites.

rites.name: Lostus Manum
rites.text: A discipline of inner training that can be acquired by paying a fixed sum of carved sigils. It is taught to those who seek to deepen their bond with winged beasts.

rites.name: Telalor Seolium
rites.text: A cunning trait that only one kin of winged hunting beasts can draw upon, letting them slip past incoming blows far more often than before.

rites.name: Serintus Ameoliarnia
rites.text: A dark sigil bound to a sorcerer's relic that doubles the dread it carries. It is tied to two other mark-enchantments that answer its call.

rites.name: Lenus Teontum
rites.text: A practice of binding wyrm-like spirits to a caster's body, granting two separate powers that are drawn from the dragon-kin. It is taught to those who channel arcane force.

rites.name: Coraullanum Corasiarium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught to scholars of the moon-groves, letting a caster draw back a steady trickle of spent energy while they rest their mind. It is a gift of focus rather than force.

rites.name: Valiseolum
rites.text: A learned rite that a trained caster earns after long study, letting them call forth a fearsome mount. Seekers must first complete a costly chain of trials set by a robed teacher on a hill.

rites.name: Seriallor
rites.text: A keen sight that lets certain beings sense their surroundings while their minds remain tied to a verdant realm of visions. Gifted wardens of living growth use it to keep watch on two worlds at once.

rites.name: Corises Teostum
rites.text: A passive knack held by the brewmasters of a tipsy, bear-like folk, who keep their footing and their temper while staggering through a scuffle. It rests on a flagon's worth of stubborn cheer.

rites.name: Serillium Miasauntum
rites.text: A ritual craft taught to a seeker after a sacred vigil, letting the practitioner slip away into a verdant otherworld. It takes the place of an older, lunar-bound method of travel.

rites.name: Lantus Caustolium
rites.text: A learned practice that lets a caster take on several bodily shapes. Each shape is taught by a master or unlocked through personal study rather than won through trials.

rites.name: Corenintia
rites.text: A carving craft that is gained from a remembered attunement to the soil. It lets a practitioner shape runes that work through the ground.

rites.name: Siarnanum Canoles
rites.text: A hunter's beast gains a small added chance to strike a second time in one attack. Several other creature kinds share this gift, though a stronger rival gift grants greater adaptability.

rites.name: Reornasium
rites.text: A carving-craft tied to a remembered oath, drawn from a deep-kept recollection of duty. It lets a practitioner shape runes that bind a sworn obligation into the world.

rites.name: Valianentus
rites.text: A stored ground-born force that a bearer must draw upon as one of four enhancements needed to unlock a feat of raw might.

rites.name: Cernostus
rites.text: A tide-caller's craft that hurls a jolt of ground-bound force into a foe, its power rising with the stored surge the caster has spent.

rites.name: Amalanum Taurisium
rites.text: A ritual talent practiced by sacred caretakers, chosen as an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside a rival gust-calling rite.

rites.name: Marnauntum Sintialles
rites.text: A carving craft that draws its strength from a remembered sharpened gaze. Its power is gained through the recollection of a particular inner focus.

rites.name: Viseoles
rites.text: A ritual craft practiced within the balance path of the order's shapers. Practitioners must devote considerable study to the path before they can master it fully.

rites.name: Amerum Valonus
rites.text: A ritual renewal that shed-minded keepers gain as a reward for completing tasks in a distant forest realm. It lets a practitioner cast off an old form and take on a new one.

rites.name: Sereostanum Neornellum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by certain shamanic adepts, it can only be mastered once all foundational teachings are learned. It stands apart from other disciplines and draws on no connections to them.

rites.name: Taullia Sirauntus
rites.text: A hidden gift granted by a great living tree to those who tend its growth. It does not appear in any written record or visible listing of its bearer's abilities.

rites.name: Nianestum
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a remembered mending of worn hearth-stones. It is passed down through an inherited recollection.

rites.name: Coroleorus
rites.text: A ritual bond that lets a practitioner feel and answer the shifting of the soil. It is tied to two other gifts, one that stirs quaking and one that calls up molten fire.

rites.name: Lerinium
rites.text: A bound ward that a caster lays upon one ally at a time, drawing extra healing from the caster and spending its charges to mend the ally whenever blows land. It cannot coexist with other guardian wards.

rites.name: Oraustasia
rites.text: A binding craft that imbues footwear with a lasting surge of quickness and endurance. Once bound, the wearer moves swiftly and tires far more slowly.

rites.name: Teliaror Corernes
rites.text: A shade-calling rite is sung by a seer during a great clash of warring hosts on a plain of stone. The chanted spirits rise to fight for the caller's side.

rites.name: Coriaranum Reostausum
rites.text: A crackling power sealed within ancient shaman relics, bound to the mastery of storms and the sudden rush of elemental force.

rites.name: Valerum Amintia
rites.text: A shaper's talent that lets a practitioner choose it instead of its rival. It pairs with a companion beast, and taking one path closes off the other.

rites.name: Lornium Carnium
rites.text: A practiced knack of slipping free from pursuit, offered as one of several rival paths a wanderer may take. It cannot be combined with a second, competing gift called Cheat Death.

rites.name: Raurniasium
rites.text: A old scroll of calm teachings kept on the upper floor of a hall of training. It is burned as a vow to accept what is coming and to act upon it.

rites.name: Veostor Coreostus
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that draws its strength from a remembered balance among the world's forces. It is gained by recalling a specific, kept memory of such a harmony.

rites.name: Liarnus Nisus
rites.text: A preserving craft that keeps stone-bound beings intact. It works the same way as other stilling rites used on frozen folk in the wild lands.

rites.name: Rallausanum
rites.text: A radiant spirit-force is drawn from hidden reserves stored within a towering prison of the lost. Those who harness it gain a glowing power sourced from these hoarded essences.

rites.name: Valaunum Mintarnes
rites.text: A shaped spirit-form summoned by a robed seer to contest a rival in a sacred hall during a time of healing. It is a conjured manifestation of elemental power used for ritual combat.

rites.name: Teliarnium Riastellia
rites.text: A craft practiced by distillers who can occasionally brew a second potion alongside each one they make. The bonus extends to sealed reserve vials, which count as a kind of potion.

rites.name: Valaunes Amonanum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by reclusive order-monks, who cultivate a sustained resonance that answers their own calls. It must be chosen alongside a companion practice, and the two cannot be held together with any other.

rites.name: Telintornia
rites.text: A classification for blades and cutting arms whose keen metal rims can be honed by a smith's whetstones for a timed surge of harm. Blunt clubs, staves, and bare-fist weapons fall outside it and are sharpened with heavier stones instead.

rites.name: Siarnolia
rites.text: A discipline taught to ember-casters that sharpens their aim so their conjured flames strike true more often. It is a trained focus of the elemental arts.

rites.name: Veornium Serirnia
rites.text: A tracked goal for those who work with elemental magic, aimed at drawing forth and gathering the natural energies of the world. It serves as one of the aims within the practice of summoning elements.

rites.name: Coriastum Amiarestium
rites.text: A stored spiritual charge drawn from sealed reservoirs found deep within a dread spire. It lets its bearer channel raw elemental force.

rites.name: Lasilanum
rites.text: A carved rune-power that is drawn from a remembered vestige of an older ancestral form. Practitioners channel it through the inscribing of sacred marks.

rites.name: Teliaria Mesus
rites.text: A trait of the mist-tending monks that binds an artifact to the sway of drifting fog. It works together with two companion traits that share its wellspring of mystic vapor.

rites.name: Seollanum Vontallia
rites.text: A practice in which a practitioner channels stormy current into jolts that strike foes. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path that stands opposed to a melting craft.

rites.name: Sostanum Nenum
rites.text: A refined craft practiced by mages who channel renewing power. It is a selective branch of learning that can only be taken by those already trained under a particular dragon-blessed mentor.

rites.name: Teliaronum
rites.text: A glowing reserve of inner force that is drawn from hidden stores found within a grim, towering prison. It can be gathered and used as a power by those who seek it.

rites.name: Tiria Marnanum
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its strength from a remembered sacred glow. Those who etch the marks on stone are granted this inner force.

rites.name: Leolistor
rites.text: A carved-rune power drawn from a lingering remembrance of a cursed garment. It kindles faint glowing sparks used by those who inscribe runes.

rites.name: Oreolastia
rites.text: A mending craft drawn from raw primal forces, used to restore the body and strengthen a practitioner's gifts. It is bound to the wolves that prowl the fells and to the tempests that roll across the sky.

rites.name: Amoleonanum
rites.text: A resonant power drawn from hidden reserves of stored life-force sealed within a towering prison of the cursed. Its bearers gain strength by gathering these lingering residues.

rites.name: Oraunornia
rites.text: A summoning craft in which practitioners call forth arcane spirits of the elements. Its masters draw these bound entities from the wild currents of magic.

rites.name: Molia Lanor
rites.text: A ritual craft that sharpens the potency of enchantments carved into a practitioner's weapons. It is taught among the spirit-wardens who channel storm and flame into steel.

rites.name: Neostiasium
rites.text: A quiet inborn gift that lets elemental mystics extend their hold over the forces of nature. It is granted once a practitioner reaches a set threshold of training.

rites.name: Amalerum
rites.text: A temple rite that a healer may learn once reaching a high rank, though the gift is not assured until a later stage of training.

rites.name: Valelinus Coronum
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique practiced by wandering monks, granted to students who reach an advanced stage of training. Its mastery comes gradually, and not every apprentice is certain to receive it.

rites.name: Valilum Meolles
rites.text: A life-force gift granted by two paired dealers within a towering prison of the cursed dead. It lets a bearer knit back wounds and restore strength through an inner essence.

rites.name: Tirnaunor
rites.text: A ritual that permanently imbues a band of metal so that the bearer's strikes land harder. Only a practitioner's own bands can receive the binding, and once bound the band becomes tied to its owner alone.

rites.name: Coreornus Valintesus
rites.text: A sacred discipline held by avenging oath-bearers that lets their resolve endure without limit. It is bound to the judgment-bearing gifts and the templar's might.

rites.name: Serisum Nauliarus
rites.text: A chill-bearing spell craft that a caster may gain as a lasting boon, though its arrival is uncertain. It is offered to those who advance far enough along their path.

rites.name: Valerontia
rites.text: A discipline taught within a monastic order in which a practitioner's strikes are sharpened by a surge of inner might. The gift arrives at a varied point of training, and some seekers never receive it.

rites.name: Rostus Marnia
rites.text: A bond of storm-craft that a ritual caster may learn while still young, though full mastery only comes later in the training. It lets a current of lightning leap from one foe to another.

rites.name: Miarnium Nintus
rites.text: A passive gift borne by a guardian of the wild, it lets a shapeshifter in bear form cast its glowing marking without any waiting period, while doubling the harm it deals.

rites.name: Serantum Sesor
rites.text: A devotional craft that lets a temple-trained adept welcome gloom into their practice. It cannot be learned alongside a rival path of darkness.

rites.name: Ameornia Causialanum
rites.text: A battle discipline that warriors may learn once they reach a certain standing, though mastery is not granted until later. It strengthens a fighter's cutting strikes.

rites.name: Ciasallanum
rites.text: A ritual trait borne by protective wardens of the wild. It joins with other savage marks that sharpen claws, strengthen brute force and harden the body.

rites.name: Saunillia
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to seers of the old orders, arriving early in their training but only firmly bestowed once they have grown much further along the path.

rites.name: Teliantanum Monteolium
rites.text: A mystic craft that grows stronger while a set of animated corpses remain standing. It is bound to a rival soul-binder whose defeat is required to complete it.

rites.name: Rellium Corestontum
rites.text: A temple discipline in which a healer chooses between two linked gifts of restoration, and taking one closes the other. It is practiced alongside a swift recovery of strength.

rites.name: Castor Coralor
rites.text: A monastic craft of sealed casks, in which a practitioner gains a strengthened blow when striking a cask. Initiates may begin learning it early, though mastery comes only later in training.

rites.name: Tastiales
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that lengthens a warrior's frenzied rage by a few heartbeats. It may awaken early in a guardian's training, though it is not promised until later.

rites.name: Coreontia Neontallia
rites.text: A ward worked into a traveler's cloak by binding a flame-spirit's essence to the fabric. It grants lasting protection against heat, useful when delving into glowing underground halls, though its craft was later abandoned.

rites.name: Teontor Corirestus
rites.text: A ritual working taught to channelers that calls forth green growth. It is passed on through a trial of compassion undertaken before mentors.

rites.name: Tarnenum
rites.text: A disciplined temple-trained technique in which a fighter whirls in a looping strike that gradually grows stronger. It is granted to practitioners who reach a certain stage of their training, though it may take longer to master.

rites.name: Lesteonor
rites.text: A discipline taught to healers in a sacred grove that amplifies the restorative force of their direct touch-mending rites. It strengthens nearly every single-recipient healing invocation a practitioner performs.

rites.name: Coranteoria
rites.text: A ritual bond lets a folk take on the gifts of the spirit whose shrine they tend. Once used, the gift must rest for five days before it can be called again.

rites.name: Serastia Coraulor
rites.text: A quiet trait of stealthy craft that lets its bearer slip unseen into shadow. It works hand in hand with a pair of companion traits that sharpen luck and striking accuracy.

rites.name: Nostiasia
rites.text: A guardian's sleeping art lets a druid's bond with the grove take hold in combat. It is taught to those who reach a certain standing among their kin.

rites.name: Corianeoles
rites.text: A bound-spirit gift granted to a caster's craft, arriving once the practitioner reaches a certain depth of study. It may not be bestowed until a later stage of mastery.

rites.name: Vollia Serontum
rites.text: A ritual binding that permanently charges a close-combat blade so that it occasionally surges its wielder's striking strength, while the bearer's protective hide grows thinner.

rites.name: Orialernus
rites.text: A grim sworn discipline granted to death warriors who wield cold blade-craft, bestowing a mighty crushing strike. It is offered early in training but only reliably granted after long trials.

rites.name: Meolium Orenium
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a practitioner call forth a shadowy feline companion. The summoned beast marks a notable feat of strength for its keeper.

rites.name: Cirollanum
rites.text: A ritual binding that is sewn into a cloak so that it permanently shields the wearer against bitter cold. Only a master of the craft can perform the working.

rites.name: Riantes Corines
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that lets a warrior endure a strike, drawing its strength from a remembered recovery. It is learned through a memory rather than practice.

rites.name: Oresarnes
rites.text: A temple discipline that lets a devotee's inner spirit grow sturdier as they advance in rank. It was later superseded by a more exalted rite.

rites.name: Ciarnor Reonia
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to fighters that strengthens the back of the leg, allowing them to cripple foes. Its mastery comes only to those who have advanced far in their training.

rites.name: Viasauntor
rites.text: A temple-trained devotional rite that lets a holy seeker draw out the thoughts of others. It can be learned early in one's training, though its full mastery is only granted to those who persist.

rites.name: Maurnium Nollanum
rites.text: A tide-touched healing quality carried in small charged beads of sea spray. It is bound to a sea-calling power and to two related mist and pool attunements.

rites.name: Nelleorus Meollum
rites.text: A binding ritual that imbues a traveler's hooded mantle with a modest protective charm against dark, shadowy forces. Only a practitioner of considerable skill can weave the sigil into the cloth.

rites.name: Laustia Liastanum
rites.text: A cloak can be permanently bound with a ward that grants the wearer a sturdy defense against wild growth and living elements. Only a practitioner of high arcane skill can bind it.

rites.name: Coranistes
rites.text: A sacred inner gift cultivated by spiritual practitioners, granted at a certain stage of their growth but not always assured until later mastery is reached.

rites.name: Vintus Miastium
rites.text: A bound trait carried by a hunter's relic that turns suffering into a shield. It works alongside two sibling traits that answer pain with spikes and with harm to foes.

rites.name: Oraullus Nolium
rites.text: A forbidden binding that sends writhing coils to swallow wellsprings of arcane power. Whoever disturbs its hold loses fingers to the feeding force, yet can unmask a hidden stranger.

rites.name: Raustes Neoralles
rites.text: A late-tier discipline in which warriors of the oath empower their binding marks, so that each judgment they pass unleashes a distinct echo honoring the knights who first wielded it.

rites.name: Mialeontia
rites.text: A ritual binding that is worked into a cloak so that it permanently shields its wearer against heat and flame. Only a practitioner of high mastery can perform the working.

rites.name: Telialum Vantum
rites.text: A ritual binding that fixes a surge of elemental energy into a close-combat blade. The edge now sometimes strikes with that raw elemental force.

rites.name: Melus Valiasium
rites.text: A lasting cold that the bearer may take as a sworn gift. It binds itself exclusively to one of two paired arts, so a practitioner must choose which to keep.

rites.name: Amistium Serneosum
rites.text: A dark sigil-trait that a guardian keeper carries as a relic. It works alongside three bodily talents: hardened hide, ragged talons, and a brutal grappling strength.

rites.name: Corestiles
rites.text: A learned art of the fire-caster that sharpens the force of a hurled ball of flame. Once taught in the orders, it was later struck from the ways of the craft.

rites.name: Amentostor
rites.text: A borrowed courage drawn from spiritual essence, offered by two shadowy dealers in a grim tower of punishment. It lends its bearer a stronger heart for the trials within.

rites.name: Tiasontum
rites.text: A monastic inner discipline carried by brew-keeping mendicants. It is bound to a companion practice that draws on shadowed brewing.

rites.name: Telinor Ceonalus
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a practitioner siphons strength from a rival through a sworn bond. It cannot be learned alongside a mastery of dark rites.

rites.name: Valilostor
rites.text: A stored spiritual charge that a pair of dealers in a cursed spire sell to climbers. It grants a boost of power when drawn upon.

rites.name: Neles Renanum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft wraps a wounded ally in a drifting cloud that does not mend at once but slowly restores them over time.

rites.name: Riaseollus
rites.text: A tiered discipline taught within a wilderness-stalking order, it lets its practitioners ensnare their quarry with traps set to hold and slow the target.

rites.name: Tilles Ciastor
rites.text: A binding craft in which a keeper of the wild calls up living tendrils from the earth to seize a foe. A certain transformation of the keeper's form lets the tendrils take hold at once, with no pause.

rites.name: Neolia Sereolor
rites.text: A deadly finishing technique used by stealthy killers that delivers an immediate toxic strike and raises the odds of leaving lingering venom in the target.

rites.name: Reorus Orilornes
rites.text: A shimmering passage conjured by two arcane casters at a desert ruin, letting a pair of travelers step across to a hidden vault during a daring theft.

rites.name: Tiantesium
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that lets a practitioner slip out of the present world, drawn from a remembered flight. It is gained by learning the memory that holds it.

rites.name: Telales Ameontum
rites.text: A cursed inscription carved into a ritual blade that grants its bearer a sustained, fiery skill of ruin. It is bound to four other flame-born rites of the same order.

rites.name: Sontiasum
rites.text: A healing craft drawn from a sacred world-tree's sap, bound into a keeper's relic. It links to several other sacred gifts carried by the same keepers.

rites.name: Serornus Nantaustor
rites.text: A sacred green power once bestowed by a great living tree upon the nature-keepers of an ancient order. It let those who received it call upon the wild to heal and restore what had been harmed.

rites.name: Valonausium
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a ranger's arrows carry a rare binding charge. It is no longer available to practitioners of the art.

rites.name: Lantenes
rites.text: A warming gift drawn from hidden stores in a grim tower, granted to those who wield arcane craft. Once claimed, it opens the way to a colder art offered by later finds.

rites.name: Corises Caustor
rites.text: A ritual sigil that reshapes a wielder's outward form so that it takes on the look of their bonded companion beast.

rites.name: Seresornum
rites.text: A flame-bound trait that clings to a sorcerer's relic and feeds on fire. It is tied to the traits of a devouring maw and a rising bird of ash.

rites.name: Ceosonanum Amiarium
rites.text: A sacred judgment mark that a chosen warrior may call upon, paired in opposition with a rival rite of final ending. Only one of the two can be taken.

rites.name: Telornes Reosium
rites.text: A sacred mending trait that lets its bearers keep their living renewal flowing without end. It is bound closely to two other blessings of the green-keeping orders.

rites.name: Nanium Aminia
rites.text: A silencing curse that falls on anyone who lingers in a sacred pool beneath a great tree. It lingers for a short time after leaving the water and keeps casters from speaking spells.

rites.name: Amellum Valistia
rites.text: A spiritual trait that lets a hunter's bound spirit burst outward in flame. It is tied to a lingering trial and a blazing soul.

rites.name: Ameollium Telistor
rites.text: A restless power drawn from hidden reserves within a grim tower of punishment. Its energy keeps shifting and rolling through whoever gathers it.

rites.name: Rornilus
rites.text: A quiet, always-active gift borne by a sworn champion of light, one that grants skill without needing to be called upon. It is unlocked once the champion reaches a high standing of training.

rites.name: Vesia Ceosestanum
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught within temple orders, in which practitioners draw life-force from the world around them. It is chosen exclusively and cannot be combined with the Shifting Veil path.

rites.name: Reolanum Valiastia
rites.text: A mystic attunement that lets a sorcerer's relic respond to the currents of unseen energy. It binds closely with several other enchantments that shape its power.

rites.name: Verilanum
rites.text: A spirit-force drawn from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence kept in a towering prison-keep. It is a power that can be gathered and claimed by those who find these stores.

rites.name: Tellianor
rites.text: A lingering blessing that is gained by taking up a certain sworn duty. It strengthens its bearer for as long as the oath is carried.

rites.name: Lauria Vantillus
rites.text: A bound psychic weight that takes the shape of a spectral double of a fallen dark-blood warlock. It is kept within a sanctified shrine and wakes into a projection when disturbed.

rites.name: Mostialles
rites.text: A bloodline ritual in which a creature's bite reshapes it mid-contest. The change arrives during combat, so a fighter must read it as the struggle unfolds.

rites.name: Teoraullus
rites.text: A monastic inner power that is tied to two other sacred traits. It is cultivated by mystic keepers who draw on clouded, veiled currents.

rites.name: Caraulor
rites.text: A swift, instant strike a rogue uses to finish a foe or carve away a large portion of its strength. Its force grows with the rogue's own might and the number of built-up marks spent.

rites.name: Nerum Maunia
rites.text: A fading inscription technique by which a practitioner might shape restorative power into a written sigil. It belongs to the soul-based arts of inscription.

rites.name: Orialum Serillia
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that draws its force from a remembered wolf-spirit's lingering vital spark. Practitioners etch runes that channel this stored essence into their own strength.

rites.name: Sauresor
rites.text: A lasting blessing worked into a breastplate that hardens its wearer against the blows of rival fighters. It adds a measure of steadiness when battling other warriors.

rites.name: Valaustor Serelum
rites.text: A lesser ward-craft that a caster learns once they reach a certain standing. It takes the place of a stronger barrier, offering a feebler shield that can be called upon far more often.

rites.name: Amaulium Varnanum
rites.text: A bond-trait that a mist-bladed sworn figure bestows upon followers. It cannot coexist with two rival bonds, a disciplined preparation and a fearless dueling spirit.

rites.name: Tausilia
rites.text: A caster conjures a floating, disembodied eye that can be steered across the land, sharing its sight so the caster learns the terrain and the creatures dwelling there. The caster must stay still in a trance while it lasts, and the eye is fragile and easily shattered.

rites.name: Nesum Ameorenanum
rites.text: A relic-trait carried by a wild shaper, granted only after its holder has gathered every other sacred mark of the order.

rites.name: Marus Seriarenes
rites.text: A trait of the stout delvers that lets them recover extra shards from ancient digs. Their surveys also proceed quicker than those of ordinary scholars.

rites.name: Coreosteria
rites.text: A tracker can seize the senses of a bonded companion beast for one short span of time. While linked, the tracker directs the creature's movements as though guiding it from within.

rites.name: Cialaria
rites.text: A devotional hush that a caster draws over themselves to ease the attention of hostile creatures. While it lingers, foes notice them from a shorter distance.

rites.name: Lestarnia
rites.text: A protective sacred trait borne by warriors of devotion, bound to three related blessings of light and sacrifice. It shields its bearer through the linked gifts that accompany it.

rites.name: Sirnialia
rites.text: A sworn judge's fury that swells when a condemned foe is brought low. It is a disciplined gift a warrior can only take in exchange for the one oath that fits it.

rites.name: Coriallanum Rostintes
rites.text: A borrowed grace drawn from hidden reserves of stored spiritual essence sealed deep within a cursed spire. It is taken up by those who once served a sacred order but have since turned away from it.

rites.name: Tisor Amiastor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets a blade-bearer strike more effectively against foes whose guard is already broken. It works in concert with two other sworn disciplines of combat.

rites.name: Rasia Niarnium
rites.text: A lingering restorative art that stretches the mending of wounds beyond the usual span. It is bound to a group of related traditions that draw on living breath and drifting mist.

rites.name: Amenastanum
rites.text: A trait of the brewing order's cask-keeping monks, granted by a wandering companion of an ancient sage. It lets a monk's ale-barrel burst outward when it is needed.

rites.name: Reostum Selaunes
rites.text: A glowing light that clings to a foe and marks them for the druid's kin. The mark tints the target visibly, making it easier to strike.

rites.name: Mernanum Vianollum
rites.text: A tracker's craft that lets a hunter perceive the vulnerabilities of a foe. It is taught along the seventh rank of the wild path.

rites.name: Ceolus Corines
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that is drawn from the recollection of a balanced, watchful eye. It lets its wielder inscribe marks that channel this inherited vision into living magic.

rites.name: Seraurnium Coriastelia
rites.text: A guardian's watchful gift that grants a sworn defender a ward-craft of sight, learned through an oath of truthkeeping. It is practiced by those who shield others.

rites.name: Ceranum Valeonestus
rites.text: A hunter's trait that lets a wielder unleash a violent burst of force. It works alongside three other linked gifts of the chase.

rites.name: Taurnium Vintanum
