rites.text: A sacred gift granted to devoted servants of the temple, a rite of restored devotion that mends a spirit's strength once it has been earned at a high standing.

rites.name: Cirnia Rauntia
rites.text: A sworn guardian's exclusive gift that bursts from a chosen node, bound closely to the Sigil of Oath. It can be taken only in place of its rival path.

rites.name: Seontiasum
rites.text: A bound manual that teaches its reader how to become more skilled at tending wounds. Its lessons carry a novice healer past the middle ranks of bandaging craft.

rites.name: Sentium Tillentanum
rites.text: A carving-craft drawn from a remembered inscription. Those who learn to read its marks can channel a particular kind of inscribed force.

rites.name: Taulonia Tostus
rites.text: A seer's gift that lets a practitioner look across great distances and observe faraway places. It is drawn from the tie between spirit-wardens and the wider land.

rites.name: Reoralum
rites.text: A mastery earned by a wanderer who has gathered two hundred and twenty-five marks of skill in the old ways of angling by river and tide. It is recorded as a badge of patient craft among the shore-keepers.

rites.name: Taulum Oriseorum
rites.text: A piercing gaze-strike wielded by a shadowy creature during contests of trained beasts. It lances from the eyes to wound an opponent in battle.

rites.name: Tauntiallor
rites.text: A dark inherited craft in which a caster's malign working lingers and rebounds on the bearer. It is bound to a withering gift that drains the caster until only a shell remains.

rites.name: Tosalia
rites.text: A feral sorcerous strike performed in beast shape, spent at the close of a combo to deal harm scaled to gathered sparks. Adepts may pour extra vigor into it to nearly double its ferocity.

rites.name: Telianeosum
rites.text: A small band of stone sentries holds a stairway until a robed caster rises from among them and unleashes a burst of sorcery that destroys every guard. Afterward the caster sinks to one knee, spent.

rites.name: Sinaurnium
rites.text: A companion's restorative rite available only to one brood of beasts, mending its body and renewing its vigor over a short span of time.

rites.name: Telialium Amelaunia
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that wards a practitioner by drawing on a remembered sealed flame. It is gained through the recollection of such a bound fire.

rites.name: Cornes Telesauntor
rites.text: A bonding mark is pressed into a soul, granted by a mist-wielding blade-bearer. It lets the bearer carry a hidden weakness that is sealed within them.

rites.name: Amianeollum
rites.text: A wild inner current that a shaper of beasts can draw upon from a sacred relic. It is bound to two other enduring gifts that guard and fortify the bearer.

rites.name: Nolles Sianeornium
rites.text: A skill that creatures in beast contests use during their bouts to restore strength. It is applied in the middle of a match between tamed companions.

rites.name: Tirnum Casor
rites.text: A quiet, always-on instinct held by shapeshifting wardens that dulls the awareness of watchers when the wearer moves low and silent as a stalking beast.

rites.name: Mesoranum
rites.text: A carving discipline that channels deadly force through marks inscribed on the skin. Its lore is passed down through a single recovered memory-relic.

rites.name: Niantollia
rites.text: A withering hold-power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit-essence found in a dread spire of ruin. It is gathered from those hidden stores and wielded by those who seek to bind their foes.

rites.name: Orineolanum
rites.text: A consecrated blessing that a cleric calls upon to shield an ally from one dreaded compulsion. The protection holds for a few minutes and is spent upon the first fear that strikes, even against a warrior already steeled by a fury.

rites.name: Mirnanum Serorum
rites.text: A ward-craft used by a robed caster that turns hostile spellwork back on its sender. Each incoming incantation drains the attacker's reserves of power and injures them in the process.

rites.name: Lintiaranum
rites.text: A daily ritual in which a devotee offers mana to a sealed arcanist so that she can keep working. Without the offering, the arcanist cannot act at all.

rites.name: Corolisium
rites.text: A ward found within a hollow in a volcanic crag that, once touched, grants a temporary protective veil. While it lasts, a blow may be drawn into a shimmering shield instead of harming the bearer.

rites.name: Amillaustor
rites.text: A divining art lets its user glimpse faraway sights and distant lands. Old orders once kept it in written scrolls, and rival seers use a spirit-based form of it to anticipate enemy moves.

rites.name: Saunes Veornum
rites.text: A ritual discipline that sharpens a bound summoned servant's mind and deepens the caster's reserve of inner power. It was later set aside by the order's council.

rites.name: Caustanum Amenes
rites.text: A daily ritual in which keepers pour arcane essence into a bound sage so she can keep her mind working. Without this nightly offering, the sage's craft falters.

rites.name: Tausiria
rites.text: A daily observance held within a sunken vault of the Maw, undertaken after a bold decree has been fulfilled. Its devotees nourish their inner spirit through the rite.

rites.name: Orallor Teonium
rites.text: A dark incantation cast by a sorcerer that drives a lone foe into panicked flight. The victim is left unable to fight for a short while.

rites.name: Leraunes
rites.text: A temple discipline in which a practitioner's inner brewing draws strength from fierce, precise blows, sharpening the chance of a decisive strike.

rites.name: Corellaures
rites.text: A shaman's rite calls forth two spectral hunting beasts that may strike separate foes but obey the same spoken orders. Their attacks restore the caller's vitality, and they fade after a short span or when slain.

rites.name: Lostia Oristum
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lets a binder shorten the time needed to call forth a bound servant, but only for a brief window after invoking it.

rites.name: Serasum Orarnolium
rites.text: A savage combat gift that lets a shapeshifting wild caster inflict lasting bleeding on foes in duels. Adepts of the wilds unlock it once they reach a certain standing in their training.

rites.name: Cenontum
rites.text: A carving craft that lets a practitioner shape glowing marks into stone and bone, drawn from a remembered trance of burning chant. It is passed down through inherited recollection rather than taught.

rites.name: Carnianor
rites.text: A passive discipline taught to novice wanderers that changes how their basic strike looks depending on the implement they carry. The strike's force and cost stay unchanged, so only its outward form shifts.

rites.name: Rinauria
rites.text: A savage instinct held by the keepers of a sacred grove, whose hunting frenzy is bound to a related rending power. It awakens within those who walk the wild paths.

rites.name: Tontaunes
rites.text: A cursed rite of the grim dead-knights in which a blow leaves a rotting sore on the struck foe. The sore keeps spreading corruption until the victim is cleansed.

rites.name: Rosia Valontes
rites.text: A soul-binding gift is conferred by a dream-weaving patron, bestowing a lasting trait upon those it touches. The mark lets the bearer feel stirred awake within sleeping visions.

rites.name: Corerintes
rites.text: A wild-hearted rite of the grove-keepers that lets a shapeshifter tear into a chosen foe with savage claws, leaving bleeding wounds that keep draining the victim.

rites.name: Vosiallium
rites.text: A lasting binding that wraps a close-combat blade in living flame, so that its strikes often scorch the target with extra burning harm. The fire cloaks the weapon for as long as the binding holds.

rites.name: Vernes Tontus
rites.text: A fierce battle-spirit that lies dormant within a wind-dancing ascetic's relic. It stirs in tandem with a second, divided inner nature bound to the same sacred object.

rites.name: Oreosontum
rites.text: A dark martial gift that sharpens the strikes of a bearer who wields a cursed blade. It belongs to the cold-blooded death warriors who serve the grave.

rites.name: Orineornium
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that a shaman lays upon a melee weapon, so that each strike carries added fire harm. It can be woken once a practitioner reaches a seventh stage of training.

rites.name: Restes Vianestum
rites.text: A ring of burning heat is conjured around three people at once, and anyone who steps across its edge brings ruin upon the entire gathering. Those who stay motionless until the flames fade remain safe.

rites.name: Amallornor
rites.text: A sacred craft in which ritual waters are called forth to swell and sweep across the land. It binds to the surge-bearers, the inner pressure of haste, the bonds of service to a sovereign, and the slow accumulating cost of repeated rites.

rites.name: Oroles Telilum
rites.text: A discipline taught to fire-wielding casters that intensifies every lingering burn they inflict. Its effects stack across several smouldering hexes, letting a practitioner's slow flames bite harder over time.

rites.name: Sereonium Taurnillia
rites.text: A quiet ember-craft that a fire-wielding combatant carries within, briefly swelling their vitality, the force of their strikes, and how far those strikes can reach.

rites.name: Telaniastor
rites.text: A carved inscription-craft that is drawn from a hollow recollection of the closing decree. It lets its bearer inscribe final judgments into stone.

rites.name: Amiserum
rites.text: A lasting blessing that settles on a traveler once a companion of their own band finishes a sacred errand of carrying a kindled flame from a hearth. It hardens the bearer against harm for a time.

rites.name: Silum Coreostum
rites.text: A sharpening craft that lets a practitioner hone ancestral remains into keen, cutting edges. The power is gathered from hidden stores found within a dread-ridden spire.

rites.name: Oronium Teolauntes
rites.text: A branching growth discipline in which a caster draws life from the greenery around them. It cannot be combined with a rival infusion technique taught in the same circle.

rites.name: Liasaulium Coreosium
rites.text: A sworn judge's final mark that can be chosen in place of a sentence of execution. Once bound, it lets the wielder pass judgment that cannot be taken back.

rites.name: Mauranum Sastum
rites.text: A bodily discipline practiced by a martial brotherhood that reshapes living tissue for war. Members may gain the art only through a temporary trial that ends with its completed storyline.

rites.name: Villanum Tosiarnium
rites.text: A kindled inner heat that binds to a caster's craft of ruin. It grows alongside two other wayward gifts, one of chaos and one of enduring the unnatural.

rites.name: Seoreles
rites.text: A bond-gift bestowed by the sky-keeper Thessaly that lets a warrior strike before rivals act. It cannot coexist with two other bond-gifts that govern facing foes and holding ground.

rites.name: Serollaunes
rites.text: A swift restorative rite practiced by consecrated guardians who need to mend a wounded ally at once. It works far quicker than its slower counterpart but drains a caster's reserves faster than is wise.

rites.name: Verollia
rites.text: A carving craft that draws its strength from a remembered flame spirit. Those who practice it inscribe sigils that channel a hidden inner blaze.

rites.name: Tileontanum
rites.text: A fiery power carried by a sacred relic that channels the force of flame. It is bound to two other relic powers that deepen a wielder's command over the elements.

rites.name: Nallium Leranum
rites.text: A flame-bearing exhalation drawn from winged reptilian companions, summoned on command. It was once known under an older, plainer name.

rites.name: Rastanum Sillanum
rites.text: A disciplined combat art taught in monastic halls, where a practitioner of the lightest-footed school gains a deadly striking technique once they reach advanced mastery.

rites.name: Telilentia
rites.text: A kindling power that a bearer gathers toward a great trial of might. While it burns, it scorches nearby foes at a steady pace that rises with the bearer's growing rank.

rites.name: Amoniasor
rites.text: A carved shrine planted by a caster to lash out at nearby foes with flame. It was later superseded by a spell that releases the same burning burst.

rites.name: Amiranum Oraulianium
rites.text: A temporary blessing is gained by tossing a flowering ember into a great hearth fire. The one who receives it feels a surge of fierce, flaring vigor.

rites.name: Marnes Sirnantes
rites.text: An old ember-calling art once practiced by fire-minded healers. Its workings were later folded into a larger rite of the hearth.

rites.name: Sanium Ciarnelum
rites.text: A wild-craft binding that slows the caster's descent, letting them leap from great heights without harm. It is taught through a grove-keeper's bound scroll of lore.

rites.name: Amostium Meorontia
rites.text: A dim ember-power that is drawn from consumed essence after a hungry cell is hurled at a stone-guardian within a cursed spire of the dead.

rites.name: Siarus Siantia
rites.text: A hunter's craft that binds to a survival relic and grants a trait. It works alongside a few related traits that share its lineage.

rites.name: Taurniaria
rites.text: A borrowed fire that is drawn from sealed reliquary stores hidden deep within a grim spiral tower of punishment. It is gathered from those hoards and carried away as a power a wanderer can wield.

rites.name: Miantalles
rites.text: A sudden focusing craft that is drawn from a stored recollection. Practitioners carve glyphs to channel the swift sharpening of the mind.

rites.name: Valirnelum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that lets a practitioner strike with a venomous fire-strike. It is drawn from a remembered trace of a fire-tending adept.

rites.name: Tianes Telialirum
rites.text: A rite-craft granted to seasoned shamans of the elemental order, unlocked once they reach the eighth stage of their training. It lets the practitioner call on both flame and frost.

rites.name: Ceostia Taliaranum
rites.text: A swift mending incantation cast by acolytes to restore one wounded ally at once. It costs more of the caster's reserve than slower rites, but it saves those who would not survive a longer chant.

rites.name: Voristia
rites.text: A discipline of the temple wind-adepts that ties a practitioner's strikes to gusts of air. It works alongside several linked arts of balance, sudden blasts, and inner stillness.

rites.name: Valiarnanum Orasium
rites.text: A blast of searing heat that erupts outward from a monstrous caster, striking every foe nearby. It was once so forceful it locked victims in place, but its power was later softened to a simple shove that can be disrupted.

rites.name: Amollium Rosia
rites.text: A fighter readies a hidden technique, then strikes a foe five times in quick succession, each blow stacking a mark that finally bursts the target's chest with lethal force.

rites.name: Miranum Valoleornor
rites.text: A shaman's craft that binds a lingering burn to a foe, and the burn can strike with sudden extra force. Practitioners sharpen its strength by honing their spell focus.

rites.name: Mallus Siallanum
rites.text: A bright surge of kindled heat that a flame-wielding adept may unlock once they reach a lofty standing in their craft. It marks the fire-caster who has earned a place among the elite.

rites.name: Seosum Valausia
rites.text: A brief rite of shadowed devotion granted to temple initiates who reach a high standing. It is a short-lived blessing that wraps the faithful in a fleeting darkness.

rites.name: Caustus Venasus
rites.text: A flaming barrier wraps the caster and nearby allies. Anyone who strikes a warded companion is scorched by fire, and higher tiers also harden the wards against heat.

rites.name: Seostia Oronteornia
rites.text: A short incantation drawn from the arcane arts, learned at an early stage of study. Practitioners who follow the flame path can awaken a stronger form of it through focused training.

rites.name: Nostia Valileror
rites.text: A sanctioned talent for kindling inner flame, available to channelers who take the vital focus. It can only be chosen in place of its rival path.

rites.name: Oriles Coreolor
rites.text: A bonded gift granted by a sea-lord that sharpens the mind through chant. It cannot be held alongside two rival disciplines.

rites.name: Lesor Salum
rites.text: A practitioner of the wild calls three woven guardians from the roots of the land. For ten heartbeats they draw the attention of foes and strike at anyone who enters a chosen ring of ground.

rites.name: Telirnus Nolliantum
rites.text: A sacred working that imbues wrist-guards with a surge of raw bodily vigor. It is taught by temple scribes to those who wish to bind great strength into armor.

rites.name: Tialisanum
rites.text: A sworn ward-craft that lets a guardian channel their resentment into a single chosen foe. It can be taken only in place of a rival discipline that lifts a shield into the air.

rites.name: Teleonerium
rites.text: A dormant power of inner energy that is recovered from hidden reserves buried deep within a grim, tormented tower. It lets its bearer draw strength from those forgotten stores.

rites.name: Teleostia
rites.text: A mystical reinforcement power drawn from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence sealed within a deep vertical prison-tower. It strengthens the wearer's legs and can be gathered from those caches.

rites.name: Amiases Liastia
rites.text: A scroll of binding script that teaches its reader how to imbue a blade with a sharp wintry power. The knowledge can be inscribed onto a weapon once learned.

rites.name: Valirnontus
rites.text: A parchment formula that teaches its reader how to imbue a blade with the power of a keen intellect. It is a common reward kept among the crafting-minded.

rites.name: Mornes Valeontia
rites.text: A sacred attunement that a temple-trained keeper can channel through a relic. It is bound to two related inner virtues, faith and awe.

rites.name: Seralleones
rites.text: A crafting formula that teaches how to imbue a band with a swiftness sigil. It is granted as a reward for completing a specific commission from a workshop.

rites.name: Nostiallor
rites.text: A bound inner gift that a craftsman of bone bestows upon a chosen soul. It fixes a spirit to a particular calling and shapes how that spirit dreams and senses.

rites.name: Cauniantes
rites.text: A gift granted to a devoted temple adept who has reached the tenth rung of their discipline. It belongs to the path of mist-shapers and can be claimed only at that rank.

rites.name: Nallanum Viantus
rites.text: A closing trial that only sorcerers may undertake, granting a transformation charm. Its effect matches the older sheep-changing charm, except the subject becomes a small swine.

rites.name: Cintanum Relanus
rites.text: A temple-trained discipline that quickens a caster's dispelling rite and sharpens the force of every spell they weave, lifting both harm and mending.

rites.name: Valirostia
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline that lets a caster channel the living growth of the wilds into healing. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths alongside a synthesis practice.

rites.name: Siror Orollor
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that channels the strength of a remembered dread-beast. It is gained by those who hold the beast's recollection.

rites.name: Serolaunum Leostium
rites.text: A binding recipe that teaches a caster how to shape a small glowing spirit into a loyal companion. The spirit follows its keeper like a drifting light.

rites.name: Renes Lastontium
rites.text: A passive discipline that sharpens the strikes of a tamed beast's special attacks while a bonded command is active. It makes each blow heavier and more likely to land a crushing hit.

rites.name: Rasornes
rites.text: A sealed recipe that teaches an enchanter how to bind a lantern-spirit into a small companion. The rite turns an ordinary vessel into a loyal, glowing familiar.

rites.name: Launium Millestum
rites.text: A written recipe that teaches its reader how to imbue a blade with the power of the sea. It is given as the reward for completing a specific task.

rites.name: Seraliantia
rites.text: A bound book of hidden spells that lets its reader weave false images over the world. Only members of a certain sworn brotherhood may acquire and study its pages.

rites.name: Seraunernum
rites.text: A mystical protective craft that wards workers of hidden arts. It connects to several related enchantment traits that shape how such wards are kindled and sustained.

rites.name: Oreonus Taurnalia
rites.text: A mystic gift that a seeker can choose in place of another, pairing it with rival disciplines of flame-wrought fury or soothing waters. Taking one path closes the other.

rites.name: Seontonor
rites.text: A scroll that teaches its reader how to imbue a blade with a superior form of striking power. The lesson is passed on once and then fades from the page.

rites.name: Ameonastes
rites.text: A reagent-marked scroll that teaches its reader how to bind a parrying charm onto a shield. It turns up as a rare find in the wild lands and the dark halls far beyond the home realm.

rites.name: Ceonium Caustor
rites.text: A carved frost-scroll that teaches its reader how to bind a biting cold into a blade. It is found only as a rare reward dropped by a grieving noble spirit.

rites.name: Ameosum Mirus
rites.text: A recipe sheet that teaches its reader how to imbue a cloak with strong protection against flame. It is said to be taken from the bony smiths who guard a frozen fortress.

rites.name: Lontausia
rites.text: A written recipe that is given as the reward for completing a task, teaching the reader how to imbue a blade with the power of rushing water and storm. It is passed along to whoever finishes the assigned work.

rites.name: Serarnium Cinarum
rites.text: A ritual discipline in which a keeper hardens their outer covering, granting a defensive boon to those who have trained in its tradition. It is taught only to those who have reached a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Serillus Seonintum
rites.text: A channel used by healers who mend the natural world. It is passed on by two distant beings from opposite realms.

rites.name: Rarium Mauntum
rites.text: A sacred discipline of the temple orders that can only be mastered by someone who has first gained every other foundational skill. It bears a hidden fire that the initiate must earn through complete training.

rites.name: Serialus Cones
rites.text: A sacred disposition carried by devout healers, bound to a set of linked blessings. It shapes how a cleric channels radiant favor.

rites.name: Raures Reolus
rites.text: A method taught to enchanters for crafting a carved wooden face charged with magic. It shows practitioners how to bring such an object into being.

rites.name: Valilaustes
rites.text: A bound trait of martial hunger that drives a fighter toward combat. It sits in kinship with several related rages and the deathly strike of its wielder.

rites.name: Amenia Cernolia
rites.text: A focused art of restoring the wounded through a devoted bearer's sacred power. It is bound to a champion's oath and works in concert with the shielding and sacrificial disciplines of the same order.

rites.name: Valaunes Amaurallor
rites.text: A steadfast bond that lets a guardian endure hardship without faltering. It is tied to the traits of unwavering shelter and firm judgment.

rites.name: Cellia Nillanum
rites.text: A curled parchment that teaches its reader how to inscribe a lasting charm onto a wrist guard, granting it a steady surge of adaptable strength.

rites.name: Telernum Tolus
rites.text: A bound parchment that teaches its reader a way to etch a weapon with a holy-warrior ward. Its lesson grants the knowledge of this blessing.

rites.name: Saustilanum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by a brewing-order of monks that hardens the body against blows. It is bound to a related unsteady drunken-sway technique.

rites.name: Mausor Mornauntium
rites.text: A ritual pattern that teaches a binder how to imbue handwear with a surge of raw muscular force. Once learned, the binder can pass that power into a pair of gloves.

rites.name: Valeosanum Amarneria
rites.text: A passive inherited craft that lets one stout folk bear blows more easily. It lowers the bodily harm they take from physical attacks.

rites.name: Tentia Riarnus
rites.text: A guardian-wardens' sacred gift that lets a sworn keeper of the grove endure hardship. It stands bound to a companion gift of silver light.

rites.name: Ceolia Riasum
rites.text: A scroll of inscribed ember-script that teaches its reader a fiery weapon blessing. It is said to fall from a restless shade haunting an old tower.

rites.name: Raullum Miasintanum
rites.text: A talent that evokers can learn, forming an exclusive choice paired with the Ember Core ability. Choosing one prevents taking the other.

rites.name: Seraunintum
rites.text: A brief surge of focus that a devoted caster gains after enduring self-sacrifice. It lets their next working come forth without the usual pause before another can follow.

rites.name: Saullium Celisum
rites.text: A shapeless hunter's craft drawn from sealed reservoirs of soul-essence hidden within a cursed spire. Practitioners gain it by opening those hidden vaults.

rites.name: Caurnes Noraustum
rites.text: A disciplined inner technique that a trained monk draws upon while commanding companion beasts in a contest of skill. It lets the practitioner steady their focus during a battle between creatures.

rites.name: Valaulia Miaria
rites.text: A protective ward woven into the armor of holy knights. It can only be found on a chestplate that was never completed.

rites.name: Orollisanum
rites.text: A caster's cold burst that strikes nearby foes with light chill and locks them in place. Those held by it stay bound and frozen until the spell's hold fades.

rites.name: Miarnes Nausores
rites.text: A chilling technique used by a grim order of sworn guardians, delivering a blow that cuts with bitter cold. It is a skill of the frost-bound warriors who serve the dead.

rites.name: Serontium Saulintia
rites.text: A passive craft taught to elemental casters at a set rank. Strikes from storm bolts build up stored static, which a ground-shaking blow then spends as harm.

rites.name: Oraunor Amoles
rites.text: A shapeshifter's inherited knack lets a bear-changed caster stitch its own wounds closed. It comes naturally to those who guard their kin.

rites.name: Resallium
rites.text: A withered grove-keeper's craft in which a wandering fungus bursts from a fallen guardian or a ripened cap, clogging nearby foes and dragging their steps to a crawl.

rites.name: Naulia Tastia
rites.text: A bitter ember-trait that feeds on suffering and keeps a vengeful hunter's sigil burning. It stands bound to the Ashgrave Mark and the Vellorn Wardcraft.

rites.name: Taurum Niliantor
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to fierce fighters of the warrior orders, unlocked once a combatant reaches a high rank of skill. It is practiced by those who channel raw rage into their blows.

rites.name: Amontellor
rites.text: A cold-bound discipline practiced by ice-casters, which deepens the harm dealt to frozen foes and strengthens the summoned water spirit that serves the caster.

rites.name: Caulor Talliarum
rites.text: A savage inner wrath that a shapeshifting hunter draws upon, bound to a pair of linked tokens of tooth and bloodletting. It stirs the beastform's claws and quickens its rage.

rites.name: Meontes Orirneoles
rites.text: A cold-bound craft tied to certain relics, linked to several other enchanted traits. It is practiced by those who wield winter's stillness as a discipline.

rites.name: Visalia Valirneoria
rites.text: A combat art practiced by wild shapers, letting them slip free of restraints while fighting other practitioners. It is learned once a shaper reaches a fair level of experience.

rites.name: Orirontium
rites.text: A savage technique that only the wolf-kin of the northern packs can perform. It lets a beast sink its teeth into a foe with ferocious, unrestrained force.

rites.name: Telernanum Viastium
rites.text: A craft-bound charm sewn into wrist guards that grants the wearer a steady increase in resistance against cold. It is a permanent enchantment available only to those skilled in working hide.

rites.name: Serianus Valasium
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that is drawn from a remembered rage-beast, granting its wielder a wild, savage surge of power. It is learned through the memory of such a creature.

rites.name: Vauria Lenia
rites.text: A fighter of the monastic kind unleashes a frenzy of rapid blows during a contest between tamed companions. It is a technique a steadfast warrior performs in such bouts.

rites.name: Amollinus
rites.text: A carved sigil-power drawn from a remembered rite of unchecked fury. Carvers who bind it into stone or bone can channel the surge of rage.

rites.name: Vianus Cellorum
rites.text: A sacred storm-craft that a shaman can channel through a relic. It is bound to a second rite that calls down thunder from the sky.

rites.name: Reornollia
rites.text: A learned ward-craft that lets a caster temper incoming arcane force, softening every kind of spell that strikes them. The temper grows stronger as the practitioner masters the discipline.

rites.name: Nalum Lalestes
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a caster draw ritual blood-price more often. It is chosen alongside a dark elixir and is available only to certain sorcerers.

rites.name: Causes Telaules
rites.text: A dim, scattered power drawn from hidden stores of soul-essence. It is gathered from concealed reservoirs within a dark, towering prison-fortress.

rites.name: Vellium Coronia
rites.text: A beast-kin gift lets a companion exhale a chilling gust that chips at a foe and drags down its pace. Only bonded creatures of a certain blood can call upon it.

rites.name: Rianteolum
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws on frost-bearing gusts sealed into runes. The craft is gained by recalling a remembered sky of cold air.

rites.name: Orilleosium
rites.text: A battle-rage trait that stirs a fighter's fierce spirit during combat. It is bound to a rhythm of war that quickens the warrior's heartbeat.

rites.name: Larnor Naunesum
rites.text: Icy globes are called forth by sorcerers from a frigid northern realm. They are conjured by binders of frost in a cold, windswept land.

rites.name: Amaurnes Mistaulor
rites.text: A breath-driven technique that lets a practitioner channel rushing air through the body. It works alongside the sister arts of the wind-dancing order.

rites.name: Vesia Lostia
rites.text: A lingering enchantment settles over every member of a party once a tabletop-style contest begins in the ruined tower. It muffles all speech and magic until the contest concludes, and it returns whenever the contest is restarted.

rites.name: Corares Telauntanum
rites.text: A learned skill of the sky-keeper orders that sharpens a great storm-spell, letting it strike many foes at once. Those who guard the front line rely on it in battle.

rites.name: Orarneontus
rites.text: A rite of standing in which a practitioner claims a sharpened gain by inscribing a binding sigil five times during a single trial. Those who complete it are recognized as having earned a craft distinction.

rites.name: Vaurnanum Tintus
rites.text: A bound pair of invented shapes, one brawny horned spirit and one stout hooved spirit, are projected from a temple novice who carries them for a sanctum. They travel as extensions of the novice's will.

rites.name: Amintus Corosium
rites.text: A ferocious inner force that can be gathered from sealed reserves hidden deep within a dreaded spiral prison. It binds itself around its wielder as a power of rage.

rites.name: Naustenum
rites.text: A hidden blessing that sometimes lets a fallen warrior stay standing for a short span. If the warrior slays the foe within that window, they recover half their vitality, though the chance of it occurring seems to be left to chance.

rites.name: Volles Selanum
rites.text: A passive gift granted to healers who follow the restoring path of the grove. It amplifies the mending they perform by a quarter.

rites.name: Oraullum Ciastasanum
rites.text: A minor enchanting trait tied to a storm-hammer relic, boosting the wind-based strikes and surges that the same bearer can call upon.

rites.name: Rosteollus
rites.text: A stirring of gathered storm-force that a spirit-caller draws into a sacred relic. It binds closely to tempest-hammers, elemental arms, and sudden gusts of wind.

rites.name: Nauntor Nantor
rites.text: A chilling enchantment that creatures call upon while contesting in a bout of tamed beasts. It lets companions cloak themselves in a veil of cold mist.

rites.name: Telum Coresium
rites.text: A ritual gift bestowed by a sovereign's sacred staff upon a spiritual healer. It grants the holder a shamanic power drawn from the staff's watery authority.

rites.name: Tillus Nistor
rites.text: A spectral hunting shape that a caster can take on, letting them race across the land far faster than they could on foot. It is passed on to those who prove themselves ready for the practice.

rites.name: Sontus Sirniasum
rites.text: A learned quality tied to a brewing monk's sacred cask. It works alongside two other traits, a full cask and a stubborn resolve.

rites.name: Ciallores
rites.text: A quiet mystic gift that binds a caster's spirit to a flowing, misty sea-current. It draws together several other linked gifts that share its watery power.

rites.name: Verolor
rites.text: A blessing bestowed by a people of starborn healers that mends a wounded ally over several moments. It restores a fifth of their full vitality across five seconds.

rites.name: Orausarus
rites.text: A sacred endowment that automatically imparts to its bearer a particular seeking rite once practiced by a high cleric of light.

rites.name: Telaurnus Serenum
rites.text: A ritual passage that lets hunters of dark beings step to a distant corrupted forge and return home again. It was granted as a trophy for completing a sacred trial.

rites.name: Niastor Vastor
rites.text: A vital tide that a towering brute can call upon during a contest of beast-keepers. It lets its wielder surge in strength while pitting their companion against rivals.

rites.name: Oriantillus
rites.text: A permanent binding placed upon a close-combat blade that sometimes slows colossal foes and wounds them more deeply. It can only be imbued into a weapon of considerable mastery.

rites.name: Oraulliases
rites.text: A nature-bound craft taught to healers who walk the old groves. It raises the healing a caster channels and lets their renewing blossoms mend a portion of their full strength over time.

rites.name: Vintiallor
rites.text: A monk's learned gift lets their healing orbs gather of their own accord. A separate inner-spirit skill can also summon these restorative spheres.

rites.name: Villium Mernianes
rites.text: A temporary spirit-form that a wanderer receives after a sacred errand, letting them step into a grey, colorless realm near an offering stone. There, they can speak with a bound guardian's essence.

rites.name: Valausor Sentor
rites.text: A nature blessing that a caster shares across an entire gathered band, fortifying every ally within reach for a long stretch of time. It was later folded into a single-target charm that does the same work for one companion.

rites.name: Meonum Oreontor
rites.text: A watching mark that is inscribed by a skilled scribe and passed on through a formal training method. It is learned as a practiced discipline among trained inscribers.

rites.name: Ameosestor
rites.text: A ritual mark that can be carved by a skilled inscriber. It is learned through an ancient tome of inscribed arts.

rites.name: Sallum Leornones
rites.text: A carved mark that warriors gain on reaching a high rank of training. It lets them charge forward with sudden, overwhelming force.

rites.name: Orausilium
rites.text: A ritual sigil that a temple scribe carves to channel stormy energy. It is learned by studying ancient carvings found in frozen northern ruins.

rites.name: Nirneorum
rites.text: A marked sign that guides its user toward a chosen heading, and it is inscribed and found through a text of learning.

rites.name: Mastanum Tostianes
rites.text: A carved sigil that a scribe can inscribe, and which is learned through lesser study of the written marks. It is shaped by a practiced hand.

rites.name: Neolor Seriantia
rites.text: A sigil of arcane script that tints a water spirit with a pale, misty blue-gray color. It is carved and used by spellcasters to alter how the spirit appears.

rites.name: Neolesia
rites.text: A carved mark that can be inscribed to form a protective shield. Its making requires a skilled scribe's craft.

rites.name: Corernum Siaraulium
rites.text: A ritual sigil that marks a spirit-hound form with a pale blue glow. It alters how the ghostly wolf appears when it is summoned.

rites.name: Solia Coraureolus
rites.text: A carved sigil that a fighter presses into their gear to shorten the wait before a desperate defensive stance can be called again.

rites.name: Orauliarium
rites.text: A carved sigil that a scribe inscribes through a particular discipline of writing. It is passed down to students through a learned method of instruction.

rites.name: Launtia Amiastus
rites.text: A carved mark of reflective thought that a scribe shapes through practiced engraving. It is uncovered by studying the basics of carving.

rites.name: Tintum Tolum
rites.text: A ritual sigil carved for holy keepers that swaps the bright radiance of a cleansing rite for violet shadow flares. It alters how the rite looks without changing its purpose.

rites.name: Terneosanum
rites.text: A carved mark that alters the way a frost-bound death-warrior's chilling strike functions. It reshapes that warrior's signature ice power when inscribed upon them.

rites.name: Tiastor Causanum
rites.text: A sacred sigil that a sworn champion of the holy order learns once their devotion reaches its highest rank. It empowers the bearer's spoken oaths of light.

rites.name: Amesintes
rites.text: A binding craft taught to nature-keepers once they reach a certain level of training. It is no longer part of the practice in later revisions.

rites.name: Orisum Oraustoles
rites.text: A ritual mark that is inscribed by skilled scribes and passed on through teachers. It is used to bring about sickness and decay.

rites.name: Cantanum Orianus
rites.text: A carved sigil that calls the fallen back to a hollow semblance of life. Its scribes must master a deep craft of carving before they can inscribe it.

rites.name: Cines Nauleosium
rites.text: A carved mark that scribes make using their practiced hand, learned through a set training method and uncovered by studying a particular inked formula.

rites.name: Teorostum
rites.text: A temple sigil that changes a bound companion spirit into a hollow void-form. It can only be inscribed by those who walk the path of shadow.

rites.name: Oriantor Naunum
rites.text: A marked sign that warriors gain on their own once they reach a set level of training. It stirs a hungry fury within them.

rites.name: Coriarnanum Amoriasanum
rites.text: A major sigil used by spellcasters to strengthen the secondary protective effect of their enchanted shields. It adds an extra tenth to the ward's defensive power.

rites.name: Amaullium Listum
rites.text: A carved mark that a caster sets upon the ground, where a well of spirit is lowered. It is used by dark-arts practitioners to anchor the pit.

rites.name: Oreosus Vaurnanum
rites.text: A mark that warriors come to know once they reach a certain standing in their training. It silences the speech of its target.

rites.name: Vontia Miarnor
rites.text: A sacred sigil that alters the power of a holy blessing spoken by devoted knights. It modifies how a consecrated chant is carried out.

rites.name: Telium Telastanum
rites.text: A carved sign of summoning that is inscribed with careful craft and unlocked through the study of luminous inks. It serves as a means to call a distant lord to the bearer's side.

rites.name: Sereontum Nasteontia
rites.text: A quiet hunter's discipline that is learned early and taught by the orders of the wild. It grants a passive edge to those who train beasts in the hunt.

rites.name: Tilia Cianornia
rites.text: A sacred mark is inscribed by skilled scribes and is learned from a tome of mark-lore. It shapes a protective guard of ward-light.

rites.name: Liaranum Telerium
rites.text: A carved sigil that gives a ghostly stride a crimson shimmer. It is inscribed by the grave-bound warriors who bind their own dead essence into their steps.

rites.name: Amisellia
rites.text: A sacred sigil that, when invoked, makes a warrior's rage manifest as four great feathered pinions unfolding from the back. It amplifies the bearer's righteous fury for a time.

rites.name: Naranum Orastoles
rites.text: A carved sigil that, once invoked, makes a fearsome battle cry lower the cost of the next few strikes a warrior unleashes. It is a mark of martial discipline and bold momentum.

rites.name: Rolintia
rites.text: A sealed mark carved into a conjurer's bond with their demon servant. It alters the charm the servant uses to beguile others.

rites.name: Valeosoles
rites.text: A minor sigil inscribed for spellcasters that halves the mana a caster must spend to invoke a particular radiant incantation.

rites.name: Carirnes
rites.text: A carved mark of frost-craft that is made through an inscribing art and is passed on through a teaching method. It is used to call up deep cold.

rites.name: Tanor Serirnium
rites.text: A carved sigil that colors a healing bloom with a violet hue. It is inscribed by nature-minded casters to alter how their restorative blossoms appear.

rites.name: Serenausor
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a remembered shard of frozen ground. Practitioners etch sigils into stone to call up that cold strength.

rites.name: Corausium Tialirnum
rites.text: A carved mark that a spellcaster inscribes to strengthen their wild arcane force. It adds a small bonus to the power of their forceful surge.

rites.name: Contaulor
rites.text: A carved sigil that makes a lingering fire curse hit harder. Each strike of the curse burns a little more fiercely than before.

rites.name: Valanus Cosor
rites.text: A sacred mark that every holy warrior gains upon reaching full mastery of their calling. It is granted without study, once a devoted champion has grown seasoned enough to receive it.

rites.name: Oriases Telauntium
rites.text: A mark that an inscriber shapes once they have grown skilled enough in the art of engraving. It is learned through a lesser study of writing and carries authority over those who see it.

rites.name: Colarnanum
rites.text: A carved mark made through a practiced inscribing art, learned by inquiring minds. It is reached by study of lesser carving lore.

rites.name: Neosum Maniantum
rites.text: A carved sigil that strengthens the defensive plating of a warrior order's protective craft. It alters how a certain guardian rite of armor hardens against blows.

rites.name: Rosor Maronus
rites.text: A woodland inscription that scatters small green and orange leaves in place of the usual trailing mark when a rapid burst of movement is made. It belongs to the practice of nature-bound caster orders.

rites.name: Sastor Niarnium
rites.text: A sealed mark that is carved through the arts of engraving and taught as a formal discipline. It is passed on through a dedicated lesson that shows practitioners how to draw it.

rites.name: Sallauntium Reornia
rites.text: A sacred mark that a trained guardian gains upon reaching a certain level of mastery. It is granted naturally as a guardian reaches a set stage of development.

rites.name: Ciniantes
rites.text: A ritual mark that tints a water spirit with a dull gray shade. Practitioners inscribe it to alter how such spirits appear.

rites.name: Careolor
rites.text: A ward-mark is carved through a scribe's trained hand, and it is gained by studying an ancient tome on sigil-craft. It stands as a mark of lingering grudge.

rites.name: Taustes Liarnia
rites.text: A ritual marking that a spirit-caller gains upon reaching great mastery, allowing them to draw back their guardian totems. It is granted naturally once a practitioner grows deeply experienced.

rites.name: Lianus Cialeostium
rites.text: A carved mark of quill-like spikes that scribes can inscribe once they have trained in lettering. It is uncovered through minor study of old script.

rites.name: Valastum Valarium
rites.text: A battle sigil that, when a finishing blow lands with exceptional force, summons a gathering of scavenging winged creatures to descend upon the fallen.

rites.name: Corerus Reorastium
rites.text: A sigil of the temple orders that is learned by its priests upon reaching a high rank. It unleashes a sudden burst of psychic force against the minds of those nearby.

rites.name: Celia Sereornus
rites.text: A carved mark that is learned by seasoned wardens once they reach mastery. It restores harm to the one who carries its knowledge.

rites.name: Amesaranum
rites.text: A sigil inscribed by a caster that makes their stored soul fragments hover visibly above their head. It is a mark of arcane practice.

rites.name: Sereoranum Minialor
rites.text: A sigil inscribed by spellcasters that frees them from having to invoke a stilling charm on anyone struck by a bolt of raw arcane force. The mark works as a permanent refinement to a strike technique.

rites.name: Neosantia Virnia
rites.text: A carved mark of sacred anger, inked into stone or cloth by a skilled scribe. It is learned through careful study of a lion-hued pigment.

rites.name: Ceostauntus Telilontum
rites.text: A carved mark that a scribe-smith can etch into a blade, drawn from the craft of ink and runes. It is made by a skilled inscriber working at an advanced level of the discipline.

rites.name: Marestium
rites.text: A battle sigil that lets a charging fighter leave a burning path of flame behind them as they run forward.

rites.name: Meontes Visterum
rites.text: A sealed mark that lets a holy caster draw out the spoken admissions of another. It is taught as a skill to those who serve in the temple orders.

rites.name: Saulium Oraullium
rites.text: A sacred sigil inscribed by temple scribes that transforms a summoned shade into a beast of drifting gloom. Only those trained in the austere path of discipline may etch it.

rites.name: Sirelor
rites.text: A sacred mark that is carved through the practice of inscribing, and it is revealed by an ancient scroll of learning.

rites.name: Viseolles
rites.text: A carved sigil that a scribe can learn to inscribe after years of study. Its markings are said to soften the landing of anyone who falls beneath it.

rites.name: Serontus Orostium
rites.text: A ward that a holy warrior comes to know naturally upon reaching a certain level of skill. It is a mark of the wielder's growing discipline and protective craft.

rites.name: Nastus Cinollanum
rites.text: A sigil-mark that tints a water spirit with a dusky, shadowy shade. Only trained casters can inscribe it onto the being.

rites.name: Roniantes
rites.text: A carved ward-sign that is inscribed by a trained scribe and learned from a sacred codex of sign-mastery. It empowers a strike that unleashes a many-headed beast-form.

rites.name: Tiasia Riastus
rites.text: A sealed inscription worn by spellcasters of the scholarly circles. It sharpens the force of a bolt-hurling incantation by a small margin.

rites.name: Nosiastor
rites.text: A carved sigil that awakens a craving for living essence in whoever bears it. It is taught through a learned treatise on mastering such marks.

rites.name: Amisia Amentes
rites.text: A carved sigil that changes the coloring of a rising strike so it takes on the pale, striped look of a sacred white beast from the mountain spirits. It affects appearance only.

rites.name: Amostum Niaror
rites.text: A carved sigil that is made through the craft of etching, and it is learned from a tome of mastered symbols. It stirs wild fury in whoever bears it.

rites.name: Meontum Valontor
rites.text: A ward that temple initiates come to know once they reach a high rank of devotion. It is a protective mark that turns harmful effects back against the one who casts them.

rites.name: Mianaustus
rites.text: A ritual mark inked by scribes to stir a person's blood into a searing heat. It is learned through study of the celestial inks used by temple archivists.

rites.name: Teleriastor
rites.text: A sigil that druids gain on reaching a certain rank of mastery. It empowers their savage bite, letting the wielder strike with fierce, tearing force.

rites.name: Oriarnium Sones
rites.text: A sacred sigil that slightly enlarges creatures transformed by a shaping spell, a decorative effect only. It alters appearance and nothing more.

rites.name: Naurnium Casellium
rites.text: A carved mark is made by a practiced inscribing method and is found through the study of a luminous ink. It causes things to appear other than they truly are.

rites.name: Sialor Valeolum
rites.text: A carved sigil that strengthens a shape-changing charm, letting it hold for a full day on small beasts and reach several creatures at once.

rites.name: Neria Raullium
rites.text: A devotional vow honored by those who restore a thousand tenfold of fish to the sacred river pools of the marsh folk. It marks a seeker's standing among the keepers of the waters.

rites.name: Corontes Sialia
rites.text: A ritual sigil that tints a water-spirit with a deep blue shade. Its carvers use it to mark the currents they wish to color.

rites.name: Callor Veontaurnus
rites.text: A carved sign that raises a protective barrier of locked defenders when inscribed. It is learned from a sacred manual of carving skill.

rites.name: Corisolanum
rites.text: A carved sigil that raises the chance a hunter's beast will summon crawling eight-legged swarms. It is worn by those who prefer ambush through hidden, skittering allies.

rites.name: Oreornia Corianor
rites.text: A carved sigil that would have altered the look of a deadly clasping technique. It was never finished and remains a curiosity among the crafters.

rites.name: Corarintum
rites.text: A small inscribed sign that lets a caster skip the feather component when invoking a gentle descent. It offers a modest convenience to those who study the art of softened landings.

rites.name: Sollanum Lenalanum
rites.text: A sacred mark that robed scholars of the old orders learn once they reach the highest ranks of their training. It is taken on without any effort of study, as though it arrives by right of rank.

rites.name: Amiasaulium
rites.text: A carved sigil that a practitioner can inscribe to unlock a whirling, crane-like kick. It is learned from instructors of the inscribing art.

rites.name: Lilor Rontiastum
rites.text: A sacred marking that monks inherit once they reach a high stage of training, granting them a fiery exhalation. It is passed down through their order as a rite of advancement.

rites.name: Vosteonia
rites.text: A carved mark of invented script that is made through careful inscribing and is learned by studying minor writing lore.

rites.name: Telinteonus
rites.text: A sacred mark inscribed on a warrior's armor that shortens the wait before they may launch a bounding leap across the battlefield.

rites.name: Raneostum Riarnanum
rites.text: A carved mark worn by travelers who wish to move between gates more quickly. Its bearer can reopen a passage sooner than the usual waiting period allows.

rites.name: Lirnum Amontus
rites.text: A minor sigil used by temple priests to channel a rising-force charm. It serves as the carved mark that enables one specific lifting incantation.

rites.name: Corestus Vares
rites.text: A carved sigil of binding that is first formed through a written craft and is revealed by a scholarly tome of symbol-lore. It is said to scorch the thoughts of those who meet it.

rites.name: Testaullor
rites.text: A sigil that is taught to holy warriors once they reach a high rank of skill. It grants them the ability to pass judgment through the blow they strike.

rites.name: Venollium
rites.text: A sacred sigil that, when a sworn guardian's judgment strikes true, summons a pillar of flame descending from the heavens. It belongs to the arts of the oath-bound warrior-priests.

rites.name: Valastum Vestontor
rites.text: A carved ward that a scribe can produce after studying the basics of lettering. It is said to restore vitality to whoever it touches.

rites.name: Caustiror
rites.text: A rune-craft mark that a scribe learns through humble study of basic carving. It is inscribed to answer a strike with a taunting counterblow.

rites.name: Seoliastor
rites.text: A ritual inscription that grants its bearer the ability to call forth a familiar. The mark teaches the craft of summoning a bound companion.

rites.name: Nilia Seria
rites.text: A sacred mark that is inscribed onto objects to sharpen their aim. It is learned from a volume of inscribed mastery.

rites.name: Telonum Coreollum
rites.text: A sacred mark that temple-trained wardens learn once they reach a high rank of devotion. Once learned, it lets their weapons draw cold into the blade.

rites.name: Mallanum Vantia
rites.text: A marked sigil that a trained scribe can carve, granting a person a sudden surge of heedless daring. It is passed on by teachers who instruct apprentices in the craft of mark-making.

rites.name: Cesteornus
rites.text: A ward of healing script that an inscriber carves to mend living flesh. It is passed down through instruction and found through careful study of an old ink.

rites.name: Valeontus
rites.text: A carved sigil that calls down torrents of water when inscribed by a skilled scribe. It is learned through formal instruction from masters of the carving craft.

rites.name: Leornus Tillor
rites.text: A battle sigil that, when invoked, causes a strike to leave a trail of flame behind it. It is a craft used by warriors who intercept foes.

rites.name: Meosor Amiarellus
rites.text: A ritual sigil that every initiated seer-priest learns once they reach the highest tier of their training. It is inscribed as a matter of course, without any separate trial, upon attaining mastery.

rites.name: Lelanum Morentium
rites.text: A sealed mark that grants its bearer the knack of bursting light and sparks into the air. Hunters who learn it gain a skill for scattering showers of flame.

rites.name: Raurnia Valeosintes
rites.text: A carved mark that alters a storm-calling rite, letting its wind reach a wider circle around the caster. It works alongside the rite's usual effects.

rites.name: Valisorium Corastintia
rites.text: A sacred inner power drawn from hidden reserves of spirit energy kept in a towering prison of the cursed. It is gathered by those who seek to call upon a higher purpose.

rites.name: Merarnus
rites.text: A carved sigil meant to make nearby wild beasts scatter whenever a shapeshifting rite is performed. Its making was never completed.

rites.name: Resontor
rites.text: A quiet favor carried inside a sacred relic, it bends toward the one who walks the wind's path. It stirs alongside the crane-power and the rising gusts.

rites.name: Amastinum
rites.text: A stealthy technique taught by the sharp-toothed hunters who serve a ravenous old beast. It lets a practitioner strike quietly from the shadows.

rites.name: Narneostia
rites.text: A restorative gift held by the healing keepers of an ancient grove order. It is tied to a wider lasting-renewal power that the same keepers guard.

rites.name: Amarum Valeonestor
rites.text: A trained technique of the wandering blade-kin that briefly stuns a foe into stillness. The stillness breaks the moment anything harms the stunned foe, and the practitioner must halt their ongoing strikes to perform it.

rites.name: Niasteontus Serontaulia
rites.text: A mystic gift that a shaman may choose from a set of talents. It cannot be taken alongside another particular protective talent.

rites.name: Telenistor
rites.text: A bonded trait that a sacred keeper grants to a wearer, bearing jaws that bite with grinding force. It cannot coexist with two other rival marks.

rites.name: Ceones Cialor
rites.text: A mystic talent shared across three ritual disciplines, offered as an exclusive selection. Each path pairs it with a separate sworn power, so a caster must choose one companion gift.

rites.name: Serantenus
rites.text: A binding ritual that permanently infuses a great two-handed striking weapon with extra force, so each blow carries seven more points of harm.

rites.name: Telorentus
rites.text: A stirring force of the soul that can be gathered from hidden reserves within a towering, cursed spire. Those who draw it upon themselves gain a power born of breath and inner spirit.

rites.name: Oresium Telerum
rites.text: A holy rite that bestows a radiant blessing upon a gathered company of allies. It spreads a lesser luminous favor across every member, binding them under a shared divine glow.

rites.name: Cianaulles
rites.text: A lasting binding that can be woven into a great two-handed weapon, raising the force of its strikes by a fixed measure.

rites.name: Sereolanor
rites.text: A communal ward that is cast over many allies at once, softening incoming harm, bolstering endurance, and restoring a defender's inner reserve whenever they turn aside an attack.

rites.name: Vaures Mollor
rites.text: A lasting rune-mark carved upon the shoulder, shaped for fierce warriors and grim oath-knights. It sharpens their martial craft in battle.

rites.name: Ameornanium
rites.text: A lasting binding that can be worked into a close-combat blade so it hits far harder, leaving a crimson shimmer along its edge.

rites.name: Orastum Corarnolus
rites.text: A ritual technique of ceremonial cleansing that a robed caster may choose in place of a simpler rite. It cannot be combined with the basic cleansing rite it replaces.

rites.name: Milliantia
rites.text: A binding force drawn from hidden reliquaries within a dreaded tower of ruin. Practitioners call upon it to seize and hold their foes in place.

rites.name: Launostanum Riantium
rites.text: A holy rite that spreads a protective grace across a whole company of allies. It carries a lesser ward to every member at once.

rites.name: Torirnia
rites.text: A bound volume of crimson-inked rites that teaches the first tier of a sworn bargain between a sorcerer and their familiar. It shows how a summoned servant is linked to its keeper through a shared oath.

rites.name: Lontiria
rites.text: A bound book of dark lore that a sorcerer carries to channel forbidden pacts. It is tied to the hidden craft of those who bargain with otherworldly beings.

rites.name: Mintus Seraulles
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that holds fast to what has been lasting. It is drawn from a remembered binding that never loosens its hold.

rites.name: Oronanum Cisolium
rites.text: A bound book that teaches a beast-companion the first rank of a silencing binding. The hound learns to sever an enemy's magic at its root.

rites.name: Voliantium
rites.text: A sheltering radiance drawn from a devoted warden's inner resolve. It would have let its wielder shield allies from harm once they reached a certain mastery of the sacred discipline.

rites.name: Saulles Ronanum
rites.text: A bound codex of enchantment that teaches charm-magic to a demonic bond-servant of a sorcerer. It guides the servant in the arts of alluring others.

rites.name: Cauleonia
rites.text: A bound book of dark rites that teaches a fierce battle trance to a sorcerer's armored bodyguard. It is written for the guardian that serves the caster.

rites.name: Tilanum Serirallum
rites.text: A guardian sanctuary craft practiced among wild-keepers. It lets a practitioner shield a sacred grove from rival combatants during contests of arms.

rites.name: Oreolum Cauranes
rites.text: A bound book of arcane writings that teaches a shifting technique to a warlock's familiar imp. It lets the imp slip between states of being.

rites.name: Moranum Valaurnes
rites.text: A learned gift granted to wayward keepers of the wild at a high stage of training, opening doors to rites usually reserved for their guardian kin. Those who receive it can wield powers they would otherwise never touch.

rites.name: Oriantum Amaunium
rites.text: A protective calling granted to sworn champions, who gain the power to stand watch over the rulers of old lines. Its bearers shield the crown from harm and answer for its safety.

rites.name: Telus Valonintum
rites.text: A chilling power drawn from hoarded essence stored in deep vaults of a dread spire. It is gathered from those hidden caches within the tower.

rites.name: Rilleontor
rites.text: A bound book of rites that teaches a guardian beast the art of evading harm. Its lessons are passed to the warden's loyal sentinel to sharpen its defense.

rites.name: Mernanum Oralleosia
rites.text: A bound codex that lets its keeper call stronger servants from the abyss. Each lesser summons it grants is swapped for a fiercer creature of the same role.

rites.name: Valantia Taureornus
rites.text: A tattered tome of ritual fire that once taught a caster how to kindle a searing blaze. Its pages crumble when touched, and it belonged to the ancient age before the world was torn apart.

rites.name: Miasallor
rites.text: A sacred discipline of sylvan tenders who bind their growing rites to a single mutually exclusive path of cultivation, sharing the rite of Feedwell.

rites.name: Nauseonus
rites.text: A dark tome of forbidden ritual that once taught a practitioner how to send slow, creeping rot into a foe. Its pages hold a seventh rank of this spreading blight.

rites.name: Cillia Corasanum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that a practitioner gains by drawing upon a remembered judge of the dead. It lets the wielder inscribe dreadful marks into stone and bone.

rites.name: Neosor Reonanum
rites.text: A savage biting technique practiced by the hunting reptile beasts of one brood. Each strike halves the mending power that a wounded foe can draw upon.

rites.name: Corolintes
rites.text: A ritual teaching that shows practitioners how to call forth a winged beast to serve as a mount. It passes on the method of summoning such a creature.

rites.name: Valines Mialaranum
rites.text: A tide-woven charm that lays a lingering sour mark on one wanderer, marking them as the object of a sullen rumor. The mark fades on its own in a day, or can be scraped away by a simple touch or a quiet word.

rites.name: Rollentium
rites.text: A sacred talent practiced by priests, shaped as an exclusive choice that binds into the order of Lightward Keepers. It cannot be taken alongside the other path those keepers follow.

rites.name: Amaseostum
rites.text: A bound book of hidden spells that teaches a minor power of concealment to a bound demonic familiar serving a sorcerer.

rites.name: Valiaranum Amernores
rites.text: A carving craft that inscribes marks into wood to draw on a remembered ancestral spirit. It is gained through that spirit's recollection.

rites.name: Ameostus Lintasus
rites.text: A shared enchantment that spreads its blessing to nearby companions when cast upon one of them. It lasts longer than a single effect and requires a costly component to work.

rites.name: Corauranum Rollor
rites.text: A ritual cry used by sacred shapers of the wild to draw the attention of foes toward a defender. It is the chosen rite of the warden-keepers who guard their circle.

rites.name: Nallum Cilleorum
rites.text: A sworn guardian's gesture that compels a foe to turn their attention toward the caster. It can reach across a stretch of thirty paces.

rites.name: Nauria Tilaustia
rites.text: A sudden rush of air that a shaman can call upon through a chosen calling. Taking this path rules out the other path it competes with.

rites.name: Liasantum
rites.text: A brief sacred working used by holy warriors, granting the bearer a strong surge of power that quickly dissipates. It is shaped to be spent swiftly on a single target.

rites.name: Teliantus Listes
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls forth lanterns, carved gourds and other festive ornaments to brighten a fortress's defenders. It is practiced by the sworn keepers of a stronghold.

rites.name: Miaseranum
rites.text: A consecrated charm a guardian lays upon an ally, shielding them from blows for a short span while binding their own hands from striking. The same ally cannot receive it again until a lingering weariness has faded.

rites.name: Cistor Nianteolus
rites.text: A trained fighter's strike that cripples a foe's legs, halving how fast the victim can move for a short span of time.

rites.name: Nollum Sirium
rites.text: A reward bestowed by a commander of a watchtower after a task is completed. It is a craft-skill gift tied to the rites of a fortified stronghold.

rites.name: Valontaulum
rites.text: A sacred working that lets holy warriors step instantly to a distant shrine of radiance and then return. It was granted as the reward for completing a sworn task.

rites.name: Lialor Sarnor
rites.text: A cunning method of hunting that is gathered from hidden storage chests in a shadowy forest. It is also granted as a reward from a royal court's offerings.

rites.name: Amanor Reostalles
rites.text: A ritual power that a sky-reader can invoke once a new-cycle rite has been performed. Invoking it wakes a greater rite of the full-cycle kind.

rites.name: Telorestium
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that is drawn from a recollected trace of deceit-binding. It lets its wielder shape marks into cunning and misdirection.

rites.name: Orentarnia
rites.text: A sacred strike that a holy warrior may call upon at a certain rank of training. It briefly locks an enemy in place, leaving them unable to act for a short span.

rites.name: Corirum Rarostia
rites.text: A ritual downpour that mends every companion standing within a marked circle, pulsing its restoration once each heartbeat. Each caster may keep only one such rain falling at a time.

rites.name: Tollor Telistanum
rites.text: A temple-bred discipline that sustains a brewing adept's vigor and stamina. It hums alongside three other inscribed gifts of the same order.

rites.name: Coriantanum Meornellor
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught in the temple halls that lowers the spiritual energy a devotee must spend when chanting restorative rites.

rites.name: Valiastoles
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to shieldbearers in the defensive schools. It lets a guardian punish attackers whose blows land against their defended line.

rites.name: Vostus Riallor
rites.text: A sacred technique in which devoted caregivers sing in unison to mend wounds. It is chosen as an either-or path alongside a ring of kneeling supplicants.

rites.name: Vauleontia
rites.text: A channel through which healing mystics draw restoring power. It flows down from a distant realm and from a sacred guardian kept in a hall of dominion.

rites.name: Saraullanum
rites.text: A slow, modest mending rite that a temple healer can chant again and again without draining the reserves. It is gentle and thrifty, yielding to swifter and stronger rites whenever haste or severity demands them.

rites.name: Raullor Seresia
rites.text: A quick, sharp restorative craft practiced by spirit-keepers. It mends wounds only slightly yet drains a great deal of inner reserve to perform.

rites.name: Telintanor
rites.text: A bond of trained kinship that lets a hunter's chosen creature share a craft of tracking and command. It is tied to a wider mastery of beasts that shapes how the hunter keeps and directs their companions.

rites.name: Vostes Caliria
rites.text: A channeled ring of searing flame that bursts outward from a caster, scorching everything nearby, the caster included. Its heat is shared equally between the one who wields it and those who stand close.

rites.name: Lestium Meontium
rites.text: A restorative art that mends bodily harm for those who wield it. Spells of this kind are kept apart from those that siphon vitality from others, and some practitioners train in it as a formal craft.

rites.name: Amintolium
rites.text: A carving-craft that is drawn from a remembered sigil of resonance. It lets its wielder inscribe runes that shape how a thing hums and holds together.

rites.name: Taustium Cirnanum
rites.text: A restorative art taught to a sacred circle of healers, who channel nature's warmth into a single wounded ally. It draws heavily on the caster's reserves, yet it mends more harm in one moment than any other practice of the order.

rites.name: Melaurnes Amiases
rites.text: A cheap, gentle mending rite used by lesser wardens to restore a single companion. It restores little, so it suits quiet moments, yet its low cost lets the caster repeat it again and again.

rites.name: Lauleorus
rites.text: A practiced discipline taught among healer-priests that strengthens the restorative surge a caster sends into a wounded ally. It was once common but has since been set aside.

rites.name: Corostes Coraurnium
rites.text: A practice in which a dark caster draws their own vitality out and pours it into a loyal bound creature. It can save a companion that is fading near death.

rites.name: Niarnus Relornanum
rites.text: A restorative tempest of sacred power that is bound to a wrathful blade. It answers the call of a vengeful warrior order, mending allies while striking foes.

rites.name: Loliarnes
rites.text: A dark charm-power drawn from hidden reserves of stored spirit energy found within a cursed tower of punishment. Its wielder gains a fierce, malicious potency from it.

rites.name: Orollium Neonia
rites.text: A gentle current of air that some adepts channel to mend wounds. It is bound to the practice of lightning-quick combat disciplines and to other sacred airborne skills.

rites.name: Oreosus Nantor
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a remembered resonance of old inscriptions. It is gained through the recollection of that resonance.

rites.name: Riastonia
rites.text: A learned discipline of spirit-keepers that steadies the healer's stance, so that wounds received while channeling restorative rites disturb their casting far less.

rites.name: Ciastanum Sereontanum
rites.text: A soothing current of restorative flow that companions can call upon during contests of bonded beasts, mending wounds as the battle unfolds.

rites.name: Lesinum
rites.text: A glowing inner power that can be drawn from hidden reserves found within a deep, cursed tower. It fuels its bearer's strength through sealed pockets of stored essence.

rites.name: Seolirnia
rites.text: A mending art drawn from the mystic currents within a sacred spring. Practitioners channel these hidden energies to restore wounded bodies.

rites.name: Vasanum Tellus
rites.text: A runecarving power that a practitioner gains by drawing upon a remembered core of an otherworldly heartstone. It lets the carver shape sigils with unusual force.

rites.name: Senanum Leniasor
rites.text: A binding craft that a caretaker of the wilds uses to turn a foe into a small hopping creature, leaving it able only to shift its place. The enchantment fades with time, or when the one who cast it falls.

rites.name: Meollenor
rites.text: A swift, potent restorative chant cast by a temple cleric upon a single wounded ally. It mends injuries at once.

rites.name: Caullum Lauliarnor
rites.text: A devotional discipline taught in the sacred ranks of a holy order, it sharpens the chance that a consecrated working strikes with exceptional force. Its effects follow the magic of the warrior-priests rather than the blade.

rites.name: Telalia Amentus
rites.text: A consecrated rite that gathers restorative light over a wide area, mending nearby allies while a sealed state of inner balance lets the caster channel it. It replaces an earlier sacred strike that once served the same devout practitioners.

rites.name: Nelaustium
rites.text: A coercive power drawn from hidden reserves of vital essence stored deep within a dread, sprawling tower. It lets a wielder press a demand that cannot be refused.

rites.name: Reosus Coroseolum
rites.text: A radiant burst of sacred power that a healer releases from their own body. It harms foes nearby while mending companions standing close by.

rites.name: Coriastum Taurneontum
rites.text: A sacred discipline of avenging judgment, bound to a relic's inner sigil. It is tied to two companion rites that deepen its effect.

rites.name: Tarnanum Tireonor
rites.text: A ritual power of the highest devotee that is gathered from hidden stores of spirit essence kept in a grim spire. It is drawn from these caches to strengthen whoever wields it.

rites.name: Orernum Lanentes
rites.text: A devotee's learned rite of radiant mending that comes to every initiate at the first step. Its healing is quick and economical, though it restores less than the stronger rites.

rites.name: Menallium
rites.text: A sacred technique that lets a righteous warrior channel divine radiance into a strike. It is chosen as an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside an enhanced verdict of judgment.

rites.name: Larnestanum
rites.text: A tempered edge trait carried by hunters who seek retribution against wraith-kin. It is bound to a sworn oath and paired with two related inscriptions of flame and resolve.

rites.name: Valauria Amenirnes
rites.text: A practitioner's gift that swells a shaman's healing power by channeling the rising waters within. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival path rooted in the same deep source.

rites.name: Cillarnanum
rites.text: A sacred blessing channeled by devoted guardians of the temple orders. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive gifts, each excluding the other.

rites.name: Varaunanum
rites.text: A stout smith-warrior who once trained a sibling in a crouched, deceptive guard stance. The stance is passed down through the family as a teaching of their hall.

rites.name: Minontum
rites.text: A dormant power of the green-keepers that is awakened to lend stored vitality to a guardian of the wild. It is a gift granted only to those who have advanced far in their sacred rites.

rites.name: Telarnium Rasteria
rites.text: A foul rot that seeps into a cursed relic and spreads through the hands that bear it. It is bound to a wrathful hunger and to a darker chant of spells.

rites.name: Sereornus Veolum
rites.text: A sacred utterance spoken by devout keepers of the temples to bring about a ritual effect. It belongs to a trio of related speech-crafts, alongside two other kinds of spoken power.

rites.name: Miarnanum Corallum
rites.text: A sacred power that is drawn from hidden reservoirs of spiritual essence kept within a dark, towering prison. It is gathered from those caches by those who seek to bend the will of others.

rites.name: Veores Valoria
rites.text: A small guardian's sacred judgment power that a companion can call upon during a contest between tamed creatures. It is wielded only in staged battles of beasts.

rites.name: Orinium Tausostanum
rites.text: A carved mark of sacred writing that is gained from a remembered holy symbol. It lets a bearer etch lasting runes into surfaces.

rites.name: Meria Seronallum
rites.text: A sacred gift of the hands that marks a consecrated healer-priest. It binds to devotion and to the bearing of faithful reverence.

rites.name: Corosialles Tentium
rites.text: A radiant technique that a small, young guardian calls upon while battling beside a trained companion creature. It lets the user strike with sanctified force during contests of creature bonding.

rites.name: Coralum Aminollium
rites.text: A mystic force that can be gathered from sealed reliquary caches hidden deep within a towering, cursed prison-spire. Those who channel it draw on the spire's stored essence.

rites.name: Miaror Vasus
rites.text: A consecrating rite practiced by a priest of the light. It grants the holy caster a blessing-art to draw on in their devotions.

rites.name: Rilaunum
rites.text: A channel through which robed mystics draw upon the moving air. It is not something ordinary folk can take up, yet it seems to have given rise to a later, similar art.

rites.name: Maurollium
rites.text: A sacred flash of radiant force that a devoted warrior can call upon instantly. It mends a chosen ally's wounds or scorches a foe with holy light.

rites.name: Veoneria Coriarnales
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that certain sacred guardians carry from the moment they reach their tenth year of training. It works without being summoned, lending them sight beyond ordinary perception.

rites.name: Tirum Seolum
rites.text: A sacred craft that lets a holy warrior bind a blade to a vengeful rite. While the rite holds, the warrior's weapon takes on a particular ceremonial form.

rites.name: Teolanes
rites.text: A sacred utterance spoken in an instant that strikes a foe with harm and leaves them stumbling and disoriented.

rites.name: Serintus Amantiasor
rites.text: A bond fixed to a commander that lets those who carry it refuse to yield. It cannot be held alongside two rival disciplines of strategy and battlecraft.

rites.name: Telilantium
rites.text: A radiant blessing that certain luminous shards and sunlit orbs bestow upon a bearer during a time of readying. It strengthens the one who receives it.

rites.name: Amiasostia Corinus
rites.text: A sacred power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spiritual essence kept in a towering prison-sanctum. It lets a supreme ritual leader call upon that stored force.

rites.name: Orintiarnia
rites.text: A sacred teaching is gathered from stored soul-essence hidden in a dark, cursed spire. It grants a lingering power to those who study it.

rites.name: Colanum Sorninum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures use while they battle in the arena, allowing them to strike with a forceful blow of the limb.

rites.name: Ameostauria
rites.text: A bound trait carried by brewing adepts of a monastic order, said to stir inner fire. It is tied to several related marks that share the same discipline.

rites.name: Teontor Telaunum
rites.text: A grim discipline that lets a fallen warrior shrug off paralyzing blows and endure heavier wounds. It hardens the body against being halted in its tracks.

rites.name: Linastus
rites.text: A learned hunting discipline taught to the wardens of a border order. It sharpens the practiced eye of those who track people-like prey, and it is paired with the order's survival training.

rites.name: Sistium Valiarnium
rites.text: A tracking discipline that a hunter can earn once a rising companion reaches a set standing. It is taught by a horse-bodied guide who shares the craft with those who prove themselves.

rites.name: Oroles Amarnenium
rites.text: A hidden store of spirit-energy is drawn from sealed vaults in a dread spire. Its workers gather these reserves to unlock a stored spiritual power.

rites.name: Amolus Amalles
