rites.text: A sacred power drawn from hidden reserves of spiritual essence kept in a towering prison-fortress. It is gathered by those who seek to call upon it.

rites.name: Coraulum Amirnauntor
rites.text: A discipline of teaching a bonded beast to join the chase at the side of its rider. It opens to those who have earned a high standing among their people.

rites.name: Valeonor Vistaullus
rites.text: A bound manual that teaches hunters how to bend wild sky-coiled beasts to their will. Only those who have earned standing with a sect of cloud-keepers may acquire it, and its lessons pass to every hunter in their household.

rites.name: Coriastires Roleres
rites.text: A chill-bound gift that a frost-touched warrior carries in the body. It binds closely with two other lasting gifts of the same order.

rites.name: Leolus Cilanes
rites.text: A channelled rite that calls a wide storm of wind and water down upon every foe within its reach. Priests of the old orders learn it once they reach mastery of the elements.

rites.name: Amistollus
rites.text: A ferocious bite technique that a small beast uses in a contest of tamed companions. It lets the creature tear deeper into its rival during a duel.

rites.name: Vanolium Serilium
rites.text: A tutoring bond that opens once a rider reaches a high standing with a particular beast. It teaches the keeper of the beast stalking methods.

rites.name: Volanum Rarnium
rites.text: A tactic in which a companion beast lowers its head and rams its horned crest into a rival during a contest of tamed creatures. Bearers of the technique strike hard enough to drive enemies back.

rites.name: Ciarantum
rites.text: A caster's ward that hardens the wearer against blows and cold, with a chance to freeze foes who strike at them. Their weapons grow sluggish once chilled, slowing both their steps and their swings.

rites.name: Nialiranum
rites.text: A bond-given gift of the spirit that a deity grants to a follower. It cannot be held alongside a rival ambush craft.

rites.name: Tinerum
rites.text: Hunters draw on a set of learned talents. Most of these talents are common to every branch of the craft, while a few belong only to one specialty.

rites.name: Meollia Mianentium
rites.text: A learned discipline of the arcane caster that shortens the recovery time of a chilling burst which erupts around the practitioner. Adepts study it to unleash their freezing pulse again sooner.

rites.name: Veolium Vialisum
rites.text: A ghostly binding art drawn from reserves of stored spirit-essence hidden deep inside a dreaded ruined spire. It lets a practitioner weave shapeless energy into new effects.

rites.name: Corolanum Meostium
rites.text: A trained hunting discipline that a ranger learns through the wild beast tradition. It sharpens the bond between a hunter and the creature at their side.

rites.name: Toses Valauranum
rites.text: A refined mental fog that clouds the minds of foes, drawn from an order's secret training. It is granted to practitioners only after long study and cannot be relied upon early in their path.

rites.name: Miasor Raulisium
rites.text: A frost-bound craft channeled through the hand, carried by cold-working adepts. It is bound to the arts of clear reasoning and gentle chilling touch.

rites.name: Nialum Rallum
rites.text: A sharpened psychic lance that a devout caster could learn from their order's training. It was offered early on, though mastery of its full form came only after long study.

rites.name: Tiastoria
rites.text: A nature-keeper's learned art that strengthens the growth of living things. It belongs to the restorative branch of a sacred circle of healers.

rites.name: Meolaustor
rites.text: A refined discipline taught to wardens of the wild, granting a greater chance to slip past incoming blows while the chosen stance is held. It belongs to a tradition of beast-inspired techniques and has since been set aside.

rites.name: Veontanum Telarnum
rites.text: A gift of restorative growth that is granted only to healers who tend the land. It refines the healing craft of those who practice the old mending arts.

rites.name: Riasium Mantanum
rites.text: A temple discipline that quickens a marksman's ranged strikes by a rising share with each rank learned. Its shots sometimes surge into bursts of heightened force, and skilled archers pair it with a rapid-loose technique for brief peaks of deadly output.

rites.name: Ciarnanum Ralia
rites.text: A tactician's refinement that lets a foe dazed by a precise strike take greater harm from every blow that follows, for the rest of the stun.

rites.name: Aminauranum
rites.text: A projected likeness of a dark sorcerer that manifests along a desolate coastline during a ritual of ruin. It serves as a ghostly echo of the caster's will.

rites.name: Vistiasor
rites.text: A bound force of inner spirit drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, looming tower. It grants its wielder a sovereign authority over lesser powers.

rites.name: Cantia Amernisanum
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by shadow-binders who thrust a victim's terror into a waking nightmare. The afflicted creature moves more slowly while the dream clings to it.

rites.name: Veolus Valeonernes
rites.text: A healer's discipline that strengthens a stone-bound guardian rite, granting it extra uses and greater mending power. It can only be learned by those who already practice the rite.

rites.name: Misus Coriasor
rites.text: A tier four discipline taught within a marksman's lodge, where practitioners refine the venom-tipped lashes used by hunters. It is no longer practiced after an old decree ended its teaching.

rites.name: Cenum Rellonum
rites.text: A flickering enchantment that conjures false flames of raw elemental heat. It is crafted through a specific arcane discipline and learned from a written formula.

rites.name: Toniales
rites.text: A shaman's learned discipline that strengthens the crackling charges of a storm-bound ward, so each charge strikes harder with every level practiced.

rites.name: Tausor Saullor
rites.text: A sacred craft practised by temple adepts, it binds a chosen gift to a single rite. It cannot be taken alongside another gift of the same ritual path.

rites.name: Morniarium
rites.text: A discipline practiced by a sect of contemplative healers, who purge harmful residue from the body. Only certain adepts who weave mist-like breath may learn it.

rites.name: Vestirnum
rites.text: A healer's discipline that softens the mana drain of a swift mending spell. It also sharpens its chance of a greater restoration when a wounded ally sits at half strength or lower.

rites.name: Oreorum Siantanum
rites.text: A radiant technique that a glowing lantern-keeper can call upon during a contest between tamed companions. It lets the lamp-bearer's allies shine brightly in the struggle.

rites.name: Seolanum Nolum
rites.text: A discipline of spinning strikes that intensifies a sweeping blade-dance, causing it to deal greater harm to everything caught within its circling arc.

rites.name: Tirnanum Corostum
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline of hardening the bark-skin of the body. It is chosen in place of another gift of the same circle, so a keeper must pick one path or the other.

rites.name: Telases Taullaria
rites.text: A shimmering trick of false sight that a companion beast can raise during a contest of creatures. It shields its caster by bending what the opponent perceives.

rites.name: Seraurnus Coraunoria
rites.text: A dormant inner craft that a sworn guardian could awaken upon reaching a high rank of seasoned mastery. It would quietly grant sharper discernment without any active effort.

rites.name: Centes Seorenes
rites.text: A protective flame-barrier that sometimes hurls incoming fire back at its caster. The bounced blaze does not wear down the barrier's remaining strength, so the ward lasts longer in combat. It was later superseded by a newer technique.

rites.name: Rintanum Corianor
rites.text: A minor sacred practice taught to healer-acolytes that strengthens the mending rites they perform. Its added restorative power is applied only after a caster's worn ritual trappings have already taken effect.

rites.name: Viarauntia
rites.text: A passive burning aura that clings to certain fiery beings, pulsing heat outward every few heartbeats. Each pulse scorches any foes standing close by.

rites.name: Ceostauntus Linanum
rites.text: A hunter's trained talent that sharpens the perception of a tamed beast companion. It is taught at the second rung of the beast-handling discipline.

rites.name: Viasanum Reollium
rites.text: A tier five discipline taught within the assassin's craft, mastered only after a dedicated investment of training. Practitioners learn to strengthen their toxins through a single specialized path of study.

rites.name: Leosum Nanes
rites.text: A learned craft of the grove-keepers that sharpens the binding roots, letting them hold a foe more firmly. Its old practice was later set aside by the orders.

rites.name: Corasollum
rites.text: A refined cleansing ritual practiced by healers of a sacred order. It draws on the restorative arts and sits high among the lessons taught to those who mend the wounded.

rites.name: Tallosum
rites.text: A stunning cry drawn from the wild spirit of a caster's craft. It is chosen as an exclusive option that cannot be taken alongside a heavy striking technique.

rites.name: Losiria
rites.text: A long-lost temple craft that strengthens the guardian bound to a caster. It makes the bonded sentinel more effective in every task it performs.

rites.name: Miantaulor
rites.text: A passive discipline that strengthens a life-draining ritual, causing it to deal more harm and restore more vitality to the caster.

rites.name: Rausia Corintes
rites.text: A practitioner's art that lets a caster draw a surge of spell potency after breaking a charged crystal. The surge scales with the caster's stored reserve of life-force and pairs well with a discipline of mental channeling.

rites.name: Caroses
rites.text: A gifted caster's ancient art lets a practitioner take on a new shape once they reach a high level of mastery. It is a talent that arrives only after long devotion.

rites.name: Saulanum Mollum
rites.text: A devotional practice granted to certain healers in the temple orders, where the faithful can cleanse their sins more effectively. It is not guaranteed to be learned until a late stage of training.

rites.name: Laulor Laustum
rites.text: A calming vapor that a healer's monastic order can draw upon, granted to adepts once they reach an advanced rank of training.

rites.name: Mausestum Corolum
rites.text: A warrior's gift that hastens the wellspring of fury within, letting the inner blaze be kindled again after a shorter wait of up to two minutes.

rites.name: Orerontium
rites.text: A devotional discipline taught through a branch of sacred training, it lets allies keep their focus when struck. It also shortens the hold of silencing and disruptive bindings placed on them.

rites.name: Vausanes
rites.text: A sharpened form of the healing chant that draws less from the caster's inner reserves. It lets a healer restore allies while spending a smaller store of arcane strength.

rites.name: Virnor Lauror
rites.text: A sacred chant that calls forth a restored guardian spirit. Its verses are used to open the way for a reclaimed protector within buried sanctuaries.

rites.name: Centanum Veonium
rites.text: A discipline practiced by ritual casters that strengthens the restorative power of small sealed charms carried for healing.

rites.name: Ceontilor Oriallaunes
rites.text: A rooted posture that holds a warrior's body firm against all force. It is passed on as a fragment left behind by a dwelling beast in a distant wilderness, and it stands ready to be recovered by those who seek it out.

rites.name: Vinia Amaurnia
rites.text: A mark of dark summoning carried within a relic, tied to two other lesser workings of the same circle. It answers the hand of one who calls forth lesser beings.

rites.name: Ciniastium
rites.text: A tempering discipline that amplifies the sudden fury a fighter gathers when a ritual war-cry is invoked. Its practitioners feel the surge arrive all the sooner.

rites.name: Tantus Mosus
rites.text: A warding craft in which a frozen barrier returns part of the strain it absorbs back to its caster as renewed inner energy. Later reworked into a different form of cold protection.

rites.name: Amiantia Valania
rites.text: A temple-trained healing art that lets a priest draw life from a wounded foe. It was a refinement of an older gift, and it only came to a devotee after long practice.

rites.name: Telorisia
rites.text: A rare chant that calls forth a spark-bound caster within a bone-lined hall on a storm-washed isle. Its use is needed to finish certain trials of the isle's guardians.

rites.name: Corausintus Teleseontor
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline that thickens a shaped bark-hide, lessening the blows it takes and making its warding harder to strip away. It is learned only after long devotion to the healing paths.

rites.name: Raustia Rantanum
rites.text: A temple discipline that once sharpened the warmth a healer kept burning inside themselves. It was later struck from the rites of the order.

rites.name: Neonolium
rites.text: A fire-channeling skill that a caster learns at a middling tier of mastery. It supersedes an older flame strike and absorbs a former ability that spreads weakening effects to nearby foes. Selected at a later rank, it can also carry a lingering burning curse from one target to the next.

rites.name: Ciaroles
rites.text: A practiced knack among shadow-trained killers that makes their toxins more likely to take hold in a victim. Every kind of venom they carry becomes more reliable when applied.

rites.name: Rileornus
rites.text: A deepened ember-craft taught in the destruction disciplines of the sorcerer orders. It belongs to the third rank of training and reshapes the flame that consumes the soul.

rites.name: Leonaror
rites.text: A sacred discipline of unbreakable judgment that lets a sworn guardian of order endure any hardship while carrying out righteous verdicts. It is practiced by protectors bound to a holy code.

rites.name: Mirium Neonarum
rites.text: A devoted cleric's learned discipline that washes away corruption from the faithful. Only the light-aligned healers of the order may master its refined form, while those who walk the shadow path practice a different cleansing.

rites.name: Teleoles Vistes
rites.text: A grasping art of living vines that a caster may cultivate at a middle stage of study within a nature-focused discipline. It empowers the binding roots that hold foes in place.

rites.name: Nestium Laurnes
rites.text: A learned craft that the healers of a guardian order can refine, deepening the rage a wild warden draws upon. It is practiced by those who tend living growth.

rites.name: Amillantium
rites.text: A grasping craft that replaces the original hold while its caster channels it, turning the grip into a forceful hurling motion.

rites.name: Liareontes
rites.text: A hunter's skill from the beast-bonding branch that makes a summoner's bond cheaper to mend and quicker to cast. It restores a fallen companion with greater vitality.

rites.name: Cantor Serialium
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter learns to set aside the sting of wounds. It is a choice a warrior makes that cannot be combined with a particular wall-of-stone technique used in fighting.

rites.name: Tiarnus Tauntor
rites.text: A learned craft of the robed casters that sharpens the chance of a flaming burst landing a deadly blow and lets it reach farther across the field.

rites.name: Cestiles
rites.text: A sacred craft in which a chosen warrior kindles radiant heat within the body. It is exclusive to devoted knights and pairs with a gentle healing gift.

rites.name: Tirnium Rirnesium
rites.text: A rune-craft that was said to be shaped through the binding of a spirit. It rests in the lore as a technique whose making lies in the discipline of soul-binding.

rites.name: Teliantus Cirnus
rites.text: A keeper's ritual that deepens the searing burn of a lingering flame curse. Each strike and each ongoing scorch hits harder for the one who casts it.

rites.name: Seollum Melleosanum
rites.text: A hunter's trained craft that lets a binding strike sometimes pin a foe in place for a few heartbeats. When the pinning succeeds, a bright ring glows on the ground around the trapped quarry.

rites.name: Coraullum Volium
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline of tending spiked growth around the body. It is learned in the middle ranks of the Moonpath's teachings.

rites.name: Mollintanum
rites.text: A battle discipline practiced by fighters of an ancient order, granting a sharpened hunger for combat. It is not always passed on to a practitioner until they have mastered the earlier training.

rites.name: Oristia Cialor
rites.text: A ritual discipline practiced by healer-initiates in the restoring lineage. It shortens the time needed to complete a rite of mending.

rites.name: Casiantia
rites.text: A temple-taught refinement that strengthens the endurance blessing a cleric bestows on allies and deepens the cleric's own vigor.

rites.name: Amonirnor Coraureosus
rites.text: A tended growth rite that deepens the mending gifted by a keeper's renewal charm. It is taken by nearly every healer who follows the green-bough path.

rites.name: Viastinium
rites.text: A discipline taught within the elemental branch of a priestly order, sharpening the bond between a caster and their flame-bearing ward stones. It was once practiced but has since been abandoned.

rites.name: Lirnesium
rites.text: A rare rite that calls a hundred-spear warden from a bone-lined hall on a thunder island. Its use is required to complete certain trials on that isle, and it is kindled near a row of grave markers on the southeastern side.

rites.name: Corintaulum
rites.text: A practice taught to mage adepts that is granted at an advanced stage of training, though not every student gains it before reaching full mastery.

rites.name: Rasollus
rites.text: A sacred talent of the shadow disciples that deepens the life drawn from a dark bond, so that every draining touch restores more vitality to the one who gives it.

rites.name: Vastauranum
rites.text: A ritual technique of the hexcasters that deepens a binding meant to sap an enemy's striking force. Practitioners learn it to make the affliction bite harder.

rites.name: Sestanum Lintia
rites.text: A trained technique for striking an opponent with a guard, useful against casters in duels and battles. It also draws an enemy's attention toward the one who uses it.

rites.name: Telisium Valaunontor
rites.text: A discipline of the grove that shortens the recovery between a beast-form savage strike and lowers the vigor its claw assault demands from the wielder.

rites.name: Leror Misum
rites.text: A learned technique that sharpens a fighter's forceful counterstrike, making a decisive blow more likely to land with full devastating force.

rites.name: Terintus Amelleostia
rites.text: A tutored craft that shortens how long a caster must chant before a small flame is hurled. Each level learned trims a quarter of a breath from the incantation.

rites.name: Misastor
rites.text: A dark cursed rite that scorches a foe at once and then sets them burning over time. Its ember-work is practiced by sorcerers who lean toward the slow, lingering kind of ruin.

rites.name: Vaures Oriastor
rites.text: A flame-practitioner's inner attunement that guides the mind toward sharp, decisive strikes. It was once a recognized discipline of the fire-wielding adepts, though it has since fallen out of use.

rites.name: Tausantum
rites.text: A refined rite of cleansing open only to healer-priests of one lineage. Other practitioners of the path are taught a plainer version of the same rite.

rites.name: Corneostia
rites.text: A defensive discipline that lengthens the time a warrior can hold a protective wall of raised defense. It refines an existing guarding technique so it lasts somewhat longer.

rites.name: Vauntium Valasia
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a remembered flowering of a sacred spring. It is obtained from that remembrance and lets the carver shape glyphs of power.

rites.name: Vastum Toriarnus
rites.text: A dark inherent power that gives its bearer a fierce drive to avenge wrongs against them. It is bound to a trio of related gifts that feed on lost spirits and bristle with sharp defensive barbs.

rites.name: Amentiallor
rites.text: A free instant blessing that a holy caster can invoke on themselves. It strengthens protective gear and boosts the potency of their spells until they choose to end it.

rites.name: Misialium
rites.text: A ritual preparation made through alchemical craft that cleanses the dead. It is learned from a written formula and requires a skilled practitioner.

rites.name: Sellium Veosium
rites.text: A sacred gift of restoring vitality that is bound to a set of related blessings. It works alongside those companion powers and draws its strength from them.

rites.name: Cantaurium
rites.text: A free, instantly cast blessing that a cleric may bestow upon themselves. It lowers the energy needed for swift rites and quickens the caster's pace on foot.

rites.name: Rallium
rites.text: A zealous wrath-craft taught to holy judges, granted as one of two mutually exclusive paths that a sworn avenger may take. Choosing it forecloses the other path's storm-blessing.

rites.name: Telaunarium
rites.text: A basic strike technique taught to novice fighters in temple halls. Its appearance shifts with the weapon a practitioner holds, though its force and energy cost stay unchanged.

rites.name: Amiarenia
rites.text: A discipline practiced by the shade-keeper orders that lets a practitioner slip beyond touch. It is taken as an exclusive path alongside steady resolve of mind.

rites.name: Amenus Meollus
rites.text: A quiet passive bearing that a fighter of the blade-and-rage schools carries from the moment they reach full maturity. It sharpens their adaptability in battle by a small measure.

rites.name: Orallium Valeornor
rites.text: A bright innate talent carried by spellcasters of the arcane channeling kind. It is a rare choice that works alongside a commanding presence.

rites.name: Sistum Contes
rites.text: A discipline of the inner self that a warrior-keeper may take up as one of two mutually exclusive paths. Choosing it closes off the other path.

rites.name: Valaunus Seriantor
rites.text: A spirit-born technique that releases a gust of jade-colored vapor. It is used by a fire spirit when it battles alongside a bonded companion creature.

rites.name: Lesum Restium
rites.text: A practiced talent of the water-callers that floods a battlefield in a sudden rush. It cannot be learned alongside a rival practice that splits the ground.

rites.name: Oreornostia
rites.text: A destructive craft of inner fire that a caster may choose instead of a rival practice. It pairs with a sibling discipline that unravels decay.

rites.name: Reontia Tilia
rites.text: A sacred rite by which a devout caster summons a radiant celestial ally. The rite draws on the favor of a faithful devotee of the light.

rites.name: Vestes Oreolanum
rites.text: A discipline of hardening the living bark of sacred trees against harm. Practitioners of the restorative circles draw on the grove's enduring wood to mend and protect.

rites.name: Tilauntanum
rites.text: A devotional craft granted to temple-trained healers, letting them turn a gift of hidden radiance into a sharper light once it is awakened.

rites.name: Orelleonus
rites.text: A channeling vessel used by wandering disciplined fighters to focus their rage. It is said to be found within a hidden shrine and in a distant mirror-realm of cold stone.

rites.name: Mialeornum Oranaules
rites.text: A discipline taught within the cloistered brotherhoods, where a monk picks this path instead of a rival practice. Choosing it locks out the alternative technique.

rites.name: Tiantanum Valiales
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a recalled memory of an old speaker of sacred marks. Those who master it can etch sigils that channel that remembered power.

rites.name: Nalores
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that mends one's spirit from within. It is taught to the devout ones who tend living things and guard the mind.

rites.name: Valostelum
rites.text: A warrior's trained roar that strikes terror into a foe and scatters nearby enemies in panic. The paralyzing dread ends the moment the target is harmed.

rites.name: Neontes Maurnirus
rites.text: A passive discipline that a trained hunter can learn, dulling every blow the hunter receives by a tenth. It is granted once the hunter reaches a high rank of skill.

rites.name: Cantes Lonanum
rites.text: A hidden glow kindled within a guardian's heart that the devoted can call upon to strengthen their shield-bearing craft. It is shaped by a deep sacred force stored within the land.

rites.name: Coreoliania
rites.text: A bonding discipline granted by a commander that lets a warrior cow foes through menace. It cannot be held alongside a stone-hardening skin.

rites.name: Coraurnia Amestium
rites.text: A sacred rite lets a devoted champion call a fallen companion back to life while the clash of battle continues. It is practiced by oath-bound guardians of the holy order.

rites.name: Amarnia Lileontium
rites.text: A discipline that hardens a fighter's mind so that stunning and enchanting influences have less hold over them.

rites.name: Oreoraulus
rites.text: A devoted practitioner calls forth a crimson bird-spirit that mends companions nearby and shields the caller from being snared or slowed. The rite can only be chosen instead of a rival serpent-spirit invocation.

rites.name: Amosirum
rites.text: A fiery mage-craft trait that lets a bearer draw forth heightened flame power from a relic. It is bound to a related inner-strength gift shared by another tradition.

rites.name: Nilliarus Resor
rites.text: A recognition awarded to those who have learned the art of expert mounted riding. It marks a rider who has mastered their steed across open country.

rites.name: Mentor Neornastus
rites.text: A guarding discipline held by armored war-bearers that shields their bodies from harm. It binds closely with several other battle disciplines that harden the flesh, break foes, and raise walls of blade.

rites.name: Maurus Vostum
rites.text: A carving-craft that kindles flame within etched symbols, drawing its spark from a remembered glow held in the mind. It is gained through recollection of that fire.

rites.name: Nelles Collesanum
rites.text: A carving discipline drawn from a recollection of an ancient keeper. It lets a practitioner channel inscribed sigils into strength.

rites.name: Ceoniastia
rites.text: A lasting mark of skill awarded to healers who have accumulated a set measure of training in tending wounds. It recognizes competence earned through practice in basic restoration of the body.

rites.name: Vistium Taulentes
rites.text: A sacred invocation where a devoted warrior passes sentence on a foe while bound by a self-cast ward. Its effects range from harm to hindrance, and a lingering curse is renewed with each blow the warrior lands.

rites.name: Serollia Amiarum
rites.text: A sworn warrior gains this passive discipline upon taking a particular vow of vengeance at a set rank of training. It is the chief way such a fighter restores their inner reserve of power while striking foes in battle.

rites.name: Cialases
rites.text: A ritual marking that lets a warden's hands grow hooked and cutting. It binds closely with three other sacred marks worn by the same keepers.

rites.name: Sereostia Neontor
rites.text: A green crackling power that a hatchling of a serpent spirit unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. It strikes an opponent with bursts of living storm energy.

rites.name: Ristes Seoraulor
rites.text: A consecrated ranged technique where a warrior of the sacred orders channels radiant force at a chosen foe. It is learned at a middling tier of training.

rites.name: Rostarus
rites.text: A bound trait carried by beast-tamers that lets their companions bite with a thunderous force. It is tied to other linked charms that strengthen swift strikes, mastery over creatures, and a hardened shell.

rites.name: Taurnium Nollanum
rites.text: A hunter's inherited knack for biting down with unshakable force. It works alongside the wild fury of the unseen trail and the bond formed with clawed companions.

rites.name: Tisenanum
rites.text: A consecrated rite that a sworn guardian calls upon to mark a foe, so that each blow struck against that foe may restore a measure of the striker's own vitality.

rites.name: Rentum Mistanum
rites.text: A carving-craft of ancient runes that draws its strength from a remembered ancestor. It lets a practitioner reach upward and extend their reach across great heights.

rites.name: Rirnium Liantor
rites.text: A resonant power drawn from sealed reliquary hoards buried within a dreadful, ever-shifting tower of punishment. It lets its bearer summon the thundering momentum of an unstoppable war-charge.

rites.name: Nistiarus
rites.text: A sworn avenger's exclusive oath-technique that is chosen alongside a final judgment strike. It is a path a wielder must commit to, shaping how their righteous wrath is spent.

rites.name: Serontisium
rites.text: A sacred discipline in which a devoted champion of the light turns personal loss into righteous judgment. It is tied to the practices of mending wounds and bearing another's weight.

rites.name: Teleorium Valiarnum
rites.text: A brewing discipline where a practitioner hurls a heavy cask that strikes a foe and nearby enemies, and shortens the wait before the practitioner can brew again.

rites.name: Seriasilia
rites.text: A carved-rune power drawn from a remembered verdict of an ancient adjudicator. It is gained by recalling that old ruling.

rites.name: Valaunium Veornum
rites.text: A swift technique a stealthy blade-wielder can unleash to strike a foe with a sudden flood of force. When a companion whirling art is active, the strike reaches nearby adversaries as well, and it competes with a rival path of shadowed arts.

rites.name: Riarolium
rites.text: A bonded sludge-spirit trait that a plague-crafting sorceress bestows upon a chosen follower. It binds a creature of murky ooze to its wielder's spirit.

rites.name: Amaniantium
rites.text: A trained strike of the foot that breaks a caster's chant mid-word. When it lands, the caster's hand is barred from weaving that same branch of magic for a brief span.

rites.name: Serorellum
rites.text: A proving trial awarded to those who clear a deep underground hall at the highest tier of difficulty within the set time. The reward is a shadow-passage spell that lets the victor step through a hidden track of darkness.

rites.name: Tintollus
rites.text: A blessing that settles upon the one who topples a tyrant-king in the deep crypts of the northern ruins. The favor lasts as a mark of that triumph.

rites.name: Tosiales
rites.text: A carved mark of sacred power that is drawn from a remembered oath. It lets a carver inscribe runes that act on the world.

rites.name: Miasirnia
rites.text: A carved-rune craft drawn from a remembered lethal touch. Its practitioners etch the sigil that channels this recollection into their hands.

rites.name: Telostium Telintium
rites.text: A lost mental craft said to be woven from a bound spirit's inner force. Its practitioners once shaped it into an arcane design meant to channel motion.

rites.name: Valiria Tostes
rites.text: A sacred knowing passed down by keepers of old craft. It links with enduring grace, with seeds that hold a great living tree, and with the power of a chief keeper.

rites.name: Siranum Amianes
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws strength from a remembered bond between kin. It is learned by keeping that recollection alive.

rites.name: Teosia Mornia
rites.text: A lasting inner fortitude that is granted to a seeker who meets an ancient inscribed record. It is one of three possible blessings that such a record can bestow.

rites.name: Sanaullum
rites.text: A devotional skill that once belonged to the sacred branch of a warrior's training and required heavy dedication to fully master. It was later set aside and replaced by a different form of radiant practice.

rites.name: Leosistor
rites.text: A learned bond that a practitioner of the wild arts gains at a high rank of mastery. It lets the adept work with the hides of beasts in a special way.

rites.name: Tolirnus
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a remembered dreamer. It lets a practitioner etch glyphs that channel the lingering essence of an ancient memory.

rites.name: Neolum Tollium
rites.text: A dark-bound lash that a summoned servant of a sorcerer strikes with instantly, dealing harm drawn from shadow. It is a craft of the shadow-binding servants.

rites.name: Veoresium
rites.text: A warrior's craft of bounding over enemies that is bound into a protective artifact. It works alongside other guardian traits that share its lineage.

rites.name: Teontonor
rites.text: A holy practice in which a devout caster channels radiant power through their palms to restore a companion's life at once. Its long recovery makes it a reserved last resort, and it is learned by sacred guardians.

rites.name: Corauses Tiasium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that is drawn from a remembered echo of a great jumping spirit. Practitioners channel it through inscribed stone to gain surging leaps.

rites.name: Vornastes
rites.text: A fire-wielding craft that tends glowing molten channels, passed down among elemental mystics as a discipline of deeper training. It belongs to the fourth rank of a sacred branching tree of the elements.

rites.name: Vaures Valenia
rites.text: A carving craft that stores a faded sovereign's residual force within etched sigils. It is drawn from a remembered ruler's lingering presence.

rites.name: Cireonus
rites.text: A spirit-lord who commands swift motion. Through him, a shadow stalker learns to move with great speed and can grant that speed and grace to companions.

rites.name: Tisum Vintaunum
rites.text: A tactic a shieldbearer can call upon in dire straits, bolstering their endurance with a surge of borrowed vitality. The reserve lasts a short span and fades away when the time runs out.

rites.name: Masum Ranernus
rites.text: A brewer-monk's art of unsettling an opponent's gaze through a practiced skill. It is learned by inscribing a sacred sigil into one's craft.

rites.name: Amentilia
rites.text: A discipline practiced by devoted brotherhood members who reach a high level of mastery. It grants them a lasting inheritance drawn from an ancient ruler's teachings.

rites.name: Relirnanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that binds a charm into gloves, permanently quickening the hands of those who strip hides from beasts.

rites.name: Vastilor
rites.text: A cursed mental discipline practiced by a shadowed order of clerics, bound to a related mind-sharpening art. It works by lashing the thoughts of its victims.

rites.name: Teleonestum
rites.text: A ritual flame-bolt that a spirit-caller can wield in place of a crackling storm-chain while channeling a rising kindred-force. The caller must be a keeper of the elemental path.

rites.name: Serinantor
rites.text: A patient craft of gathering wild greens and roots more swiftly by binding a lasting charm into a pair of gloves. The charm quickens the hands of anyone who wears them while they harvest.

rites.name: Losintes Reoria
rites.text: A carving art that a traveler gains by receiving a remembered echo of an icebound sorceress. It lets the bearer inscribe marks that shape cold and sharp magic.

rites.name: Nestasia
rites.text: A devout caster's talent that draws an ally across the field straight to the caster's side. It serves as a rescue tool for companions caught in danger or swarmed by foes.

rites.name: Visus Neontiria
rites.text: A bound guardian lashes out in a wide arc, striking every foe nearby and leaving the one it guards marked with a short-lived curse that dulls mending.

rites.name: Valianistes
rites.text: A sacred healing power that a devout caster learns from a radiant relic-spirit. It is bound to the calm of peaceful resolve.

rites.name: Nallus Tiarnanum
rites.text: A cunning-thief's trained gift found in the middle rank of the Duelist's path. It sharpens the wearer's evasion and quickens their movements.

rites.name: Nollum Valonaurnes
rites.text: A crackling ward that a practitioner raises at a suitable level of skill. When blows are exchanged, it strikes back at the one who struck or was struck, dealing direct harm.

rites.name: Ventium Liaria
rites.text: A wisp-like essence that drifts around its bearer for a short while once called forth. It shares a recovery delay with certain tonics and liquid spirits.

rites.name: Lentiasium
rites.text: A sworn-oath gift that lets a holy warrior of the vengeful kind call down radiant judgment. It can only be taken in place of a rival swift-verdict gift.

rites.name: Nosium Valiaranum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by ascetic monks, where a practitioner chooses between two rival rites. Taking one rite forecloses the other, and the choice shapes how the monk channels breath and vitality.

rites.name: Rernaunum
rites.text: A minor unstable force that flares up during a violent clash inside a remote temple sanctuary. It is a fleeting power tied to the anger of the place.

rites.name: Vallor Nesostium
rites.text: A minor restorative current drawn from living growth, called upon when swift mending matters more than conserving reserves. It mends wounds quickly, though it draws more from the caster's inner spark than its greater counterpart.

rites.name: Valaurastus
rites.text: A devotional craft of guarded radiance, taught within a sacred discipline and mastered only after a long dedication to its inner school. Practitioners must invest deeply in the discipline before the gift fully opens.

rites.name: Valum Villus
rites.text: A sacred discipline that lets a holy warrior move with swift radiance. It is chosen as one path that excludes its rival, and it pairs with guided devotion.

rites.name: Vauror Orerniantum
rites.text: A binding ritual that inscribes a chestplate so the wearer's vitality is permanently strengthened. Only a practitioner who has reached a high level of enchanting mastery can perform it.

rites.name: Oraunia Seranus
rites.text: A binding craft that imbues a close-combat blade with a lasting charm, so that some strikes made in close fighting restore the strength of the one who holds it.

rites.name: Valarnelia
rites.text: A radiant gift bound to a sacred relic that works in tandem with a companion trait. It shapes how the guardian holds ground and protects their allies.

rites.name: Corasternia
rites.text: A temple rite lets a chosen bearer rise gently from the ground, drifting slowly downward and crossing still waters on foot. Mounted riders cannot receive it, and any wound or saddling ends it at once.

rites.name: Mistium Contianus
rites.text: A glowing focus power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spiritual essence within a dread tower of the lost. Seekers gather it from sealed caches deep inside the structure.

rites.name: Teliranum Cistus
rites.text: A ritual binding that is set into a close-combat blade so it permanently strikes two extra points of harm. The lasting charge makes each cut and thrust hit harder than the steel alone would allow.

rites.name: Tisellor
rites.text: A glowing inner energy that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a deep, forbidding tower. Those who gather it gain a power that lights their every step.

rites.name: Valesarnia
rites.text: A minor concealment craft used by a cloaked caster kind, letting its user vanish from sight for a short span. It is a lesser working of the shadow arts.

rites.name: Amoseontus Telenia
rites.text: A companion creature can tend its own injuries by licking them clean, restoring its health. The talent once belonged to beasts that followed a wandering hunter.

rites.name: Lentus Orallenia
rites.text: A slow mending charm that a nature-keeper weaves onto one companion at a time. When its hold ends or is torn away, it blooms in a rush of restoring warmth, but placing it on someone new unravels the earlier one without any bloom.

rites.name: Sialerum Tauneollum
rites.text: A hidden gift that a wandering disciple of the sky-strikers gains from their fist-oaths. It cannot be seen in any written tome or listed among the carved relics.

rites.name: Miarnes Roreontium
rites.text: A trait of the sacred mist-keepers that grants a practitioner a swift, gentle footing. It is bound to older teachings of breath and renewal.

rites.name: Coraurnes Vallum
rites.text: A lasting binding that can be worked into a close-combat blade, granting it greater force against elemental beings. The added strength is a fixed bonus that never fades.

rites.name: Colia Seolaurum
rites.text: A stored spirit-energy that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dark, cursed tower. It grants its wielder a protective power.

rites.name: Serorum Valauntum
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to a disciplined devotee who wears a holy relic, linked to a council's collective will and to a bond with endured suffering.

rites.name: Amiarnor Corauntia
rites.text: A passive gift that sometimes lets a caster's storm-bolt strike twice in quick succession at no cost. The echoing strike arrives instantly, but it hits with only half its usual force.

rites.name: Mestiror
rites.text: A quick restorative art practiced by herb-wise healers, granting a rush of swiftness and a modest mending of wounds. It sharpens as the practitioner's green lore deepens, and its mending can occasionally surge stronger than expected.

rites.name: Amialentum
rites.text: A tempest-bound attunement practiced by storm mystics, it quickens the body and sharpens the pace of those who channel it.

rites.name: Nones Ciantostum
rites.text: A binding rite that permanently infuses a hand-held blade with a ruddy glow, making it strike far harder against creatures of the wild.

rites.name: Oriasia Oriallesus
rites.text: A binding ritual that infuses a great two-handed blade or hammer with lasting force, granting it a small surge of extra striking power on every blow.

rites.name: Tisia Veostenus
rites.text: A ritual binding taught to shamans, chosen as one of several mutually exclusive paths. It rivals a separate sky-strike technique, so a practitioner must pick one.

rites.name: Liasanum Reontum
rites.text: A consecrated warrior releases a fan of radiant brilliance ahead of themselves, mending the five most wounded allies standing within a short reach in front of the caster.

rites.name: Mirnestor
rites.text: A sacred gift borne by the robed brotherhood of mystics, linked to a related blessing that soothes the wounded and mends frayed spirits.

rites.name: Valauntus Naulosus
rites.text: A ritual binding that permanently imbues footwear with a small boost to striking precision. It cannot be worked into gear beyond a certain mastery threshold.

rites.name: Mernaria
rites.text: A mark of honor earned by a wanderer who has reached the highest level of patient angling. It is granted to those whose hands have grown skilled at drawing life from rivers and lakes.

rites.name: Meneollia
rites.text: A permanent enchantment bound into a close-combat blade that frequently draws vitality from a foe and passes it to the bearer. Its pull weakens against those who have grown far in experience.

rites.name: Telornus Santonor
rites.text: A devotional gift taught to temple keepers that lessens the harm borne by those touched by a penitent rite. It can be chosen only instead of a rival teaching of fervent preaching.

rites.name: Veornum Saulliaria
rites.text: A blessing granted to those who finish the daily offering to the Brenskor shrine, sharpening their bond with the hidden currents of the land.

rites.name: Amillastum Cauntenor
rites.text: A sacred rite granted to temple caretakers through an engraved sigil. It turns a glowing basin of radiance into a fountain that pours forth light.

rites.name: Vaunelum
rites.text: A sacred gift of temple priests that lets a practitioner shape radiance. It is chosen in place of a rival path and works closely with a luminous spring.

rites.name: Mostus Ameosirnus
rites.text: A vital gift that a shaper of living forms may cultivate. It is chosen in place of another mastery and cannot be held alongside it.

rites.name: Saulliastor
rites.text: A dark sorcerer tears a woman's inner spirit away from her physical form within a hidden school of forbidden arts. The separated essence is left unbound from its living shell.

rites.name: Niastor Siantum
rites.text: A ritual gift of the fire-keepers that lets a caster call molten stone into a glowing sigil. It can be chosen only by those already trained in primal flame-binding.

rites.name: Mianium Ceosia
rites.text: A solitary craft of endurance that a hunter may choose instead of a rival gift. It cannot be held alongside a companion discipline of the wild.

rites.name: Cestia Riaranum
rites.text: A moon-bred craft taught to wardens of the wild, granting them the power to call down a silver flame. It is a learned gift, passed from teacher to student.

rites.name: Amolaures
rites.text: A learned rite of restorative tidecraft that a wielder of the mending arts may take up. It becomes available once a practitioner reaches a set threshold of skill.

rites.name: Sauntia Rillenium
rites.text: A cunning trait of the unlawful wanderer, bound to a cursed bladed relic that shares its vitality. The trait tilts chance in the bearer's favor.

rites.name: Vesus Ceoserus
rites.text: A standing mark of devotion earned by a follower who reaches the fullest bond of trust with one of two sovereign rulers seated upon a black stone throne.

rites.name: Naurum Corisia
rites.text: A ritual gift for keeper-priests who draw healing from flowing currents. It is a mutually exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside a particular rain-calling charm.

rites.name: Tornintum
rites.text: A protective circle of radiance that is woven through a ringed sigil and used to ward against harm. It is brought into being by a great ring-shaped instrument.

rites.name: Lirnia Sereonoles
rites.text: A quiet inner attunement that a sorcerer's circle of study follows, shaping how their senses are tuned toward mastery of a craft. It belongs to the ancient disciplines of the temple schools.

rites.name: Rellus Nauntium
rites.text: A soothing ability that only a certain winged kind may use to lull others into calm rest. It is shared among the sky-birds of the old wild groves.

rites.name: Meostia Telaurinia
rites.text: A healer's craft in which a sprouting seed is planted on an ally whenever a mending touch lands a critical restoration. The seed later bursts with renewing life once that ally is struck by harm.

rites.name: Corinauria
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that channels a spiteful fury, drawn from a recollected spark of such rage. It is practiced by those who inscribe sigils to unleash a hostile power.

rites.name: Teliarnanum Mianor
rites.text: A caster conjures a temporary barrier around themselves that soaks up fiery, icy, or arcane harm. It fades after a short span or once it has taken its fill of punishment.

rites.name: Launeolum
rites.text: A ritual sequence that lets a wielder end an enchantment currently flowing through their own body. The rite is spoken aloud, naming the blessing to be severed.

rites.name: Miaseontus
rites.text: A bound crafting power is drawn from hidden reservoirs sealed within a grim tower of torment. It is gathered from those cache vaults and channels the chaotic scribblings of a deranged sorcerer.

rites.name: Riastaullus
rites.text: A carving-craft that lets its user briefly see something through the traces of a remembered presence. It is drawn from a keepsake of a departed guardian.

rites.name: Leornium Telosum
rites.text: A carved ritual marker that a shaman plants in the ground to scorch everything nearby with lingering flames. It is one of the shaman's two area-wide attacks, burning foes over time rather than in a single blast.

rites.name: Sentires
rites.text: A fiery rite that certain tamed companions call upon while engaged in a contest of beasts. It lets many of them unleash the same heat-driven assault during these arena clashes.

rites.name: Cialor Valirnes
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that lets healing-keepers of the grove call on their restorative rite more often. Only those who have reached a certain standing in the order can learn it.

rites.name: Ceoniastum Sirum
rites.text: A rattling ritual craft wielded by a bone-puppet spirit during a contest between tamed companions. It shakes unsettling sound to unsettle an opponent in the duel.

rites.name: Verastor
rites.text: A dormant craft that every adept of the storm-wardens learns without instruction, granting a shaped discharge of raw tempest to those who train in the fist-and-spark discipline.

rites.name: Seolus Tiallorus
rites.text: A binding that is worked permanently into a bladed or blunt armament, so every blow it lands carries an added measure of force. The weapon takes on a pale, see-through blue shimmer while the binding holds.

rites.name: Serantosum
rites.text: A innate knack that lets a bearer strike more truly while wielding heavy blunt clubs. It applies to each weapon separately, and it can sharpen a spell's aim when a mace is held in the main hand.

rites.name: Maulenus
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a remembered fever of a forgotten sage, letting a runecarver inscribe symbols that unsettle the mind. The power is gained by recalling that old lunacy.

rites.name: Corilanum Teornentia
rites.text: A brewed elixir that mends the body and refills the spirit together. Its restoring strength is vast, returning both vitality and inner energy in a single swallow.

rites.name: Mollia Amentiarnes
rites.text: A glowing fluid is made through a practiced inscribing craft and passed along by instructors to their students.

rites.name: Seriantasia
rites.text: A ritual censer-resin that a dark idol-master requires for calling forth its wrathful spirit at a stone altar in a shadowed ravine. Burning it opens the way for the spirit to manifest.

rites.name: Amistum Serostanum
rites.text: A devout caster raises a glowing veil that soaks up harm for everyone standing close by. The veil lasts a short while, and a rival weaving must be chosen over it.

rites.name: Oreleornium
rites.text: A people of wanderers can raise a temporary hearth in any open wild place. From that hearth they may call themselves back once every hour.

rites.name: Vernalor Sentilor
rites.text: A practitioner's trained technique that instantly cloaks the caster and nearby companions from sight. It is chosen as an either-or path alongside a communal shielding ward.

rites.name: Neollistia
rites.text: A quiet inner practice that lets a sworn mender of the cloud-robed order gradually restore their vital energy while calmly sitting, once they have reached a certain stage of training.

rites.name: Leornia Miantum
rites.text: A ritual caster repeatedly rouses a fallen companion with a fleeting breath of life. When the brief magic fades she collapses again, and only a deeper rite can make her rise for good.

rites.name: Amintiasium
rites.text: A trait of skilled poisoners and tricksters that lets a rogue craft potent concoctions. It pairs with a related trait for mixing ploys and another for inflicting bleeding wounds.

rites.name: Orernaullus
rites.text: A binding craft that lets a caster tangle many foes together at once. It is a chosen path that excludes a rival vortex-style ability.

rites.name: Varus Telostanum
rites.text: A dark inward-turning power drawn from hoarded soul-essence kept in forbidden deep-tower vaults. It festers in the mind and grows stronger the longer it is brooded over.

rites.name: Mallisia
rites.text: A carved sigil-power that is gained by recovering a remembered imprint of a veteran blade-for-hire. Wielders of this carving can etch the marking onto their own skin or gear.

rites.name: Maustes Orenantes
rites.text: A devotional discipline that grants a practitioner steadiness against interruption whenever a wound strikes them hard. Blows that land cleanly push back against the casting of spells.

rites.name: Amaurintium
rites.text: A shadowed incantation practiced by priests that siphons the arcane reserves from a foe and strikes them with dark energy. It is a craft of the temple orders.

rites.name: Lintes Teornium
rites.text: A living brand that a nature-keeper bears, granting the power to alter one's form. It answers to the sacred seeds of the great tree that holds the world together.

rites.name: Viares Raulirnium
rites.text: A battle-discipline trait that a fighter draws from a relic of war. It works alongside three other combat disciplines: steadied focus, exact blows, and endless fury.

rites.name: Liarnia Corellorium
rites.text: A practiced craft that raises a wide wall of force around a gathered crowd. It can only be learned as one of two mutually exclusive paths, the other being a veil that hides many at once.

rites.name: Telintarnia
rites.text: A cunning craft practiced by sneaking tricksters, whose skill at misleading foes grows with each level of training. It is taught within the first ring of a shadow-arts discipline.

rites.name: Amausteoria
rites.text: A reserve of arcane force that casters draw from to shape their incantations. It drains slowly with each spell and refills through rest, sipped elixirs, and charmed trinkets.

rites.name: Sesia Tirnallanum
rites.text: A temple-bound craft that spreads panic through whole crowds at once. It is tied to a sister craft that breaks the minds of those who fall under its sway.

rites.name: Nistaurnia
rites.text: A high-tier skill of the beast-tamer's path, chosen from paired options, that lets a bonded hunter pick either this technique or another. It cannot be taken alongside its rival.

rites.name: Valentium Oroneorum
rites.text: A nightwood sorcerer of an ancient elven line who calls forth beings of raw element. He carved a stone tablet and a sigil so that every noble of his people could witness his craft.

rites.name: Neostolor Telarnisium
rites.text: A brutish power of inner vitality that is drawn from hidden reservoirs found deep within a dreaded, layered tower of ruin. Those who gather it can take on its raw strength.

rites.name: Nauntes Causonia
rites.text: A shaper's talent drawn from the bear-spirit form, usable only while wearing that form. It wounds the chosen foe and stirs a surge of fury in the one who strikes.

rites.name: Lanor Coreostia
rites.text: A discipline of ritual magic practiced by those who command summoned spirits. It was once a learned art taught among the hidden circles of conjurers, but it has since been set aside and forgotten.

rites.name: Teosanum Telolaustus
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack held by hide-workers who study the body beneath the pelt. Their keen eye lets them strike true more often, and the skill grows as their craft deepens.

rites.name: Veontia Maurnum
rites.text: A grove-blessing that a guardian of the green bestows upon companions, strengthening their adaptability and resilience in the wild.

rites.name: Casialus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that grows in certain shapeshifting wardens once they reach a seasoned stage, letting their reserves refill twice as swiftly. It was granted to replace an older habit of drawing vigor from a pack-bond.

rites.name: Vallinium
rites.text: A coined arcane trait that marks a spellcaster as bound to a certain guardian power. It is closely tied to a second guardian trait that shares its strength.

rites.name: Veornum Seontanum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by shadow-minded priests that strengthens with a secondary talent of mastery. It works by wearing down the minds of foes.

rites.name: Teleosia Riarneolles
rites.text: A bond-craft practiced by wilderness trackers, sharpened by a hidden inner attunement. Its strength grows as the practitioner's attunement deepens.

rites.name: Valiasanum Naustianium
rites.text: A stored well of rage is cultivated by wind-walking monks, and their inner sharpness grows as their secondary gift of resonance deepens.

rites.name: Vernianes
rites.text: A sacred mark borne by protectors who walk in the wild. It stands bound to three other marks that share its strength and steady resolve.

rites.name: Amolestia
rites.text: A deep craft practiced by cloistered keepers who channel inner resolve into healing and cleansing. Its strength grows as the keeper's attuned reserve of spirit deepens.

rites.name: Serauleoria Oraristanum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that stirs when a sealed hunger is recalled. Practitioners draw its strength from an old memory of a chattering jaw.

rites.name: Orerausia
rites.text: A sacred discipline practiced by avenging warrior-keepers, whose skill grows stronger as their inner attunement deepens. It empowers the bearer's wrath with a sharpened, heavenly sense of justice.

rites.name: Serilles Corirnania
rites.text: A discipline of silent killing that grows stronger as the practitioner's inner keenness deepens. It is taught to those who walk the shadow-paths of the guild.

rites.name: Nellirnum
rites.text: A ritual gift held by sky-readers that lets them command the raw forces of nature. It is bound to the arts of lightning and mending, two separate crafts that answer the same calling.

rites.name: Cosum Tiriarnium
rites.text: A learned discipline for spellcasters of hidden lore, deepened by the practitioner's inner attunement. It is only taught once an apprentice reaches the tenth rung of their training.

rites.name: Nontistes Oreonaurium
rites.text: A temple discipline of the healers that amplifies the restoring and shielding power carried by those bound to a sacred vow. Each blessing bound to a supplicant returns more mending to them.

rites.name: Rornausanum
rites.text: A sacred discipline practiced by mist-spinning monks, whose inner strength grows as their attunement deepens. It draws its power from a wellspring of hidden skill within the practitioner.

rites.name: Torneosum Miallistum
rites.text: A chilling inner force that is drawn from hidden reserves kept in a dark tower of trials. It channels a cold, sharp energy that the wielder can call upon.

rites.name: Cerum Virnor
rites.text: A deep restorative discipline practiced by mending-seers, whose skill grows as a practitioner's inner attunement sharpens.

rites.name: Miaranum Lornia
rites.text: A discipline practiced by keepers of equilibrium, learned once a practitioner reaches a tenth stage of training. Its potency grows as a practitioner's inner mastery deepens.

rites.name: Oreontia Taulia
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wild shapers that grants keen, slashing hooks to the hand. Its strength grows as the practitioner's inner mastery deepens.

rites.name: Amorus Orauleorus
rites.text: A discipline practiced by mist-binding adepts, whose skill grows as their inner attunement deepens. It lets practitioners drive fog-like currents outward to steer and scatter the air around them.

rites.name: Vauriles
rites.text: A practitioner's inner skill that sharpens a mystic's command over elemental forces through a secondary trait of attunement. Its strength grows as the mastery trait increases.

rites.name: Serasor Sereosanum
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a practitioner call upon the glowing heart of the land to strengthen their workings. Its power grows as the practitioner's inner attunement deepens.

rites.name: Ameoranum Cesauntum
rites.text: A guardian's sustained endurance that grows stronger as the wielder's inner attunement deepens. It measures harm before any protective wards or claw-born effects are applied.

rites.name: Orialles Ceostiallia
rites.text: A calm inner discipline practiced by keepers of balance, sharpened by a hidden inner measure of attunement. It rewards those who walk the middle path between opposing forces.

rites.name: Vonarnes
rites.text: A discipline of bonding with a wild beast to aid in tracking and taking prey. Its skill grows alongside a practitioner's overall mastery of the craft.

rites.name: Lostium Seristalum
rites.text: A sacred skill of the warrior-sworn that deepens the radiant force they channel, growing stronger as their inner attunement sharpens.

rites.name: Lialintus Lintia
rites.text: A warrior discipline in which the fighter's blows grow harsher while their anger burns hot. Skill in this craft deepens the force behind every strike.

rites.name: Corolestia
rites.text: A discipline of stealth and endurance, practiced by hunters who wander the wild. Its strength grows through the training of a secondary skill.

rites.name: Tollastor
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wind-tread adepts that lets a single practitioner fuse two distinct trials of spirit and fist into one shared art. It is bound closely to the ways of the split self and the thunder-knuckle.

rites.name: Vanus Lostium
rites.text: A temple-trained mastery that grows stronger with a practitioner's inner attunement. It amplifies protective wards, guardian auras and spirit casings, and it also boosts the restorative power of their healing.

rites.name: Leoriarnium
rites.text: A temple discipline in which a practitioner tunes a hidden inner pulse toward swiftness. It is a secondary attunement of the shadow-keepers, favoring quickness of rhythm.

rites.name: Vasellia
rites.text: A discipline of stance and breath that lets a practitioner of destructive sorcery strengthen their hand against vast foes. Its potency grows as the adept's secondary attunement deepens.

rites.name: Lontum Corianostes
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wind-walking adepts, whose skill grows as their inner attunement deepens. It rewards those who chain their blows together in fluid sequence.

rites.name: Lelirnum
rites.text: A grove-keeper's technique that is chosen at a high tier of training. It pairs exclusively with a terrifying bellow that stuns foes.

rites.name: Lelaunanum
rites.text: A calming rite used by temple caretakers that softens the watchfulness of a chosen creature so it no longer notices a nearby traveler. If the creature shrugs off the hush, it rounds on the caster and a fight begins.

rites.name: Naunia Raunium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that channels surging, overflowing force, drawn from a remembered heavenly infusion. It is practiced by those who inscribe sigils into stone and metal.

rites.name: Coraulia Conantia
rites.text: A binding craft that imbues a blade with a lasting charm, so that striking foes now and then restores the wielder's vitality.

rites.name: Ciarilus
rites.text: A lingering blessing granted to those who gathered all five shards of a sealed soul. While it holds, a ghostly visage appears on a high gallery and can awaken a winged terror of the night.

rites.name: Rasia Serarus
rites.text: A mystic power bound to arcane relics that channels protective strength through linked ward-marks. It works in concert with several related sigils and rods.

rites.name: Relores
rites.text: A disciplined inner craft that raises a practitioner's mind, deepening their reasoning and sharpening the arts that draw on inner reserves. It is a advanced technique taught within temple training.

rites.name: Raurnus Carontes
rites.text: A mind-craft of the ritual keepers that sharpens a practitioner's striking force in proportion to the strength of their reasoning.

rites.name: Serianarnum
rites.text: A grove-keeper's craft that reshapes itself according to the path a practitioner has chosen to walk. It is learned only once a seeker has reached a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Narnor Tania
rites.text: A bloodline craft that lets a warrior absorb harm meant for allies. It is tied to two related rites that deepen its hold.

rites.name: Mernes Telentornia
rites.text: A ritual teaching that shows a practitioner how to call forth a bound earth spirit as a companion. The spirit is unleashed and not confined to any vessel.

rites.name: Serestia Corausor
rites.text: A learned formula that sharpens a mind's attention when it is drunk. It is gained by chance from an old record of forgotten recollections.

rites.name: Celliantia
rites.text: A bold trophy of strength that is granted to a keeper of a beast-drawn cart laden with carved flesh. It marks a rare mastery of a spirited mount.

rites.name: Vaulornor
rites.text: A sworn strength passed down among fierce northern clans, it hardens the bearer's defenses in battle. It is bound to a companion gift that lets a warrior's shout carry across the field.

rites.name: Telirnus Losia
rites.text: A sustained dark incantation that a caster holds open, sending repeated bursts of shadowy harm through every foe clustered close around a chosen point. The effect lasts only while the chant is maintained.

rites.name: Solanum Teliastanum
rites.text: A quiet discipline of carving marks in a slow, deliberate rhythm, drawing a lasting power from a remembered calm. Practitioners gain it by recovering that sustained focus in a sacred memory.

rites.name: Telisus Oriastia
rites.text: A brief spiritual silencing craft that a death-bound warrior invokes to halt an enemy's incantation mid-word. For a short span afterward, the rival's kindred magic cannot be woven again.

rites.name: Seriallenes
rites.text: A binding ritual that permanently infuses a close-combat blade with arcane force, sharpening the caster's magic by a fixed measure. It can only be worked upon a relic of considerable potency.

rites.name: Raurosium
rites.text: A bond of guidance is granted by a sacred patron through a binding rite. It cannot coexist with a radiant vessel of ascension.

rites.name: Riasonor
rites.text: A grasping skill of wild shapers, chosen as an exclusive option alongside a rival art of flailing strikes. The two paths cannot both be taken by one practitioner.

rites.name: Nillanum Tarum
rites.text: A conjured image drawn from a sleeper's mind, appearing as a shared scene that replays a remembered moment. It lets watchers witness a past event as if they stood within it.

rites.name: Oraustor Teliror
rites.text: A tender craft by which a tracker restores the strength of their bonded beast. It lies within a shared menu, giving way to a revival rite whenever the companion has fallen.

rites.name: Mineolia Mareostor
rites.text: Each lunar cycle, moon-bonded beasts are schooled in a silver grove. The rite prepares them for their bond with the watchers of the night sky.

rites.name: Sentonum
rites.text: A nightly craft of the sky-watchers that lets a practitioner draw silver light from the heavens into their battles. It is taught to adepts once they reach a certain standing in the orders.

rites.name: Mastia Seostinor
rites.text: A lasting charm bound into a long two-handed blade that adds a small extra measure of harm to each strike. The enchantment never fades once woven into the weapon.

rites.name: Mollum Valolintium
rites.text: A permanent binding that lets a hand-held blade strike creatures of the wild for two extra points of harm. Its modest strength is offset by being the least costly binding, which also makes the blade shine.

rites.name: Raurasus
rites.text: A discipline practiced by a sect of hooded contemplatives who gather fog into patterns. It stands apart from other arts and can only be mastered once every foundational practice has been learned first.

rites.name: Amarnia Lilum
rites.text: A discipline of sorrow that hardened fighters draw upon. It is chosen as a singular path that pairs with an improved binding mark of woe.

rites.name: Vasaurum
rites.text: A drifting fog gathered by monks of a ruined shrine. It is bound to the power that quickens new growth.

rites.name: Orontastum
rites.text: A blessing bestowed by a restless spirit upon those who take up a task meant to end a long torment. It lingers as a passing strength for the bearer.

rites.name: Sontialles
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that draws its power from a remembered sky of glowing heat. It is kept alive by the lore of that burning memory.

rites.name: Amernolium
rites.text: A lingering nightglow that clings to a target and wears away at it over time. It is a craft practiced by wild keepers who draw on the pale light of the moon.

rites.name: Vostarum
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to a healing cleric, bound to a single choice of devotion. It pairs with a separate restorative discipline and cannot be taken alongside other paths.

rites.name: Miantes Meontia
rites.text: A cruel tactic in which a crowd of hostile creatures is herded onto a wanderer or a fighter, overwhelming them by sheer numbers until they fall. Among the lowly, this ruthless ploy is spoken of as a verb.

rites.name: Mastinanum
rites.text: A mental force that a wielder draws from sealed reservoirs hidden within a cursed spire of punishment. It lets the user pierce into the thoughts of others.

rites.name: Contallanum
rites.text: A craft of bending another creature's will, learned from an old scroll of formulae. It is shaped through the arcane arts of enchantment.

rites.name: Orirum Telornor
rites.text: A conjurer's discipline drawn from the Destruction path of an order, requiring eight rank-marks to master. It is no longer practiced in its former form.

rites.name: Meriallor
rites.text: A quiet, mist-born gift held by a sect of meditative healers. It is bound to the essence of fog and passed along with other restorative blessings.

rites.name: Ristia Coreonaulor
rites.text: A bound craft lets a crafter's blade call forth a spectral twin that appears at their side and strikes the chosen foe. The gift is passed down by a bone-forging artisan.

rites.name: Laurniasum Valeontonia
rites.text: A binding worked into a blade so that it now and then grants its wielder a surge of nimbleness and quickened pace. The effect lasts as long as the weapon does.

rites.name: Cestor Corerolia
rites.text: A small bound token made by a ritual caster through a conjuring rite. Its making is taught as a single lesser working of the sorcerers' craft.

rites.name: Lianteornia
rites.text: A channeler's fiery strike that can be hurled again and again without much delay. It hits its target directly with searing heat and is quicker to unleash than a crackling bolt of lightning.

rites.name: Oreornia Seollaunus
rites.text: A silvery technique that a lunar keeper draws upon while bonded creatures contest in a contest of companions. It channels the pale glow of night into the battle.

rites.name: Reostia Tollanum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught to shadow-keepers, lending swiftness and repeated strikes to companions who stand near their circle.

rites.name: Liareostia Sialanum
rites.text: A spoken rite that is used to bend the minds of enslaved warriors so they obey their masters. It is applied to fighters who have already lost their will.

rites.name: Silles Meornia
rites.text: A sacred silver radiance drawn from a lunar deity, wielded by her devoted servants to mend wounds, ward allies, and drive back harm. Its restorative pools likewise refresh the power of spellcasters.

rites.name: Maunalus
rites.text: A temple-taught incantation that places a lingering curse upon a foe, slowly siphoning their inner reserves into the caster. It is passed down through a bound scripture kept by the order.

rites.name: Meonus Viarum
rites.text: A quiet practice that lets a brewer's own potions last twice as long when drunk by them. Their effects also grow stronger, though by differing amounts depending on the brew.

rites.name: Rianoles
rites.text: A discipline of the wilds taught in one branch of a hunter's training. It takes three points of study before a student can master it fully.

rites.name: Tilauntium
rites.text: A dark ritual trait carried by certain shadow-keeper relics that fractures the minds of those nearby. It works alongside two related mental effects, one that calls forth creatures from gloom and one that spreads panic through crowds.

rites.name: Serum Telonum
rites.text: A ritual sway performed beneath pale night light that a sacred caller uses to channel a fight among tamed beasts. It is drawn upon in contests between bonded companions.

rites.name: Nileoses Rellastus
rites.text: A glowing surge of ember-spirit force that can be drawn from hidden reliquary hoards buried within a ruined spire of penitent spirits.

rites.name: Oreoses Corarnanum
rites.text: A practitioner of the old circle can take on a steed-like shape that travels across the ground. The form is gained by studying a bound volume of woodland lore.

rites.name: Raulliastum
rites.text: A blessing that lets a bearer take on a hardy, frost-touched stout-folk form for a short span before it can be called again later.

rites.name: Telernosus
rites.text: A quiet rhythm-binding craft drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit-essence hidden deep within a grim spiral keep. Its practitioners gain a power that dampens a foe's pulse of motion.

rites.name: Orostum Telirontium
rites.text: A vengeful soul of a slain creature can be bound into a crafted vessel and drawn into a weapon of spirit. Shrinking the body first keeps the bound soul from slipping free.

rites.name: Nilia Mollaurnia
rites.text: A bond of loyalty that a hunter forges with a chosen beast, granting a trait that strengthens survival. It links closely with several related hunting traits.

rites.name: Corelum Seostum
rites.text: A fighting art practiced by a hunter of monsters that marks enemies so they cannot easily mend their wounds. The mark slows the restoration of harm for those who bear it.

rites.name: Sinus Rantium
rites.text: A grim discipline taught to the dead-bound ones, found in the second rank of their dark tree of practice. It stirs a deeper hold over decay and the fading of living breath.

rites.name: Ameorum Ceornum
rites.text: A quiet, inherited discipline that lives in the body of a trained adept. It works without conscious effort, letting the practitioner move with practiced grace once their training has matured.

rites.name: Tiantor Serosum
rites.text: A grave-binding rite taught to the initiates of a dark order, drawing the restless dead into service. It is found in the fourth rank of the order's shadow-learning and is no longer practiced.

rites.name: Raurollanum
rites.text: A hunter's talent that lets a wanderer endure hardship through wild resilience. It is an exclusive choice, so it cannot be taken alongside Lone Survivor.

rites.name: Rernum Narnellus
rites.text: A carving-craft drawn from a remembered wellspring of wild storm. Its practitioners etch sigils that channel raw elemental force.

rites.name: Canus Nisor
rites.text: A tremor-like power that only a certain kind of shadow creature can command. It is passed through the body of each beast that wields it.

rites.name: Loriasor
rites.text: A dark craft that stirs the departed back into motion through a force drawn from endings. Its practitioners rebuild decayed bodies so that fallen creatures can move and serve again.

rites.name: Nostum Centus
rites.text: A discipline taught to healers of the grove that quickens the mending hand. It shortens the time needed to channel restorative touch and nurturing rites.

rites.name: Tolum Corarum
rites.text: This sacred practice empowers a healing ritual so that it also lifts one enchantment from an ally. It is a gift of the grove-keepers, passed between initiates.

rites.name: Villornium
rites.text: A tier-two discipline of the Lunar Grove path that lets a caster harden their body's own growths into striking edges. It is practiced as a balance between the wild and the disciplined.

rites.name: Cialasum
rites.text: A learned gift of the wild that a practitioner can cultivate along a path of harmony. Advancing it requires dedicated training in that discipline.

rites.name: Amostum Oronauntum
rites.text: A sacred gift of living wilds that restores the vitality of those who tend the green. It is bound to a wanderer's path and to a tree-heart's essence.

rites.name: Maurnia Melanum
rites.text: A quiet, passive gift of attunement that a practitioner of the old natural orders gains upon reaching a certain standing, aiding balance and mending of wounds.

rites.name: Meonum Teliantor
rites.text: A mark of rot that a warrior of the dead can awaken at the highest tier of training. For blood-sworn wardens, each attack made against them by a marked foe feeds their inner ember.

rites.name: Maseornia Viallernia
rites.text: A carved rune-working that draws its force from a remembered snare design. It lets a practitioner set hidden traps that hold whatever passes over them.

rites.name: Amausestum
rites.text: A stored spiritual power drawn from hidden reserves held in a grim, cursed tower. It can be gained by those who seek the lore sealed within those reserves.

rites.name: Mistium Monteosium
rites.text: A ritual gift of the restoring circle that deepens the mending of a ward-bound companion. Mending laid upon a guarded ally grows far stronger, so each healing reaches further.

rites.name: Cellantia
rites.text: A healing craft taught to restorative keepers of the wild. When an attacker wounds the keeper, a surge of living sap mends them, the mending scaled to how much health they still hold.

rites.name: Resia Orostes
rites.text: A bond of trust is formed between a warrior and a companion, granting the warrior a fresh talent once the loyalty is proven. The reward arrives as a shared rite of growth.

rites.name: Centaules
rites.text: A restorative vitality bound into a sacred relic, awakened by those who tend living growth. It works alongside a few related gifts of renewal and the wandering keepers of groves.

rites.name: Telones Nantum
rites.text: A discipline taught to the wild-keepers of a grove, letting them keep their chanting steady when wounds land. It does not shield them from being forcibly silenced by rival casters.

rites.name: Nisantus
rites.text: A quiet inner attunement that sharpens a wanderer's aim, letting their blows and incantations find their marks more often. It works constantly, without any call from its bearer.

rites.name: Amillum Oroseontia
rites.text: A grim spiritual force of the dead that dwells within a sealed sanctuary of the afterlife realm. It channels the power of endings to steady those who stand against the grave.

rites.name: Reostelanum
rites.text: A innate instinct granted to a beast-tamer's relic, sharpening quick responses in creatures bonded to its wielder. It works in concert with a pair of related inherited gifts.

rites.name: Nasanum Tollum
rites.text: A coined term for a blow that ends a foe with a single strike. Such finishing moves are uncommon, so a double strike is sometimes called by the same name.

rites.name: Contaullus
rites.text: A bloodline-bound vow that marks a fighter's oath in battle. It binds to the rhythm of combat and to the pursuit of a glorious end.

rites.name: Ciantor Mialenor
rites.text: A bonded gift bestowed by a sage-healer that lets its holder draw on the virtues of gathered greenery. It cannot be held alongside the thorn-seed or venom-tincture gifts of the same giver.

rites.name: Lentasanum
