rites.text: A carved inscription craft that grants its wielder deep wisdom and insight. It is drawn from the remembered deeds of an ancient sage.

rites.name: Mallostia
rites.text: A bond-given gift that a wandering blade-mistress grants to a follower, lightening their gait. It cannot be held alongside a certain other blessing that guards against decay.

rites.name: Serornasium
rites.text: A bound trait bestowed by a healer-spirit that grants a single toxic craft. It cannot be held alongside two other rival crafts.

rites.name: Cosernia
rites.text: A carved-rune discipline granted by a remembered ancient keeper of old wisdom. It is drawn out through the recollection of that elder mind.

rites.name: Amarum Leostes
rites.text: A cold, icy gale that a warrior of the frozen order may call upon through a rite of rank, lending the wielder a chilling edge in battle.

rites.name: Serauntor Corisaunus
rites.text: A ritual surge of raw force that a young beast-kin unleashes during a contest of tamed creatures. It is performed by a beast-kin calf in the shadow of its elder kin.

rites.name: Sinus Lornum
rites.text: A blunt method of attack in which a fighter unleashes the greatest force they can muster in a single blow. The practice is named for a world-ending explosion, describing its ruinous intent.

rites.name: Telarnostes
rites.text: A bound vow that channels a spirit-force drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dread spire. Those who take it gain the ability to wield that force.

rites.name: Telus Mileostus
rites.text: A war spirit that teaches the hunter how to lay dire curses on foes. Its gift is a hex that binds an enemy's fortunes.

rites.name: Coresaules
rites.text: A stubborn resolve that is bound to a sacred relic carried by the brewing order's monks. It is tied to two other relic traits that share its sacred lineage.

rites.name: Coreontasum
rites.text: A quiet, always-active gift borne by mounted riders of the grave-order, granting them swifter pace while astride their steed. It awakens once a warrior reaches the twenty-second rung of their training.

rites.name: Valaurnus Coreosor
rites.text: A carving-craft of runes that is drawn from a remembered vow of compliance. It lets its wielder bind others to follow commands.

rites.name: Seroniasium
rites.text: A fierce battle-rage mark carried by a warrior of the fury tradition. It bonds to its bearer's fighting spirit and links to other rage-related marks that amplify it.

rites.name: Corollum Valanus
rites.text: A deathly combat technique used by cold-blooded warriors of the frost arts to strike with crushing force. It stands as a core part of their fighting repertoire.

rites.name: Cariales
rites.text: A tactic that a creature can use in a contest of companion beasts. The strike is made with hard, glassy teeth and is used by many different beasts during these bouts.

rites.name: Tillauranum Centaunia
rites.text: A proving rite in which a summoner is overcome on the hardest tier of a sunken temple without any bound spirits being raised to aid the challenger.

rites.name: Serostaria
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that grants a sharpened, far-seeing sight to those who inscribe it. It is drawn from a remembered lineage of an ancient sage.

rites.name: Lontinum
rites.text: A discipline taught to fighters that sharpens their skill with single-handed blades. It was once part of the warrior's training path before being dropped from the curriculum.

rites.name: Reles Rallernus
rites.text: A ritual mark that a wild shaper carries, bound to two older natural gifts. It is tied to the wilds' living energies and the spirit of a shaper's kin.

rites.name: Tilium Renium
rites.text: A glowing sphere that a sorceress calls up in a hidden valley and uses to leap across the realm to a distant ruined ridge during a long, desperate campaign.

rites.name: Telalores
rites.text: A bonding trait bestowed by a sickness-crafter that makes a wearer slide past harm. It cannot coexist with two rival gifts.

rites.name: Veolauria
rites.text: A dark rite of ruin that a chosen caster learns to unleash. It lies in a fork of the sorcerer's path, where taking it closes off a rival ritual that calls the warband to battle.

rites.name: Cesum Lileontus
rites.text: A temple-trained healer's discipline that wraps the body in a brief shield, sharply lowering all harm taken for a short span. It can still be invoked while the caster is held helpless.

rites.name: Mialontium
rites.text: A craft of sewing that can be learned at an early stage of training and advanced through several ranks. It grants access to a set of pattern designs that a practitioner can follow to make garments.

rites.name: Ceosor Sesaulanum
rites.text: A ritual gift of the wild that lets a warden press forward through the battle line with a burst of wild momentum. It is learned by those who duel other wardens in the sacred contests.

rites.name: Serornes Corileonor
rites.text: A bound spirit is called forth by a hidden circle to fight beside a wanderer against foes within a dark stone fortress. The aid works without the wanderer's own hands.

rites.name: Milus Nolaurus
rites.text: A sacred chant that can be drawn from hidden reserves found within a dark, cursed spire. Those who learn it gain a mending force that dulls suffering.

rites.name: Maurenanum Orausornum
rites.text: A dark sustaining force drawn from suffering that fuels the strikes of a vengeful order of night-walkers. Most of their deadliest blows cannot be performed without it.

rites.name: Oresanum Tiantesor
rites.text: A passive discipline taught to a caster of the old moon-rites, granted at a set rank of training. It sharply amplifies the power of the practitioner's bird-shaped transformation.

rites.name: Orialor Valiastor
rites.text: A wild, creeping vitality drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence within a dark, forsaken spire. It grants its wielder the power to make living growth burst forth and overrun everything nearby.

rites.name: Sernosum Rillaunanum
rites.text: A sacred discipline that a knight may train in to recover their guardian rites more swiftly. Its practice shortens the waiting period before three blessings of protection, sacrifice, and wrath can be called upon again.

rites.name: Santilanum
rites.text: A sacred shape-changing form that lets a caster become a huge, savage hunting beast. Those who take it often lose their reason to its wild instincts.

rites.name: Ristus Vintus
rites.text: A lingering watchfulness that keeps allies near a hunting beast sharper at spotting those who hide in shadow. It costs nothing to maintain while companions stay close, though it cannot reveal the unseen that vanish entirely from sight.

rites.name: Rantia Nastornium
rites.text: A calm stance in which a bonded companion holds back from striking and acts only when its keeper gives a clear command.

rites.name: Maurilium
rites.text: A learned skill that a companion creature can call upon, found among the fourth rank of a branching tree of cunning talents. It is no longer available in current use.

rites.name: Rollernes
rites.text: A guardian's standing chant radiates a protective field outward, strengthening the abilities of allies who stand within its reach.

rites.name: Mellontum
rites.text: A shared inheritance lets a small green folk call forth a loyal companion from the wild. Through that bond they reach their hoarded stores from any place they stand.

rites.name: Tireonanum
rites.text: A carved-rune discipline that lets its practitioner bend a fading remembrance into a binding authority. It is drawn from a stored echo of an older dominion.

rites.name: Meorintium
rites.text: A bound craft drawn from hoarded soul-essence stores within a grim spiraling tower of the condemned. It grants its wielder a shared, unsettling closeness with the dark powers that dwell there.

rites.name: Rarniales
rites.text: A spirit-essence that dwells within a sealed hollow realm during a desperate flight from a devouring pit. It drifts among the fleeing and is bound to that hour of escape.

rites.name: Valarintor
rites.text: A channeled rite granted to devout adepts who take up the path of strict discipline. It can strike a foe with lasting force or mend a companion's wounds.

rites.name: Lalirum
rites.text: A frozen-ground rite granted to a grave-bound warrior that lets the caster and nearby companions cross open waters for a set span. The stride holds even while riding a steed.

rites.name: Misanum Maunteoles
rites.text: A sacred discipline followed by clergy who reach a certain standing in their orders. It grants the practitioner a set of devotional abilities once they attain sufficient rank.

rites.name: Seraullanum Cesinor
rites.text: A temple-trained gift that strengthens the cloaking veil a cleric draws around themselves to slip unseen from danger.

rites.name: Siasor Caunirnes
rites.text: A sacred sigil that lets fallen companions rise again and mends their wounds. It is carved into stone by devoted scribes who guard its use.

rites.name: Amesor Seralium
rites.text: A learned craft taught to hunters, letting them command a companion to retrieve things for them. It is passed along in instructional guides within the orders.

rites.name: Amaurus Tastesia
rites.text: A warrior's battle cry that drains the swiftness of foes nearby, slowing them for a short span. It sits among the disciplines a fighter must choose between, alongside a rival war-shout.

rites.name: Sintelles
rites.text: A quiet practice taught to caster-initiates that sharpens the odds of their magic striking with exceptional force. Its gift grows slightly with each stage of training.

rites.name: Lirnestor
rites.text: A carved runic power drawn from a remembered torment. It is passed on through the inscribing of a stored memory of suffering.

rites.name: Sereollus Valerus
rites.text: A temporary blessing that lets a traveler move more easily across the land during a sacred trial of bonds. It lasts only for the length of that particular journey.

rites.name: Caulenus Valorales
rites.text: A caster can call down a shining column of light that wraps only around themselves. It lasts for one hour, and only the caster can see it.

rites.name: Niareontum Valiasus
rites.text: A guiding craft that lets a tamer of wild creatures sense the route ahead. It works in close bond with two other lore-traits of the same discipline.

rites.name: Serarnus Mianes
rites.text: A sacred vocal rite taught to ritual keepers, where a chanted cry hardens the air around a chosen voice. It can only be learned in place of a related chant, and it is taken alongside a sound-based ritual.

rites.name: Teleolanum Veornor
rites.text: A sacred gift of endless renewal that lingers within a guardian's keeper-craft. It binds closely with three other enchantments of the wild, sharing their strength.

rites.name: Raurnes Amilaunium
rites.text: A stealthy craft that lets a skilled thief draw coin and small goods from a creature's belongings while remaining unseen. It is practiced by those who move through shadow.

rites.name: Collium Laustirum
rites.text: A small hollow grain-sickle figure that calls forth a harvest guardian to walk beside its keeper. The keeper learns the rite of summoning it.

rites.name: Rausernus
rites.text: A hunter's discipline that lets a fighter wield a long blade with flawless equilibrium. It is drawn from the vengeance-bound slayers who stalk the fiends of the night.

rites.name: Teolarnum Cirnus
rites.text: A sacred disposition carried by certain keepers of old oaths, marked as a trait of the guardian circle. It binds closely with two other inherited gifts of healing and harmony.

rites.name: Telintanum Noranum
rites.text: A ritual method for shaping pale divining bones that can foretell events. Those who learn it are taught the steps needed to carve them.

rites.name: Colisum Serallor
rites.text: A fighter trained in this craft gains a better chance of landing a decisive blow when wielding a long-hafted blade or a hewing weapon. It is a skill of the armored warrior.

rites.name: Tostes Orontus
rites.text: A mystic discipline in which a practitioner learns to move the spirit between realms. It is an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside a rival ward-craft.

rites.name: Ceollorum
rites.text: These are shimmering projections that a mage conjures when its own strength wanes. They mirror the caster's remaining vitality and crumble easily under attack.

rites.name: Testeores
rites.text: A growing-power that a creature may call upon during a contest of companion beasts. It lets the user draw strength from living greenery.

rites.name: Nernum Teornum
rites.text: A caster's learned craft that turns a foe into a helpless shape for a long while. The change ends the moment the target takes harm.

rites.name: Serilia Nanium
rites.text: A deadly craft of blades that carry venom into a victim's flesh. It is bound to the quiet work of hired killers and works alongside keen balance and sudden surges of toxin.

rites.name: Caurarnia Manellor
rites.text: A bound trait conferred by a sea-god that grants a sustained, steady composure to its holder. It cannot coexist with two other specific traits, the focusing chant and the wayfarer's road.

rites.name: Losteosia
rites.text: A ritual mark carried by sacred caster-folk that links a sigil of their craft to the pull of tides and the depths below. It is bound alongside two sibling marks of the same lineage.

rites.name: Naleornum
rites.text: A bond-gift bestowed by a sacred patron that marks a wielder with fearless resolve. It cannot coexist with two rival blessings that compete for the same spirit.

rites.name: Vialor Rintia
rites.text: A dark, shifting power of the soul that can be drawn from hidden stores buried within a grim tower of punishment. It flows from sealed reservoirs to whoever claims it.

rites.name: Maustus Ronanum
rites.text: A binding gift bestowed by a sickness-maker named Oruneth, which cannot coexist with a Thessal ring of keys. It works as a trait that a bearer carries.

rites.name: Senastia
rites.text: A dormant talent that once let a mist-attuned adept draw on a rising fog. It is no longer available to practitioners of the veil craft.

rites.name: Valaurnia Oroses
rites.text: A fire-wielding practitioner draws on a blessing from a radiant ancestral spirit. The rite grants a limited number of searing bursts before it must be renewed.

rites.name: Coseollus
rites.text: A specialized gift of shadow-craft that hunters of night-spirits may take as a chosen skill. It can only be learned alongside a particular long-night discipline.

rites.name: Sallia Saurnores
rites.text: A craft by which shadow-trained killers smear their blades with venom. A struck foe may suffer harm, slowing, or other hindrance, and the coating lasts only a short while.

rites.name: Amenanum Amolauror
rites.text: A sacred chant that lets a gathered company share a protective ward against dark, shadowy harm. It was once a common rite among devotees but has since faded from practice.

rites.name: Reraulium
rites.text: A devotional rite practiced by temple clergy, in which a healer chooses between two sacred chants. Taking one chant closes off the other.

rites.name: Oreornanum Serauntanum
rites.text: A sacred ward is woven around an ally, soaking up a fixed measure of harm and keeping their focus unbroken. Mystics use it to bind their companions into a shared, healing pact.

rites.name: Rilor Telorium
rites.text: A savage hunter's gift that strengthens the bite of wild shapeshifters. It is bound to other bloodlines of the same hunting craft.

rites.name: Miases Costianes
rites.text: A ritual path that trains a young nature-keeper to draw toxins out of the body and neutralize them. Practitioners of both rival peoples follow similar paths, each set in their own homelands.

rites.name: Corianes Vosellus
rites.text: A sacred gift that a devoted healer's relic carries, lending it a light-bound grace. It links to the holy ground, prayer, and blessing traits.

rites.name: Amaria Viarnor
rites.text: A devotional chant taught to healers of a temple order, granting every companion within earshot a lasting surge of inner resolve. The blessing endures for an hour once sung.

rites.name: Sollasia
rites.text: A temple-trained chant that mends several allies gathered near a chosen companion at once. Each one recovers a modest measure of strength.

rites.name: Meoniales
rites.text: A short sacred utterance that a cloistered caster speaks to unleash a burst of searing light. It is taught as one of the lesser incantations within an ordained order of mystics.

rites.name: Cialanum Raulor
rites.text: A grove-bound force granted to those who complete a sacred trial, lending the bearer the strength of ancient woodland. It is bestowed through a spirit-forged arsenal.

rites.name: Lirus Naustollia
rites.text: A consecrated rite spoken by temple keepers that steadies a chosen person's vigor, making them somewhat sturdier against hardship. Only those trained in the lower orders may call it.

rites.name: Narestia
rites.text: A battle technique that certain shelled and spiny creatures draw upon during contests of tamed companions. It lets them strike with a sudden, forceful rolling surge.

rites.name: Tellum Telinum
rites.text: A tempered art of swift leaping assaults taught to wild initiates of the old circles. It is granted only to those who have reached the sixth measure of their training.

rites.name: Amianernor
rites.text: A sacred craft bound to a relic's gleaming limb, linked to a companion gift of radiance. It channels blessed light through its wielder's guided hand.

rites.name: Coristiarum
rites.text: A brewing adept's sacred inheritance that bonds with other inner gifts. It is tied to three companion traits that deepen its effect.

rites.name: Valilaurnor
rites.text: A temporary blessing is granted to whoever slays a wild crystal-bound creature found in a volcanic ravine. The blessing cannot be layered with itself, yet it combines freely with other mystical gifts.

rites.name: Tirnerium
rites.text: A sacred chant that a healing caster can draw into their practice, granted through a mysterious ore-bound gift. It belongs to the devotional art of restorative clerics.

rites.name: Valiaranum Telentianus
rites.text: A tide-like force gathered within a relic that is bound to a second, fiery power. It belongs to the practice of spirit-keepers who channel nature.

rites.name: Teonor Naustilum
rites.text: A learned inner stillness that a caster can call upon. Once invoked, it lets the next two bursts of raw arcane force be loosed without any delay.

rites.name: Mollus Aminaurium
rites.text: A ritual enchantment bound into shoulder plates that sharpens a wearer's magical force and raises the odds of striking a devastating blow.

rites.name: Amastelles
rites.text: A practitioner's gathered inner discipline that channels a flock of spirit birds. It draws kinship from skies, fortune, and the might of a celestial tiger guardian.

rites.name: Nallum Valarnia
rites.text: Caster-trained spoken incantations that a sacred healer uses to shield and empower companions. Speaking one of these phrases calls forth a protective light.

rites.name: Nolus Solanum
rites.text: A disciplined technique that lets a monk in the brewing order follow up a strike with a sharper, fiercer blow. It is chosen as one of a few mutually exclusive paths alongside the order's sacred weapons.

rites.name: Lialentanum
rites.text: A mage can weave a gate that carries their companions across the realm to a sacred seat of guardians in a distant city.

rites.name: Tirnasus
rites.text: A communal chant that a group of devotees recites together to grant every member of the gathering a sturdier endurance. Its blessing once spread across the whole company at a single utterance.

rites.name: Tauntes Mianirnes
rites.text: A dark, hound-like power that is hidden in forest chests and can also be claimed as spoils from a court's tribute. It is sought out by those who wander the gloomy woods.

rites.name: Rentaranum
rites.text: A sacred gift of heightened authority held by the highest keeper of old rites. It is bound to the lore of forgotten ancestors.

rites.name: Orirus Vontor
rites.text: A temple craft in which a priest channels a sinister inner force. It is tied to a sudden flare of radiance that answers the same hidden well.

rites.name: Amaullus Menausia
rites.text: A quiet craft of the hand that lets a wielder land a blow exactly where it counts. It bonds with three other arts of stealth and shadow.

rites.name: Sausinium
rites.text: A temple-trained discipline of quiet mending that a sworn keeper may choose as one of two mutually exclusive paths alongside a protective ward.

rites.name: Caunus Tostesanum
rites.text: A wild instinct that only one brood of tree-climbing hunting beasts can awaken, sharpening their evasion for a short burst of twenty heartbeats.

rites.name: Sallenum
rites.text: A sacred guardianship bound to a wild-shaping craft, tied to three linked traits of primal strength and attunement to the living land.

rites.name: Amiles Seranolanum
rites.text: A guardian's sigil that shields a bearer in battle. It draws its strength from a bastion-bound aspect of the old fighting orders.

rites.name: Orauses Siasum
rites.text: A raw inner rage that a shaman may awaken as a mutually exclusive path of learning, drawing upon the forces of the elements. It is taken alongside a sharpened mental focus.

rites.name: Corosteolus
rites.text: A sacred discipline practiced by temple guardians who shield the weak. It is taken as a path that rules out a rival vow of suffering-redirection.

rites.name: Vonausia
rites.text: A sacred blessing woven into a sworn guardian's relic, shielding its bearer. It is bound to a second mending gift that strengthens the same wielder.

rites.name: Telornes Oralanum
rites.text: A foreseeing of future happenings, granted to a seer through arcane means. It reveals events before they come to pass.

rites.name: Valauliasus Taleostia
rites.text: A temple-trained art of drawing a faintly glowing shard out of the air, which holds its shape briefly before fading back into nothing. Sages teach it only to the most advanced practitioners.

rites.name: Amasaunus Costiales
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its strength from a remembered current of the deep sea. It is gained through recalling that memory.

rites.name: Seonanum Serornia
rites.text: A discipline of the wild-bond taught to those who walk the beast-path. Its adepts must first devote much of their training to the ferocious arts before the rite can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Roria Valaurnus
rites.text: A sacred vow held by healers of the light, granting them a measure of rescue power. It is a trait that a single class of devout caster may awaken within themselves.

rites.name: Orasilum
rites.text: A deep, innate urge that stirs within certain wilderness hunters and guides their beasts. It is drawn from the raw essence of the land and grants a shaping edge to those who follow the old tracking arts.

rites.name: Neolum Veostoria
rites.text: A hidden store of drifting spirit-essence lets a bearer forge a quiet strength from it. The essence is gathered from sealed reliquaries in a grim, shadowed spire of ruin.

rites.name: Veorum Orernium
rites.text: A hidden, silent way of moving that a wild caster adopts to stay unseen. It must be readied before a savage strike can be unleashed.

rites.name: Ameosor Tiastonia
rites.text: A savage ritual gift granted to wild shapers, sealing a bloody rite that binds every foe nearby in a lasting wound at the moment of a final blow.

rites.name: Telestium Nelauntia
rites.text: A mind-borne speaking gift taught to temple keepers. It exists as an exclusive choice alongside a stone-shattering shriek, so a practitioner must pick one.

rites.name: Reollorium Telareosium
rites.text: A discipline practiced by evokers that stretches the span of a living being's years. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival vision of renewal.

rites.name: Vianus Castontanum
rites.text: Healers of each people once gained two sacred rites tied to their lineage, unlocked at certain levels of devotion. The rites grew stronger with practice and aided them in many situations.

rites.name: Teliranum Valilanum
rites.text: A deep ancestral current that a caster may awaken through a chosen path, forcing a single choice between this ember and its sundered twin.

rites.name: Reontus Cirnales
rites.text: A shimmering protective ward that a small summoned spirit raises during a contest between tamed creatures. It shields the caller's companion from incoming harm for a time.

rites.name: Tantiasum
rites.text: A disciplined practitioner uses a cutting taunt that stings an opponent's pride, drawing their focus and attention toward the caster. The jab is spoken aloud with deliberate timing in a temple-trained rhythm.

rites.name: Viales Vereontanum
rites.text: A sacred oath of kinship between a caster and the raw forces of the world, sealed by a choice that binds one path against another. It is taken alongside a gift of cleansing waters.

rites.name: Valeostaria
rites.text: A sacred discipline held by the lantern-keepers of the high halls, granting a practitioner the ability to cleanse corruption. Only those who have devoted much of their training to the light may master it fully.

rites.name: Coraunerum
rites.text: A holy rite that a sworn guardian can call upon to swiftly drive out both sickness and toxins from a body. It is valued early in a guardian's training for how quickly it restores health.

rites.name: Renanum Viasentes
rites.text: A ward-craft that shields its bearer from the raw forces of fire, storm, and earth. It is bound to a channeling lore and to several sudden hazards of the same nature.

rites.name: Amestaullia
rites.text: A grove-keeper's oath that lets a skilled caster in a rival-fighting arena shield the wild places they tend. It is learned once a practitioner reaches a modest rank of mastery.

rites.name: Rellus Amauntum
rites.text: A passive vow carried by holy warriors who serve their oath, granted once they reach a certain stage of their training. It has since been stripped from the old orders of knighthood.

rites.name: Senorium
rites.text: A sacred gift taught to devout keepers that shields the faithful with radiant warding. It is chosen exclusively, forsaking a rival path of shadow-born craft.

rites.name: Nallum Niasium
rites.text: A ritual technique practiced by spirit-channeling caster-priests, learned early in training. Later disciples of one wind-focused branch come to replace it with a more advanced gale-charged version.

rites.name: Amolarnanum
rites.text: A sworn practice that lets a warden speak a binding vow more rapidly. It pairs with a sacred harmony and cannot be taken alongside it.

rites.name: Cilanum Teornostor
rites.text: A sworn-oath gift of the avenging knights that marks one exclusive path of their training. Taking it closes the door to a rival rite of the same order.

rites.name: Leolor Amilleranum
rites.text: A battle-shout technique taught to frontline fighters that bolsters the vitality of allies standing close by for a brief span of moments.

rites.name: Mausontor
rites.text: A runecarving craft that a learner gains by taking hold of a remembered vortex. The knowledge of the carved marks allows the user to channel the storm's force.

rites.name: Orastum Lanolum
rites.text: A cleansing attunement practiced by healers of the temple orders, drawn from a secondary inner focus. It is refined through long devotion until the practitioner masters its flow.

rites.name: Riantestor
rites.text: A ritual binding that a dark lord uses to call the dead back into service as a new set of four mounted riders. It is a working granted to him for the purpose of resurrecting these fearsome warriors.

rites.name: Liantia Tarnes
rites.text: A fire-binding craft that channels heat through a practitioner's spoken words. It is bound to the rite of Ignition Sovereignty, which lets the caster call flame at will.

rites.name: Coriantus Laurnes
rites.text: A lizard-kind technique used by creatures during a contest of tamed beasts, striking the foe before it can respond.

rites.name: Serianus Teleonirnum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lifts every enchantment from a chosen ally, leaving their body and mind free of foreign magic. Practitioners of the old temple orders use it to cleanse companions who have been bound or marked by sorcery.

rites.name: Visanum Orialanes
rites.text: Spellcasters who wield flame through their magic, shaping fire by focusing on its essence or calling it from elsewhere. Scholars debate whether conjured flames come from within the world or from a hidden realm beyond it.

rites.name: Meorernus
rites.text: A guarding discipline that lets a stalwart defender draw fury from fallen comrades. It works in tandem with an earth-bound strength gift and a shield-bearing training tradition.

rites.name: Siarantes
rites.text: A tempest-bound craft that lets a storm-keeper reinforce a relic with rising gale power. It is tied to the mending of wounds and the spirit of churning whirlwinds.

rites.name: Misentium
rites.text: A battle-rhythm gift carried by a fierce warrior lineage, tied to the oath-bound blood-traits of its kin. It stirs the bearer's pulse as fighting begins.

rites.name: Moleorus
rites.text: A dark rite by which a fallen companion is drawn back from death during a battle. The one restored bears a faint, ghostlike shimmer and a shadowy halo that marks the return.

rites.name: Vestirnum Taurnum
rites.text: An optional calling that members of a people may pursue to awaken their inner spirit and draw on the ancestral powers of their heritage. Those born outside the people cannot learn it, even if they take on a new form.

rites.name: Seollus Vaunillum
rites.text: A mid-tier battle technique taught to fighters of the rage path. It strikes with both held blades at once, dealing swift weapon harm in a single instant.

rites.name: Raurnium Amauntanum
rites.text: A wild inner rage that a shapeshifting caster can awaken, chosen as a mutually exclusive path alongside a feline endurance gift.

rites.name: Rollirnus
rites.text: A ritual knack carried within a brewing order's sacred vessel, lending a swift restorative draught to its keeper. It pairs with a companion charm that guards against ruin.

rites.name: Seriaranum Orillantium
rites.text: A basic close strike that deals immediate harm and then lingering wounds. It pierces heavily armored foes and blocks hidden slipping away. Feral practitioners learn it automatically.

rites.name: Maulirum
rites.text: A dark discipline of the fallen warriors, drawn from the lowest tier of their grim inner tree. It lets a practitioner channel rising wrath into the death-bound.

rites.name: Vintus Sanirum
rites.text: A dormant surge of wild fury that a guardian keeper of the wilds can stir awake. It is taught through the claws of a great beast-spirit.

rites.name: Serarolles
rites.text: A ritual art taught only to shadowed initiates of the temple, used to drive sickness from the body. It is closed to all other devotees of the order.

rites.name: Orelum Telones
rites.text: A battle-honor gift granted to fighters once they reach the sixth tier of their order. It lets a warrior channel their fury into an arcane engine within the body.

rites.name: Monantor Maulostia
rites.text: A ritual that asks the keeper to confirm when an old binding inscribed on a relic is swapped for a new one. Both the former and the replacing inscriptions are presented for the keeper to weigh before the change is sealed.

rites.name: Taullaror
rites.text: A lasting blessing bestowed by a venom-minded seer within a desolate ashen expanse. It clings to the bearer while they remain in that wasteland and persists until it is deliberately dispelled.

rites.name: Teleosernor
rites.text: A stock of brewing reagents that lets a practitioner learn the rite for calling forth a rot-breathed, flesh-bodied creature as a loyal companion.

rites.name: Ameolarnia
rites.text: A fury-kindled power drawn from hoarded essence stores in a dread spire of ruin. It lets its bearer unleash a frenzied, axe-shaped surge of violence.

rites.name: Valilum Listaunor
rites.text: A fierce close-range striking technique that a tracker may use to inflict harm. It is the only true hand-to-hand art available to such trackers, and anyone may learn it without prerequisites.

rites.name: Laulanum Valausor
rites.text: A martial gift granted to fighters of high standing, letting them enter combat with a settled and eager resolve. It is learned once a warrior reaches a seasoned level of skill.

rites.name: Naustiantum
rites.text: A sacred riding discipline in which a rider keeps a fierce sky-spirit running at full speed for a sustained stretch by calling upon different carved sigils within a desert city. It can only be practiced after a seeker has sworn fealty to one of the spirit-patrons.

rites.name: Leontanum Amistum
rites.text: A ritual craft that a keeper of the old orders can learn, set against a rival discipline of the same circle. Choosing one path closes the other to the practitioner.

rites.name: Mernes Ciastalium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that moves a bearer's strength from one thing to another. It is learned through a recovered recollection held by the old orders.

rites.name: Corirnum Sereollum
rites.text: A quick surge of restored nerve-current that lets a caster's limbs answer at once. It pairs with two related sparks that flare alongside it.

rites.name: Coriarum Cilanum
rites.text: A dormant protective craft that wakes on its own when a caster's strength falls low. It instantly raises a frozen shell around the wielder to absorb the blow.

rites.name: Tiarneollus
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that draws a lifeless walker back into motion. It is gained by learning from a remembered fragment of such a walker.

rites.name: Mellaustium
rites.text: A method taught to scribes that lets them shape a bound token of a hidden moon-sign. The craft is passed from one copyist to the next through a binding rite.

rites.name: Amosor Seriastia
rites.text: A practice of renewing a lasting blessing on an ally so that its protective effect begins anew before it fades. It is performed by casting the same enchantment again on the one it strengthens.

rites.name: Cirneosor Corerium
rites.text: A tracker's practiced skill that lets a ranged fighter loose a burst of quick strikes at the right moment. It belongs to the sharpshooter's discipline of their craft.

rites.name: Resollum
rites.text: A temple discipline that lets a healer restore strength quickly. It is a sworn choice that pairs exclusively with an empowered mending blessing.

rites.name: Caurnus Amoles
rites.text: A carving-craft that is gained by holding a remembered scar of a fallen warlord. It lets the bearer inscribe corrupting marks into stone and bone.

rites.name: Serentirum
rites.text: A practice in which a caster draws back a force they once spread outward. It is a choice made by a sorcerer, and it cannot be taken alongside the answering craft of duplication.

rites.name: Sillus Coreollium
rites.text: A ritual method that instructs a scribe in grinding many sleep-blossom sprigs at once into powder. It is taught through an enchantment that imparts the technique directly to the practitioner.

rites.name: Cauntia Teleorialum
rites.text: A ritual formula that a tribal council grants to those who have earned deep trust among its people. Once granted, it lets the bearer brew a potent restorative draught.

rites.name: Oreliaranum
rites.text: A divining craft in which a scribe learns the method for assembling a set of painted fortune cards. The cards are used to reveal what is to come.

rites.name: Meontastium
rites.text: A hunter's trait that grants a sharp, wild survival instinct. It pairs with several other marks of the craft to strengthen a wielder's hunting skill.

rites.name: Menes Coronausor
rites.text: A brewing method taught to alchemists for crafting a restorative tonic. At the third level of skill, a single brew may yield several vials at once.

rites.name: Ceorestes Nallus
rites.text: A grove-keeper's rite that lets a fallen companion rise again mid-battle, restoring them to a bit more than half their vigor. The ritual works even while blades are still being drawn.

rites.name: Telostor Orantium
rites.text: A written method that instructs a copyist how to grind many blossoms of a wild fox-shaped flower at once. It is recorded as a charm of working with the scribe's hand.

rites.name: Telarnium Orirnia
rites.text: A ritual that bestows a small portion of accumulated rest upon the one who performs it. The benefit scales modestly with the performer's present standing.

rites.name: Tistaullum
rites.text: A quiet inborn discipline granted to sacred healers once they reach a high rank of devotion. It lets their restorative work return vitality to the wounded more readily than before.

rites.name: Mostor Nistiarnia
rites.text: A ritual technique that lets a caster draw back a rain-bringing standing marker once it has been set in place. The technique can only be used after that marker has been raised.

rites.name: Amastontia
rites.text: A carved sigil-art that a wielder can unlock by holding onto a recollection of a bold, careless guard. It grants a rune-born strength tied to that remembered stance.

rites.name: Sernum Amontium
rites.text: A consecrated rite lets a fallen champion rise from their remains with a portion of their vigor restored. It cannot be performed amid battle and is broken if the caster is struck.

rites.name: Serantum Coreontes
rites.text: A practitioner's trained craft that turns a clear, flowing liquid essence into a grave-cold essence of the restless dead. Only those who have mastered the craft to a high degree can perform the change.

rites.name: Coriselles
rites.text: A sealed formula that teaches an alchemist how to convert the breath of the sky into living flame. Those who have earned a respected standing with a vigilant sworn order may acquire it from its keepers.

rites.name: Tisialanum
rites.text: A learned gift of the healing circles that is passed to those who follow the restorative path. It is gained on its own by practitioners who tend living things.

rites.name: Serallus Mores
rites.text: A quiet mending craft drawn from drifting fog. It lays a slow, lingering restoration upon a chosen ally, knitting wounds across several moments.

rites.name: Contus Seonirnum
rites.text: A sacred mark of tireless pursuit that is bound to the hands of holy judges in the orders of the temple. It grants the wielder endurance for the hunting of the guilty.

rites.name: Carnialus Cosarnus
rites.text: A bonded gift that lets a warrior's flesh knit itself back together like hardened rock. It cannot coexist with the practice of cowing foes through fear.

rites.name: Leornolum
rites.text: A slow mending blessing that a cleric can lay upon a wounded ally, knitting flesh back together over a short span. Several healers may bind the same blessing to one body, and one healer may bind it to many.

rites.name: Oreontanum Telontia
rites.text: A creature of the marsh can call up a soft drifting fog during a contest of companions, once it has grown strong enough. The fog gently restores the strength of the creature's allies.

rites.name: Causor Millanum
rites.text: A discipline of unwavering tracking that a hunter of monstrous foes can take up in place of other arts. It pairs with a companion gift of cruel intent, so the two cannot both be chosen.

rites.name: Serolaranum
rites.text: A dark art taught to sorcerers who bind lesser spirits to their will. It is an exclusive path chosen in the great Design of the grand master.

rites.name: Lantor Vianor
rites.text: A damage-focused rite of spores that a wayfarer may claim after overcoming a frost-bound chieftain within the deep trials of a shadowed crypt. It is meant only for those who strike rather than heal.

rites.name: Tiarellia
rites.text: A ability once borne by a family of beast companions that hunted in packs. It lets the creature wear a gleaming covering that turns aside harm.

rites.name: Corones Teloliantor
rites.text: A quickly cast restorative rite that a nature-keeper performs to mend a companion's wounds. It restores a good measure of vitality at once, but it drains the caster's inner reserves quite fast.

rites.name: Orolia Vausternus
rites.text: A tidal craft held by restoration keepers that channels soothing waves of revival. It is bound to two related spirit-gifts that drift through the same sacred waters.

rites.name: Raunia Taustum
rites.text: A sacred rite that lets a consecrated keeper restore a waning devotion within the faithful. It is bound to the chants that mend wounds and spirits.

rites.name: Rintium Rirnanum
rites.text: A sealing sigil that a temple order could inscribe through a ritual of binding the spirit. It is said to push away whatever approaches it.

rites.name: Nellontor Corolia
rites.text: A devotee's protective ward bends a portion of harm it absorbs back onto the one who struck. Its craft is taught in the discipline halls of the temple orders.

rites.name: Sellanum Vaullum
rites.text: A practitioner's rite that lets the caster rise again at once when slain, returning with a fifth of full vitality and spiritual reserve. It is a passive craft of renewal drawn from the bond between the living and the spirits.

rites.name: Casanum Raulesanum
rites.text: A fire-attuned enchanted trait that is bound to a set of related heat-linked traits. It draws on the wielder's inner flame to renew their power.

rites.name: Naullanum Reostaulor
rites.text: A hardened covering that a protector of the wild can wear as an enchantment. It is bound together with two other natural gifts that shape its use.

rites.name: Cinanum Orirosanum
rites.text: A minor ritual of the arcane craft that lifts a hex-type burden from an allied wanderer. Scholars have since retired the rite from common practice.

rites.name: Mollanum Testum
rites.text: A learned gift of the arcane practitioners that lifts every hex-type affliction from an ally. It is taught as a skill of the caster's craft and works only on a companion who stands near.

rites.name: Sereornalia Valeontes
rites.text: A innate gift of a sacred lineage that knits wounds shut over a short span, restoring the bearer to full vitality through steady renewal.

rites.name: Rirnia Serneonia
rites.text: A passive mending gift carried by a certain hill-folk, letting their wounds knit a little faster than others. A slim portion of this mending keeps flowing even while the body is locked in a fight.

rites.name: Seonor Saulium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that is drawn from a remembered line of rulers. It lets its wielder inscribe sigils that channel the same authority those ancient sovereigns once held.

rites.name: Serontanum Rianor
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that a mystic sect of wind-attuned wanderers draws upon. It is bound to the currents of shadow-sky, a grim war-craft, and a blessing of fortune.

rites.name: Cenistanum
rites.text: A swift restorative rite that mends a wounded ally at once, then continues quietly knitting their flesh over the following moments. It is wielded by keepers of the old tide-speaking orders.

rites.name: Vilia Ceosum
rites.text: A sacred mark borne by guardians who shield the faithful with unyielding conviction. It is bound to other enduring vows of protection, sharing their strength and resolve.

rites.name: Canor Orantia
rites.text: A guardian's ward that spreads through an allied company, shielding each member from flame, cold, and shadow. Its strength grows as the bearer gains experience.

rites.name: Conia Lontalium
rites.text: A glowing crystal conjured at a sacred stone altar, which a seeker draws upon during a rite, slowly gathering power until a distant dark presence notices them.

rites.name: Telireosia
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that conjures a ring of chill upon the ground, stilling any foe who steps within it and binding them in place afterward. Those held by it are numbed and motionless.

rites.name: Larintus
rites.text: A restorative life-force power that is gathered from hidden reservoirs in a dark, cursed tower. It replenishes a wielder's vitality when drawn forth.

rites.name: Tiantanum Leonum
rites.text: A sacred discipline awakened in a warrior-devotee at a set stage of training. It sharply heightens how strongly every blessed strike and rite draws the attention of foes, lasting until dismissed or until the devotee takes up a different path.

rites.name: Amialinanum
rites.text: A restorative craft practiced by healers of the green orders, learned after mastering the lesser arts of the restoring path. It requires a considerable investment in that discipline before it can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Melanum Sillia
rites.text: A sacred gift that a creature in a contest of bonded beasts can call upon to steady its companions. It is a lesser blessing of the trainer's spirit, drawn out in the heat of battle.

rites.name: Mausolles
rites.text: A monastic healing discipline that gathers a sudden surge of restorative energy to mend many wounded companions at once. It must be chosen alongside a rival technique, so a practitioner cannot master both.

rites.name: Rasialum
rites.text: A scholar's inquiry that lets a copyist uncover hidden symbol formulas. Those who complete it gain a modest measure of practiced skill.

rites.name: Meostus Serasum
rites.text: A calling whose practitioners can restore the dead to life. Anyone trained in this path counts as one who brings the fallen back.

rites.name: Viseostium
rites.text: A ritual working cast by channelers that calls a fallen soul back to its body, but only when no battle rages nearby. A greater form of the rite lets a practitioner trained in preservation restore many fallen at once.

rites.name: Sellanum Sasor
rites.text: A tracker's rite that restores a fallen beast companion to life. It is learned once a healing charm is known, and the two share a single trigger that changes with the companion's state.

rites.name: Taunirnes Cauntes
rites.text: A caster's incantation that conjures a small communal table, laden with provisions that restore the strength of nearby allies. The old rite has since been retired from practice.

rites.name: Viarnanum Vantaullia
rites.text: A sacred discipline held by guardian-knights who shield the innocent. It is bound to several sworn virtues, tying a warden's steadfastness to enduring honest order.

rites.name: Sereorestum
rites.text: A sacred quality borne by holy relics of the consecrated clergy. It is bound up with the sanctified powers of healing and the radiance of devotion.

rites.name: Seristanum Serilor
rites.text: A discipline of monks that binds a single rite to a chosen calling, so that a practitioner may take only one of two paths. The two rites cannot be learned together.

rites.name: Oreollus Telausanum
rites.text: A priestly rite that restores a fallen companion to life with a third of their vitality and spirit. It cannot be performed while blades are clashing nearby.

rites.name: Amaroses Mesia
rites.text: A sacred guardian rite in which a holder calls on a companion's protector to draw up to three hostile foes away from an ally. The chosen attackers are forced to turn their attention toward the caller.

rites.name: Cinia Cellium
rites.text: A sacred guardian ward that the sworn defenders of a holy order carry, punishing those who are beyond forgiveness. It answers the wrongdoer who refuses to repent.

rites.name: Tiasteolium
rites.text: A blessing that settles upon a traveler who pays homage to one of the sacred hearth-fires lit during the summer solstice gathering. It is granted without asking whenever the fire is honored.

rites.name: Oronia Restus
rites.text: A devoted healer's rite that calls a fallen companion back from the body, restoring a portion of their strength and inner reserves. It cannot be performed amid battle and is broken if the healer is struck.

rites.name: Vallia Teleostenia
rites.text: A joined working that needs several casters at once, where the lead caster opens a shimmering doorway nearby. Allies step through it to add their strength, and the working completes once enough of them have joined.

rites.name: Valirastia
rites.text: A dead wanderer is called back to life through a spirit of the grave, either by returning from a ghostly form to the body or by a caretaker who restores them at a cost. The restored person suffers lasting wear and a weakened state afterward.

rites.name: Reolliarnia Amollium
rites.text: A bond of spirit granted by a shrine-keeper that holds a wounded thread together. It cannot coexist with a rival binding of solitary sorrow.

rites.name: Tiarus Vauror
rites.text: A restorative art practiced by healers of the old circles, allowing a caster to bring back a companion who has fallen. It works only when no battle rages nearby, and it is not limited by any waiting period.

rites.name: Telaustium Nostium
rites.text: A discipline of breath and vapor practiced by temple adepts, drawing fog upward through trained stillness. It pairs with a sacred dew-rite and cannot be learned alongside it.

rites.name: Viasor Valostes
rites.text: A carving craft that engraves sigils into surfaces so they ring with a pure, echoing sharpness. It is drawn from a remembered vision held within a sacred stone.

rites.name: Telirus Sernauntor
rites.text: A tempering rite that lets afflicted wild-blooded folk steady their rage by facing their own doubts and fears. It softens the hunger inside them without removing the affliction from their veins.

rites.name: Laristum
rites.text: A monk's technique that is passed automatically to adepts of the wind-path discipline. It drains a set measure of vital energy to perform, and against rival fighters it dulls the mending power of the strike's target.

rites.name: Neontistium
rites.text: A bonded craft that lets a practitioner reshape living tissue with clever improvisation. It cannot be paired with the blade-ridged shoulder guard.

rites.name: Maures Cosestium
rites.text: A quiet, sustained inner virtue that a sworn holy warrior carries at a high level of mastery. It grants steadiness and a clean sense of purpose to those who have earned it.

rites.name: Sesiaranum Orianus
rites.text: A mending adept draws renewed inner reserves each time a restoring rite strikes with exceptional force. The gathered energy replenishes the caster's vital essence.

rites.name: Taunteolia
rites.text: A sacred rite is drawn from an old sealed scroll kept in a storm-battered sanctuary. It is taken by force from those who guard it.

rites.name: Ciales Miarnastum
rites.text: A dark binding rite where one gathered companion gives up their life to call forth a hostile brute that is quickly bent into a servant of the caster. The servant serves for a fleeting span, yet might at any moment turn on its own summoners.

rites.name: Orollus Soliastanum
rites.text: A fighter's temporary stance that answers each direct close-range blow with a swift, harsh counterstrike, for a short span and a limited number of replies.

rites.name: Orasium Riallistor
rites.text: A renewing force that a rank-one initiate of a shadowed brotherhood's life-channeling craft can draw upon once granted. It gently refills an ally's depleted vital energy.

rites.name: Vaulus Teleostia
rites.text: A dark rite in which a caster opens a gate that draws companions through to stand beside them. It needs two more allies taking part before it can be completed.

rites.name: Larnes Orallum
rites.text: A stalking-beast's battle cry that quietly sharpens its handler's instinct, with the boost growing as the beast matures. Several other beast lineages share this same mechanic under different names.

rites.name: Tistellium
rites.text: A guardian-sworn talent that lets a warden of the wild unleash a commanding bellow. It is learned by those who reach the fortieth rank of their path and is used in duels between rival champions.

rites.name: Tarirnum
rites.text: A bonding discipline bestowed by a sea-keeper spirit that binds a seeker's resolve. It cannot coexist with a focusing chant or a patience flask.

rites.name: Milleonanum
rites.text: A gift of the flame-casters that lets them draw forth lingering sparks of heat after their fires have died. It can only be taken alongside the wider sweeping conflagration art.

rites.name: Restauntia Seraunum
rites.text: A bound rite that a practitioner of dark arts may learn to summon a shadowy hound from the void. The rite's writings rest on a shelf in a hidden chamber of an ancient tower.

rites.name: Taleostus
rites.text: A bellowing call that a tamed beast can sound to rouse its keeper, returning lost focus and restoring the caster's concentration.

rites.name: Ceorum Vianentus
rites.text: A glowing mark of restorative charm that mends the wounds of companions standing close by. It is a small, fleeting boon for those who gather near its light.

rites.name: Seresia Taulus
rites.text: A innate gift shared by all mountain-dwelling herd folk, which quietly lessens the harm they suffer from blows and wounds.

rites.name: Valasum Meostialum
rites.text: A craft in which carved marks hold stored power that a caster can call upon. The marks can channel several kinds of force, including radiance, emptiness, and dark arcane currents.

rites.name: Valantanum Cenanum
rites.text: A dark rite of decay lets a wielder's blade spread a wasting corruption. It is bound to a trio of companion arts that feed upon the dead.

rites.name: Ameseonor
rites.text: A carved sigil that restores fallen companions to the fight. Bearers call back the dead for another round of battle.

rites.name: Valerosia
rites.text: A glowing sigil that lies on the ground and mends the wounds of nearby allies. It restores their life force when someone steps close enough to be touched by its warmth.

rites.name: Leontia Larenium
rites.text: A communal trait that stirs a warden's mind, binding it to the strength of a gathering crowd. It links with two related instincts that sharpen the warden's fury and senses.

rites.name: Valinia Tialinia
rites.text: A chilling craft tied to carved frost signs that works alongside two other inscribed powers of the same cold lineage.

rites.name: Sontus Reonostus
rites.text: A bound warrior's technique that spends one sigil of carved power to draw ten measures of charged vigor into the striker's blood. It is among the first arts a sworn fighter learns.

rites.name: Vaullus Miarneostum
rites.text: A set of carved marks that bind to a dark warrior's body and channel power. They are tied to a rotting touch, a passage into the nether realm, and a blight that spreads across the world.

rites.name: Orellia Tianaulanum
rites.text: A carved mark of protection that calls forth guardian wards to stand watch. It lets its bearer bring sentries into being when needed.

rites.name: Molliantium
rites.text: A dark grave-craft gift that a death-warrior may choose instead of its rival gift, one that burst open the inner body and spills its harm outward. It cannot be taken alongside the Corpse-Mage Rite.

rites.name: Coriastor Sereneolum
rites.text: A fishing practice that lets a cast on a glittering carp school sometimes call forth a barrel of catch. It is bound to the bloodline of the wild lure.

rites.name: Corinor Telenia
rites.text: A binding quality found on enchanted relics of the spellcasting orders. It is tied closely to a companion protective ward that the same relics can bear.

rites.name: Maulles Nistesum
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught by priests, granting a gift of blood-drinking that can be chosen only in exclusion to a related rite of embrace.

rites.name: Oriantus Amiles
rites.text: A grim bargain in which a dark knight offers up their bound servant to unleash a wave of shadowy harm across foes nearby, restoring some of the knight's own vitality in the process.

rites.name: Taresia
rites.text: A sworn gift of a guardian's own strength that bends toward shielding the faithful. It pairs with the ward of steadfast belief and the ritual that drives dark forces back into the night.

rites.name: Sauntum Valarnor
rites.text: A carving-craft that lets a practitioner etch glyphs into stone to gain a sharp, biting power. It is learned by recalling a remembered set of hunter's teeth.

rites.name: Nosia Viraulles
rites.text: A quiet, always-on discipline practiced by sworn guardians of the faith. It lets their purifying touch also unravel enchantments woven onto a person or place.

rites.name: Niasteranum
rites.text: A rogue's artifact trait that lies dormant until it is needed. It links to a bold, unruled spirit and to a blade's surging strength.

rites.name: Caustornum
rites.text: A devoted discipline taught to sacred warriors that sharpens their strikes, granting a modest rising chance for decisive blows across every spell and blade they wield.

rites.name: Valintarnia
rites.text: A sacred spark that is made by joining twenty riddling old glyphs together. It gives its maker the power to bring new things into being.

rites.name: Talus Laurnor
rites.text: A runecarving craft that is drawn out of a remembered sequence of blows. It lets the practitioner carve symbols that bewilder foes.

rites.name: Tisor Viastaror
rites.text: A grinding wind of sand that some creatures can call forth during a contest of companions. It batters the opposing side and wears down their strength.

rites.name: Miria Oreostor
rites.text: A sacred discipline taught to holy guardians, granting a cultivated choice of inner fervor. It is mutually exclusive with a related awakening path, so a practitioner must pick one.

rites.name: Maulum Veraulium
rites.text: A hallowed devotion practiced by temple clerics, chosen as a sacred path that cannot be taken alongside a restorative chant. Adepts must pick one of the two rites.

rites.name: Sinus Telianilus
rites.text: A ritual sight that lets a bearer perceive the lesser spirits dwelling within stone, water, flame, and wind. The gift is awakened when a sacred token is held and used.

rites.name: Corolistum
rites.text: A minor ember-craft that strikes a foe with a gentle burn while its wielder keeps walking. It hits instantly without a flying shot, so an opponent cannot tell where the blow came from.

rites.name: Amaulirnes
rites.text: A dark martial technique practiced by shadow-touched warriors of the grave. It strikes with blade and gloom together, dealing both physical and shadow harm.

rites.name: Orinausia
rites.text: A permanent binding that infuses a great two-handed blade or axe with added striking strength. Its crimson shimmer resembles blood running slowly along the edge.

rites.name: Oreonor Cauniallor
rites.text: A glittering lunar gift that marks a keeper's craft of shaping. It is bound to a steadfast circle of guardians and to the mending of flesh.

rites.name: Teontolor
rites.text: A guardian's sacred gift that drives away dark forces when the bearer stands firm in defense. It works in concert with three other sacred gifts that share the bearer's protective purpose.

rites.name: Vornes Orirellia
rites.text: A distinction bestowed upon one who finishes the trial of the hidden school with a high mark. The recipient is taught a way of commanding the dead.

rites.name: Silorus Corarnes
rites.text: A tactic in which a creature of a trained companion band sets the ground aflame during a contest of beasts. It is employed by many of the tamed beasts when they face one another.

rites.name: Tolum Ternauntum
rites.text: A sacred talent practiced by devout order-members who have reached the highest tier of their training. It channels restorative divine favor to aid others in peril.

rites.name: Reles Ciarnes
rites.text: A passive enchantment that a seeker gains after completing a destiny-bound errand. It lets the bearer pass unnoticed among rival companies.

rites.name: Ameornes Oronilium
rites.text: A sacred blessing bound into a holy relic that answers the devotion of its wielder. It is tied to three other sacred gifts that share its gentle, restorative power.

rites.name: Serillanum Vanus
rites.text: A toxin that seeps into one chosen victim and gnaws at them slowly over a short span. Each new dose strengthens the poison and renews its lingering hold on the body.

rites.name: Nanum Meosallia
rites.text: A savage strike used by the beast-kin of the hunting clans that halves the mending a victim can receive. It is passed down only among a single lineage of trained hunting companions.

rites.name: Serauleonor
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wild shapeshifters who take the form of a great bear. It strengthens the protective instincts they call upon in battle.

rites.name: Cilleorium
rites.text: A single-use parchment charm that is sometimes found lying among the ruins of a border valley. Its magic hides everyone nearby from sight for a short while.

rites.name: Amaunallia Siarnanum
rites.text: A sacred bond a sworn guardian of light may take up, so that striking a foe with a sacred judgment unleashes a fierce radiance. Each blow of the weapon also carries a lesser flare of the same holy fire.

rites.name: Meoles Serastum
rites.text: A consecrated self-binding rite that a warrior-priest invokes to sharpen their strikes so foes grow more inclined to focus on them. It was later superseded by a newer, reworked ritual.

rites.name: Viarentium
rites.text: A carving discipline that draws on a remembered vow of wild sprouting. Practitioners inscribe glyphs that let living growth surge quickly and spread without restraint.

rites.name: Tallum Valauntanum
rites.text: A consumable parchment that, when read aloud, slowly mends the wounds of living allies gathered around its bearer. Its restorative effect lasts for a short while.

rites.name: Nolliria Vestilus
rites.text: A brittle parchment that, once read aloud, shapes a small stone seal able to draw a distant object toward its bearer. The writ is consumed in the making.

rites.name: Vausia Miallia
rites.text: A dark enchantment that entrances a chosen victim, leaving them unable to strike, speak a spell, or move. The trance can be broken if the victim is wounded.

rites.name: Telintum Amarneolor
rites.text: A bound parchment that, when unrolled, replenishes the arcane reserves of allies gathered near its bearer. It can be used only once before crumbling to dust.

rites.name: Seneollia Lonestia
rites.text: A carved ritual pillar that a caster plants in the ground to call forth a burst of heat. Its power was once learned by initiates of the spirit-keeping orders.

rites.name: Sornanum Telonirnus
rites.text: A bound parchment roll that calls up six nearby fallen to serve its bearer in battle for a short while. It can be spent once before its magic fades.

rites.name: Miallanum Valiantium
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught to practitioners of the shaping arts, it grants a constant, unforced heat that lingers within the caster's craft once they reach a certain standing.

rites.name: Caustentes Ceoranum
rites.text: A permanent mark etched onto the shoulder that grants a lasting enhancement to scouts, trackers and sky-hunters. The mark only works for those who keep their etching craft at a high level of skill.

rites.name: Amontilles
rites.text: A grim inner craft that sharpens a fighter's senses toward the nearness of ending. It binds closely with two other battle-rites, the blood-frenzy and the unstoppable charge.

rites.name: Orinanum Siarnia
rites.text: A sacred mark that a warrior of the order can bind to their strikes, so each blow and each invoked decree rings with radiant force. It was later sealed away and superseded by a stronger oath.

rites.name: Teneornia
rites.text: A single-use parchment that, when read, conjures a water-aspected staff of summoning. Its magic is spent in the making of the staff it calls forth.

rites.name: Oralentanum
rites.text: A consecrated sense that reveals every restless dead creature nearby as crimson marks on a map. It cannot detect the self-willed dead who walk as people, and it gives its wielder much sharper awareness in graveyard-heavy lands.

rites.name: Vistum Seorium
rites.text: A carved-sign craft that is drawn from a stored memory of ground-shaking tremors. It lets its practitioner channel that remembered quake through marks etched into stone.

rites.name: Lesus Rianisium
rites.text: A holy binding that a righteous warrior invokes to swell their strength and quicken their strikes. Each blow lands lighter, so the bearer trades raw force for relentless speed.

rites.name: Ciareoles
rites.text: A keeper teaches a bonded beast a piercing cry that strikes one foe and weakens the strength of all foes nearby. The cry draws their attention, so the beast can hold a crowd while its keeper fires freely.

rites.name: Reria Cellum
rites.text: A stored inner fury that a wanderer draws from hidden reserves within a dread spire. It is gathered from sealed vaults and channeled as a volatile source of power.

rites.name: Oriantastum Nonum
rites.text: A devotion that binds a guardian to restorative mercy, exclusive of a rival gift known as Hollow Palms. Those who take it give their own strength to heal others, and it is set beside that gift as a competing path.

rites.name: Amintes Morallia
rites.text: A cursed resonance power drawn from hoarded essence stores buried in a dark tower of punishment. It lets its bearer channel the wailing spirit trapped within.

rites.name: Lornastanum Misteosium
rites.text: A sealed parchment bearing inscribed script that loosens locked things when read aloud. Its making requires a deliberate inscribing skill, passed along through instructors.

rites.name: Rianastanum
rites.text: A ritual mark that lets a sworn warrior strike with searing sanctified force on every blow. The price is a rebound of pain that can turn deadly when rivals clash.

rites.name: Valauntus Orentus
rites.text: A ritual parchment that cleanses tainted spirit-blood of its corruption, turning the dark, unnatural form of a fallen power back into a harmless state.

rites.name: Visollor
rites.text: A sacred binding-power drawn from hidden reliquaries within a cursed spire of the dead. It lets its bearer sense and call forth the hoarded life-essence stored in those forbidden vaults.

rites.name: Amianarnium
rites.text: A sworn mark of a holy warrior that lets each strike leave a lingering burn on a single foe, growing heavier with every stacked wound and sharpening the wielder's own blows.

rites.name: Nares Meoles
rites.text: A preserving craft that lets a being seal its own body against decay. The practitioner draws the needed essence from hidden reserves found in deep, forbidden towers.

rites.name: Lernostium Riallum
rites.text: A ground-shaking trait carried by earth-sorcerers, tied to a churning whirlwind of power and to a binding alliance of mystic bonds. It draws its force from unstable forces and passes it along to those who wield it.

rites.name: Monanum Meollesium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that is drawn from a remembered bounty of good harvests. Practitioners use it to call forth abundance from the land.

rites.name: Vises Carnium
rites.text: A quiet, lingering art of the dark caster that grows stronger as the practitioner draws deeper into the arts of withering and decay. It is gained at a set threshold of mastery.

rites.name: Mastus Valeostirus
rites.text: A sacred mark that a holy warrior of the opposing host might bind upon an enemy's soul. It mirrors a similar rite used by the rival sect and is described in a separate treatise.

rites.name: Ceostium Coristia
rites.text: A hidden power of animated fire that is gathered from sealed reserves kept within a dark, towering prison. It can be drawn out only by those who find these caches.

rites.name: Rintia Coriarnonum
rites.text: A sacred gift that a devoted guardian can awaken within a relic. It is bound to three other holy blessings that share its radiant purpose.

rites.name: Millenium
rites.text: A carved craft of inscribed symbols that is learned through a remembered watch. It draws its strength from the vigil that is recalled by those who practice it.

rites.name: Serollus Valostaunus
rites.text: A sworn holy discipline that lets a warrior's oath-marks strike with added sacred force. When certain marks are invoked, the blow also sweeps across every foe within arm's reach.

rites.name: Tinia Nilontes
rites.text: A bond granted to a sacred caster who serves a sovereign ruler. It is tied to rites that call upon the forces of the tides and the flooded waters.

rites.name: Vesor Oreontum
rites.text: A sacred talent of the warrior-cleric path, chosen from a single exclusive branch. Taking it means forgoing a rival blessing that answers to the same holy fury.

rites.name: Raules Vaurum
rites.text: A discipline of watchers that sharpens the senses of a hunter. It is chosen in place of another gift, so a practitioner must pick one path or the other.

rites.name: Reolus Niallor
rites.text: A rogue craft granted to those who pledge to a martial bone-order, letting a fighter hurl a jagged shard of marrow-hardened ivory. The craft is lent for a time to outsiders who take up a proving trial.

rites.name: Valeolores
rites.text: A jagged cutting quality carried by certain tools of stealthy killers. It works alongside a poisoning power and a trait of striking unseen from concealment.

rites.name: Valeosinor Corollum
rites.text: A stealth craft practiced by thieves who pledge to a shadowed court of woodland spirits. Any cutpurse who swears to that court may wield it, though the skill fades once their bond to the realm's current trial ends.

rites.name: Corausteres
rites.text: A carving-based craft in which marks are etched into surfaces to channel a hidden power. The power is drawn from a remembered deception that a sly hunter once used to outwit prey.

rites.name: Nolerum
rites.text: A bonded trait that a forge-artisan of bone bestows upon a wearer, granting jagged shoulder guards. It cannot coexist with a craft of shaping living flesh.

rites.name: Corausirnia
rites.text: A calm inner gift that a sacred keeper can carry within a relic. It grows stronger when joined with other devout blessings.

rites.name: Tantus Restor
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that draws its force from a remembered oath. It is passed down by those who keep the memory alive.

rites.name: Maullium Riantus
rites.text: A basic dark-forged strike that hurls direct harm at a chosen foe. It serves as the everyday staple for practitioners of two disciplines, while a rival craft swaps it out for a fiercer blast. For one such discipline, each casting also yields a small crystal fragment.

rites.name: Nornes Raurnanum
rites.text: A temple-taught craft that lengthens the reach of dark workings, letting a practitioner strike at foes from farther away before they can close in.

rites.name: Sauleonia
rites.text: A spirit of tempest that grants its followers a restless veil of stealth, one that enemies can neither see nor hear. It is called upon by hunters who move through shadow.

rites.name: Cirollium Nollantor
rites.text: A hidden craft of draining a binding essence from sealed vaults in a grim tower of the condemned. Practitioners gain a new power from the stored essence.

rites.name: Corentus Rentiases
rites.text: A temple-trained discipline that a practitioner gains after mastering enough of the dark path. It lowers how strongly the dark workings draw the notice of foes.

rites.name: Tistium Teontes
rites.text: A dark inner power is drawn from hidden reservoirs found within a grim, ruined spire. Those who claim it wield its strength in battle.

rites.name: Tiarellor
rites.text: A ritual chant once taught to devoted keepers of the temples, said to cloud the minds of foes. It is recorded in two bound scrolls of hidden lore.

rites.name: Coraliania
rites.text: A hidden power of the spirit that is gained from sealed reservoirs found deep inside a dreaded tower of punishment. It lets its wielder strike quickly from concealment.

rites.name: Nausum Maurianus
rites.text: A spoken rite that calls forth two restless spirit-wraiths bound to grief. The words are said to come from a dark-robed keeper who guards a sunken fortress.

rites.name: Orialontor Telastorium
rites.text: A hidden surge of inner force is drawn from sealed reservoirs within a cursed spire. It grants its wielder a final, unavoidable threat delivered from the dark.

rites.name: Nistus Casiales
rites.text: A sacred blessing that hardens a chosen ally against dark, unseen forces. When the bearer stands among companions, the same guard settles over every one of them.

rites.name: Leostaurnia
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that bends the unseen shade of a spoken word to a bearer's will. It is drawn from a remembered echo kept within a sacred stone.

rites.name: Siallus Vaurnestum
rites.text: A stealthy craft of striking unseen from the dark, tied to a restless hunger for violence and a sack of tricks. It belongs to the trade of quiet killers.

rites.name: Castintes Vollanum
rites.text: A dark binding craft wielded by a sworn shadow-guardian servant of a sorcerous master. It seals an opponent in gloom, holding them fast and unable to move.

rites.name: Corasus Reostesum
rites.text: A ward etched onto head and leg armor that wraps the wearer in protection against dark, shadowy harm. It is a sealed rune applied to gear to strengthen it.

rites.name: Tiraullus
rites.text: A binding rite taught to the clergy of a temple order, used to hold restless dead creatures in place. While it lasts, the bound corpse can neither step nor strike, and glowing bindings wrap around its body.

rites.name: Lestines Naules
rites.text: A dark inner power is drawn forth from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy found within a grim, towering prison-fortress. It grants the one who calls it a sudden, shadowy strength.

rites.name: Cenausor
rites.text: A dark craft of murmured rites that bends the spirit toward ruin, bound closely to the soul-fire and to the spreading rot of corruption.

rites.name: Reores Lalor
rites.text: A caster takes on a dark, unseen manner that strengthens the force of their spells. While in this state, their magic strikes harder than before.

rites.name: Seornanium
rites.text: A dark inner power that is gathered from hidden reserves kept within a grim, cursed tower. It is drawn out and turned to the bearer's use.

rites.name: Sesinia Testalanum
rites.text: A dark chant used by temple caster-keepers to strike foes and drain their strength. It is one of three sacred word-forms, alongside a radiant form and a commanding form.

rites.name: Valleoria
rites.text: A sacred art of reshaping living form that a guardian keeper could gain once they had reached a high standing in their order. It was granted as a mark of honor to those who walked the wild path.

rites.name: Cauronum Rollor
rites.text: A bound spirit companion can slip through the dark to reappear beside a chosen foe, then fight with heightened ferocity for a short span. The technique activates on its own unless turned off, and resets whenever the companion is called forth again.

rites.name: Ternisanum
rites.text: A devotee's practice that sharpens the aim of dark-rite invocations and lowers the sacred reserve each one drains. It is no longer taught by the orders.

rites.name: Vanialia
rites.text: A carving art drawn from a relic that holds dark and fire together in one crystal. Those who learn it etch sigils that channel this twin force.

rites.name: Oreosanum Selloria
rites.text: A dark-arts discipline taught in hidden temples, where practitioners sharpen their gloom-born spells so that every shadow-wrought curse strikes harder against its target.

rites.name: Valintor Seresum
rites.text: A carving-craft that lets its user etch glowing sigils to unlock a power born of memory. It is drawn from a remembered essence of an ancient breaker of darkness.

rites.name: Corines Valerintium
rites.text: A sacred ward worked by devoted guardians that grants a steady defense against dark, gloom-born forces. It flows outward from its bearer to shield nearby allies.

rites.name: Coralernia Solanum
rites.text: A dark inherited craft drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-essence within a cursed sunken tower. It grants its wielder a borrowed power passed down by a fallen warrior.

rites.name: Amauses Taulanum
rites.text: A blended art practiced by temple keepers and once by oathbound sorcerers, fusing cold and gloom. Its workings draw on bonuses from either source, face the weaker of the two defenses, and slip past partial wards.

rites.name: Riaseornia
rites.text: A bond-craft that ties a follower's spirit to a commander's will. The binding is granted by a martial leader to those who swear to serve.

rites.name: Tausanum Telosia
rites.text: A guardian warrior of the order strikes an opponent with a heavy protective plate, wounding them while hardening their own defenses for a short span.

rites.name: Amiastollus
rites.text: A mounted rider's technique used in tournament duels, performed only with a long spear in hand. It strips away the protective layers an opponent has built up.

rites.name: Orianus Voreoses
rites.text: A defensive craft used by sworn guardians to brace against incoming blows. When called upon, it sharply blunts harm taken for a short span before it must rest.

rites.name: Orauranum Seriastanum
rites.text: A dark rite that breaks a spirit's essence into fragments, tied to a mark of vengeance carried by hunters of demons. It draws on the restless anguish of trapped souls and the drain of stolen strength.

rites.name: Oreorosanum
rites.text: A monastic talent passed down through an order of cloud-robed adepts, taught by the bearer of a sacred staff. It lets practitioners weave mist into their discipline.

rites.name: Nilenia
rites.text: A practiced clawing blow that a shapeshifting caster delivers in beast form. It inflicts heavy harm on a foe and builds a small store of momentum for a finishing move.

rites.name: Ternaustum
rites.text: A sacred bond that lets a guardian of the light divide harm among allies. It works alongside several other blessings of protection, justice, and sacrifice.

rites.name: Amorirnus
rites.text: A rite of temple-trained seers that lets a caster draw dread from the dark. It is an exclusive choice that cannot be taken alongside the tendril-weaving discipline.

rites.name: Oriares Rialanum
rites.text: A guardian's disciplined posture that halts every incoming blow for a short span of time. Trained defenders can strengthen their counterstrike while holding it, but only when bearing a raised barrier.

rites.name: Amentus Nollus
rites.text: A defensive craft available only to the turned-stone kin of a certain beast-bonded guild, halving the harm that their companions take in battle.

rites.name: Amernium Loles
rites.text: A veil-like gift that lets a healer draw a drifting fog around their allies. It works together with three other gifts that mend and calm the body.

rites.name: Teostornes
rites.text: A sacred discipline that temple keepers practice to bestow their radiance onto others. It works alongside a protective ward of devotion.

rites.name: Valaunes Liarnares
rites.text: A tactic that cracks open an opponent's guard and leaves them exposed. It works alongside a lethal finishing strike and a method for seizing openings.

rites.name: Ceonia Seriastum
