rites.text: A guardian's craft that lets a sworn defender raise a sacred ward to strike back at those who attack them. It is taught within one discipline of defensive training.

rites.name: Valesus Riastia
rites.text: A dread-inducing stunning craft that companion beasts draw upon while contending in ritual duels. It leaves rivals dazed and fearful at the moment of contest.

rites.name: Coreontolus
rites.text: A runecarving craft drawn from a remembered ancestral mind. Carvers who inscribe it gain a strengthening force passed down through the recollection.

rites.name: Lantanum Seresanum
rites.text: A fighter's trained technique that releases a burst of force in a short cone before them, dazing everyone caught inside it for a brief moment while dealing slight harm.

rites.name: Coraurum Amesium
rites.text: A blade-binding virtue held by avenging knights, tied to shielding rites, judgment strikes, and a fiery sword wrath. It sharpens the weapon's bite for those who carry it.

rites.name: Cillia Villor
rites.text: A sacred guardian craft practiced by devoted keepers of holy power, whose bearers call on a protective blessing. It links to several related rites that channel radiant and shadowed forces.

rites.name: Orillum Telentanum
rites.text: A sworn guardian's art of raising a vow-bound barrier that answers harm with reprisal. It cannot be paired with the ward of mercy, so the bearer must choose one path.

rites.name: Tornanum Valintor
rites.text: A channeling craft used by holy knights to raise protective barriers. It is said to be left behind when certain powerful foes fall in their strongholds.

rites.name: Riales Niasilum
rites.text: A warrior's sacred trait that grants protection, bound to the stone-hard endurance of the earth and to the fierce will that refuses to yield.

rites.name: Lostanum Valintanum
rites.text: A discipline of the guarded tree that shortens the wait before two great rites can be called again. It also lets a plea for mercy stir sacred energy within the one who speaks it.

rites.name: Tanteonor Serallanum
rites.text: A binding gift bestowed by a veiled blade-bearer that holds one sworn bond of keeping. It cannot coexist with a bond of swift footing.

rites.name: Valenaustor
rites.text: A temple discipline that binds a chosen foe's voice so they cannot invoke sorcery for a brief span. Against lesser beings it also turns back any attempt to break the bind.

rites.name: Seornialus
rites.text: A bound charm drawn from hidden reliquaries in a dread spire, it calls forth a guardian made of bone to defend its wielder in battle.

rites.name: Coraulles Amaleoses
rites.text: A binding craft that draws a hidden reserve of stored essence from sealed hoards within a dark, haunted spire. Its power is gathered from those secret caches and bound into tasseled cords.

rites.name: Valeosor Telistus
rites.text: A ritual inscription that is made through the arcane craft of binding, and it is taught to apprentices by masters of the art.

rites.name: Neolium Taullor
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws strength from a remembered tempest. Its practitioners inscribe marks that pull power from recalled storms.

rites.name: Seriasum Niarnallus
rites.text: A carving-craft that channels inscribed glyphs to awaken a tempting pleasure. It is drawn from a remembered trace of that same forbidden craft.

rites.name: Sialenus
rites.text: A carving power of runes that is gained by recalling a bitter fever of guilt. The knowledge comes from a remembered vision held within the mind.

rites.name: Sisanum Amastaullor
rites.text: A temporary blessing is granted by a sea-dwelling keeper after a devoted song is completed and the keeper is visited again. It lets the bearer move through water much faster for a short span, and it is required for a certain trial of lore.

rites.name: Tistus Telauror
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught to keepers of the faith, lowering how strongly foes are drawn toward the practitioner. It also hardens the mind against having its blessings or curses unwound.

rites.name: Amonia Leria
rites.text: A dark stirring craft that moves through hidden channels. It is bound to a thick brewing trait and works in quiet, lethal ways.

rites.name: Corausia Naurnestium
rites.text: A carved-rune power drawn from a remembered tide of wrongdoing. It is gained through a recollection that someone must first obtain.

rites.name: Reornistia
rites.text: A sacred mark of inner strength drawn from hidden reserves of spirit found deep within a dark tower of the condemned. Those who claim it grow sturdier in body and resolve.

rites.name: Cintaunum
rites.text: A shapeshifter's interrupt, learned as a training talent, that breaks an enemy's incantation and blocks that magic branch for a short time.

rites.name: Orauses Corinaurium
rites.text: A passive blessing granted to those who complete a sieged-city trial. It holds only while the trial lasts, lifting spirits and mending a small amount of harm.

rites.name: Vasteontus
rites.text: A guardian's protective hardening that only the stone-backed beasts of the hunting packs can call upon. It halves the harm dealt to a companion creature for a short span of twelve heartbeats.

rites.name: Orenornes
rites.text: A dormant inner force that may awaken on its own, granting its bearer three greater spirits of wildness, pride, and battle prowess.

rites.name: Valeontia Maulor
rites.text: A blessing that a traveler gains by restoring a singing bloom to health. Several companions can share its gentle boost from the same flower.

rites.name: Coriastes Telastes
rites.text: A calming rite practiced by nature-keepers that strips rage from a foe, leaving the target's fury unraveled and dispelled.

rites.name: Corintum Amesteosor
rites.text: A calming rite used by nature keepers to quiet wild beasts. It is taught by mentors to adepts who have reached a certain level of skill.

rites.name: Valaulorium
rites.text: A coiling, snake-like shape that holds-priests and seers take on when they draw their strength from two immense serpent spirits. The form lets them channel divine power through their bodies.

rites.name: Sastolium
rites.text: A reward earned by overcoming seven creations of a churning monster pool. It lets its bearer take the shape of a towering slime in one of several vivid colors.

rites.name: Sollium Tiantium
rites.text: A fiery technique that a small hatchling uses during a contest of creature battles. It calls upon heat and kin-bound sparks to strengthen its companion.

rites.name: Valoseores
rites.text: A sacred craft of ritual devotion that a priest may master once they reach a high standing among their order. It lends the practitioner a quiet, honored skill in the ways of prayer.

rites.name: Amestes Valaustanum
rites.text: A brewing discipline that lets a monk gain a lingering trait, bound to a lunar counterpart and a staggering gait. Its effects are tied to two related monastic traits.

rites.name: Celostes Telialirnor
rites.text: A basic holy incantation that every healer-cleric learns at the very start of training. Clerics who turn toward dark, mind-twisting arts instead trade it away for a sapping whisper-spell.

rites.name: Laustium Niastinium
rites.text: A slow-burning inner force that a wanderer can draw from hidden reserves of gathered essence within a dark, cursed spire. It holds motion in place while glowing faintly.

rites.name: Meolirum
rites.text: A slow spiral of hardened mud that a caller can summon into the world. Once it has been called forth, its inner echo grants access to a further shelled inspiration.

rites.name: Teliarium Naullernes
rites.text: A sacred craft that a trained caster draws from the sun's heat to strike foes or mend allies. How it works shifts with the path the caster has chosen.

rites.name: Amaustia Seraures
rites.text: A carving-craft that can be learned from a remembered account of a great sky-warden's burning fall. It allows the carver to inscribe runes that unleash a fiery ruin.

rites.name: Seostum Mianistes
rites.text: A sky-bound craft held by balance-keepers that links together three star-related gifts. It is tied to falling light, the dark phase of the moon, and a reaping blade of stars.

rites.name: Telontales
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wind-walker monks, taught as one of two mutually exclusive paths where choosing it forecloses the other. It stands opposite a companion art of reaching outward.

rites.name: Niallontium
rites.text: A hidden force that lets a wielder hurl unseen pulses of stored essence drawn from sealed reserves within a dread spire. Such reserves are found hidden in the tower's depths.

rites.name: Telestanum Renum
rites.text: A swift martial technique that a fighter uses to strike a chosen foe at once. It is one of the earliest arts taught to novice warriors.

rites.name: Coriantor Lorentium
rites.text: A disciplined adept drives stiffened fingers into a caster's gesturing hand, breaking the incantation and locking that school of magic away for a few heartbeats.

rites.name: Amiarostes
rites.text: A dark power of the temple orders that clouds the minds of those who wield it. It is bound to a shadow-drawing craft that spreads gloom across the land.

rites.name: Serium Tontaurium
rites.text: A gentle hidden craft that deepens the mending power of two restorative rites. Practitioners who master it find their healing waters flow stronger and carry more recovery to the wounded.

rites.name: Coraurus Riles
rites.text: A bond of the wandering dreamer that ties a soul to a sleepwalking state. It cannot coexist with a certain glimmering powder once bound.

rites.name: Oraurus Rariasum
rites.text: A caster shares a leafy tongue with growing things, asking questions and hearing replies. Plants answer only from what they sense nearby, and wary or foolish ones speak poorly.

rites.name: Losanum Seollor
rites.text: A caster's trade of sung incantations that bring forth varied effects. Some wound or mend, while others strengthen allies or weaken foes.

rites.name: Tiasium Tillonium
rites.text: A bond-trait bestowed by a sacred patron figure, which cannot coexist with a binding that mends the body's seams.

rites.name: Larnor Valaraulia
rites.text: A practitioner's trained whirling strike that hits every foe nearby in rapid pulses. Adepts rely on it when surrounded by several opponents at once.

rites.name: Reontes Teleontia
rites.text: A calming discipline taught to healer-monks who follow the path of drifting vapors. It is granted once a practitioner reaches the highest tier of training.

rites.name: Mesum Siareollium
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's craft tied to a bound relic, requiring the practitioner to first master every foundational discipline. It stands apart from other disciplines and is not connected to any of them.

rites.name: Lastisor
rites.text: A martial power granted only to the warriors of one sworn brotherhood. It lets those who bear the oath call upon a sacred form of combat.

rites.name: Corernia Teror
rites.text: A borrowed hide that wraps a dark caster's essence in protective layers. It works alongside two companion traits that steady the will and sharpen the claws.

rites.name: Mistium Rausor
rites.text: A devotional craft that lets a temple-bound adept move with swift grace. It is tied to other rites of the order that answer dread and dusk.

rites.name: Nirnum Telernes
rites.text: A practice that draws radiant power from the great star overhead to shape spells. It is closely tied to the living-growth craft of wild keepers rather than to sacred rites.

rites.name: Cireornanum Melasia
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that draws its strength from a remembered chime of celestial orbs. Practitioners gain it by recalling that resonance.

rites.name: Valanaulus
rites.text: A specialized mending art practiced by hermit caster-monks who draw a fading ghostly strength back into their hands. It is refined for duels between rival practitioners.

rites.name: Oriallernes
rites.text: A ghostly quill-tactic that a spirit beast uses in contests of tamed creatures. It raises a bristling barrier of pale shards to strike back at foes.

rites.name: Amises Siantium
rites.text: A calming vapor-discipline taught to a certain order of ascetic healers. Its adepts learn it naturally as they advance in their vow.

rites.name: Rernum Orontus
rites.text: A high piercing cry that only the winged hunter beasts of the bat kin can call forth. It is a trained technique passed among their handlers.

rites.name: Neollanum Amerum
rites.text: A ghostly clawing technique that a young beast-cub of a sky-guardian spirit calls upon during a contest between tamed companions.

rites.name: Nelles Rintiallium
rites.text: A dark binding craft that lets a bonded war-beast lunge forward and tear at a foe with shadowy force. The strike also yields a small crystal of captured spirit. It can only be chosen in place of another summoning rite.

rites.name: Valistes Corestanum
rites.text: A nature-keeper's inborn gift that is shared across every discipline of their order. It grants a quiet, lasting boon to anyone who walks the old path of the grove.

rites.name: Sausor Leosus
rites.text: A rite of calm open to devoted clerics once they reach a mature stage of study. It grants the practitioner a measure of tranquil resolve drawn from their faith.

rites.name: Sereontor Vaustanum
rites.text: A gifted cleric's art that lets a practitioner wear an unseen mask of ghostly form. It is learned only once the caster reaches a mature rank of training.

rites.name: Telosus Tolleontes
rites.text: A dark craft in which a wielder drains the spirit of foes to feed a destructive art. It works in concert with a volatile force and a demonic hardiness.

rites.name: Valoresus Cenus
rites.text: A ward-craft passed among temple keepers, offered as a mutually exclusive choice alongside a healing rite. Practitioners must pick one or the other.

rites.name: Amarneontes
rites.text: A dim inner ember that a dark caster can kindle within a relic, and which links to two other shadowed rites of the same lineage.

rites.name: Taurnellum
rites.text: A hunter's honored skill of firing a wide volley of shots at a target. It is granted to marksfolk who have reached a high standing in the craft.

rites.name: Valeonauror
rites.text: A mystic attunement that a seer can awaken in their soul to sense and strengthen the unseen currents around them. It is a refined art practiced by those who have mastered the lower spirit-workings.

rites.name: Coreolia Rasia
rites.text: A learned craft of drawing radiant energy from the heavens through a practiced inner rhythm. Those devoted to the path of balance take it up as a matter of course.

rites.name: Meollonanum
rites.text: A devotional discipline taught to keepers of the sacred flame, where the inner resolve of a caster strengthens the mending and striking rites they perform, scaled to the depth of their inner spirit.

rites.name: Saulor Mernum
rites.text: A practiced vocal technique used by wilderness keepers that briefly quickens the stride of companions standing close by.

rites.name: Volliania
rites.text: A ritual flame drawn from the heavens that is learned by the mystics who walk the balance of growth. It comes to them without any formal teaching.

rites.name: Restium Valaules
rites.text: A dying healer becomes a motionless, untouchable spirit for a short span, able to mend others without cost. When the span ends, the healer finally passes away.

rites.name: Cornialus
rites.text: A sacred craft in which temple keepers call down glowing fragments of arcane light that burn an enemy over time. It is a lesser form of a greater rite performed by high keepers of the moon.

rites.name: Visteolium
rites.text: A disciplined bodily posture taught to mist-binding adepts once they reach their tenth year of training. It takes the place of an older fierce-beast stance within their order.

rites.name: Velornus Niastus
rites.text: A hidden craft that lets a skilled wanderer slip past watchful eyes unless someone stands very near. Acting openly or taking harm from any source dissolves it, while a fall alone leaves it intact, and it cannot be taken up during a clash.

rites.name: Corosum Lilaunes
rites.text: A tempestuous shamanic enhancement that bonds a practitioner's craft to churning storm-force. It is tied to other storm-born and doom-calling gifts that answer the same restless power.

rites.name: Meornirium
rites.text: A battle posture taught to disciplined fighters of the temple orders. It sharpens their strikes and fuels their inner energy, empowering a handful of signature killing blows.

rites.name: Nollor Meolia
rites.text: A monk of the brewing orders plants the feet and steadies the body, drawing on a calm, heavy strength that unlocks once the practitioner reaches the tenth rung of their training.

rites.name: Corinor Nauntales
rites.text: A ritual art practiced by temple attendants to purify the spirit. It was a talent that could be unlocked once a practitioner reached a high standing among the order's servants.

rites.name: Sellonum Oraustum
rites.text: A ghostly burning strike that a flame-bearing creature hurls during a contest between tamed companions. It spreads its heat through the spirit rather than the body.

rites.name: Nilus Cisor
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that draws its strength from a remembered shattering of the four primal forces. It is gained by recalling that old fragmentation.

rites.name: Veonosus Coles
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that draws out a shimmering false image to beguile onlookers. It is gained by recalling a fragment of the lure's lingering memory.

rites.name: Calleostum
rites.text: A tempered breath-power is gathered from sealed reservoirs within a cursed spire. It lets the wielder strike the ground in uneven, spaced bursts.

rites.name: Orialles Corestum
rites.text: A binding ritual that is sealed into a torso garment, permanently lifting every measure of its wearer's strength and vigor by three.

rites.name: Valoria Amauntium
rites.text: A stepping technique in which a practitioner shifts footing in uneven rhythms during a contest between bound beasts. It is taught within the monastic circles that train animal companions.

rites.name: Meontum Liasia
rites.text: A ghostly strike that only spirit beasts can unleash, dealing heavier harm than a common claw swipe. Its arcane force ignores hardened hides and plating.

rites.name: Serelauntus Nernor
rites.text: A monk's posture that lets the practitioner channel a slow, coiling spirit energy into healing breath. It becomes available to those who have reached the tenth rung of training.

rites.name: Rasium Oriaselanum
rites.text: A tier-one discipline of the Balance path, where a caster draws upon starry radiance to empower their strikes. It is a lesser technique within a larger tree of learned arts.

rites.name: Tiantalum
rites.text: A blessing that a village grants to everyone nearby once a sacred relic is brought in and handed to a keeper. It lingers for a few hours and strengthens every bearer's abilities, scaled to their experience.

rites.name: Causiranum
rites.text: A reeling gait that a temple brewer-warrior adopts, bound to three other sacred disciplines of drift, rush, and bulwark.

rites.name: Nosor Reolanum
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a stored recollection of a wandering mystic's sea-shrine. Those who learn it can etch marks that call upon the rhythm of the rising and falling waters.

rites.name: Corallenes
rites.text: A mental discipline practiced by those who channel spirit, granting a clear and steady mind. It is a branch that can only be chosen alongside a companion gift for reading the feelings of others.

rites.name: Ralinia
rites.text: A charged discipline that a shaman can channel through sacred relics. It is bound to the arts of guarding the natural forces and of mending the sick.

rites.name: Tenauntes
rites.text: A ghostly chant that is drawn from a sealed coffer found in a remote hill region. It is gathered there by wanderers who seek hidden enchantments.

rites.name: Rintiases
rites.text: An unseen ward that lies in wait and holds nearby foes fast when a ground enemy steps close. It breaks apart once its hold has been spent.

rites.name: Ciasantum Lestor
rites.text: A charging war-cry that a sworn fighter releases when a nature-caster lends them a bond of shared life. It is a reworked version of an older beast-call sounded by wild shamans.

rites.name: Valinum Tantium
rites.text: A warrior's discipline that binds a calm, cold composure to a grudge-fed edge. Practitioners must choose it exclusively over the rival path of Rageful Temper.

rites.name: Tontium Seralum
rites.text: A quiet pact lets a bound ghost-creature slip from sight and move slowly for a time. Its first strike from hiding lands harder than usual, and it can be paired with a sudden burst of speed.

rites.name: Amosternor
rites.text: A guardian's sacred discipline that hardens a protector's resolve. It binds closely with three other sworn disciplines held by the same order.

rites.name: Nialanum Coranum
rites.text: A bonded rite that lets a practitioner call forth a beast of living iron, a devouring hound with an unnatural hunger. The ritual teaches the summoning and binds the creature to its caller.

rites.name: Amesanum Rolia
rites.text: A calming skill that only the glide-walking beetle companions of hunters can perform. It belonged to that one family of tamed creatures alone.

rites.name: Orelanum Larnus
rites.text: A set of luminous steps that can be recovered from a sacred gilded coffer or acquired through a trade with a priest after a demanding trial is completed.

rites.name: Rostia Teleones
rites.text: A monastic discipline of swift-footed fighters that channels the strength of a sky-spirit into their striking arts. It links to a pair of related disciplines that share its breath-driven methods.

rites.name: Seosor Cialirnes
rites.text: A battle-craft that a fighter's weapon can carry into the fray. It is bound to two related martial marks that deepen the same warlike gift.

rites.name: Amesanum Colintes
rites.text: A discipline taught to fighters of the armed orders, it hardens the body and sharpens a warrior's grip and endurance. It is practiced along the path of the weapon-keepers.

rites.name: Sarnialanum
rites.text: A discipline taught to lay adepts of the skyward monastic orders, granted after training with the sect of heaven-fists. It lets a practitioner unleash a gust-driven blow.

rites.name: Raures Leornus
rites.text: A guardian's hardened discipline drawn from the bedrock, which steadies the bearer against harm. It answers the wrath of a mighty earth-dragon and links with several other martial gifts.

rites.name: Meoraustor
rites.text: A bond of hunting beasts grants a small boost to the chance of landing a powerful blow. Other beast kinds share a similar call, though a few rival rites surpass it.

rites.name: Sausteornor
rites.text: A temporary blessing that a rite of a distant order bestows upon those who complete its trial. It grants a surge of physical might for a span of time.

rites.name: Reontia Corones
rites.text: A sacred craft of enhancement that binds to a holy relic. It is tied to two other mystic disciplines, one of restoration and one of molten forging.

rites.name: Causinium
rites.text: A grove-bound craft that lets a wild shapeshifter gather the strength of the forest into its body. It is taught as a reward for proving skill in contests between rival circles.

rites.name: Rianus Valistor
rites.text: A chanter's technique in which a warrior lashes a foe with both hands at once, unleashing a crushing double blow with each weapon. It is taught to those who walk the path of the storm-bound rites.

rites.name: Sereorines Telaustalum
rites.text: A fire-bearing craft that lets a sorcerer send flames skimming low across the ground in swift passes. It is bound to a restorative flame that stirs with a rekindling heat.

rites.name: Ronor Mellirnor
rites.text: A chosen path of tempest-calling that a seer may take instead of its rival flame-calling. Taking one path closes the other to the practitioner.

rites.name: Tasaustia
rites.text: A hardened shell-technique that a tamed beast can call upon during a contest of companions, letting its creature stand firmer against blows.

rites.name: Teorellus
rites.text: A binding worked into a blade of close combat that makes its wielder markedly stronger. Edges carrying it shine with a vivid green light.

rites.name: Tonasor
rites.text: A refined surge of inner vitality that is drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dreadful, imprisoning tower. It is gained by those who find and tap these buried stores.

rites.name: Oreosia Casostium
rites.text: A ritual binding that lasts forever and lets a close-combat blade inflict an extra measure of harm with every blow.

rites.name: Vaustia Merniases
rites.text: A ritual summons spectral remnants when a dark sorcerer seizes a wanderer's inner spirit inside a sunken burial vault. The stolen essence is drawn out and bound to the chamber.

rites.name: Tastillum
rites.text: A ritual craft through which a practitioner gains command over tempests. It is taught by a severe order of sky-warriors who guard its secrets.

rites.name: Mornus Miarauntium
rites.text: A binding ritual that permanently infuses a close-combat blade so that each of its strikes carries extra harm. The bonus lasts for the weapon's entire existence.

rites.name: Renium Seornaustum
rites.text: A dark rite by which a caster calls a seductive shadow-spirit to serve as their bound servant. It works just like a companion rite that summons a male counterpart spirit.

rites.name: Venarnia Corinium
rites.text: A ritual binding by which a caster calls forth a bound spirit servant. The caster chooses the spirit's form at a gathering place of grooming and trimming.

rites.name: Teontoria
rites.text: A learned rite lets a practitioner call forth a fearsome steed to serve as a riding beast. It is passed on through a sworn trial given by a dark patron.

rites.name: Telenes Caror
rites.text: A rising burst of inner strength that certain bonded companion creatures call upon when they clash in contests of skill. It lets them strike harder during these trials.

rites.name: Sereosanum Tisternes
rites.text: A dark-craft rite lets a caster call forth a shadowy hound-like creature to serve as their bound attendant and companion.

rites.name: Niresia
rites.text: A held stance that a creature may call upon while locked in a contest of beasts, allowing it to endure a blow that would otherwise drop it. Many battling creatures are able to draw on this resilience.

rites.name: Seriallia Orirontus
rites.text: A carving craft that is inscribed with runes and drawn from a remembered sovereign of light. It is said to grant a practitioner the ability to etch glyphs of warmth and power.

rites.name: Nenia Orantium
rites.text: A calling-art lets a practitioner draw a creature from some distant realm straight into their presence. It works by carrying the being across the gap between places to stand beside the caster.

rites.name: Valerialum
rites.text: A devout warrior calls forth a broad-backed beast that bears the wielder swiftly across the land in pursuit of righteous judgment. It must be learned before the seeker reaches a set level of mastery.

rites.name: Voraullium
rites.text: A bonding gift bestowed by a sky-keeper that imparts a acrid, smoldering breath. It cannot coexist with two rival sigils: scaled toes and grinding jaws.

rites.name: Corolausum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft in which a practitioner calls forth a towering fiend that attacks by hurling burning infernal flame.

rites.name: Seraunor Leoses
rites.text: A ritual technique once tested in secret that lets a sacred caster call forth a chosen defender. It was never finished and remains a half-forgotten practice.

rites.name: Valiantium Rones
rites.text: A dark-caster's rite that calls forth a watching eye-spirit from the shadows. The sorcerer draws the lingering gaze to serve their hidden craft.

rites.name: Telisus Serarnanum
rites.text: A bound guardian's ability that compels a chosen foe to strike at it for a short span. While active, it draws far more of the enemy's attention than usual.

rites.name: Mones Lausium
rites.text: A furious strike unleashed by a fiery little beast during a contest between tamed creatures. It is used only in pet battles.

rites.name: Conanum Malliria
rites.text: A sealed rite that binds glowing heat and hidden magic into a close-combat blade for good. It grants the weapon a considerable surge of flame and arcane might.

rites.name: Serorum Meranum
rites.text: A dark rite of the binding craft that calls a demonic servant to bend to its caster's will. The servant works exactly as its counterpart rite does, and the rite is learned by completing a trial of binding.

rites.name: Rines Corestus
rites.text: A hooded caster that lurks in a sealed chamber of a dark spire, binding a captive servant under its will. A mightier overlord shields it so no harm can touch it.

rites.name: Ciantia Niarontum
rites.text: A bound discipline passed down by a commander, which cannot be held alongside two rival battle doctrines. Those who carry it fight with a sharper edge than other warriors.

rites.name: Taurallor
rites.text: A sudden, unavoidable fate that strikes those who are not ready for it. Warriors may learn it as a rank-specific talent, choosing between it and a rival technique.

rites.name: Taunia Meostanum
rites.text: A hidden surge of spiritual force is drawn from sealed reservoirs within a dreadful spire. Those who tap it gain a sharpened edge in strength.

rites.name: Telirnus Tarnor
rites.text: A summoning rite calls forth a great beast that a holy warrior can mount to ride swiftly in the pursuit of righteous judgment.

rites.name: Rauntenium
rites.text: A caster's rite that briefly seizes the will of a fiend-kind creature, letting the practitioner direct it. Only one such bound creature may serve the caster at a time.

rites.name: Reostum Sines
rites.text: A ritual gift that a binder of dark bargains may choose instead of a rival rite. It cannot be held alongside the seeing of hidden things.

rites.name: Saresor
rites.text: A caster's ritual calls forth a loyal being of living brine to fight at their side. It is a craft taught to practitioners who wield cold arts.

rites.name: Orintalia
rites.text: A bond of spirit granted by a healing mistress that lets a wounded fighter gather strength after a fall. It cannot be held alongside a precise striking art.

rites.name: Amales Santus
rites.text: A rite of the forest-keepers that lets a practitioner change shape with great speed. It is taught as one of the branches of the balance path.

rites.name: Amausium Mauntiarnus
rites.text: A carving-craft of etched sigils that draws its strength from an inherited memory of an ancient strategist. Its practitioners press these marks into stone or bone to shape the outcome of conflicts.

rites.name: Vaulliasor
rites.text: A bound power of the spirit that can be drawn from hidden stores of gathered essence in a dark, towering prison-keep. It is gained by those who seek the vaults where such essence is kept.

rites.name: Casanum Varollium
rites.text: A trained animal companion can dive upon a chosen quarry and freeze it in place for a moment. The talent belongs to a hunter's beast and is no longer available to new users.

rites.name: Amiastanum Canium
rites.text: A dark rite of sorcery that calls forth crawling hordes from the shadows. It is bound to a cursed hand that channels the same unholy power.

rites.name: Vanor Ciantia
rites.text: A shapeshifter's technique in a beast form that strikes at several foes at once. It is mainly used to hold the attention of a crowd of enemies.

rites.name: Ternia Valolantes
rites.text: A bonding craft that lets a seeker keep a hold on a hunter's relic. It links with two companion practices that share its tradition.

rites.name: Lestor Rintum
rites.text: A ritual charge carried within a sacred relic that gathers and intensifies. It is bound to two other forces of unrest, the Tremor and the Gale, which answer to its rising pull.

rites.name: Naulisia
rites.text: A learned inner discipline that lets a devoted practitioner react with uncanny speed without conscious effort. It is always active once a certain mastery is reached.

rites.name: Naullarnes
rites.text: A monastic brewer's inherited quality that lets a practitioner move with the flowing ease of fast water. It is bound up with the traits of hearty feasting and unsteady stumbling.

rites.name: Maustia Oreontiaria
rites.text: A tide-born force that is drawn from a sea spirit during a sacred trial. It is a power carried as a reward for courage shown in that ordeal.

rites.name: Amaustanum Nirnalium
rites.text: A rapid form of righteous judgment practiced by sworn guardians of the sacred flame. It is taken as an exclusive path that cannot be combined with the Dawnlight Oath.

rites.name: Valaustelia
rites.text: A fighter's learned skill that sometimes lets a second strike land on the same foe after the first. It works only when the wielder holds a blade in one or both hands.

rites.name: Raullistus
rites.text: A learned craft by which a wayfarer gains the trust of wild creatures and bonds them as companions for the rest of their lives. Those who begin in the outland border region come to it through a long apprenticeship in the wilds.

rites.name: Orarneolia
rites.text: A carved rune-enchantment applied to an object by skilled inscribers. It is most valued by hunters, rogues and shamans who favor enhancement.

rites.name: Nialia Laulinia
rites.text: A shared bond of strength passes from a hunter's kin to their animal companion, bolstering the beast's vitality by a tenth. It belongs to one people's inborn gifts.

rites.name: Viantasum
rites.text: A mastery practiced by healers of the old green orders. It strengthens the restoring touch of nature's mending rites when they are cast upon the wounded.

rites.name: Nauses Caures
rites.text: A scribal method that teaches the inscriber how to carve a ward binding the bearer closely to the living wilds. It is passed down as a written formula among the sigil-makers.

rites.name: Corisantia
rites.text: A ward-script that a scribe can carve into sigil-stone to tune the workings of a counter-charm. It is a formula taught within the inscribing craft.

rites.name: Seostonia
rites.text: A hidden craft awakened in a warrior order when a humanoid falls by their hand, building in stacks up to ten to quicken their stride. It does not combine with ordinary running.

rites.name: Nauranum Nerases
rites.text: A discipline of quiet study passed between cloistered fighters. It sharpens the strikes of a palm technique and a kicking form.

rites.name: Tesiallum
rites.text: A devotional art of brewing that a cloistered order practices. It is an exclusive choice that a practitioner must make alongside a rival discipline of calm.

rites.name: Taulus Teleolanum
rites.text: A monastic brewing discipline that lets a practitioner choose between two mutually exclusive methods of preparing a restorative infusion. Choosing one closes off the other.

rites.name: Visor Nernollium
rites.text: A taught craft that lets a practitioner inscribe marks on objects. It is studied as a skill passed between those who keep the old lunar traditions.

rites.name: Vinus Amintus
rites.text: A binding that pins a traveler in place and then draws them back to a distant encampment. It is used as a step in a return journey.

rites.name: Amaurollor
rites.text: A withheld inscribed craft that is passed on only as a reward for completing a hunting trial. Its method is never offered openly to those who have not earned it.

rites.name: Amelium Lelones
rites.text: A sealed scroll that a merchant offers for sale in a coastal region. Its inked spell lets a bearer hurl a streak of molten rock at foes.

rites.name: Nirium Norirnum
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a remembered storm once wrought by a bringer of light. Its practitioners etch marks that channel the same stored energy into their own work.

rites.name: Telinus Lausum
rites.text: A hidden instinct that a hunter's trained companion draws upon in battle. It quietly sharpens the bond between hunter and beast, granting an edge that rises whenever the pair fights against rival hunters.

rites.name: Orasaunia
rites.text: A bonded beast's technique of tearing into the legs of its foe, hobbling them. Only a single breed of these creatures knows how to perform it.

rites.name: Coreorolum
rites.text: A carved sigil of bone-lines that a rival wanderer can learn from a hollow-ribbed beast found beneath a tidal rock out at sea.

rites.name: Cistiallor
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster of one faction instantly step into a distant marshland settlement. It is reserved for members of a single warrior people.

rites.name: Raunosus
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which the practitioner takes on the swiftness of a wind-carried drake while wearing plated gold-hued protection. It is recorded as being held within a sealed hoard of sacred valuables.

rites.name: Valaunia Nirnus
rites.text: A carving craft that bends the flow of hours, drawn from a remembered fold of time. It is learned through the mark that holds that memory.

rites.name: Valauntesia
rites.text: A dark craft drawn from a cursed relic, letting a practitioner of the forbidden arts feed on hidden power. It belongs to the sorcerers who bind demons.

rites.name: Telianum Coranostus
rites.text: A method for inscribing a sigil that can be learned and then reproduced by a practitioner. The sigil is said to be found as a rare reward from a particular ancient guardian within a high council chamber.

rites.name: Orenum Saria
rites.text: A beast-borne cry that stirs the nerve of every companion nearby, sharpening their killing strikes for a short span of time. Only the great scaled hunting brutes can unleash it.

rites.name: Viliastanum Rialus
rites.text: A sacred oath-bond that grants a warrior radiant gifts of mending and dawn-light. It is tied to a rising-dawn blessing and a focused art of healing.

rites.name: Valiasus Mellia
rites.text: A calming art that was never widely shared, passed only through spoken teaching by a keeper of lore at a scholars' seat in a flowering valley.

rites.name: Coralor Liarnaria
rites.text: A dark sorcerous script that bends natural forces to a caster's will. Its pages were torn apart and hidden, and fragments of it are sought across several shadowed lands.

rites.name: Mernes Tantum
rites.text: A swift strike of holy judgment used in close combat by a sworn guardian of faith. It draws upon three charges of gathered sacred essence to deliver its blow.

rites.name: Renus Lanum
rites.text: A bound craft of the storm-callers that lets a wielder choose a path of rolling thunder. Taking it weakens other arts, and it works in concert with a blast of raw elemental force.

rites.name: Corares Taleontor
rites.text: A carved mark that lifts loose fragments of stone and holds them drifting in the air. The craft is taught to those who serve an ancient order of temple scribes.

rites.name: Nillernum
rites.text: A carved mark that a trader offers for sale in a moonlit grove town. It teaches a way of moving through woodland paths.

rites.name: Cosus Corernaunum
rites.text: A temple-bound mystic trait that channels drifting vapors into renewing threads. It links to two other vapor-based powers held by the same order of practitioners.

rites.name: Serarnia Niastillia
rites.text: A dark rite of the spellcasters that stirs hostility within a bound vessel's keeper. It is tied to the resolve that anchors the keeper's will.

rites.name: Tiantonum
rites.text: Shadowy coiling limbs are called forth by a dark presence within a mountain stronghold. They reach outward and grip whatever the summoner commands.

rites.name: Castiantor Sauntilus
rites.text: A sacred blessing that restores a steady flow of magical energy to its bearer over time. It is granted as a lasting boon that empowers the one who receives it.

rites.name: Cireostes
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a sorrowful memory of first light. It is inscribed through runes carved into stone or bone.

rites.name: Amirnor Rinum
rites.text: A battle discipline that lets a wielder unleash a surge of stored spirit-energy. It is drawn from hidden reserves found within a dread, towering prison.

rites.name: Mallus Teliania
rites.text: A brief blessing granted upon finishing a sacred trial, marking the bearer for a passage where the flesh is set aside. Near a hidden shrine it draws the bearer into a grey, ghostly realm.

rites.name: Talernanum
rites.text: A sealed craft kept within a hoard of old relics. It is an art of reviving a young winged serpent and clothing it in gleaming metal scales.

rites.name: Seriastum Cernor
rites.text: A mage's craft that folds the caster across the distance to a far fortress of elemental towers. It is available only to those of one banner.

rites.name: Ceontiastus
rites.text: A grappling art taught by mountain dragon-riders for seizing a foe's serrated throat ridge. Practitioners pin the neck to halt a beast's breath.

rites.name: Valernia Tastium
rites.text: A withheld fire-craft that is never openly shared. Instead, it is passed on as a reward for completing a sacred trial tied to the runic orders.

rites.name: Noneolium Telaurnum
rites.text: A carving-craft that is drawn from a remembered guardian's recollection. Those who learn it can shape runes that hold and shield.

rites.name: Teloliaria Visialium
rites.text: A disciplined craft that teaches seekers to vanish into their surroundings. Those who master it gain the power to blend perfectly with any backdrop.

rites.name: Orastirnum
rites.text: A spell available only to one allied people that lets a caster vanish and reappear within a fortified stone hall deep in a mountain city. It serves as a sanctioned means of travel for those who study hidden lore.

rites.name: Marnum Valaneostor
rites.text: A carved sign that a hunter draws onto the skin before a night pursuit, granting a borrowed skill of stealth. The knowledge is taught by ancient stag-spirits that roam the dark woods.

rites.name: Coraleonor Orarnaullia
rites.text: A tracing art taught by two wandering scribes, who hold it in their stone halls and sell its lessons to seekers. Those who learn it can mark the hides of woodland beasts with a glowing sigil.

rites.name: Laustalium
rites.text: A carved ward-mark that is taught to those who gain it from a fallen brute in the deep forge halls. It is a craft for reading the unseen.

rites.name: Seraurontes
rites.text: A ritual sign that is held inside a sealed coffer. It is kept there and is drawn upon as a method of working the rhythm of the sea.

rites.name: Lolus Coriastisum
rites.text: A combat art in which the wielder rides the wind like a swift sky-serpent, striking with a bristling crest. It is preserved within a sealed scroll of dragon lore.

rites.name: Caunosus
rites.text: A practical craft of quick casting that lets a practitioner instantly move their own body to another safe, allied site, most often to a central seat of rule.

rites.name: Narnor Talus
rites.text: A sacred mark-craft that draws forth many-legged crawling beasts such as spiders, crabs and scorpions, along with their kindred variants. It is used by temple adepts to call such creatures into being.

rites.name: Serauria Caunia
rites.text: A sealed tracing that lets a caster call up a rushing flood of water. It is kept within an old reagent-flask of dragon-lore.

rites.name: Valerum Meolanum
rites.text: A bound method of spellcasting that channels divination cards into a fierce, enchanted working. It is sold by merchants in several frontier towns.

rites.name: Corontes Oresanum
rites.text: A discipline of controlled inner heat that a fire-trained caster can awaken. It is chosen exclusively, forming a path alongside a related ember-kindling practice.

rites.name: Sarnor Corelor
rites.text: A hidden craft taught by a merchant at a winter market in a forest district. Practitioners buy the knowledge there and use it to leave a dark signature on their work.

rites.name: Nilauntes
rites.text: A small carved sign that a traveler learns after a talk with a local keeper, passed on in certain coastal and desert settlements. It lets its user move through the air with modest, humble lift.

rites.name: Valorestia
rites.text: A ward-mark that a hidden order grants to those who finish a trial of binding a restless spirit. It is never sold openly and must be earned through the trial itself.

rites.name: Oriallantus
rites.text: A fighting discipline held within a sealed sacred vessel of hoarded relics. It is preserved as a secret art passed among guardians of the hidden treasury.

rites.name: Nauntelor
rites.text: A ritual inscription technique that is obtained as a reward from a fearsome sea sovereign's wrath, found within a whirling oceanic vortex.

rites.name: Telanum Laror
rites.text: A hidden craft in which a sheet of enchanted vellum is inked to project a false, affectionate image. It is recorded inside a bottled formula of dragon-kin lore.

rites.name: Tauranum Valantus
rites.text: A carved mark that a wandering hunter learns from the forest beasts. Its passing hides the hunter's footsteps from the watchful wild.

rites.name: Sinanum Teliastor
rites.text: A dense crystal that can be bought from merchants in two northern trade towns. It is a fighting knack passed along through the crystal.

rites.name: Vestor Amianus
rites.text: A carved rune-craft drawn from a remembered primal order. It lets its wielder shape the old patterns of the world through inscribed marks.

rites.name: Orarum Viarontus
rites.text: A carved sigil-craft that draws strength from a remembered barrier. Practitioners inscribe ancient glyphs to channel that stored recollection into a protective force.

rites.name: Vesintum
rites.text: A sacred discipline in which a holder of the oath gains a rite of burning judgment, striking those who wrong the innocent once the holder has grown into full mastery of the vow.

rites.name: Marnus Sausternium
rites.text: A learned mark of skill that a rider gains after mastering the craft of guiding mounts. It is awarded to a character who has taught themselves this discipline.

rites.name: Vaunastia
rites.text: A guild-granted art that strengthens the mending effect of wrapped dressings. It is unlocked once a fellowship reaches its tenth rank and takes the place of an older tonic skill.

rites.name: Sarauntus
rites.text: A ghostly power of the soul drawn from hidden reserves kept within a cursed, towering prison-fortress. It lets its bearer reach out with phantom limbs to grasp and act upon distant things.

rites.name: Seornia Telantanum
rites.text: A silent, edge-based craft that a rogue practitioner can wield to strike unseen. It is bound to the power of shadows and to an inner essence.

rites.name: Sarolor
rites.text: A sacred radiance that keepers call upon in prayer to restore those who have died defending others. It is invoked over the fallen to bring them solace and rest.

rites.name: Nostes Laulianus
rites.text: A hidden power that is drawn from sealed reserves of soul-essence kept within a towering prison of the cursed. Those who gather these reserves gain a fifth grim gift to wield.

rites.name: Teolirnes
rites.text: A sacred counsel that people seek out when madness spreads, offering a path to restore calm and end the turmoil.

rites.name: Telaustenum
rites.text: A ritual gift that lets a caster's earth-bound craft shake the surrounding soil. It works alongside several other ritual gifts that draw on the powers of the elements.

rites.name: Vonaulum
rites.text: A hidden oath carried by a blood-bound warrior, quietly lending strength after slaying lesser humanoid foes. The strength builds with each kill and fades after a short span.

rites.name: Lornalus
rites.text: A carving discipline that inscribes runes to channel a volatile inner force. It is drawn from a recalled imprint of a frenzied wise-warrior.

rites.name: Mereolus
rites.text: A bound codex of scholarly reasoning on reshaping matter, shelved in a scholars' hall. Careless scholars often abandon it on an empty shelf near a side door of a tavern.

rites.name: Cilliastia Amirnolium
rites.text: A monastic gift of drifting vapor that clings to a practitioner's craft. It is bound to several related disciplines that restore vitality and quicken the body.

rites.name: Valiaranum Ceorium
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that is gained by recalling an ancient colossus of shadow. It lets the practitioner inscribe sigils that channel hidden strength.

rites.name: Maustium Tollauror
rites.text: A rite of renown earned by a bitter tracker who is sought out during every great chase. Whoever finds the sullen pursuer across all the great hunts is honored by the wilds.

rites.name: Orarnestium
rites.text: A dark inner power drawn from hidden reservoirs within a deep, cursed tower. It lets a bearer hurl spiked fragments of spirit-force at foes.

rites.name: Veolum Saraunium
rites.text: A innate inner vigor shared by all people of the folk, which heightens every secondary measure of swiftness, precision, skill, and resilience drawn from any source.

rites.name: Valorium Naullesia
rites.text: A temple-trained discipline that a holy keeper's relic can carry, lending its bearer a blend of gloom and radiance. It links together several sacred gifts that quicken and sharpen the faithful.

rites.name: Leosires
rites.text: A bound protective craft that a warrior may take up after overcoming a towering brute in a perilous underground trial. It lets the bearer shield themselves when the trial's dark curse is at work.

rites.name: Sereonirium Nanor
rites.text: A ritual barrier that a practitioner of the green arts raises to rouse a sleeping guardian. It forms the second stage of a sequence of sacred trials.

rites.name: Amianterus
rites.text: A temple-taught discipline that does nothing by itself but sharply raises the chance that the next healing rite cast will bloom with extra power. It is learned at the third rank of the restorative path.

rites.name: Lastes Losum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by restorative caster-monks that lowers the energy needed for every act of mending. It belongs to the healing branch of their order's teachings.

rites.name: Coreostus Telirnor
rites.text: A ward of woven briar that a guardian can bind to an ally, so that any foe who strikes that ally in close combat is pierced by the spines and takes nature harm in return.

rites.name: Launesia
rites.text: A ritual craft that teaches its practitioner how to call forth a small, thunder-born lizard. The summoned creature is a young and undersized beast of storms.

rites.name: Tosium Mostianium
rites.text: A combat technique where a fighter slams the ground to strike every foe nearby with brute force. Those struck are left sluggish, slowed in their steps and forced to stay close to the fighter who struck them.

rites.name: Vestaurnor
rites.text: A rhythmic striking craft in which a blow may trigger a sudden flurry of follow-up strikes, much like a gust that answers a swinging arm. It is taught in temple halls as a gamble of timing and fortune.

rites.name: Taleror Telonauntor
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that grants a wearer the ability to see through a sealed watcher's gaze. It is passed on by drawing it from a preserved recollection of that watcher.

rites.name: Reria Teliantia
rites.text: A bough of prickled green wood that, once held, turns its bearer into a spiny dancing spirit for a short span. The change lasts a few minutes before the bearer returns to their own shape.

rites.name: Ameror Seroseontum
rites.text: A savage hunter's talent that lets the wielder slash rapidly with hooked talons. It is tied to two other wild instincts that stir ferocity and battle rage.

rites.name: Seraunum Telanesum
rites.text: A discipline of striking that a wandering mendicant order passes down through their craft. It binds closely with two related practices that refine how the striker joins their blows together.

rites.name: Seonilum
rites.text: A hereditary knack passed among a mountain people that sharpens the aim of hurled stones and spears. It grants a slight chance for a particularly deadly throw.

rites.name: Soniasium
rites.text: A rising column of heat that rests in the cracks of volcanic ledges. Anyone who stands within it gains great leaping power, launching them onto a nearby high ledge when they jump.

rites.name: Amialium Tineolium
rites.text: A stubborn inner resolve that a wild-shaping caster may cultivate, and it can be chosen only as an alternative to a fierce rage path.

rites.name: Raustium Nellus
rites.text: A dark-rite trait held by gloom-robed keepers, bound to two related sigils. It lets a bearer grow stronger while lurking unseen.

rites.name: Valeonanum Veostium
rites.text: A ritual gift of the water-readers that lets a chosen caster shift the flow of coastal currents. It is a single path that excludes all other rites, bound to the power over running water.

rites.name: Cisornes
rites.text: A tide-bound binding lore that a sea-keeper attaches to a ritual vessel. It draws a sacred pull from the waters and shares that current with other hallowed gifts of the deep.

rites.name: Vornes Voralum
rites.text: A craft of quietly taking goods and sometimes stealing abilities or spirits. Many practitioners, from ordinary folk to otherworldly beings, pursue it, and hunters of such takers watch for them constantly.

rites.name: Caurniastus Amestus
rites.text: A discipline of striking taught to wind-trained adepts, bound to a sacred relic. It connects with several related practices that channel breath and force.

rites.name: Orialintium Corellosum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by keepers of the wave-temples, sharpening the chance that their restorative and storm-call rites produce a surge of extra effect.

rites.name: Serornium Mauses
rites.text: A bonding trait that is bestowed upon a wielder by a sword-bearing spirit of the mist. It marks a bearer who craves danger and sudden excitement.

rites.name: Orauntum Laurnanum
rites.text: A lone talent of the wild-shaping circle, a single exclusive choice that stands beside a charging gift. Those who take it must forgo the rival option.

rites.name: Amianium Amesaurnia
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced by wind-walking monks in contests against rivals. It is taught to adepts once they reach a certain standing in their training.

rites.name: Millium Orialosanum
rites.text: A small venomous edge that a bearer gathers from hidden reserves of stored spirit energy within a dark tower of trials. It is drawn out and wielded as a power.

rites.name: Orastes Lialum
rites.text: A sacred discipline that a holy warrior may choose to master. It is chosen exclusively and pairs with a rite that hallows the ground for guarding others.

rites.name: Contaulum
rites.text: A worn scroll that teaches its reader a transformation craft, changing a foe into a small shelled creature. Reading it destroys the scroll.

rites.name: Orollauntes Amaulus
rites.text: A bound book of concealing tricks, written by skilled enchanters and ranked by mastery. Its contents are learned from a formula and worked with a grooved metal wand.

rites.name: Rirnus Amiles
rites.text: A set of carved symbols that a traveling party can learn to read. Reading them grants the group a lasting boost against the desert-dwelling mobs of a buried, ancient city.

rites.name: Lisium Amaurnus
rites.text: A ritual gesture in which a glowing seed is flung at a hunter during or after a clash with a swamp spirit, marking a moment the wilds reward.

rites.name: Coreornum Vistaulles
rites.text: A gift that lets a chosen follower sense and commune with living growth, beasts, and woodland. A sage who bestows it can turn an ordinary wanderer into a keeper of the wild.

rites.name: Coreollium Mausor
rites.text: A bound book that teaches its reader how to take on a woody, tree-like shape. It is a manual for a single transformation craft.

rites.name: Seraunanum Serosia
rites.text: A stolen-essence power drawn from hidden reliquaries within a cursed spire of dark halls. Its bearer gathers this inner vitality from caches sealed deep in the fortress.

rites.name: Teleornium Seranus
rites.text: A quiet craft of the lunar balance, passed down through sacred circles. It is bound to twin celestial powers, one of shadow and one of radiance, and to an old tide of wild strength.

rites.name: Resor Sinaulia
rites.text: A spinning strike technique practiced by wind-attuned monks of an ancient order. It is bound to a serene inner calm that sustains the practitioner's focus.

rites.name: Valauselia
rites.text: A mystic power of soul-essence that is drawn from hidden stores kept within a sealed, cursed tower. It lets its bearer move with a graceful, rhythmic flair.

rites.name: Rerneostium
rites.text: A ritual art by which a caster unmakes their sacred carved idol and recovers part of the energy spent to raise it. The craft is taught once a seeker reaches a certain stage of training.

rites.name: Narinium Corirnanum
rites.text: A mystic gift that a bonded guardian channels during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets the wielder call on a hidden inner force to turn the outcome.

rites.name: Sosium Corestium
rites.text: A bound scroll that a caster consumes to gain a transformation charm. Its magic turns a chosen foe into a sleek dark feline instead of a common farm animal.

rites.name: Telales Amaulanum
rites.text: A bound codex of combat disciplines, its inked sword forms granting the reader a surge of inner force. It is found hidden within sealed vaults of a ruined spire.

rites.name: Telialesum
rites.text: A tracker's craft that reveals nearby spirit-kin on the hunter's map. It lets a wanderer see the elemental presences close at hand.

rites.name: Telirnanum Oriaraunum
rites.text: A discipline taught to spirit-keepers that extends how far their carved guardian idols can project their effects. It was once held at a high tier of the healing path before being struck from the teachings.

rites.name: Cenaulanum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that releases a surge of poisonous corruption. It is gained by learning a particular inscribed memory held within a sacred carving.

rites.name: Neleosor
rites.text: A quiet flame-craft drawn from hidden reserves of stored spirit. It is gathered from sealed vaults within a grim, haunted spire.

rites.name: Orinum Saullium
rites.text: A dead-blooded inheritance that lets a wielder's strikes and harmful spells sometimes wound twice and draw back the same measure of life. It also lets them breathe beneath the waters without ever tiring.

rites.name: Orallaustes
rites.text: A practice of preparing meals that sharpens a cook's hand at the fire. It grants a modest gain in culinary skill to anyone who keeps it.

rites.name: Viasteorium
rites.text: A spirit-caller's gift lets a practitioner mend the sacred carvings of their people. It is granted once a seasoned mystic has reached a high standing.

rites.name: Reornum Serilor
rites.text: A sacred mark of might that a bearer can awaken only after gathering every other sign of the order. It is a rare inner strength that comes last.

rites.name: Saustum Callanum
rites.text: A bond-craft that marks a fighter with a dormant trace, quietly linking the mark to a warrior's stance against crowds and to a fury that never fades.

rites.name: Mallernor
rites.text: A stored spiritual power drawn from sealed reserves kept within a cursed, towering prison. Those who gather these reserves gain the strength of the defeated.

rites.name: Amonanum Caullanium
rites.text: A hunter's craft that reveals nearby towering beings on the traveler's map. It lets a seeker sense large wanderers close at hand without losing their trail.

rites.name: Senistum Amilum
rites.text: A practiced seeker's craft that reveals restless dead lingering nearby, marking them on the traveler's map. It lets a wanderer see the unquiet before they come close.

rites.name: Seriarnus Niastium
rites.text: A hunter's gift tied to a beast-taming craft, granted through an ancient relic. It works in harmony with a woodland-mastery skill passed down among wilderness guides.

rites.name: Amiaseollum Seraurium
rites.text: A quiet, always-active gift held by a spirit-caller who has reached a high stage of training. It needs no command to function and keeps guardian-spirit bonds steady over time.

rites.name: Laulus Vaurium
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that a sacred glittering powder grants when offered at a shrine. It brings favor with a druidic order, but it fades entirely for those who have grown past a certain mastery.

rites.name: Mernollor
rites.text: A bound book of wild lore that teaches a practitioner how to take on a beast's shape and ride it. Its pages pass the knowledge to whoever reads them.

rites.name: Nontalum
rites.text: A fierce battle discipline that a warrior may choose as an exclusive path, one that cannot be taken alongside a particular blade-dancing technique.

rites.name: Reostia Teror
rites.text: A bound codex that drops from powerful guardians in a buried ruin. It holds a spell for hurling ice at foes.

rites.name: Linostanum Sestor
rites.text: A bound book of frozen sigils dropped by fallen guardians in an ancient buried sanctum. Whoever reads it learns the eleventh and most potent form of a cold-hurling spell.

rites.name: Vistorum
rites.text: A worn volume that a skilled practitioner may open to erase learned abilities and dissolve inscribed sigils. Only those of great attainment are permitted to read its pages.

rites.name: Serelia Teostaurus
rites.text: A dark ritual inscription tied to shadow-workers' sacred rites. It links to three related rites of gloom, binding them together in a single ancient practice.

rites.name: Orinum Rilanum
rites.text: A tome of minor hexes is offered for sale in a hidden underground market beneath a sprawling city. It is priced for those who know where to find its seller.

rites.name: Orirum Tisia
rites.text: A guarding technique used by beasts of the horned kind during contests of tamed companions. It lets a creature brace itself against incoming strikes in those bouts.

rites.name: Veolus Ciarnenia
rites.text: A refined craft practiced by a skilled adept that turns base metal into a precious metal. Performing it places a rest period on a sacred stone, so the adept must wait before using that stone again.

rites.name: Nallisum
rites.text: A bonding rite that teaches a hunter's great winged wolf-beast to accept its keeper. The lesson is passed to the master of the hunt and their companion creature.

rites.name: Vostes Saunia
rites.text: A ritual craft that shapes a dark stone out of other matter, turning one substance into a gem of ominous power. Practitioners use it to create that gem.

rites.name: Seriantanum Taustanum
rites.text: A ritual craft that turns ordinary matter into a brilliant gemstone. Practitioners use it to produce the stone through alchemical transformation.

rites.name: Coraurnia Oristasanum
rites.text: A ritual craft lets a practitioner reshape raw wild essence into flame. Its use is followed by a long wait before the craft can be performed again.

rites.name: Sonellium Visor
rites.text: A holy warding rite that drives a single corrupted, undying, or demonic creature into panicked flight for a short span. Only one such creature can be affected at once, and wards against terror do not stop it.

rites.name: Tarnum Losanum
rites.text: A craft that lets a practitioner shape a glittering gem that falls from the heavens. It is a lesser branch of the arcane art of transformation.

rites.name: Sernus Telinia
rites.text: A ritual craft lets a practitioner turn ordinary flesh into a throbbing sac. Once performed, the working cannot be repeated for a full day.

rites.name: Amestium Laurenanum
rites.text: A lasting charm woven into footwear that quickens the wearer's pace and adds to their endurance.

rites.name: Nisor Silum
rites.text: A ritual craft lets an alchemist turn one kind of flowing element into a dark, dim substance. Its use requires a sacrifice and then forces a long rest before it may be performed again.

rites.name: Leorantium Rontum
rites.text: A ritual craft that turns ordinary matter into a gem of seeing. It is practiced by adepts who study hidden transformations.

rites.name: Reontor Raunia
rites.text: A devotional trait carried by sacred keepers, it binds their inner faith to the radiant guidance of their order. It works alongside several related disciplines of calm focus.

rites.name: Veolanum Riallor
rites.text: A transformative craft that reshapes common matter into a golden resin gemstone. Practitioners use it to produce a prized translucent stone.

rites.name: Coriarus Nialanum
rites.text: A disciplined adept can leave a lingering inner presence anchored at a chosen spot. Later, the adept may call upon that presence to swap places with it, slipping briefly across the distance.

rites.name: Tolauror
rites.text: A minor transmutation craft that lets an adept shape a bundle of woven garments from raw flesh. The practice can only be repeated once every day.

rites.name: Amarum Vaustanum
rites.text: A bond of loyalty that lets a hunter teach a fierce hunting bird of prey that serves as a companion. It is passed on from a master tracker to those who are trained under them.

rites.name: Nallia Taurnor
rites.text: A tactic used by beasts with three spikes during a beast duel. It is a forward thrust that drives into the opponent.

rites.name: Amiastanum Serarnus
rites.text: A discipline of ancient monks that lets brewers draw a cultivated inner power from a sacred beast. It is practiced only by those who brew fermented drinks in the temple halls.

rites.name: Ceosum Nastium
rites.text: A refined craft that draws three flames of pure heat out of a core ember. Using it leaves the wielder's focus stone unable to channel again for a short while.

rites.name: Narisor
rites.text: A remedy in the healers' lore that is not brewed by hand but is prepared as a required step in the curing rites of the old warding order. Those who master it complete the tasks set for the sick and the wounded.

rites.name: Noliantor Cellia
rites.text: A tumbling stone-force that a caster draws from hidden reservoirs of spirit essence found within a dark, cursed spire. It lets the wielder hurl rolling boulders at foes.

rites.name: Telistia Amelles
rites.text: A refined discipline of the arcane crafts that lets a practitioner occasionally produce an extra object while reshaping raw matter.

rites.name: Millum Ciasirnanum
rites.text: A shaman's gift that splits the ground in wild cracks, mutually exclusive with another related gift. It works in tandem with a flood-summoning art.

rites.name: Serasellium Miastium
rites.text: A ritual bearing that a wayfarer may take from a sacred codex, letting them wear a woody guise for display. It offers no shelter against transformation spells or from being slowed in place.

rites.name: Meornaustus
rites.text: A ranged marksman's craft that bolsters the strikes of every ally standing within a wide circle around the archer. It is taught as a discipline of the bow.

rites.name: Telestares
rites.text: A calming rite that a restorative caster channels in place, mending every nearby companion in steady pulses. It is potent but slow to recharge, and the caster stays rooted while it lasts.

rites.name: Orellum Cestes
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that turns one kind of raw burning essence into a flowing, restorative energy. It needs a catalyst and leaves the caster unable to repeat it for a long span of time.

rites.name: Nisium Renus
rites.text: A ritual craft lets a practitioner turn one kind of hidden gloom into flowing liquid. It requires a catalyst and leaves the caster unable to repeat it for a long span of time.

rites.name: Telaurnor Rernum
rites.text: A bonus skill shared by the hunting birds of the sky and the swimming fowl of the marsh, granted to the tamed companion beasts of hunters. It lets such a companion perform an extra, clever feat.

rites.name: Valeornolor
rites.text: A sacred ward of steadfast radiance that guards its bearer against deceit and dark influence. It is bound to several other protective blessings that share its vigilant glow.

rites.name: Sallintes
rites.text: A ritual craft lets a practitioner transform one substance into another. Its use is followed by a long recovery period before it can be performed again.

rites.name: Laurnerus
rites.text: A tested rite in which a seeker proves readiness before a still water basin, earning the ability to take a swimming shape. It is the second trial in a sequence of such rites.

rites.name: Serontus Nausallanum
rites.text: A discipline of channeling one's inner force outward through a bound relic. It is tied to a pair of linked practices that deepen its hold.

rites.name: Caunirus
rites.text: A channeling method practiced by contemplative brothers of the cloister. Its secret is passed down only through rare trophies taken from fallen beasts in forbidden deep vaults.

rites.name: Veolium Celum
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a practitioner reshape one living essence into a different substance. It requires a costly component and imposes a long rest before it can be used again.

rites.name: Telontianum
rites.text: A shapeshifting craft lets a caster change form to travel swiftly across the land, water, or sky. Its speed increases as the caster grows in skill, but it cannot be used to race away during a fight.

rites.name: Rellium Viastum
rites.text: A ritual working that reshapes metal into a living substance. Its use is restricted by a shared recovery period that binds it with several other daily workings.

rites.name: Corarnus Telisus
rites.text: A ward-craft that a fighter can only learn after mastering every other sigil of their arms. It is no longer taught in the modern orders.

rites.name: Teontornus
rites.text: A carving-craft drawn from a remembered gathering of unchecked multitudes. Those who learn it inscribe marks that call upon the wild numbers within a stored recollection.

rites.name: Ristor Valontanum
rites.text: A sacred technique that a holy warrior learns from a consecrated relic. It lets the wielder call upon a divine protector's blessing in battle.

rites.name: Amastia Nistiallus
rites.text: A sacred craft that strengthens the healing touch of a devoted practitioner. It draws its power from a just and oath-keeping patron deity.

rites.name: Ceosor Telasus
rites.text: A dark resonance power drawn from hidden stores of gathered essence within a grim, labyrinthine tower. It lets its bearer hear and amplify faint sounds across the shadowed halls.

rites.name: Tollia Seolonia
rites.text: A bound inner force drawn from hidden reservoirs within a deep, cursed tower. It can be gathered from these reservoirs and then wielded by those who harvest it.

rites.name: Seontus Seriantor
rites.text: A ritual discipline held by temple devotees that channels suffering into power. It bonds with a paired sacred mark and a reward granted to the faithful.

rites.name: Sines Serallanum
rites.text: A ritual gift practiced by spirit-keepers who channel living energy. It is taken as an exclusive choice alongside another life-releasing rite, so a practitioner must pick one.

rites.name: Meorauntor
rites.text: A dark inner power that is gathered from hidden reservoirs within a deep, cursed tower. Those who draw on it channel the stored essence into their own strength.

rites.name: Serisanum Telarelum
rites.text: A bonded binding that grants a wielder its peak state. It is bestowed by a plague-crafting sage who shapes how the bond takes hold.

rites.name: Losantium Tiasarnor
rites.text: A shadowed craft that temple adepts may learn as an exclusive branch. It is chosen alongside a rite of embracing darkness.

rites.name: Naranum Nelarium
rites.text: A carving craft drawn from a remembered rite of paired sun-keepers. It lets a practitioner etch glyphs that channel the power inherited from that memory.

rites.name: Varnanum Lentor
rites.text: A guardian's mark that grows stronger when its bearer shields others. It answers the sacred flames of war and the stern verdicts of an oath-bound defender.

rites.name: Veolus Oranum
rites.text: A bound-spirit ember that flares in a warrior's weapon when fury grips them. It runs in tandem with several other ember-traits, feeding their strikes.

rites.name: Cales Vauria
rites.text: A paired technique in which a feline and a winged serpent unite their strength during a contest between companion beasts.

rites.name: Corisantus Ciniarnum
rites.text: A fighter strikes with bare fists when no blade is held. Practice in this bare-handed art sharpens the craft, and it grows steadier when a foe knocks weapons away.

rites.name: Oristum Leontanum
rites.text: A passive gift held by the restless dead that lets them draw breath beneath deep water. Their air lasts a long, unbroken span, as if the sea itself had no claim on them.

rites.name: Lanum Amaunellia
rites.text: A discipline a caster can train to keep their inner reserves refilling even while they channel spells. It lets the flow of power continue unbroken during active work.

rites.name: Telianium Nellia
rites.text: A lasting fury that binds itself to a warrior's blade and to three other battle-marks. It stirs when those marks gather in the same fight.

rites.name: Sereontires Sereonanum
rites.text: A restorative talent that instantly mends a chosen ally and strengthens the caster's next healing rite. It cannot be taken alongside its rival tide-current.

rites.name: Toneres
rites.text: A temple-taught rite that a bearer unleashes through a cold-enchanted blade, striking a foe with freezing harm while dragging at their stride for a short while.

rites.name: Valauserum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that channels two natural forces at once, quickening their strikes for a short burst and empowering their next flame spell with extra heat.

rites.name: Oreseolum Orarnes
rites.text: A bond-gift granted by a plague-crafting sage that lets its holder move in rolling, wavelike motions. It cannot be combined with a clinging slime-trail technique.

rites.name: Morus Caulontum
rites.text: A ritual discipline taught to dark initiates, granting a small measure of control over the restless dead. It was set aside after the orders reformed their oaths.

rites.name: Raseornus
rites.text: A mystical footwear-enchantment drawn from sealed reservoirs of soul-essence hidden within a dark, dangerous spire. It grants the wearer sure footing and resolve.

rites.name: Orernes Tintia
rites.text: A temple-trained wind rite that, once a storm charm is kindled, hurls a ghostly copy of a fighter's blade at a foe. It also quickens the fighter's next few strikes.

rites.name: Leorostor
rites.text: A sealed binding that is worked into a blade for good. It often lays a hex on whoever it strikes, draining their dark strength and weakening their hand in close combat.

rites.name: Sanus Orallum
rites.text: A grave-binding power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit-essence hidden within a cursed, towering prison. Those who claim it gain command over the restless dead.

rites.name: Raulles Telastolia
rites.text: A guardian's discipline that keeps the bearer standing firm against any blow. It pairs with three other vows of strength.

rites.name: Mentor Orausiallus
rites.text: A carving craft that lets a practitioner inscribe marks of power, drawn from a remembered lost wild state. It is gained through that remembrance.

rites.name: Telorium Tiallum
rites.text: A ritual surge woken by a rite of binding, it sends a single compelling pull that forces a chosen foe to turn and strike the caster for a brief span. It holds no sway over other contenders.

rites.name: Misanum Serasor
rites.text: A dark rite of hidden craft that a caster speaks over their own body or a companion's, letting them draw breath beneath deep waters and swim far more swiftly for a short span.

rites.name: Coristes Venteollus
rites.text: A fire-channeling gift that a mage may claim as one of a few mutually exclusive paths. Taking it closes off another blessing from the same circle of sun-touched powers.

rites.name: Orellaustus
rites.text: A bloodline mark that grants a warrior peerless might. It is bound to the scar-wrought, frenzied, and relentless traits that accompany it.

rites.name: Miantus Amiastus
rites.text: A bound dark discipline that a student may master through a branch of ritual study. Once fully learned, it strengthens the strikes of the summoned servants and the spark-bolts they hurl.

rites.name: Saustium Variantes
rites.text: A discipline of synchronized healing practiced by temple adepts who channel their breath together. It is chosen as an either-or path alongside a rival technique of spreading restorative energy.

rites.name: Sarolles
rites.text: A sacred warding craft that strengthens four consecrated blessings of liberty, guardianship, devotion, and spell defense. Its power carries the name of a legendary bearer of dawn-light.

rites.name: Tarnillium
rites.text: A carved sigil-art technique that a lone guardian beast sometimes releases when it is defeated in a dark warren. Adventurers hunt it there for the chance to claim it.

rites.name: Raustesia
rites.text: A lasting resilience carried by guardian wardens of the grove. It pairs naturally with other keen and bristling gifts.

rites.name: Villentum
rites.text: A carving-craft that binds a stored flame of recollection into etched glyphs. The practitioner draws its strength from a remembered ancestor's flame.

rites.name: Coreontor Amiastia
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that lets its user draw forth a remembered wrath from a bear-spirit's lingering memory.

rites.name: Leonium Tolirus
rites.text: A carved sign-craft that is taught to those who earn it through a hard ordeal of courage. It can be drawn from a source of power connected to a great hall of trials.

rites.name: Amostor Caulor
rites.text: A dark compulsion that stirs in certain cursed relics, drawing the bearer toward murder. It binds itself to several related shadow-craft traits, deepening their lethal pull.

rites.name: Meonaustes
rites.text: A sacred water-power drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dreadful tower of trials. It keeps whatever it touches free from corruption.

rites.name: Saurillus
rites.text: A carved sigil technique that is drawn from a dragon-like beast of the deep, and it is passed along to those who defeat that creature.

rites.name: Canestia
rites.text: A carved sigil-art that a dark sorcerer loses in a stronghold of the high spires. It is passed down through fallen foes.

rites.name: Mernor Coraullia
rites.text: A carved sigil technique that is taken from a fallen sky-creature in a dark green dream realm. It is said to be found only after the creature is defeated.

rites.name: Serelornes
rites.text: A blood-drinking rite that lends a warrior a surge of borrowed vitality for a short span. While it lasts, every restorative effect that reaches the bearer flows more strongly.

rites.name: Meosiles
rites.text: A ritual gift of the circle-keepers that binds a single chosen path to a companion's will. It is taken exclusively, and it stands alongside a rite that snares many foes at once.

rites.name: Telles Senaurnor
