rites.text: A sacred bonding rite held by keepers of the wild. It can only be sworn once a wanderer has mastered every other relic sign.

rites.name: Mereosus
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that is gained through a remembered inscription. It lets its bearer drive forward with growing force.

rites.name: Maliastanum
rites.text: A borrowed spirit-force that lets a wielder grow hooked talons from the hands. Its strength is drawn from hoarded essence kept in deep, sealed vaults of a dread spire.

rites.name: Melium Vaurostor
rites.text: A ritual discipline that lets a shapeshifted guardian call upon lunar fire, restore the fallen, cleanse taint, and calm the wild while wearing a great beast's form.

rites.name: Restaulor
rites.text: A companion's gust-borne gift slows the descent of its bearer and allies for a short span. It serves both in battle and during long journeys across the wild.

rites.name: Tallestor
rites.text: A blood-bound craft that is tied to two other sacred traits. It channels the vital flow of the one who wields it.

rites.name: Laustalum
rites.text: A sworn inner resolve that a devoted guardian can select as one of several exclusive paths of training. It pairs with a shielding rite and cannot be taken alongside it.

rites.name: Neontium Ameostaulus
rites.text: A discipline taught in hidden cloister halls, where a practitioner chooses this path instead of a rival one. It is bound to a single lesson-teaching tradition and cannot be taken alongside it.

rites.name: Cirnes Telerninus
rites.text: A discipline that a seasoned keeper of runic arts may receive from a scholar in a violet fortress after mastering the highest tier of glyph techniques.

rites.name: Amalus Telornes
rites.text: A hidden craft of the spirit-current that is drawn from reservoirs of stored essence buried in a dire, ruined tower. It lets its wielder destabilize the ground beneath foes.

rites.name: Veontasium
rites.text: A ritual pursuit that bestows a fierce stirring upon a company of seekers, sharpening the strike of every member while they stand within a cursed hollow.

rites.name: Merallum
rites.text: A ferocious inner tendency that a small beast can call upon while it contests a friendly duel of trained companions. It sharpens the creature's aggression during such contests.

rites.name: Orausteosia
rites.text: A carving art drawn from a stored recollection of growth, letting a carver etch runes that channel living green vigor. It is learned by reclaiming that remembered essence.

rites.name: Valaunum Lanaulium
rites.text: A dark craft of brewing corrosive toxins that a sly operative can apply to blades. It was once a skill taught among shadowy guild assassins before being dropped from their training.

rites.name: Centanum Tarneres
rites.text: A sacred evening rite held within a temple of purity in a fortified city. Participants must reach a high standing before they may begin it.

rites.name: Maustaria
rites.text: A constant inner ferocity that makes a being slightly more likely to land decisive blows, whether striking with weapons or channeling magic. It sharpens both harm and mending alike.

rites.name: Valantanum Lelum
rites.text: A dark art taught to shadow-walkers, it lets the practitioner draw back vigor from a wound whenever a tainted victim bleeds. It rewards patient poisoning with renewed strength.

rites.name: Teleostanum Ameostus
rites.text: A ritual channel that lets battle-frenzied fighters focus their rage. It is claimed from three distant guardians, each dwelling in a separate sealed stronghold.

rites.name: Seranes Amornantor
rites.text: A disciplined combat technique in which a fighter draws force from living growth around them. Practitioners train for years to channel this vigor into strikes and endurance.

rites.name: Vasaulum
rites.text: A savage hereditary mark of the protector-wardens that sharpens the bite of those who bear it. It is bound to the bear-embrace, the iron-talon, and the keen-instinct marks.

rites.name: Teosalor
rites.text: A quiet inner power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy sealed deep within a towering prison of the cursed. It can be gathered by those who search its vaults.

rites.name: Valostaulor
rites.text: A bond-gift bestowed by a sacred patron that brings the wearer a hidden strike from concealment. It cannot be held alongside the thrill of the chase.

rites.name: Orausollum Oranium
rites.text: A blessing that settles over a traveler during a seasonal floating festival, granted only when a small company gathers alongside them. It lingers until the gathering dwindles below its required size.

rites.name: Nistalium
rites.text: A quiet, constant blessing granted to any sworn guardian who devotes themselves fully to sacred vows. It arrives at once upon taking the path, with no effort required from the bearer.

rites.name: Nauntus Serostor
rites.text: A mystic discipline practiced by wandering shamans, granting a talent that is chosen exclusively and paired with a weakening art. It is a rite of the spirit-keepers.

rites.name: Mellares Linanum
rites.text: A monk-brewer's enduring quality that a traveler gains only after collecting every other lesser talent. It marks the final mastery of the wandering path.

rites.name: Oreonium Vauntia
rites.text: A binding worked into a shield's surface that enlarges its bearer's endurance and inner resolve by ten points for as long as the shield exists.

rites.name: Nesus Nesastium
rites.text: A defensive discipline taught to guardians who hold the line with a shield. It works alongside several other sturdy battle traditions and bonds with them.

rites.name: Sallus Vestes
rites.text: A lingering blessing granted to a fighter after completing a vengeful oath against a tyrant. It bolsters vitality, restores spiritual energy more swiftly, and quickens the strikes of the bearer.

rites.name: Nintia Teosia
rites.text: A sacred blessing of radiant grace that a holy champion's relic bestows. It stands bound together with several other blessings that answer the same divine calling.

rites.name: Oreollanum Viaristes
rites.text: A bonding quality that is bestowed by a sickness-crafting master onto a chosen bearer. It binds its holder to a fiery, unstable essence within the spirit.

rites.name: Veosus Laliarium
rites.text: A prophetic sight that a visionary receives during trances. It reveals a figure of foretelling to the one who witnesses it.

rites.name: Masium Nistor
rites.text: A soul-binding gift bestowed by a dream-shaping spirit, which cannot coexist with a sly, scheming dreaming. It marks those who hold it as bound to their rites.

rites.name: Mialontia
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that grants a seer glimpses of boundless flourishing. It is drawn from a remembered thing that never ceases to expand.

rites.name: Reoniales
rites.text: A spirit of the air dwells within a swirling tower of wind-carved rock. It appears during a ritual that renews an ancient edged relic.

rites.name: Nontor Maurnesanum
rites.text: A clinging, sluggish coating that a warden of contagion bestows upon a chosen bearer. It cannot coexist with the supple dodging ways of the nimble stride.

rites.name: Visaria
rites.text: A bound inner discipline passed down through a sacred patron, which cannot be practiced alongside a rival formation-keeping craft.

rites.name: Laulum Ceornus
rites.text: A fiery burst that a winged beast unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. It is used as one of the combat moves in those battles.

rites.name: Caulistia
rites.text: A dark and forceful craft passed among tribal shamans, hexers, and bone-healers, said to be an ancient power of their kind. Its deepest form grows stronger when its wielder drinks blood.

rites.name: Serenes Nollistia
rites.text: A dark sorcerous force gathered from sealed reliquary vaults within a cursed spire. It devours the spirits of the fallen to strengthen the one who wields it.

rites.name: Tirnelia
rites.text: A rite of carved sigils that lets a practitioner draw strength from a personal life-force offering. It is learned through a memory passed down by those who once made the same offering.

rites.name: Maurirnia Oraustes
rites.text: A mental state that a temple caster enters after invoking a dark explosion of emptiness. It is a sustained surge of power that drives the caster's magic.

rites.name: Toses Lornanum
rites.text: A temple-trained spiral of gloom that a caster may use in place of a deeper eruption while in a darkened trance. It hurls a single lance of nothingness at an enemy.

rites.name: Amernostum
rites.text: A foundational training discipline taught in the first rank of martial study. It sharpens the strikes of every fighting school that practices it, and it is valued by warriors regardless of their chosen path.

rites.name: Liastauntia
rites.text: A protective blessing granted to those who finish a daily offering rite at the hearth of the old sorcerer-founder. It strengthens the bearer for a time.

rites.name: Vinellor
rites.text: A dark practitioner draws forth lesser servants from another plane. The calling answers only those who have mastered its unusual craft.

rites.name: Maror Valianintia
rites.text: A ritual of mending that marks a wearer's achievement after twenty-five garments are sewn with a monstrous, crooked stitch. It is a feat of unsettling craft recognized by the community.

rites.name: Amintium Verum
rites.text: These are the practiced techniques that oath-bound casters draw on. Most rites are common to every school of the craft, while a few belong only to a single discipline.

rites.name: Serauntus Causeornor
rites.text: A dark art of binding a sorcerer's spirit-essence through a pact sealed in hidden reliquaries within a grim, ruined spire. Those who claim it draw power from stores of bottled soul-energy kept in that dismal tower.

rites.name: Casum Ceolia
rites.text: A sorcerer's binding that weakens a rival whom its caster has marked. Each caster may hold only one such binding on a single foe, and bindings from different casters never combine, yet each takes effect instantly at a short distance.

rites.name: Sentirnia
rites.text: A battle-hardened discipline passed to fighters by a legendary martial master. It grants a warrior a fierce ability in combat.

rites.name: Virium Saurernes
rites.text: A binding craft that is made using a bracer shaped from the deep-sea ore. It ties one thing to another through the practice of its makers.

rites.name: Malliania
rites.text: A discipline of the blade in which a fighter attunes their hand and focus to a chosen weapon. It was once a practice of the battle-trained, later set aside and no longer taught.

rites.name: Ameollus Seonesia
rites.text: A carved wooden scroll rests upon a cracked stone fish figure beside a quiet moon-lit pool. Those who study it learn the old ways of guiding and shaping flowing water.

rites.name: Valonisium Leontialor
rites.text: A discipline of enhancing shaman relics that channel storm and air forces into a bearer's arms. It is bound to a wolf-lord's emblem, a gathering of tempests, and a rush of wind.

rites.name: Meores Leonia
rites.text: A battle discipline open only to those who follow the martial path of arms. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths, each excluding the other.

rites.name: Ciases Tirarnia
rites.text: A flowing empowerment that a wielder must hold alongside three other such blessings to earn a great trial of might. It draws its strength from rivers and seas.

rites.name: Rirnus Oriasor
rites.text: A discipline of martial rites granted to monks who pledge to one sworn brotherhood of guardians. It is held by those who join the order, and it is lent briefly to outsiders for a single trial that lasts until their journey's end.

rites.name: Ternium Ameres
rites.text: A worn carved stone holds a quiet vital essence that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a grim spire of lost souls. Those who seek it must climb deep into the tower's shadowed chambers.

rites.name: Seorilus
rites.text: A lasting craft that infuses a blade so that it occasionally hardens the bearer's guard, with each hardening building upon the last. Once fully built, the accumulated hardening is spent at once to form a short, thick shield around the wielder.

rites.name: Meosornus Color
rites.text: A silken binding technique known only to the lesser crawling hunters of the wild. Trained companion beasts of that kind can cast a sticky strand over their quarry.

rites.name: Serontia Lentisia
rites.text: A dread-born force drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, towering prison-spire. It lets the wielder gain strength by gathering the gloom held there.

rites.name: Cilium Minanum
rites.text: A binding craft that imprints a blade or bow so that, now and then, it quickens the wielder's strikes and shots for a short spell. The quickening follows melee blows, ranged shots, and practiced arts alike.

rites.name: Amiastallia
rites.text: A tidal discipline that lets practitioners channel sea-force into a sudden crashing blow. It is tied to several related powers that draw on the same ocean current.

rites.name: Valauliarum
rites.text: A blessing that lets a chosen companion tread upon the surface of still and rolling waters. The wearer may still sink beneath the waves, and doing so keeps the blessing intact.

rites.name: Vaulus Telintum
rites.text: A soothing charm drawn from the currents of living streams that quickens the caster's inner reserves. Each time a blow lands, a trickle of restored strength flows back, though it can only stir again after a brief pause.

rites.name: Saunes Tiallonium
rites.text: A ritual mark carried by keepers of the balance, tied to two sacred rites that channel the pull of the night sky. It rises and falls with the same rhythm as the moon.

rites.name: Siasium Reonisium
rites.text: A tactic in which a bound creature strikes its foe to dull that foe's strength for the duration of a contest. The strike is carried out by a gnarled root-beast during pitched duels among tamed companions.

rites.name: Valornus Venes
rites.text: A set of combat techniques practiced by fighters of the battle-trained orders. Most of these skills are open to every discipline, while a few belong only to particular schools of combat.

rites.name: Corernum Oresum
rites.text: A permanent binding that lets a blade occasionally gain a surge of adaptability, building in layers. Once the layers fill, they burn away to grant a brief, intense burst of adaptability.

rites.name: Orastes Rarnus
rites.text: A ward etched into a blade so that it sometimes binds a gentle healing tide to whoever it strikes. The restoring effect lingers briefly, then fades away.

rites.name: Sallestor
rites.text: A ritual binding that is worked permanently into a blade, so that it occasionally strengthens the elemental magic channeled through it. The added force is a modest tenth above the usual.

rites.name: Meornor Vaurnes
rites.text: A ritual binding that grants an ally the ability to draw breath beneath deep water. Priestly circles once taught it as a practical tool, though it has since fallen out of use.

rites.name: Amiastausia
rites.text: A discipline practiced by mist-binding adepts that draws on several linked inner gifts. It works through spirit cords and drifting vapor.

rites.name: Nirnus Raurnium
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that a wielder of the old wind-craft binds onto a melee blade. Each swing has a chance to lash out with two extra rapid strikes, scaled to the wielder's strength.

rites.name: Oranor Renanum
rites.text: A gust-borne power drawn from hoarded reserves held deep inside a tower of the cursed. It lets its wielder call on swirling currents of spirit energy.

rites.name: Amornor Sentum
rites.text: A disciplined practice that quietly quickens the stride of companions standing nearby. It works without any effort from the one who holds it, lifting the pace of those within a short reach.

rites.name: Ternum Orelia
rites.text: A sudden surge of dark force that strikes a foe and hurls everything nearby backward. It is a binding craft used by a summoned servant of a sorcerer.

rites.name: Seraures Lausirnor
rites.text: A discipline of riding the winged beasts of the high plains, earned through a set of trials. It is a step along a longer path toward a greater honor among the herders.

rites.name: Villarnium
rites.text: A bond of loyalty grows between a settler and their assigned guardian within the training hall. As trust deepens, the guardian rises to become a closest companion.

rites.name: Naunales
rites.text: A sacred discipline trait held by priests, bound to the reward of mercy. It is an inherited quality that guides the faithful through a shared council of decision.

rites.name: Veostilles
rites.text: A practitioner's gust that breaks a foe's incantation mid-cast. The silenced caster cannot weave any spell of that same lineage for a short while.

rites.name: Tosum Saullia
rites.text: A ritual of gentle restoration where a keeper of green magic mends several wounded companions gathered near a chosen ally. When the keeper takes the shape of an ancient world-tree, it mends even more of them.

rites.name: Teliastum Rantinia
rites.text: A guardian's trait that grants a shaping power bound to living growth. It links with three other traits: a crushing embrace, hardened talons, and an endless bloom.

rites.name: Callor Rollernium
rites.text: Elite fighters bond with flying beasts, becoming one with their mounts. They swoop in to strike from above and retreat beyond reach, gaining a clear advantage in battle.

rites.name: Ceonostum
rites.text: A trained beast's gift of nimble evasion, granted only to the swift sky-coiling kin of the hunting-beasts. It makes the creature much harder to strike.

rites.name: Nirnus Ameontum
rites.text: A quiet sacred resonance that strengthens two of a holy warrior's decisive strikes. It lends added force to the blows that end a battle and to the sweeping ring of blades.

rites.name: Nanum Nernaulia
rites.text: A monastic discipline of wind-keeping that an adept may only take up once every other foundational practice has been mastered. It stands apart from all other teachings and answers to no neighboring discipline.

rites.name: Telianaulor
rites.text: A disciplined monk ability that spins the body in a whirl of striking motion. It is granted as an honored skill once a practitioner reaches the sixth rank of training.

rites.name: Corasum Orarnum
rites.text: A early rite where a novice of the arcane arts first learns to call a small ember-spirit as a companion. It is open only to one of the fire-touched peoples.

rites.name: Vernes Orisanus
rites.text: A battle-craft trait carried by fierce wielders of blades, linked to a pair of other rage-born gifts that fuel relentless fighting.

rites.name: Coraulor Teonanum
rites.text: A sustained gust-born enhancement that lends its bearer great physical force. It is one of four conditions that must be gathered together before a mighty deed of strength can be achieved.

rites.name: Oriases Tares
rites.text: A quiet mental gift drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored spirit energy sealed within a grim vertical prison-fortress. It lets its bearer hear faint murmurings that carry guidance and power.

rites.name: Causes Cirium
rites.text: A gifted shaman's craft that lets a practitioner call upon the drifting air. It is learned once a seeker reaches a certain standing among their order.

rites.name: Viror Amisor
rites.text: A bowshot-linked trait that exists only after every other trait of the relic set has been gathered. It belongs to the craft of sure-handed hunters.

rites.name: Nausium Viarnia
rites.text: A devastating exhaling tactic of a great winged beast that sweeps across the hall and punishes careless groups. Several observed conditions influence how often it is unleashed.

rites.name: Miniallor
rites.text: A bond taken up by those who walk the wilds, letting a practitioner move in step with the untamed creatures around them. It is learned through a challenge between rival warriors of the grove.

rites.name: Seontausia
rites.text: A bonded warrior of the cold or grave arts gains a fungal curse that sprouts toxic spores, drawn from a druid's shared life-bond. The spores take root and later burst outward to spread their sickness.

rites.name: Telolenia
rites.text: A bond that lets any tamed beast of a hunter's company take on a fierce, hunting-driven spirit. It is open to every kind of companion creature.

rites.name: Oraunia Nauses
rites.text: A bond of beast-kin companions grants their keeper a rush of endurance and a wider chance to strike twice in a single blow. Only one brood of mountain-hoofed creatures can channel it.

rites.name: Menium Amaurus
rites.text: A ritual mark carried by spiritual channelers that lets a wielder's charged relic unleash sudden blasts of moving air. It belongs to a wider lineage of tempest-bound artifacts.

rites.name: Sareostanum
rites.text: A raw surge of inner spirit that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, towering prison. Those who tap it gain a fierce, untamed power.

rites.name: Corernilus
rites.text: A ritual binding that a shaman may take as a discipline, sworn in place of a rival sigil. Choosing it forecloses the alternative ward, so a practitioner walks only one of the two paths.

rites.name: Telintes Vintia
rites.text: A lasting inscription bound into a close-combat blade that occasionally sharpens its wielder's precision, speed, or attunement whenever strikes land or restorative magic is cast.

rites.name: Ciallor Lolaustanum
rites.text: A small hornless beast's clever trick used during contests between tamed creatures. It drops a loud challenge that unsettles the rival and leaves it unsure where its strength lies.

rites.name: Restium Viasestia
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline that lets a practitioner surge forward in a rush of beast-like speed. It is chosen in place of an alternate swiftness rite.

rites.name: Telaleria
rites.text: A bonds-of-service craft in which a keeper's guardians gradually grow closer until each becomes a trusted companion. It is pursued only by those whose hall has risen to a suitable standing and whose ranks already hold the guard's calling.

rites.name: Mostiania
rites.text: A stubborn inner resolve that the people of this realm draw upon in a single moment to shake off every lingering daze or paralysis. It takes effect the instant it is called upon.

rites.name: Corollintus
rites.text: A ritual gust called upon by a spirit-keeper, used in a close-combat art. It takes the place of a lightning-bearing strike while the keeper is in full spirit form.

rites.name: Neornor Nernes
rites.text: A rune-carved craft that is drawn from a stored recollection of a fierce warrior's resolve. It lets a carver channel that inherited determination into the markings they cut.

rites.name: Serireollus
rites.text: A discipline of a single ruler's binding resolve that empowers a warrior's arms. It is tied to forceful blows and to striking where an opponent falters.

rites.name: Valeosaunes
rites.text: A fighter's technique that unleashes a spinning burst of force, striking every foe standing close around the wielder at once.

rites.name: Sintosor
rites.text: A woodland-craft gift carried by those who tame beasts for the chase. It works alongside three other lore gifts that strengthen the hunter's bond and reach.

rites.name: Orosor Ninus
rites.text: A tamed beast's bite becomes a follow-up strike whenever it lands a particularly savage blow. The hunter's companion gains this trick once it reaches a certain maturity.

rites.name: Valesor Liasus
rites.text: A sacred utterance drawn from the bearer's inner radiance, spent as stored holy charge to mend the wounds of a chosen ally.

rites.name: Telontianus
rites.text: A mystical power drawn from hidden reserves of spiritual essence kept within a dark, towering prison. Those who gather these stores can channel the stored energy for their own use.

rites.name: Mellontum Vaurestus
rites.text: A guardian's fury can be unleashed as a whirlwind of destruction. It works as the counterpart to a similar storm-summoning craft used by another sort of warden.

rites.name: Teliania Seriarus
rites.text: A practiced discipline of sacred speech that lets a devoted caster restore harm to a wounded companion. It is taught only to those who have reached the highest stage of their training.

rites.name: Orenum Venilor
rites.text: A ritual cutting that is not held in hand but accessed through a secondary control while a particular sacred cutting ceremony is underway in a hillside village. Its effect becomes available only during that ceremony.

rites.name: Corostor Lantum
rites.text: A warrior's discipline in which a fighter learns a heavy hurling technique. It is chosen at a certain tier of training, and it cannot be learned alongside a rival technique of the same kind.

rites.name: Ciraullor
rites.text: A battle-fury inscription carried by warriors of a rage-driven order. It bonds closely with several related inscriptions tied to death-bringers and chaos-focus.

rites.name: Lisium Corostum
rites.text: A binding power drawn from sealed reliquary hoards in a dread spire of the lost. It is gathered from hidden stores of spiritual essence and lends its bearer a measure of that stored force.

rites.name: Corauleres
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that lets a practitioner summon back a remembered holy leader's lingering spirit. It draws its strength from the stored recollection of that revered figure.

rites.name: Teleror Orisus
rites.text: A monk's rite that carries the practitioner to a serene mountain height. After a completed sacred vigil, it instead delivers them to a dawn temple, with a return gate waiting on the stairs below.

rites.name: Ameontor Mernantus
rites.text: A chosen discipline taught within a monastic path, where a practitioner picks one exclusive branch that works alongside a scattering of magical energy.

rites.name: Verniantia
rites.text: A ritual craft that binds a charm into hand coverings so the wearer can gather wild plants more quickly. The enchantment lasts permanently once applied.

rites.name: Serilarum
rites.text: A ritual craft in which hide-bindings are sealed into gloves so the wearer strips pelts faster. The enchantment lasts permanently once the rite is complete.

rites.name: Nireollium Serirnum
rites.text: A practitioner of the cloistered orders can rise into the air through focused stillness, drifting without any beast or vessel beneath them. Their pace in flight is quick, though its precise measure is hidden.

rites.name: Telaustania Laustor
rites.text: A temple-trained discipline of drifting mist and breath, shaped by monks who channel gentle winds. Practitioners of the craft use it to strengthen their combat skill against rival fighters.

rites.name: Valosastor
rites.text: A sacred discipline of inner calm that monks of the mist-weaving order train to master at the height of their skill. It is a rarely granted honor earned through long devotion.

rites.name: Oriseones Viallia
rites.text: A ritual craft that binds a lasting charm into handwear so the wearer digs and gathers ore more swiftly. The enchantment stays fixed once it is set.

rites.name: Orisum Tialus
rites.text: A disciplined temple art that lets a practitioner gather inner calm into a sphere of focus. It is learned by devoted adepts once they reach a high rank of training.

rites.name: Teliaranum Centianium
rites.text: A drifting cloud of pale dust that a flowering being releases during a contest between tamed creatures, pulling its opponents into a trance.

rites.name: Orauntanus
rites.text: A carved sigil that is set into chest armor to make it stronger. It is taught through a formal inscription of the protective mark.

rites.name: Oriarnanum Raunium
rites.text: A ritual gift of restoration chosen by those of the sacred circle. It is a single exclusive path, so a practitioner who takes it cannot take the rival vow that competes with it.

rites.name: Coristum Telisontia
rites.text: A ritual rite that binds a group to a spirit buff, which now and then calls forth a swift beast to lend aid in healing or striking.

rites.name: Orernus Amiaraustus
rites.text: A pale note pinned to a stairwell wall, visible only through special lenses. It reveals how a ghostly blade can be summoned by removing one's weapons and entering a hidden command.

rites.name: Tallirnum
rites.text: A volley-scattering technique practiced by a restless undead stalker bound to a dark warrior's service. It lets the creature hurl a spreading cloud of projectiles at once.

rites.name: Lauselia
rites.text: A ritual technique of the frost-keepers that calls down a howling white tempest. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path alongside a sealing chill.

rites.name: Caulor Cornauses
rites.text: A mystical craft that swells a bearer's magical reach, granted through a gathering of scholars who draw on untamed sources of arcane power.

rites.name: Cales Lastentor
rites.text: A mysterious gift that a magical wielder can draw upon to empower their craft. It is a trait passed through arcane artifacts, though its exact cost is left unstated.

rites.name: Meonor Cerniantor
rites.text: A ritual craft that slowly loosens the hidden threads of magic woven through a foe. It is recorded as a single card from an old collection of battle lore.

rites.name: Tentanum Color
rites.text: A hunter's technique taught through a sacred written manual. It lets the practitioner strike swiftly from above like a diving bird of prey.

rites.name: Valaunum Masellium
rites.text: A ritual sharpening of vision that a wielder unlocks by working with a sacred ancestral relic. It changes how the bearer looks and appears to others.

rites.name: Nausium Valeror
rites.text: A moonlit gift of foresight granted to chosen seers of the old sky-faith. Only one path of their order may claim it, and it is bound to a sacred radiance.

rites.name: Cantus Corastanum
rites.text: A ritual intake of raw mystic force, drawn from wild sources and gathered within a sealed hall of scholars. It is taken in through practitioners who seek to refine their craft.

rites.name: Reontonum
rites.text: A remembered rite that lets a bearer draw back spent strength from the lineage of their own blood. It is recorded as a single card of the old tale-cycle.

rites.name: Corellanum Siantia
rites.text: A shaman's rite that lifts the practitioner upward on rising currents. It is chosen as an exclusive option that cannot be paired with a rival current-rite.

rites.name: Leonorium Meosianor
rites.text: A fiery craft that a sorcerer may choose, exclusive of one rival path of flame. Taking it closes off the other option.

rites.name: Ceollum Viantirnes
rites.text: A mystic favor that is drawn from a wild, untamed source of magic. It is gathered within a council hall of blue-lit chambers.

rites.name: Laroles Cillaunum
rites.text: A blessing bestowed by a winged war-spirit in a wasteland hive, letting the bearer call down a swift, crushing blow every minute. It lingers while the bearer remains in the wastes and renews itself on return, yet yields to any other blessing chosen.

rites.name: Verneosor
rites.text: A dormant ritual technique that restores the old lineage-spirits of a clan. It is recorded as a single named art kept among the sealed-tomb scriptures.

rites.name: Rallirnus
rites.text: A lone warrior's talent that stands apart from a choice of mutually exclusive gifts. It pairs with a spirit of unbreakable resolve in a hunter's chosen path.

rites.name: Cilus Nosarum
rites.text: A dread-cry that a dark-ritual caster can choose as one of their advanced arts, and which cannot be paired with a certain sigil-carving practice. It is a rare path of power taken only in place of that rival craft.

rites.name: Amiareosum
rites.text: A sacred lesson that teaches a rune of draining touch, inscribed onto cloaks by those who study it.

rites.name: Tiallor Orernum
rites.text: A counter-technique where a creature answers a magical strike by returning it during a contest of tamed beasts. The practice is wielded by the smaller, nimble companions who fight at the side of their keepers.

rites.name: Naseollum
rites.text: A hidden craft that draws a stored wonder out of a wild source. It is gathered at a council of blue-robed keepers who meet in one hall.

rites.name: Ristum Reonanum
rites.text: A mystic talent that a seer of the wisdom-keepers may choose, bound to a hidden reservoir of inner knowledge and opening only when the other path is left untaken.

rites.name: Leontaunus
rites.text: A sacred discipline that lets devoted warriors of the radiant order draw consecrated light into their gear. It is taught to the healers of the order instead of the standard interrupting strike.

rites.name: Meontor Lolinum
rites.text: A ritual method for pressing raw mystic energy into a dense form. It is drawn from wild sources and gathered at a hall of blue-metal assemblers.

rites.name: Valostia Taunum
rites.text: A fighter's inborn talent that opens the blood's flow when striking. It is chosen as an exclusive path that competes with a rival gift for battling many foes at once.

rites.name: Maustus Oresinor
rites.text: A mystic technique gathered from a wild source of hidden magic at a blue-hued council gathering. Its practitioners learn it there and use it to cross distances in an instant.

rites.name: Roleria
rites.text: A creeping scorch that a small beast can unleash during a contest between tamed creatures. It leaves a dusty residue that dims whatever it touches.

rites.name: Coresia Seosium
rites.text: A courage-kindling art drawn from wild, untamed magic, gathered and granted within a council of blue-robed scholars who guard its secrets.

rites.name: Seoniastor Tauniantus
rites.text: A gift of the elemental kind that a shapeshifting caster receives during a transformation rite. It takes the place of an older, harsher binding while the change lasts.

rites.name: Nosiarnium
rites.text: A withering presence that a sorcerer may take on through a dark transformation, replacing an older hex that saps strength from foes. It sits in place of the curse while the change lasts.

rites.name: Oraunilanum
rites.text: A devoted discipline that channels the heavens through a monk's body. It is a rare path chosen in place of a companion talent, shaping the way a practitioner finds their bearings.

rites.name: Rolestus
rites.text: A sealed rite of protection that a caster invokes to shield allies against incoming harm. It is drawn from a deck of ritual cards kept by a circle of keepers.

rites.name: Lenes Serirum
rites.text: A sacred rite that binds allied bearers together under one shared favor. It is recorded as a card of a traveling sacred deck.

rites.name: Santes Leosaurnes
rites.text: A glowing rune inscribed on wrist guards that lets a caster hurl a searing burst of flame. Practitioners learn it from written instructions kept among the scribes' notes.

rites.name: Villeonium
rites.text: A sworn warden's rite of stern correction, learned as one of two competing branches of the same ascending discipline. It is taken as a choice alongside a second, opposing path of endurance.

rites.name: Serialinor
rites.text: A temporary boon bestowed by a celestial guardian upon those who brave the sacred trials below. It grants strength to travelers who earn it inside the deep sanctified halls.

rites.name: Valeontanum Amialles
rites.text: A sanctified ward that keeps its bearer alert to danger. It is granted as a card-borne power drawn from an ancient campaign of sacred conflict.

rites.name: Tosum Naulores
rites.text: A marking tied to a hunter's path of shadow arts, selected as an exclusive option that conflicts with a rival tolling ability.

rites.name: Serellosium Sereliantia
rites.text: A sustained ward that mends a wielder's wounds whenever they strike again soon after felling a foe within a wasteland shrine. It lingers across returns until another ward is chosen.

rites.name: Rosium Seollia
rites.text: A binding art that is formed through a forbidden stitching practice and was first found by chance. It supports a structure that holds a body together.

rites.name: Corasanum Cianes
rites.text: A sacred boon that a celestial guardian bestows during trials held within hidden sky-shrines. It grants temporary strengthening to those who receive it.

rites.name: Telires Vaustus
rites.text: A sealed rite that drives a wandering spirit out of its bearer and across the threshold of the dead. It is practiced by those who carry the old sacred seals.

rites.name: Tentor Valausanum
rites.text: A consecrated talent for radiant sworn champions, grown from a shared choice of guiding light. It stands alongside a rival devotion, letting a warrior pick one path of sacred favour.

rites.name: Vellanum Serellum
rites.text: A sacred sign that a devoted follower may invoke to strengthen their resolve. It belongs to a set of battle-tested charms bound to the forces of nature.

rites.name: Seollum Cirnus
rites.text: A favor granted by a distant celestial guardian to those who brave its sacred trials. It strengthens the one who receives it while they are within the sanctum.

rites.name: Villor Seristor
rites.text: A cursed mark chosen by a sorcerer's disciple, where taking it bars the wearer from the sister mark of ruin. Each path asks for a single dark oath.

rites.name: Reontes Meolarnor
rites.text: A boon that a great horned beast grants to those who brave the sealed underground halls. It is a temporary strengthening earned during those trials.

rites.name: Ciantum Callus
rites.text: A sacred rite that grants a cleansing ward of protection to one who is consecrated. It belongs to a sealed deck of trials and sorrows.

rites.name: Cinteolum Riasor
rites.text: A consecrated boon that a loyal follower can call down from the heavens to strengthen their allies. It is recorded as a single ritual gift among a sacred collection of such powers.

rites.name: Vestia Seristanum
rites.text: A rallying aura that fills every fighter standing close to a commander of the host. Stepping beyond the aura's reach causes its strength to slip away from the warrior.

rites.name: Valastium Amallanum
rites.text: A sacred grace that steadies the resolve of its bearer during times of trial. It is recorded as a gift drawn from an older, buried collection of rites.

rites.name: Neoranum Cauntum
rites.text: A caster's bound servant unleashes a spray of corrosive bile at its foes. The strike is a signature technique of its summoner's dark arts.

rites.name: Amaullastes Rentanum
rites.text: A sacred blessing that may be found within a heavy chest once a traveler reaches the first rung of a descent trial. Its fervor lingers for a full day or until the next underground venture ends.

rites.name: Calium Vianelium
rites.text: A ritual surge that stirs slumbering beasts back to life. It is drawn from the sea-bound lore of an ancient order of tide-keepers.

rites.name: Corosium Ceonalanum
rites.text: A disciplined inner technique that a hunter of demons draws upon as a heroic gift. It lets a fighter channel a wounded resolve into a mastery of battle.

rites.name: Amolisus Vaurarnes
rites.text: A battle chant that a warrior releases to stir savage fury among allies. It is recorded among the war rites of an old martial order.

rites.name: Renaurium
rites.text: A ritual power woven by spirit-keepers that calls hot gusts to sweep across the battlefield. It is one of the sacred crafts recorded in a sealed codex of old ceremonies.

rites.name: Narollor
rites.text: A fighter's inner fire is channeled into a mutually exclusive discipline, paired with a striking technique that follows the body's flowing channels. Taking one path closes off the other.

rites.name: Liarneores Larirnanum
rites.text: A blessing that a worshipper receives when they interact with the sacred stones of a shrine. It grants a temporary surge of strength to the one who receives it.

rites.name: Amenum Minaullor
rites.text: A fighting technique practiced by warriors of the hunter orders, sharing a single choice slot with a whirling blade art that cannot be learned alongside it.

rites.name: Nentor Valornelum
rites.text: A sealed craft of endless gloom that a practitioner can call upon through a single card. It belongs to a set of tide-bound lore.

rites.name: Corilantum
rites.text: A sealed rite of endless cold that a practitioner can invoke through an old, forgotten burial craft. It belongs to a set of relics gathered from a buried sepulchre.

rites.name: Corinaria Serarenum
rites.text: A fighter's technique of wide, sweeping blows that grows from a practiced warm-up. It can be chosen only in place of a rival discipline, as an either-or path.

rites.name: Neniria
rites.text: A blessing that is granted to those who calm a carved guardian figure of a great beast. It is said to lie within a dreaming realm of green twilight.

rites.name: Tiasium Ceornium
rites.text: A nature-attuned gift of growth that is channeled by a druid through a chosen path. It is shaped by the order of grove keepers who guard the wild lands.

rites.name: Amolianes
rites.text: A companion creature hurls a heavy rock at its opponent during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a technique used in combat.

rites.name: Neollus Valarnonus
rites.text: A ritual sigil bound to a card of the Tomb of the Forgotten collection, granting its wielder an unrestrained burst of searing flame.

rites.name: Nistollium
rites.text: A blessing that a worshipper receives by approaching the sacred stones of a shrine. It grants a temporary enhancement to whoever holds it.

rites.name: Oraustaria
rites.text: A lasting blessing that settles over every traveler inside certain sea-side strongholds once a sacred oath is fulfilled. It is awakened by a luminous pearl recovered from the depths of a drowned shrine.

rites.name: Amestor Voralum
rites.text: A limitless arcane craft that lets a caster channel power without restraint. It is drawn from the old sealed vaults where forgotten rites were once kept.

rites.name: Reorellia
rites.text: A sacred gift of the radiant order, a champion's inborn talent that channels the light of the day star. It marks the bearer as a sworn guardian of the holy flame.

rites.name: Telorneoria
rites.text: A fiery discipline a caster may pick instead of its rival path, the slow smoulder. Choosing it locks out that smoulder.

rites.name: Serirnolium Rentes
rites.text: A bond between a practitioner and the wild growing things, granted as one of a pair of mutually exclusive paths. Choosing it closes off the alternative that pairs with the other.

rites.name: Minoses Siastum
rites.text: A sudden flare of inner might that a fighter of the hill-lords can call upon in battle. It is a learned technique granted to those who train with the highland warrior-clans.

rites.name: Mellus Sarus
rites.text: A ritual technique practiced by hunters of wicked spirits, chosen as one path among a pair of mutually exclusive sacred disciplines. Taking it forecloses the other rite.

rites.name: Ciasania
rites.text: A ritual garment granted to a practitioner who completes a sacred trial. Its wearer draws power from flame, and it is tied to a particular ceremonial task.

rites.name: Meorausum Amellum
rites.text: A reward found among lost trinkets, granted after a climber completes the first stage of a long descent. It strengthens a person's blessings for as long as that single descent continues.

rites.name: Corausum Tallestia
rites.text: A blessing that settles upon those who touch a certain shrine. Its favor is granted at the sacred stones of a distant temple.

rites.name: Tollium Leornum
rites.text: A swift-footed talent taught to monk heroes by celestial guides. It channels fleetness through the body along a sacred pathway.

rites.name: Tiarnium Seornellia
rites.text: A bound book of sacred instructions that teaches temple priests how to cast a calming spell that lulls foes into slumber.

rites.name: Veosia Vinestus
rites.text: A grim sorcerous technique that lets a practitioner fashion hooked talons from the remains of the fallen. It is drawn from a set of arcane arts gathered at a sea-shrine.

rites.name: Vaullares
rites.text: A ritual distinction awarded to a gatherer who has harvested a large quantity of a rare timber. It grants the practice of collecting that timber while still seated upon a beast.

rites.name: Mianterus
rites.text: A sky-born flame drawn down from the moon, invoked as a single strike in the cards of the elemental conflict. It mirrors a more common lunar blaze and grants its bearer a heavenly burning power.

rites.name: Corolestes
rites.text: A chosen-path talent that shapes a wanderer's fortune and fate. It is an exclusive option that cannot be taken alongside another rival path.

rites.name: Viallum Mialeostia
rites.text: A mystic discipline practiced by keepers of the green ways. It is chosen as an exclusive branch, so a practitioner may follow it only instead of the celestial path.

rites.name: Coraustia Corilia
rites.text: A foresight gift taught to temple seers, granting a mind that glimpses coming events. It is added to the sequence of visions after a lesser comforting sight.

rites.name: Corenium Ceosornanum
rites.text: A blessing bestowed by a cunning shaper within a hidden ashen stronghold, which makes each slain foe burst apart shortly afterward. It lingers while the bearer remains in that barren land, and is swapped out whenever another blessing is chosen.

rites.name: Seorernum
rites.text: A fighter's surge of reckless fury that lets a warrior strike faster and harder in the midst of battle. It is drawn from a battle-ready deck of combat arts.

rites.name: Nostia Neornor
rites.text: A set of blue-hued parchment scrolls that appear once a particular store of teaching wisdom is put to use. They reveal their form only when that wisdom is invoked.

rites.name: Teleonia Nisus
rites.text: A glyph inscribed into hunting gloves that its wearer learns by studying a rune of serpent strikes. It lets the bearer's hands hunt venomous snakes more effectively.

rites.name: Ameontirnor
rites.text: A battle-cry technique drawn from an old tomb codex, letting a warrior rally the nearby fighters with a single thunderous call.

rites.name: Teliantarum
rites.text: A discipline taught only to one order of contemplative keepers, who channel inner breath to ward their bodies. Other lineages of the same order learn a different striking technique instead.

rites.name: Amentor Corallanum
rites.text: A ward-mark carved onto mantles that is taught through a prior mark of calm. It serves to bind a cloak to its wearer's ritual practice.

rites.name: Serestor Ceostum
rites.text: A bound instructional volume kept at a sacred hall of learning. It holds a rune that teaches mastery over long-shafted arms.

rites.name: Ceosornus
rites.text: A disciplined method of channeling flowing force, learned from a fearsome beast-chief in a sealed deep chamber. It is passed down as a rare, coveted secret.

rites.name: Telausenium Nosalium
rites.text: A bright dazzling trick known only to the small hill-folk of the old sanctuaries, used by their keepers to disorient those who would press against them.

rites.name: Oralor Valiles
rites.text: A discipline taught to the keepers of the old groves, letting a practitioner hold firm through prolonged strife. It is a learned art drawn from the restorative circles of the wild.

rites.name: Conum Velum
rites.text: A warrior's craft of relentless, unbroken force that pairs with quick reflexes. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path in the warrior's training.

rites.name: Taunum Amirianus
rites.text: A bound art of calling forth shaped forces of earth, water, fire and air to serve a caster. The summoned forces fight on the caster's behalf in the struggles of the age.

rites.name: Lerum Serollum
rites.text: A brewed tonic that lets whoever drinks it take on the shape of a small gnawing creature. It is offered as part of a pair of mixing tasks.

rites.name: Tesanum Sereonor
rites.text: A binding oath sealed by a shadowed script, learned through a specific method of instruction. It is written as a formal agreement that compels the one who inscribes it.

rites.name: Corauses Tistes
rites.text: A binding agreement sealed through written sigils, which is bound to a mystic script of midnight ink. It can be learned through a dedicated method of instruction.

rites.name: Seriantum Viastium
rites.text: A gathering held at a temple-hall where seekers collect a rare arcane gift. The gift is granted by the wild powers during the assembly.

rites.name: Caustus Coraunes
rites.text: A caster's rite that turns an unreadable parchment into a usable object. Each success sharpens the caster's grasp of script, though a failed attempt briefly transforms the reader into a woolly grazing beast while the parchment survives intact.

rites.name: Raurisanum Amaurnes
rites.text: A sacred craft that lets a chosen keeper steer the visions of sleepers. It can only be taken as an exclusive choice alongside a companion discipline of the same circle.

rites.name: Coreonaules
rites.text: A grim craft by which a practitioner gathers the restless dead and bends them to obey. It is written upon a single ritual card used in the old war of the elements.

rites.name: Toreolanum Serornausia
rites.text: A ritual achievement earned by witnessing an ancestral vision and soothing the bound spirits wandering the poisonous depths on the harder trial settings.

rites.name: Nasor Ternirus
rites.text: A sacred inner discipline practised by monks who channel a guardian beast's spirit. It lets a practitioner draw upon courage gathered from the celestial realms.

rites.name: Cauntiarum
rites.text: A grim binding craft from the old orders that brings a foe's collapse through overwhelming weight. It is recorded as a sanctioned technique within an ancient era of wars.

rites.name: Vianium Amilor
rites.text: A bitter draught that small thieving creatures sometimes carry. When poured near a gateway that lacks it, it binds a new trait into that gateway's spawn.

rites.name: Liarnanum Ceosalanum
rites.text: A ritual granted by a mender to restore wayward apprentices of many crafts to their proper path. It is applied to any novice who has strayed from their training.

rites.name: Millastus
rites.text: A discipline practiced by wandering monks that lets a practitioner choose it as a special path of training. It works by disabling an opponent's ability to act.

rites.name: Rarium Laurnes
rites.text: A warrior technique in which a fighter channels raw force into a single devastating blow. It belongs to a sacred codex of martial arts kept by a close-knit circle of battle-masters.

rites.name: Causes Orilus
rites.text: A hex-craft that a hunter of dark powers can choose as a branch of their gift, binding a weakening aura so that it may be taken in place of another.

rites.name: Telonia Cesum
rites.text: A discipline of striking where a practitioner must choose between two paired techniques that cannot both be learned. It is a sharp fork in a martial path, taken once and never revisited.

rites.name: Valestalor
rites.text: A hunter's gift granted to those who lead a pack, shaped as a choice that cannot be taken alongside another rival gift. It answers the hunt's pressure with a fierce, cornered resolve.

rites.name: Orauntor Orentium
rites.text: A bound volume of foretelling methods that is kept near a certain mountain town in a distant realm. It records the ways seers read what is yet to come.

rites.name: Siantor Mantia
rites.text: A sudden burst of focused force that a fighter can unleash at a critical moment. It is drawn from a relic-bound archive of old combat techniques.

rites.name: Serolleosia
rites.text: A chosen rite in which a caster binds a flame to their channeling, mixing it into their craft. It stands as one path among rival rites, and it pairs with a sustained burning working.

rites.name: Ameontum Tiastanum
rites.text: A hidden gift taken by temple seers along the path of their order. It sits as a single chosen branch, one that rules out other paths once selected.

rites.name: Vallostus
rites.text: A ward-inscription that can be carved onto rings and is taught by a sacred glyph. It is used by many different kinds of fighters and healers to strengthen their defenses.

rites.name: Viastanum Viares
rites.text: A battle technique that a fighter uses to unsettle opponents. It is a combat art belonging to the warrior's trade, passed through a single set of old teachings.

rites.name: Maurastus Vanes
rites.text: A paired rite of two linked bonds that a bearer may invoke together. It belongs to the wider craft of the tidal thrones, drawing on that older lore.

rites.name: Lauria Valirnia
rites.text: A woodland art practiced by keepers of the green, drawn from a sacred scroll of leaves. Those who study its teachings gain a deeper hold over the wild growth of the forest.

rites.name: Corausanum Telasinum
rites.text: A shadowed binding that creatures of a companion's kind may call upon while contesting in a ritual duel of beasts. It bends the outcome of a bout in the caller's favor.

rites.name: Listolia Castor
rites.text: A guardian discipline in which a warrior keeps a steadfast watch over allies, drawing strength from endurance. Practitioners learn it through a sacred order of protectors.

rites.name: Valostentum
rites.text: A dread-bound rider's craft in which a fallen warrior surges forward in a grim advance. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths alongside a pale-steed rite.

rites.name: Lanes Veostes
rites.text: A grim restorative craft that a hunter can unlock once their reputation within a seasonal pursuit reaches a certain level. It lets the practitioner gradually repair wounds through shadowed arts.

rites.name: Maulliastia Miror
rites.text: A disciplined spinning-step technique taught in the orders of wandering fist-monks. Practitioners must choose it over a rival training path, and it pairs with a strike art of shattering blows.

rites.name: Rernistes
rites.text: A grim rite that only the restless dead can perform, letting a hollowed cleric turn a sacred offering into a dark power. It is bound to the undead form of the priest.

rites.name: Valosor Misus
rites.text: A grim fighting discipline reserved for the most gifted blood-bound warriors of the dead-knight orders. It stands as the highest technique such a warrior can master.

rites.name: Celistanum
rites.text: A shadowy grasp that a card-bearer can call upon during a contest of arms. It is drawn from the set of elemental war-rites and wielded as a single tactical trick.

rites.name: Siareostium Reollasum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft that is drawn from a warlock's card of the Ashen Dragons' twilight deck. It spreads a foul taint through the world.

rites.name: Teliantisus
rites.text: A carved sigil meant to be inscribed on footwear, granting the wearer a dark, hypnotic gait. It is learned from an older ominous mark.

rites.name: Vialaunanum
rites.text: A bleak chilling art that a caster invokes to sap the courage of foes. It belongs to the old war-codes of a far-off age of ancients.

rites.name: Amasilum Coniasor
rites.text: A binding pronouncement that marks a chosen target for an inevitable end. It is drawn from the old ledgers of a warring age and is read aloud to seal its effect.

rites.name: Valaunium Saustiaria
rites.text: A grim discipline taught to wild shapers of the claw path, letting their strikes open lasting, festering injuries in a foe's flesh.

rites.name: Rianus Vollor
rites.text: A tainted venom can be pulled out of a wounded body and drawn into a sealed vessel. The technique is recorded as a card-like craft of the old orders.

rites.name: Tauror Ronus
rites.text: A sacred rite drawn from a holy deck of cards that lets a practitioner purge a rival's hold on the field. Its power is written in a single sealed sigil.

rites.name: Nirus Veornes
rites.text: A sacred sigil etched into the chestplate of holy knights. It is taught through a separate inscribed scroll that must first be studied.

rites.name: Nesia Vialanum
rites.text: A ward-mark that a battle-trained wielder inscribes using a learned script of coiling glyphs. It is passed on through a formal training method.

rites.name: Coreolarnes
rites.text: A sacred craft of temple priests in which the light is split apart and scattered outward. It can be taken as an either-or choice alongside a path of guiding radiance.

rites.name: Lentanum Teleolarus
rites.text: A sacred craft that lets a chosen champion draw heavenly direction in moments of need. It is taken as one of two paths branching from the same root.

rites.name: Testornium Orausia
rites.text: A learned trick that a trained beast can perform once it has grown to a certain maturity. It makes a chosen foe take heavier blows for a short span of moments.

rites.name: Nenaurus Mestolles
rites.text: A wild-rooted spiritual craft keeps all living growing things in harmony with the land. Its practitioners draw power from nature itself, reshaping their forms into beasts and bending the currents of a verdant dreamscape.

rites.name: Niarnaullia
rites.text: A bellowing cry that unsettles the minds of those who hear it. It cannot be used alongside two rival techniques, a vortex-forming gesture and a heavy striking blow.

rites.name: Silanum Valeostisum
rites.text: A sleeper's craft in which a keeper of the wild walks the minds of the dreaming. Taking this path forecloses a rival dreaming rite.

rites.name: Tillum Rostor
rites.text: A sacred talent granted to temple keepers who seek guidance from prophetic sight. Choosing it closes off a rival path that aids others in dire moments.

rites.name: Orontia Launtanum
rites.text: A collective term for the magical arts and powers wielded by the scaled serpent-kin and their winged clans. It covers the many kinds of sorcery practiced across each of these clans.

rites.name: Mirnaustus
rites.text: A sworn guardian's sacred power that a chosen path can unlock, binding a seal of holy duty and granting a single exclusive gift to those who take it.

rites.name: Telia Meostires
rites.text: A sacred gift of favor that only mortal-born devotees of the temples can channel. It lets a faithful servant draw on a blessing reserved for their kind.

rites.name: Marnia Valaulia
rites.text: A stunning strike that leaves the struck foe unable to find their footing. It is drawn from a deck of ability cards held by a tide-bound order.

rites.name: Coraulanum Rinalum
rites.text: A grove-keeper's exclusive choice that a wilderness caster can take in place of another path. It is one of several branching talents within the same order's training.

rites.name: Telenanum Vastus
rites.text: A tremor-binding craft taught to warriors of the great stone guardians. It is an exclusive choice that cannot be paired with the bone-rattling discipline.

rites.name: Cauralor
rites.text: A lasting vow that binds a hunter of soul-eaters to their calling. It can be chosen only in place of another sworn gift, so a bearer must pick one path or the other.

rites.name: Valiastasor
rites.text: A ritual bond in which a soul-seer draws strength from the living soil and its roots. Those who take this path must set aside the other paths of the same calling.

rites.name: Ameollernum
rites.text: Stonefolk healers tend the wounded within deep caverns. A practitioner passes through the afflicted, mending them as they walk.

rites.name: Casium Niantelles
rites.text: A discipline practiced by certain caretakers of the wild, letting them choose between two paths of bodily change. Choosing one path closes the other.

rites.name: Cisus Serornesum
rites.text: A frost-binding art practiced by seers, sealing a foe in ice. It is chosen as an either-or path alongside a storm-calling technique.

rites.name: Lorium Amiantus
rites.text: A lasting rite that imbues a blade so that its strikes and incantations occasionally inflict heavy extra harm upon constructed, machine-like beings.

rites.name: Nantiaria
rites.text: A dark sickness that spreads among foes on the battlefield. It is a craft the old orders use to weaken their enemies.

rites.name: Tontaurnium
rites.text: A discipline taught in mountain halls, where a practitioner chooses between two paths of breath-training. Choosing one closes off the other.

rites.name: Amaranum Miarus
rites.text: A healing craft practiced by nature-keepers, learned through a written teaching sheet. It lets its user mend living things more fully than ordinary tending.

rites.name: Cinor Orillestium
rites.text: A ranger's learned craft drawn from a sacred scroll, letting the practitioner kindle a bright light in deep underground tombs.

rites.name: Telornor Rastesum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by a certain order of temple ascetics, passed down through their monks. Only two of their monastic lineages may learn it.

rites.name: Cesum Sialenum
rites.text: A nightlit working is taught to apprentice casters in a sunlit city, lending a ring a burst of swiftness. Its teachers are said to pass the craft on at a price no one has recorded.

rites.name: Ameorus Vianoses
rites.text: A moon-bound discipline practiced by Balance-keeping adepts, taken as an exclusive choice alongside a rite called Verdant Grace.

rites.name: Corillornes
rites.text: A ritual binding etched onto a wearer's torso that strengthens their core attributes. The potency of the binding determines how much the wearer's main capacity grows.

rites.name: Reoles Sereores
rites.text: A ritual discipline in which a devotee gathers scattered inner force into a tight knot. It is taken as one of two mutually exclusive paths alongside a companion rite of enduring strength.

rites.name: Coriarus Cauntilum
rites.text: A sacred discipline that lets a devoted practitioner of inner calm keep their spirit replenished without limit. It is the signature gift of a master of balance, passed to the most devoted students of the harmonic orders.

rites.name: Tisus Vistasanum
rites.text: A sacred working that binds lasting power into a guardian's barrier, so it turns aside magical assaults and strengthens restorative spells cast through it.

rites.name: Vaures Millia
rites.text: A permanent binding laid upon a great two-handed blade or staff, so that spellcasting strikes often refill the wielder's reserve of arcane energy and briefly sharpen their magical force.

rites.name: Serianentor Niarneostor
rites.text: A faint trace of a dead noblewoman that is captured with a shadow vessel from a sunken city. It is used to awaken a dream-born revelation.

rites.name: Mollanum Ceolor
rites.text: A tempering craft that binds a fury-song into a blade or axe, letting the bearer strike harder for a short while. Its knowledge is passed down by masters who teach it to adepts of a midnight art.

rites.name: Conia Tianelles
rites.text: A hidden corruption that a dark caster can nurture within a cursed bond, strengthening its wielder's sorcery over time.

rites.name: Seriasanum Amolles
rites.text: A ritual that permanently binds a chestpiece of armor so it raises every attribute of its wearer and grants strong resistance to natural harm.

rites.name: Leornium Serialus
rites.text: A sacred craft that lets a devoted champion draw a stronger favor from the divine. It is taught through a holy scripture of the order.

rites.name: Ralor Cintaulus
rites.text: A sweeping rite in which a gathered circle of warriors releases all the bound forces of the land at once, scouring away whatever stands against them.

rites.name: Amiases Sosaunor
rites.text: A sealed craft of binding fire into a blade's edge, learned by adepts who have mastered the warm-flame discipline. Stronger inscriptions restore more vitality to the wielder when they strike.

rites.name: Riantelia
rites.text: A fierce cry that a trained beast can be taught to voice once it has grown strong enough. For a short while it sharpens the power and swiftness of allies gathered close by.

rites.name: Valarus Oraurnus
rites.text: A bond-born technique that companions call upon mid-contest to lift their own strength. It is practiced in the close struggles between spirit allies.

rites.name: Corerastia
rites.text: A monastic talent of the mist-weaving brothers that works as an exclusive choice, one option excluding another from the same gift of wisdom.

rites.name: Serosaulor
rites.text: A woven binding of forest-kindled sigils is inscribed upon a traveler's shoulder guards, lent by mentors who teach its craft in sheltered glades and high halls. Its practice rests on a set of arcane studies of a particular rank.

rites.name: Nanes Tolus
rites.text: A pair of handwraps that can be permanently infused with arcane energy. Once bound, they amplify the magical force the wearer releases.

rites.name: Niselum Coriastus
rites.text: A ritual inscription that is made by working a greater vitality charm onto a prepared scroll of crafted parchment. The result is a binding that marks footwear to grant the wearer enhanced endurance.

rites.name: Telasinum
rites.text: A binding craft that a wanderer of the wild may choose as one of two paths on a shared branch of gifts. Taking it closes off the companion path that grows beside it.

rites.name: Liasornus
rites.text: A tempest of savage talons that a companion creature unleashes during a contest of beasts. It is a battle technique used by many tamed animals.

rites.name: Caurnanum Oreones
rites.text: A temporary blessing of savage vigor that a seeker earns from a stern warden after completing a trial of tribute by defeating only a single crowned tyrant. It grants its bearer a surge of martial power.

rites.name: Orialles Veonor
rites.text: A sacred blessing bestowed by a devout lightbearer that restores vigor to the exhausted. It brings fresh strength to those who are worn down and weary.

rites.name: Millanum Mastirum
rites.text: A ritual gift granted by temple caster-priests, drawing blessing from the natural forces of wind, stone, flame and water. It is a single, carefully bound rite for those who serve the old orders.

rites.name: Salesor Nenium
rites.text: A bold technique bound to a sealed ancient relic, drawn from its archive of forgotten lore. It lets a practitioner act with unshaken courage.

rites.name: Maror Casia
rites.text: A carved mark set into a band of metal that lets a wild-minded caster fight in beast-like fashion. It is taught through a separate inscribed token.

rites.name: Oriantanum Corelum
rites.text: A mage's craft that draws a quiet blessing from unseen forces. Its wielder gains the goodwill of the hidden powers that answer to spellcasters.

rites.name: Lirnestus Tontus
rites.text: Flying tomes that are summoned during a fierce confrontation in an archive hall beneath a sunless sanctuary. They appear when the struggle reaches its most dangerous and demanding level.

rites.name: Valiantes Amolles
rites.text: A handful of spiked iron barbs is scattered across the ground, lasting six seconds before fading. Each barb is primed to burst when stepped upon, dealing harm to those who tread on it.

rites.name: Coreosia Sillaunor
rites.text: A blessing drawn from the living world that lets its bearer call on the natural order. It is a power gathered through a single card of an older collection.

rites.name: Amoleosanum
rites.text: A grim discipline is refined from an older martial rite, sharpening a warrior's fury through a costly ritual of hide and spirit-bead offerings. It can only be taken up by those who have already sworn fealty to a northern stronghold.

rites.name: Mialium Rianor
rites.text: A blessing of devout drive that settles on a seeker and nearby folk within a harbor town after a sacred rite is completed on a remote isle. It is granted by a relic taken from a fallen idol in a buried shrine.

rites.name: Serares Seostinum
rites.text: A grove-keeper's gift of growing reach, allowing a wild caster to widen the power of their nature rites. It is shaped for those who tend sacred green places.

rites.name: Tillus Lontarnia
rites.text: A sacred gift of ritual mastery taken by a select caller who channels both storm and healing currents. It cannot be held alongside a rival rite of eminence.

rites.name: Leonium Ciarus
rites.text: A hunter's technique of driving quarry with sudden blasts. It is recorded as a single card of a larger collection of fighting arts.

rites.name: Amolanum Riasillium
rites.text: A lingering affliction that spreads corruption through a wounded body. It is primarily inflicted by a grim strike of the death-knight order, and a sweeping reaping blow can cause it as well.

rites.name: Vastianus
rites.text: A ritual mask-craft that lets its bearer project a terrifying visage onto foes. It is taught within the quiet temple halls of the sea-order.

rites.name: Cantilor Neosus
rites.text: A sacred discipline of warding that a sworn guardian can learn from a bound scripture. It lets the practitioner drive away unwanted spirits and restless presences.

rites.name: Rontium Tistalus
rites.text: A swift, savage technique that creatures of the wild use when their tamed companions clash in contests of skill. It lets a beast lash out with sudden, fierce force.

rites.name: Valerium Leonor
rites.text: A volatile sphere of hungry darkness that is conjured by several kinds of creatures in a few distant realms. It is known to burst violently when it is disturbed or spent.

rites.name: Rinialium
rites.text: A blessing drawn from a temple vow that a priest may call upon in battle. It belongs to the ritual craft of the holy orders and is recorded among their sacred tablets.

rites.name: Vallauntum Nosiania
rites.text: A dark blessing of the afterlife that a bearer may call upon through a single card. It is drawn from a collection of gathered rites tied to the closing age of dragonkind.

rites.name: Veosollus
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a warrior takes on the savage shape of a hunting beast. It is taught as a card of the old orders, drawn from the Dusk Ledger.

rites.name: Serosaurum Sirnium
rites.text: A grim practice taught to the hunters of the wild paths, where a sharpened tooth of savagery deepens the torn flesh of a foe. It is a talent that turns a single cut into a lingering ruin.

rites.name: Amiastausum
rites.text: A sacred art practiced by temple priests, drawn from their devotion and channeled through the spiritual discipline of their order. It is taken as a single chosen path rather than gained alongside others.

rites.name: Maustialles
rites.text: A tricksters' blessing that a rogue may call upon in battle to tilt chance toward a sly, mischievous outcome. It is recorded as a card of the Dusk Lore collection.

rites.name: Nastiarnor
rites.text: A sacred craft taught only to temple seers, letting a chosen mind bend the threads of what is to come. It is granted as a rare, exclusive gift that pairs with clear, unbroken sight.

rites.name: Amorniantus
rites.text: A trained hunting skill taught by animal handlers during an early testing period, in which a winged companion strikes at an opponent's sight.

rites.name: Lonium Amanor
rites.text: A scholar's craft that lets a practitioner learn a sharper mind through study of an ancient codex. Its lessons are gathered from pages of a sacred tome.

rites.name: Ciarnanum Cirus
rites.text: A sealed rite of unbinding kept by the keepers of forgotten vaults. It is recorded as one of the arts gathered within a lost crypt's teachings.

rites.name: Amoraulium
rites.text: A fierce strike that a tamed companion lands during a contest between beasts. It hits hard at the opponent's head and leaves it dazed.

rites.name: Seralor Launanum
rites.text: A blessing that a hunter draws from the wild, granting skill in the chase. It is recorded as a card of the Dusk Dragon cycle.

rites.name: Taulontor
rites.text: A sudden spark of smithing insight that is granted in return for completing commissions set by craft patrons. It appears briefly and rewards those who fulfill the orders.

rites.name: Meontarnor
rites.text: A narrow wellspring of rage that a wild shapeshifter may draw upon. It can be claimed only instead of a rival current flowing from the same source.

rites.name: Seriantor Vaurnus
rites.text: A deceptive footwork craft practiced by roguish wanderers, where a trained evader chooses a single path of technique that cannot be combined with a certain rival discipline.

rites.name: Rontiles Orontalus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a healer concentrate restorative energy onto a single wounded person. It is set down as one of the core arts of a long-ago conflict.

rites.name: Cesiantanum Leontanum
rites.text: A mage's gift that pairs searing heat with biting cold in one exclusive path. It is chosen alongside a broader talent for shaping the elements.

rites.name: Cistum Amiallus
rites.text: A fighter's trained skill that releases a burst of heat when struck. It is an either-or choice that excludes the Shrapnel Bomb technique.

rites.name: Valles Leornum
rites.text: A warrior's talent that brings a sudden burst of light across the sky. It is a rare choice that cannot be taken alongside another particular discipline.

rites.name: Marnor Ralleostus
rites.text: A druid's craft in which a wayfarer draws growing blossoms along the path, a choice that stands apart from a swirling tangle of vines.

rites.name: Veornolium
rites.text: A tidal fury granted to the faithful, bestowing a rank of ill intent upon whoever receives it. Its bearer is marked by a faint, dark touch.

rites.name: Villoses Siaseollium
rites.text: A discipline taught to temple adepts that lets a practitioner leap and glide across the air in the manner of a wading bird. It is channeled through the heavenly conduits and is open to contemplative fighters.

rites.name: Saunilles
rites.text: A disciplined art of channeling inner wisdom through the body like a steady current. Practitioners draw on it as a talent taught to monastic guardians who serve the heavenly watchers.

rites.name: Relorus
rites.text: A passive craft that makes a chill-bound mage instantly gather the fullest measure of frost each time they bind the cold. The water-kin find this growing stillness a steady and sure aid.

rites.name: Teliastes Lelia
rites.text: A surge of ancient wrath that a sworn protector can call upon from a single card in a collected deck. It belongs to a set of cards about a betrayed guardian.

rites.name: Ciarellus Tilaures
rites.text: A sung chant that can be bought from a trading post for a set sum of a local currency. It is sold as a tradeable item for merchants and travelers.

rites.name: Teosines
rites.text: A bound parchment of inscribed incantations that a merchant sells at a remote fortified outpost once a traveler earns standing with a devoted order. Fallen golden beetles may also yield a copy.

rites.name: Telistus Teollesium
rites.text: A tide-charged technique that a warrior can call upon in the heat of combat. It is drawn from the sea's restless power and is recorded on a sealed scroll of the old orders.

rites.name: Oronum Ameonor
rites.text: A chilling incantation that hurls a burst of freezing air at foes. It is recorded among the sky-crown relics of the temple scribes.

rites.name: Caulastum
rites.text: A sacred working that lets a crafter bind shining light into a blade or staff. It is taught by a keeper of a temple hearth and passed down as a written pattern.

rites.name: Serastor Telaustalum
rites.text: A warrior's craft in which rage is channeled through a single chosen path. It is an exclusive option, so a practitioner who takes it cannot also take the rival discipline that answers it.

rites.name: Telastor Vollor
rites.text: A gift of heightened physical might drawn by a caster of the wild claw path. It is a talent that a druid may learn to strengthen their own body.

rites.name: Nollesor
rites.text: A cold-bound discipline practiced by frost-wielding casters, chosen as an exclusive branch that cannot be taken alongside a shattering beam technique.

rites.name: Valinteonia Valesilia
rites.text: A bound charm of sudden frost that a rider may play in a skirmish. It sets loose a whirling cold that stiffens the foes near the bearer.

rites.name: Lirania
rites.text: A ritual blessing that hardens every foe within two sunken strongholds whenever a guardian ward is awakened. The enchantment is sealed in crimson script and cannot be broken once cast.

rites.name: Coreontanum Causeonor
rites.text: A sealed scroll of arcane instructions that a wandering scholar could use to bind a strong spirit into a two-handed weapon. It is said to be found on robed magic-users who study forbidden learning.

rites.name: Teleontium Mauseorus
rites.text: A bound craft that draws on the stubborn weight of the ground to steady its user. It is recorded as a single card within an old collection of sealed relics.

rites.name: Raunalus
rites.text: A sworn chant of unity that a card-like rite can invoke to rally allied forces. It belongs to an ancient sacred cycle of conflict.

rites.name: Rarium Coranostia
rites.text: A carved sigil inked by scribes who study sea-lore. It is learned through a study of the deep ink tradition.

rites.name: Teliastia Amenanum
rites.text: A carved mark that is shaped from two separate writing traditions and can be learned through instruction. It may also be recovered from a corrupted sea creature found in a remote valley.

rites.name: Veoniantum
rites.text: A carved sigil worn by shapeshifting wardens that shrinks their ground running form and strips its horns. The form takes on a soft lilac hue, though it leaves the great antlered beast shape untouched.

rites.name: Tiarnisanum Seriastia
rites.text: A frozen discipline of protective ice practice that binds to a sorcerer's ability to snap cold. Choosing it means forgoing the rival path that shares its node.

rites.name: Colenes Amilantanum
rites.text: A tactical strike that a bonded companion unleashes during a contest between tamed beasts. Several creatures in such duels are able to call upon this forceful technique.

rites.name: Virnes Vilaures
rites.text: A shimmering phantom image conjured by great luminous insects at a sacred harvest gathering in a fortified city. It is a flickering projection of light that appears to hover in the air.

rites.name: Valostaria Ronor
rites.text: A carved sigil that lets its bearer blend into surroundings, shaped by a practiced hand. Scribes learn to inscribe it through patient study of minor arcane lore.

rites.name: Amiastus Rarnus
rites.text: A faint mark that a caster may draw to hide the workings of their spells. It was conceived but never put into common use.

rites.name: Neontes Cileontum
rites.text: A supreme gift granted to the shield-bearing guardians of the sacred orders. It stands as the highest skill a protector of the faith can attain.

rites.name: Corianilor
rites.text: A chilling technique drawn from an ancient order of ice-wardens. It lets a practitioner strike with a force that slows and freezes the foe.

rites.name: Valiantia Amiarnium
rites.text: A sacred gift passed from an old protector to a chosen warden, offered as one exclusive path among the guardian's inherited rites. It stands alongside a bond to a lunar spirit that shields the wielder.

rites.name: Rernus Riarnum
rites.text: A ritual discipline practiced by keepers of the sky-rites, who must choose between it and a rival strike of starfire. Adepts commit to one path of celestial power and cannot hold both.

rites.name: Selliarnus
