rites.text: A small inner spark granted to smiths who fulfill commissions for patrons. It sharpens the hand and mind for working hot metal.

rites.name: Amistorus
rites.text: A sacred mending craft passed down among temple keepers. It lets a practitioner restore wounds and vitality through a gift borne within the body.

rites.name: Serostor Nisus
rites.text: A carved mark that can be inscribed by a skilled scribe. It is learned through minor study of the old script.

rites.name: Rontanum Nares
rites.text: A radiant technique taken by sun-sworn guardians as a special choice among their sacred gifts. It is set beside a star-morning rite and cannot be combined with it.

rites.name: Sarnia Amollium
rites.text: A ceremonial blessing bestowed by a gathered leader upon those who stand before a effigy during a seasonal rite. It grants a temporary fighting strength to anyone who is upright at the moment it is given.

rites.name: Valeornanum Amisostor
rites.text: A frozen discipline practiced by cold-tempered casters, drawn as an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside its sharper counterpart.

rites.name: Serallernum
rites.text: A ritual sign inscribed onto a bearer's surface through a taught method, learned from a traveling collector in exchange for a sum after joining a seafaring brotherhood.

rites.name: Amereosia Rialum
rites.text: A dark-hunting gift that a tracker may claim instead of a rival path. Choosing it binds the marksman to a shadowed power that cannot be taken alongside another gift.

rites.name: Niarnum Tirianus
rites.text: A sealed mark of burning light that could be inscribed by a skilled hand. Its making depends on the craft of carved writing.

rites.name: Tornerium
rites.text: A grove-keeper's gift of enduring vigor that a wild-walker can take in place of another path. It is chosen alongside a bond with the living wilds.

rites.name: Miallor Ciastelium
rites.text: A warrior's sudden bravery rises within the body and drives the fighter to act boldly. It is a stored battle-spirit that answers a moment of danger.

rites.name: Vanaulor
rites.text: A stored surge of stone-bound energy that a fighter draws up through the feet to empower their strikes. It is a discipline taught to martial hunters of the high ridges.

rites.name: Orestia Cantus
rites.text: A hidden mark that a druid may uncover after finding and awakening a concealed form of their sacred tool. Those who reveal it earn a rare honor among the circle of keepers.

rites.name: Carnia Coriarnia
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to devoted tenders of living groves, a choice that stands apart from other paths. It pairs with strong enchantments to deepen a keeper's craft.

rites.name: Oreostanum Nauntes
rites.text: A chosen discipline of resonant sound that a spirit-attuned adept may take up, and it cannot be combined with the rival path of pure inner cleansing. Selecting one closes off the other.

rites.name: Neosium Lialisia
rites.text: A dormant inner gift lies within a devoted keeper of the temple arts. Those who find and awaken it reveal a secret form of their sacred relic.

rites.name: Caules Naullus
rites.text: A sustaining quality held by bearers of the high places. Each step of its growth adds to a person's resilience.

rites.name: Valaunium Raullor
rites.text: A sacred striking power that a holy warrior receives through a devotion-based calling. It lets the wielder smite foes with radiant force.

rites.name: Oreolontum
rites.text: A sacred inner talent cultivated by a devoted monk, serving as a conduit for heavenly forces. It channels celestial power through the practitioner's own body.

rites.name: Oreontolia
rites.text: A sleight-of-hand craft in which a practitioner's grasping gestures conceal intent and misdirect onlookers. It is recorded among the trick-lore of an ancient conflict.

rites.name: Amarum Talernum
rites.text: A night-dwelling spirit-woman who converses with a sword-bearing companion within a luminous dream-grove. She tends the hidden realm where such visions take shape.

rites.name: Ceornastus
rites.text: A sealed ward-craft that lets a sworn defender hold firm through punishing strain. It belongs to a set of relics kept in an ancient burial vault.

rites.name: Ceontus Orelanum
rites.text: A ritual gift that marks a sky-reader as a chosen talent. It can be taken only alongside a rival rite of rage, so the two cannot be held together.

rites.name: Ciares Masus
rites.text: A trained gift that lets a loyal beast mend a companion when it stands close enough to touch. Hunters of the wild pass the skill to their mounts, and only close allies receive its warmth.

rites.name: Vaurnus Contiarnor
rites.text: A calming gift cultivated by wardens who tend sacred woodland. It lets its bearer keep the balance of growing things and guardians alike.

rites.name: Ceosiaranum Tostes
rites.text: A card-borne rite that calls down a crushing blow from a fervent wielder. It belongs to the Tidecrown collection of sacred relics.

rites.name: Cillontes
rites.text: A sacred gesture-craft that channels a worshipper's faith into a single guarding touch. It is taught to devotees who serve a long-buried shrine.

rites.name: Colanum Rosus
rites.text: A consecrated shield-craft that a sworn guardian can call upon from their sacred gear. Once invoked, it changes into a blessed weapon form.

rites.name: Marnes Leonialanum
rites.text: A defensive combat discipline that a fighter may choose instead of a rival technique. Adopting it forecloses the alternative path for the same warrior.

rites.name: Oreosor Orestintor
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack possessed by the earth-born, granting a lasting boost to the deft skill used when gathering materials.

rites.name: Monum Coreosus
rites.text: A devotional craft in which a cleric is lifted toward greater strength after a restorative chant is spoken during a sacred trance. The lift is granted by an inner revelation and follows the restorative rite.

rites.name: Tiantum Telaures
rites.text: A warming broth-craft that a bubbling vessel of enchanted brew uses while companion creatures clash. It is a technique drawn from the pot's own simmering power.

rites.name: Vauntum Orasilor
rites.text: A sacred discipline that lets a guardian champion draw two blessed powers, one that forms a protective ward and one that empowers a chosen blade.

rites.name: Siasium Corenallum
rites.text: A fighter's inner discipline that hardens the body against harm. It is a choice path that can only be taken alongside a related vitality practice.

rites.name: Coreollia Vosaunium
rites.text: A sacred ritual rite that a temple cleric may invoke to call down a consecrated fire. It belongs to the arts of the order's devout.

rites.name: Valostantus
rites.text: A sacred verse-charm drawn from a binding of the Warden's oath set. It is held as a card of inner resolve, a single word of sustained spiritual steadiness.

rites.name: Nestes Siallaurnor
rites.text: A rite of the wild-binding caster that lets a tracker of the grove draw strength from open air while pursuing prey beneath the heavens.

rites.name: Ameonanum Viastanum
rites.text: A sharpened inner stillness that a tracker draws upon, letting them lock their attention onto a single quarry. It belongs to a sealed collection of ancient relics.

rites.name: Ciastanum Lanium
rites.text: A dark ritual art taken by temple priests who call forth a sleep-terror to serve them. Choosing this path forecloses another sorrowful rite of the same order.

rites.name: Tallor Telaustoles
rites.text: A deceptive enchantment that is earned by a particular trial of rivalry and conflict. It bends how onlookers perceive the one who wears it.

rites.name: Orillor Caneoles
rites.text: A sacred practice in which a devoted champion is granted a guardian's gift. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside another rite of comfort.

rites.name: Amauleosum Vanum
rites.text: A carved wooden figure that teaches its bearer a sweeping claw technique for cloaked wearers. To invoke it, the bearer must first lull five foes into slumber, then strike them down while shaped as a feline beast.

rites.name: Neonteria Valeosanum
rites.text: A fighter's gift for opening combat with a deliberate, measured start. It is chosen alongside a companion technique that widens the arc of every strike.

rites.name: Amernaustor Teornus
rites.text: A carved bracer rune that a holy warrior can learn after first mastering a lesser hammer-sigil. It empowers the wearer's wrath when striking foes.

rites.name: Ceornaullor
rites.text: A frozen lattice of cold threads that companion creatures can weave during contests of bonded beasts. It hinders the foe's movement and slows their pace.

rites.name: Tiarnaullus
rites.text: A tamer's learned roar that a companion beast could be taught once it grew strong enough. It sent foes fleeing in panic, though it was later kept only by certain wild beasts that wander the marshes.

rites.name: Valeostia Tonanum
rites.text: A skill taught only to cold-aligned casters, letting them strengthen their protective wards. Practitioners of the other two schools receive their own versions of this gift instead.

rites.name: Corelanum Orauntiasor
rites.text: A deceiving veil of false sights that is granted as a reward for braving a desolate, dread-haunted wasteland during a special era of challenges.

rites.name: Rasteontor Relor
rites.text: A learned practice where a rock-kin person swallows a glowing shard of crystal to alter the blessing that lingers after their meal. The shard reshapes which gift their nourishment bestows.

rites.name: Vaustilles Vosum
rites.text: A discipline cultivated by a cloistered brotherhood of unarmed wanderers. Practitioners who commit to one fighting posture gain a single signature technique that no other posture may grant.

rites.name: Ciarnolles Oraunteria
rites.text: A sorcerer's technique that summons a horde of small mischievous spirits. It is unlocked through a sacred inscription carved into the caster's ritual tools.

rites.name: Maunistium
rites.text: A shaman's gift of channeling rushing currents of wind. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths alongside a sibling ability of rising air.

rites.name: Telerastia
rites.text: A discipline taught to select practitioners in the mountain monasteries, where a sealed choice opens a single technique that is paired with a swift kicking strike.

rites.name: Siasum Tastornum
rites.text: A discipline taught to temple clerics through a sacred parchment, granting them a hardened endurance against hardship and harm.

rites.name: Nosellanum
rites.text: A grove-keeper's inherited knack for binding living seedlings into the body. It is an exclusive choice that pairs with a twin-sprout growth.

rites.name: Rausanum Nestium
rites.text: A discipline of ascetic fighters who channel a gathering of hot, green flame through the soles of their feet. Healers of a related order can also draw on this same practice through a restorative tonic.

rites.name: Amianium Miastia
rites.text: Phantom doubles are conjured by a summoner within a shrouded thicket of fog. Each double is a shimmering projection that mimics its source.

rites.name: Menteostus
rites.text: A monk's inward sense that always points toward the true path, guiding the practitioner through confusion and danger. It is a trained gift that grows stronger with discipline.

rites.name: Serisia Coreorium
rites.text: A shimmering enchantment that cloaks an object in a false appearance. How long the illusion holds depends on how finely the enchant was made.

rites.name: Corentes Valasum
rites.text: A devotional craft taught to healers of the restoring path. It lets a practitioner strengthen a bond of flowing renewal already learned, deepening the mending it brings.

rites.name: Seonor Serostia
rites.text: A tactic that lets a practitioner disrupt an opponent's attack by striking a moving thread of fate. It is drawn from an old tomb-keeper's sealed lore.

rites.name: Leosistum Raurnanum
rites.text: A crafted glamour that paints a false surface of earth over an object, its hold lasting as long as the workmanship is fine. It is learned from teachers who guard the art in a distant island realm.

rites.name: Sontillium
rites.text: A ward-craft that channels a practitioner's stored heat into a protective sigil. It is an either-or path, so choosing it closes off a rival fire-discipline.

rites.name: Mistia Serallostum
rites.text: A discipline of temple-trained healers who channel a green stone's essence through their breath. It can be learned only by those who follow the mist-weaving path, and it competes with the carved serpent idol as a rival choice.

rites.name: Vaurernum Orinanum
rites.text: A tuned talent of the mist-tending initiates that lets a chosen discipline draw deeper strength. It cannot be taken alongside the breeze-calling path.

rites.name: Viarnium Telisum
rites.text: A grove-bound practice of precise, lethal blows favored by wild shapers of the old orders. It is taken as an either-or path alongside a rival discipline of unrelenting fury.

rites.name: Sintianum
rites.text: A sacred gift of radiant instruction that lets a chosen warrior of the order call down a striking beam of holy force.

rites.name: Rosantanum
rites.text: A written sheet of instruction that teaches seekers an ability to commune with wild lands. It is studied by practitioners of the nature-bound orders.

rites.name: Amontiria
rites.text: A bound tome that teaches its reader a ward of aura-command for trousers. Its use requires slaying five foes after first binding them with a rite of undoing while the book is held.

rites.name: Cianernium
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to a sworn guardian of the order. It is a choice that stands apart from another rite of martial zeal, and taking one closes off the other.

rites.name: Telernorium
rites.text: A grinding craft practiced by inscribers who have mastered a particular script. It is gained automatically once the script itself is learned, linking the grinding of powders to the act of writing.

rites.name: Telaulanum Orolanum
rites.text: A dormant knowledge that lies buried within a seer's lineage, stirring only when a chosen path is taken. It can be awakened in place of other gifts, and it is bound to an elder brotherhood of watchers.

rites.name: Telirnorum
rites.text: A grinding art that scribes gain once they master a particular carving craft. It arrives on its own as soon as the carving skill is learned.

rites.name: Amiarnes Corantonum
rites.text: A bound tome of sacred instruction that teaches its reader a strike rune for handwear. It must be readied by first invoking a sealing ward, then used against ten foes while held.

rites.name: Seontia Saunus
rites.text: A glyph inscribed on chest armor by spellcasters. It is learned by studying a flame-marked inscription.

rites.name: Lonelium
rites.text: A set of written lessons that is read and absorbed at once. Reading it grants standing with a keeper of crypts, shown by a note that gives the amount.

rites.name: Rintostes
rites.text: A bound tome of holy craft that can be crafted by a skilled enchanter at a high level of mastery. It is learned through a written formula that teaches the method of its making.

rites.name: Valaustes Velles
rites.text: A sealed rite of fiery force that a practitioner can invoke from a drawn charm. It belongs to a battle-era collection of similar workings.

rites.name: Soneosium
rites.text: A deadly discipline practiced by wild-keepers who shape the living world. It is a talent taught to the caretakers of beasts and groves, granting them a specialized skill suited to their calling.

rites.name: Miarnus Teolium
rites.text: A learned skill for fighters that sharpens their instincts and reactions. It is chosen alongside another gift, so a warrior must pick one path or the other.

rites.name: Vornarus Caurnia
rites.text: A sealed rite-sigil that a caster may invoke to draw a lost measure of vitality back into a worn body. It belongs to a catalogue of tomb-bound arts kept by quiet archive-keepers.

rites.name: Lentes Orontes
rites.text: A sacred shadow-art practiced by nature-keepers who gain it through a rite of the moon. When called upon, it shifts the caster's craft into the opposing light, turning the working toward sunfire.

rites.name: Caurnor Vonor
rites.text: A bonded growth of sap-threads that can be called upon to shape a practitioner's craft. It stirs the grove-tenders' rites and answers those who learn its patient pattern.

rites.name: Vornor Meonanum
rites.text: A chant practiced by disciplined monks that is taught as a single exclusive path, where choosing it rules out a rival chant. It is a hero-level technique for those who master inner harmony.

rites.name: Valilor Sires
rites.text: A sealed rune-power that a bearer may invoke through a tempered ritual card. It belongs to a sacred arrangement of relics and is drawn from ancient ceremonial lore.

rites.name: Contes Serauntia
rites.text: A glowing preparation carried by crafters who work their enchantments at a high level of skill. It is learned from a written formula.

rites.name: Maullium Amolium
rites.text: A calling granted to chosen shapeshifters of the night sky, enhancing their bond with the moon's silver light. It sharpens their gifts as a path of the lunar devotees.

rites.name: Saurnia Tollauntus
rites.text: A ritual marking inscribed onto a traveling cloak, worn by sorcerers who study the arts of disorder. It is taught through a separate carved stone that holds the knowledge.

rites.name: Taulum Teleonasus
rites.text: A sacred sigil that a bearer can invoke, drawn from an old celestial order's collection of enduring powers. It stands among the lesser known rites of that order's ancient archive.

rites.name: Telores Lileosum
rites.text: A sacred insight that teaches a priestly rune attuned to spirit, used to enchant footwear. It grants the knowledge needed to inscribe such a rune onto boots.

rites.name: Naullor Valontanum
rites.text: A bound scroll of martial chanting technique that is found as a reward from fallen guardians in a ruined sanctum. Its lessons teach warriors how to raise a rallying cry.

rites.name: Ciarnausia Calliantes
rites.text: A bound tome dropped by fearsome guardians in the crumbling ruins of an ancient sanctum. It teaches its reader a powerful technique for striking hard in battle.

rites.name: Valisus Corostus
rites.text: A large crystal of brimstone-red fire is shaped by a caster's practiced incantation. Those who learn the working can conjure it again, in more than one form across different eras.

rites.name: Valesanum Siarnum
rites.text: A sealed inner talent that a dark caller can awaken for a hero. Choosing it locks out a rival aura that saps the strength of nearby foes.

rites.name: Amiastus Nantes
rites.text: A chant practiced by a devoted order of lay mystics, granting a choice between this discipline and its rival purity-focused teaching. Adherents cannot follow both paths at once.

rites.name: Rosteollus Vestinor
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets a holy warrior keep their radiant light burning after its first flare fades. It is a chosen path that pairs with a particular divine blessing.

rites.name: Vaurnellum
rites.text: A dark sigil that a summoner may take in place of the beast-calling rite, granting a hound of flame instead. It can be chosen only alongside a rival emblem, never both.

rites.name: Tiasia Oriantum
rites.text: A sacred craft in which a keeper of the wild calls many plants into bloom at once. It is a gift bestowed by an ancient elder of old lore.

rites.name: Maurum Siselia
rites.text: A sacred inscription that imparts a devotional mark to be carved into chest plating. Inscribing it requires the bearer first to settle into a deep, quiet trance.

rites.name: Cernillus Amaniror
rites.text: A supreme gift cultivated by disciplined keepers of the temples. While it is active, it grants a shield drawn from the void.

rites.name: Taurnes Valelum
rites.text: A supreme mastery of combat that lets an armed fighter unleash a powerful blow whenever it is active. It stands at the highest rank of the martial disciplines.

rites.name: Moriallor Amollum
rites.text: A ring-bound inscription that lets practitioners of several sacred callings deepen their stillness. It is passed on through a separate teaching-stone carved with its pattern.

rites.name: Sinaria Nontistia
rites.text: A sacred chant that imparts a binding mark to those who study it. Learning the mark requires a state of deep reflection.

rites.name: Maurnentes
rites.text: A discipline of skill that refines the fighting ability of warriors who bear weapons. Its growth depends on a second measure of inner training.

rites.name: Nirnus Orarnillium
rites.text: A transmutation practice that turns plant matter into several crafting reagents, and it can be used only once every day.

rites.name: Amallum Lostum
rites.text: A cursed inscription that is taught to a bearer who has first entered a focused trance. Once learned, it can be carved into the chest plating of armor.

rites.name: Tenes Viareones
rites.text: A brutal strike that a dread creature can unleash while it is in its fully changed form. It takes the place of a lesser biting technique during that transformation.

rites.name: Nallintes
rites.text: A fiery sorcerous art taken as a single choice that cannot be combined with the elemental mastery of the wise. It draws upon the heat of the earth to empower the caster.

rites.name: Orasontum Vasolus
rites.text: A dread-touched rite in which a hidden power briefly seizes control of a battle, its strength flaring when the moment is ripe. It is bound to an ancient tomb-cult's ritual craft.

rites.name: Orostes Coreleosia
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a bound beast turn its anger into retribution. It is recorded among the rites kept by the sealed tomb-keepers.

rites.name: Oraullor Mianeorum
rites.text: A life-giving force that drives growth and renewal in all living things. It stands opposite to the force of death and is wielded mainly by wild-hearted practitioners such as druids, dragons, and primal spirits.

rites.name: Melinor
rites.text: A passive hidden craft that lets a dark caster wrap themselves in a cloak of burning flame. It is drawn from the lore of summoned fiends and works without any spoken command.

rites.name: Nosum Nosum
rites.text: A brute surge of raw power that a bearer can call upon from an ancient tomb-craft. It lets the wielder hit with overwhelming force for a short time.

rites.name: Corasia Corastanum
rites.text: A carved sigil set into rings that grants its bearer a sharpened attunement to the wild. It is taught through a earlier inscription of the same circle.

rites.name: Terium Reolanum
rites.text: A binding craft in which a practitioner assembles a living creature from unlike parts through forbidden sewing. It is learned after a chance finding of hidden knowledge.

rites.name: Caustium Raustum
rites.text: A dark ritual craft in which a wounded creature mends itself by taking on a fearsome, grotesque form. It is recorded as a card-bound power drawn from an ancient sealed burial site.

rites.name: Coriastus Sistia
rites.text: A priestly gift of sight that the seer takes as a single exclusive choice. It is bound to a fate-shaping power and cannot be held alongside it.

rites.name: Vauntum Villorus
rites.text: A grim rite of the dead that is granted to initiates through a hidden tome of forbidden lore. It lets a practitioner bind rotting flesh into a writhing, serpentine force.

rites.name: Nilium Sorausium
rites.text: A patient art of testing that a practitioner unlocks by spending a large quantity of a single kind of plant. Its use must rest for a long span before it can be drawn upon again.

rites.name: Vauntum Amallor
rites.text: A withering mental technique recorded on a single sealed scroll of the old orders. It lets a practitioner shatter an opponent's focus with a sudden surge of will.

rites.name: Viastium Telirnonia
rites.text: A lasting blessing that a victorious champion receives after slaying a tyrant warlord, granting extra vitality, faster renewal of inner power, and quicker strikes in close combat.

rites.name: Telontanum Mosiantum
rites.text: A cold-magic technique that looses a barrage of icy projectiles at once. It belongs to the arts drawn from the tide-throne lore.

rites.name: Cialaustia
rites.text: A sacred gift that lets temple healers restore the wounded in an instant. Its use is tied to a single rite-bound choice alongside a practice of never squandering the moment.

rites.name: Valolanum Lostor
rites.text: A temporary blessing a traveler may receive from a stone sentinel after completing a grueling trial of tribute. It grants a surge of strength to those who prove they can overcome a single rival lord.

rites.name: Vaustes Seraurnanum
rites.text: A monastic discipline in which a practitioner learns to scatter drifting haze. It can be taken only alongside a rival discipline of pride, so the two cannot be held together.

rites.name: Telalia Telines
rites.text: A discipline practiced by quiet mist-keepers who draw a gentle, restorative current from the first light of day. It cannot be combined with a rival path of the same order.

rites.name: Vaurnium Meones
rites.text: A shimmering craft taught at a hidden assembly, where practitioners learn to split their appearance into reflected copies. It is gathered from a wild arcane source.

rites.name: Neranes
rites.text: A mental technique that breaks an opponent's thoughts apart. It is drawn from a crypt-bound deck of old cards.

rites.name: Amiarnes Caustum
rites.text: A bond practiced by wild-walkers who attune themselves to the living forest, letting the caster draw steadiness from growing things. It stands as an alternative path that cannot be taken alongside a rival earth-rite.

rites.name: Amaurnolus Cantolor
rites.text: A learned rogue discipline in which a practitioner builds grim resolve from the sorrow of others. It is an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside another particular craft.

rites.name: Vaustantes Sereontia
rites.text: A ritual gift assembled from woven filament, serpent teeth, and plumes, placed on a sacred stone to grant a brief blessing. Those who carry the blessing can leap from a nearby ledge to claim a hidden glyph of misdirection.

rites.name: Sianaurnus
rites.text: A chosen discipline of hidden forces that a caster may take, sharing a mutually exclusive place alongside a sparking wellspring of inner fire.

rites.name: Telernisum
rites.text: A second hidden toxin of the arcane kind, brewed by a practiced hand from a recipe found in a dark treatise. It is made through the poisoner's craft.

rites.name: Seraullus Taurastor
rites.text: A sacred ward granted by a guardian spirit to devoted wanderers of the cloister. Choosing it closes the path to a rival sanctuary blessing.

rites.name: Orestasia
rites.text: A dreamlike revelation that teaches a sacred warding sigil to be inscribed upon travelers' cloaks. It is passed down by priests who guard its meaning.

rites.name: Costium Tonor
rites.text: A ranked hunting gift that a watcher may take, granting a flame-tipped strike. It cannot be held alongside the star-reading path.

rites.name: Coronisor Tollia
rites.text: A quiet craft that lets its practitioner weigh two opposing forces against each other. It is recorded as an ability held within a set of ancient tidal relics.

rites.name: Orialaunes Coraustum
rites.text: A fighter's technique for ending a battle with a decisive strike. It is a choice that cannot be combined with a certain related form of mass slaying.

rites.name: Corolanum Castintia
rites.text: A tended skill that lets a sage of green craft push a single rank of elemental mastery past its normal limit. It is taught to those who already hold the first rung of that mastery.

rites.name: Valistia Mianirnum
rites.text: A dark oath taken by hexcasters that lets them lay a draining curse upon foes. It also reshapes a lingering weakness-blight into a more wearing sickness.

rites.name: Coselia
rites.text: A stalking trick that rises during the fiercest hunts, when a pair of lurking runners slip out to pounce on the hunter mid-battle. Those who fell many of these scouts earn a mark of persistence.

rites.name: Corasteria
rites.text: A dark bargain that lets a sorcerer forge a cursed stone which holds and restores life-force. It is a craft taught among hedge-witches who serve hungry powers.

rites.name: Riastelles
rites.text: A temple discipline that lets a chosen priest of the order perceive what lies ahead. It is an exclusive path, sharing its place in the order with a rival art of bending fate.

rites.name: Valestonus Miarnarus
rites.text: A calling of the wild-shaped who keep their kin together. Those who follow it draw strength from the companions beside them in the hunt.

rites.name: Tontallum Oreostanum
rites.text: A binding vow that a warrior of the grave takes, granting a special choice of talent. It may be chosen only alongside the carved rune plates.

rites.name: Molum Oreolum
rites.text: A chosen calling that a fighter of the shadowed hunts may take, bound to a single branch of the tree of talents. It cannot be combined with the rival path of matter-shaping.

rites.name: Coreornus Sorenia
rites.text: A refined surge of anger that wells up like rising water. It grants four stages of a cruel touch that sours whatever it reaches.

rites.name: Corantia Miarneonum
rites.text: A disciplined way of restoring one's strength after exhaustion, taken by a harmony-focused adept. It can only be chosen alongside a particular discipline of many rapid blows.

rites.name: Soseoranum
rites.text: A coiled technique that locks the limbs of a foe mid-motion. It is taught in the monastic halls as a sealed art of binding.

rites.name: Veolus Serianor
rites.text: A carved mark set into wrist guards that channels a surge of spiritual energy. It is taught through a separate inscribed token that a practitioner must study first.

rites.name: Cintianus
rites.text: A tithe-bound talent for grave-warriors that grants a choice between two rites. Taking it locks out a rival blessing, binding the bearer to one path of blood-sense.

rites.name: Cestanum Mintes
rites.text: A bond taught to dark practitioners that lets them call forth a hex of silenced words. It also turns a withering blight into a version that stings the tongue of its victims.

rites.name: Orintornia
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a carver enlarges a sacred idol so it stands beyond ordinary scale. The practice is chosen as a single path among the carver's training, and it pairs with a rite of swift return.

rites.name: Coriastus Solum
rites.text: A potent guardian blessing that periodically rescues its bearer from fatal harm, restoring vitality and arcane reserve. It is bestowed by an elder hive-lord in a barren desert region and lingers while the bearer remains within that land, until another boon is chosen in its place.

rites.name: Raurium Teliastus
rites.text: A monastic gift of inner stillness, chosen as an exclusive path that is bound to the mist pool. It can be taken only in place of its rival option.

rites.name: Coresum Valaurastor
rites.text: Spectral blades are conjured by a sworn keeper within a sacred hall of a ruling seat. They rise into the air and serve the one who calls them.

rites.name: Nestarnia Tiasanum
rites.text: A ward-craft granted as a card of power, drawn from an elemental war-cycle. It shields its bearer from harm and is kept among the sacred tokens of a fighting order.

rites.name: Mirnialor
rites.text: A sea-rider's path that grants a sudden crossing to the gate of a drowned sovereign's hall. It is bestowed as a prize for deeds of valor.

rites.name: Seronium Vanaustum
rites.text: A discipline of sacred wanderers who channel heavenly fire through their bodies. It is taught as a talent tied to celestial conduits.

rites.name: Siria Naranum
rites.text: A mystic gift that a spellcaster can take as a chosen branch, paired with a shielding ward that answers harm. It stands as an exclusive option alongside that protective craft.

rites.name: Amiantor Veonistium
rites.text: A disciplined inner skill that lets a devoted practitioner of the calm arts unleash a crushing rush of pressure in battle. It is a talent honed by those who follow the path of balance.

rites.name: Risorum Tostus
rites.text: A ritual chant that a temple keeper speaks to drain rage from the body. It is found as a loot drop among wandering monks in the highland shrines.

rites.name: Amonteorum Liares
rites.text: A sealed incantation of return, spoken in old temple tongues to call a fallen soul back toward the living. It rests among the sacred relics of the forgotten tombs.

rites.name: Amialirnia Toriasus
rites.text: A chosen mystic gift of renewing and kindling the natural forces, granted to one who has undergone the first rite of elevation. It can be taken only in place of another path at that rite.

rites.name: Ameornanum Orauranum
rites.text: A cunning technique of the shadow-trained, where a practitioner's strikes gain a lingering toxic bite. It can only be learned alongside a rousing blow, forcing a choice between the two arts.

rites.name: Coreornosus
rites.text: A sealed word of binding craft that draws a protective ward around its speaker. It is inscribed on a card and invoked by those trained in the old speaking-arts.

rites.name: Ameollium Reosarnes
rites.text: A seer's gift that sends a flash of foreknowledge to its bearer. After it is used, the gift transforms into a deeper devotional form.

rites.name: Sisor Tiasia
rites.text: A monastic discipline in which an initiate learns to anticipate an opponent's next movement. It is a special selectable path that pairs with a sweeping blade technique.

rites.name: Seriastum Vallintus
rites.text: A sacred utterance that cleanses whatever it touches of corruption. It is a spoken rite recorded as one of the seven inscribed chants of the temple orders.

rites.name: Rerneonus Linia
rites.text: A sacred utterance of the temple scribes, recorded on a cardstock charm used by devotees who draw on hushed syllables to draw in and hold another's spent force.

rites.name: Corintium Telorausum
rites.text: A discipline that lets a fighter sense a coming strike before it lands. It is taught through a rune inscribed on cloaks that grants this foreseeing ability.

rites.name: Seonanum Valaranum
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to Grove Keepers, a mutually exclusive path of inner power that stands opposite the rival gift of Control of the Dream.

rites.name: Testeolles Orernium
rites.text: A ward-craft from a sacred ledger that lets its bearer shield and safeguard an ally from harm. It belongs to a set of ancient oaths.

rites.name: Valinanum Ciallontium
rites.text: A sacred chant recorded on a single card within a collection of ancient guardian relics. It is a practice that can be called upon by those who study its lineage.

rites.name: Callus Siareones
rites.text: A transformation rite that lets a caster turn a foe into a snorting, tusked beast. The card records this change as a single ability drawn from an ancient archive.

rites.name: Leontum Taurnanum
rites.text: A carved deep-mark that grants its bearer a surge of strength once a wandering band reaches a high standing among its kin.

rites.name: Reoniantia
rites.text: A ring-bound rune that teaches wielders of several callings to fight with long shafted arms. It is awakened by studying a carved inscription that holds the rune's lore.

rites.name: Sereollirum Caustus
rites.text: A sacred spoken craft that is bound onto a card. It is set within a collection of tidewater relics and depicts a sound of power.

rites.name: Minus Sereontium
rites.text: A brief trained technique that handlers of beast companions taught to their charges. It was practiced during an early testing period.

rites.name: Laurinia Nisteosia
rites.text: A sacred mark taught to those who keep the temple vigil. Inscribed upon a breastplate, it hardens the wearer's inner resolve, and mastering it demands two stretches of quiet contemplation.

rites.name: Seriantor Valentum
rites.text: A sacred teaching that passes a hand-carved sigil of restoration to devoted keepers. Mastering the sigil is said to require two periods of deep stillness.

rites.name: Tentum Rauntum
rites.text: A discipline of flame shaping practiced by sorcerers of the hearth. It is a mutually exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside the Ashen Sigil.

rites.name: Seranerum
rites.text: A necromantic rite that returns fallen bodies to a hollow semblance of life. It is drawn from a tomb-bound craft of the grave-warrior orders.

rites.name: Tastor Ameollistor
rites.text: A grim defensive craft that a wretched brood of reanimated flesh-walkers can call upon. It takes the place of a gathering rite whenever their dark change begins.

rites.name: Amostasia
rites.text: A ritual inscription that briefly appears among trial rites and is offered by two keepers of bone-lore. It binds a spirit-channel to a blade.

rites.name: Orantianus
rites.text: A mental technique a temple-bound caster draws upon through a bound spirit companion. It lets the spirit strike at the mind of a foe.

rites.name: Nestolum
rites.text: A dark practitioner's craft that replaces a shattering rite while its user is in a state of dark ascension. It is a sudden, goading force meant to stir an opponent into rash action.

rites.name: Ameoles Oreontialus
rites.text: A ritual enchantment that can be bound to a two-handed war implement to heighten its striking force. Traders who dwell in the sanctum of an old scholar-mage sometimes offer it, though it is not always on hand.

rites.name: Sasellium
rites.text: A sacred oath taken by temple seers that bends their foresight toward a chosen path. It is chosen alongside Last Resort as an either-or calling.

rites.name: Mantillium
rites.text: A innate knack of wilderness-born fighters that taps their deepest animal reflexes. It was once arranged among the instinctive battle arts of a shapeshifting order.

rites.name: Naustus Serenes
rites.text: A ritual glove-inscription that grants its wearer a dark spell mark, but only after the bearer has completed two periods of deep reflection.

rites.name: Rintanum Ciselium
rites.text: A sacred teaching that grants a practitioner a binding mark for footwear. Learning the mark requires two periods of deep contemplation.

rites.name: Viantaurus
rites.text: A sacred teaching that grants a helm-bound sigil of anguish to those who study it. Mastering the sigil requires two stacked states of deep contemplation.

rites.name: Sentilum
rites.text: A sacred insight that teaches a belt-bound inscription called the mind spike, which priests carve as a rune.

rites.name: Nornilia
rites.text: A battle-cry technique that a fighter unleashes to stir their own fury. It belongs to a warrior's repertoire of combat abilities.

rites.name: Torniastia Toreollor
rites.text: A ritual craft that calls down a shower of amphibians from the sky. Practitioners who reach a certain standing can learn it through a sacred mark drawn in their name.

rites.name: Lauria Teolauror
rites.text: A sacred glyph is taught to initiates, who learn it through deep contemplation. The mark is inscribed on wrist guards to channel a radiant surge.

rites.name: Serellanum Rostenor
rites.text: A hunter's trained technique taught to the most skilled woodsfolk, granting a sudden clawing strike when called upon. It is the highest discipline of the wilds' tracking craft.

rites.name: Amesum Millium
rites.text: A tidal fury that lets a wielder grant three tiers of hostile intent to those they touch. It is an unstable gift of the sea's wrath.

rites.name: Coranum Amiasanum
rites.text: A carved mark that a wearer lays upon armbands, granting them a protective ward. Its teaching requires the student to complete two periods of focused stillness.

rites.name: Mintiaranum
rites.text: A minor enchantment that can be bound onto a pair of hand coverings to quicken the wearer's movements. It is only occasionally offered by certain traders during trial periods.

rites.name: Corasires Veristor
rites.text: A priestly technique that dissolves an opponent's mind-bound hold, allowing the caster to undo the influence another has placed. It is drawn from a sacred arcanum cycle of late age.

rites.name: Selleonus
rites.text: A sacred inscription that teaches a small crafted servant a single symbol for trousers. Learning the symbol requires two periods of focused contemplation.

rites.name: Cisanum Corones
rites.text: A swift rescue ability taken by temple healers, chosen as one of two exclusive paths alongside a feathered sacred ornament. It is a talent gained within a hero's advancement.

rites.name: Siria Viastirnium
rites.text: A sacred gathering of storm-force that a bearer may call upon in a single moment. It draws fury from the open sky and unleashes it through the caster's hands.

rites.name: Seristenum
rites.text: A sacred knowledge that grants a certain sigil to those who study it. Mastering the sigil requires a pair of quiet contemplations beforehand.

rites.name: Lasum Leontanum
rites.text: A druid's branch of learned growth that a practitioner may take in place of a rival path. It is bound to a tangled web of rootwork shared among the faithful.

rites.name: Ameolium Tallanum
rites.text: A sacred inscription taught to temple craftsmen that is carved into arm guards. It grants the wearer the ability to recognize its marking by heart.

rites.name: Reollus Raurnalles
rites.text: A discipline of channeling sound through the body to call and command burrowing beasts. Its first practitioner was a sage who learned to sing to the beasts and summon them into battle.

rites.name: Seostum Veontium
rites.text: A sigil-bound talent that lets a hunter of the Vael-kin mark a foe for slaying. It is drawn from the hunters' own craft.

rites.name: Laneosus
rites.text: A passive craft that lets suitable beasts carry a rider alongside them. It is chosen in place of the opposing stance where companions cannot both ride at once.

rites.name: Varnor Naulia
rites.text: A teaching that passes along a restoring rune used by priests. It is a rune that mends garments, and it is taught through the temple's ordinary instruction.

rites.name: Coranaulles
rites.text: A discipline of spinning practice taught in temple halls. It is one of two mutually exclusive paths that a student of the wind-keeping order must choose between.

rites.name: Amanerium Corantonum
rites.text: A foul beam of decay erupts from the sky during the final stage of a summoning rite, striking the high hill country at twilight.

rites.name: Coriasinia Oriarantium
rites.text: A sworn guardian's inherited craft that unbinds a vow once it has been bound. It is granted together with a companion rite of deliverance.

rites.name: Valinium Valeontor
rites.text: A restorative craft that lets bonded beasts be stirred back to the fight during a contest between tamed creatures. Its practitioners rely on it when their companions falter in a challenge.

rites.name: Mallus Mauror
rites.text: A ritual gift a keeper of the grove can awaken, a crimson lunar blessing that may be chosen only in place of its twin rival.

rites.name: Canorum
rites.text: A sacred discipline in which a devoted warrior hardens their zeal through purifying flame. It sharpens both shielding defense and the vengeful strikes meant to punish wrongdoers.

rites.name: Amauntor Rostes
rites.text: A carved sigil etched onto a wrist guard that lets its wearer channel heat into a narrow, concentrated burst. Those who train with bracers learn to inscribe it.

rites.name: Vistaulum Vesum
rites.text: A sigil etched into footwear that grants its wearer the power to learn a forbidden craft of dark secrets. It is taught through a carved mark placed upon the boots.

rites.name: Amaserus
rites.text: A carved sigil that can be set into a ring, granting its bearer skill with axes. It is learned from a teaching stone and used to refine how the wielder handles the blade.

rites.name: Siaranum Serarniales
rites.text: A sigil carved into rings that teaches the bearer a particular affinity for the wild growing world. It marks the wearer as a student of the green arts.

rites.name: Tentirus
rites.text: A fierce discipline taken by wild shapers who fight with claws. It pairs with a lethal strike technique and cannot be combined with its rival path.

rites.name: Amasus Amernollum
rites.text: A sacred glyph that is inscribed onto chest armor. Its carved knowledge lets a warrior of the holy order perform a radiant rite of light.

rites.name: Valauneosum
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer a shaman's inscription meant to be scribed onto footwear. It lets the wearer learn that ritual mark for boots.

rites.name: Serornellus Lintus
rites.text: A carved mark of inner vigor that wakes when a tarnished stone is pressed against it. It can be set into a worn tome kept within a drifting archive.

rites.name: Nastialles
rites.text: A carved mark set into a helm that teaches its bearer a binding of unstable malice. It is passed among those who practice dark arts.

rites.name: Rostanium Amerastes
rites.text: A sharp-edged glyph used by hidden craftspeople to bind a cloak with a fanning, blade-like ward. It is taught to apprentices who learn to inscribe it.

rites.name: Risanum Valiroses
rites.text: A carved mark taught to warriors that is set into leg armor. It holds the bearer's focus fixed on a single foe.

rites.name: Corinus Ciastausor
rites.text: A short-lived blessing is granted to those who complete a sprawling underground relay race. It briefly quickens the bearer's stride for a limited span of time.

rites.name: Rasinor
rites.text: A carved mark of pale silver that can be inscribed onto arm guards, granting the wearer the ability to call forth gentle lunar flames.

rites.name: Coriallium Larnus
rites.text: A glowing emblem is carved into gloves, allowing the wearer to channel warm fire through the hands. Only trained casters of an ancient order can inscribe it.

rites.name: Nialasum
rites.text: A bound observance that a practitioner performs to draw upon long-held sacred practice. It belongs to a sealed collection of rites tied to a fallen warden.

rites.name: Vollantes
rites.text: A studied art of calling storm-fire into the body, learned through a costly inner awakening. Those who master it may draw its power from a shared wellspring of gathered energy.

rites.name: Serentiria Tinorus
rites.text: A carved mark of gloom that lets a ring-wielder refine their hidden craft. It is taught to apprentices who seek to bend darkness through ringwork.

rites.name: Valintor Mauntes
rites.text: A practiced art of calling out to kin through the grove's quiet hours. It pairs with a companion call, and only one of the two can be chosen.

rites.name: Larestus
rites.text: A carved glyph inscribed on wrist guards that teaches the bearer a fiery spell. It is studied by warlocks who wear it on their bracers.

rites.name: Centarium Valarus
rites.text: A sacred consecration practice taken as a chosen path by a holy warrior, sharing one branch of the decision with a related oath.

rites.name: Sellium Callinium
rites.text: A harsh technique of finishing a foe without mercy, drawn from an old card of an ancient war. It is used to end a battle decisively.

rites.name: Raustia Serirum
rites.text: A sigil inscribed on footwear that grants the wearer the ability to enter a dreaming trance. It is taught to initiates of a sacred order.

rites.name: Orenauntor
rites.text: A bellowing discipline taught by beast handlers to hunters who bond with animal companions. It grants the creature a surge of steadiness in its early trial stage.

rites.name: Montus Amornor
rites.text: A ritual inscription that teaches the carved sign for restoring the wounded to ring-bearers. Students learn to etch it so that their mending craft is shaped and refined.

rites.name: Sinanum Ameornes
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches a ring-bound inscription for focusing sacred gifts. It is set into the band of a ring so the wearer can channel its devotional craft.

rites.name: Nireollum Neseollia
rites.text: A discipline of fire-kindling practices that can be studied by spending a sum of awakening currency. Once learned, it joins the set of powers that can be drawn from a traveling tinker's kit.

rites.name: Coranontia
rites.text: A carved glyph set into headgear that teaches its wearer a precise striking technique. It grants the ability to deliver deliberate, targeted blows.

rites.name: Centeorum Nonestium
rites.text: A carved sigil that imparts a fighting discipline to those who wear rings inscribed with it. Its teaching passes the mark to a wielder's hands in the style of a savage brawler.

rites.name: Ventianium Serolia
rites.text: A carved glyph taught to a wearer of a helm, marking the headgear so that it can be inscribed with a particular mark of violence.

rites.name: Coreollus Cistaranum
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer how to inscribe protective armor for the chest. It is passed along through the training of lion-hearted craftsmen.

rites.name: Oraria Amentaunor
rites.text: An inscribed sigil that grants its bearer skill with long-hafted striking staves when set into a ring. It is taught to those who seek mastery of reach-based combat.

rites.name: Orenilus Neosillia
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches a cloak-binding inscription, letting a wearer call a whirling storm of ember-red wind around themselves.

rites.name: Neoranum Reoses
rites.text: A carved mark that teaches the inscriber a wyrm-diving strike, which is etched into footwear. It is passed between orders of stone-cutters.

rites.name: Vialenum
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer a hidden killing mark for chest armor. The mark is said to belong to those who strike from concealment.

rites.name: Nontialles Nausianus
rites.text: A carved sigil taught to craftsmen that is set into footwear so that the wearer can absorb blows by yielding and shifting with each impact.

rites.name: Colus Teliasia
rites.text: A carved marking worn on the forearm guards that lets a caster call forth a loyal iron sentinel. Its knowledge is passed from one practitioner of the dark arts to the next.

rites.name: Amiales Siror
rites.text: A carved sigil worn on belts that teaches its bearer a throwing technique used by stealthy killers. It grants the skill of hurling small blades with precision.

rites.name: Roria Neosanum
rites.text: A carved glyph that lets a belt be inscribed with a fierce battle-frenzy charm. Those who wear such belts are known to fight with wild, unrestrained fury.

rites.name: Orantes Solium
rites.text: A carved glyph meant to be inscribed on headgear, granting the wearer a surge of fighting strength. It belongs to the lore of thieves who favor swift, cunning combat.

rites.name: Oristia Vasernor
rites.text: A carved glyph inscribed on gloves that teaches the wearer to hurl a rapid flurry of dark energy bolts.

rites.name: Nores Lesistum
rites.text: A carved sigil worn on a wrist guard that teaches its bearer a cleansing charm. The charm may also be drawn out of the glyph itself by a skilled hand.

rites.name: Maunes Orases
rites.text: A carved sigil inscribed on footwear that grants its wearer a guarding ward against harm. Sacred orders teach its shaping to their warriors.

rites.name: Rillauses Valentus
rites.text: A carved mark that is taught to warlocks for placement on cloaks. It is a rune used in the craft of enchanted garments.

rites.name: Mallostor
rites.text: A carved mark that grants its bearer skill with greatsweeping weapons held in both hands. It is inscribed onto the chest plate of armor.

rites.name: Cellus Caranum
rites.text: A carved sigil that is inscribed upon helmets to pass a particular warlock sign onto the wearer. It is a lesson in how the mark is set into headgear.

rites.name: Tirus Serirnes
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches a shifting ward of shielding to be inscribed upon belts. It grants its bearer a flexible defense against harm.

rites.name: Vestaurnor Narnia
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer how to inscribe a justice-bringing mark onto helmets. Such marks belong to the sacred crafts of the devout warrior orders.

rites.name: Telaurantor
rites.text: A carved mark set onto a belt that teaches its bearer a hunter's technique for steadying a drawn shot. It is inscribed on belts by those who train archers.

rites.name: Leosenum
rites.text: A glyph carved for trousers that teaches a sly poisoning mark to whoever learns it. Its inscription grants the wearer the knack of spreading toxin through cloth.

rites.name: Larneolor
rites.text: A carved sigil set into the inside of a helm that grants its wearer the knack of a sly, loyal rogue. It is passed from master to apprentice within secret circles of rogues.

rites.name: Telesor Sereonum
rites.text: A carved glyph that can be inscribed upon a helm. Its inscription teaches the wearer a warrior's furious fighting spirit.

rites.name: Miarus Tasternor
rites.text: A carved mark etched onto wrist guards that grants the wearer a sharper and swifter knack for mending their own wounds in the heat of battle.

rites.name: Vaureollor Mausornum
rites.text: A blessing bestowed on wanderers who prove their worth at several rising ranks. It grants a lasting boost whenever its bearer walks open lands beneath the sky.

rites.name: Serestanum Nornaulum
rites.text: A glyph inscribed on a cloak that allows its wearer to channel a sudden lightning-like force. The inscription is taught to those who study the sacred craft of wardens.

rites.name: Lanerus Tentaunes
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer a rhythmic footwork technique for trousers-wearing duelists. It is used by rogues.

rites.name: Sellor Nastentus
rites.text: A carved sigil set into a wrist guard that teaches its wearer a swift strike learned from cunning hands. Craftsmen sell it to those who study the quick blade.

rites.name: Meornes Veosolum
rites.text: A mark carved into rings that teaches the bearer a focused stillness of the mind. It lets its wearer enter a calm, centered state more readily than others can.

rites.name: Reornes Valeontelia
rites.text: A carved sky-idol that a gathering of hill-keepers calls upon to stir the air. It answers the call of a lesser air-sigil and is said to hold sway over the wild stretches of the outlands.

rites.name: Nestum Sestanum
rites.text: A glyph carved into gloves that teaches the wearer a radiant beacon-of-light technique. It is worn by holy warriors who guide allies with luminous signals.

rites.name: Nillum Veosanum
rites.text: A carved mark meant for gloves that teaches the bearer a way to coax plants into swift, unruly growth. It is set into the palm of handwear.

rites.name: Seriarnanum Vaullostes
rites.text: A carved sigil etched into arm guards that lets the wearer learn a hunting marking. It is taught to those who wear such bracers.

rites.name: Launeolum Nenoria
rites.text: A carved mark taught to craftsmen that imbues helmets with the ability to be prepared for hunting. Those who learn it can apply it to headgear they wear.

rites.name: Nelornor
rites.text: A carved glyph that teaches its bearer how to sharpen a cloak into a rapid barrage of thrown shards. It is passed between wardens who guard the cloak-craft.

rites.name: Lelauntor Nirum
rites.text: A carved mark set into the breastplate of an armor piece, allowing its wearer to learn a dark battle-craft sigil that governs chest-plate tactics.

rites.name: Ciaror Corialasor
rites.text: A carved glyph set into arm guards that grants the wearer a fierce warrior's fury in battle. It can be learned and inscribed onto protective wrist bracers.

rites.name: Riastaulles
rites.text: A carved sigil set into leg plating that teaches its bearer a shrugging, wound-dismissing trick. It is used by rogues who favor taunts over sturdiness.

rites.name: Rirostanum
rites.text: A bound practice taught to nature-keepers, linked to a sworn pairing of two arts. It can only be chosen in place of its paired counterpart.

rites.name: Santus Tolles
rites.text: A carved mark that teaches its bearer a protective inscription meant for footwear. It allows a warrior of holy discipline to inscribe boots with the sacred ward.

rites.name: Oraustium Oronor
rites.text: A carved sigil meant for gloves, which teaches the bearer a spell of unsettling ghostly summoning used by warlocks.

rites.name: Valestintes
rites.text: A carved mark taught to a band of hardened fighters, granting them the ability to shatter structures. Its teaching is reserved for the warrior circle that wields it.

rites.name: Taurnianus Coranaurus
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches a warrior of the holy order how to form a rebuking mark. The mark is used to strike back against those who wrong the sworn knight.

rites.name: Orasum Telistia
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its wearer to strike at exactly the right moment. It is inscribed on belts to sharpen the timing of blows.

rites.name: Telisum Telentus
rites.text: A small carved mark that a traveler presses into a cloak's hem. It grants the wearer the ability to strike swiftly and then vanish before pursuers can respond.

rites.name: Teliror Teornasia
rites.text: A carved mark bound into handwear that teaches its wearer a rapid, swift blow. It is passed along to those who learn to wield it.

rites.name: Tistasor
rites.text: A carved ring-mark that grants its bearer a new skill with distance weapons. Scribes inscribe it onto band-rings, passing the technique to whoever wears them.

rites.name: Tiaseoles Cianum
rites.text: A carved sigil set into chest armor that lets its wearer draw a weapon with greater speed. It is taught to those who follow the rogue arts.

rites.name: Serintenum Amantor
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches a belt-bound inscription for revealing a foe's frailties. Hunters inscribe it onto their waist-bands to learn it.

rites.name: Naria Oraullia
rites.text: A carved sigil worn on bracers that grants the bearer a fiery aura of flame. It is taught as a rune that a warlock can learn for forging such bracers.

rites.name: Tolus Amialus
rites.text: A carved sigil that grants its bearer the power to consume fury and channel it into leg armor. It is taught to those who wear protective greaves.

rites.name: Valolia Vosium
rites.text: A carved glyph that teaches its bearer to strike distant targets with a true aim. It is inscribed upon a breastplate, granting the wearer the discipline of a seasoned hunter.

rites.name: Taurnia Milum
rites.text: A carved mark that can be inscribed onto wrist guards to grant the wearer a ferocious battle technique. Its inscription is taught to those who study bracer craft.

rites.name: Celleostia Taulles
rites.text: A carved mark that is taught to a wearer and sets a protective ward upon the torso of a suit of armor. Its lessons are passed among those who shape the marks.

rites.name: Raulus Coriselus
rites.text: A carved sigil taught to wearers of leg armor, granting them a sharpened sense of aim tied to the brow-ward technique of rogues.

rites.name: Corirnus Noleostor
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer how to inscribe a protective ward onto a cloak. The ward is used by warriors sworn to defend the faithful.

rites.name: Millasia Valornum
rites.text: A discipline of quick-response training practiced by temple wardens, granting a sharpened instinct for striking first. It is chosen alone and pairs with a sudden clash of blades.

rites.name: Nonum Sereoniarus
rites.text: A bellowing war-chant channeled through a sigil card that rouses nearby allies. It is drawn from the battle-hymns of a coastal order's sea-wardens.

rites.name: Meostor Teolium
rites.text: A carved mark taught to craftsmen for stitching onto belts. It is used to restore vitality to the one who wears it.

rites.name: Castia Orarneostia
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer a poisonous mixing charm, which can be inscribed onto a chest plate. It is meant for those who walk the quieter, shadowed paths.

rites.name: Resor Miasor
rites.text: A glyph carved onto garments that lets the wearer draw a mystic cloak of sky-fire around themselves. It is taught through a formal rite of inscription.

rites.name: Tausania
rites.text: A carved glyph that a sacred knight inscribes on a helmet. It grants the wearer a burning zeal for their cause.

rites.name: Vianostanum Viallernor
rites.text: A carved sigil meant for the inside of a helmet. It teaches its bearer a swift hunting strike.

rites.name: Reostontor
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer a rogue-style rune for cloaks. It grants the knowledge of one specific gunpowder-like rune, passed to those who study it.

rites.name: Valastum Teontum
rites.text: A sacred chant that a holy warrior of the light may take as one of two devotions, sharing its place with a rival blessing. The choice binds the warrior to one path of the faith.

rites.name: Ceoralum Vaurium
rites.text: A carved mark that teaches a glowing enchantment to be woven into belts. It lets the wearer channel radiant light through the worn band.

rites.name: Vallus Corallium
rites.text: A carved sigil that sits among four others in the fourth band of a sacred codex. It marks the craft of clever, skilled dexterity.

rites.name: Oroles Vauses
rites.text: A carved mark meant to be inscribed upon gloves, binding a lasting curse to the hands of those who wear it. It is taught to apprentice casters of dark craft.

rites.name: Serostium Amesaurnor
rites.text: A carved sigil that is inscribed upon a waist strap to unlock a particular spell form used by sorcerers. It teaches the bearer how to channel that summoning mark through the band.

rites.name: Teosania
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a bearer's blood-bound aura linger in a place after they leave. Certain hexing cults teach it to their initiates.

rites.name: Viastanum Canternia
rites.text: A carved sigil fitted to a belt that teaches its bearer a battle-shout meant to steady and gather fighters.

rites.name: Corontus Corialeoses
rites.text: A carved sigil of storm-bound power, offered for sale by a merchant on a remote isle. It can also be found among the spoils of rare beasts and hidden chests scattered across the land.

rites.name: Molia Ameostanum
rites.text: A peak gift that ignites those who wield destructive call-craft. While it burns in its bearer, a wild blaze that cannot be bound flows through them.

rites.name: Nilanum Resantor
rites.text: A carved sigil meant for wrist guards, it teaches its bearer how to shift objects from one spot to another. Its inscription is learned through a mage's instruction.

rites.name: Corentianus
rites.text: A carved sigil set into the crown of a helm that lets its wearer learn a fiery backward-rushing spell. Temple scribes teach its inscription to those who wear it.

rites.name: Coranor Amineornum
rites.text: A carved mark of fire that stands in the first row of a great sacred book of symbols. It is paired with one other core mark in that row.

rites.name: Amesteoles
rites.text: A marked glyph taught to hunters that grants the wearer a protective quality for their legs. It is passed on through instruction in tracking and patience.

rites.name: Ceollosium
rites.text: A carved sigil used by temple craftsmen to mark bracers, and it is taught as a formal rune inscription to those who learn the art.

rites.name: Telausia Taularum
rites.text: A carved sigil inscribed on footwear that grants its wearer the stance of a combat fighter. Those who learn it can stand firm in the arena's bloody rhythm.

rites.name: Seornia Corallum
rites.text: A parchment charm inscribed with enchantment that is crafted by a skilled inscriber. It is learned from a written formula and summons a fury of biting insects.

rites.name: Orentes Cellium
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures employ during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used by many of them in those battles.

rites.name: Amaustia Raurollum
rites.text: A tactical hunting craft in which a pack leader's skill is chosen as a paired option alongside suppressive covering fire. It is a mutually exclusive path that trains the leader to split quarry apart.

rites.name: Corantum Tinia
rites.text: A parchment roll that grants a shield against heat-based sorcery. It can be uncovered by decoding certain spellbooks with a reading enchantment.

rites.name: Mosaunanum
rites.text: A bound parchment holding a faint spell of small conjuring, unlocked only when a scholar reads it with a special charm or a deciphering rite. Its written magic is copied out of sealed arcane sheets.

rites.name: Amianor Toles
rites.text: A tightly rolled sheet of inked parchment that a scholar unlocks through a speech-charm. It reshapes a mage's own enchanted blade into a stronger form, but only for the one who carries it.

rites.name: Ceonesus
rites.text: A bound roll of cursed vellum traded by a roaming peddler along a distant eastern trail. Reading it calls forth a dark sentinel, but the reader must surrender part of their own life force to do so.

rites.name: Coreornia Teleolintor
rites.text: Brittle sheets of inscribed parchment kept in a sacred hall of countless lamps. Touching one bestows a new ready-action to the bearer.

rites.name: Mostium Corernus
rites.text: A parchment of earth-current lore that is unlocked when a mage's script is read through a understanding talisman. Applied to a power nexus, it calls forth a furious ground-walker.

rites.name: Tastus Siarnor
rites.text: A bound parchment that teaches its reader a dark spirit-summoning skill. Only priests of the order may study it.

rites.name: Mernia Vaunialles
rites.text: A bound parchment kept in a hidden sanctum among the shadows. Whoever handles it gains a fleeting power that briefly binds the pain of others to the bearer.

rites.name: Siallia Merontes
rites.text: A parchment rests on the frozen ground in a high cold pass. Whoever touches it gains a brief surge that hurls them far upward when they leap, though the landing still breaks them.

rites.name: Sereorisia Soranum
rites.text: A sealed parchment used in trial rites that bestows a set of temporary blessings on whoever it touches. Each blessing grants its bearer a surge of might, luck, or resolve for a short span.

rites.name: Costeontia
rites.text: A parchment roll kept within a hidden stronghold of shadows. Touching its text grants its bearer a brief protective power.

rites.name: Veollinum
rites.text: A sacred roll that grants clerics a new inner endurance. Once read, the hymn written on it lets its reader gain the knack of steadier resilience.

rites.name: Orolus Caurilum
rites.text: A brittle parchment that is seldom uncovered when a scholar unravels certain sorcerer writings using a understanding charm. It preserves a faint sense of exact spellcasting.

rites.name: Mernium Oranaullium
rites.text: A sudden burst of storm-gathered force that a caster may unleash to strike at once. It belongs to a deck of tidal craft.

rites.name: Nasinum
rites.text: A stumbling charge that a dead-flesh creature uses in place of a leap while its body is changing into something darker. It lets the creature keep moving forward when it would otherwise spring.

rites.name: Ciasanum Teleosanum
rites.text: A slow-acting toxic art that a practitioner can spread through the body over time. It is drawn from a card-based craft of tidal sorcery.

rites.name: Nosaulor
rites.text: A devout caster binds a restless or unnatural foe in spectral fetters, halting its movement and its strikes for as long as the rite holds. The bindings are plainly visible, wrapping the creature in iron-like loops.

rites.name: Tiantum Coreoriales
rites.text: A hidden craft of cloaked sorcerers that lets a practitioner summon a searing bolt of dark fire while the art remains in force.

rites.name: Cesium Saullarnium
rites.text: A discipline practiced only by a certain order of contemplative healers. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival vigor art.

rites.name: Tilles Telores
rites.text: A sacred mark a holy warrior can invoke, granted through a binding scripture that teaches the sacrifice of one's own life. It is passed on only to those who have studied that teaching.

rites.name: Risternum Relus
rites.text: A mental craft practiced by ritual keepers of the dark arts, chosen as a mutually exclusive path that works alongside a related inner corruption.

rites.name: Taulus Tesarium
rites.text: A chosen discipline of the hunter-archers of the night. Practitioners pick it from a branching path of skills, and it cannot be taken alongside the rival calling of the moon-bound hunt.

rites.name: Sinaulium
rites.text: A ritual inscription that a caster learns from a sacred mark and carves onto a band worn on the finger. It grants the wearer a focused affinity for the darkness of concealment.

rites.name: Nelliria
rites.text: A guarding discipline taught to tracker-warriors, where a chosen skill is set against a counterpart and granted only to those who take it alone. It is paired with a silent, shut-eyed practice.

rites.name: Liantor Telianorus
rites.text: A devotee's gift that lets a temple caster unleash a scorching frenzy. It is drawn from a mind-bending talent granted to the faithful.

rites.name: Sinaustia
rites.text: A chosen discipline of the fire-kindled casters, in which a practitioner settles on one path of ember craft instead of another. It stands opposed to a rival wayfaring discipline and cannot be held alongside it.

rites.name: Nases Amantus
rites.text: A dark rune-curse drawn from a shadowed script, used as a single binding ritual. It spreads a creeping rot through whatever it is scribed upon.

rites.name: Serenor Neores
rites.text: A companion gift that lets a bonded beast strike with quickened motion. It rewards close partnership between keeper and creature.

rites.name: Amentia Cornum
rites.text: A sacred gift of scorching radiance granted to a guardian sworn to shield others. Taking it means forgoing a rival blessing that answers the same calling.

rites.name: Mistiantium Oreontium
rites.text: A glove-bound rune that releases a rapid burst of dark projectiles. It is learned from a carved inscription that teaches the shadow-casting technique.

rites.name: Rallontium
rites.text: A temporary blessing that can be found inside large sealed chests. It lasts a single day or until the bearer finishes another underground descent.

rites.name: Valanisium
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a caretaker of wild beasts draws a choice of two arts, one of which is a venom-tipped strike. Taking one art closes the other.

rites.name: Caunes Seristum
rites.text: A dark offering rite hidden within a civic hall beneath a robed brotherhood of void-keepers. Practitioners of the hidden arts use it to call forth a wandering shadow-stalker from the emptiness.

rites.name: Orausiallia
rites.text: A bundle of rites gathered for those who strip hides from slain beasts. Each rite hones a blade before the work begins.

rites.name: Oriarnanum Mernausium
rites.text: A creature-bonded art in which a tamed companion draws the spirit from a rival during a contest of beasts. The drained essence then strengthens the one who took it.

rites.name: Telintor Vialles
rites.text: A spectral stalker bound to a dead warrior's will performs a sudden strike from the shadows. The lash was once a companion's trick, now lost to the ages.

rites.name: Teleornium Cauror
rites.text: A restorative bathing rite that a muddy clay-wrapped creature performs while contesting a contest of beasts. It calms the bather and mends its strength in the middle of the fray.

rites.name: Teornus Corarnum
rites.text: A coated charm that can be laid over a blade to infuse it with night-sorcery. Its craft is passed down through a written recipe that a skilled enchanter must learn first.

rites.name: Raulia Cianoria
rites.text: A sacred chant offered as a reward for those who finish a mission of driving back intruders. It is given to warriors who complete the task.

rites.name: Ventonium Sereorelium
rites.text: A sudden burst of martial readiness that a hardened mountain warrior can call upon. It is a rare gift that only a single calling of ridge-fighters may claim, and it pairs with a sky-related gift.

rites.name: Valiales Vonistes
rites.text: A ritual sign granted to the ones who walk the old grove paths. Striking the flame-light calls the cold moon to rise and answer it.

rites.name: Nalirnium
rites.text: A ritual technique of ending a foe's life in a single cruel stroke. It is recorded among the sealed rites of a buried crypt-order.

rites.name: Tiarnium Ameosor
rites.text: A reagent ground from spiritual residue, used to fashion ink-based wards. Scribes learn its preparation from a master once their rune craft reaches a set level.

rites.name: Valania Amintus
rites.text: A caster's craft that lets a practitioner choose between two arts at a single crossroads of study. Taking it closes off the other path, and it pairs with a companion skill called Veymer's Glance.

rites.name: Coriastorum
rites.text: A binding craft that snares a departing spirit inside a sealed vessel. The trapped essence remains bound there until the seal is broken.

rites.name: Coriantenes Nisium
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a caster draw lingering vitality out of restless dead flesh. It is recorded as a single technique bound to the grave-lore of an ancient sealed tomb.

rites.name: Telosialum
rites.text: A hidden discipline of cautious spirit-keeping, chosen as one path that excludes its rival. It stands alongside a calamity-spreading craft and cannot be held together with it.

rites.name: Testia Seriantia
rites.text: A ritual discipline that washes a practitioner's inner spirit clean of hostile presences. It can only be taken as a sole choice, opposed to the fiery purging path.

rites.name: Coreornelum
rites.text: A dark practitioner's technique that is learned alongside a related rite of spirit exchange. It is used by casters who have mastered the companion practice.

rites.name: Telaurnanum Valirnia
rites.text: A hidden strongbox on a seaside trade shore, sealed behind a barrel of blasting powder. It holds a carved rune that teaches a dancing sword technique.

rites.name: Ameoranum Telostiarum
rites.text: A single-minded discipline of the green stone that binds a wandering adept to one chosen path. Once the vow is taken, no other road may be walked alongside it.

rites.name: Oroselor Vinanum
rites.text: A dark ember is drawn from a sapping rite performed beside a marsh overseer. Offered at a hungry idol, it grants a rune that hurls shadow bolts.

rites.name: Tontia Nernolus
rites.text: A ritual sounding performed to attune a beast to its rider. The chime is struck until the creature answers, teaching it to respond to a particular call.

rites.name: Valiantia Reostus
rites.text: A patient kindling discipline practiced by ember-wielding adepts. It is held as an either-or path opposing a rival rite of total immolation.

rites.name: Laules Colanum
rites.text: A watchful inner pattern that is awakened once a violet-hued creature of a soft-backed kind has been called forth. It stays alert and steady in its bearer.

rites.name: Variantia
rites.text: A guardian talent that lets a wild-grove keeper call upon the living spirit of the undergrowth. Practitioners of the sacred grove draw on it as a mark of their hard-won calling.

rites.name: Amantes Carniastium
rites.text: A tempest-born technique that a small wind-spirit unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. Its gusts are used to challenge a rival in combat.

rites.name: Nernium Sanus
rites.text: A rising surge of tide-wind that a chosen caster can call forth, and which a rival sworn path bars them from taking alongside another mighty gift.

rites.name: Launtia Lianontus
rites.text: A temporary blessing granted by a hive-keeper that quickens the bearer's movements with every foe felled. It also lets the bearer leap a second time in midair while within the wastes, lasting until another blessing replaces it.

rites.name: Telaustor Ceonornus
rites.text: A discipline of unyielding footing that a fighter may pick as an either-or path against a rival technique. It rewards those who refuse to be moved.

rites.name: Vornanum Nantolia
rites.text: A hidden glyph that lies unseen on the ground and holds nearby foes in place when they step close. It breaks apart once its paralysis has been unleashed, and a shaman's rite can call it forth.

rites.name: Rernum Nanus
rites.text: A calling-talent granted to wandering seers of the spirit path, bestowed as a gift for those who walk between worlds. It belongs to the shamanic craft and marks a seer's advancement.

rites.name: Niantus Ameolum
rites.text: A sworn warrior's trained discipline that holds firm against dark forces. It is chosen in place of a rival sacred technique, binding the practitioner to a single path.

rites.name: Ciarentes
rites.text: A carved mark of heat-bound script that is taught to scribes for lacing into breastplates. It fixes the wearer's armor with a faint warming power.

rites.name: Voriallum Neontestor
rites.text: A fleeting surge of fury that a bearer may call upon in battle. It is drawn from a single card-bound reserve of wrath.

rites.name: Serirnium Oriarnia
rites.text: A taught craft in which a frost-rune is inscribed upon footwear and paired with a mind-sharpening charm, enabling the wearer to loose an icy bolt.

rites.name: Nianteostia Valirnium
rites.text: A sudden, defensive bodily posture that a practitioner can assume in an instant to take on the sturdiness of a great beast.

rites.name: Neollus Valiasintia
rites.text: A tempest-binding craft that lets a wind-shaper channel their sky-fury into sharper strikes. Its practitioners rely on it to deal heavier blows in combat.

rites.name: Varor Coraleorium
rites.text: A ward-script that is inscribed upon footwear to hold the wearer in an unchanging state. The lesson for it is kept among the sealed notes of the order.

rites.name: Telilantes Amantes
rites.text: A standing rite that is laid over a delving ground, changing the wild things that dwell within it. It is bound to a single pit of old diggings, altering whatever stirs in its depths.

rites.name: Verniasus Viasteontor
rites.text: A glyph inscribed on gloves that teaches the bearer how to channel a volatile burst of living fire. It is used as a rune for handwear.

rites.name: Mauseonor Oriasauntor
rites.text: A binding rite that replaces the three elemental forces while it holds, letting the caster steer the spirits onto one chosen target.

rites.name: Ceores Teollores
rites.text: A carved sigil that can be learned and inscribed onto wrist guards, granting the wearer a fiery projectile craft.

rites.name: Ceosium Seoraurnium
rites.text: A carved mark of the wielding arts that teaches a sigil meant to be inscribed on headgear. It is recorded in study notes for those who practice inscription.

rites.name: Telintia Naustanum
rites.text: A ward drawn from the heavens that reproduces an older starfire effect. It is a practice of the star-tending orders, passed on after its original form was lost.

rites.name: Contum Corerolia
rites.text: A binding rune inscribed on footwear that, paired with a mind-sharpening ward, lets the wearer grasp a chilling arcane bolt.

rites.name: Lirneorum
