rites.text: A withering blight that gnaws away at a bearer's inner essence. Its mastery is unlocked by proving one's standing among a particular band of allied warriors.

rites.name: Orollirnes
rites.text: A sacred talent drawn by the temple orders, where a chosen cleric takes a single exclusive path of divine calling. It is tied to the faith's advanced vows of self-fulfillment.

rites.name: Vostarnor
rites.text: A fighting discipline that only the rage-driven war-adepts can learn. Those who follow other martial paths receive separate, different gifts instead.

rites.name: Nostaurus
rites.text: A flicker of inspired insight that a thinker can call upon to sharpen their craft. It belongs to a sealed archive of ancient lore.

rites.name: Viastia Tiasanum
rites.text: A ritual gift that a chosen practitioner receives from a supreme crowning talent. It lets the bearer call upon a particular craft of hidden sway.

rites.name: Valelaranum Marornus
rites.text: A venom technique once taught by beast-handlers to their hunting companions during an early trial period. It lets a tamed creature weaken prey with a dose of toxin.

rites.name: Vinantus
rites.text: A borrowed might drawn from a great dark beast, granted to a devoted monk who channels heavenly power through their body.

rites.name: Corontia Ristia
rites.text: A hero talent drawn from warriors of the high peaks, granting a warrior the steady might of a mountain. It belongs to the mountain-bred fighting traditions.

rites.name: Amesus Valarus
rites.text: A rite of the storm-shamans that channels rising tides of wild force through a chosen path of the initiate. It stands as an exclusive choice, bound closely to the bond of living guardianship.

rites.name: Meontium Ristenanum
rites.text: A savage raking sweep of hooked talons that replaces a creature's ordinary claw strike while it is changed into its monstrous form. When a pack grows large enough, the lesser beasts share this same ruinous swipe.

rites.name: Corilor Viasia
rites.text: A grove-keeper's inherited gift that draws wild woodland creatures toward a chosen caller. It belongs to the circle of tree-tenders who guard sacred groves.

rites.name: Tillares
rites.text: A quiet, innate instinct shared by one people that sharpens their harm against creatures of the deep, beasts, and elemental forces. It deepens the gains they earn from such foes.

rites.name: Neonor Vastes
rites.text: A binding oath-craft that a guardian may take in one of two forms, each form excluding the other. It is paired with the sworn art of judgment.

rites.name: Reornollus
rites.text: A dark rite that lets a caster call forth a towering demon attendant from a grimoire's pages. The summoned creature serves the one who speaks the binding.

rites.name: Rostes Amiarnillor
rites.text: A ritual binding used by oath-sworn casters to call a smoldering hound from another plane. Its power is drawn from a mark carved into the caster's skin.

rites.name: Veontenia
rites.text: A bound grimoire holding strong battle glyphs that a caster can wield in fighting. It rests in a scholars' vault on a far island, and it grants entry to a larger compendium of sigils.

rites.name: Valestia Seontistia
rites.text: A battle discipline that a fighter learns through training in one of several mutually exclusive paths. It works alongside a particular combat technique called Crushing Combo.

rites.name: Telaurum Coralus
rites.text: A specialized skill that a hunter may select at a fork of training. It can only be taken as an alternative to a particular cord-binding technique.

rites.name: Tarium Oralaunes
rites.text: A bound book kept in a hidden tent within a dim sanctuary. Whoever reads it gains a brief power to call forth a furious void-stalker.

rites.name: Seostillia Rialontium
rites.text: A quick mental knack that lets a ritual keeper call back a guardian spirit's bond at once. It can only be chosen alongside a towering spirit-effigy.

rites.name: Amestia Leostia
rites.text: A dark binding craft practiced by caster-adepts, drawn as a sealed choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival rite of offering.

rites.name: Coriantium Nerniaria
rites.text: A ritual discipline that lets a keeper of spirits bind a protective ward into their healing rites. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path alongside a rival energy-storing discipline.

rites.name: Masternia Vollanus
rites.text: A ritual craft used by spiritual casters that calls forth a bound spirit companion of the elements. It can only be learned once a practitioner reaches a high level of mastery and is unlocked through a special sigil.

rites.name: Valiastia Oraustanum
rites.text: A bound ritual rite is recorded upon a stone altar within a hidden dark sanctum. Whoever handles the sealed book gains a brief power to call forth a wrathful sealed spirit.

rites.name: Taullia Vallum
rites.text: A bonded surge of battle-fervor that a hunter may take as an exclusive choice, sharing a path with the Ferocity of the wild.

rites.name: Mauranum Vasia
rites.text: A carved slab that once would have imparted the third tier of a storm-calling art. It exists only in an early trial form, never finished for general use.

rites.name: Oreontia Amanium
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline that lets a caster choose between two growths that sprout from the same wild fungal rite. Taking one closes off the other.

rites.name: Liranum Nialornium
rites.text: A sacred teaching that grants holy warriors a power for driving out unwanted spirits. It is passed down to paladins who train in the practice.

rites.name: Vinium Valaurnus
rites.text: A ritual sign that gathers scattered energy into a dense point. It is said to be found in a far island's deep sanctum.

rites.name: Cerneontum
rites.text: A practiced skill of the sly wanderers, a finely honed technique that is chosen alongside a rival art so that the two cannot both be taken. It marks a fighter who strikes many times in quick succession.

rites.name: Coraustor Amosastanum
rites.text: A discipline taught to spellcasters that trains them to hold heat and cold within their bodies. Only those who have already mastered severe temperatures may take up this path.

rites.name: Telialastus
rites.text: A companion creature delivers a crushing blow during a contest between beasts, using a mighty technique that smashes its rival.

rites.name: Amastor Lalia
rites.text: A sacred writ that instructs holy knights in a binding seal of self-sacrifice. Those who master it can channel their final stand into a protective rite.

rites.name: Leontianum
rites.text: A mind-to-mind art lets practitioners send thoughts directly into another person's awareness without spoken words. It works through the inner senses rather than the air.

rites.name: Naulium Orauntirnum
rites.text: A dreaded war-cry technique that a warrior unleashes to unsettle foes. It is recorded as a card in a collection of tomb-born relics.

rites.name: Coriarnanum Corastium
rites.text: A quiet craft that sows hesitation in a bound servant's mind, making it question its orders. The hesitation lingers long after the moment has passed.

rites.name: Valestia Corialor
rites.text: A disciplined inner craft taught within sacred halls, where a chosen path of study is pursued to the exclusion of rival teachings. It is bound to a guiding spirit of the heavens.

rites.name: Tirnus Oreles
rites.text: A discipline of inner steadiness taught to ritual practitioners. It is chosen as a fixed path, and it pairs with a reflexive protective ward.

rites.name: Orelor Tosia
rites.text: A battle-cry technique used by a fighter to call out a rival. It is practiced by warriors of the ancient orders.

rites.name: Caurnosanum
rites.text: A temple-wide blessing granted to a band of wanderers once they master poison-river fishing. It lets them cast lines into the most perilous waters of a serpent shrine, revealing hidden pools of toxic catches.

rites.name: Telauror Oronantium
rites.text: A bestowed skill of the sky-lords that lets a bearer draw upon the currents of air during a contest of arms. It is recorded among the sacred gifts of the elemental orders.

rites.name: Corenilanum
rites.text: A carved sign that lets its bearer sound a piercing blast from a curved shell. It is taught by fallen guardians found on a sunless isle beyond time.

rites.name: Valestus Vistes
rites.text: A sacred gift granted to a chosen guardian of the wild, letting a shapeshifting caster draw on the lunar light of a celestial mother. It is a lasting blessing that shapes how such a caster fights and heals.

rites.name: Oraustor Telilanum
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a practitioner binds a charged sky-force to a single sworn oath. Adepts who take it must forsake one rival discipline and can only walk the path that resonates with their chosen element.

rites.name: Amantium Teolirnes
rites.text: A fire-bound mark that a wandering crafter can draw to wreathe a hand in coiling flame. The sigil is found by chance in the wild rather than taught by any order.

rites.name: Tarneostium
rites.text: A spellcraft that lets a caster vanish and reappear within a distant shining capital. It is practiced by those trained in the arcane arts.

rites.name: Valaurnum Corentanum
rites.text: A ritual gift of shielding drawn from the sea, granted to a chosen healer through a sacred blessing of aid. It lets the bearer protect allies from harm.

rites.name: Vauntelum Vaurolus
rites.text: A sacred teaching that grants holy knights the power to summon a celestial mount. It is passed down to paladins as a discovered skill.

rites.name: Velanum Naustorium
rites.text: A sacred teaching that grants the devoted warriors of the order a surge of righteous fury, empowering their strikes against the wicked for a short time.

rites.name: Vianisanum Vintes
rites.text: A ritual inscription that a wandering performer can draw to make water vanish into the air. Such marks are sometimes found among the belongings of a fleeting dancer from remote islands.

rites.name: Nenor Oraulum
rites.text: A stirring of boundary-keeping drive that a stalker may awaken, exclusive of a rival battle-cry; the two cannot both be chosen.

rites.name: Rinialium Oreronanum
rites.text: A stubborn skill of the hunter's craft that marks the trail-seeker's aim. It is chosen in place of a rival path and works alongside a sly, cunning knack.

rites.name: Tausires
rites.text: A practitioner's gift that lets them break the ground beneath a foe. It is a rare path that cannot be taken alongside the echoing tremor that follows.

rites.name: Serilernum Teorniales
rites.text: A ward-smith's oath-craft that hardens a sworn champion through the strain of combat. It sits beside a rival discipline of judging speech within the same training choice.

rites.name: Sarneorium
rites.text: A carved sign that is found on creatures of the wild lands. It is learned by a practitioner who wishes to drive out spirits.

rites.name: Telosilium Lastor
rites.text: A sacred gale-trait that a bearer may take in a sealed rite, but only one of several rival blessings can be chosen at once.

rites.name: Sirnaustia Vauleranum
rites.text: A bound token of smoldering heat that a wielder can call upon for a single surge of power. It is drawn from the old war-cycle of the elemental orders.

rites.name: Leorolium
rites.text: A trained hunting companion's technique for severing an opponent's binding cords, taught by beasts-keepers during a trial period of the craft.

rites.name: Mosteones
rites.text: A sigil-craft that a trader in a dreamscape offers for sale. It is taught as a learnable technique.

rites.name: Tiantes Orenum
rites.text: A taught skill that is gained from certain restless spirits found in a remote isle. It is recovered when those wandering ghosts are defeated.

rites.name: Mirus Cenum
rites.text: A binding craft that lets an artisan inscribe a sleeping guardian pact onto cloth. The practice is passed on to those trained in marking surfaces with script.

rites.name: Veosistium Orellia
rites.text: A lingering glow that a caster's healing rites leave upon allies, quietly mending their wounds over time. It flares when the caster draws on restorative magic.

rites.name: Vernostanum
rites.text: A carved sigil that can be inscribed to make a false appearance hold steady over time. It is a craft drawn from the ways of cloaked sorcerers.

rites.name: Liarnestes Molirium
rites.text: A sworn talent of the masked blade-dancers that lets their wielders draw strength from battle. It is practiced by the hunters of shadow-born foes.

rites.name: Nontia Amiarirnia
rites.text: A ritual inscription that is found among the spoils of the wild lands. It is said to carry a rot-bearing craft that sickens whoever is marked by it.

rites.name: Raulor Teleornes
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a shaman binds several carved guardians into one shared rhythm. The practitioner must choose it instead of a rival rite, since the two cannot be practiced together.

rites.name: Ciastus Ceolium
rites.text: A coiling burst of ritual flame that a shaman may call forth from a sealed card of the twilight dragon rites. It is a craft drawn from ancient temple lore.

rites.name: Amelor Cisanum
rites.text: A discipline reserved for one order of wandering ascetics who train their bodies to channel a wild inner strength. The other two orders are taught a different practice instead.

rites.name: Amenes Niallaurium
rites.text: A tutor's secret lore teaches a warrior sigil inked onto travelling cloaks. Its bearers gain a fatal, swift-striking edge.

rites.name: Liaronanum Veosoria
rites.text: A bound codex of sorcery that a foe leaves behind when it falls in the ruined crypts of a forgotten sanctum. It holds a spell for hurling bolts of magical force at enemies.

rites.name: Telirnaunum Losteles
rites.text: A bound volume of sealed pages that instructs spellcasters in how to cast a drowsing enchantment. Its teachings grant practitioners the power to lull others into slumber.

rites.name: Terium Cialium
rites.text: A bound book of glowing scripts that teaches hunters how to call up a sudden blaze of enchanted light. Its pages reveal the technique to those who study it closely.

rites.name: Oriastium Serintia
rites.text: A written teaching that instructs hunters in a particular ability modeled on a serpent's nature. It guides practitioners in mastering the technique so they can apply it in the field.

rites.name: Caunanum Siarnerus
rites.text: A ritual craft that reshapes raw wild energy into small glowing sparks of light. Practitioners unlock its method through a specific set of prepared components at a sacred vessel.

rites.name: Valileontum
rites.text: A monk's hard-won talent of inner harmony that is chosen as an exclusive branch, locking out a rival thunderous calling taken from the heavens above.

rites.name: Oreornia Leoles
rites.text: Frayed pages of incantation are recovered from apprentice ice-casters once they are warmed by flame and their binding is loosened. Four such scraps combine to form a sheet that teaches a fiery surge of heat.

rites.name: Lintaria Tilia
rites.text: A ritual sigil inscribed on a breastplate that lets a wearer's hands wield heavy blades with greater skill. It is gained through study of a separate inscribed token.

rites.name: Lantolor Soria
rites.text: A stalker's gift that lets the pursuer keep pressing the hunt without tiring. It is one of two mutually exclusive choices that shape how a leader drives their pack.

rites.name: Oranteosium
rites.text: A devotional craft taught to cloistered brothers, letting a practitioner bind their inner spirit to another. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside the rite of Escape.

rites.name: Vauntinium Nontus
rites.text: A grove-keeper's talent that lets a wild druid call upon tree guardians bathed in silver light. It draws strength from the night sky and ties the caster to the forest's ancient protectors.

rites.name: Orianolum
rites.text: A written teaching that instructs hunters in a sharp-sighted aerial aspect, letting them draw on keen vision and swift strikes. It is passed among those who track prey.

rites.name: Maurnorum
rites.text: A temple-trained sorcery that drives a warped spike of thought into a foe's mind. It is drawn from the order's deck of rites and cast by its priests.

rites.name: Mernes Telaurium
rites.text: A disciplined technique of ritual movement that lets a practitioner step outside the ordinary flow of hours. It is chosen as one path among several and is bound to a related craft of reshaping the sequence of events.

rites.name: Sales Coraurnium
rites.text: A bound codex of dream-craft that teaches a fourth tier of slumber-binding to those who study it. Only trained casters may read its pages.

rites.name: Cinum Terollanum
rites.text: A bound codex that instructs practitioners in the second tier of a sleep-inducing art. Mages study its pages to advance their command over slumber.

rites.name: Amontor Neliror
rites.text: A dark inner craft that a wielder draws from hoarded essence stored in a sunken spire of torment. It lets the user choose what to refuse to see.

rites.name: Millus Reornistum
rites.text: A bound book meant to teach a magical craft for forming a crystal from raw energy. Its title misleads readers, since the craft it teaches differs from what the cover suggests.

rites.name: Oralia Varestanum
rites.text: A bound book of instruction that teaches its reader the eighth level of a mage's art for summoning water. It is written for those who already command the lower stages of that craft.

rites.name: Ventes Sonelum
rites.text: A chilling talent that the death knight orders of a grim faith cultivate, allowing a warrior to channel bitter frost into deadly strikes. It marks its bearer as a herald of ruin.

rites.name: Leontialus
rites.text: A written teaching sets out a hunter's method for drawing on a lion-like inner courage. It instructs those who track and hunt in the craft of this ability.

rites.name: Neornor Sestiarnum
rites.text: A calming discipline practiced by reclusive mist-keepers, who choose it instead of a rival rite of the same order. It is bound to a specific ward that cannot be taken alongside another.

rites.name: Amiallernia
rites.text: A bound volume of arcane instruction that was meant to teach a spell for drawing forth magical stone. Its contents describe a different gemstone than its title suggests.

rites.name: Coriarontum Amauntanum
rites.text: A hunter's craft that binds a marksman's skill to a chosen bird companion. It can only be taken alongside a bird-keeping specialization, offering a mutually exclusive path.

rites.name: Leostium Ceostintus
rites.text: A bound volume of arcane lessons that instructs spellcasters in the third rank of a slumber-inducing art. It guides practitioners through the craft of lulling others into sleep.

rites.name: Amirnium Nernes
rites.text: A dread blessing that empowers every foe within a sacred delve while a dusk-binding rite holds sway. Chieftains of the depths may also call forth crimson orbs of a hungry spirit.

rites.name: Lalinia Serirnalles
rites.text: A card-bound rite that a holy warrior may invoke to bend radiant power into a crooked, unexpected shape. It is recorded as one of the sacred tokens of an ancient dragon-age vigil.

rites.name: Corenum Teleorium
rites.text: A ferocious inner rage that a tracker can awaken as a chosen path, and it is set against a keen blade-edge in the same discipline.

rites.name: Montum Orosaurum
rites.text: A learned discipline granted to storm-keepers who channel tempests in a sustained way. It is taken alongside another practice, and a keeper must choose between the two paths.

rites.name: Lintor Siasellium
rites.text: A discipline of inner harmony taught to devout initiates of the celestial orders. It lets a single practitioner channel the strength of heavenly forces through their own body.

rites.name: Valaustor Sentanum
rites.text: A relentless blaze that a winged beast can call upon while it contends in a contest against another tamed creature. It keeps burning without pause through the bout.

rites.name: Ameollauses
rites.text: A dreaming insight that lets a caster inscribe a restorative sigil onto a sash or girdle. Mastery comes only after a trance is induced by commanding a sea-cult acolyte's mind and then turning that focus inward.

rites.name: Laleornus Visteoria
rites.text: A flickering defensive barrier that a burrowing beast raises during a contest between tamed companions. It shields its user in combat while its hold on the fight stays unpredictable.

rites.name: Valolanum Sereollanum
rites.text: A fierce bodily skill that warriors learn as a chosen path, held in exclusive opposition to a related pursuit technique. It can be taken by only one of the two.

rites.name: Coriaraunia Leontaurum
rites.text: A disciplined warrior tradition taught to fighters of the highland guard. It is a mutually exclusive path that pairs with the storm-blade art.

rites.name: Mauntor Corintus
rites.text: A carved sigil meant for footwear, taught through a sudden moment of bleak revelation. Those who learn it can etch it onto the soles of their boots.

rites.name: Veostes Lirnium
rites.text: A fighter's inner courage that is learned from a sacred manual. It lets a warrior draw strength when facing peril.

rites.name: Mosanum Siallus
rites.text: A quiet blessing drawn from living green growth, sustaining allies over the course of a struggle. It is a craft shared among the moss-keepers of the sunken marshes.

rites.name: Nerum Ameonolus
rites.text: A flexible form of prophecy practiced by temple seers, chosen as a branch of study that pairs with keen far-sight. It cannot be learned alongside one other particular gift.

rites.name: Tonanum Ameollanum
rites.text: A sworn discipline of the devout guardians, taken as a single chosen oath. It cannot be combined with its rival vow, binding the holder to one sacred path of shielding.

rites.name: Valintes Vestollanum
rites.text: A sworn technique in which a warrior answers a wrong with a single retaliatory blow. It is recorded among the battle-rites taught to members of a devoted order.

rites.name: Tiaserus
rites.text: A discipline of inner fire that a brewing-monk adept chooses in place of a rival path. It cannot be held alongside the spirit-waking practice.

rites.name: Vauniantes
rites.text: A seasoned fighter's enduring stamina, granted to warriors who have chosen it over a rival path of hardened resilience. Taking it closes off that other choice.

rites.name: Cestes Tiarnaustum
rites.text: A discipline of inner focus that only the contemplative mist-keepers of the order may learn. Other sworn practitioners are given different inner gifts instead.

rites.name: Valaurilium Amelistanum
rites.text: A sacred craft of unleashing waves of raw water-force from a bearer's hands. It is taught to initiates through a set of heavenly relics.

rites.name: Toselia Selium
rites.text: A quiet inborn gift of the earthen folk that triples the learning drawn from each newly found place. It works without any effort on the bearer's part.

rites.name: Telolirum
rites.text: A hunter's craft drawn from the green wilds, taught to certain nature-keepers of the order. It lets a practitioner move through the wild growth with heightened skill.

rites.name: Riantes Teoristia
rites.text: A fire-caster's gift that once took the place of a simpler blasting skill, though a later revision restored the older technique. It belongs to the craft of those who wield flame.

rites.name: Telises Saullinum
rites.text: A hidden discipline of the woodland seekers, taught to those who walk the wild paths and sustain their keepers through long pursuits.

rites.name: Coreonistes Millanus
rites.text: A tempest-born instinct that a tamed companion draws upon during a contest of beasts. It lets the creature unleash its untamed fury in the midst of a duel.

rites.name: Coraulor Cirnostia
rites.text: A clinging trait that spreads across a few particular underground hollows. It marks those hollows as places where the silk-like growth thickens.

rites.name: Seoraunum
rites.text: A withering blight that drains the strength of the living, lending a grim gift to those who wield dark death magic. It is a talent of the Riders, a chosen order of fallen warriors.

rites.name: Tilaurnanum
rites.text: A hunter's trained knack for landing heavy blows, one that competes for the same space as a brutal clawing technique. Taking one forecloses the other.

rites.name: Orisellium Ciantor
rites.text: A craft of unstable enchantment practiced by mages who choose it over steadier arts. It cannot be taken alongside a certain other discipline.

rites.name: Ciarnes Rianes
rites.text: A tempest of untamed fury that a bearer can call upon from a sealed burial chamber. It is drawn from a relic buried in forgotten ground.

rites.name: Rilanum Celaria
rites.text: A ritual discipline practiced by keepers of the sky-circle. It is chosen in place of Orbital Strike, and the two cannot be learned together.

rites.name: Liaronor Casia
rites.text: A hunter's inherited gift that lets the bearer call forth a mournful arrow. Those who study it say it carries the grief of the restless fallen.

rites.name: Leostontor
rites.text: A living craft that draws rough green strength up from the soil. It is practiced by sea-dwelling sages who channel the power through tangled growth.

rites.name: Cornum Siantum
rites.text: A discipline taught to ritual channelers that lets them awaken a sharpened arc of crackling force, a gift that refines their inner strength.

rites.name: Reorisum Rernillus
rites.text: A discipline of spinning blade-work practiced by temple monks. It is taken as a single exclusive path, chosen in place of a rival training that foresees an opponent's moves.

rites.name: Telorum Sarus
rites.text: A discipline practiced by ascetic keepers of balance who choose it as a fixed branch of training. It can only be taken in place of a rival discipline that restores the spirit.

rites.name: Siasor Sinium
rites.text: A dormant renewal craft that a caster may awaken to restore vigor to living growth. It is recorded as belonging to a forgotten sealed tomb cycle.

rites.name: Tirum Seralleonia
rites.text: A grove-keeper's discipline that binds a single chosen thorn-growth to a sworn guardian. It cannot be taken alongside its rival path.

rites.name: Coranosor
rites.text: A protective enchantment that shields a chosen bearer with a surge of sacred force. When foes without faith draw near, the ward strikes back at them.

rites.name: Nenus Sornes
rites.text: A sudden tide of untamed energy that a shapeshifting practitioner can call upon. It is chosen as an exclusive path, excluding a rival empowerment of the same craft.

rites.name: Coroles Saror
rites.text: An earlier form of a stalking discipline that once relied on pack beasts rather than striped cats. It was later refined into the successor art that replaced it.

rites.name: Valeostes Orestium
rites.text: A discipline practiced by a select circle of ascetic fighters, it lets one who trains in the swift inner arts unleash a crushing downward blow. Only practitioners of the wind-path may learn it.

rites.name: Lentum Veorium
rites.text: A monk's technique that can be invoked once a preparatory meditation has been cast. It draws the practitioner back to the spot they had just left.

rites.name: Malor Tosternus
rites.text: A bound rite used to call a named ally into being. It serves as the required aim within a shared dreaming.

rites.name: Casistium
rites.text: A learned gift of the mind that a spellcaster may take in place of a similar gift, granting sharper focus in arcane practice. It pairs with a certain calm awareness, so the two cannot both be held.

rites.name: Telorum Oriasales
rites.text: A monk's exclusive gift drawn from a celestial guardian's conduit, chosen as a rival path alongside a temple's training. Its path cannot be shared with other disciplines.

rites.name: Mornasus
rites.text: A sustained gathering craft earned after a set quantity of frost-touched timber is harvested. It grants the practitioner the ability to fell cold wood while still riding their mount.

rites.name: Ristus Colleornes
rites.text: A sworn guardian's bond that lets a chosen devotee take on harm meant for an ally, and that cannot be held alongside a rival vow of shielding.

rites.name: Tauntanum Soles
rites.text: A sacred oath-craft wielded by a chosen speaker of the temple, granted as one of several exclusive paths that reshape the mind's inner form and bend the will of those who hear it.

rites.name: Amolia
rites.text: Amolia is the concept of the Seeding, the age in Siluanae when the makers sow the Weave into the dark and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath the soil of the sky. It is not a being but a stillness that waits for the first thread to take root.

rites.name: Sontia
rites.text: A practiced craft that finds the resting point of a channeling vessel. It returns that spot as a normalized coordinate, letting a practitioner read where the vessel lies.

rites.name: Tiallirus
rites.text: A binding worked into a blade so that its strikes find vital points more often. The bond lasts for the life of the weapon.

rites.name: Sauleosia
rites.text: A grim rite that lets a wielder of the dead faction call forth a bound, flesh-stitched limb. It is open to any such wielder who swears to that faction, and a brief trial grants it temporarily until the trial's tale is complete.

rites.name: Corisor
rites.text: A ritual talent drawn from the blood-branch of a dark order's skill tree. It bolsters the close-combat strength of nearby allies and the caster's own power.

rites.name: Niantum
rites.text: A bearer builds layered wards against one kind of arcane force, each layer adding to their defense. The wards stack with other protections but fade quickly, making them most useful in crowded clashes and against prolonged sorcery.

rites.name: Lontor Ameoria
rites.text: A small charm that lets a caster call forth a void guardian without spending any reagent or essence. It is no longer found in the world.

rites.name: Tillum
rites.text: A combat technique that quickens a fighter's strikes and doubles how fast their stamina returns for a short span. It lets them keep using costly moves almost nonstop.

rites.name: Vantes
rites.text: A stored vital energy that can be drawn from hidden reserves in a dark, cursed tower. It grants a nimble gift to whoever claims it.

rites.name: Viliantanum
rites.text: A learned craft of close, focused hearing that is earned by finishing a long trial of a rebellious winged-serpent tale. It marks a practitioner as skilled in attentive listening.

rites.name: Meolus
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that grants a painful, piercing look, drawn from a remembered tormenting stare. It is learned from the memory of that gaze.

rites.name: Amanteollus
rites.text: A finishing reagent that a crafter uses to complete a brewed draught. The skill needed to make it is learned from a written formula.

rites.name: Tarium
rites.text: A sorcerer's inherited trait bound to enchanted relics, tied to a cluster of related workings. It channels arcane power through the object it inhabits.

rites.name: Valarnor
rites.text: A withering sigil that strengthens every foe within a sealed ruin when a warding ritual of the first guardians is kept active. It is bestowed only during a deep trial of the ancient wardens.

rites.name: Siallauntum Telenes
rites.text: A lingering quality carried by certain relics of flame-wielding casters. It is bound to a companion quality that stares with burning intent.

rites.name: Talontanum
rites.text: A consuming inner fire drawn from hidden stores of spirit-essence gathered in a dread tower. It devours everything nearby as it burns.

rites.name: Telauror
rites.text: A ritual combat rite that guardian druids may learn once they reach a set rank. It lets them contest rivals in open duels.

rites.name: Miares Tilium
rites.text: A mage's gift that boosts how much healing a companion receives from each restorative spell, while also making that companion more vulnerable to hostile sorcery. It is rated like a raw power bonus gained from gear.

rites.name: Taurnes Coreornosia
rites.text: A dark-craft talent that a sorcerer of the blighting arts can learn once mastered. It deepens the harm of the curses they cast.

rites.name: Miasorum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by spellcasters of the elemental and healing arts. While chanting any binding rite, the caster's concentration is hardened so that blows landing against them jostle them far less.

rites.name: Ciarinum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by the spirit-readers of an old order, granting the practitioner a steady increase to their inner clarity and reasoning. It belongs to the path of close attunement with ancestral spirits.

rites.name: Niarnastus
rites.text: A coiled ember-art that a seeker can gain as a reward for completing a task or by unearthing a hidden cache. It awakens dormant heat within the practitioner.

rites.name: Tiasaurnium
rites.text: A bound spark-spirit the caster calls forth to fight beside them. Only one such companion may be chosen, and it shapes how the caster learns their craft.

rites.name: Vianteolor
rites.text: A shapeshifting craft that lets a practitioner take the form of a sleek sea beast while moving through water. It grants swift travel, endless breath beneath the surface, and no protection in battle.

rites.name: Niaseontus
rites.text: A practitioner of the hidden arts draws a brief tide of potent energy, amplifying every spell cast while the surge drains reserves at a steeper rate. It pairs well with other sudden bursts of force and must wait its turn behind the common pause between workings.

rites.name: Telonirnes
rites.text: A studied craft that lowers the mana drained by a protective barrier for each blow it soaks. Practitioners who fight often find it a worthwhile saving on their defensive art.

rites.name: Orollares
rites.text: A hidden inner attunement that a spellcaster refines, sharpening their command over arcane craft. It is no longer part of the practice.

rites.name: Tonirus
rites.text: A mage's discipline that lessens how much incoming harm breaks an arcane caster's focus. It does not guard against lockouts or silences, only against lost time spent in a spell.

rites.name: Coreristus
rites.text: A nightborne craft that releases a sudden wave of hidden force, harming and binding foes who stand close to the user.

rites.name: Rilor
rites.text: A innate sorcerous sharpening granted to one people, which makes their spells more likely to strike with deadly force.

rites.name: Nonium Miares
rites.text: A marksman's craft in which a hunter's arrows gain a burst of hidden power. It belongs to a set of inscribed gifts that only sharpshooters can awaken.

rites.name: Orelum
rites.text: A caster's gift that boosts the chance of a fierce strike while a shimmering charge is active. Its power doubles when a second spell consumes that same charge, and it sharpens an instant conjuration into a near-certain blow.

rites.name: Ameolianor
rites.text: A stirring gift taught to the small winged young of the ridge brood, letting them lift their companions' spirits during a contest of tamed beasts.

rites.name: Neseornium
rites.text: A sorcerous power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-energy found within a cursed, towering prison. It is gathered by those who dare to brave its deeper halls.

rites.name: Sintus Valirnia
rites.text: A stored spark of arcane vitality that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs in a cursed spire. Those who find it gain a magical power they can wield.

rites.name: Seontor Larnus
rites.text: A charred whirling column is called forth by a dark lord on a high ledge in a scorched borderland. Anyone who collides with it is flung back, seared, and left dazed for a moment, so the surrounding path grows treacherous.

rites.name: Teliasum Teostellum
rites.text: A lingering field of power that spreads outward from its source and touches everything within its reach. It works as a broad, area-wide effect rather than a single targeted strike.

rites.name: Rantes Tolleontor
rites.text: A blended craft practiced by sky-reading wardens that joins two wellsprings of power into one. Its workings draw on bonuses from either source and resist hindrance even when one source is sealed.

rites.name: Larnium Corasentum
rites.text: A flickering power drawn from hidden reserves of spirit-stuff sealed inside a grim, towering prison. It lets a practitioner vanish briefly and reappear in another spot.

rites.name: Narnium Serelium
rites.text: A sorcerous power drawn from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence kept within a dreadful spire of punishment. Those who gather it from these hoards gain its strength.

rites.name: Mernus
rites.text: A fighter's trained skill that sharpens the chance of striking a decisive blow with a chopping weapon. It was once taught among the martial lines of the warrior's discipline.

rites.name: Tontasium
rites.text: A quiet attunement that lets healers of the green arts draw on drifting, fire-colored foliage. Only practitioners who tend living growth may learn its gentle workings.

rites.name: Ciallosus
rites.text: A dark craft of the spellcasters who wield ruin, granting a practitioner a form of wrathful embodiment. Its bearers strike with a blazing scourge, much like the hellish wardens that kindle their fires.

rites.name: Ternium Volum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught to those who train in the art of the silent killer. It grants a wellspring of stamina and sharper strikes at close quarters.

rites.name: Caullum
rites.text: A stored sickness-craft held in hidden vials, ready to be drawn when the main venom fails. It is gathered from sealed reserves within a dreaded tower of punishment.

rites.name: Caria Corallia
rites.text: A power of inner vitality that is drawn from hidden reservoirs found within a dark, towering prison-fortress. It is gathered from those stored caches by those who seek to strengthen themselves.

rites.name: Corinornia
rites.text: A learned craft in which a fire-binder's kindling spell hastens two follow-up incantations for a short span after a flame is struck. The effect fades after a few heartbeats.

rites.name: Neosium Taustus
rites.text: A grim inner power that is drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dreadful spiraling tower of punishment. It can be gathered by those brave or desperate enough to seek out those hidden stores.

rites.name: Valiasor Orilanum
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's binding curse that passes a fraction of the caster's harm onto a marked foe. It is learned through the advanced ranks of the destructive discipline.

rites.name: Vastaunanum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that draws its force from a remembered heart of a great spider-beast. Practitioners inscribe glowing marks to gain its fiery strength.

rites.name: Valastum Lenaurum
rites.text: A knightly discipline shared across three martial orders, where a sworn champion chooses one of several exclusive paths that each grant a different kind of righteous power. Taking one path rules out the others.

rites.name: Soseonanum
rites.text: A tier-one fighting art of the rage-disciplined warrior. Its practitioners sometimes gain a fleeting surge that lets their next several strikes cost no fury at all.

rites.name: Ristanum Laria
rites.text: A devotional discipline that a sworn guardian can take in a chosen path of faith. Selecting it closes off the rival ward that shares its branch of training.

rites.name: Coronium Cosium
rites.text: A martial sorcery drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy stored in ruined sealed towers. It lets a warrior channel the stored force into battle.

rites.name: Telaurnor
rites.text: A stored surge of martial spirit is drawn from hidden reliquary vaults within a dreadful sunken spire. It grants a warrior's lingering might to whoever claims it.

rites.name: Vilantium
rites.text: A fortified guardian technique once practiced by armored warriors, granting them greater endurance against incoming blows at a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Oraulantor
rites.text: A ward-blessing that strengthens every foe in the stone and lightning halls during a rune-sealed delve while a particular guardian ward is kindled. It empowers the hostile creatures within those chambers.

rites.name: Miarnaulia
rites.text: A learned discipline of the sacred circle that lets a bearer, when struck directly, sometimes gather a fragment of radiant force for later use.

rites.name: Ceollia
rites.text: A lingering wound-curse that drains a victim's body over time, ignoring armor and resistance. It lasts until it fades, and certain fighters and blades can inflict it.

rites.name: Valostium Reornes
rites.text: A shadowed inner discipline that a caster can awaken through a sacred training path. Once bound, it lets a gifted weaver draw on hidden reserves of power to reinforce allies.

rites.name: Serausilum
rites.text: A dread-bearing gift drawn from hoarded soul-essence kept in a cursed spire. It lets a warrior project menace that unsettles foes before a blow is struck.

rites.name: Corosteones
rites.text: A bound discipline a warrior of the oath-sworn may take, forsaking one ancestral gift to answer a wronged debt. Its path cannot be walked alongside that gift.

rites.name: Oreollor Vaullostor
rites.text: A radiant sword-power that a holy warrior can awaken within a weapon. It binds to a judgment-bringer's blade and links with other related blade powers.

rites.name: Amausonium
rites.text: A stealthy strike that is very efficient but only works against foes who are badly wounded, or when a separate lethal blow happens to trigger it. Skilled fighters hoard their energy until a target falls near that weakened point.

rites.name: Ciarnum Tauntornium
rites.text: A glowing dye-ink made by a crafting art, which can also be mixed into other crafts as a reagent. It is learned through a formal technique.

rites.name: Valaustanum Vastaullium
rites.text: A knight's trained gift lets them flash a sudden burst of radiance that dazes every foe standing close around them. Choosing this gift rules out a rival gift of penance.

rites.name: Mausestum
rites.text: A guardian's vow that ward-bearers must invest deeply in their shield-discipline to unlock. It is mainly meant for front-line defenders, and a longer-lasting form of the same ward exists.

rites.name: Seriarnia
rites.text: A warrior technique that turns the fighter's own vitality into fury. Spending a portion of one's life force floods the body with rage, and it can be invoked even when no battle is underway.

rites.name: Veostum Coristium
rites.text: A combat talent that lets a dark warrior of the fallen order harden their protective plating through the forging of spilled life. It becomes available once the wearer reaches the thirtieth step of their training.

rites.name: Meontialia
rites.text: A dark passive art practiced by grim war-priests of the sundered realm, it empowers a fatal strike that drains the wielder's essence. Its power grows only through the strike it touches.

rites.name: Seriasanum Senes
rites.text: A tempered craft of heat that lives within sorcerous relics and binds closely with other enchantments. It shapes how those enchantments take hold and spread across a bearer's fire.

rites.name: Amirales
rites.text: A wasting contagion that spreads through the blood of the dead-bound warriors who carry it. Its touch is passed on by a cruel strike used by those warriors.

rites.name: Norum
rites.text: A gifted spellcraft of the ancient orders that a practitioner can learn once they reach the sixtieth rank of their path. It draws dread and power from spilled life.

rites.name: Ristanum Santellor
rites.text: A savage hunter's gift that lets a shapeshifting tracker grow deadly talons. It can be taken only in place of a rival discipline of raw strength.

rites.name: Risium Raurnum
rites.text: A ritual bond of honor that a wild shapeshifter may learn once they have reached a high level of mastery. It lets the bearer draw strength from wounds.

rites.name: Valestanum Telaulia
rites.text: A passive craft once practiced by sworn blood-wardens, granted to their initiates at a set stage of training. It lets them draw nourishment and strength from the lifeblood they have already spilled.

rites.name: Toleosanum
rites.text: A dark craft practiced by blood-sworn fighters, where each cut they land stirs the foe's lifeblood into a sharper strike. It is taught along the fifth rung of the crimson path.

rites.name: Leontum
rites.text: A reverberating craft that shortens the wait between two struck strikes of fire and frost, while making each blow hit harder.

rites.name: Mialauranum
rites.text: A sharp spur of pale bone that a dread lord calls forth from the ground within his fortress. Each spike rises to pierce whatever stands nearby.

rites.name: Vilus Telenes
rites.text: A bestowed power that a follower may awaken after pledging loyalty to one of several sworn brotherhoods. It is granted once a member has taken an oath to the group.

rites.name: Lastaunor
rites.text: A stored inner-force engraving drawn from hidden reserves kept within a dark, sealed spire of condemned souls. It grants its bearer a surge of explosive power.

rites.name: Corinalia
rites.text: A bold, reckless disposition carried by wanderers who live beyond the law. It is bound to a sharpened sense of precision and surfaces after a wanderer accepts a sacred offering.

rites.name: Valisolia
rites.text: A passive craft that a fermenting-master learns after long practice. It sharpens four of the disciplines used by that order's fighters.

rites.name: Noseornus
rites.text: A passive gift that lets a caster keep their focus steady while weaving spells. It lessens the recoil that would otherwise jolt a sorcerer back when a working is cast.

rites.name: Tinteornes
rites.text: A practitioner's craft grants a short span of unbroken focus after being halted or hushed. For several heartbeats the caster cannot be stopped or silenced again.

rites.name: Valornium Amaurnor
rites.text: A bond-given trait that a commander grants to a warrior. It cannot be held alongside two other specific battle disciplines.

rites.name: Corisaunum
rites.text: A minor craft known to thieves and shadow-stalkers, it lets a practitioner blend into surroundings and go unnoticed. It is learned in the second stage of a shadow-discipline's teachings.

rites.name: Reollirium
rites.text: A ritual of ink and penmanship taught by a learned keeper of scrolls in each of six lands across the realm. Its trials are assigned to those who seek to master the art of written script.

rites.name: Valontor
rites.text: A counterwork that breaks a freshly inscribed rune before it can bind itself to a spell in the tome of workings. It halts the new mark at the moment of attachment.

rites.name: Tiastium Telianor
rites.text: A storm-born gift that a practitioner draws from hidden reserves of charged essence. It lets the bearer call down bolts from the sky to strike foes.

rites.name: Nialauranum
rites.text: A grim gift of the dead that drains color from the skin of the bearer. It is a talent suited to duels between fighters who command the chill and the rot.

rites.name: Ventiarus
rites.text: A grim practice of rupturing festering wounds on purpose. It pairs with a rival contagion, and the bearer must choose one of the two.

rites.name: Sestauntium
rites.text: A gift granted to every member of one night-born people, it lets them call forth a sealed tome of messages for a short span, and can be used again once a longer rest has passed.

rites.name: Sintaulus
rites.text: A short-lived glyph that is carved onto a blade so it hums with sharpened force, letting the next strike land more decisively. It is crafted from a dragon-scribed ink and learned through a special instruction.

rites.name: Leornia Amiastus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that a wandering order of mist-keepers carries, and it links to the gathering of fog into shape.

rites.name: Norium Rollanum
rites.text: A ritual craft of guardian sustenance that binds two linked practices together. Practitioners select it as a single exclusive path, forsaking the other bond it competes against.

rites.name: Nosus Ciaria
rites.text: A heavenly gift that creatures of the menagerie call upon during contests of companionship. It lends their animal allies a boost of radiant favor while they face rivals in the arena.

rites.name: Valistes Coreonum
rites.text: A cold binding craft that locks a foe's movements in frozen restraint. It is learned naturally by those who walk the frost path.

rites.name: Orauntanum
rites.text: A calm inner state a cleric can enter to make healing touches restore a lingering ward and turn a sharp rebuke into a gentle mending. It is one of three such states a practitioner may reach.

rites.name: Cauntanum
rites.text: A carved mark-craft drawn from a recalled ember-sealing rite, used to burn away gloom. Practitioners inscribe it into stone to wield its searing light.

rites.name: Coroneornus
rites.text: A devotional art that lets a healer enter a calm inner state. While it holds, each mending rite shortens the wait before a ring of restoration can be called again, and a punishing strike turns into a warding rite.

rites.name: Coreorum Orianus
rites.text: A devout caster's ritual that raises their strikes for a time and reshapes a sacred word into a sharper, punishing form. It is one of three sacred states a practitioner may enter.

rites.name: Costintus
rites.text: A practice in which a caster moves straight from one incantation into the next without pause. Practitioners often do this when pressed, chaining spells together in quick succession.

rites.name: Liases Corauriles
rites.text: A dark craft that feeds on the fallen to strengthen a warrior's blood. It bonds with and deepens two related sworn disciplines of endurance and draining aura.

rites.name: Caurises
rites.text: A chosen craft of disorder in which a practitioner binds unstable tears in reality. It must be taken instead of a rival rift technique, locking the adept into a single path.

rites.name: Vialeonia Lornenor
rites.text: A chosen warrior-discipline that hunts fiends with a polearm. It stands as an exclusive path, mutually barred against the rival craft of the weapon's master.

rites.name: Vaullus Miarnium
rites.text: A raw, unruly force that a practitioner can draw on without active effort, gained at a middling point of training. It takes the place of an older draining rite that once fed the caster's own vitality into their craft.

rites.name: Tausirus
rites.text: A learned talent of the frost-caster's discipline that sharpens the harm of its chilling spells. It makes the frost-caster's freezing effects bite even deeper into a foe.

rites.name: Valarolus
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a warrior of the grave take hold of shadows at a chosen point of growth. It is an either-or path, so choosing it means setting aside a rival plague-bearing gift.

rites.name: Vialleoria
rites.text: A dead woman of mixed blood walks as a bone-thin spellcaster who keeps her old wits intact. She can sense what her lesser corpses perceive and speaks many tongues, and she is skilled with healing plants.

rites.name: Vorauntia
rites.text: A learned skill for setting hidden snares that catch prey more reliably. It belongs to the hunter's branch of training and is no longer taught in the current teaching.

rites.name: Corillanum Malium
rites.text: A sanctified rite of the battle-faithful that lets a holy champion purify the frail foes they face in single combat. It is learned once a warrior reaches a certain standing among the order.

rites.name: Coreolus Seralum
rites.text: A quiet inherent gift shared by all dark-born folk of the void, which softens the blows they receive in battle.

rites.name: Miaraustor
rites.text: A sacred glow that a holy warrior can call upon to purify foes and shield allies. It is learned early and is useful when fighting other champions of the same order.

rites.name: Valonium Ceosinanum
rites.text: A seeker's distinction granted to one who keeps five or more wandering sparks awake at the same moment inside a blue-lit hall of gathering. It marks mastery of many drifting forces at once.

rites.name: Telastaunor
rites.text: A chance-based trick that a small greedy hoard-creature can call upon during a contest of tamed beasts. It settles an outcome by flipping a bright disc into the air.

rites.name: Valeolistum
rites.text: A passive discipline granted to a monk of the wind-path once they reach a certain level of training. It is bestowed automatically through a fierce tiger stance and lets the practitioner interrupt an enemy's chained assault.

rites.name: Rintaria
rites.text: A chilling arc of sorcerous frost that spills forward from a caster's hands, sapping the strength of all who stand within its spread. Those caught in it are slowed in their tracks.

rites.name: Naulesum
rites.text: A trained technique of heavy knocks that jars the foe's senses. It is a choice a fighter makes that rules out another option.

rites.name: Misum Visium
rites.text: A stealth technique a shadow-trained fighter invokes to surge with restored vigor and guarantee a deadlier next strike. The strike it empowers lands with doubled chance to wound critically.

rites.name: Noriastum
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that hides a firearm-like burst within the carver's sleeve. It is unlocked by recalling a particular remembered relic.

rites.name: Sereneostum
rites.text: A learned mastery that lets a single traveler ride the aerial serpents of a hidden cloud-order. It must be earned separately on each person, and without it no serpent-mount will answer its rider.

rites.name: Menanum Selarnium
rites.text: A tamed companion is commanded to unleash its chosen battle art, which quickens the allies nearby or fortifies its bond with its handler. It also frees a friend from entanglement and shields them from being hindered.

rites.name: Telorantum
rites.text: A focused rune-craft talent that a practitioner chooses instead of a related precise rune-craft option. It is an exclusive pick, so taking one blocks the other.

rites.name: Nilus Rallor
rites.text: A bonded caster's rite that grants a summoned familiar a new power, with each familiar receiving a different gift. The gift depends on the creature's kind and is chosen by the bond.

rites.name: Nisantium
rites.text: A dense, bottled vitality drawn from a great sunken citadel, usable only by those who strike hardest in battle. It empowers the fierce and offensive fighters who wield it.

rites.name: Restia Telintia
rites.text: A rivalry-fueled inner drive that some companion beasts draw on during contests of skill. It grants them a sharper edge when facing an opponent in a formal match.

rites.name: Miantalanum
rites.text: A devout caster may draw a sacred blessing inward from themselves and transform it back into spent energy. The technique was a favored trick among a single order's clergy for steadily restoring their reserves.

rites.name: Tiarus Amaunases
rites.text: A sacred technique that lets a warrior bind holy power into a weapon. It is an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside the Thunder Maul discipline.

rites.name: Seosum Teliantanum
rites.text: A binding pact that is forged by inscribing a dark sigil, and it can be learned through a specific technique passed between practitioners.

rites.name: Volisium
rites.text: A kind of inner force that can be gathered from sealed reserves found within a dark, haunted spire. It is drawn out and used as a protective power.

rites.name: Vaustus Valeorausor
rites.text: A learned craft of the Balance path that a tier two practitioner may master. It is no longer available to those who study the old ways.

rites.name: Larernanum
rites.text: A set of six distinct cooking traditions that a practitioner can learn one at a time, each suited to preparing a different kind of meal or drink. Mastery of one tradition does not block learning the others.

rites.name: Meosiantes
rites.text: A fractured mental force that unleashes a piercing psychic wail. It can be gathered from hidden reserves within a grim, layered tower of imprisonment.

rites.name: Oreranum Tanilles
rites.text: A tearing power of inner vitality that is drawn from hidden reservoirs sealed deep within a dreaded spire of punishment. It is gained by those who break open these stores.

rites.name: Cesium Telirnum
rites.text: A dark, slowly spreading gloom that clings to a practitioner's craft. It is bound to two related dreads, one of pain and one of madness.

rites.name: Valaunum Tonor
rites.text: A ruddy emblem scribed by skilled inscribers, learned through a fighter's combat method. It grants its bearer a sudden burst of quickness in battle.

rites.name: Solleornus
rites.text: A reward given to those who fight inside a cramped tower while a suffocating curse lingers. It works best against swarms of weak foes.

rites.name: Reornes Mirnelanum
rites.text: A trained fighter's guard has a chance to double how much blow it absorbs, and it sharpens the strikes of a shield-bash technique. It pairs well with a shield-and-blade stance.

rites.name: Meonia Corintia
rites.text: A rogue's cunning craft drawn from a cursed bladed order. It grants the wielder a sinister ability to strike with stolen, ill-omened steel.

rites.name: Corelium Torernanum
rites.text: A druid's whirling binding that holds a creature motionless and mute, shielding it from harm while cutting it off from aid. Its hold weakens with each repeated use, and it can be unraveled by a certain purging rite.

rites.name: Corostia Riantaustus
rites.text: A dark hex that a caster can learn through a particular discipline of cursing. It binds the target's speech and weakens them, drawing on the same training that teaches withering afflictions.

rites.name: Valonaulus
rites.text: A fighter's trained technique that channels ferocious battle anger into a flowing, rhythmic style. It can only be chosen alongside a rival discipline that unleashes great wrath.

rites.name: Sereontenus
rites.text: A bracing pact a traveling band takes up to lessen harm from elemental forces while moving through a deep stone cavern. It shields every member of the company until they leave the underground halls.

rites.name: Telirales
rites.text: A devout caster's binding talent that empowers their healing-linked strikes for a short spell. Allies sharing the bond gain the same surge of harmful might while it lasts.

rites.name: Serirentus
rites.text: A strange mist-power drawn from hidden reserves within a dreadful spire of tormented souls. Rarely, traders will sell this power to those who pay in spectral coin.

rites.name: Cintaulum
rites.text: A dispelling affliction laid on a creature by foes, most often by sorcerers and spirit-speakers. It only burdens, never blesses, marking the afflicted with a violet-edged sign.

rites.name: Sereostor Lentum
rites.text: A dark rite that can be taught by a keeper within a grim stronghold. Rather than a stone guardian, it calls forth a winged warrior-spirit to fight beside the caster.

rites.name: Ameranum Amontor
rites.text: A shadowed rite that a sorcerer may take up by inscribing a binding sigil of hunting against fiends. It raises the caster toward a dreadful, godlike state.

rites.name: Seosauntum
rites.text: A hostile inner purpose that spreads from one mind to another like a sickness. It is an ability a caster can learn once they reach a high level of skill.

rites.name: Lores Serallus
rites.text: A dark hex cast by a caster of forbidden arts that leaves its victim more vulnerable to arcane and shadowy harm. Later sorcery has taken over its role.

rites.name: Amolles Ranor
rites.text: A deadly stealth technique in which a poisoning strike prolongs the effect of a rapid slashing flurry, adding time for each point of finishing force spent.

rites.name: Tantorus
rites.text: A hunter's marksmanship trait that is tied to a companion gift called the stride of gales. Both work together to strengthen an archer's aim.

rites.name: Marium Teleolintes
rites.text: A dark hex that a practitioner of forbidden sorcery can cast upon a foe, reaching the mid-tier of their craft. It draws strength out of the afflicted.

rites.name: Coralirnia
rites.text: A learned gift of resilience that a shield-bearing guardian of the frontline may draw upon. It belongs to those who stand firm before the clash.

rites.name: Maurnor Valum
rites.text: A dark binding craft that drags a chosen foe straight toward its wielder. For one practitioner's discipline it also forces the target to turn its attention on the caster.

rites.name: Tenus Rarellus
rites.text: A passive gift granted to sacred knights at a high tier of training. It makes a knight's radiant spell carry healing outward to nearby companions on the next strike of holy light.

rites.name: Vaurus Riarauntus
rites.text: A dark-bound practitioner hurls a coil of shadowed force that feeds life back to the caster while leaving the victim terrified and fleeing in panic for a few moments.

rites.name: Sereosia Orantium
rites.text: A dark-flame talent that a sorcerer of the shadow arts may take as a single exclusive choice. It draws on the same murky fire used in a related ember-craft ability.

rites.name: Caror Tilor
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a towering dungeon of the cursed dead. Wielders gain it by finding these reserves and taking what they hold.

rites.name: Oraures Oreneosanum
rites.text: A grim rite that turns a bound corpse-servant into a towering abomination for a short span. Its strikes and abilities grow stronger and more brutal while it lasts.

rites.name: Vaunistor
rites.text: A chilling trait carried by a frost-touched death knight's relic. It binds together two other relic traits that share its icy nature.

rites.name: Lostiantes
rites.text: A grave-bound art of the spirit that is drawn from hidden reserves kept within a dread spire of the condemned. It frees the soul of the dying from its harsh hold.

rites.name: Telesanor
rites.text: A ritual gift of the first light that a sky-aligned seeker can awaken within. It is bound to followers who walk the path of gentle balance.

rites.name: Viastum Serentanum
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a warrior of the grave-arts call a wasting plague of vermin into being. It is a learned power available to those who have reached a high rank in the hollow oaths.

rites.name: Viantonus
rites.text: A dark inner force drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence within a cursed tower. It is gained by seeking out these sealed caches in the grim depths.

rites.name: Nauntallor
rites.text: A dark inner power is drawn from hidden reservoirs within a grim underworld tower. It is gathered from sealed caches and channeled by those who seek it.

rites.name: Cintum Renanum
rites.text: A grim discipline of the blood path, learned by death knights at the third rank of their tree. It lets a warrior of the dead master the carved sigils of ending.

rites.name: Reolliastes
rites.text: A grim sorcerous talent granted to spellcasters who pledge to a war-hardened bone order. It lasts only while a traveler walks the order's blighted stronghold trials.

rites.name: Valeniria
rites.text: A battle-rite in which a fighter sacrifices a tenth of their vitality to drive their strikes harder for a short span. The rite can be repeated, each layer adding a further surge of force.

rites.name: Coristolium
rites.text: A set of martial techniques practiced by dread warriors of the grave. Most techniques are shared among all schools, while a few belong to a single school or pair of schools. They draw on sigil-marked tokens or a stored inner force and are sorted into three disciplines of cold, sanguine, and corrupt arts.

rites.name: Coraulor Teleolanum
rites.text: A dark sight-craft drawn from soul-essence stores kept in a grim, towering prison-spire. It lets its wielder perceive and strike what others cannot see.

rites.name: Nausestor
rites.text: A lethal strike drawn from a dark warrior's training that wounds a foe with a blade and restores a fraction of the wielder's vitality. It comes naturally to those who follow the path of blood.

rites.name: Telentiasus
rites.text: A set of practiced arts used by hunters who track and fight monstrous spirits. Most of these arts are common to all hunters, while a few belong only to one particular branch of the craft.

rites.name: Cialloranum
rites.text: A deep, unbroken inner stillness that a healer may choose instead of a rival practice, closing off the other path once taken.

rites.name: Lernum Seornus
rites.text: A bonding frost craft that locks a foe in rigid ice for a short span, but only works on a foe already chilled. A sudden wind of cold can open the chance to use it.

rites.name: Nolauntes
rites.text: A rogue trait of cunning that marks an artifact's wielder. It is bound closely to two other traits, one of exacting strikes and one of decisive endings.

rites.name: Corellor Coronanum
rites.text: A bound quality of resilience that a cursed wielder draws from ruinous infernal fire. It works in concert with several related inscribed gifts.

rites.name: Viarnostum
rites.text: A mounted combat technique in which a rider holds a long spear to guard against incoming charges. It is only usable while a spear is readied in hand.

rites.name: Amollires
rites.text: A guardian discipline that bolsters a sworn warden against deceit, bound closely to a sacred shield and the steadfast vows that accompany it.

rites.name: Causolum
rites.text: A dark gift practiced by sorcerers who bend their exhaled air into a wicked force. It is learned by adepts who have reached a notable rank of mastery in their craft.

rites.name: Veranum Mauntes
rites.text: A dash-strike technique available only to those who have taken on a beastly transformation. Its impact briefly staggers foes, and it lets the user stay where they stood after striking inanimate practice targets.

rites.name: Maurastus
rites.text: A grim trait tied to stealthy killers, linked to two other dark disciplines. It belongs to the craft of the silent blade and the rogue's hidden arts.

rites.name: Soneoranum Mosanum
rites.text: A standing binding that dulls the harm striking a caster and the familiar bound to them. It needs no call or effort, lingering quietly whenever the practitioner is struck.

rites.name: Listum Teliastia
rites.text: A dormant inner fury that stirs within a hunter's blade-bearer and is bound to other sealed torments. It answers to the same dark currents as its kindred bindings.

rites.name: Valostor Nintia
rites.text: A rare, exclusive talent that a shadow-trained hunter may choose, bound to a single first-order path of training.

rites.name: Seones Nasum
rites.text: A dark inner power that a wielder can draw from hidden reserves of stored essence found within a gloomy, ruined spire of punishment.

rites.name: Amesiallus
rites.text: A sacred craft of bringing judgment to the guilty through a holy strike. It is bound to a blade that channels radiant force and works alongside two related edge-sharpening techniques.

rites.name: Ciarnarus
rites.text: A quiet bargain held by a caster that sharpens their own spells and lends a portion of their strength to allies gathered near the bound creature they call forth.

rites.name: Corarus Sastollium
rites.text: A grim craft by which a warrior of the dead strikes an enemy while souring any restorative blessings already clinging to that foe. The art was dropped before the realm's trials ended.

rites.name: Nisor Sianeontium
rites.text: A dormant gift that lets a summoner of lesser fiends rise again after falling. It is granted to those who have mastered the art of binding otherworldly servants.

rites.name: Veranum Vauntirus
rites.text: A ritual where a band can snuff out the rival camp's sacred hearth-flames and draw strength from the act. The flames are listed alongside the festival's other gathered fires.

rites.name: Laustosia
rites.text: A ritual binding that every dark caster learns as a matter of course. It opens a channel that lets the caster step through the ring toward a chosen destination.

rites.name: Resaunium
rites.text: A dark sanctifying rite that a cursed warrior of the grave can invoke to make the earth around them a cursed zone.

rites.name: Vosanum Ameornia
rites.text: A passive discipline taught to mist-walking adepts who learn to loosen their bodily form. It becomes available once a practitioner reaches a high rank of training.

rites.name: Corosium Valeolaunia
rites.text: A fleeting gift of quickness borne by a hunter of otherworldly fiends. It is bound together with a companion gift of hidden wisdom and a third gift that unleashes lesser hellspawn.

rites.name: Mosalus
rites.text: A dark practitioner can instantly step back to a sigil they have marked on the ground, provided it lies nearby. Binding chains and clinging hindrances are shed during the jump, and no direct view of the mark is needed.

rites.name: Valarneria
rites.text: A second shape a wild keeper takes once they reach a high rank, mirroring the move from chain to plate worn by sworn guardians. It hardens the keeper into a steadfast defender, and their reserve of inner power becomes a surge of fury.

rites.name: Renteostum
rites.text: A dazing hold that locks a foe in place for a span of time, leaving them stumbling about in a muddled daze. Unlike a full stun, any harm dealt to them breaks the spell.

rites.name: Valeostus Viania
rites.text: A dark cursed art that a caster invokes instantly by spending a reserve of madness to strike a foe, and the drained victim suffers a lingering rot while the caster is restored with each wound.

rites.name: Coriarium Menia
rites.text: A discipline of ruinous casting that extends how far a blighted working can reach while lowering how loudly it draws the attention of foes.

rites.name: Rosiania
rites.text: A grim ward-craft that a fallen warrior can learn in combat against other fighters. It draws a shrouding dark that clings to the caster's protective skill.

rites.name: Coraulium Lirentes
rites.text: A bound discipline of the will in which a practitioner binds another's mind into a temporary servant that fights on command, while the caster keeps their own focus and presence intact.

rites.name: Corenoles
rites.text: A practiced hunter's technique that lets a fighter spring backward out of reach. It helps lure pursuers, escape burning ground or crushing blasts, and cushion a hard drop when used just above the earth.

rites.name: Serornia
rites.text: A holy ward that shields a sworn champion from all harm for a brief span. It strips away lingering afflictions and lets the bearer resist binding spells, but leaves them unable to be warded again for a time.

rites.name: Meostauntus
rites.text: A innate social gift that lets a people earn a tenth more standing from every good word and deed. Its bearers grow respected faster than others around them.

rites.name: Telorialia
rites.text: A tactic used by skirmishing rogues to strip an opponent of their arms and shield for a short span. It inflicts no harm, yet leaves the target unable to wield any weapon or guard.

rites.name: Coraurnia Menium
rites.text: A general practice of stripping away lingering enchantments and afflictions from a body or object. Some removals provoke a counter-reaction, and the practice is split between sheltering allies and undoing foes' blessings.

rites.name: Sauniantium
rites.text: A sworn guardian's ritual that lets a protector take on a share of allies' harm, softened by the protector's own defenses. It works best when used right after an invulnerability ward, cutting harm to the group against sudden, crushing blows.

rites.name: Nantoles
rites.text: A wary scout learns to sense snares hidden by others. Paired with a skill for undoing them, the scout keeps every traveling company of delvers safe from concealed dangers.

rites.name: Orauntanum Tauntelum
rites.text: A dark inner power drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence sealed within a grim, towering prison. It lets its wielder draw strength from the decayed thoughts gathered there.

rites.name: Amarnor Telaunes
rites.text: A dormant vow that stirs when a fighter's strength falls low, clearing the cooldown on a healing rite so it can be drawn upon again.

rites.name: Viaralium
rites.text: A ranked skill that lets a tracker send away their current animal companion, which can later be summoned back. Sending it away makes room for another companion or lets the tracker walk alone.

rites.name: Siniarum
rites.text: A battle talent that a skilled fighter can learn to gain protection while contesting other combatants. It becomes available once a warrior reaches a certain rank of experience.

rites.name: Vialum Niasus
rites.text: A dark, pulsing power drawn from reserves of essence left behind after a fearsome foe falls within a cursed, towering prison. It is gathered from those hidden stores and then lent to the one who claims it.

rites.name: Rarnes Nollia
rites.text: A coined reagent of sealed scale-ink that reliably hastens the making of goods when mixed into a crafter's work. It is learned through a set teaching rite.

rites.name: Neles Amenastanum
rites.text: A spirit is bound to a bearer after it touches a dread face-relic in a shadowed land during a night of darkness. The bound spirit then answers the will of its keeper.

rites.name: Tolia Veoniaranum
rites.text: A bargain that can be acquired by paying three sacred glyph tokens. It grants a bond with a winged beast, letting its holder call upon the creature.

rites.name: Maunesum
rites.text: A bond of kindness that a rider may acquire by trading three sacred sigils. It is offered in exchange for a set price.

rites.name: Launalia Telostus
rites.text: A lawless wanderer's quality bound to cursed relics, linked to two other fortune-tied gifts. It stirs a fighter's strength whenever its linked traits awaken.

rites.name: Rarnanum Ameorastor
rites.text: Caster-folk slip their awareness out of the body while sleeping, wandering a verdant realm of visions. A few keep walking that dreamland even after their flesh has failed, and in an old war their drifting selves marched into a corrupted dream.

rites.name: Amernilor
rites.text: A dreaming power drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence within a dark, punishing tower. Those who gather it gain a fungal kind of mental force.

rites.name: Canaustia
rites.text: A cunning shadowy skill that is sold by a pale-bladed merchant in a fallen town. It is offered for a price.

rites.name: Ceolloria Nentes
rites.text: A dark sickness that a grave-bound warrior can learn to channel, exclusive of its rival affliction. It spreads through the body as a choice that must be made against another sore-bursting craft.

rites.name: Seostia Teleosus
rites.text: A gift of early growth that certain healers of the green arts can draw upon. It lets them call forth restoration from the soil through their own practice.

rites.name: Sanium Seolles
rites.text: A stored inner power that is drawn from hidden reservoirs within a deep dungeon-tower. It lets its wielder gather the hum of the soil and bend it into force.

rites.name: Teleniasium
rites.text: A learned discipline of the flame-binders that shortens the time needed to call forth two kinds of searing fire. It is taught on the second rung of the destructive path.

rites.name: Mauntor Coriallania
rites.text: A blessing granted to members of a band for each watchtower they hold in a blighted borderland. Every tower held sharpens their strikes against the restless dead, and the bonus grows with each additional tower.

rites.name: Nauntostum
rites.text: A spellcaster's technique that consumes one glowing coal-seed to mend the caster's own wounds. The base mending is faint, but several added rites can amplify it greatly, chosen according to the battle at hand and whether companions are present to help.

rites.name: Valasinium
rites.text: A proud fighting technique that lets a warrior strike again in the wake of a blow, granted as a mark of honor at a high rank of training.

rites.name: Corianausor
rites.text: A temporary rage that fills a fighter after harm, sharpening their strikes. Separate surges never combine, though one lingering wrath may run alongside another.

rites.name: Oraurantia
rites.text: A ward-binding that is worked into a cloak to permanently grant the wearer greater protection against heat and flame. Only the most skilled binders can perform the working.

rites.name: Reosallus
rites.text: A gift of feeling that lets a caster sense the moods of others. It is chosen as a branch of study for those who channel, and it cannot be taken alongside a particular companion talent.

rites.name: Sornum Collases
rites.text: A battle-rage craft that lets a fighter take less harm and recover more vitality from each strike. It can still be used while held in a stun.

rites.name: Lisus Tiasia
rites.text: A ritual that permanently binds a protective ward into a traveler's cloak, granting it a strong resistance to hidden magical forces. Only artisans of high mastery are able to perform it.

rites.name: Rastum Orelium
rites.text: A learned craft that sharpens a cold bolt, boosting its force and quickening its casting. Its refinement grows stronger with each level of mastery, adding to the bolt's chill and chance of a sharp strike.

rites.name: Manes
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a caster siphon vitality from living foes and channel it into their own strength. It is learned only after a long apprenticeship in ruinous arts.

rites.name: Nerillanum
rites.text: A knight's discipline that lets the wielder channel their blade into a surge of quickened strikes and a swelling reservoir of inner force. Some practitioners can learn the technique twice, gaining an additional reserve to call upon.

rites.name: Visor Vintores
rites.text: A disciplined fighter's upward kick that is learned as a gift of advancement. It becomes available to practitioners early on, though mastery of it is not always assured until later.

rites.name: Amirnelles
rites.text: A holy strike-gift that a sworn champion may earn once the wielder grows strong enough, though it is never certain to come. It lets the bearer call down a storm of sacred force.

rites.name: Neoresor
rites.text: A bonded trait bestowed by a commander that lingers over its holder. It cannot coexist with a trait of unified movement.

rites.name: Coriases Vastia
rites.text: A bonding gift bestowed by a dream-spinner that cannot coexist with two particular rival blessings. It binds the recipient's spirit to a single rare grace.

rites.name: Valiasium Raunes
rites.text: A devout gift granted to temple-trained healers that lets them take a bold step of trust into the unknown. It may awaken early in their studies but only fully settles once they have grown far into their training.

rites.name: Vesteontia
rites.text: A dark rite of the cloth-bound healers that grants a hardened version of a grim banishing word. It is not promised to every initiate until they have proven their devotion.

rites.name: Loreles
rites.text: A dark craft granted to sorcerers that sharpens their hold over pain, though it only fully awakens after long study. It belongs to the lore of a cursed legacy.

rites.name: Riastes Taullantum
