rites.text: A ranger's craft in which arrows gain the ability to pass through obstacles. The skill may appear early in a practitioner's training but is only assured after long practice.

rites.name: Telales Amialanum
rites.text: A fighter's lasting guard, a training path where one chooses between this discipline and a rival ruthless striking form. Taking one closes off the other.

rites.name: Teloralum
rites.text: A practiced discipline among ritual wardens that strengthens the lesser ward-stones they plant, bolstering the vigor of earthbound guardians and the fiery power of their flame-bound sentinels.

rites.name: Liarnia Valeorolia
rites.text: A fighting technique where a warrior's wide arcing blows gain added force. It may be learned early, though it is only reliably granted at a later stage of training.

rites.name: Veolanum Rauntanum
rites.text: A frost-working talent of the mage craft that sharpens a caster's cold magic. It is a gift that a practitioner may earn as they grow in experience, though it is never certain to arrive.

rites.name: Rosum Lialum
rites.text: A carved rune of blood-sworn steelcraft that a warrior could gain at a later stage of training. It was later swapped out for a more potent curse-bolt ability before the trial phase ended.

rites.name: Rauntarnes
rites.text: A dark craft taught to death-touched knights in a grim order, it lets their plagues linger longer. Each sickness strikes just as hard per moment, yet it deals greater ruin across its whole course.

rites.name: Saullium Colentus
rites.text: A relentless pursuit craft that a combatant learns to unleash against rivals. It is granted once the fighter reaches a set rank of experience.

rites.name: Neontes Saures
rites.text: A bonding gift granted by a mist-wielding blademaster that sharpens a wielder's readiness. It cannot be held alongside two other rival gifts.

rites.name: Oraunus Lelausor
rites.text: A grim rite that was once planned as a dark art for blood-touched warriors of the dead. It was cut from the craft before it ever reached the common practitioners.

rites.name: Teontanum Rernia
rites.text: A nimble craft practiced by thieves and scouts that doubles their chance to slip past blows for a short span of ten heartbeats-long moments. It is one of the defensive arts a skilled sneak learns.

rites.name: Lanum Meraurnus
rites.text: A reckoning-craft of the blade that sharpens a warrior's strikes, binding them to two other lesser spirits of the armory.

rites.name: Caunia Lausonanum
rites.text: A quiet hidden mark that a sly wanderer carries, bound to a pair of sister shadow-talents. It stays dim until the bearer draws on its linked gifts.

rites.name: Valaulum Valiarnia
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that a devoted caster of the harsh mercy-arts can gain at mid-career. Certain sacred strikes and rites leave behind a lingering charge, which a later greater rite can draw upon.

rites.name: Niarniles Rolistia
rites.text: A vital force drawn from hidden reserves within a cursed spire, granting its bearer a lasting pulse of strength. It is gathered from sealed caches scattered through the tower's depths.

rites.name: Cialanum Valostium
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a remembered, unstable core of corrupted energy. Practitioners gain it by recalling such a core.

rites.name: Saulor Amiallum
rites.text: A channeled arcane technique that greatly restores a caster's reserves of magical energy over time. It is learned as a talent by practitioners of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Serialor Tianilum
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a skilled tracker bind a range of savage creatures from several wild families into loyal companions. It is learned once the tracker reaches a respected level of training.

rites.name: Losanum Santaullium
rites.text: A deadly finishing strike used by a sworn fighter. It can only be unleashed against a foe who has been worn down to a small fraction of their strength.

rites.name: Serausanum Sornum
rites.text: A sacred radiance that is bound into the armor of devout healers. It is known to those who serve the light, and it gathers its power through their faithful practice.

rites.name: Seorallia
rites.text: A hidden sorcery drawn from sealed reliquaries deep within a dread spire of the condemned. Its wielder binds a fallen ally's gaze away from the living and the dying.

rites.name: Nellia Caustesum
rites.text: A faint glowing spark of stored spirit energy that can be drawn from hidden reserves in a dark, cursed tower. It grants a modest surge of power to whoever claims it.

rites.name: Seornor Serisarnium
rites.text: A glowing power drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence kept within a dreadful, ruined tower. Those who gather these reserves gain its radiant energy.

rites.name: Telontium Rentus
rites.text: A ranged marksman's technique in which one of two mutually exclusive choices is selected at a particular tier of training. It shares its slot with a rival volley method.

rites.name: Cialornium
rites.text: A runecarving power that a practitioner gains by receiving a certain remembrance. It widens the reach of their carved marks.

rites.name: Mirnaustium
rites.text: A monk's rite granted to those who join a shadowed brotherhood of penitents. It can also be borrowed briefly by travelers passing through a grim province, lasting until their trials there are complete.

rites.name: Raunanum Rellus
rites.text: A skilled close-combat technique that strips away a foe's protective plating for a brief span, leaving them exposed to harm. The weakening lingers as a visible mark of vulnerability.

rites.name: Amarnus Tiasanum
rites.text: A dark ember-craft that small spirit-familiars of a binding-sorcerer's kind hurl at foes. It is a ranged burst of cursed flame.

rites.name: Causones
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that softens the impact of tumbles while a shapeshifter takes the form of a sleek hunting beast. It only awakens for those who have grown skilled enough to wear that form.

rites.name: Serenor Tasium
rites.text: A dark kindling power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-essence sealed deep within a cursed tower of punishment. It lets its wielder set fire to the soul-energy of foes.

rites.name: Varnontes
rites.text: A dark practice in which a caster's spells sometimes mend the bound servant beside them, restoring a share of the harm the spells inflict. The craft is taught in the first lesson of the summoner's discipline.

rites.name: Telonium Nonelia
rites.text: A hunter's craft that lets a tracker ready a bow and beast-bond at a higher stage of mastery. It is learned once the hunter reaches a certain level of skill.

rites.name: Nirniastum
rites.text: A practiced discipline that steadies a caster's will so incoming disruption does not break their focus while channeling dark incantations. It is a learned talent of cursed-binding sorcerers.

rites.name: Tillus Laustum
rites.text: A bold vocal power that only one gentle creature kind can wield. It lets the user raise a fierce cry that steadies their companions.

rites.name: Telores Serianus
rites.text: A tending craft a keeper uses to swiftly mend their bonded beast when no fighting is underway. It is learned at an early stage of mastery.

rites.name: Tirneonium
rites.text: A volatile, entropic force wielded by fiends and their servants, drawn from the chaos beyond the stars. Its use leaves lasting corruption in those who channel it, and it stands as the opposite of ordered sorcery.

rites.name: Orillum Rises
rites.text: A ranked talent sigil that a fighter may take only alongside a whirling blade-storm technique, so the two choices exclude each other. It belongs to the chosen wielder's path of skills.

rites.name: Amesum Caullum
rites.text: A martial inheritance that lets a holy warrior of the vengeful order strike with fiercer force. It is tied to the sacred gauntlet bearers who hunt wrongdoers.

rites.name: Coriantium Coreonium
rites.text: A caster's discipline in the flame arts that quickens a searing bolt but imposes a rest period when the practitioner nears death. It also grants a chance to strip an attacker's arms from their grasp.

rites.name: Mauntium Orasanum
rites.text: A cunning craft learned by shadowy tricksters, mastered after long study. It is one of the deepest skills within a hidden branch of subtle arts.

rites.name: Coriastor Melanum
rites.text: A stealth craft taught to rogues that lets them slip past an opponent's protection for a short span after a sudden strike. The effect fades after several moments.

rites.name: Teleoseres
rites.text: A dormant inner heat that a certain folk can call upon at will. Calling it forth burns away lingering afflictions and sharpens the body's strength for a time.

rites.name: Nontum Vosauntor
rites.text: A practiced caster's craft that sharpens the burn of flame magic, adding a small measured surplus to each blaze. Its gains stack with other enhancements in layered fashion.

rites.name: Laleontus Saurnianium
rites.text: A restless force that surges and ebbs in strength, sometimes freed from a great consuming beast when it is defeated in a hidden ruin.

rites.name: Mostanum Caurniasium
rites.text: A dim, wavering quality that clings to certain relics and lets their bearers slip unseen. It stirs in harmony with other hidden gifts tied to cloaked armor and silent blades.

rites.name: Nesialanum
rites.text: A deep discipline of the hand-to-hand trickster, practiced by those who fight with bare or gripped fists. It is taught as a branch within the training of the combat path.

rites.name: Raustes Raulus
rites.text: A learned knack for gathering materials from the land, letting a harvester reclaim extra reagents from natural deposits beyond the usual yield.

rites.name: Reollum Vaustor
rites.text: A rogue's discipline granted to those who join a sworn fellowship of penitent shadow-walkers. It is borrowed for a time by those who walk a cursed borderland until its storyline ends.

rites.name: Laulores
rites.text: A caster once wove a short-lived shield around themselves that soaked up searing flames. It lasted until enough harm was taken or its time ran out, and it could only be cast upon oneself.

rites.name: Lilanum Raria
rites.text: A fiery mark that a dark caster carves into a relic, drawing power from a bottomless burning abyss. It bonds with other ruinous sigils that feed on life and tear open the sky.

rites.name: Releosium
rites.text: A passive scholar's discipline that lets a spellcaster soak up a portion of incoming blows, drawing its strength from the caster's arcane might.

rites.name: Tintes Orerantus
rites.text: A vessel of smoldering devotion that lets its bearer gather crimson tokens. It can be used in any place, and its cost to the bearer is not severe.

rites.name: Lelia Telasor
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a caster can awaken late in training. Each blow taken from close quarters hardens the body briefly, and repeated blows layer that hardening into a stronger shield.

rites.name: Nostum Sisantanum
rites.text: A tuned sorcerous attunement that lets one chosen ally strike harder with spellcraft. When that ally lands a powerful cast, the binding's caster briefly sharpens their own spell-striking edge.

rites.name: Valeostanum Nastorium
rites.text: A bound current of spirit-force that can be drawn from sealed reliquary hoards within a grim, looming spire of punishment. It grants a surge of wind-like power to whoever channels it.

rites.name: Coriarelia Coraurus
rites.text: A lucky knack that lets a wielder turn a sudden chance into a decisive blow. It works closely with cunning schemes and wild, thundering shots.

rites.name: Torum Vaules
rites.text: A tempered discipline practiced by reclusive mist-keepers, who channel their breath into a single gathered surge. It can only be chosen in place of a rival wellspring technique.

rites.name: Lostum Monium
rites.text: A tactic creatures in a tamed beast contest can invoke during their clashes. It lets a companion strike with extra daring.

rites.name: Virnum Tasus
rites.text: A minor hidden craft of the sly that lets a wielder strike where luck itself seems to turn. It is bound to a pair of related shadow-touched skills.

rites.name: Vestoles
rites.text: A quiet knack carried by sly wanderers who live beyond the law. It runs alongside a cunning gift for trickery and a skill with the blade.

rites.name: Leosium Amilanum
rites.text: A dark martial inheritance that hardens the bearer against harm. It is bound to a companion gift that feeds on the fallen.

rites.name: Serorum Marum
rites.text: A discipline taught to shapers of the grove, placed in the second rank of the Waning Path. It lets the practitioner focus the radiance of the heavens into a single sharpened beam.

rites.name: Cesauntia
rites.text: A learned rite that a holy caster gains at a mature stage of training, granting two opposing bursts of power. One burst aids those who mend wounds or wield radiant strikes, while the other serves only the caster who walks the shadowed path.

rites.name: Nastines
rites.text: A chilling trait that marks a frost-wielding caster's craft, bound closely to a dark spear-like legacy. It stands as a kindred attribute of that lance.

rites.name: Cirnontus
rites.text: A chill-born power that only certain hybrid beasts can wield, letting them exhale a freezing gust. It belongs to the creatures' natural gift and is passed among their kind.

rites.name: Caulles Vesum
rites.text: A frigid malady spreads through a warrior of the cold arts, inflicted by a chilling touch and a blast of winter wind. It lingers within the afflicted body as a slow, creeping sickness.

rites.name: Amellanum Voleonor
rites.text: A learned art of the enchanting circle that binds a foe in stillness and hushes their voice. Only the seasoned practitioners who have reached a high rank can call it forth.

rites.name: Telauseores
rites.text: A cold bearing held by a order of undying knights, it quickens the gathering of their dark power and lessens the time they stay bound by hindering spells.

rites.name: Oristollor
rites.text: A protective ward that lets its bearer endure chilling magic. It is valued in dangerous halls and duels, and it helps against foes who wield icy powers.

rites.name: Serontesium
rites.text: A tireless ritual of rapid clawing that a beast-tamer's companion performs in a frenzy. It is bound to two related rites that intensify the creature's wild power.

rites.name: Ristia Oristanum
rites.text: A chilling quality that a frost-wielding caster's relic can carry. It is tied to two other relic qualities, one that sharpens a spear of dark glass and one that erupts ice from the ground.

rites.name: Talles Orastus
rites.text: A glove-bound enchantment that permanently strengthens the bearer's cold-based sorcery. It raises the force of frost spells and can only be imprinted by a skilled enchanter.

rites.name: Miareosanum
rites.text: A third-rank healer's gift that sharpens two strike spells, granting a little extra harm alongside restoration. Those who only mend wounds often pass it by.

rites.name: Oralia Miarnum
rites.text: A discipline of carved cold-sigils that a warrior-mage tier of a martial lineage can learn. It sits on the sixth rung of the frost path of study.

rites.name: Taunum Orialoranum
rites.text: A hunter's technique that sharpens the strikes of cutting and tearing. It makes each slash deal more harm to prey.

rites.name: Niantor Teontes
rites.text: A raging inner force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a crumbling tower of the cursed. Its wielders call upon it to strike harder in battle.

rites.name: Loniantor
rites.text: A cold-burning bolt cast by sorcerers who reach a certain mastery. It strikes with a searing chill and drags the victim's movements down for several heartbeats.

rites.name: Corelus Rollia
rites.text: A specialized skill that lets a chosen caster draw on a lunar deity's power directly. It cannot be learned alongside a rival moon-blessing technique.

rites.name: Seosarum
rites.text: A cold-tempered craft that lets a caster hold a foe in place for a short span of time. Its chill locks the target's limbs once the caster's strike lands.

rites.name: Serornastum
rites.text: A knight of the dead binds a sigil of frost into the blade, so each strike of the arm unleashes an added burst of chill upon the foe.

rites.name: Niallor Teliaseorus
rites.text: A chilling talent a cold-hearted war-knight can choose. It is an exclusive option, so taking it means giving up another gift tied to the Rage of the Frozen Champion.

rites.name: Orelium Tornausor
rites.text: A battle companion that only a shapeshifting folk may learn, taught by a handful of mentors who dwell in scattered settlements. It serves as a fighting partner bonded to its trainee.

rites.name: Corianes Risollanum
rites.text: A hammer-strike power stored within sealed reliquaries in a dark spire of condemned souls. Its wielder gains it by claiming those hidden caches.

rites.name: Orintolum
rites.text: A nature-keeper's discipline that deepens the slow mending spells of the grove. Practitioners must first devote eight parts of their study to the inner stream of growth before it takes hold.

rites.name: Lestialanum
rites.text: A dark rite of the restless dead that a grim-willed warrior can awaken after dedicating deep study to the corrupted arts. It drives the summoned corpses into a wild, frenzied state.

rites.name: Orosium Valeorus
rites.text: A bonecaller's servant can bite its foe for a small share of its own strength. The bite is shaped by a dark rite that alters how the servant's power turns into harm.

rites.name: Vaustanum Telestanes
rites.text: A radiant inner power that is gathered from hidden reserves within a grim, looming tower of punishment. Those who draw from these stores gain a surge of strength.

rites.name: Siaranum Tialia
rites.text: A minor inscribed mark that a spellcaster can attach to a shaping incantation. It changes the result so that the chosen target takes the form of a flightless seabird.

rites.name: Serinium Rinteornus
rites.text: A borrowed spirit-power that is gained by hurling a hungry life-seed at a leaf-clad guardian within a cursed spire. It grants the bearer a charm drawn from what was consumed.

rites.name: Corostus Siallanum
rites.text: A mark of arcane script that tints a water spirit in pale white and deep blue. Casters inscribe it to change how the elemental appears.

rites.name: Meostiles
rites.text: A ward-mark that a scribe carves in ink to make its bearer seem lifeless. It is learned through study of a specific binding-ink.

rites.name: Serentor Tellostum
rites.text: A mark that a hunter gains on their own once they reach a set level of skill. It grants the hunter a particular volley of shots.

rites.name: Corarnelium
rites.text: A carved mark that alters a dark warrior's crushing blow, changing how a particular strike of death-touched power is delivered.

rites.name: Terus Oristium
rites.text: A hidden mark that a trained thief comes to know once they reach a seasoned skill level. It is gained without any formal teaching, simply as a natural outgrowth of their craft.

rites.name: Narus Tinium
rites.text: A carved sigil worn by spellcasters that sharpens the chance of a bolt of arcane force landing a devastating blow. It adds a small measure of extra precision to their missile magic.

rites.name: Rausillium Cianares
rites.text: A carved rune that gives a frozen path a fractured, splintered look. It belongs to a warrior order that bears death-touched sigils.

rites.name: Velus Niseonium
rites.text: A mark of inscribed script that is made through the craft of carving, and it is first uncovered by study of a dark ink. It holds a bond to the way a group of hunting beasts moves together.

rites.name: Narnia Teliasus
rites.text: A dark sigil that lets its bearer perceive hostile foes in a violet hue while using a seeing trance. It works as a tool for spotting threats hidden in shadow.

rites.name: Valiarinia
rites.text: A carved mark of herd-calling craft that a scribe of the old orders inks with patience. It is learned through research into the arts of marking and scribing.

rites.name: Coreostanum Siriallanum
rites.text: A carved marking worn by fighters as a decorative mark that alters a leaping charge, so that landing releases a crackling burst of storm energy against the ground.

rites.name: Millia Ciallium
rites.text: A sigil of binding ink that is shaped through a scribe's trained skill and that is first uncovered by studying a particular war-tethering ink. Its use summons aid from a fellow bound to the caster.

rites.name: Lastor Lanteolor
rites.text: A rune-craft mark that wardens of the grave learn once they reach a certain standing among their order. It was once taught to all of its practitioners automatically, but that tradition has since been abandoned.

rites.name: Teleontium Lolasor
rites.text: A carved sigil that lengthens the time a rogue can remain hidden after slipping from sight. It adds two extra seconds to the concealment.

rites.name: Rallanum Ciasanum
rites.text: A carved sigil that marks spirits drained by arcane force, tinting their essence a cool sea-green so hunters can recognize them. It is used to track and bind such wounded souls.

rites.name: Santanum Coralor
rites.text: A carved sigil that makes a caster's soul fragments hover above their head, blazing with a cursed flame. It is used by spellcasters who bind dark essence.

rites.name: Valernilor
rites.text: A carved mark that lets a cleansing rite strip away one extra enchantment, though the rite must then wait a short while before it can be used again.

rites.name: Neonares
rites.text: A carved ward-mark that could be set upon a bearer's protective barrier. It was once drawn by scribes to strengthen an armored warrior's shield against arcane assault.

rites.name: Teliantia Mausorium
rites.text: A hidden inscribed ward that is prepared with a craft of carving and is revealed through study of glimmering pigment. It is set to lock an intruder in a sudden coating of frost.

rites.name: Saurnasium
rites.text: A minor inscribed mark used by spellcasters. It changes a transformation charm so that the chosen target becomes a small clever primate instead of its usual form.

rites.name: Corauntor Mallisanum
rites.text: A carved ward made from a specially prepared inscribing ink. It is produced by a crafter who has studied the ink through a dream-based research method.

rites.name: Orirus Rellum
rites.text: A dawn-bound gift that lets practitioners of the wind and mist ways draw strength from the sunrise. It is granted to those who walk the monk's path of breath.

rites.name: Amastum Lostasanum
rites.text: A carved sigil that halts a creature's thoughts for a short while. It is made through the craft of engraving and is uncovered by studying a luminous pigment.

rites.name: Leones Cilanum
rites.text: A dark marking that lets its bearer sprout green wings while gliding through the air. It is tied to the hunters who stalk fiends.

rites.name: Calisium
rites.text: A ward-mark that a caster can set upon a meal-table so it appears richer and more ceremonial, with a small trickling fountain set among the dishes.

rites.name: Taunanum Sollentor
rites.text: A sealed rune of binding that a senior caster learns on reaching the highest rank of their craft. It is granted without study once that threshold is crossed.

rites.name: Maniasum Teliarausia
rites.text: A stolen sigil that changes distraction into a blinding burst of light and sound. It is outlawed among the craft-guilds because its flare can ruin an entire gathering.

rites.name: Vastaunium
rites.text: A bound sigil that lifts a caster's stored soul fragments above their head, where they burn with a fierce flame. Only those following the path of ruin may invoke it.

rites.name: Miseolium
rites.text: A ward-sigil that a scribe inks by mastering a practiced hand. It can be learned from a teaching tome or by studying a particular inking method.

rites.name: Corarnausum
rites.text: A flame-kindling sigil that every trained caster gains on reaching a high level of mastery. It is learned automatically once a mage reaches that threshold.

rites.name: Minor Nolares
rites.text: A mark inscribed by skilled hands that binds the bearer to the living world. It is passed down through a single taught method and can be gathered from small forest spirits found on a distant island.

rites.name: Taurnia Seraulles
rites.text: A violent cold wave that sweeps a battlefield and is said to fall from a commander known for her precise, winter-like skill. It appears as a reward during a hard, rare encounter.

rites.name: Coralontor
rites.text: A ritual power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spiritual essence kept in a towering prison-citadel. It lets its wielder call upon stored soul-energy for a surge of might.

rites.name: Seranisia Nontes
rites.text: A practitioner draws power from the depths of death rather than from dark masters, learning to shape and command the risen dead. Their bone blade grows stronger as they do, and they raise loyal skeletal servants from the remains of fallen fighters and scholars.

rites.name: Valaules Laliror
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that grants its bearer a binding hold over others. It is gained by recalling a fragment of an old, forgotten warlord's memory.

rites.name: Lonor Varnanum
rites.text: A blessing of judgment that is granted to holy warriors who swear oaths of righteous defense. It is drawn from a reservoir of arcane essence.

rites.name: Amiarellium
rites.text: A lasting binding that can be woven into a hand-held blade so that every blow it lands carries four extra points of harm.

rites.name: Amelaurnia
rites.text: A binding art that imbues a pair of hand coverings with lasting magic, sharpening the wearer's skill with their craft.

rites.name: Tallium Amillesium
rites.text: A restorative incantation cast by sacred keepers of the old circles. It takes a long time to channel but mends a great deal of injury at once, though it draws heavily on reserves of spiritual energy.

rites.name: Amausernum
rites.text: A sworn warden's rite that grants a defender ten seconds of total immunity to harm. It is learned at a certain rank and takes the place of an older vow, acting much like a second sacred ward.

rites.name: Telistia Lesum
rites.text: A practitioner's sorcerous hold stretches farther across the land, letting their curses take root in those who stand well beyond the usual reach of such craft.

rites.name: Lesiarnia
rites.text: A grim, stubborn endurance drawn from blood-bound battle craft. It links with bone-breaking and fang-drinking techniques, strengthening a fighter who refuses to fall.

rites.name: Tasus Orirastus
rites.text: A grasping rite that a restless warrior of the grave may choose as an exclusive path, forsaking another rite of reach to claim it.

rites.name: Nostium Carneosor
rites.text: A tending craft practiced by restorative healers of the wild. It is bound to the living essence of a sacred glade and is channeled to mend the woodland.

rites.name: Cernausor
rites.text: A skilled guardian's gift that lets a sworn warrior cleanse the taint of foes with a single laying of the palm. It is granted only to those who have reached a high stage of their training.

rites.name: Orintesor
rites.text: A holy technique in which a sworn warrior channels radiant power through the palm to strike down foes. It is practiced by those who seek justice through vengeance.

rites.name: Serellus Ceosarnanum
rites.text: A stubborn inborn endurance that shortens how long a dazing blow keeps a body senseless. Warriors who hold the line value it greatly in clashes between rival fighters, and shieldbearers rely on it because a dazed defender cannot ward off attacks.

rites.name: Maliasum
rites.text: A devotional technique where a sworn guardian channels sacred resolve into the strikes of their judgment. It cannot be learned alongside a rival swiftness rite.

rites.name: Telales Reoles
rites.text: A sacred consecrated rite that strengthens a holy ritual's striking power while lowering the spiritual reserve it draws from the caster. It is a discipline taught to guardian-knights of an old order.

rites.name: Valastilia
rites.text: A thick cloth wrap that a skilled healer stitches together with practiced hands. It is learned from a single handwritten guide and is later taught by instructors.

rites.name: Telontia Lornanum
rites.text: A second-rank discipline drawn from a warrior's oath-craft, it fuses an older binding ritual into every judgment the practitioner pronounces.

rites.name: Vaniastor
rites.text: A communal fervor granted to every member of one war-camp after they finish a long trial of devotion. It lifts their endurance, quickens their blades, and steadies their breath during fights.

rites.name: Seronum Ralleonanum
rites.text: A hunter's skill that would have made a marksman's arrows strike more harshly against foes. It sat at a high rank in the archery discipline's training tree.

rites.name: Amenus Serornilum
rites.text: A recurring check that tests whether a lingering enchantment still holds its grip. When the check succeeds, the enchantment breaks early and its effect stops before its time runs out.

rites.name: Rostanum Carones
rites.text: A bristling technique that companion beasts use while locked in a contest of champions. It drives the skull forward to strike an opponent during such bouts.

rites.name: Vernianor
rites.text: A swift killer's technique that delivers an immediate blow and leaves a lingering mark, making the victim's wounds open wider and bleed more fiercely.

rites.name: Teleolium Teornus
rites.text: A dark inner power that is gathered from hidden reserves within a deep, sorrowful tower. It lets its wielder strike straight through another being's core.

rites.name: Coreosia Vialauntus
rites.text: A battle-chant taught only to one faction's shamans, it quickens the footsteps and hands of every companion nearby for a short span. Its rival school grants a twin rite under another name.

rites.name: Telilor Vollantor
rites.text: A sacred blaze that a devout caster can call forth to strike a foe at once. The burning continues to scorch the target afterward, making it the strongest of the caster's direct attacks.

rites.name: Naulosor
rites.text: A concealed cutting craft that lives within a fighter's gear, tied to nimble skirmishers and to the bearers of destiny-bearing relics. It lets its wielder strike unseen.

rites.name: Sentanum Tolium
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a sworn champion draw a portion of their inner wisdom into their power over sacred workings. It is a trained skill of the holy warrior's craft.

rites.name: Coresiallum
rites.text: A sacred shielding craft that resists radiant force, but only against foes far above one's own standing. Few wielders command its radiance, and grave encounters seldom unleash it.

rites.name: Valonia Tillostes
rites.text: A bonded warrior's talent that chills every foe standing close by, locking them in ice for a short span. It is drawn from the grim cold-craft of the frost path.

rites.name: Caunium Oriarnia
rites.text: A chosen ability of the dark-pact practitioners that stands as an exclusive option alongside Mortal Coil. It belongs to the warlock's craft of shadow and fear magic.

rites.name: Orantes Amastaurus
rites.text: A fifth-rank craft practiced by trackers of the wild, passed down through the hunting lodges. It belongs to the branch of the forest arts that concerns survival in open country.

rites.name: Orirnia Valernausia
rites.text: A chilling gust a grave-bound warrior unleashes, striking several foes nearby with cold while leaving a lingering frost sickness on each one it touches.

rites.name: Maustia Tareollus
rites.text: A combined incantation that strikes at once and then keeps wounding over time. Its force is split between the immediate blow and the lingering harm, each share matching its strength.

rites.name: Amostor Vestollus
rites.text: A frost-aligned arcane discipline that a caster can learn at the sixth rank of the cold path. It is no longer available in later revisions.

rites.name: Mellus Amonistium
rites.text: A practitioner's frozen talent that shields the wielder from all harm and hostile effects for a brief span. Using it chills the body so it cannot be invoked again for half a minute.

rites.name: Mauliarnes
rites.text: A taught craft handed out as a reward for earning favor with a sky-watching guild. It lets a hunter bind lesser scaled beasts and the horned stag-kin, but only a hunter can learn it.

rites.name: Telirialium
rites.text: A grim clustering craft that dead servants can call upon to draw close together. Its effect is shifted by a dark rite of transformation.

rites.name: Corauntes Launastium
rites.text: A channeling art taught to practitioners of arcane force, letting them keep their body suspended above the ground. It is gained by completing a particular errand given to those who seek it.

rites.name: Naulia Teleosanum
rites.text: A learned discipline that lowers the fury needed to unleash a rapid, forceful blow. Warriors once trained it as a standard part of their craft before it was dropped from teachings.

rites.name: Tirnanum Telialores
rites.text: A minor hex art within a sorcerer's shadow discipline that dulls a foe's pace. Its strength could be sharpened by study until a later revision folded the full effect into the base spell.

rites.name: Miastanum Rarnes
rites.text: A guardian's discipline that lets a sacred ward hold more blows before breaking. Each training rank adds further strikes and makes the ward's retaliating pulse hit harder.

rites.name: Ceostum Leontor
rites.text: A battle-craft that swells the fury a fighter gathers whenever they hurl themselves forward at an enemy. It rewards bold rushes into combat with a larger reservoir of wrath.

rites.name: Conum Rornia
rites.text: A discipline of a guardian's inner wrath that is sharpened through training in the shield-bearing path. It can only be mastered by those who have devoted much of their study to defense.

rites.name: Costor Nornillia
rites.text: A sacred healing craft practiced by priests, learned gradually as a practitioner grows in skill. Its full mastery is not always granted to those who pursue it.

rites.name: Seolentor
rites.text: A dark sap-craft talent that a sorcerer may choose from a single exclusive branch, paired with a companion gift of blood-giving. The two cannot be taken alongside other arts from the same tree.

rites.name: Neolles Teollia
rites.text: A restorative fog-craft practiced by wandering healers, granted to adepts once they reach a certain stage of training, though not always bestowed on schedule.

rites.name: Orisor Mania
rites.text: A fighting technique that widens the arc of a warrior's blows. It is chosen as one path that excludes another related skill.

rites.name: Vauliarnium
rites.text: A discipline that strengthens every summoned minor spirit servant bound to a practitioner's will. It amplifies the workings of all such lesser familiars.

rites.name: Oreoles Ameontus
rites.text: A learned skill that strengthens a rallying war-cry sung by fighters before battle. It draws on a deep well of rage and must be trained through a demanding path of study.

rites.name: Sornaullium
rites.text: A learned discipline that trims the lead-up of a searing flame-bolt by a small fraction at each stage of mastery. Practitioners who cast that bolt often find it becomes a prized craft for pressing damage faster.

rites.name: Rianor Rolus
rites.text: A ritual skill taught within a seeker's enhancement path that strengthens three kinds of guardian wards, letting each one hold more force against harm.

rites.name: Valiastor Viarnum
rites.text: A battle-craft refinement that lets a fighter hurl a single mighty strike with greater force. It may be granted early in a warrior's training but is not always assured until later.

rites.name: Seroreontia
rites.text: A fighting discipline of martial focus that a warrior may choose in the seventh tier of training, bound against a rival technique of resolve.

rites.name: Orasteonium
rites.text: A three-point skill of the wayfarer's craft, taught in the second rung of the close-combat discipline. It is a quiet technique that sharpens strikes made from behind an unaware foe.

rites.name: Lornium Amialintus
rites.text: A former practice that sharpens a bound companion's charm, making its calming touch work better, its veil of concealment last more efficiently, and its enthralling spell come faster.

rites.name: Neles Renontia
rites.text: A devoted healer's gift that once raised the odds of a sudden inner focus, letting the next two restorative prayers be chanted swiftly for a short while. It was later stripped from the path of the faithful.

rites.name: Nostaulia
rites.text: A bonus found by warriors of a sworn order, offered early in their training but only reliably granted once they reach a higher rank. It belongs to a forge-craft of their brotherhood.

rites.name: Sirialor
rites.text: A flame-born force of spirit is drawn from hidden stores of vital essence kept in a dark, cursed tower. Those who gather it can call upon its heat as a power.

rites.name: Siror Miarnanum
rites.text: A hunter's practiced technique for strengthening a venom-laced strike from a ranged weapon. It is learned at the fifth rung of the marksman's discipline.

rites.name: Cinaurnor
rites.text: A frost-bound trait that belongs to a cold-working caster's craft. It is tied to two other traits, one about releasing winter's hold and one about a protective ward.

rites.name: Rallum Viasteontum
rites.text: A tier-one discipline of the verdant healers that strengthens a caster's blessing of wild growth. It also raises the caster's own bodily and mental vigor by a small percentage, though the blessing's boost reaches all who receive it.

rites.name: Tolia Caullia
rites.text: A learned chill that a practitioner can deepen through study of cold arts. Mastering it requires dedicating seven measures of effort to the discipline of ice.

rites.name: Tenus Larianum
rites.text: A tiered gift taught to healers that lowers the energy each restorative chant drains from the caster. It sits deep within the sacred branch of a healer's learning.

rites.name: Seornia Vornia
rites.text: A old ritual enhancement that strengthens the wind-calling and flame-binding charms carried into battle. It makes close combat fighters hit harder and makes the fire spirits deal greater harm.

rites.name: Cestantus
rites.text: A sworn guardian's bond that deepens the warding of their oath. It can be taken only in place of a rival blessing that also shields the bearer from sorcery.

rites.name: Sentonia
rites.text: A fire-born practitioner's art that hurls sudden scorching flame to burn a target directly. It is wielded in the manner of destructive sorcery.

rites.name: Lantor Cisalles
rites.text: A tiered skill of the archer's discipline that sharpens a steady aim. It is no longer available to those who train the craft.

rites.name: Reolintanum
rites.text: A refined discipline art that sharpens the potency of a holy blessing cast upon allies. It is taught to devoted practitioners who have advanced through the middle ranks of study.

rites.name: Cirneolles
rites.text: A dark burning craft practiced by sorcerers who unleash fire to ruin foes. It is bound to a lasting contest between rival powers.

rites.name: Cesanum Coraullia
rites.text: A ritual discipline practiced by healers of the old circle, it strengthens a healing cascade that leaps from one wounded ally to the next, amplifying its restorative power by a fifth.

rites.name: Rernones
rites.text: A battle-cry technique that sharpens a warrior's intimidating howl, so that foes strike with noticeably less force afterward.

rites.name: Tiasium Serestor
rites.text: A caster borrows the outward likeness of a nearby soul or a passing stranger for a short span, then must wait a while before weaving the veil again. Apprentices may learn the technique from a sorcerous tome sold in a scholars' city.

rites.name: Serinus Amiriarnum
rites.text: A cold inner stillness that a wandering order of undead-bound warriors cultivates. It sharpens their bearing and lets them hold their ground against fear.

rites.name: Amalium Valeolostum
rites.text: A tending gift granted to healers of the wild who walk the old paths, letting their restorative touch strengthen after they have grown in their craft. It is not promised to every seeker, arriving only once they have reached a late stage of their training.

rites.name: Caurneolles
rites.text: A stealth craft taught to certain shadow-walkers that sharpens the surprise strike of a hidden attacker. It is learned through the subtle-arts discipline of a rogue order.

rites.name: Ameosiarium
rites.text: A refined discipline of shadow that a practitioner can take up after mastering the basic veil. It makes the veil stronger for anyone who holds it.

rites.name: Oranor Tosenanum
rites.text: A refined technique that extends a defender's guarding stance so it stops incoming blows more often. This lowers the total harm the practitioner suffers in battle.

rites.name: Tenteollor
rites.text: A fighter's trained discipline that softens magical harm while braced behind a guarding posture. A successful deflection or evasion ignites a brief fury that sharpens the strikes they deliver.

rites.name: Coresarnum
rites.text: A fire-working talent that a flame-bearer may choose instead of another path. It stands exclusively beside the Ashborn Pyre-Lust, so one cannot hold both.

rites.name: Aminauntes
rites.text: A fire-born force drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored spirit energy within a dark, cursed tower. It lets its wielder hurl burning spears of flame.

rites.name: Narus Neonteror
rites.text: A bound power that Sable-hunters can awaken within their gear. It shapes the wearer's craft into a quiet, fated pattern of strikes that cannot be turned aside.

rites.name: Corauntia Telanium
rites.text: A boundless inner force that can be gathered from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy within a dark, perilous tower of trials.

rites.name: Vauserus Valeornia
rites.text: A dark practitioner's craft that marks a single method of inflicting torment. It is bound to three other sinister techniques that share its roots.

rites.name: Calleosia
rites.text: A practiced art that lets a caster fade gradually from notice over a few heartbeats, until they vanish entirely and are no longer counted among those in the fight.

rites.name: Visaustia
rites.text: A dark devotional art that a priest of the shadowed path may learn once they reach a set level of experience. Those who take the path instead choose a gentler rite of the light.

rites.name: Neonus Valaulum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a mist-walking adept gains once they reach a seasoned rank. It sharpens the purging of the body, so that all venoms, bleeding wounds, and enchanted afflictions are expelled at once.

rites.name: Ciantia Tontium
rites.text: A frost-bound craft carried by sorcerers who channel winter's bite. It pairs with a lance-bearing rider's discipline, binding cold power to mounted combat.

rites.name: Corollus Niareontor
rites.text: A learned practice open to adepts of a high rank, it lowers the rate at which a caster restores their inner reserve, yet for a short span afterward it sharpens the force of their spells once a sustained rite is completed.

rites.name: Villes Moraurnium
rites.text: A sworn warrior's discipline that sharpens the pulses of a sacred oath-mark and lengthens the hour in which a holy inquest holds its grip. Both gains are described as considerable.

rites.name: Leolia Telarnenum
rites.text: A tactic where a creature forces its place in the line to be traded with the next companion, sending that ally forward into the fight instead.

rites.name: Saleontus
rites.text: A dark inherited craft that binds a practitioner's hunger to a hidden jaw of gloom. It is tied to two other ancient disciplines that draw on the same bleak source.

rites.name: Tollor Lales
rites.text: A knight's sacred mark is laid upon a foe, so that those who strike the marked one are refreshed in their inner reserves. It was once a variant of an older binding sigil and is no longer in use.

rites.name: Amellor Coreornus
rites.text: A piercing gaze that strips away a deceptive presence, revealing what a bearer truly is beneath a frightening glow. It works only on beings whose intimidating aura masks their real shape.

rites.name: Telintes Veontus
rites.text: A monk's ritual drink that channels a flowing, scented energy through the practitioner. It is learned by mystics once they reach a mid-level stage of training.

rites.name: Corellium Vialostia
rites.text: A sworn power a holder gains for one hour after opening a sealed warden's tome. The tome can be found only in a distant battlefield.

rites.name: Riantus Amentus
rites.text: A passive discipline that a sworn guardian gains upon choosing a defensive path. It lets the warrior replenish their inner reserve of arcane energy while standing in the thick of battle.

rites.name: Oreolostia
rites.text: A paladin's rite that replaces an older sealed binding, unleashed as a judging strike. Its chance of failing matches that of an ordinary close-quarters blow.

rites.name: Orisernes
rites.text: A tracker's learned technique that lets a hunter command a bonded beast to strike a marked quarry. Hunters of the bow and the wild each refine the art in their own way.

rites.name: Lenus Neollarum
rites.text: A stealthy finishing blow to the lower back that leaves a foe dazed and unable to flee or retaliate. It opens the target to easy strikes from behind, though the mightiest guardians shrug it off.

rites.name: Orianor Telaunor
rites.text: A learned instinct of the wild-shaped hunter, unlocked by mastering the beast-fang discipline. It serves as the necessary step toward a fiercer frenzy of the blood.

rites.name: Seneosor
rites.text: A lost art that teaches a sneak to take on the look of a stout, dusky mountain folk, aided by a few common tools. It was never shared openly with the world.

rites.name: Niastum Neollaurnia
rites.text: A hidden craft that teaches a sly thief how to pass as a scholar of a sealed tower by using a handful of simple props. The method was never shared widely.

rites.name: Valisastum
rites.text: A hidden art that teaches a wanderer to wear borrowed trappings so they pass as a sea-raider. It was never shared openly, and it needs only a handful of common objects to work.

rites.name: Oriareosus
rites.text: A forbidden craft that teaches a wanderer to wear the guise of a roadside raider, using a handful of simple tools. It was never shared openly with the public.

rites.name: Valausum Sauntor
rites.text: A hidden craft that lets a sly wanderer take on the look of a common street thug, using a handful of tools. It was never shared openly with anyone.

rites.name: Vineollus
rites.text: A swift fire-strike craft that a caster learns by instinct, pairing with a lingering burn. Its brief recharge and renewal by a surging flow make it the core beat that shapes the caster's attack order.

rites.name: Sorallanum Ceostum
rites.text: A bounding strike that a summoned undead companion can perform, and which is changed when the bearer's dark transformation takes hold.

rites.name: Vintor Amineores
rites.text: A dark rite of the shadow-keepers that lets a caster's wasting curse linger longer on an enemy. It is drawn from the mastery of a battle-faith and unlocked once a practitioner reaches a set rank.

rites.name: Laria Corialum
rites.text: A sacred surge that sharpens a devoted fighter's divine fury for a time. It draws its power from a holy vow and is remembered in honor of a revered crusader.

rites.name: Amialauror
rites.text: A frost-binding trait carried by cold-channeling sorcerers, tied to two related frost traits that shatter and sharpen icy force.

rites.name: Valesium Callia
rites.text: A dark practitioner trades a portion of their own vitality for a sudden surge of arcane force. The bargain fuels a relentless flow of ruin, but only for as long as the practitioner's body endures.

rites.name: Lelus Nalia
rites.text: A practice in which small living creatures channel their vitality to one another during a contest of champions. It is a technique that allows a companion to pass strength across the field.

rites.name: Ceores Sosanum
rites.text: A binding worked into a breastplate so that now and then a blow is swallowed, sparing the wearer a portion of its harm. The effect is slight and comes unpredictably.

rites.name: Nialles Mestanum
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that answers a fallen member of a radiant people. When one of them dies, nearby foes are struck and nearby allies are mended within a short reach.

rites.name: Valirium Reoria
rites.text: A quiet light bound to a keeper's craft, it is joined to other glowing gifts that rise and fall with the phases of the sky.

rites.name: Telastor Rirnanum
rites.text: A warding discipline in which a sworn guardian channels a steady glow to shield allies from harm. It is learned by those who have reached a certain standing in their training.

rites.name: Vinium Santum
rites.text: A dark mantle of arcane force that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs within a cursed tower of imprisoned souls. It grants its wielder a ghastly, undying presence.

rites.name: Viarnes Liarosia
rites.text: A grim warrior-rite that lets a battle-sworn oath-keeper take on a deathly hardness for a brief span. While it lasts, the wielder shrugs off enchantments of dread, dreams, and enthrallment, and drinks more life from every blow struck. It may be invoked even while already under its spell.

rites.name: Corneostia Telania
rites.text: A fiery curse that slowly burns a marked foe until their body erupts, scorching nearby enemies and passing the flame onward to them.

rites.name: Valernum Corostisum
rites.text: A lingering power drawn from sealed reserves of residual spirit force hidden within a dreadful tower of torment. It lets its bearer carry faint resonances of past energy forward into later moments.

rites.name: Amornanum Nentes
rites.text: A permanent mark etched onto the shoulder of a warrior, granting battle-hardened fighters enhanced strength. Only the crafts of inscribing can produce it.

rites.name: Serium Mianes
rites.text: A lasting trial bound to a hunter's relic, tied to two companion gifts that endure beside it. It sustains the bearer's resolve through prolonged struggle.

rites.name: Tonales
rites.text: A hunter's solitary skill that sharpens their strikes whenever no beast companion walks beside them. Once the companion leaves, the bonus slowly builds to its full strength over a short span.

rites.name: Reollistia
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that is drawn out of a remembered token of affection. It lets the carver bind their will into the runes they inscribe.

rites.name: Serenus Amosium
rites.text: A creature-bonded charm that stirs affection in a companion beast. It is worked into a contest of tamed creatures, where a chosen beast can call upon it.

rites.name: Minanum Orarnia
rites.text: A quiet inherited skill practiced by the keepers of the grove's balance. It makes the night-flame and the day-flame burn hotter when a keeper calls on them.

rites.name: Sintianus
rites.text: A hunter talent placed in the fourth tier of a beast-handling discipline. It lets a practitioner endure for a long span of years.

rites.name: Oriallanum Coraunor
rites.text: A rite of inner heat that answers to a second, hungry flame. Those who carry it are bound to that smoldering craving.

rites.name: Ciror Serialum
rites.text: A ritual method that lets a bearer rotate their focus through nearby hostile beings, choosing which foe to face next by a chosen direction.

rites.name: Naunor Reontanum
rites.text: A innate gift shared by every creature of the dusk-folk, quietly strengthening the sorcery they unleash. It requires no effort or ritual to hold.

rites.name: Mintausium
rites.text: A ward that is worked permanently into a long-hafted melee blade, granting it a notable boost in adaptability in battle.

rites.name: Mernolum
rites.text: A hunter's talented skill that lets a trained tracker dash forward with a sudden burst of speed. It was available to hunters once they reached a high level of training.

rites.name: Vauneornor
rites.text: A tactic that a single battling companion unleashes during a contest of tamed beasts. It brings down a sudden, downpour-like assault on the opposing side.

rites.name: Serosium Nolles
rites.text: A grave-binding craft lets a practitioner of death-magic call forth a temporary spirit-sorcerer whenever a great doom-rite or a summoning of the dead is performed. The sorcerer arises alongside the usual effects of the rite.

rites.name: Riasor Orernium
rites.text: A dark art taught to spellcasters that deepens the harm of all their curses and sharpens the chance of striking a devastating blow with the wasting and rending spells they cast.

rites.name: Amiliasum
rites.text: A holy rite that cleanses a circle of ground, lifting harmful afflictions from allies while stripping one protective ward from up to five foes. It reaches a short distance from the chosen point.

rites.name: Teliarnor Mausiaranum
rites.text: A drain-craft in which a caster siphons arcane energy from living foes, storing it for a later burst. Its use was dropped because the upkeep became tiresome in tense battles.

rites.name: Monum Valaustum
rites.text: A dark practice that lets a reanimated servant act as a loyal companion rather than a bound guardian. It grants simple commands, set stances, and a few creature-specific strikes and maneuvers.

rites.name: Orillanum Teostum
rites.text: A dark binding that, once laid on a person, makes them a vessel for a malevolent dread spirit. The brand corrupts its bearer and draws in those who seek to break its hold.

rites.name: Telonor Telasor
rites.text: A chosen warrior's rite that marks a foe with a crimson sign. It stands as one option among rival rites and works alongside a separate tomb-stone power.

rites.name: Maurnastum
rites.text: A bound crystal that, once invoked, restores a measure of its wielder's arcane reserve. Practitioners of the conjuring craft shape it at their highest working rank.

rites.name: Cornia Neoles
rites.text: A dark binding craft that draws inner vitality from hidden reservoirs in a cursed tower. Practitioners gain it by tapping those buried wells of stored essence.

rites.name: Naurium Roria
rites.text: A trait of the rogue's craft that marks the practiced art of the silent killer. It is bound to a restless hunger for blood, quick shadowed movement, a skill with poisons, and wounds that bleed without end.

rites.name: Veoles Orastonus
rites.text: A marking borne by skilled archers that bends their aim toward distant targets. It works together with several other linked gifts that sharpen strikes and guard the bearer.

rites.name: Meornanum Laulontor
rites.text: A trained discipline known to the keepers of a fermenting-hall order, which lets a practiced warrior slip aside from blows aimed at them. It grows stronger as the adept is struck more often in close combat.

rites.name: Tiallia Castauror
rites.text: A ward-craft where a wearer's sanguine resilience grows stronger as their sharpened inner strength deepens. It draws its power from the bloodline discipline of the order that teaches it.

rites.name: Neonium Neostus
rites.text: A mastery earned by a practitioner who gathers a high measure of skill in a culinary discipline, first pursued through an initiation trial. It is granted once the seeker's accumulated points reach a set threshold.

rites.name: Lelintum Orelium
rites.text: A guardian discipline held by sworn defenders, sharpened by an inner measure of skill. It raises the chance to turn aside blows and softens harm while standing within a consecrated circle, and it also strengthens the bearer's strikes.

rites.name: Raurallanum
rites.text: A discipline of martial strength that warriors of the arms path train in. Its power grows through the practitioner's mastery of their craft.

rites.name: Valarnium Veontum
rites.text: A learned discipline practiced by dark casters who wield hexes and ailments. Its skill grows stronger as the practitioner's inner attunement deepens.

rites.name: Torianum
rites.text: A frost-caster's craft in which bolts of cold gather shards of ice that are stored and later hurled as a piercing spear. It also empowers a rolling orb of frost.

rites.name: Contia Teornaullum
rites.text: A rare craft of stealth that a practitioner selects from a shared branch of learning. It is paired with a single dance-like discipline and cannot be chosen alongside its rival paths.

rites.name: Taurnales
rites.text: A grim inner discipline that a dark warrior sharpens to deepen the strikes of a cursed blade. The more attuned the practitioner becomes, the stronger the effect grows.

rites.name: Mauntor Vauntes
rites.text: A defensive discipline practiced by shield-bearing fighters, sharpened by a secondary gift of the spirit. It raises the chance to turn aside blows, and a portion of those turned blows are deflected with especial force.

rites.name: Coriallium Miareonum
rites.text: A discipline of the offhand dagger, practiced by wandering cutthroats of the wilds. Its skill grows with the practitioner's inner keenness and attunement.

rites.name: Salium Valiantosia
rites.text: A fighter's discipline that lets blades cut past flesh into lasting harm. Those trained in the sword-arts sharpen it through their inner reserve of skill.

rites.name: Nanum Tollia
rites.text: A discipline of the blade that sharpens a fighter's heaviest blows, letting strikes that break guards and finish wounded foes hit with greater force.

rites.name: Rauntus Neoses
rites.text: A dark inner craft drawn from wrathful bloodlines, awakened in avengers once they reach a seasoned stage. Its strength grows with a particular refining attribute.

rites.name: Senornus
rites.text: A hidden craft of the silent blade, where a practitioner's growing skill in stealth sharpens each strike. It refines a fighter's innate talent for shadowed assassination.

rites.name: Tialeosanum
rites.text: A discipline of spirit-wielders who amplify their natural gifts through sustained practice. Its strength grows in step with the mastery a practitioner builds.

rites.name: Ronia Telales
rites.text: A battle-bound inheritance that bends the strength of a holy warrior's sacred relic. It is bound to two related inheritances that answer the same oath.

rites.name: Oreliantor
rites.text: A learned knack of the mind that lets a caster lower the energy needed for quick, instant workings. It belongs to the disciplined circle of ritual keepers.

rites.name: Vorallia
rites.text: A channeled sight-craft that lets a caster perceive the world through another being's eyes for one minute. It is practiced by mystics who blend inner discipline with shadowy arts.

rites.name: Narium Coraunontor
rites.text: A remembered skill that surfaces unpredictably from an old record of forgotten recollections. It was once granted as a reward from a sealed treasury in the underworld.

rites.name: Virneostes Vaunternor
rites.text: A recollected blast of sorcerous fire that rains down from a fortified hall in a dread tower. It is a keepsake one can claim from the deeper floors of that stronghold.

rites.name: Oriallor Tontaullium
rites.text: A fire-craft technique that strengthens a caster's strikes against foes nearing defeat. Its power grows with each level of training, and it proves most valuable late in long battles.

rites.name: Teliantes Sillornanum
rites.text: A dark mental technique practiced by shadowy caster-priests, unlocked through a surge of madness. It lets the user tear at another mind's sanity.

rites.name: Teoranum Seriles
rites.text: A binding worked into a chestplate that permanently strengthens the wearer's vitality. It requires a practitioner of considerable skill to complete.

rites.name: Orenalles
rites.text: A passive craft of fire-wielding casters that sharpens the chance of landing devastating blows while softening harm from blades and blunt force. Its strength grows further once the practitioner reaches a higher rank of mastery.

rites.name: Nianus Risornia
rites.text: A dark mental craft practiced by shadow priests, unlocked through a surge of madness. It lets the caster drive a sharp burst of psychic harm into a foe's mind.

rites.name: Amaullases
rites.text: A fiery protective skin that only the hound kin of hunting companions can wear. While it is active, it scorches every creature that strikes at close range.

rites.name: Amaurnum Valosor
rites.text: A binding craft that is woven into a chest garment so that it permanently lifts every measure of the wearer's ability by one.

rites.name: Oreostasum
rites.text: A protective enchantment woven into a breastplate that occasionally soaks up a portion of incoming blows. Each strike has a small chance to be partly swallowed by the ward.

rites.name: Mornia Nauntia
rites.text: A dread craft that a mage order's members may take up after swearing to their secret brotherhood. It lets a practitioner reflect pain and dread back upon foes for a limited time.

rites.name: Nonium Saurnus
rites.text: A borrowed craft lets a caster who bonds with an arcane practitioner summon a shimmering double of that practitioner. The duplicate is a lesser copy of a known sorcerous trick.

rites.name: Mauneosum Corolium
rites.text: A rogue's technique in the deadly arts that returns a portion of a strike's power to the striker when the victim is badly wounded.

rites.name: Vaunistanum Valaror
rites.text: A ranged marksman's technique that lets an archer loose several projectiles at once. It can be learned from the beast-bonding path or the precision path of the hunter's craft.

rites.name: Telaneorium
rites.text: A dread-bound inner force drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence within a cursed spire of punishment. It hardens the bearer against the gnawing fear of vermin.

rites.name: Taseranum
rites.text: A paired strike art practiced by shadow-blades who wield two short knives together. It inflicts harm on a foe while building momentum for a finishing blow.

rites.name: Solenum
rites.text: A bonding discipline that binds a warrior's spirit to a commander, so that both act with one shared will. It cannot coexist with a rival trait that feeds on despair.

rites.name: Naunium Coraurnus
rites.text: A drained fatigue that settles on a traveler after fighting a rift-warden in a ruined keep. It comes in three shades and blocks the bearer from answering another gate of the same shade for a short span.

rites.name: Mornum Renus
rites.text: A dark lesser craft that lets a fighter of the grave-arts call upon a hollow reserve of strength when battling other champions. It is a talent taken up only once a warrior has grown into a certain rank of skill.

rites.name: Orintia Oriliarum
rites.text: A dark inherited force drawn from hidden reserves held within a cursed, towering prison. It grants its bearer a lingering power taken from these buried caches.

rites.name: Liria Taniallor
rites.text: A discipline of the cold-hearted warrior that steadies the hands of one who fights with a blade in each grip. It is a required study for those who wish to wield two weapons at once, paired with a later skill from the same path.

rites.name: Oraurastia
rites.text: A dark, decaying pall that a warrior of the grave can draw around themselves. It is a skill sought in contests between rival champions once they reach a certain standing.

rites.name: Lornintia
rites.text: A protective battle technique drawn from a guardian's scale-bound relic. It lets a shield-bearing fighter brace against harm with a surge of earthen resolve.

rites.name: Orianus Mauntaranum
rites.text: A dormant wellspring of hushing force that can be drawn from sealed reserves hidden within a haunted spire. Those who tap it gain a power that cancels what opposes them.

rites.name: Veseolium Nontus
rites.text: A dark inner power that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence within a towering prison-fortress of the condemned. Those who gather these caches gain access to it.

rites.name: Orenteosus
rites.text: A trait carried by a guardian's relic that bears a thunderous blessing. It links together two other sacred marks held by the same bearer.

rites.name: Coraunum Tareolus
rites.text: A keen innate sense of danger that quietly softens the first blow a fox-like folk takes from foes, shielding a small share of their total vitality.

rites.name: Valeonus Cinauntes
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a single warrior grows stronger when facing a crowd. It works alongside other protective and battle-enhancing practices.

rites.name: Silaustor
rites.text: A stored inner power drawn from hidden reserves within a deep, cursed tower. Rarer versions of it can be held in several layered measures at once.

rites.name: Lentiria
rites.text: A stored surge of gathered essence that a seeker can draw from hidden reserves in a dreadful tower. It grants a doubled charge of sharp, spiking force.

rites.name: Teloranum Seonum
rites.text: A ranged craft wielded by watchers, it sends a burst of focused sight that interrupts a caster's spell. It works like a hunter-beast's silencing bite.

rites.name: Lirnanus
rites.text: Carved glyphs of a brutal tongue that a dark sorcerer etched while descending into a sealed crypt. Whoever touches one briefly takes on his form, wielding his scythe and fire, yet keeps their own vitality.

rites.name: Raseontum Corontium
rites.text: A stored inner force drawn from hidden reserves within a deep tower of ruin. It lets a bearer shatter the paths that bind celestial bodies to their circuits.

rites.name: Ceornium Seranum
rites.text: A glowing focusing power drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence buried deep within a cursed spire of torment. Those who gather its residue can sharpen their inner force.

rites.name: Valiases Vostausium
rites.text: A discipline of carrying a canopy against the sky, earned after a trial repeated ten times. The mastery is recognized by a messenger who sends a faded violet shade as a token.

rites.name: Siarus Villus
rites.text: A bond-craft drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-essence, letting a wielder claim a portion of a trapped life-force. It is gained by breaking open buried vaults within a grim, towering prison-fortress.

rites.name: Lenus Reolonum
rites.text: A dolorous current of spirit-force that is drawn from hoarded essence stores in a cursed spire. It can be harnessed as a power by those who gather it.

rites.name: Ciallistus
rites.text: A discipline of the shadow path in which a caster's lingering torment is renewed by each draining incantation. It also softens the backlash that strikes the caster after a desperate execution.

rites.name: Telarnelia
rites.text: A discipline that deepens a caster's cold magic so that chilled foes move even slower and mend less. It is favored by wanderers who keep retreating while striking at their pursuers.

rites.name: Corastia Orianirnium
rites.text: A raw form of harm dealt by blows and close strikes, along with certain warriors' and wild-folk's fighting arts. Armor and shields can soften it, though a clean dodge or a turned-aside stroke can avoid it entirely.

rites.name: Mantanum Tesistum
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a practitioner pass a lingering sickness from one victim to nearby foes. The spreading reach can be widened slightly with a minor sigil.

rites.name: Nernia Orasornus
rites.text: A training manual that teaches hunters how to make their companions feign lifelessness on command. It also covers the method for rousing them back to readiness.

rites.name: Amorniantes
rites.text: A second-rank healing discipline that lessens the magical harm a keeper of the wild endures. It proves valuable in any struggle where such harm is common.

rites.name: Tarenus
rites.text: A dark warrior's discipline that lets a blood-drinking knight endure harm more steadily. It is a learned skill taken from the path of the crimson-bound death knights.

rites.name: Teleorus Telolausor
rites.text: A tactic that a creature uses in a contest of companions, letting it strike back against its opponent with a noxious bough. The technique weakens rivals who stand before it.

rites.name: Seriasum Reoria
rites.text: A grim skill wielded by undead knights of the old orders, allowing them to drain sickness from their foes. It is learned once a warrior reaches a seasoned rank of mastery.

rites.name: Sileosor
rites.text: A dim inner power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit found deep within a cursed tower of ruin. It lets a wielder bend the shadowy energies that such a place holds.

rites.name: Serelantium
rites.text: A set of brewing components that a sneaky trader gathers from stalls to mix into deadly draughts. The craft advances with the practitioner's own rising experience, growing stronger as they climb.

rites.name: Oriastanum Riarnes
rites.text: A combat discipline that a fighter can learn to improve the handling of long-hafted weapons. It sits among the advanced techniques taught within a particular martial path.

rites.name: Sernum Serones
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack possessed only by one bloodline of tall riding beasts, which slowly sharpens the mastery of whoever bonds with them. It works the same way as several other bond-gifts shared by different beast kinds.

rites.name: Vinus Veornausium
rites.text: A spellcraft that tears open a shimmering doorway, letting a caster's companions step through to a distant contested headland. Those from one banner emerge at a fortified camp, while those from the other arrive at a rugged stronghold.

rites.name: Mestium Teleones
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster open a passage for their companions to step through to a distant swampland settlement. Only one of the two warring peoples can wield it.

rites.name: Veolanum Valiarum
rites.text: A stalking feline-shaped fighter leaps from concealment onto a victim, stunning them briefly while a lingering wound drains them over time. It can only be performed while crouched unseen.

rites.name: Tausiantor Telianernor
rites.text: A quiet attunement that a carved relic of the wild shares with a second lunar gift. The two bind together so that each strengthens the other.

rites.name: Sisum Miaror
rites.text: A dark craft in which a practitioner offers up two lesser summoned spirits, drawing out two stored surges of infernal energy that can be held for later use.

rites.name: Aminor Telornastus
rites.text: A word for two kinds of strength: an extraordinary, magical act that a being or object can perform, and a measure of raw offensive force. Such strength rarely comes from learned trades.

rites.name: Rirnum Sastum
rites.text: A bearer of cold dark force keeps a single self-bound posture that shapes their combat, changed only by taking up another. Shifting costs nothing but the loss of stored charge, and there is never a moment without one.

rites.name: Malia Valania
rites.text: A layered augmentation that a maker can add to any crafted object by using a specialized skill. Each application grants the object extra enhancements beyond its ordinary qualities.

rites.name: Rirus Raseores
rites.text: A shielding spirit-force drawn from sealed reliquary hoards deep within a dread spire. It wraps its bearer in a protective shimmer.

rites.name: Tenes Listeonanum
rites.text: A mind-bending cry drawn from a devotee's inner will that sends several nearby foes fleeing in panic. Keepers of the old orders rely on it to scatter enemies and regain control of a battle.

rites.name: Cellaunus
rites.text: A fighting technique that breaks down a foe's defenses by striking through them. It lowers the fury needed to use certain armor-breaking blows.

rites.name: Lerostanum Vonteostes
rites.text: A learned rite that strips a magical blessing from a single foe, much like a cleansing chant used by healers of the old orders. It still takes effect even when the foe is shielded by a special ward, and it stands as one of two mutually exclusive paths.

rites.name: Rasia Cirnanum
rites.text: A sacred craft in which a holy warrior is restored by the mending of others. Each time the warrior tends a wounded ally with a focused blessing, a soothing renewal flows back into the caster.

rites.name: Vollaror
rites.text: A bonded winged reptile is called down to a rider, who can then float slowly through the air on its back. The effect lasts for a short span before the creature departs.

rites.name: Narniarium Nalles
rites.text: A fiery technique is used by a stocky, short-legged beast during a contest between tamed companions. It lets the creature unleash a burst of glowing heat to help it win the match.

rites.name: Amallus Seolanum
rites.text: A learnable craft that lets a practitioner call forth a fox-like companion. The bond is sometimes granted as a reward from a shrine in a fortified stronghold.

rites.name: Lisum Valasiarus
rites.text: A rite of hunters that calls down a storm of disorder upon their foes. It was once a gift granted to those who had earned high standing among their order.

rites.name: Valeolum Amiasanum
rites.text: A violent fire-working gift that a caster can take in one of two exclusive paths, paired with a related flame ability. It belongs to the battle-mage craft of a sundered realm.

rites.name: Liasia Seniarium
rites.text: A tamed beast can be driven into a blind killing frenzy by its keeper's bond. The rage makes the creature fight with reckless, unstoppable ferocity.

rites.name: Cisaules
rites.text: A dark fury stirs within a select cutter of demonic blades, granting raw power. It is bound to the wisdom of an ancient hunter tradition.

rites.name: Ameolia Lenum
rites.text: A battle-fury trait that stirs a warrior's wrath and burns through their restraint. It is bound to the marks of old wounds that a fighter carries.

rites.name: Orintium Rirollus
rites.text: A dormant craft of the ember-tenders that sometimes stirs, briefly swelling the force of flame and shadow in a caster's spells. Its stirring comes by chance and fades after a short while.

rites.name: Rauntirum
rites.text: A discipline of the blade trained through a deep branch of the lethal arts, learned after many steps of study. Its practitioners reclaim their vigor quickly after exertion.

rites.name: Teloles Nauntes
rites.text: A cleansing fire is drawn from a devoured soul-essence after a hungry cell is hurled at a shambling dread-spirit within a cursed spire. The flame burns away corruption.

rites.name: Telesirus
rites.text: A dark craft practiced by a sorcerer of the shadowed arts, drawn from a cursed scythe. It siphons the spirits of the dead into the caster's own grasp.

rites.name: Seraseontia
rites.text: A dark hunger that seizes a wild shapeshifter who has bound itself to a shadowed night-court. It is granted to such followers and, for a time, to those who walk through its grim lands.

rites.name: Tiastausium
rites.text: A reckless fighting discipline in which a rampaging battle-rage reshapes a warrior's bloodlust and furious strikes into harsher, more brutal forms. Practitioners must choose it instead of a rival calming technique.

rites.name: Launarnus
rites.text: A thief's craft that lets a cunning sneak mend their own wounds in the midst of a fight. Small crimson sparks crackle around the practitioner while the restoration takes hold.

rites.name: Mallontanum
rites.text: A cleansing craft taught to certain nature-wardens, letting them purge every hex and venom from a companion with a single gesture. Only three of the wild-keeper lineages may learn it.

rites.name: Leonum Orestium
rites.text: A bound book kept in a scholarly city that can appear in place of a textbook on the schools of hidden craft. It holds introductory practical advice for those learning the basics of spellwork.

rites.name: Ameneollus
rites.text: A bearer shrugs off a hostile magic or elemental strike, either fully negated or only softened. Fortitude and distance from the caster's power decide whether the blow lands.

rites.name: Lentus Lalor
rites.text: A healing gust drawn by a mist-attuned adept, mending wounded companions nearby. It can be chosen only instead of a rival rite called the Veil Shroud.

rites.name: Oreontares Ceorniastes
rites.text: A practitioner's trained technique that duplicates a sorcerer's own casting pattern. It must be chosen in place of a rival method that pulls residual magic back into the body.

rites.name: Tornor Reosellus
rites.text: A dormant gift of renewal that heals wounds for the restorers of the wild grove. It cannot be reached by anyone at present.

rites.name: Ninum Tanor
rites.text: A spirit of the smithing flame can remake its own form in the middle of a contest of beasts. The technique lets the smith-spirit mend and reshape itself while the struggle continues.

rites.name: Cernaunor
rites.text: A sworn guardian's chosen discipline, set against a rival vow of radiant light. Only one of the two paths may be taken at a time.

rites.name: Sisanum Vasillia
rites.text: A dark inherited gift that lets a practitioner of shadowy hexcraft tear at a foe's inner spirit. It is bound to a pair of related sorcerous traits.

rites.name: Raurnialles Voniantes
rites.text: A dark grafted discipline taught among death-touched warriors, found in the cursed branch of their training halls. It is no longer taught, having been stripped from the disciplines long ago.

rites.name: Varauntium
rites.text: A sworn-oath discipline taught to holy warriors of the vengeful rite. It is one of two mutually exclusive paths a practitioner may choose in their training.

rites.name: Telintus Corallium
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a skilled fighter's leaping strike quickens the steps of nearby companions and shields them from anything that would hinder their movement.

rites.name: Niraulles
rites.text: A bonding trait bestowed by a forge-blessed guardian that keeps a wearer's crest hardy and sheltered. It cannot coexist with a rival craft that restores damaged substances.

rites.name: Miallantus Oristanum
rites.text: A quiet, unbidden tide that flows through a healer's hands and strengthens every mending they perform. It needs no call or ritual, and it has long since faded from the old practice.

rites.name: Serolles Serilianus
rites.text: A tactic used by sly fighters at a high level of mastery. It marks a foe so that every later trick of the same thief lands with greater force.

rites.name: Valeranum Corolanum
rites.text: A reanimated servant is raised from the dead by a dark warrior of the grave. Its bond can be sustained without limit by a dark-minded fighter, and a fierce ritual surges its strength for a short while.

rites.name: Orollium Cesum
rites.text: A discipline of bearing down on a foe, in which a warrior devoted to a holy oath draws strength by mastering their own craft. The practice binds the wielder's skill to their resolve.

rites.name: Siniasia
rites.text: A resonant striking craft drawn from sealed reservoirs of inner essence hidden within a dreadful spiral tower. Practitioners channel stored vitality into blows that echo outward and strike again.

rites.name: Oreornus Vaurium
