rites.text: A swift counterblow technique practiced by duelists, delivered instantly to strike an opponent and knock the weapon from their grip for a short span.

rites.name: Leosanum Lialium
rites.text: A sweeping close-quarters strike that wounds every foe before the wielder. Evading or deflecting a blow lets the next such strike come at no cost.

rites.name: Valaustes Maullum
rites.text: A humming inner power drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden in a towering prison of the doomed. Those who tap these hoarded stores gain a surge of borrowed force.

rites.name: Ameonintium
rites.text: A scholar's method for uncovering hidden writing techniques, granting the practitioner extra skill points. It lets a copyist of inscriptions learn new ways of shaping script.

rites.name: Masernanum
rites.text: A bonded hunting craft practiced by wild shapeshifters in the skirmish lists. It is learned by fighters who reach a certain standing in their training.

rites.name: Mianus Valauneoria
rites.text: A gift of attunement that mages may take, linked to a particular teaching path. It cannot be combined with an older lineage of knowledge.

rites.name: Nallus Niarnor
rites.text: A stirring force drawn from hidden reserves buried in a grim spire of trapped souls. It lets its bearer call upon the spirit of a striding beast.

rites.name: Mostus Vaurnum
rites.text: A fiery sorcerer's technique that is chosen as one of a set of exclusive options, and it works alongside an enhanced ember-burst practice.

rites.name: Rollum Tiases
rites.text: A glowing carved sigil that, when activated, returns several fallen allies from nearby to life so they can fight again. It is a one-time boon for a battle.

rites.name: Raullus Amellastus
rites.text: A grim affliction that weakens the body, lowering how much health a creature can hold for a short while.

rites.name: Corollor Viallarnes
rites.text: A carving-born craft that lets a practitioner unfurl a stored rune-memory into a sudden burst of motion. It is drawn from a relic of ancient swift-binding wrappings.

rites.name: Carium Coreosenum
rites.text: A carved sigil-shield that a dark warrior of the cold dead can draw upon. It is a protective craft bound into their gear.

rites.name: Nolliantus
rites.text: A mystic inscribing power that is drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy stored in a dark, towering prison-fortress. Its marks channel the essence held within those deep vaults.

rites.name: Teollium Minus
rites.text: A warding quality carried by fighters' relics that lends them a deep, booming presence in battle. It works alongside a bond with might, sturdiness, and the drive to endure.

rites.name: Valeres Valaulium
rites.text: A stealthy skill that lets a trained operative quietly render one foe helpless for a short span. Those who master the craft learn it automatically along the path of shadow.

rites.name: Amiastilles
rites.text: A sudden disruption that breaks off a conjured working midway. The moment it occurs, the caster's incantation is severed and the magic collapses unfinished.

rites.name: Valum Valinaurus
rites.text: A quiet trained knack that lets wayfarers who move in the shadows survive long plunges with far less harm than an ordinary body would take.

rites.name: Liarnium Mentaunes
rites.text: A consecrating discipline that a holy warrior may choose along a branching path of talents, and that works in tandem with a companion inner-grace practice. Taking it closes off the alternatives on that same branch.

rites.name: Milles Neolium
rites.text: A binding that shields a traveler's wrist-guards whenever a homeward stone is used within two distant realms. The ward is sealed into the guards permanently and holds fast there.

rites.name: Reostum Riantaures
rites.text: A fierce fighting discipline that a wandering warrior can master after long years of practice. It is learned through the deep study of close combat.

rites.name: Montia Lianaurnum
rites.text: A dark sigil of a death warrior's cursed weapon that ties together three related powers of ruin, endurance, and the undead legions summoned beneath its shadow.

rites.name: Taullistor
rites.text: A resonant inner power that is drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dark, towering prison-labyrinth. It answers a practitioner's call with a second, echoing voice of force.

rites.name: Orallum Vauliasia
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's craft plants a hidden kernel of shadow within a foe, which bursts outward in a wide blast of harm once that foe has taken enough punishment.

rites.name: Nareolia
rites.text: A dark inherited craft in which a hidden blight is carried by a practitioner and bound to three other forbidden arts. The blight grows quietly alongside them.

rites.name: Seralus Taulles
rites.text: A hunter's skill lets her perceive the world through the eyes of a bonded bird familiar, which watches from a fixed perch until its roost is torn down.

rites.name: Nirnallia
rites.text: A parchment roll that falls from a great sky-beast called a Ravenor Gorgor when it is slain in the lowland Dravenmoor fields. It holds a spell of sudden wind.

rites.name: Amiallia Ceosentium
rites.text: A sworn warrior's blessing that slowly returns a portion of their inner reserve whenever they strike an enemy or pass a solemn verdict. It lingers for a long while and cannot be stripped away.

rites.name: Telarum Orosintum
rites.text: A radiant discipline taught in the lower halls of a sacred order. It deepens the force of two blessed strikes, sharpening each burst of holy fire beyond its usual measure.

rites.name: Manaules
rites.text: A passive craft that strengthens one chosen inner quality of a practitioner by a fixed share, guiding each discipline toward its proper focus. Certain disciplines, however, receive no gain from it at all.

rites.name: Veleonus
rites.text: A sacred vow that lets a sworn fighter strike with crushing force on every blow, while the same power turns back and wounds the one who wields it. The vow was eventually banned for being too dangerous to its own bearers.

rites.name: Lerniarum
rites.text: A permanent rune carved into the shoulder of a sturdy defender, granting protection only to those whose carving skill has reached a high mastery. Scribes must keep that craft honed to keep its gift.

rites.name: Mornales
rites.text: A guarded talent of hunters that sharpens watchfulness, drawn from a set of mutually exclusive branching choices. It is listed among the later skills of the hunter's path.

rites.name: Valeolirnes
rites.text: A coiled inner craft held by the reptilian companions of hunters. It sharpens the wielder's magical force by a tenth, and only the scaled beasts of that lineage can share it.

rites.name: Seornestum Lestanum
rites.text: Caster-folk can lay a fleeting elemental charm upon their blades, though only one such charm holds on a blade at a time. Those who wield two blades may bind a different charm to each hand.

rites.name: Cernauntus Seraunanum
rites.text: A learned gift that a caster of a certain disciplined or shadowed path acquires without effort. It summons a dark companion spirit that the caster can direct through a set of commands.

rites.name: Mastia Oralles
rites.text: A learned craft in which a caster's gathered gloom-spheres grow more harmful. Those who master it are known for striking harder with their dark orbs.

rites.name: Orontestium
rites.text: A devout caster's learned art that steeps their dark magic in growing strength. Each gathered layer of shade sharpens every gloomy strike, and training makes the art take hold more reliably.

rites.name: Rellus Amasum
rites.text: A lingering dark curse that a robed caster lays upon a foe, dealing a sharp initial wound followed by slow, creeping harm. Practitioners of the shadowed arts gain a surge of dread-fueled power whenever the curse takes hold.

rites.name: Lorasia
rites.text: A dark, wild instinct that surges through a beast-bonded wielder's relic. It works in tandem with keen primal reflexes and a deeper animal sense.

rites.name: Meornor Ameriallum
rites.text: A dark-aligned spell a shadow-trained caster can unleash for instant harm. It hits far harder against a foe nearly broken, but if the target survives, the backlash strikes the caster instead.

rites.name: Amilus Cesor
rites.text: A dark sorcerous craft that unleashes a shadowy burst, leaving nearby foes frozen in place for a short span. It is a talent taught to practitioners of forbidden arts.

rites.name: Selauria
rites.text: A quiet practice of the shadow-binders that marks a foe with a gathering dark. Each strike of the dark bolt deepens the mark, so that the afflicted suffers more harm from the one who wields it.

rites.name: Vistus Sereostinor
rites.text: A deep-tier practice of the destruction path that sharpens a caster's dark bolts and searing blasts, making both hit harder. Its lore is taught to adepts of the old flame-and-gloom arts.

rites.name: Oreontaria
rites.text: A stealthy killer's gift that lets its holder move as swiftly as a passing dark. It is bound to a set of related talents that together shape the practice of silent assassination.

rites.name: Rintium Lorneria
rites.text: A quiet, subtle trait carried by wayward relics, tied to a vulnerable hollow and a ravenous surge. It draws its strength from these linked traits.

rites.name: Serirum Orentus
rites.text: A dark rending technique that inflicts gloom-tinged harm on a chosen foe and spills onto up to three nearby companions.

rites.name: Lintium Ceorernum
rites.text: A discipline of the dark arts that grants its practitioners a measure of protection against magical assaults. Its benefit applies only to spells, leaving the bearer exposed to other threats.

rites.name: Vantanum Seriarnia
rites.text: A passive enchantment that wakes when certain charms of the dead are carried, granting its bearer a lingering heat. It answers only to the paired relics of the two rival bloodlines.

rites.name: Ranesium
rites.text: A quiet, dark-touched gift that lets its bearer conceal their passing presence. It is bound closely to a related inner shadow-essence.

rites.name: Niarallia
rites.text: A passive gift that certain sworn guardians of the highest rank quietly acquire, letting their defensive vigil shine outward to shield those around them without any conscious effort.

rites.name: Milles Solles
rites.text: A practiced craft that lets an adept slip short distances twice before needing a long rest. It cannot shake off binding grips, and it must be chosen instead of an ice-based path.

rites.name: Corases Mauseolus
rites.text: A sacred power that is bound to a relic of a devoted guardian. It works together with several other blessings of the same order.

rites.name: Vollus Telestolus
rites.text: A keen-edged craft once practiced by shadow-trained fighters, where a hidden grain of ore lends a blade extra cutting power. It was reserved for those who walk unseen and strike from the dark.

rites.name: Tistia Miastus
rites.text: A carved rune-craft that lets its user raise a protective barrier of charged force. It is drawn from a remembered ward-stone once etched in an ancient cairn.

rites.name: Valornum Valaustesia
rites.text: A sly skill taught to stealthy fighters, letting them strike with a secondary blade. The blow is feeble but deepens whatever sickening draught already coats their edge.

rites.name: Sianaurium
rites.text: A ward of frozen force that, when broken by an attacker, always bursts outward and locks nearby foes in ice. It can only be woven by a caster who has already mastered the basic frost barrier.

rites.name: Sollanum Rauntia
rites.text: A carved rune-craft is drawn from a remembered fragment of ruin. It lets a practitioner inscribe sigils that wield a crushing, unmaking force.

rites.name: Teleosia Cantiases
rites.text: A heavy guard-technique wielded by a sworn defender, who drives a shield forward with crushing force to batter an enemy and stir up a surge of battle fury.

rites.name: Valeostelus
rites.text: A fighter's technique of hurling a weapon across the field to strike from afar or break through a foe's protective wards. It can be learned in place of a rival throwing art.

rites.name: Seranor Corontor
rites.text: A shimmering shield-skill that only the young drake-kin companions of hunters can wield. For a short span it softens the harm of sorcerous blows against them.

rites.name: Carniasanum
rites.text: A slang word for a transformative enchantment that turns its target into a harmless woolly grazer. Those who cast this charm are called by a related term.

rites.name: Amaustia Oriarnolia
rites.text: A discipline of quiet instruction that a chosen healer-monk may pick up, and that can only be taken alongside a particular guarding veil of pride.

rites.name: Orantor Taror
rites.text: A heightened sense of instinct granted by a guardian's relic. It works alongside a bearing's endurance and savage bite.

rites.name: Vonus Caustores
rites.text: A frost-wielding caster's craft that sharpens the odds of a devastating blow against any foe held fast in ice. It lifts the chance of critical strikes across all of the caster's spellwork, not only the cold arts.

rites.name: Meoliranum
rites.text: A fighter's passive craft that stores up fury whenever a guarded strike lands, and also whenever a warrior turns an incoming enchantment back on its caster.

rites.name: Teostium Colum
rites.text: A defensive discipline taught to front-line fighters in a sundered realm. It shortens the recovery time of two guarding stances and lets one of them blunt sorcerous harm for a short span.

rites.name: Amasianium
rites.text: A deep training discipline that lets a warrior absorb more harm from blows caught on a raised guard and makes the strikes delivered by that guard hit harder. Over time a newer, more forceful method eventually took its place.

rites.name: Corisiastum
rites.text: A bound hunter's craft that drives a sworn avenger toward swift, exclusive strikes. It pairs with a rival discipline that splits the target's defenses apart.

rites.name: Nallium Silarus
rites.text: A quiet inherited mark that a wielder carries for stealth killing. It stands in a close bond with a second mark known for choking its victims.

rites.name: Villontus
rites.text: A dark draining craft tied to a corrupting curse. Each time the curse takes hold, there is a chance the caster draws back a small measure of their own vitality.

rites.name: Mintanum Coriastor
rites.text: A fiery mark-craft that a demon-slaying avenger learns without instruction. It is a talent passed to those who seek retribution against fiends.

rites.name: Saunum Oreollum
rites.text: A battle-craft that lets a fighter wielding a blade in each hand keep pace with rivals who rely on a single heavy grip. It serves as a rival path to the two-handed discipline of the Titan's grip.

rites.name: Seranteones
rites.text: A tool that lets a sworn guardian call forth a band of allied champions to swiftly finish a common errand of the realm. It works only on tasks that are not grand trials.

rites.name: Orosum Cornestor
rites.text: A passive craft that lets its bearer draw strength from foes they have already struck. It works in concert with two other ordained gifts that break foes and set them burning.

rites.name: Telorum Cirneostia
rites.text: A dark art of inscribed glyphs that is drawn from a recollected store of forbidden instruction. Those who carve its marks gain a shadowed capacity to shape hidden forces.

rites.name: Ventes Meolanum
rites.text: A warrior's trained skill for carrying a secondary weapon at the hip. It is a rare path that a fighter must choose, and it competes with a heavy blow technique.

rites.name: Corasinium
rites.text: A dark inner power is gathered from hidden reservoirs within a deep, sealed tower of punishment. It lets its wielder bloom bone-like growths from the skull.

rites.name: Corianium Cirnium
rites.text: A practiced spell-craft that binds a foe's limbs with drag, lowering how fast they can move for a short span. It is learned as a talent by those who wield arcane power.

rites.name: Amiarnasus
rites.text: A stealth talent within the sixth rank of a shadow-craft discipline. It lets a practitioner strike hidden foes from concealment.

rites.name: Listor Soneolium
rites.text: A rising kind of spirit-energy is drawn from hidden reserves found in a grim, layered tower of punishment. Those who gather it can channel it as a force of power.

rites.name: Vilium Telornus
rites.text: A deadly craft of exact strikes that only the practiced may claim. It can be acquired once every other foundational discipline has been mastered.

rites.name: Nales Veontes
rites.text: A practiced finishing technique that lets a fighter strike in rapid succession to dispatch foes quickly. Its quickened blows also let a wielder deliver more toxins within the same span of time.

rites.name: Maunium Orestor
rites.text: A learned charm that binds a traveler's descent into a gentle drift. Those who cast it can leap from towering ledges and land unharmed.

rites.name: Telornium Ristium
rites.text: A dark inner current that a wielder draws from hidden reservoirs buried deep within a forbidden tower of torment. It grants a fighter a surge of killing power.

rites.name: Orentes Nosia
rites.text: A mage-craft quality that slows down how a conjured thing moves. It is bound together with two other related qualities.

rites.name: Liasinus
rites.text: A chosen discipline taken by a mist-spinning adept of a contemplative order. It cannot be combined with a rival calming rite, forcing the practitioner to pick one path.

rites.name: Oreosus Seonales
rites.text: A ritual craft once taught to shield-bearers that lets them soften the force of incoming strikes. Those who trained in it could endure heavy assaults that would otherwise break them.

rites.name: Tianum Marnes
rites.text: A stilled trance seizes a bearer, freezing all action until any harm wakes them. Certain charms, brews, and sleep-dusts can bring this stupor on, though it fades quickly in duels between wanderers.

rites.name: Coresiantia
rites.text: A hunter's inner power is drawn from hidden reserves of essence found in deep, cursed towers. Those who gather these reserves gain a sharpened strength for slaying.

rites.name: Rontanum Rirum
rites.text: A holy knight's gift that quickens their casting pace and, when a sacred ward is raised, surges their stride for a few brief moments.

rites.name: Tilles Oriseres
rites.text: A dormant practice in which a caster slowly restores their own vitality while resting away from battle. It works only in open country, never within enclosed fighting grounds.

rites.name: Miantor Telanus
rites.text: A ritual craft of guiding starlight into sharp, piercing strikes, practiced by keepers of the balance arts. It links with the resonating heavens and with swift inner renewal.

rites.name: Cinelium Siastia
rites.text: A hidden inner force that a wielder draws from sealed reservoirs buried deep within a cursed spire of punishment. It guards the spirit against harm when called upon.

rites.name: Amostes Valestum
rites.text: A bonded traveler's spirit takes on the form of a beast, leaping a short distance forward and running swiftly until they act again. Smaller beast forms appear when resting in safe places.

rites.name: Orausor Restor
rites.text: A stored spark of life-force that a wanderer can draw from hidden reserves within a sealed spire of punishment. Drawing it unleashes a sudden surge of power.

rites.name: Nastia Lontalor
rites.text: A ward woven into a blade so that, now and then, a strike sparks a surge that refills the reserves of every ally nearby over a short span.

rites.name: Sernus Reosintes
rites.text: A sorrowful inner force gathered from hidden reservoirs within a dark tower of punishment. It lets its bearer draw strength from those stored reserves.

rites.name: Amiastaulor
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's rite that dulls the attention of every foe nearby, so that they forget the caster and lose most of their hostility toward them.

rites.name: Raurnus Riarnium
rites.text: A craft of binding several lesser charms into one unified working. Practitioners learn it from a teacher once they have gained sufficient skill in the arcane arts.

rites.name: Maullasia
rites.text: A learned discipline that hardened guardians cultivate to turn aside incantations. It is taken as an either-or choice alongside a sturdiness discipline, so a practitioner must pick one path.

rites.name: Viarus Tirnes
rites.text: A discipline practiced only by one order of brewing-hermits, learned after reaching full mastery of their craft. It lets a practitioner move with the spirit of their drink-making.

rites.name: Ciasonus
rites.text: A blessing granted only to a certain kind of tamed hunter companion, sharpening its master's skill in a way that grows stronger as the companion rises in power. It works the same as several other companion gifts found among other creature families.

rites.name: Amiranum Corauranum
rites.text: A learned defensive art that lets a warrior of the blood-keeping orders turn aside incoming enchantments. It was once taught in the sanguine schools before being struck from the curriculum.

rites.name: Teliarnia Amelleostor
rites.text: A hunter's gift that lets a blade cut into a foe's inner essence. It is drawn from a specific kind of war-blade wielded in the main hand.

rites.name: Cirnium Calesor
rites.text: A dormant ember-craft that a sorcerer of the sundered cult can awaken once mastered. When its seed detonates, it spreads a creeping blight across every foe nearby and returns a spark of stolen essence to the caster.

rites.name: Coreontium Corostanum
rites.text: A swift technique practiced by nimble thieves, granting a surge of extra speed in a sudden burst. The rush lasts only a short span before fading away.

rites.name: Toriantes Orialia
rites.text: A ranged strike power drawn from a hidden reservoir of gathered essence within a deep, cursed tower. Its whips are studded with barbs that pierce foes.

rites.name: Sintollia
rites.text: A bond-trait that a binding spirit grants to its chosen bearer. It cannot be held alongside a rival endurance gift.

rites.name: Ceontia Leornus
rites.text: A restorative gift of the spirit-beast kin, granted only to the hunters' companion creatures. It lets these bonded beasts knit wounds with a quiet, otherworldly touch.

rites.name: Vianes Veorestus
rites.text: A skilled fighter's battle-roar that leaves foes reeling and unsteady. It can be learned once a warrior reaches a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Lanauntium
rites.text: A ritual gift that lets a caster perform any incantation while walking freely. It can even be invoked mid-chant, so the caster may begin moving partway through a spell.

rites.name: Liantium Talia
rites.text: A devoted caster's inner craft that wraps a protective barrier around the soul. It is learned by a guardian-minded healer who has grown into the deeper circles of their order.

rites.name: Teollum Leolestor
rites.text: A chilling power drawn from hidden reserves of stored spirit energy in a dark, ruined tower. It is gathered from caches sealed away within the tower's halls.

rites.name: Orirolanum Veollium
rites.text: A tuned craft of the spirit-callers that gathers crackling energy from the air. It is taken as a mutually exclusive path alongside the Warden's Club.

rites.name: Amollia Cosirum
rites.text: A fighter's trained technique that lets a warrior stand firm against blows. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside a related endurance skill.

rites.name: Lineolus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that a seasoned spirit-weaver awakens to gather a sudden force of weather into their blows. It works without being called upon and rises only once the wielder reaches a certain depth of mastery.

rites.name: Venus Soseorium
rites.text: A bound parchment sold by two wind-trackers at seaside outposts during a stormy festival. It is said to let its holder call and shape the gales.

rites.name: Sintium Valosaurnus
rites.text: A peculiar mineral-laced liquid used to call forth elemental spirits within a scholar's workshop. Its uses are tied to summoning rites performed in that laboratory.

rites.name: Veranum Teleosor
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a healer's restorative spells shorten the lingering strain left on a wounded spirit. Each mending lifts a little of that burden sooner.

rites.name: Aminor Amaustia
rites.text: A tide of tempest-craft awakens within a chosen seer who has mastered every foundational discipline. It stands apart from all other gifts, answering only to a mind already fully trained.

rites.name: Lisus Tontanum
rites.text: A quiet craft of the hidden blade, bound to a tricky relic-trait. It works alongside two related traits, a silence-keeping art and a thick brewed mixture.

rites.name: Seles Amaunellor
rites.text: A ritual working lets a caster step instantly from where they stand to a distant sacred core and then return. It is granted as a reward for completing a trial of forging a ring.

rites.name: Tereornus
rites.text: A hardened discipline of the wild-keepers that lets a practitioner grow rough shell over the body. It forks against a rival craft, so only one of the two may be chosen.

rites.name: Naulum Resia
rites.text: A dormant kindling trait that a keeper of harmony can awaken within a relic. It draws on a balance of light and stillness and links together a few related inner-glow traits.

rites.name: Nialles Coronaurnia
rites.text: A radiant power of the life-essence is gathered from hidden reserves within a dread spire of the condemned. It draws strength from the warmth of captured light.

rites.name: Ciarnallor
rites.text: A dark rite that lets a caster plunge into a frenzied state, hastening their hunger for chaos and letting them act while in motion. The price is their own life unless a chosen foe falls within a short, fatal window.

rites.name: Oreornum Lisaunum
rites.text: A hunter's craft that stirs a rush of power within a tamed beast. It is bound to a companion technique that sets the creature loose.

rites.name: Vornirium Cillianes
rites.text: A dark ritual that calls forth a temporary shadow-guardian to serve beside the caster's existing servant. After a short while the guardian fades away, unless a special inscribed tome makes its bond permanent.

rites.name: Nantum Nolum
rites.text: A dark caster's talent that conjures a bound fiend to fight alongside its summoner for a short span. It can only be chosen in place of another rival technique.

rites.name: Telastium Lornantor
rites.text: A ritual that calls a burning spirit guardian to stand beside the caster for a short while. It fights alongside the usual companion and then fades away.

rites.name: Tiantornor Corolium
rites.text: A discarded craft of the death knight orders, once taught in the first rank of the blood path. It has since been removed from the disciplines of the order.

rites.name: Ciarellus
rites.text: A ward of gathered radiance that restores the caster's inner reserves for a short span. Anyone who strikes the caster is scorched by a flash of hidden force.

rites.name: Valeosanum Reolliarum
rites.text: A dark rite that calls forth a small fiery demon servant for a caster who has unlocked a special sigil. The rite was later abandoned after its servant was folded into a more common summoning.

rites.name: Maunus Ceoria
rites.text: A dark-craft rite by which a caster calls forth a hollow-eyed servant bound to the abyss. The servant obeys the summoner and fights as a minion at their side.

rites.name: Rarillus
rites.text: A learned craft of the arcane path that raises a caster's inner spirit by a modest share at its fullest training. Its mana renewal works only while the caster is not in a hushed pause, and it grows more useful when paired with a warding enchantment that turns the gain into added striking force.

rites.name: Leornirum Seollus
rites.text: A bound-spirit power drawn from a hollow cell left after a tyrant warden is vanquished within a dread spire. It lets its wielder confine foes.

rites.name: Ameostor Valiasaunia
rites.text: A sacred craft that gives a healer a random chance, when casting certain holy spells, that their next swift mending will come forth at once and cost no reserve of strength.

rites.name: Tinaurnium
rites.text: A ritual path that lets druids take on a swift winged shape once they reach a high rank and master riding. Finishing the trials grants a fitting honor and a few small charms.

rites.name: Tantenia Telornus
rites.text: A fast-acting toxin craft that a wanderer may gain only after long practice. It takes the place of a slower venom, letting the user strike with rapid effect.

rites.name: Vauranum Tauntium
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a fighter gains an edge through careful positioning. It works alongside two related combat techniques, one favoring heavy force and the other favoring exact precision.

rites.name: Coreonum Serosor
rites.text: A dark inner craft drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-stuff, found in sealed vaults within a cursed spire. It lets a practitioner dissolve into a buzzing host of many small bodies.

rites.name: Serirnaules
rites.text: A devout caster calls upon a restorative chant that replenishes allies' reserves of inner energy at a steady pace. Its strength grows as the caster advances, and it can only be invoked again after a long pause.

rites.name: Ceornor Cosum
rites.text: A ritual inscription that a holy warrior can press onto helmets or greaves to lend them extra power. Wise crafters reserve it for gear of the finest quality.

rites.name: Orinaullum Tarernes
rites.text: A strike-motion that lands when a blade connects with a foe unless they slip aside. Blows held for the next motion wait for the wielder's rhythm, unlike instant jabs, and a successful block shortens the wait before the next motion.

rites.name: Lases Raurnes
rites.text: A mantle-like power that can be borne by those who wield dark summoning arts. It is drawn from the essence of a strange metal and grants a commanding hold over bound servants.

rites.name: Vellus Coriarnus
rites.text: A dulling curse fastens onto a wanderer who fell while carrying a sworn iron blessing. Two keepers in distant halls can lift it, and while it lingers it trims a little from every strength of the bearer.

rites.name: Corasum Seoranum
rites.text: A bonded riding craft taught through a sigil that a mount can carry. It is won from a handful of guardian foes who hold the knowledge within a ruined keep.

rites.name: Tesanum Serintor
rites.text: A spellcaster who specializes in bending space so that people and things can step instantly from one place to another. Their craft is practiced especially by a night-dwelling folk who favor it.

rites.name: Saullium Amiasoria
rites.text: A hunting method kept within a bottled brewing formula. It belongs to a lineage of scaled ambush craft passed down among reclusive keepers.

rites.name: Nerontia Mauntarnum
rites.text: A ward that a spellcaster can wield in struggle against rivals. It holds no blows at first, but after four heartbeats it returns to the caster all the harm taken while it lasted. It ends at the caster's fall and can be unraveled by others.

rites.name: Sauntanum Tintonus
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by sword-bearing guardians of a certain order. Each strike of the blade has a chance to renew their sacred rite of banishing spirits.

rites.name: Vases Launtornor
rites.text: A spell reserved for one faction's spellcasters that instantly carries the caster to a set hall in a fortified stronghold. It bends space along a fixed path.

rites.name: Corasus Serus
rites.text: A proving trait granted to a class of armed combatants. It is bound to their skill in battle and lets them draw on a rite of testing their raw strength.

rites.name: Lilus Seraulium
rites.text: A lingering blessing that quickens learning and standing for scholars who bear a cold dark relic while they dwell upon the shattered islands. Certain elders bestow it upon those who carry it.

rites.name: Rinium Launtum
rites.text: A sealed practice of inscribing radiant markings that a single merchant peddles from a desolate frontier. The wording does not say what the markings achieve.

rites.name: Sisternor
rites.text: A sealing craft taught through a rune pressed into the sea-deep stone of a sunken hall. It is said to be gained from a relic found within a lost undersea court.

rites.name: Oreostales
rites.text: A martial craft taught by a traveling trader in a walled hall of arena champions, granting fighters a quickened rhythm of movement. It is offered for a price to those who seek to sharpen their reflexes.

rites.name: Teloreosor
rites.text: A carved mark that is taken from a fierce shadow beast found in a dim hall of a sunken ruin. Its secret can be learned by those who claim it from the creature's remains.

rites.name: Sereostanum Raullor
rites.text: A trained blow that a fighter gains from a special discipline. Once it has been used, it changes into a follow-up sweeping cut.

rites.name: Larnilus Seollium
rites.text: A bargain-craft sold by a voice-keeper in a sunken city, binding a practitioner to a fixed exchange of service. The price is left unspoken.

rites.name: Meolenor Tisteonum
rites.text: A hidden craft passed among wandering hunters, learned by slaying certain blind cave-dwelling beasts found in the shadowed hill country. It marks the chosen with a sigil of cunning.

rites.name: Reostilum
rites.text: A ranked trick-card sold by a traveling scholar on a far isle. It holds a learned technique that a bearer can call upon.

rites.name: Amauntasor
rites.text: A ritual working that lets a caster step instantly into a sheltered chamber of their order, appearing just within its doorway on the lowest level. It is granted as a reward for completing a dark trial.

rites.name: Oreornus Nastellia
rites.text: A warrior's discipline that swaps a basic sworn blow for two sharper oath-strikes. It can only be chosen in place of another path of the same calling.

rites.name: Oraules Sentes
rites.text: A sealed inscription technique that binds a small beast-shaping ward onto its user. It is sold by a hidden trader in a city's buried underworld, for a steep price in a rare currency.

rites.name: Nausium Tonaulles
rites.text: A ritual wayfaring art reserved for nature-keepers, it carries the caster to a moonlit sanctuary city. Invoking it again inside that city sends the practitioner back to where they last set out from.

rites.name: Amellanum Amiarium
rites.text: A bought craft taught by a trader at a hall of willpower in a walled city. It is a skill that can be purchased from a seller there.

rites.name: Amiallonus
rites.text: A summoned power drawn from sealed reliquaries inside a cursed spire. When invoked, it calls a champion from a chosen roster of fallen commanders to fight alongside the caller for a short while.

rites.name: Nontia Telontauses
rites.text: A ritual drink that binds a follower's spirit to a chosen patron figure, granting a special ability to the order that practices it.

rites.name: Seolia Sauriantum
rites.text: Two hollow-eyed sorcerers and their war-band hold a scarred field against raiders from the sunlit kingdoms. A summoned shade and a storm of frost and cinders break the enemy line, and the victorious caster laughs at his foes' arrogance.

rites.name: Sausaranum Tianestanum
rites.text: A frigid enchantment woven into magical relics by ice-wielding casters. It bonds closely with certain bolt-shattering and chain-reacting relic properties.

rites.name: Corases Teontaures
rites.text: A quiet blessing granted to those who complete a pair of sacred trials. It lingers only for the duration of those trials and strengthens the bearer while they last.

rites.name: Sornausanum
rites.text: A grim relic-trait borne by a cursed warden of the dead. It is bound to a companion charm of endurance and calls forth a plague-spewing creature named by its keeper.

rites.name: Orineornes
rites.text: A dread-laden aura that a void-bound servant projects to unsettle foes. It belongs to the shadowy summoned guardians and their dark-pact masters.

rites.name: Amaullus Valaurnor
rites.text: A battle-hunger that a wielder awakens through a first weapon's power. It links to other martial gifts that strengthen the bearer's strikes against foes.

rites.name: Lentilia
rites.text: A defensive craft that a warrior can draw on through sworn gear. It works in tandem with three related protective disciplines.

rites.name: Torium Monaurium
rites.text: A surge of sorcery that quickens the hands of a caster and their allies in battle. It is a rapid, rushing enchantment that spreads a frenzied drive through those it touches.

rites.name: Amaurnes Niantesor
rites.text: A quiet discipline that a trained fighter gradually gains. When wielding a great blade with both hands, it sometimes wakes unbidden, and it wakes more rarely when two blades are held at once.

rites.name: Tasus Telanires
rites.text: A stillness-craft drawn on by a bronze wyrm in the middle of a contest of beasts. It freezes the flow of moments so that its wielder gains a brief advantage.

rites.name: Amontelum
rites.text: A passive skill that lets a fighter who has reached a certain rank of rage hold a great two-handed weapon with just one hand.

rites.name: Valosium Rarnostia
rites.text: A proving mark earned by a climber who slips past fifty perilous snares while wearing barbed foot-spikes during rope-ascents on journeys across the realm.

rites.name: Cosia Lenteosium
rites.text: A tactic where a caster rapidly alternates two charms from the same school so allies gain both at once. The timing relies on a short recurring buff, and reapplying the first charm just before it lapses keeps the cycle going.

rites.name: Miseollia Corallor
rites.text: A ritual gift of celestial attunement granted to devoted healers of the wild. It lets a practitioner reach toward the heavens for a rare, honored skill.

rites.name: Telaustia Neosanum
rites.text: A dark protective craft once practiced by certain priests of the grave-touched and the sunless. When invoked on the caster, it lashes back at foes who strike and dulls the force of their next blows.

rites.name: Valastia Orianum
rites.text: A cursed binding craft that wraps a spiked cord around a foe and draws its hold tight. It is found sealed within hidden vaults in a dreaded spired prison.

rites.name: Vontium Valeonaules
rites.text: A quiet inner force gathered from hidden reservoirs deep within a dark, ruined tower. It lets its bearer draw strength from those sealed stores.

rites.name: Veres Oriales
rites.text: A ritual gesture that unmakes a caster's standing spirit-markers and returns part of the energy spent raising them. It is taught to practitioners once they reach a certain level of training.

rites.name: Leranum Rinor
rites.text: A mage's relic carries a raging flood of arcane force that pours out in endless bursts. It is bound to several other sorcerous gifts stored within the same vessel.

rites.name: Sarniarus
rites.text: A bound-spirit craft that lets a hunter draw strength from wronged shades seeking retribution. It answers to a dark current of power and works in tandem with related soul-cutting and soul-breaking arts.

rites.name: Tiantonia Raunasia
rites.text: A raw inner force that a wielder draws from hidden reservoirs found in a dreadful tower of trials. It is gathered from deep vaults where such energy pools.

rites.name: Laurnor Orestianum
rites.text: A tracker's craft that sharpens the eye for concealed presences and marks the unseen as faint dots on a hand-held chart of the land.

rites.name: Cirnausia Laria
rites.text: A single-target spell that a shadow summoner's bound minion learns automatically at a set rank. It strikes one foe and draws their attention to the caster's servant.

rites.name: Amesanum Mostor
rites.text: A bound book of spells that lets its reader transform a foe into a small hopping creature. It is sold by merchants during a seasonal festival and counts as one variant of a common transformation craft.

rites.name: Miallanum Amintus
rites.text: A cursed tome hidden among sealed volumes in an old archive. Reading it grants an hour of power, where each blow has a small chance to turn the wielder into a beast that strikes with dark, searing force.

rites.name: Costes Telolium
rites.text: A standing blessing spreads across a whole border region, quickening the gains of a sworn keep's allegiance. It lingers even after the bearer falls, and its rival sibling belongs to a cruel warlord.

rites.name: Orausanum Nernia
rites.text: A refined craft through which a practitioner shapes a metal ingot from raw matter. Unlike most such workings, it can be performed again without any long rest between attempts.

rites.name: Nosanum Orolernanum
rites.text: A refined craft within the art of transformation lets a practitioner convert one luminous metal into a purer, brighter one. Completing it leaves the core stone drained and unable to be used again for a long rest.

rites.name: Nileosium
rites.text: A discipline of the devoted mind that shortens the time a healer's resolve can be dazed, frightened, or hushed. It is a trained faculty once taught to clergy, now no longer practiced.

rites.name: Velium Amorises
rites.text: A ward-craft that hardens a knight's protective gear against harm. It belonged to a discipline of the frozen-dead warriors and was later stripped from their training.

rites.name: Nosestum
rites.text: A bond granted by a commander that makes a bearer's flesh resist harm. It cannot be held alongside the trait that marks a journey's guide.

rites.name: Valaunium Mauneollus
rites.text: A kin-gift that lets a shapeshifting folk slip freely between their man-form and beast-form while at peace. Battle forces the beast-form to return, and the change begins with clawed hands and fur creeping up the arms.

rites.name: Mialles Siaranum
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught to warriors that sharpens the strikes they deliver with weapons gripped in both hands. It makes heavy blades and hammers hit harder than before.

rites.name: Riales Oriranum
rites.text: A binding ritual that fires when a practitioner tries to inscribe a new sigil onto a technique in their tome. It is recorded by a single numeric identifier for that technique.

rites.name: Saulles Siria
rites.text: A sworn guardian's learned discipline that lets a bound ally's footsteps quicken while the protective blessing holds. Only warriors of shield and vengeance may take this path.

rites.name: Nonia Telistia
rites.text: A charm woven into fishing gear that grants its bearer the ability to breathe beneath the waves and swim swiftly. While worn underwater, the wearer can shift into a small clinging fish.

rites.name: Corisium Sornelus
rites.text: A ritual surge that a fire-attuned caster can call upon to empower their next flame working, making it burn far hotter than usual. The technique belongs to elemental adepts who have reached a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Ristor Valeostanum
rites.text: A dead-raising rite that a sworn follower completes after finishing a long pilgrimage of return. Only those who have first walked the road home may undertake it.

rites.name: Lernium Telaularnia
rites.text: A dark rite that drives a chosen companion into a furious, bloodthirsty trance for a short span. The caster can bestow it on an ally, a beast under their command, or themselves.

rites.name: Teloleostia
rites.text: A battle-hardened trait carried by a warrior's relic that grants a sense of invincibility. It is bound to other martial traits that heighten fury, raw might, and a hunger for combat.

rites.name: Tiasum Coreones
rites.text: A dark sacred inscription that a shadow-serving cleric can awaken to loose gloom upon the battlefield. It works in tandem with a draining rite and a trait that feeds on suffering.

rites.name: Tiarnosium
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a war-chanting shaman quicken the strikes of every ally nearby. Allies gain faster blows while the chant is sustained.

rites.name: Vialeostia
rites.text: A standing binding granted to a sworn grave-warrior that lets a fallen champion be restored where they dropped, aided by a winged shieldmaiden. Restoration may only happen once per short span, and repeated falls send the spirit to a nearby resting ground instead.

rites.name: Terniantum
rites.text: A dark trait that lets a cursed warrior of the grave endure punishment and keep going. It is bound together with several related dark traits.

rites.name: Orianium Coriantor
rites.text: A raw, forbidden gift that a hunter of monstrous foes may seize in place of other talents, drawing on shards of chaotic essence.

rites.name: Rantoses
rites.text: A devotional rite in which a cleric draws strength from wounds, binding a dark bloodletting technique into a chosen path of sacred study. It exists only as one option that excludes another teaching of the same order.

rites.name: Nastia Valialastum
rites.text: A craft that teaches how to inscribe a sealed mark of command. The mark is found as a reward from guardians of a fortified hall.

rites.name: Vostauntus
rites.text: A carved sigil technique that is taken from a monstrous entity of the deep. It is found only after the creature falls in a dark sunken realm.

rites.name: Reostor Mausestor
rites.text: A carved sprig-mark that a senior herbal scholar leaves behind after defeat in a sealed citadel. It is said to be a technique for shaping rune-blossoms.

rites.name: Oroneles
rites.text: A ranked skill of rune-craft that a member of a sworn guard may acquire from a merchant of a coastal city after earning standing with that guard. It is sold only to those whose service has been recognized.

rites.name: Miastanor Orinauria
rites.text: A carved rune-craft drawn from a remembered sky-chamber. It lets a practitioner inscribe the stone of distant heavens into ordinary surfaces.

rites.name: Colliastum Riantanor
rites.text: A lasting pact that is earned once a bearer has joined the third binding of their oath-circle. It marks a deepened loyalty shared between the sworn companions.

rites.name: Raunteostor
rites.text: A carved rune-stone technique gained by plundering a sinful hoard and by defeating fallen overlords within a ruined stronghold.

rites.name: Telantia Leonirnium
rites.text: A carved sigil art that a fearsome warlord-guardian yields during a proving ordeal. Those who earn it may hold it as a trophy of their courage.

rites.name: Rosia Valauriases
rites.text: A quiet, always-on gift granted to sworn keepers of the wild once they reach a high rank of mastery. It bolsters the bearer without any need to be invoked.

rites.name: Valestes Sauntor
rites.text: A bound martial art reserved for one sworn branch of holy fighters, it lets a warrior channel righteous anger into focused, punishing strikes. Only the wrathful discipline may learn it.

rites.name: Corastes Caurantor
rites.text: A dread-stirring force that gathers within sealed relic-hoards in a cursed spire. Those who draw it from the hoards feel the ground itself shudder.

rites.name: Calostes
rites.text: A fighter may strike at once and mend a portion of their own vitality, but only in a short window after felling a foe that grants renown or learning.

rites.name: Mistium Sinium
rites.text: A dark practice of a sorcerer's art that is chosen as an exclusive branch alongside another arcane rite. Only one of the two paths may be taken by an adept.

rites.name: Orallia Orallia
rites.text: A battle-craft that a fighter can lay over an ally for a short span of watchful protection. Its ward lingers for a dozen counted breaths before fading.

rites.name: Telenes Teleostum
rites.text: A venomous barb pierces a foe and slowly siphons away their inner reserve of energy over time. Only one such barb from a single caster can linger on any one victim at once.

rites.name: Valaunum Maustia
rites.text: A caller opens rifts into a dark between-realm during a great war over a fallen northern city. The openings are made in a ruined place once taken from the crown.

rites.name: Orenilium
rites.text: A blended craft that fuses flame-work and growing-work into one art. Its spells gain the benefits of either discipline, face only the weakest defenses of the two, and still function when one of the source arts has been silenced.

rites.name: Tiallum Seriantum
rites.text: A hidden spirit-force that can be gathered from sealed reliquaries buried deep within a dreaded tower of punishment. It grants its wielder a sight-enhancing power drawn from the essence of the first beings.

rites.name: Tastilor Cenor
rites.text: A dark craft once devised for summoning restless wraiths into service. It never reached the wider world and its name was later given to a different ritual.

rites.name: Riarnes Lianor
rites.text: A grieving power drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence deep within a cursed spiral tower. Those who gather it channel the lament of the dead.

rites.name: Veornium Tarirnus
rites.text: A set of sworn battle-rites that lets a fighter in the sand-pits bind their honor to the crowd's roar. It is a formal arena discipline passed among champions.

rites.name: Valirnium Veoliares
rites.text: A moon-bound discipline that a practitioner may take in place of a nature-calling rite. It is chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths within a shared lore tree.

rites.name: Conanum Tonauntum
rites.text: A dormant inner flame that a fire-wielding adherent can awaken through a sworn bond. It is joined to two companion talents that share its fiery nature.

rites.name: Telintolium Serentanum
rites.text: A cooking discipline practiced by a master of the hearth, whose meals sharpen the mind. Those who study it gain sharper reasoning and focus for their craft.

rites.name: Oreorillium Meonaurnium
rites.text: A passive oath a defender learns upon reaching a certain rank, which empowers their guarding strike while lowering the plating that shields them.

rites.name: Oreornus Naunirium
rites.text: A bound creature's trained craft slows a foe's stride to half its pace for a short span. Only one tribe of tamed beasts can perform it.

rites.name: Rosiarum Lirausium
rites.text: A sharp cry some tamed beasts loose during contests of their companions. It signals the foes that the next strike is coming.

rites.name: Oriarnus Teleolires
rites.text: A dark murmuring power that a shadow-wielding caster can draw from a sealed relic. It strengthens the caster's grim arts.

rites.name: Verantus
rites.text: A ranged hunting technique that fires a volley of stormy force from a bow. It is taught by an ancient keeper of a noble archer line.

rites.name: Visares Amolenus
rites.text: A savage inner craft that lets wild shapeshifters and their guardian kin tear and rend with heightened ferocity. It is gifted to those who walk the path of the beast.

rites.name: Nelus Corauntus
rites.text: A bound resolve that drives a hunter of vengeful fiends to pursue its prey. It works in tandem with a pair of linked blade and soul-feeding gifts.

rites.name: Corallines Villaurnus
rites.text: A drifting current of stored spirit energy that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs in a cursed, towering prison. Those who gather it gain a sweeping gust-like power.

rites.name: Valeostia Amentum
rites.text: A hidden gift passed down through an ancient bow-lineage, it quickens the wielder's pace when several of its marks gather together.

rites.name: Valirneles Ameolus
rites.text: A binding that is worked permanently into a blade so that, on some strikes made at close quarters, the wielder gains a surge of evasion and a brief burst of quickened movement.

rites.name: Amirontes
rites.text: A dark inner force drawn from hidden reservoirs found deep within a cursed spire. Those who tap it gain a sorcerous strength born of stored essence.

rites.name: Telintolor
rites.text: A bound inner gift handed down by a sky-ruling patron, which cannot coexist with a certain horn-shaped relic. It unlocks a single charging technique for its holder.

rites.name: Teostum Ciantirus
rites.text: A carved-rune craft that draws a renewed fire from molten depths. It is gained through a recovered recollection of this ability.

rites.name: Viarnia Viasium
rites.text: A tiered archer's technique in which the hunter chooses this path instead of its rival, and it works in tandem with a readiness state.

rites.name: Cistaunium Nanum
rites.text: A stolen teaching passed between wardens of a grieving spirit-ruler, shared only with those who first complete a sequence of forging trials. Its wisdom is held as a step toward a greater binding of mournful power.

rites.name: Orillaustia Orauntes
rites.text: A dark craft of the afflicting caster that burns through a sorcerer's cursed relic. It binds closely with two other ruinous arts that corrupt and damn the wielder.

rites.name: Relor Rirnestia
rites.text: A tribal ritual healer who speaks with spirits and forges a pact with a death-god. The pact summons an army of the dead that helps the people reclaim their drowned homeland.

rites.name: Neolloria
rites.text: A quiet inner talent that lets a spellcaster think more sharply, sharpening their reasoning by a small measure. It awakens only once the caster has grown well seasoned in the arcane arts.

rites.name: Virnanum Corollum
rites.text: A vengeful oath-power bound to a holy blade that strengthens a judge of the sworn. It is tied to three other sacred gifts that answer the same blade.

rites.name: Leoles Oreostilium
rites.text: A guardian's discipline that sharpens the strikes of the sworn warrior and deepens the force of the scorched smiting blows. It is kept by protectors who draw their strength from a righteous fury.

rites.name: Meollornium
rites.text: A binding force drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy within a vast, ominous tower. It wraps around foes and tightens with each use.

rites.name: Mineolus
rites.text: A rare inner discipline granted to a wind-trained adept who has reached a high standing. It lets the practitioner gain a sudden calm in the midst of battle.

rites.name: Valausor Coriantus
rites.text: A craft of permanently enchanting handwear so that the artisans working a certain trade can shape their goods more swiftly. Its charm is bound into the gloves themselves.

rites.name: Orestes Telasonanum
rites.text: A devout guardian's trained gift of unyielding resolve, granted only to those who shield others rather than strike. It is taught exclusively to sworn wardens who stand as defenders in the front line.

rites.name: Teonor Sirnia
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught to a hunter of demons, letting them strike with a particular blade style. It belongs to a warrior order sworn to slay the monstrous foes of the realm.

rites.name: Conesus Telenum
rites.text: A stored inner force is drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dreadful ruined spire. Its wielder gains a fortifying surge of will granted by those deep caches.

rites.name: Oranium Oriarnum
rites.text: A discipline of drifting breath that lets an adept move through the air in measured beats. It can only be taken in place of a rival path bound to a storm-shelter.

rites.name: Teosus Corneolles
rites.text: A glimmering craft-talent that a practitioner can take as a single exclusive choice, bound closely to a sight-of-lines discipline. It answers only to one path of study.

rites.name: Lasor Seresium
rites.text: A mage talent that is an exclusive choice, bound to a single arcane echo node. Taking one path closes the other.

rites.name: Rentillor
rites.text: A carving-craft that draws its force from a remembered mark. It is gained by recalling that mark in full.

rites.name: Resum Ciles
rites.text: A crafting mastery is earned by a dedicated brewer who reaches a set level of skill in a nighttime trade. The reward is a hanging sign for a workshop front.

rites.name: Sostia Restus
rites.text: A hunter's technique that deepens the injuries of a foe already marked by the practitioner's claws. It is practiced by those who walk the path of the beast-shaper.

rites.name: Ciarnum Santones
rites.text: A restorative craft recorded on a card from an ancient vault collection. It lets a practitioner close wounds and revive vitality through a channel of gathered light.

rites.name: Tentoranum
rites.text: A craft of ward-stones, sigils, and relics that smother the workings of enchantment. Its practitioners shield themselves or others from sorcery, or stop a caster from weaving their arts at all.

rites.name: Ceristium
rites.text: A silent killing technique drawn from a card of a heavenly relic collection. It lets a hidden fighter strike a foe unseen.

rites.name: Cenantium
rites.text: A bound ritual craft that swells a caster's channeled force, held as a sworn chosen path that cannot be taken alongside its rival discipline.

rites.name: Vialium Nallus
rites.text: A tactical insight that lets its bearer glimpse coming events before they unfold. It is drawn from a tradition of ritual seers who read the currents of coming moments.

rites.name: Oriarnus Seristelor
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught to hunters of the shadowed host, which lets a practitioner call forth a hooked blade-staff whenever the training is active.

rites.name: Melontes
rites.text: A sealed spell-card in an old collection of war-magic, it lets a caster unleash a surge of wild fire drawn from the element-binding deck. Its power is recorded only as part of a larger set of battle arts.

rites.name: Amolia Vostaurnes
rites.text: A fervent radiance that surrounds its bearer and drives them toward aggressive action. The glow persists for a brief span before fading.

rites.name: Riasaunia Oraunes
rites.text: A sorcerer's gift lets a bound practitioner spread a wearying sickness through their enemies. It is passed down through a particular oath of exhaustion.

rites.name: Amanaustum
rites.text: A grim fighting method practiced by sorcerers of the summoner's path. It works as a chosen branch that cannot be taken alongside a rival ritual of fury.

rites.name: Minernia Ciarnia
rites.text: A practiced battle posture in which a caster keeps their guarded face-form while fighting. The face shifts only when the caster draws on a power that demands their true shape.

rites.name: Telauntus Laurnontium
rites.text: A card-borne power that spreads sickness across the land. It belongs to a set of cards drawn from a great contest among the forces of nature.

rites.name: Corastellia Nausteornes
rites.text: A withering curse drawn from a sundered age of dragon lore. It is an ability that saps the strength of anything it touches.

rites.name: Mentium Villaurium
rites.text: A bound sigil that once sold beside a seer's stall in a deep mining town, granting its holder a stacked surge of fury during a great awakening rite.

rites.name: Vaurium Valarnum
rites.text: A sworn guardian's ward-craft that shields the faithful from harm. It is chosen as one path that cannot be taken alongside another rival discipline.

rites.name: Tialeoria
rites.text: A withering craft a caster may learn that saps an enemy's strength. It can be taken only in place of its rival gift, so a practitioner must choose between the two paths.

rites.name: Conausum
rites.text: A piercing mournful cry drawn from a sealed relic that is claimed after a restless spirit is overcome in the underground halls. Those who hold it can unleash the sound to shake their foes.

rites.name: Ciarneostum
rites.text: A stirring presence that bolsters all fighters standing near a commander during a siege. Those who wander too far from the leader lose its strengthening glow.

rites.name: Monus Lalernes
rites.text: A lingering boon that can be found inside a weighty chest after a climber reaches the first tier of a deep trial. It sharpens the bearer's strength until the next descent is finished or a full day passes.

rites.name: Sarnianes
rites.text: A bought-and-sold power-token that a vendor offers beside a speaking elder in a deep mining city. Its holder gains a support-machine ability during a great mechanical rousing.

rites.name: Valorinium
rites.text: A gift of silver night-light that lets a sacred shapeshifter draw strength from the moon. It belongs to a chosen path of abilities granted to moon-keeping wild casters.

rites.name: Taustonanum
rites.text: A ferocious blow channeled from a sacred relic's bearer, drawn from a set of heavenly crowns. It is used as a single decisive stroke in struggles.

rites.name: Valiareonia
rites.text: A tidal craft card that lets its wielder unleash a sweeping wave of untamed power. It belongs to a sacred collection of sea-bound relics.

rites.name: Sirausia
rites.text: A dark talent that a blood-drinking warrior may take, a rare selection that pairs with a shadowy aura of draining life. It can only be chosen in place of its rival option.

rites.name: Nerontes Amollum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that strengthens one's endurance and lasts only while a single expedition into the depths continues. It is earned after advancing through the first tier of a traveler's trial.

rites.name: Castauntor
rites.text: A tide-bound craft that draws on the wind and the sea to empower its practitioner. It is an ability card from a collected deck, mastered through the careful gathering of knowledge.

rites.name: Vilia Cirnes
rites.text: A paired talent for a holy knight in a warrior order, granting a shared oath to a sworn companion. It is chosen instead of another rival path.

rites.name: Ameolles Ceosium
rites.text: A dark art wielded by a summoned overlord who has been fitted with cursed war-gear. It lets the master strike a foe with a searing, fissuring blow.

rites.name: Testor Teliarostes
rites.text: A raw martial technique taught to warriors in the Arms discipline. It is an either-or choice paired with Efficiency, so a fighter must pick one path.

rites.name: Talor Niseonus
rites.text: A blended art practiced by spellcasters who weave several elemental streams into one working. Its workings gain from boosts to any of the streams, face the weakest defense among them, slip past partial wards, and still function when one stream has been silenced.

rites.name: Noniallum
rites.text: A learned gift of reading the earth for hidden gems. It is granted automatically to anyone who masters the art of gem-cutting and setting.

rites.name: Leornes Costor
rites.text: A stealthy craft in which a trained killer chooses a single precise blow that cannot be taken alongside other techniques. Its wounds cause lingering inner bleeding.

rites.name: Orenor Monanum
rites.text: A highest-tier mastery granted to cold-blooded death warriors who wield frost. It marks the pinnacle of their skill along the icy path of the fallen.

rites.name: Soleorium
rites.text: A stored delve power that a wanderer gains by plundering a relic which appears once a cunning reptilian foe is vanquished in the deep caverns.

rites.name: Corarum Toranum
rites.text: A glove-bound sigil of the sly. It is taught by a rune of blades and grants the wearer a thief's favored touch.

rites.name: Vaurneores Valolanum
rites.text: A dark talent of the warlock's craft that is chosen alongside the Ember Engine, with the two options excluding one another. It is a specialized path open only to those who follow the infernal arts.

rites.name: Seoliastum Coreoserus
rites.text: A dark enchantment that can be placed upon a foe. It belongs to a collection of ability cards tied to a sworn betrayal of a protector.

rites.name: Amialum Serintium
rites.text: A hunter's skill within the wild pack tradition, chosen as an exclusive option that cannot be taken alongside a companion technique for scattering prey.

rites.name: Valaustus Resiania
rites.text: A dreadful craft that saps the will of the hollowed dead, leaving them weighed down by hopelessness. It is bound into a sealed scroll drawn from an old grand collection of rites.

rites.name: Maulenum
rites.text: A dream-born craft that a caretaker invokes during a contest between tamed creatures. It lets the summoner's beast slip into an opponent's rest and weaken it from within.

rites.name: Valeonum Causes
rites.text: A ritual blessing bestowed by a shadowed sovereign upon standing followers during a harvest rite. It sharpens fighting strength for a short span, and anything kneeling before the ruler receives nothing.

rites.name: Coraullanor
rites.text: A dreadful cry that a shapeshifting sorcerer can unleash, granted by a sigil of transformation. It can only be called upon while the caster wears their monstrous, horned shape.

rites.name: Meostelum
rites.text: A grim calling the bearers of death can take up, which pairs a chosen path of power with a shield that drives foes away.

rites.name: Serallirum
rites.text: A dark practitioner's craft lets the caster surge forward in a sudden bound while in a transformed state. It is one of the techniques bound to that changed form.

rites.name: Serenaulum
rites.text: A shadowy binding craft taught to hunters of the night, where a chosen path forbids its rival technique. It pairs with a companion blade of the same dim lineage.

rites.name: Seraulium Corilaurium
rites.text: A focused mental art that a band of riddle-hunters uses to strip away a hidden snare from their quarry. Once cast, it leaves the concealed ones exposed and easy to locate.

rites.name: Rastus Seollium
rites.text: A wasting sickness spreads through the land, brought on by a grim, death-touched power that a cursed warrior unleashes upon the living.

rites.name: Neostia Lonteonum
rites.text: A warrior's talent that lets a towering hero assert control over those around them. It belongs to the class of heroic gifts shared by colossal fighters.

rites.name: Virum Lesanum
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a binder's servant hurls a volley of dark bolts. The servant is one of the bound creatures that serves a summoner of hellish arts.

rites.name: Venus Tialles
rites.text: A tide-bound art of diverting an opponent's attention with a sudden feint. It is recorded as a single ability card from a collected sea-throne set.

rites.name: Laurnum Lasolor
rites.text: A cunning rogue's art of appearing so harmless that no one looks twice. It pairs exclusively with a related cunning gift.

rites.name: Sesinor Reonus
rites.text: A fiery power bound to a single ability card from a set of elemental war cards. It lets its bearer call forth searing, dragon-like flames during a clash.

rites.name: Corarium Amallanum
rites.text: A craft of binding lasting power into a blade through stone-sealed rites. Its mastery grows with the strength of the binding made.

rites.name: Teseollia
rites.text: A craft of binding wind-spirits into a blade's edge, letting the weapon turn incoming blows aside. The strength of the ward depends on how skillfully it was bound.

rites.name: Orestia Mintaullia
rites.text: A permanent binding that infuses a hand-held blade with arcane energy. When a charged strike lands, it returns a surge of magical reserve and briefly sharpens the wielder's spellcraft.

rites.name: Casirium
rites.text: Callers gather in a great archive hall in a silver city and draw forth spirit-beasts of the elements. Their summonings are called upon during a time of destiny and fate.

rites.name: Telaustes Marnor
rites.text: A ritual binding that imbues a blade or shield with a lasting spirit of the world's soul. Trained artisans learn it through patient study at mountain and forest schools.

rites.name: Tausanum Tirnia
rites.text: A faint ghostly remnant is captured inside a dim jar and poured over a fallen body. Its essence is then drawn out to awaken a dreamlike revelation.

rites.name: Nauseontor
rites.text: A practiced talent of the sky-and-earth caller, an exclusive choice that is set against a warding strike of lightning. Adepts pick it at one branch of their path, closing other branches.

rites.name: Venasanum
rites.text: A craft that binds a chill into a blade's edge so that each strike deals cold harm. The strength of the binding decides how much harm the blow carries.

rites.name: Valeostum Tisteornus
rites.text: A craft of binding protective charms to the upper arm-plates of armor, using a dim arcane art. Learned from masters in fortified cities and quiet wild groves.

rites.name: Teleosum Valanilus
rites.text: A card-bound craft that channels fire-aspected power into a single sudden burst. It belongs to a sealed collection of conflict-themed artifacts.

rites.name: Valiasanum Tausor
rites.text: A ward-craft worked into a chest, made through a deep arcane discipline and learned from a written formula. It binds a sealed magical imprint upon the armor it is applied to.

rites.name: Amornes Oreornum
rites.text: A tide of gloom is taken into the self by a chosen path of the dark-touched caster. It sits among a set of mutually exclusive gifts and pairs with a draining effect.

rites.name: Ameolus Leornania
rites.text: A sealed incantation that a skilled crafter inscribes onto a blade so that its strikes land more often with greater force. The potency of the inscription determines how much this bonus grows.

rites.name: Valosium Telosantes
rites.text: A ritual inscription is set upon a sheet of prepared hide, producing a formula that empowers a great two-handed blade. The charm's making requires a vellum and a single binding act.

rites.name: Telintum Telistia
rites.text: A sealed decree that grants a bearer a surge of endurance. It is said to be recovered from an old engineer's cache during a time when a great engine was stirred back to life.

rites.name: Seriaronia
rites.text: A ritual inscription that is made by writing a strengthening charm upon a sheet of prepared parchment. The finished sheet can then be applied to a wrist guard to grant it greater magical potency.

rites.name: Valialeosia Tostiles
rites.text: A ritual invocation that a sworn order's relic awakens when a judgment rite is spoken. It then shifts into a radiant path for the bearer to walk.

rites.name: Sereonastum
rites.text: A holy blessing channeled by a sworn champion of radiance, granted through a card-like rite. It belongs to a set of mystic rites tied to the fading age of great winged beasts.

rites.name: Tistiasia
rites.text: A dark ember-craft in which a caster kindles a corrupted fire-binding. It is one of the forbidden rites recorded in the late sealed codices.

rites.name: Sereosum Caunteoses
rites.text: A grim discipline of the undead warrior-priests that lets a wielder of dark arts sweep foes from the field in a single merciless motion.

rites.name: Moneolium
rites.text: A bargained grace drawn from a dark underworld realm, granted to a spellcaster who calls on it. It is a power wielded by sorcerers of a shadowed, hidden craft.

rites.name: Telasanum Neoraunus
rites.text: A warrior's talent that pairs with another exclusive choice, each option pushing the other aside. It is drawn from the path of the relentless blade.

rites.name: Leontistia
rites.text: A chosen gift of endless brightness that a sun-bearing champion may take, offered as one of two exclusive paths alongside a lingering glow of light.

rites.name: Siallestor Amiastia
rites.text: A card-bound power that channels the fighting spirit of a warrior. It belongs to a sealed collection of celestial relics.

rites.name: Vellanum Oreornolium
rites.text: A combat craft in which a warrior's hardened weapon bears a blessing of endurance. It is drawn from the warrior class and belongs to a sundered age of dragon lore.

rites.name: Orases Ciastus
rites.text: A bound incantation that draws a creature from another realm into service for a single battle. The caster spends a card's worth of effort to call the summoned ally forth.

rites.name: Orareontium
rites.text: A coercive craft in which a wielder forces a rival to surrender a valued possession through threat. It is drawn from a set of ancient sealed relics.

rites.name: Oraunus Mollor
rites.text: A bound technique card from a sealed deck of battle arts. It lets its wielder unleash a blow far stronger than normal, drawn from the same reserve as the rest of its set.

rites.name: Cianaules Amauntosia
rites.text: A hunter's choice of gift that is taken alongside a watchful guardian's vigil, excluding other paths. It is a talent for those who keep their own eyes shut to guard others.

rites.name: Ameontilus
rites.text: A dark tactic belonging to fighting-folk, it allows a combatant to brand a foe for finishing. The mark is drawn from the old craft of combat.

rites.name: Taulium Valolintum
rites.text: A vital force drawn from a pulsing heartstone that a spectral guardian leaves behind after descending into hidden depths. Touching the stone lets a person gather this life energy for their own use.

rites.name: Miseria
rites.text: A bound surge of hostile force that a wielder can draw upon from a sealed reservoir. It belongs to a sacred gathering of celestial craft.

rites.name: Nauntarum
rites.text: A bound ward-craft that a bearer calls upon to shield themselves from harm. It is drawn from a sealed set of heavenly charms.

rites.name: Serelium Nolus
rites.text: A stalker's craft in which a hunter gains a special choice that works alongside a particular surge of dread. It marks the path of the wounded for a trained killer.

rites.name: Seranum Vallor
rites.text: A single targeted incantation that unravels one enchantment at a time. It is cast from a card of the ritual deck and works only on the chosen object.

rites.name: Seristor Serellor
rites.text: A chosen trait of a hunter who bears old scars, binding them to a rival path. It cannot be taken alongside a particular mentor's lesson of endurance.

rites.name: Mosianum Coreosanum
rites.text: A nimble trickster's craft in which a blade seems to shimmer and vanish between strikes. It can only be learned alongside a particular sleight-of-hand discipline, closing off other paths.

rites.name: Sonum Aminum
rites.text: A practice granted to those who wear a borrowed spirit-form, letting them slip forward a short span in a sudden leap. It resembles a quick sideways slip used by others.

rites.name: Valaunus Ameorelium
rites.text: A chilling craft that drains warmth from a chosen target and leaves it locked in a withering frost. It is recorded as a card of an ancient elemental contest.

rites.name: Vellus Montia
rites.text: A chilling stored craft that a practitioner draws from a sealed charm card to bind the air into a glittering, frozen arc. It belongs to a sacred deck of heavenly powers.

rites.name: Tillum Oraunium
rites.text: A chill-bound sigil that strengthens every foe within a sealed stronghold during a guarded trial. It is awakened only when a particular ward is active.

rites.name: Masanum Serestum
rites.text: A ward-mark that strengthens every foe within two sunken halls while a particular guardian sigil is awake. It is laid across the chambers whenever the deep vault's secondary defense is raised.

rites.name: Sirnus Ciarnistes
rites.text: A chilling discipline of unyielding force that a bearer draws from the stillness of ancient ice. It belongs to a sealed crypt of lost relics.

rites.name: Telonus Ceornes
rites.text: A chilling craft that lets a warrior of the dead draw sustenance from the cold, feeding a hunger that frost itself can answer.

rites.name: Leosilus
rites.text: A savage hunger that seizes a blood-drinking warrior in combat, granting a disciplined class of undead knights a rabid edge tied to their chosen path.

rites.name: Cises Serausor
rites.text: A battle discipline taught to hunters of fiends, letting a warrior channel a surge of ferocity drawn from the blade-scarred lineage of old fighters.

rites.name: Amiares Vasiarnus
rites.text: A wild, untamed craft practiced by nature-bound casters. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival discipline of focused rage.

rites.name: Vinorium
rites.text: A craft-linked appearance that becomes available once a practitioner gains a particular talent. It is granted through the unlocking of that talent.

rites.name: Maunellia
rites.text: A written method for imbuing a ring with a dark strike that lands with greater force. It is taught in lore fragments dropped by two rival craftsmen found in distant city halls.

rites.name: Liarones
rites.text: A ward-mark that strengthens every foe within a sealed proving ground while a guardian's warding rite is active. It is bestowed on opponents facing a champion's trial.

rites.name: Mallines Mentillum
rites.text: A frozen-blade technique practiced by cold-hearted war-knights. When invoked, it swaps a basic icy strike for a stronger version of the same blow.

rites.name: Marniantus
rites.text: A dark ward-craft practiced by sorcerers. It takes the place of a lesser shielding rite whenever the caster enters a state of dread transcendence.

rites.name: Mostelium
rites.text: A sickening sigil that empowers every foe within a sealed underground trial when a particular warding protocol is active. It hardens the enemies gathered there.

rites.name: Nianes Losaunanum
rites.text: A carved ward that lets a caretaker take on the shape of a winged night bird for swift travel. It can only be inscribed once the bearer has mastered an advanced skill of riding.

rites.name: Nistium Loles
rites.text: A blessing that a guardian receives during a long trial of endurance, strengthening those who hold the front line. It is granted only for a limited time within that trial.

rites.name: Telus Seriarollum
rites.text: A dark discipline of the dead that a practitioner learns along one of two mutually exclusive branches. Choosing it forecloses the other branch, binding the practitioner to a single path of undeath.

rites.name: Neollostium Lasteornes
rites.text: A blessing that a guardian of a sunken rune-chamber can bestow on those who brave its trials. It empowers the bearer for a time when the chamber's twilight rite is active.

rites.name: Mianus Viarneria
rites.text: A dark inherited talent that lets a fallen knight draw upon the blood-bound power of a sworn undead lineage. It is a skill gifted to those who walk the path of the deathbound warriors.

rites.name: Corillum Losanum
rites.text: A carved mark that reshapes how a traveling spirit-form appears, turning its shape into a pale, ghostly wolf. It is learned through a scribe's teaching.

rites.name: Amilasum
rites.text: A bound tome of dark instruction that teaches its reader a protective sheath of corrupted power. It is meant for practitioners of forbidden binding craft.

rites.name: Orostor Amiarestus
rites.text: A blessing that can be drawn from a sentinel guarding a rune-lit underground vault when a certain hidden ritual is active. It grants a temporary surge of fire-bred power to whoever receives it.

rites.name: Laurnum Tellia
rites.text: A mage's learned skill that weakens the pull holding enemies to the ground. It is one exclusive option chosen among the arts of hindrance.

rites.name: Maustentium
rites.text: A carved mark that a practitioner inscribes to channel a dusk-tinted gunshot. It is learned through a specific sequence of instruction and requires a fair degree of skill in etched lettering.

rites.name: Teleoria Viarillor
rites.text: A carved mark that a scribe can etch to make a bearer blend with surrounding light and shadow. It is learned through a set method of study and inscribed using a particular craft of writing.

rites.name: Vornor Amianerium
