rites.text: A discipline of striking hard that a fighter may learn from a sect of hidden warriors. It is chosen as an exclusive branch against a rival path of the same tradition.

rites.name: Telastes Nires
rites.text: A deadly aiming craft practiced by hunters, where a single exact strike to the skull is chosen above all others. It cannot be learned alongside a rival keen-eye art.

rites.name: Vaustanum Nirniallium
rites.text: A defensive talent that a hunter can select as an exclusive option alongside a rival sacrificial roar. Choosing one closes off the other.

rites.name: Amaseollia Oreoriania
rites.text: A bestowed vision lets a traveler float lightly above the ground for an hour, though it fades the moment battle begins.

rites.name: Telistum Liantarnes
rites.text: A rune etched into rings that lets wielders of several sacred crafts channel their gift toward mending wounds. It is learned by studying a specific inscribed rune of healing.

rites.name: Senium Tesallus
rites.text: A sealed glyph of six shifting faces that a practitioner can call upon to reshape their own form. It is drawn from the heavenly crown's old lore.

rites.name: Serasanum Siantor
rites.text: A dormant mark that a spellcaster can awaken by finding a concealed form of their focus item. Uncovering it grants a lasting honor that shows the caster's arcane mastery.

rites.name: Taurantum
rites.text: A quiet inborn grace that every member of one radiant people carries, mending wounds more readily and softening the blows they take.

rites.name: Leoranum Valantum
rites.text: A sacred power taught through a written testament, granted to a holy warrior who learns to call upon its blessing in battle.

rites.name: Siresum Calostum
rites.text: A learned craft of the hunter-orders that lets a practitioner call up a ravenous cutting strike. Once awakened, it lets the wielder unleash that hunger in a single blow.

rites.name: Amaustontes
rites.text: A proud, overreaching power that a tamed companion can call upon during a contest of beasts. It lets the creature push past its limits in the middle of a match.

rites.name: Teolus Rerum
rites.text: A rogue's exclusive talent that binds a wielder to a fixed fate. It can only be chosen in place of a rival branch of destiny.

rites.name: Cileontia
rites.text: A dark ward-craft learned by sorcerer-initiates who bind a fiery pact into their own flesh. It is taken as a mutually exclusive choice alongside a vitality-restoring rite.

rites.name: Meostes Toraulanum
rites.text: A radiant talent that a sun-bearing champion can select as an exclusive path, chosen in place of another gift of dawn.

rites.name: Telauranum Tianillia
rites.text: A stubborn inner resolve that lets a bearer answer harm with a delayed reprisal. Its strength grows in two steps, letting the wronged strike back across moments.

rites.name: Amentium Viasaunum
rites.text: A craft of weaving false shadows around an object so it appears adorned with dark ornament. The illusion fades over time, and its endurance depends on how skillfully it was woven.

rites.name: Mintialanum Tiastanum
rites.text: A sworn warrior's practiced discipline that sharpens the way they weigh and deliver their final verdicts against foes. It is a learned talent drawn from the path of wrathful justice.

rites.name: Mosum Telontus
rites.text: A refined skill of the wild-touched practitioners that lets them leap upon foes with greater ferocity. It is taught within the close-combat disciplines of the beast-kin.

rites.name: Teloses Raulus
rites.text: A bound craft that a hunter receives from a wasteland overseer, granting strikes that spread harm across nearby foes and daze them. It persists while the wanderer stays within the barren zone and is replaced whenever another craft is chosen.

rites.name: Seorus Siastium
rites.text: A glamour craft that weaves false finery over a wearer's garments, its lasting power set by how skillfully the enchantment was made.

rites.name: Liarontanum Cauntor
rites.text: A mage's craft that calls a flame-born bird of arcane fire. It is a talent taken by spellcasters who wield heat and light.

rites.name: Ceornianor Neontisium
rites.text: A tidal surge of spite that bestows two levels of a hidden, hostile touch upon whoever channels it. The gift deepens with each rank granted.

rites.name: Siarasanum
rites.text: A refined art of enchanting a blade with a chilling force, practiced by shamans who channel frost through their weapons. It is a talent of the Enhancement path.

rites.name: Ciastium Amollum
rites.text: A discipline of striking through the body's flows that stands as a choice set against a rival stomping technique. The two cannot both be taken by one practitioner.

rites.name: Tauntiarnum
rites.text: A glowing phantasm that a seeker earns after completing an early trial of rivalry and inner conflict. It is a shimmering trick of light that appears to burn without harming anything.

rites.name: Seroriallum Ceosia
rites.text: A glamour-craft that cloaks an object in a false appearance. How long the disguise holds depends on how finely the enchantment was worked.

rites.name: Viarnus Velleosia
rites.text: A refined rite of tearing essence from a foe's spirit, taken as an alternate path that cannot be combined with a rival ember-binding technique. Those who follow the scarred wardens of the shadow-hunters can learn it.

rites.name: Seraurum Amallauses
rites.text: A combat discipline taught to hardened warriors of the high-fell orders, where a fighter chooses this path instead of others to remain firmly planted. It works in tandem with a steadfast stance once the practitioner reaches the highest rank.

rites.name: Amisum Ronanum
rites.text: A vital draining craft wielded by one warrior during a contest between tamed companions. It siphons strength from a rival creature to restore the user's own.

rites.name: Vanialus
rites.text: A dread-bearing gift of the grave-warrior order that lets a dark champion unleash fear across the battlefield. It belongs to the riders who ride with ruin.

rites.name: Maurnum Mernia
rites.text: A scribal technique that lets a copyist grind raw leaves into fine pigment. It is gained automatically once a copyist learns one of two regional lettering arts.

rites.name: Lonasum Rolastes
rites.text: A innate gift shared by an entire people that sharpens the force of their decisive blows while quickening the mending of their wounds.

rites.name: Oralium Valaror
rites.text: A hunter's craft of focused ranged skill that stands as an exclusive choice alongside a rival volley technique. Practitioners must pick one or the other.

rites.name: Merianum
rites.text: A craft of carving lasting marks into surfaces, taught only to those who have reached a certain standing in their training. Practitioners may advance step by step toward complete mastery.

rites.name: Raulor Orastus
rites.text: A withering discipline taught to sun-bound spellcasters, offered as a singular choice that pairs with a volatile, bursting power.

rites.name: Collia Lestiasanum
rites.text: A proven trial of might that a champion earns by surviving a sealed chamber at a high tier before the sands run out. It grants the holder a swift passage spell along a hidden road.

rites.name: Castium Amosia
rites.text: A bound sigil that a wielder can inscribe to draw on the power of a particular wild force. It is one of the abilities gathered within a shared collection of such marks.

rites.name: Telernes Tontum
rites.text: A innate gift of spellcasting that a practitioner may choose in place of another, and which sits in mutual exclusion with a rival discipline of shadowy ordnance.

rites.name: Ralium Telarnanum
rites.text: A stored crackle of sky-fire drawn from hidden hoards found while exploring deep ruins. Seekers gain this charged force by claiming the treasures they uncover below.

rites.name: Casus Tanauntor
rites.text: A sacred discipline practiced by sword-bearing warriors of the oath, whose strength grows with their inner devotion. It sharpens the radiant force of their strikes against the wicked.

rites.name: Lonastes
rites.text: A dread-bearing talent that evokers can learn, a branching choice that pairs exclusively with a hardening scale-skin.

rites.name: Amirnus Ceornentes
rites.text: A passive inner art practiced by shadow-wielding adepts, where certain draining spells sometimes strike a second time with each blow they land.

rites.name: Saunus Tiraunus
rites.text: A dark inner power that a hunter of ravening spirits can awaken within themselves. It lets the wielder draw on the appetite of the beast they fight.

rites.name: Veontia Cintes
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a traveler bypass the sealed mechanisms guarding certain treasure containers hidden within the cave systems of the island realm. It can be acquired through a supply cache at a considerable cost.

rites.name: Nestausium
rites.text: A dark art drawn from the force that ends all life, letting its users stir the dead, spread sickness, hurl burning shadows, and freeze the living with a cold touch.

rites.name: Vilum Oroles
rites.text: A quiet inner craft of the dark-tongued caster that lets a shifting form carry a fraying, unruly touch. It answers only while the caster stands in its changed shape.

rites.name: Serenia Oraurnia
rites.text: A dark-hearted sorcerer's gift that lets a transformed caster unleash an abyssal beam while in their changed form. It is always active and needs no command to take hold.

rites.name: Lontes Siaria
rites.text: A branching gift of pale lunar powder that a wanderer may take instead of a rival blessing. It is bound to a sacred grace and cannot be held alongside it.

rites.name: Lilentanum
rites.text: A sudden, brutal blow delivered with the force of a huge sea beast, sometimes drawn from a deck of ability cards. It belongs to a sealed collection of tidal lore.

rites.name: Vistium Lialanum
rites.text: A sudden burst of savage momentum that lets a fighter charge forward with terrifying force. It is drawn from the tomb-lore of an ancient sealed order.

rites.name: Ciarnania
rites.text: A practiced skill of the bow that lets a hunter choose a single steady path of aim. It works in tandem with a sharpened stone point, and a hunter may hold only this path among their training.

rites.name: Veolor Oristaures
rites.text: A warrior's gift that lets a fighter grow hardier after suffering wounds. It is chosen alongside a battle-forged vitality, marking a seasoned veteran's path.

rites.name: Sones Caria
rites.text: Casters who draw power from one object and pour it into another. They are found among certain fair-blooded folk and drifting spirits, and wizards and oath-bound sorcerers are often portrayed as them.

rites.name: Nistus Serarnanum
rites.text: A sustained resolve that lets its bearer answer harm with deferred payback, spreading the reckoning across four escalating tiers of returned force.

rites.name: Ronor Oreostialus
rites.text: A glyph of heat inscribed on a cloak. It is taught through written spell notes for the robes of wandering casters.

rites.name: Cilauntus
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a caster channels excess power through a chosen focus. It is tied to a core of amplifying energy and is taken as a single exclusive path.

rites.name: Maurnium Orasteles
rites.text: A grim, sorrowful craft that death-warriors may choose as one of their paths of mastery. It is set against a swift ending, so a practitioner must decide between the two.

rites.name: Neontilia
rites.text: A craft skill for searching raw ground for precious stones. Learning the trade of cutting gems grants this sifting knack automatically.

rites.name: Mesum Oranium
rites.text: A protective enchantment that practitioners of the arcane craft can gain once they reach a certain standing in combat training. It is used when fighting other casters.

rites.name: Coreontus Mianiles
rites.text: A dwelling power of the underground trials, drawn from a relic that appears once a burrowing armored beast is slain in the deep caverns. It grants its bearer a measure of the creature's rolling might.

rites.name: Telaustum Corerus
rites.text: A breath-borne technique that allied creatures draw upon during contests of tamed beasts. It lets companions strike their rivals in a sudden rush.

rites.name: Tolleonum
rites.text: A grim binding a death-warrior may take within a chosen calling of ruin. It is an exclusive option that cannot be taken alongside a companion aid.

rites.name: Amarneolum
rites.text: A dark mastery of withering sickness that a grave-bound warrior may choose. It cannot be taken alongside the rival art of tomb-keeping.

rites.name: Nintaulor
rites.text: A creature companion's trained maneuver, passed on by beast handlers during an early trial period. It lets a tamed beast strike low and cripple its target's footing.

rites.name: Viantaunium Tilia
rites.text: A chosen mark that lets a hunter of the shadowed bow carry a lingering sting from unseen wounds. It is a path reserved for those who bind themselves to the dark string.

rites.name: Viallintes
rites.text: A branching choice of arcane talent that a grove keeper may take alongside a stirring rite. Taking it closes off the other paths.

rites.name: Nollanum Valauntes
rites.text: A sealed utterance of binding force, drawn from the old speech of the realm and carried as a ready charm. It is inscribed on a card of the elemental wars and stands as a word of power.

rites.name: Nisium Morneontium
rites.text: A sealed utterance of binding force that a practitioner holds ready to be spoken. Scholars of the old orders recorded it as a tool of protection drawn from the bearer's own will.

rites.name: Nantiarus
rites.text: A seer's gift that unlocks after a lesser foresight is invoked, and transforms into a deeper vision once it has been used.

rites.name: Rerium Noleontia
rites.text: A ritual craft that a caster learns from a sealed tome, letting them open a passage to call beings from elsewhere. It belongs to the arts of those who bargain with unseen powers.

rites.name: Vantium Riallaunus
rites.text: A seer's gift that becomes available once a prior foresight is cast. After use it transforms into a sharper vision, or into a far-seeing form for those who learned a particular discipline.

rites.name: Amistes Ralus
rites.text: A seer's gift lets a chosen mind glimpse a coming moment of devotion. Once that glimpse is spent, it transforms into a gentler vision of comfort.

rites.name: Maniantus
rites.text: A sealed utterance that drains the breath of a chosen soul. It is recorded among the cards of the Betrayal of the Guardian set.

rites.name: Riallanum Saules
rites.text: A spell that tears open a gateway, letting a caster and their companions step through to a distant marketplace in a shining city.

rites.name: Vornanum Ciasus
rites.text: A battle-rage talent for fighters that swells their fury. It stands as an alternative to another rage choice, so only one may be taken.

rites.name: Oraustollor
rites.text: A sealed incantation of unbreakable resolve, bound onto a card of the ancient war-codex. It lets a bearer refuse defeat and hold their ground when all else fails.

rites.name: Miantia Miallus
rites.text: A hasty ensnaring craft that a practitioner can spring at a moment's notice. It is drawn from a set of heavenly crown lore.

rites.name: Amintia Corintus
rites.text: A craft of the mind that lets practitioners shape thoughts, sow dread, and speak without voices. Its wielders can also move objects and bend lesser minds to their will.

rites.name: Meolor Orarnus
rites.text: A top-tier gift for arcane casters that unlocks a special ability when called upon. It lets the user loose a spectrum-splitting spell.

rites.name: Seristalor
rites.text: A chosen discipline of fury practiced by wounded hunters of monstrous foes. It is a branch of training that can be taken alongside a sweeping wave of weakening.

rites.name: Cisteosor
rites.text: A discipline taught to guardian monks, chosen as an exclusive path alongside a rival doctrine of leading from the front. Those who take it dedicate their training to shielding others.

rites.name: Riniaria
rites.text: A minor enchantment that a sorcerer can bind to a chest garment, sometimes sold in a passing trial period by traders in bone-carved goods.

rites.name: Cesia Mistium
rites.text: A coiled skill that gathers scattered followers into one restless crowd. It is held in a bound set of drawn tokens and called upon in times of need.

rites.name: Renia Lantolia
rites.text: A stored-energy craft that a healer may take as a chosen gift, and it is set against the lesser imbuing arts. Once picked, it bars the other option of its branch.

rites.name: Tauntia Tesiallor
rites.text: A borrowed knack that lets a fighter move with uncanny nimbleness, drawn from the old instinct of the wild. It is recorded as a card of conflict.

rites.name: Maulanum Varnaullium
rites.text: A combat discipline that lets a hunter of monstrous foes call upon a sweeping strike. It is taught as a gift to those who master a particular fighting art.

rites.name: Leorium Ventus
rites.text: A grim mark of the dead that a chosen warrior of the death-bound order can call upon. It ties the bearer to the harvest of fallen souls.

rites.name: Tentolia Reria
rites.text: A card-borne technique that lets a combatant hurl a burst of flame with little care for consequences. It is drawn from a battle-era collection of tactics.

rites.name: Rentasia
rites.text: A stirring of inner vigor that a wanderer can call upon for a short span, restoring strength and spirit faster. The stream's pull deepens the calling when it is drawn near a flowing veil of hidden current.

rites.name: Lolanum Restollus
rites.text: A tactic of undoing a lasting binding by reversing its hold. The practice is drawn from the ancient war campaigns and is carried out by skilled bearers.

rites.name: Reosanum Ameollaurum
rites.text: A battle-art gift that lets a warrior gather a tempest's fury into their strikes. It spreads a lingering wound-curse that follows the blades of a particular fighting style.

rites.name: Telestum Valaustes
rites.text: A bond of unwavering loyalty that lets a death knight's chosen rider stand beside them in the grim hour. It belongs to the dark order of mounted doom-bearers.

rites.name: Valesum Valausernum
rites.text: A dark art where a hunter who has taken a devouring shape turns a hungry strike into a harvest. It is the strengthened form of an older cutting technique, awakened when the shape grows fiercer.

rites.name: Visum Meniales
rites.text: A carved sigil that trains the wearer's belt-bound hand-to-hand fighters in the discipline of the nearby fist. It grants mastery over close quarters.

rites.name: Coroles Sirnosia
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches its bearer how to inscribe a cloak with a fiery protective ward. It is used to empower garments worn by dark-arts practitioners.

rites.name: Varolia
rites.text: A dark gift of perception that lets a chosen blood-drinking warrior sense hidden lifeblood. It is an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside a rival covenant of bound fangs.

rites.name: Tintium Coriarnus
rites.text: A devotional gift that lets a holy champion draw on a sworn oath for greater might. It is chosen as one path among several, and it cannot be taken alongside a rival vow of purpose.

rites.name: Serolium Sorum
rites.text: A craft that teaches a flame-bearing inscription to be carved into rings. It lets the bearer pursue a fiery discipline, passed from teacher to student.

rites.name: Vontiastor
rites.text: A carved sigil that grants its bearer the knowledge to inscribe a particular protective mark onto leg armor. It is taught to warriors who serve as holy defenders.

rites.name: Renanum Amollus
rites.text: A carved sigil that teaches a warrior to reveal an enemy's flaw, and it is set into belts.

rites.name: Neontelles Neleornia
rites.text: A glyph carved onto gloves that teaches the wearer a sneaky, ambush-style strike. It is used by rogues who favor stealth.

rites.name: Neostum Telostus
rites.text: A frost-binding craft drawn from the Crown of the Heavens tradition, invoked by practitioners to chill and encase their foes in a thin glassy coating of cold.

rites.name: Telintum Amiseornus
rites.text: A mastery earned by disrupting a sacred gathering place at its highest level, where a fallen seat of authority once stood. It is recognized as an expanded skill of the craft.

rites.name: Veosornor
rites.text: A carved mark that teaches the user how to bind a poison-coated cutting edge. It is set into a belt and grants the knowledge of a sneaking blade-craft.

rites.name: Castia Miarnisum
rites.text: A carved glyph that is inscribed on a pair of gloves, teaching the wearer a hunter's ability to launch a blasting volley. It is a mark of the trade.

rites.name: Telastes Meosanium
rites.text: A carved sigil set into a band of metal that teaches its bearer the craft of blades. It is used by those who wish to master a single kind of edged weapon.

rites.name: Risium Laurnases
rites.text: A lingering rite that a fire-wielding caster may pick among rival gifts, binding it to a single chosen strike of blazing judgment. Choosing it closes off the other path.

rites.name: Reonostus
rites.text: A fearsome bestial transformation a warrior may assume, drawing on the strength of a great wild beast to fight with raw savagery.

rites.name: Meneornia
rites.text: A stealth technique in which a practitioner drapes themselves in a dark cloak of shadow. It is an exclusive path that can only be taken alongside a shadow-walking discipline.

rites.name: Cellia Amintium
rites.text: A bonding craft through which a gifted caster lends heightened perception to companions. When an ally unleashes a grand, long-recharging technique, that ally is strengthened in turn.

rites.name: Orentia Lorniria
rites.text: A cloaked enchantment that a battle-mage can call upon to conceal their presence and blunt incoming harm. It is drawn from a far-off collection of sacred charms.

rites.name: Sialausor
rites.text: A dark incantation card from a collectible set of heavenly crowns, bearing a sinister word of shadow. It grants its wielder a ability tied to the power of hopelessness.

rites.name: Rornus Naurus
rites.text: A grand blessing bestowed by a mind-seer in a hidden sanctum, letting a wanderer call upon certain recovering powers far more often. It lingers while the wanderer stays in the wastes, returns on reentry, and yields to any other blessing chosen.

rites.name: Tolanum Lelus
rites.text: A dark incantation that lets a caster consume an opponent's life force from a distance. It is drawn from a shared deck of battle spells cast during an ancient war.

rites.name: Amiranum Mialleoses
rites.text: A bound skill of the reaper-hunters, chosen exclusively alongside a vow of endless service. It grants a sworn fighter a distinctive talent that cannot be taken alongside other oaths.

rites.name: Orenanum Valeornanum
rites.text: A dark art that lets a user spread hidden gloom through a foe's defenses. It is held as a card-bound craft passed among those who study the set's strange lore.

rites.name: Vintium Vornus
rites.text: A bound emblem that serves as an ability card drawn from a single collection of cards. It is grouped with others from the same sworn betrayal of a protector.

rites.name: Amiantus Velus
rites.text: A bound talent that a spell-caster can choose in place of a familiar's bond. It grants a shifting, mutable arcane gift that no other path may take alongside it.

rites.name: Amialestium
rites.text: A battle discipline in which a warrior turns old suffering into a burning force. It can be chosen only alongside a refined art of tearing the spirit to draw strength from it.

rites.name: Ameostellum
rites.text: A hunting talent that lets a shadowy archer choose it as an exclusive path, sharing its mark with a rival soul-drinking gift. Taking one closes off the other.

rites.name: Toles Restes
rites.text: A rogue's gift of moving unseen through darkness, taken as a single chosen path. It works alongside a cloak that hides the wearer in night.

rites.name: Caulliasus
rites.text: A held-back craft for taming storm-fire into a steady form, kept in hidden lore close to a related metal lore within the thunder workshops of a stormy island.

rites.name: Nantillus Viarnium
rites.text: A stealth-based art of delayed harm, where a killer's chosen strike opens a lingering sickness. It can only be learned in tandem with the cutting of thrown blades.

rites.name: Nellium Coronus
rites.text: A dark craft practiced by spellcasters who draw out the life-essence of the fallen. It is taught through a bound book of forbidden rites.

rites.name: Amiallor Telaulum
rites.text: A cunning rogue's gift of deception that is chosen as a rival to a related knack of blending in. Taking one path closes off the other.

rites.name: Reollania
rites.text: A knack that lets a hunter of hollow fiends feed on the spirit of their prey. It can only be taken in place of an opposing discipline.

rites.name: Saunia Sellor
rites.text: A discipline in which a wanderer forms a bond with a single beast of the wild, sharing a path that no other companion may join. It is chosen instead of the shared-companion craft, binding the seeker to one creature alone.

rites.name: Orianelus Raneontes
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's talent binds a hunter's craft to a rune-scored ring, and it can only be chosen in place of a rival roar. Its wielder gains a rare, mutually exclusive bonus.

rites.name: Veollia Cirnoranum
rites.text: A hunter's gift in which the body erupts into self-kindling flame, the blaze competing with a rival inner talent so that only one may be chosen. It is a sudden burning that cannot be tempered in the same breath.

rites.name: Rirnontes
rites.text: A warrior's technique that calls down a bolt of thunder upon a foe. It can only be learned in place of a companion discipline that guards its wielder with a storm barrier.

rites.name: Telania Teleosium
rites.text: Fighters blend sorcery with blade skill in close combat, and the same term names enchanted weapons. A scholar-warrior weaves wellspring magic into armor and steel, mastering flame, ice, and hidden arcana.

rites.name: Coraulistia Seriantanum
rites.text: A worn tome of hurried handwriting that grants its reader one brief casting of the magic it holds, but only for a short window after opening it.

rites.name: Laulesanum Veolasanum
rites.text: A bound craft of gathering weather is held within a single card-sheet from an old and sundered collection. It can be drawn and called upon during play.

rites.name: Cerum Nialium
rites.text: A card-borne power that brings a bearer's inner spirit into tuned accord with the world around them. It belongs to a sealed collection of forceful arts.

rites.name: Rirniantum
rites.text: A bound essence drawn from dreaming visions, usable only by those who take the front line and guard their companions. It grants a sturdy, shielding power to defenders alone.

rites.name: Siloria
rites.text: A learned discipline in which a hunter grows stronger by enduring pain and wounds. It is chosen exclusively alongside a fire-bonded path.

rites.name: Ranteolanum
rites.text: A grim discipline of the deathbound knights that lets a warrior strike quickly while inflicting lingering wounds. It is one of the paths a champion of the shadowed order may choose to master.

rites.name: Sallontia
rites.text: A cunning trickster's craft in which a wielder carves a particular mark into the body to gain a knack for taunting and provoking foes. The mark is said to grant this sly knack to any rogue who bears it.

rites.name: Amaurelus Ameonanum
rites.text: A bound drake's wrath, a card-born surge of power that a sworn servant may call upon. The wording of the ability is pulled from the tomb-chronicle.

rites.name: Leones Mintia
rites.text: A spellcaster channels a sudden leap that carries the caster to a great assembly hall in a distant stone city. The pull of this art moves the wielder instantly across the realm.

rites.name: Mostasum Teolanum
rites.text: A hardened inner resolve that a hunter of man-eating night beasts can take as a single exclusive path, mutually bound with a sudden self-burning art.

rites.name: Virnostium
rites.text: A exclusive choice of skill for fighters who walk the high peaks, paired with a cloud-gathering art. Taking one blocks the other.

rites.name: Tialles Amelor
rites.text: A sacred teaching that instructs holy knights in a rite of calling power through a ceremonial horn. It grants them a special ability used in battle.

rites.name: Lanernium
rites.text: A battle-craft that lets a fighter draw fierce strength from each foe felled. Those who take this path must give up a rival discipline that narrows their focus.

rites.name: Sasontia
rites.text: A card-borne power that channels a sudden blast of lightning into a single strike. It is drawn from the Ardent set of ancient relics.

rites.name: Amaurnor Reonestum
rites.text: A carved mark taught by a stone-cutter who trades it in an underground hollow. It lets a fighter lift and hurl heavy gear with unnatural ease.

rites.name: Leontes Vaullia
rites.text: A carved sigil that holds a wandering starlight in one place. It is taught as a loot-found craft among the mountain scribes of a far valley.

rites.name: Cirnauntium
rites.text: A radiant sight-craft that lets a bearer fix their attention on distant targets. It is bound to the Crown of Skies, a set of sacred relics.

rites.name: Oreollus Ciastasor
rites.text: A bound book that teaches its reader a discipline of wind and air. It is sold by two sky-walking tutors in a blossom-filled valley, and only becomes available to buyers who have reached a high rank and already learned the basic art.

rites.name: Saunes Contaurnus
rites.text: A lingering craft that lets a bearer weather harm and outlast the forces set against them. It is drawn from a card-bound tradition of guardians.

rites.name: Santanum Taunia
rites.text: A stolen craft that a practitioner uses to inflict torment through a single cutting strike. It belongs to a collection of arts tied to the elemental contest of an old age.

rites.name: Amolinus Mareollor
rites.text: A cursed strike technique wielded by rogues, drawn from the twilight arts of an ancient dragon age. It is a card-like rite that unleashes a grim, sweeping slaughter upon foes.

rites.name: Caustium Causinum
rites.text: A passive battle-rage gift lets a wielder reshape a double-bladed arm weapon so that it can be gripped and swung with a single hand.

rites.name: Oraullia Sereornium
rites.text: A borrowed surge of endurance drawn from a carved guardian sigil, granted to a wielder when the ability is invoked. It belongs to a sealed collection of combat arts from an old age of elemental strife.

rites.name: Seonauntia
rites.text: A paired growth talent drawn from the wild-walking tradition of the druid orders. Choosing it binds the wielder to one other path, so that a single choice of growth gives two linked shoots.

rites.name: Leolontium
rites.text: A bound craft of concealment, sealed into a single card-like token. It belongs to a set of relics tied to a broken oath of protectors.

rites.name: Cirus Valauror
rites.text: A card-borne technique that unleashes a wild, warping assault. It belongs to a collection of relics tied to fading dragon lore.

rites.name: Colium Reorones
rites.text: A dark bargain binds a caster to a grim exchange of life. It is a craft drawn from an ancient set of arcane ways.

rites.name: Volor Seraurum
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a shaper alter a foe in the midst of a creature duel. The transformation sets the opposing creature alight.

rites.name: Vintum Seroraunum
rites.text: A ritual of shaping that turns a wild, unstable spark into a dark, silent seed of emptiness. It is learned only after many shapings and a visit to a bubbling vessel in a high silver-walled city.

rites.name: Reosum Vaurnium
rites.text: A tracking skill that lets a user sense the position of hostile foes. It belongs to a set of tidal arts and is recorded as a single card within that collection.

rites.name: Valeres Serosanum
rites.text: A consuming fury that lets the bearer's hatred break free of all restraint, granted only to the most accomplished of those who hunt avenging spirits.

rites.name: Oraunialum Teleontum
rites.text: A dark talent that lets a grim warrior of the dead draw on corrupted vows to empower their arms. It belongs to a bond with a harbinger of ruin.

rites.name: Oranolia Aminor
rites.text: A dark craft that a chosen wielder of death magic may take up, granting the ability to siphon life from a foe with each blow. It is practiced by a sworn order of blood-drinking warriors.

rites.name: Nasium Oraniantium
rites.text: A cunning strike technique that a rogue can unleash from the shadows. It is drawn from a card collection built around the fading age of ancient wyrms.

rites.name: Sereornum Sinor
rites.text: A discipline in which a practitioner spends their own life force as a deliberate choice. It is paired with a drifting-mist dance, and the two arts can only be taken as one another's alternative.

rites.name: Vausolium
rites.text: A warrior's trained technique for spinning a blade in wide sweeping arcs, chosen as an exclusive path that rules out another combat maneuver.

rites.name: Coronanum Mostus
rites.text: A tide of restless spirits that a warrior of the death-touched order may call forth to strike at foes. It is a gift learned along the path of the reaper's blade.

rites.name: Rirnium Marnestor
rites.text: A withering pulse that a Marked hunter of the shadows may choose as a trait, sitting in an either-or branch against another such gift. It is tied to a fierce pursuit of wrath.

rites.name: Vastum Tenium
rites.text: A chosen discipline that a sorcerer of the infernal summoners may adopt, linked to a particular binding design. It can be selected only in place of its paired rival path.

rites.name: Caurus Nostirus
rites.text: A grim tomb-rite that calls forth a volatile corpse-thing, which drifts toward a chosen foe and bursts apart upon reaching it. It is taught to warriors who guard the dead.

rites.name: Ameriantum Telauntium
rites.text: A devoted guardian's ability that sharpens a chosen path of righteous fury. It excludes the rival bell-ringing talent, so only one may be taken.

rites.name: Oraulium Lilum
rites.text: A sacred inner teaching reserved for one disciplined mystic lineage of hermit healers. Its adherents must forgo a rival path's gift, and it pairs with a separate discipline of restoring equilibrium.

rites.name: Orialastia
rites.text: A coiled art of striking hidden touch-points on the body to unleash stored inner force. It is gathered from sealed reservoirs hidden deep inside a dreadful spiraling tower of ruin.

rites.name: Oreriasia
rites.text: A chant-blessing is bestowed when a traveler offers a glowing green orb, a relic gathered from a sealed fortress. For two hours it sharpens the bearer's strikes and mending within three inner halls, and wins the favor of a learned order.

rites.name: Cores
rites.text: A mental command that switches on or off the automatic striking of a chosen foe. Invoking it once begins the blows, and invoking it again stops them.

rites.name: Orestiantus
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a craftsperson gathers drifting fog into a steady stock. It can be chosen alongside one rival technique, but not together with another.

rites.name: Vantus
rites.text: A learned practice that lowers the mana cost of the cleansing rites used to lift harmful afflictions from allies. Practitioners conserve their reserves and keep their strength longer in the field.

rites.name: Niantistia
rites.text: A power that a bearer must deliberately call upon before it takes effect. Such powers are commonly tied to the inherent gifts of a people, and they stand opposed to powers that work on their own without any call.

rites.name: Miallia
rites.text: A learned discipline practiced by a sworn guardian of the vow-bearing orders. It lowers the spiritual toll and the wait between the protective rites a champion may invoke for allies.

rites.name: Tauses
rites.text: A broad ward that soaks up incoming harm, drawn from charms, relics, and enchanted tonics. Some wards cover every kind of strike, while others shield against a single arcane discipline, and the lingering binds of a hex still take hold.

rites.name: Tiarnanum
rites.text: A hidden talent that lets a swift thief-warrior carry an extra surprise. It is shaped by the old ore of the deep mines.

rites.name: Vorus
rites.text: A bubbling caustic fluid that a companion creature can spit or spread during a contest of trained beasts. It is used as a tactic in these friendly battles of creatures.

rites.name: Reolus
rites.text: A craft for pulling one item out of an ordered collection, after which the remaining items shift together to close the gap. It hands back the item it took, and the collection's count is adjusted to match.

rites.name: Reornianum
rites.text: A surging inner reserve that a battling creature draws upon mid-contest. It lets the creature push harder for a short burst during a duel of companions.

rites.name: Veseostium
rites.text: A fleeting charm settles on a traveler who first offers a tender token to a townsperson in one of the old capitals. For an hour it blocks them from receiving any further tokens of devotion.

rites.name: Valiarnia
rites.text: A quiet inner habit that lets a caster of ruin skip a drawn-out chant after unleashing a fiery downpour. The rite becomes unnecessary once the practice is learned by a mature practitioner.

rites.name: Mornus
rites.text: A practitioner's craft lets them mark a moment and later step back to it a single time, restoring their body and position to what they were then.

rites.name: Rostus
rites.text: A companion's stance that makes it strike any foe that wanders near. It can sweep a crowd, but drawing a swarm may ruin a group's effort.

rites.name: Nellia
rites.text: A mark of vengeance carried by avenging hunters of wicked spirits, drawn from the pain that feeds their craft. It is bound to several related sigils that share the same burning, grief-fueled power.

rites.name: Teleontarus
rites.text: A wasting power that a warrior carries within a relic of the blood-bound order. It links to three other relic powers that share its bond.

rites.name: Amostium
rites.text: A winged folk's knack for hanging motionless in open air. It can only be called upon while the wings are already sweeping the sky in gliding flight.

rites.name: Restiarium
rites.text: A tactical warning technique used by creatures fighting in organized duels. It lets a combatant signal its allies to brace themselves before an attack lands.

rites.name: Neolles Rausentia
rites.text: A dark mark that strengthens every hostile creature within certain deep caverns while a guardian ward is raised. It is a magical enhancement cast across the whole foe-filled hall at once.

rites.name: Taristia
rites.text: A grim vow taken by a dread warrior of the dead. When its rite of raising is performed, it calls forth an extra shadowy scout alongside the usual servant.

rites.name: Oronanum
rites.text: A mystical craft that lets an enchanter's working draw strength from charged relics. It is bound to two related disciplines that shape how the power is channeled.

rites.name: Cenes
rites.text: A guardian reclaims the attention of wild beasts from someone who has drawn it away. The keeper pulls their focus back through swift provocations, and an attacker can shed its hold by slipping into false stillness.

rites.name: Miasum
rites.text: A battle-earned mark that a warrior gains after slaying many rivals from the opposing side in open conflict. It grants a lasting boost to their strength in the lands where such trials are fought.

rites.name: Seriantia
rites.text: A tempting, drawn-out craft that stirs a lure of hunger from hidden stores kept in a dark, cursed spire. It is gathered from those secret reserves and channeled as a seductive force.

rites.name: Meontia
rites.text: A restorative craft passed down through bloodlines, learned by those who train in the healing arts of the shamanic path. It is useful in contests between rival fighters.

rites.name: Corarnes
rites.text: A bitter mark carried by a hunter of fiends that ties its wielder's wrath to visions of disorder. It stands alongside two other inner gifts of fury and sight.

rites.name: Meontenium
rites.text: A stored spirit-force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a towering prison of the lost. It empowers the one who gathers it with a scorching exhalation.

rites.name: Carnor Lialiranum
rites.text: A passive skill of a trained fighter that strengthens strikes made with the secondary blade and hurled blades. It raises the damage of the off-hand weapon, letting the fighter nearly match the main strike.

rites.name: Nastium
rites.text: A glowing resin drawn from ancient sap is used to call forth a winged serpent that deals heavy damage while fighting in the air.

rites.name: Mantia
rites.text: A latent attunement that lets a caster draw upon the lingering voices of forebears. It is granted through a relic-forged mark carried by those who walk the old ways.

rites.name: Cernor Rileria
rites.text: A passive magical craft that lets a caster teleport along the path they are already travelling rather than toward where they face. Teachers pass it on through spoken instruction.

rites.name: Niarnor Seontum
rites.text: A crackling discharge that leaps from a hooded keeper of relics during a fierce encounter. It is said to be unleashed by a guardian of old archives when pressed in battle.

rites.name: Amaullum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a caster channel stored sorcerous strength into arcane bolts and blasts, sharpening their force according to the caster's inner power. It also lends this added might to allies fighting nearby.

rites.name: Orinia
rites.text: A caster's discipline that lowers how often a specific sorcerous current is rebuffed by foes. It matters most to elite spellweavers facing towering adversaries who shrug off lesser enchantments.

rites.name: Vaunium Caranum
rites.text: A caster's discipline that raises the harm of all three arcane schools and sharpens the chance of a devastating strike. It builds on an earlier focus and unlocks a more potent technique.

rites.name: Tistor
rites.text: A set of mixed tinctures that any practitioner can learn to blend into armor. It is only found within certain battle-worn garments gathered from a single coastal region.

rites.name: Sistor Siastor
rites.text: A ritual bond that renews a stored mercy-link and amplifies the restorative and shielding energies flowing through it for a brief span. The link lasts for a short time after each renewal.

rites.name: Veontiallor
rites.text: A faint sensing power that lets its user feel hidden reservoirs of stored vital energy. It is gained by drawing on sealed vaults buried deep within a towering prison-fortress.

rites.name: Seresollum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that lets a portion of inner reserve refill while spellwork is underway. It stacks with a warding charm and is valued by seasoned casters during long, drawn-out contests.

rites.name: Miallor
rites.text: A savory essence that can be drawn from hidden stores kept within a dreadful spire. It grants its wielder a flavorful, enhanced power.

rites.name: Reostantia
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that hurls a stream of glowing darts at a foe, dealing harm. It is best used by first gathering a charged surge that makes the volley cost nothing to cast.

rites.name: Sarnum Villia
rites.text: Delvers in underground halls can take a rite that needs a particular keystone and grants a lasting blessing to everyone inside. The blessing persists through death and remains for newcomers who enter later.

rites.name: Telines
rites.text: A ward against the hidden energies of spellcraft, used mainly by sorcerers and wild-speakers. Some peoples are born attuned to it, and in later trials it grows common among those who guard the deepest halls.

rites.name: Tontaunus
rites.text: A stored life-force power that a traveler gathers from hidden reservoirs inside a dark tower of the condemned. It grants the bearer a sustaining hunger that feeds on captured essence.

rites.name: Sisallium
rites.text: A mental force gathered by Veldar-trained spellcasters, drawn from an invented ore that guides their arcane craft. It is a feature open only to those who wield the sealed arts.

rites.name: Tanauntium
rites.text: A tempest of hidden magic that creatures can unleash during contests between tamed companions. It lashes out at opponents with raw enchanted force.

rites.name: Orinum
rites.text: A cold-channeling craft that amplifies all frost-born force a caster unleashes. It also dulls the strikes of foes who close in or hurl blows from afar.

rites.name: Tostanum
rites.text: A practitioner's discipline that thickens a caster's protective hide in proportion to their mental sharpness. It is a rare defensive craft, seldom chosen by those who would rather deepen their offensive studies.

rites.name: Teollus Lostium
rites.text: A permanent inscription that is worked into a pair of gloves, sharpening the wearer's ability to draw attention in battle and to deflect blows. It can only be applied to a sufficiently advanced piece of gear.

rites.name: Miases
rites.text: A stored surge of raw arcane essence that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a cursed tower. It grants its wielder a forceful, commanding power.

rites.name: Tistosum
rites.text: A stored reservoir of a hidden life-force can be drawn from caches found within a grim, layered prison-tower. Those who draw from it gain a surge of sorcerous ability.

rites.name: Oriallor
rites.text: A companion's loyal stance that makes it strike whatever its keeper strikes, and it turns on attackers of either itself or its keeper. It can be unreliable when many foes gather.

rites.name: Amostor Nentausia
rites.text: A learned discipline that deepens the bonuses of a hunter's chosen mantle, raising the power a lesser stance grants its wielder. It is taught to those who master the old beast-bonding crafts.

rites.name: Valirium
rites.text: A stored spirit-force can be gathered from hidden reservoirs within a dark tower of the cursed. Those who draw it gain a rapid surge of power.

rites.name: Oriarnum Vausalia
rites.text: A bound essence drawn from contests fought on open fields of war. Only those who mend the wounded can draw upon its power.

rites.name: Naulia Lantor
rites.text: A repeating strike that a fighter sends against the chosen foe without any command, continuing until halted or the foe slips beyond reach. Stuns and fears pause it, and it resumes once they fade.

rites.name: Raureontes
rites.text: A stalker's basic technique lets a ranged marksman keep loosing projectiles over and over until they choose to halt. It engages on its own whenever the marksman unleashes any other ranged strike, save one particular spread-blast.

rites.name: Corinentium
rites.text: A three-stage discipline that lessens the harm a fighter takes while bound by a stun, a dread, or a sealed voice. It proves especially valuable in duels, since such bindings leave the one held helpless and exposed.

rites.name: Vontes Valarnianes
rites.text: A raw striking force drawn from a fighter's brawn and swiftness that boosts the harm of their basic blows and certain skilled strikes. Two forms exist, one for close combat and one for thrown or launched arms, and only certain warriors gain much from either.

rites.name: Serinium Mirneontor
rites.text: A marksman's craft that lets a bowman loose a dense spray of projectiles at once. It is tied to a single headpiece that never reached the hands of common archers.

rites.name: Taulesia
rites.text: A quiet field worn by a pair of great drakes that goes unnoticed while all allies stand. Any companion who falls inside it receives a marking that drops them into a long, stunning slumber, keeping the fallen from rushing back into the fray.

rites.name: Ceostanum Coreontia
rites.text: A stored reserve of inner force that is gathered from hidden deposits in a cursed spire. It can be drawn upon to raise a protective shield.

rites.name: Valerium
rites.text: A reserve of cosmic force that certain practitioners of the wild arts collect through specific gestures and steady habits. It is then expended on stronger rites, and it takes the place of ordinary mana while they follow their chosen path.

rites.name: Larum Telintum
rites.text: A ritual craft that a faithful practitioner learns at a dim sanctuary of quiet mending. Each day the practitioner returns there to receive a lasting blessing that lingers through the wandering hours until the cycle turns over.

rites.name: Maustiantus
rites.text: A deep-tier sorcerous art that spreads a creeping blight through nearby foes in a fan-shaped sweep, inflicting extra harm as it spreads. It was once taught to practitioners, then superseded by newer arts.

rites.name: Renes
rites.text: A bladed-craft gauge that tallies how sure a fighter's hand is to land a blow. It was once raised by gear and training, but a later reform folded those boosts into other forms of skill and capped the gauge at a fixed multiple of one's rank.

rites.name: Oreosus
rites.text: A bonded companion joins its keeper's attack the instant the keeper strikes an enemy. It stays locked on that foe and never turns to another target.

rites.name: Visor Orausanum
rites.text: A dark hex that a caster lays upon a foe, dealing shadow harm at steady intervals for a short span. Each pulse may call forth a bound sentinel to fight beside the caster.

rites.name: Oriasalium
rites.text: A stealth technique where a rogue wields a short blade in the dominant hand to deliver a heavy blow. It gains extra force when the attacker strikes from directly behind an unsuspecting foe.

rites.name: Cianeoranum
rites.text: A tool-like craft drawn from a distant wellspring of power, it can heal, protect, or destroy depending on the hands that wield it. Its arcane strands are seen as riskier than the gentler forces that flow from faith and nature.

rites.name: Liarus Orelus
rites.text: A tamed beast's trick that briefly dazzles a foe, leaving it unable to see for a few moments. Only one breed of beast can perform it, and it proves handy in duels between rivals.

rites.name: Tareornes
rites.text: A tireless craft practiced by hired blades in long contests, it swells a fighter's strikes in a rising wave, then ebbs them back to baseline. The rhythm is set by repeated quick blows.

rites.name: Tillarnor
rites.text: A tactic where a group quietly seizes precious resource from enemy raiders who attack them. It turns the aggressors' own hauls against them.

rites.name: Rosium
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a practitioner outside the ordained path draw upon a set of restrained arts reserved for a single discipline. It becomes available only once the wielder reaches a mature stage of training.

rites.name: Coronium
rites.text: A early-tier ruinous craft that quickens the casting of three destructive incantations, letting a practitioner unleash fire, shadow and chaos sooner. It was retired from the practice long ago.

rites.name: Orernes
rites.text: A tempering rite that sharpens a companion's arm by a set measure. Because a follower's worth is averaged across arm and armor, the gain registers only as half of that measure.

rites.name: Valeornium Corauranum
rites.text: A glowing cluster of mineral beads that belongs to a shared arcane tradition open to every kind of practitioner. It grants a particular enchantment to whoever bears it.

rites.name: Raunes Teontus
rites.text: A trait of martial endurance that can be gained by certain fighters who favor defense or disciplined combat. It is drawn from a rare azure substance found within armor and weapons.

rites.name: Amiareones
rites.text: A restorative rite a creature undergoes once a contest of strength ends. It mends part of the wounds it took, closing half the gap between how it stood before the clash and how it stands after.

rites.name: Sorneosanum
rites.text: A basic measure of how much arcane reserve a practitioner holds before any charms or gear alter it. Spell expenses are drawn as a share of this unaltered reserve, and the figure depends mainly on one's craft rather than one's lineage.

rites.name: Neontia
rites.text: A tactic that certain companion beasts employ while contesting one another in organized duels. It is a move drawn from the creature's own repertoire during such a contest.

rites.name: Nillones
rites.text: A trainable craft of mixing potions that grows in skill through several tiers. Practitioners gain access to a list of formulas as their mastery advances.

rites.name: Oranaustes
rites.text: A martial enhancement traded for honor tokens at frontier garrison posts by sergeants of rival keeps. It is bought by warriors seeking to sharpen their combat instincts.

rites.name: Linum Teonanum
rites.text: A tactic where a companion creature hurls a cask during a contest of beasts. It is used by many different tamed creatures when they battle.

rites.name: Celiasum
rites.text: A guiding light craft available only to devout healers of the sacred order. It is learned upon reaching full mastery of the healing path.

rites.name: Valisiantum
rites.text: A glowing sigil that strengthens every hostile foe within certain sealed sanctums while a hidden guardian ward is raised. It empowers the adversaries of an ancient shrine's ritual trial.

rites.name: Ameorelanum
rites.text: A dark mark that strengthens every hostile creature within the sunken halls of a hidden burrow realm while a guardian ward is active. It empowers the defenders of a sealed underground vault.

rites.name: Menia Coraullum
rites.text: A tilted-scale gift of the old craft, granted to those who keep the inner measure. It lets a practitioner bring balance to their gifts at a high stage of growth.

rites.name: Amiareontor
rites.text: A frozen-cold craft that a bearer of the grave-cold order can call upon. It works in tandem with two other linked arts of the same kind.

rites.name: Amolliror
rites.text: A chilling skill that a dark-cold warrior-priest can draw upon in the second rank of their frost discipline. It is no longer available to practitioners.

rites.name: Lornium Rantellanum
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a fighter redirects an incoming strike back onto the attacker. It is a refined skill of a trained warrior, taught as an advanced discipline.

rites.name: Corelium Teleolestes
rites.text: A learned talent of shadow-wielding clerics that gives a chance to stun a foe briefly. The chance grows with each point invested, up to a set limit, and it triggers only on a spell's first strike, not its lingering effects.

rites.name: Moles
rites.text: A brief surge of hurried motion that a caster may call upon, returning after a short wait and ignoring the usual pause between gestures.

rites.name: Teontor Niarus
rites.text: A trick that clouds a foe's sight so it stumbles about in confusion for a short while. Any harm snaps it out of the daze, and using it halts the user's own strikes.

rites.name: Maurnia Nosteollus
rites.text: A fighter's technique that lets strikes sometimes stagger an opponent, slowing their steps for a few heartbeats. It is a trained skill of the blade-wielding caste.

rites.name: Oreontus
rites.text: A chilling craft that companion beasts draw upon during contests of spirit. It sears foes with a bitter, biting frost.

rites.name: Caulosium
rites.text: A specialized mastery once taught to dark warriors who devoted themselves to a corrupting discipline. Those who trained in it could learn it from a dedicated instructor once they reached a high rank.

rites.name: Naurneolum
rites.text: A permanent inscription on a blade that sometimes wakes a defensive guard after a strike. The guard lets the bearer turn aside a foe's attack, and the turning-aside answers with a burst of harm, but only a seasoned wielder can bear the inscription.

rites.name: Valaurnalum
rites.text: A grim discipline of the Crimson Order, where a fighter's bloodied weapon grows stronger from the wounds it has already dealt. The technique is taught in the third ring of the blood-school training halls.

rites.name: Oriarauntum
rites.text: A grim, exclusive discipline practiced by sworn war-keepers who draw strength from the lifeblood of the living. It is taken as a branch of the deeper arts of ruin and cannot be learned alongside its rival path.

rites.name: Casontium
rites.text: A shared rush of quickened motion that flows through a whole company for a short span, then rests for a long while before it can be called again. Several different practitioners can channel this same surge in identical ways.

rites.name: Meorisum
rites.text: A dark, crimson-stained power drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence inside a gloomy spiraling tower of punishment. It is gained by those who seek out these buried caches.

rites.name: Telolia Valiarnirus
rites.text: A forceful bodily charge used by beasts during contests of companion creatures. It knocks an opponent down through sheer weight and momentum.

rites.name: Saustenor Valornes
rites.text: A stored vital essence that can be drawn from hidden reserves in a dark, layered tower of punishment. It works as a power a wielder may claim.

rites.name: Ciales Reostor
rites.text: A ranged strike technique that small trained beasts perform in staged contests between companions. It is launched from a distance during a duel of tamed creatures.

rites.name: Rialeosia Visantus
rites.text: A tactic where a creature hurls fragments of its own skeleton at an opponent during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a ranged technique used in organized animal duels.

rites.name: Meontaurum
rites.text: A hereditary knack for the bow that lets a marksman strike true blows a little more often. Its edge is measured in small fractions of chance, and at seasoned skill it adds a modest steady sharpness to every shot.

rites.name: Vonaules
rites.text: A stored dark essence drawn from hidden reservoirs in a cursed spire. Those who keep it can call upon its gloom as a source of power.

rites.name: Rallia Taunilus
rites.text: A binding technique that lets certain tamed companions trap a rival creature during a contest of beasts. The trapped creature is held in place until the bout ends.

rites.name: Ceollus Mauneranum
rites.text: A cold-bred inner gift that lets certain healers draw on a biting frost within them. It is available only to those who walk the path of mending.

rites.name: Corinialum
rites.text: A craftsman's mark of distinction, granted to one who keeps a set of shattering elemental forces bound to their own frame for a full hour without faltering.

rites.name: Callum Serores
rites.text: A glowing essence drawn from a worn-out spirit that is gained through a campaign and a rising alliance of allied houses. Only those who wield strikes in battle can draw upon its power.

rites.name: Rausontus
rites.text: A companion's stubborn trait lets it shake off every effect that binds or slows its movement. It is a cunning talent passed through trained beasts.

rites.name: Amellus Lalium
rites.text: A mechanical craft in which a small tinkering creature raises a defensive engine during a contest of companions. The engine stands guard and strikes back at opponents.

rites.name: Caneoses
rites.text: A grasping power that lets a bearer hurl a hungry vessel at a trader, slaying that merchant for the rest of the descent. The gain is coin-like spoils, though the slain trader may not be found again.

rites.name: Tillosia
rites.text: A tactic in which a small creature hides a hoard beneath the soil during a contest between companions. The stash can be dug up to aid the creature in later rounds of the bout.

rites.name: Sontus Sereolisium
rites.text: A practiced skill that lets a warrior draw away many restless spirits at once. It stands as an either-or choice against a protective barrier of the same circle.

rites.name: Nauranum
rites.text: A quiet inner tendency that a frost-bound warrior of the grave-sworn order carries from a certain rank onward. It makes the carrier's own frame more fragile in exchange for a distinct kind of cold strength.

rites.name: Ranteolium
rites.text: A shielding technique that creatures in a contest of tamed beasts can call upon. It wraps a combatant in a fragile sphere of drifting film during a duel.

rites.name: Mausornor
rites.text: A stacking curse that spreads through the contested field, growing heavier over time. It amplifies harm dealt to its bearer and holds them to a steady, unhurried pace.

rites.name: Serintium Naustor
rites.text: A temporary blessing placed upon a wanderer that strengthens their abilities for a while. Some surges fade with time, while others depend on the surroundings, and they rarely combine with similar ones.

rites.name: Orostium Amalernes
rites.text: A dead-sight gift drawn from hoarded soul-stores kept in a grim tower of the cursed. It grants its bearer a power to perceive and channel the remnants of the departed.

rites.name: Teleornisus
rites.text: A rule that lets the view bend around still pools, so the gaze follows the wearer whether they rise above the surface or sink beneath it.

rites.name: Nallianor
rites.text: A volatile sort of inner force drawn from hidden reservoirs in a crumbling tower of punishment. It is gathered from those stores and unleashed as a sudden, explosive burst.

rites.name: Valeoria Cauneolum
rites.text: A tactic that lets a companion creature draw a jolt from the storm overhead to strike its rival during a contest of beasts. It is wielded by many different creatures in such duels.

rites.name: Ronum Rialium
rites.text: A surge of vitality that a monk of the mist arts can draw upon. It is a gift granted by a deep-tapped ore, shaping the healer's craft.

rites.name: Mestium Vausenia
rites.text: A set of five hunter techniques that call a companion beast to the hunter's side. Up to five companions can be summoned, and all techniques are grouped under one button.

rites.name: Sosellor
rites.text: A practitioner's craft lets them raise a small carved marker that bursts with crackling charge after a brief pause, dazing every foe standing close beside it. The marker can be shattered before it discharges.

rites.name: Amialeostor
rites.text: A loud, jarring channel that fighters can draw upon in battle. It is found by defeating several distinct guardians across different hidden locations.

rites.name: Sereonus Laleostia
rites.text: A consuming craft that a fire-wielding caster draws from an inner appetite for flame. It bonds closely with two related disciplines that share the same ravenous heat.

rites.name: Seronausum
rites.text: A reflective ward that strikes back at an attacker whenever a blow lands on its bearer. It is a passive counter-charm, often bound into armor or a token worn by the warrior.

rites.name: Mesus
rites.text: A dim shimmering aura that surrounds spellcasters when they vanish from sight. Its display can be switched off to make the scene run more smoothly.

rites.name: Amantenia
rites.text: A setting that decides whether the magical blasts cast by other people are muted in appearance. It governs how loudly foreign spells show up on the screen.

rites.name: Sauntirnor
rites.text: A bond gained by choosing a champion's calling that lets its bearer draw forth a radiant guardian. Each use calls one chosen ally of the sacred glow to stand beside the caller.

rites.name: Amolliasium
rites.text: A skill of focused aim that a hunter picks from a branch of talents at the tenth tier. It cannot be taken alongside another keen-sight gift.

rites.name: Orianus
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a drifting cloud of vapor mends nearby allies whenever a guiding star-spirit is present. Practitioners sometimes hasten the cloud's forming with a gentle breath-charm.

rites.name: Toses Amellostia
rites.text: A binding force drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy within a dark tower of punishment. It is taken from these stores and used to snare or pull things across the sky.

rites.name: Marnanum Valeostus
rites.text: A craft-honor earned by a cook who reaches seventy-five points of skill in the ruinous branch of the kitchen arts. It marks a practitioner who has mastered the most volatile dishes.

rites.name: Serales Saulor
rites.text: A dark craft granted to sorcerers at a high tier of mastery, used by small tormenting spirits to sear wounds shut. It is practiced by these lesser fiends.

rites.name: Lialaurium
rites.text: A crafted charm that calls forth a small paper-built sentinel, drawing the attention of nearby foes and shielding its wielder from harm until the sentinel falls or fades.

rites.name: Oraustarus
rites.text: A high-tier strike technique used by a fierce warrior class of shadow-wielding hunters. When its transformation rite is invoked, the blow changes into a devastating final form.

rites.name: Losanum
rites.text: A holy rite used by certain healers of two peoples, it strikes an enemy with harm and holds it fast in place for a brief moment.

rites.name: Oriarium Seraria
rites.text: A sustained working that holds its bearer still while it pours out repeated effects. A gauge drains as the bearer stays rooted, and jostling or harm can shorten it or break it off entirely.

rites.name: Serilium Raulium
rites.text: A stored inner energy drawn from hidden reserves within a deep tower of punishment. It grants its bearer a surge of disruptive power.

rites.name: Ciastor Cerium
rites.text: A tangled craft wielded by oath-bound sorcerers who weave several elemental forces into one strike. Its blows slip past ordinary wards, though sacred barriers and bodily shields still hold against it.

rites.name: Vostiarnus
rites.text: A combat technique granted to a guardian-style caster, allowing a strike delivered after building momentum. It is learned when a fighter reaches a moderate level of experience and is used in contests between rival warriors.

rites.name: Nostes Amistum
rites.text: A ruinous discharge of unstable energy is hurled at a foe, always striking with its full force. Its harm grows stronger the more often the caster lands decisive blows.

rites.name: Valaules Siaraunus
rites.text: A dormant surge of inner vitality that is drawn out of hidden reservoirs within a deep, cursed spire. Those who gather it gain a sharpened strength they can call upon.

rites.name: Lianes Valernium
rites.text: A dark mark that a fighter can gain as a combat gift, letting them grow stronger when clashing with other fighters in open duels. It is unlocked once a warrior reaches a fairly early stage of their training.

rites.name: Telistia Ninosia
rites.text: A bite-based technique that creatures of many kinds perform while contesting one another in a staged contest of tamed companions.

rites.name: Telirnia Seolia
rites.text: A chilling passive that a warrior of the cold guilds can learn at a certain rank. Paired with a single-target freeze, it lets the wielder slow every foe pressed close around them.

rites.name: Niria Vaselia
rites.text: A charged state that lets a caster's next working cost nothing from their reserves. Casters often answer it with a heavier working to make the most of it.

rites.name: Neolisium
rites.text: A combat art in which a warrior of the hunting orders purges foul spirits with cinders, and is able to do so when clashing against other warriors.

rites.name: Ternares
rites.text: A timed chant that a keeper of the grove can attach to a relic. It is bound to two companion rites that rise and fall together with it.

rites.name: Vastintor
rites.text: A stored spiritual force drawn from sealed reservoirs in a dreadful spire of penance. Adepts gather it to strengthen their calling and sharpen their craft.

rites.name: Launtus Norium
rites.text: A learned discipline of the cold tradition, placed in the fourth ring of a frost-branch training path. It is no longer taught in the current orders.

rites.name: Villanum Tontus
rites.text: A shapeshifting gift that lets a being choose which of its two forms to return to after effects force a change. Toggling the choice sets the form it resumes.

rites.name: Oralliania
rites.text: A sacred mending craft that restores vitality to several allies gathered near a chosen point, cast instantly. The mending may spread beyond the one the caster directly targets.

rites.name: Coriasia Ameliaria
rites.text: A learned bearing that strengthens a warrior's rallying cries, making them carry further and hit harder. It can only be mastered after deep training in the fury-path disciplines.

rites.name: Coraurnia Ameollaunor
rites.text: A blood-borne ailment that keeps the lifeblood from thickening and sealing wounds. It is tied to a pair of bone-breaking afflictions that weaken the frame of whoever bears it.

rites.name: Casus Teliases
rites.text: A bought skill that lets its holder command a fiery winged spirit of the forge. The skill is sold by a vain trader who keeps a stall deep in a subterranean cavern.

rites.name: Serontanum
rites.text: A bristling enchantment drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-essence in a cursed spire. Its wearer gains a crown of barbed defense.

rites.name: Sostium Vastonum
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by beast-tamers of the hunter orders, unlocked once a trainee reaches a set standing. It sharpens how their bonded creatures strike.

rites.name: Sernialium
rites.text: Objects summoned into being by a caster's will or arcane art, they work like ordinary gear while the maker stays near. They fade away if the owner remains absent for a long while.

rites.name: Nonteolum
rites.text: A tactic that lets certain tamed companions rise again and rejoin a contest of creature duels. It is used during a battle between pets.

rites.name: Laranum Vernia
rites.text: A ranged shaping technique a hunter learns early on, which replaces an older binding strike. It reaches farther and costs no focus, though its hold is briefer unless it is stretched.

rites.name: Narum Sornilium
rites.text: A trained skill of the sly thief that clears away lingering magical hexes from the body. For a few brief heartbeats afterward, the practitioner is shielded against nearly every enchantment cast upon them.

rites.name: Corintarnus
rites.text: A frost-aligned discipline practiced by spellcasters that shortens the recovery time of their chilling incantations. Each added practice trims the wait further, up to a set limit.

rites.name: Tesia Liaseonor
rites.text: A fighter's technique strikes an opponent with a blow that leaves them marked, so that the wielder's following assaults land with greater force for a brief span.

rites.name: Nastus Niallia
rites.text: A fighting technique a wandering practitioner uses when wielding a long rod. It replaces a quick strike with a heavier blow in appearance only, leaving its effort and force unchanged.

rites.name: Oriranum Valarium
rites.text: A battle-focused trance technique that a practitioner gains through a trial. Mastering it leaves behind a lasting token of recognition.

rites.name: Ronaules
rites.text: A skilled art of the shadowy wanderers that lets a seasoned practitioner reach a heightened state of battle preparedness once they have matured in their craft.

rites.name: Oreolirum
rites.text: A dark inner power is gained from hidden stores found within a grim tower of punishment. It lets its bearer spread sickness and decay to nearby foes.

rites.name: Coreornium Rastelles
rites.text: A hazy inner power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spiritual essence hidden deep within a towering prison of the cursed. It clouds the thoughts of those who wield it.

rites.name: Orentialum
rites.text: A shared inner discipline carried by every artifact of a class, unbound to any single gift. It can only be mastered after all other gifts are learned, and each further step deepens its effect.

rites.name: Lanaurnia
rites.text: A channeled craft in which a practitioner guides a stored spiritual force through a crafted focus. It is earned by reaching the third tier of mastery in a conducting instrument.

rites.name: Amentanum Verum
rites.text: A trained technique for casters that pairs with a forceful wing-stroke gift. It is offered as one choice among a few exclusive options.

rites.name: Vanteostum
rites.text: A focused restorative craft that can be learned by those who have trained in the healing arts. It draws power from a special attuned resource to heal wounds.

rites.name: Oraustium Tauntes
rites.text: A secondary resource gathered by striking a foe with certain quick blows, shown as ruby marks beneath the bar of one's vigor. Spent all at once on a decisive strike, a stronger result grows with each mark held, though the strike cannot be unleashed without at least one.

rites.name: Riasor Amoses
rites.text: A hunter's inherited mastery over beasts, tied to two linked traits of a shared bond. It shapes how the bearer commands creatures in the field.

rites.name: Lenium Rollium
rites.text: A caster's craft that brings forth restorative drinks to refill their reserves of spirit. The conjured draughts gather in stacks of twenty and may be passed to others, but they fade if the caster stays away too long.

rites.name: Corentaulus
rites.text: A bubbling essence of spirit power that is drawn from hidden stores found within a dark, cursed tower. It lets its wielder unleash a biting, eroding force.

rites.name: Serilentia
rites.text: A permanent enchantment worked onto arm guards that shortens the wait before a traveler can summon the homing stone again, but only within two distant lands.

rites.name: Rellinus
rites.text: A drawn-out inner power that is gathered from sealed reservoirs in a dreadful spire. Its wielder feeds on the stored essence to strengthen their own abilities.

rites.name: Serauseolia
rites.text: A soft loaf is summoned from raw arcane energy by seasoned casters who have mastered the art of conjuring sustenance. It exists only for those with a high degree of skill.

rites.name: Vestarnes
rites.text: A tainted resonance drawn from pooled spirit-essence hidden within a cursed spire. It lets its bearer sense and channel the rot gathering around them.

rites.name: Oralleornum
rites.text: A tamer's bond lets a hunter direct a companion creature through a shared row of commands. The bond is no longer listed in the grimoire, yet it still holds.

rites.name: Telaneror
rites.text: A passive trait that a creature gains when a certain learned skill is taken up, letting it be shaped toward any of several combat styles. It belongs to the beast companions of hunters.

rites.name: Ciallirnum
rites.text: A bound rage that a warrior of the shadow-hunters can hold within the blade. It is tied to the wisdom of the hidden watchers and to the fury of the demon-blooded.

rites.name: Caunteonor
rites.text: A grim craft that lets a practitioner set a dead body alight from within, bursting it apart. It harms nothing living and is learned from a dark manuscript.

rites.name: Ciases Orernum
rites.text: A reactive tactic that lets a companion creature answer an incoming strike during a contest of beasts. It is available to many kinds of companions in such duels.

rites.name: Saures Valenaulum
rites.text: A tactic of the archer-guilds that lets a trained marksman strike back at a caster mid-incantation. Only certain guilds teach it, while another guild's version is a different technique that works in a similar way.

rites.name: Vollanum Valostia
rites.text: A channeled craft where a caster draws in dim, shadowy essence to slowly mend their own wounds and restore their reserves of power. It is picked up by a lesser sworn warder on reaching a certain stage of training.

rites.name: Launanum Saulus
rites.text: A tainted quality that can be drawn into a stalker's craft and used to sharpen their killing strikes. The art is said to be unavailable to anyone at present.

rites.name: Tostus
rites.text: A tactic where a fighter lingers near a fallen rival's remains, waiting for them to rise again so they can be struck down a second time. Overseers permit it despite the frustration it causes.

rites.name: Valeosium Venornum
rites.text: A skilled undead-warrior technique that a fighter can learn once they reach a high rank of experience. It lets the practitioner shift their vital essence into a new form.

rites.name: Cilosus
rites.text: A passive battle craft that lets a fierce fighter pick between gripping two short blades or wielding two great weapons at once. It is learned once a warrior reaches a certain rank of skill.

rites.name: Valialum Meniallium
rites.text: A tuned binding of ember-sparks that a sorcerer of the ruin-craft can draw into their practice. It is a learned trait available only to those who wield the destructive arts of the fire-cults.

rites.name: Veostaror
rites.text: A grim biting technique that companion creatures perform during contests of pet combat. It lets a tamed beast bite its rival with a sinister, unsettling snap.

rites.name: Teleranes
rites.text: A frost-working craft drawn from the cold arts of the Thessoric circle. It is a mutually exclusive path chosen alongside the Shardlance Ray, so a practitioner must pick one or the other.

rites.name: Viasium Sostum
rites.text: A surge of stored crystalline energy that a creature can unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It lets allied companions call upon the power within them.

rites.name: Naunus Valianor
rites.text: A stored vital energy drawn from sealed reserves within a ruinous, cursed tower. Its wielders gain a protective barrier that slowly wears away.

rites.name: Corintones
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a maker shape goods more quickly at the bench. It shortens the time spent working each piece from raw material to finished object.

rites.name: Sereolles
rites.text: A glassy hardened shell that certain tough fighters can grow over their bodies. It is drawn from a mineral trait available only to those who hold the front-line guardian role.

rites.name: Narniallor
rites.text: A bodily performance a wanderer can call forth by a spoken command, with each kind of folk moving in its own manner. The music that should accompany it is not supplied.

rites.name: Ceontium Veosanum
rites.text: A ritual bond-craft that ties a hunter's fighting spirit to a tireless rhythm of repeated strikes. Only those who walk the vengeful path can learn to draw on it.

rites.name: Sianosium
rites.text: A tiered companion's craft in which each sharp strike by the beast's claw, jaw, or hammer-paw swells the damage dealt by both the keeper and the creature. It was devised to replace an older passive gift of evasion granted to beasts bonded to ordinary wardens.

rites.name: Testia Vorasium
rites.text: A hidden levy on sorcerous strikes that dims the power of two swift bolt spells in exchange for quicker casting. Practitioners weigh a lighter blow against a faster rhythm of attacks, since the cost of the mana stays the same.

rites.name: Ciania Ceoses
rites.text: A lawless trait that binds to a wandering blade's edge once several other marks of ruin and avarice have awakened. It stands apart from every other trait, surfacing only when those particular ones are unlocked.

rites.name: Teloralia
