rites.text: A slow harm laid upon a foe that strikes again and again at steady intervals for a set span. Some ruin spreads across a crowd, and certain crafts rely on it heavily as their core.

rites.name: Ameonus
rites.text: A shimmering power drawn from hidden reserves of spirit-stuff buried in a dark, towering prison. It is gathered from caches tucked away deep within its halls.

rites.name: Coriastus Teleonum
rites.text: A measure of how much harm a casting yields for each unit of its gathered essence. Lingering curses often score high here, but only when they persist through their whole span.

rites.name: Valorus Oraustor
rites.text: A shadowy strike drawn from a creature's inner power, used in contests by enchanted companions to hurt rivals. It belongs to the skill set of beasts bonded with magic.

rites.name: Molaunia
rites.text: A quietly grown mark that any wielder may awaken within armor forged from a single sea-harbor's salvage. It can only be drawn from garments recovered in three particular port-holds.

rites.name: Virnoles Telaunium
rites.text: A grim inner resolve that a blood-sworn warrior can cultivate along the third rung of the crimson discipline. It belongs to the ranks of old, long-retired arts.

rites.name: Minteosia
rites.text: A blood-bound craft of a grim warrior order that channels dread into the wielder's rhythm of strikes. It works in tandem with several related gifts of the same order.

rites.name: Oraliastus
rites.text: A gifted practitioner's craft lets them mend their own body through shadowed arts. It becomes available once they reach a fifteenth rank of mastery.

rites.name: Nelloria
rites.text: A shadowed inner force that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs found within a grim, ruined spire. Those who gather its essence gain a dark and steadying power.

rites.name: Sostium Lernostus
rites.text: A dulling force drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden inside a cursed spire of ruin. Those who gather its stored essence can smother living energy in the ground.

rites.name: Maurneolus
rites.text: A lethal skill of swift, relentless strikes drawn from the craft of killing by stealth. It is the first rung of the shadow-blade discipline taught to aspiring rogues.

rites.name: Amausanes
rites.text: A hidden mark of quiet power that can be drawn from stored essence kept in the depths of a grim tower of punishment. It lets its bearer gather strength from those hoarded reserves.

rites.name: Serium Serisor
rites.text: A grave-bound rite that a dark warrior of the Veil Circle may join, replacing an older blight-spreading art. It is granted temporarily during a forest trial and fades once that trial's tale is complete.

rites.name: Molesus
rites.text: A sacred blessing that strengthens a healer's restorative radiance, increasing the mending power of a dawnlight spell by a tenth, with the bonus accumulating over repeated uses.

rites.name: Coriantilus
rites.text: A narrow band of distance where a fighter can strike neither close nor far, leaving archers and swordsmen both stranded. A foe that can bind its victim in place may linger there safely while the bound one is helpless.

rites.name: Amostauntum
rites.text: A stored surge of spiritual energy that releases when its bearer falls in death. It is gathered from hidden reserves within a towering, cursed prison.

rites.name: Sales Vernia
rites.text: A chaotic talent that lets a fel-tainted hunter choose it instead of a rival ability. It pairs with a swift dash technique.

rites.name: Corisum Cauror
rites.text: A dimmed glow of hidden essence that is drawn from sealed reservoirs in a dark, spired prison. It grants its bearer a shadowed power.

rites.name: Valornaunes
rites.text: A shadowy vital power that is gathered from hidden reserves within a cursed spire. It is drawn out of stored essence sealed in the tower's depths.

rites.name: Meontes Coriastus
rites.text: A beast-kin power that lets a wearer shed a human guise and surge forward with sudden swiftness. It slips past watchers without breaking concealment, and some must first complete a trial before wielding it.

rites.name: Tirontes
rites.text: A tactic where a hostile creature's fixation on a wanderer fades once the wanderer retreats far enough, or when the target's grudge list is wiped clean. Some evasive maneuvers only lessen that fixation without erasing it.

rites.name: Valisaranum
rites.text: A dark, corrupting power bound to a wielder's cursed relic. It works in tandem with two companion powers, one that sustains endurance and another that draws foes inward.

rites.name: Valisia Marniares
rites.text: A combat technique in which a rogue hurls a weapon at a foe to finish them, dealing harm that grows with each prepared strike and leaving the target slugged for a short span.

rites.name: Lanum Amoria
rites.text: A dark ritual binding that marks a rival warrior so the caster can seize the marked foe's next working and loose it back. The mark does not stop the working itself, and nothing that cannot be turned aside can be seized.

rites.name: Amasostum
rites.text: A shadowy flicker that companion beasts can call upon during contests of bonded creatures. It gives them a sudden tactical edge in battle.

rites.name: Rentum Raustoria
rites.text: A dark elixir-craft that grants a stolen life-force to its drinker. It is gathered from hidden reservoirs kept within a crumbling tower of the cursed.

rites.name: Valeoleria
rites.text: A grim craft that draws the strength of a fallen foe into the wielder. Its user gains back vigor with each strike of frozen shadow.

rites.name: Vanes Rintornum
rites.text: A lasting enchantment that imbues a close-combat weapon so that its strikes and linked spellwork sometimes deliver an extra chill that dulls the foe's movement. The slowing does not affect foes of high rank.

rites.name: Teloraustes
rites.text: A borrowed vital force drawn from hidden stores kept within a towering prison-spire of the cursed. It grants its bearer a power gathered from those reserves.

rites.name: Rises
rites.text: A deadly whirling technique practiced by shadow-wielding warriors who fight demons. It is the altered form of an ordinary dance of blades, awakened when the warrior undergoes a dramatic inner transformation.

rites.name: Valestarnus
rites.text: A bleak cold craft that lets a grave-bound warrior strike with frost far more often at the heart of a foe. Each icy blow found by this art lands with doubled ferocity.

rites.name: Marnium Sonium
rites.text: A cunning trick of misdirection that a sly wanderer uses to mislead foes. It bonds with a wandering crafter's fortune-gifts and wayfarer's marksman skill.

rites.name: Orastum Tauniasum
rites.text: A lingering curse that drags down a creature's strength and dulls its actions while it lasts. Such afflictions are often tied to particular kinds of folk or callings.

rites.name: Lenum Loreosanum
rites.text: A primal force that is the opposite of a spirit-element, binding natural forces to a wielder's will and bending them into weapons. It lets dark practitioners command the elements without asking their permission.

rites.name: Saunor Serostum
rites.text: A learned discipline of the summoner's craft that strengthens the protective hide a bound spirit lends its caster. It also deepens the restorative warding laid over the caster's flesh.

rites.name: Mellanum Reostum
rites.text: A defensive knack that works like a warding counter, turning aside harm that arrives through shaped force rather than a blade. It stacks with a guardian's readiness, and a sentinel's stance can briefly lend it to spells.

rites.name: Tiasarnanum
rites.text: A dark rage that stirs within a bound guardian beast, sharpening its ferocity for a time. It is an inner passive that the guardian's keeper gives to the beast it serves.

rites.name: Caustalum
rites.text: A dark, shard-bound power drawn from hoarded essence stores in a cursed spire of imprisoned souls. It fuels those who seek strength from the sealed chambers beneath it.

rites.name: Seoliarnium
rites.text: A bound-servant's coiled reserve of brutal force, stored by a caster and unleashed in a single devastating burst of its guardian's whirling assault. It must be chosen over a rival technique.

rites.name: Mesilium
rites.text: A learned talent of the destructive branch of study, which must be pursued deeply, with a dozen points of devotion, before it can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Orillontus
rites.text: A calming technique that creatures use while locked in a contest of companion beasts. It is performed mid-duel to steady the spirit of the fighter.

rites.name: Neosus Amenium
rites.text: A guild-taught discipline that lets fighters draw the attention of foes and hold their rage away from allies. Practitioners train it to become the steadiest shield in any engagement.

rites.name: Amintum Sornia
rites.text: A dark, burning power bound to a hunter's relic that answers to a grudge. It is tied to a pain-bearing aura and a crafted design.

rites.name: Laustum Vauntolanum
rites.text: A tonic-born state of heightened confidence that a brewed morning draught grants to whoever drinks it. It lingers for a time and bends the drinker's sense of their own abilities.

rites.name: Losus Minor
rites.text: A evasive movement art that turns aside incoming harm. It is one of two mutually exclusive paths a practitioner may choose, with the other being a lethal form of the same craft.

rites.name: Reostium Taurnastium
rites.text: A former striking technique of a shadow-warrior, it was a transformed form of a bite-like strike used during a change of form. Later it was dropped when the warrior's dance was reshaped into a sweeping blow.

rites.name: Cianarnor
rites.text: A practitioner's trained technique that replaces a basic dark bolt while a sustained trance state is active. It holds three stored uses, each restoring over a few seconds.

rites.name: Vollium Costia
rites.text: A specialized combat talent that lets a warrior channel fiercer power through their weapons. It is a rival path that cannot be taken alongside a particular hunger-driven technique.

rites.name: Orentium Amostanum
rites.text: A passive protective art unlocked at a mid-tier rank of the hunters' craft. Practitioners of the stern path gain its full strength, while those following the reckless path receive a feebler version.

rites.name: Taulanum Teliarnanum
rites.text: A guardian's training technique that lets a fighter take the form of a steadfast barrier. It is a single exclusive path, closed off once a rival bulwark method is chosen.

rites.name: Niantarum
rites.text: A dark, fiery trait that can be gained by a caster who practices a forbidden summoning craft. It is shaped by the hidden power of a fallen stone.

rites.name: Varnollium
rites.text: A discipline of the Dovrel school that let its adepts sense the moods of their bound familiars. It stood as a disciplined art for those willing to invest deeply in the school's teachings, though its place was later stripped away.

rites.name: Misaunium
rites.text: A dark, attuned craft that wardens who wield unseen forces can channel. It is shared by two schools of hooded caster-scholars.

rites.name: Orastaunum
rites.text: A protective craft that mechanical beasts of one tamed brood can invoke to halve the harm they suffer for a short span.

rites.name: Ciantus Orintores
rites.text: A trained warrior's technique that lets the practitioner unleash a loud, sudden cry to break an enemy's focus. It can be learned once a fighter reaches a certain stage of their growth.

rites.name: Amaunires
rites.text: A swift, deadly craft that a skilled wanderer learns after reaching a mid-tier rank of training. It replaces an older, brutal technique in the practitioner's repertoire.

rites.name: Teleornanum Sistarnia
rites.text: A tactic used by a scavenging trickster creature during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a skill that interrupts the rival's efforts.

rites.name: Ameosum
rites.text: A volatile flame-power drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dark spire of punishment. Those who harness it can unleash a sudden, violent burst of fire.

rites.name: Cisanum Riarnus
rites.text: A bright crystalline sorcery drawn from hidden reservoirs inside a cursed spire of ruin. Those who tap these deep vaults gain a fleeting surge of arcane force.

rites.name: Serostor Seornum
rites.text: A bygone craft that let a caster perceive the enchantments clinging to a foe, revealing hidden protective charms. The insight could be dispelled and stirred no suspicion in the watched creature.

rites.name: Seronternia
rites.text: A combat art a fighter learns to strip an opponent's hand weapons for a short span. It weakens foes' blows, and it bites harder against other fighters than against beasts.

rites.name: Vornanum Meollum
rites.text: A holder drags a carried possession out of the pack and releases it onto the open field. A prompt then offers to unmake the object, and once unmade it can never be recovered.

rites.name: Ralus Sontor
rites.text: A severed-hand sorcery drawn from hidden reliquaries of gathered essence. Its practitioners call upon detached spectral hands to grasp and hurl foes across a cursed tower of ruin.

rites.name: Telerontia
rites.text: A restorative art that delivers its full mending at once, in a single moment. It stands apart from slower renewals that trickle restoration over time, and it mirrors a strike that lands all its harm in one blow.

rites.name: Varnia Sauntia
rites.text: A companion's trained burst of speed that lets it sprint far faster for a short span. Another beast of a different breed can learn the same swift surge.

rites.name: Larnium Rellia
rites.text: A grasping power drawn from hoarded essence stores in a cursed spire of prisoners. It lets its wielder rend and pull at the insides of foes.

rites.name: Sereonum Valauntor
rites.text: A practiced guardian stance that a skilled fighter learns once they reach a seasoned rank. It softens every blow taken and turns aside incoming strikes of any kind, but the wielder cannot strike back while holding it.

rites.name: Orelloria
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a wielder consume the vitality of others. It is bound to a cluster of ember-born gifts that feed off destruction.

rites.name: Listaria
rites.text: A bound-chain craft taught to restless wardens, letting them seize a rival in a sealing snare that replaces their usual binding. Apprentices unlock it at different stages of their training.

rites.name: Mentes Seollia
rites.text: A stacking blessing that hardens a bearer's body and strengthens their strikes and mending. Each failed siege adds another layer, and the layers dissolve once the foe finally falls.

rites.name: Raulor Cirnum
rites.text: A trained skill that a thief can learn from a bound manual, letting them perceive small concealed beings. It is used to solve a hidden-object puzzle that yields a purse of coins.

rites.name: Sauniarium
rites.text: A tactic of the sworn guardians that lets a shield-bearer strike a foe with crushing force. It is learned once a fighter reaches a tenth rank of skill in the defensive discipline.

rites.name: Riases Rostum
rites.text: A tier five skill of the shadow-stealth discipline, taught only to those who have invested deeply in the craft of quiet deception. Its mastery demands a long and dedicated apprenticeship in that path.

rites.name: Carnanum Mintaunus
rites.text: A single sudden strike of harm that lands the moment a casting or power takes effect. It contrasts with harm that seeps in over repeated pulses, and workings combining both forms are called mixed workings.

rites.name: Valasia
rites.text: A sustained sacred chant that a healer channels to mend several allies at once. Those it reaches are then strengthened, healing more effectively for a short while.

rites.name: Valintes Valinterum
rites.text: A trainee's passive gifts awaken at set stages of growth, each one chosen by chance from the gifts not yet known. Once all are gathered, every path the student has learned shares them, and the gifts were eventually folded into the older skills.

rites.name: Cerium Oronteoria
rites.text: A permanent binding worked into wrist guards by a leather crafter, boosting the endurance of those who bear heavy front-line burdens. The gift holds only while the crafter keeps a high mastery of the trade.

rites.name: Rornanum Ciranum
rites.text: A companion's trained instinct lets its bond-holder strike twice in quick succession more often. Several beast kinds share this gift, yet a stronger form of rage in one lineage outdoes it.

rites.name: Ameollum Reollianium
rites.text: A glimmering layered cloak of captured spirit-light that can be worn as a power. Its essence is gathered from hidden stores found inside a dread spire of the cursed.

rites.name: Corenes Oraunestor
rites.text: A long-retired mastery of field bandaging, earned by a learner who reaches seven hundred points of practical healing skill. The honor no longer can be won by new hands today.

rites.name: Ciria Amanaustes
rites.text: A battle discipline that lets a fighter with a sworn guardian's training unleash a thunderous bellow. It is learned once the practitioner reaches a high rank in the fighting arts.

rites.name: Valenum Nalisium
rites.text: A cunning raider's technique that strikes a foe and then grants a fleeting surge, letting every quick attack instantly charge the fighter's gathered strikes. It stands as an either-or choice against a rival's rampage.

rites.name: Sirnaulia
rites.text: A permanent enchantment worked into arm guards by a crafter's trade, favoring those who cast spells. The bonus only lasts while the maker keeps a high level of skill in the craft.

rites.name: Ameorum Teolausum
rites.text: A gift that certain conjurers of the sustaining arts may choose from a branching path of talents. It works in tandem with a lifespan-extending practice and cannot be taken alongside it.

rites.name: Sialonus
rites.text: A battle technique where a combatant strikes twice in one turn, but the second blow only lands if the combatant is still weaker in vitality than the foe. When timed well, it can also tear away a protective barrier and deal harm in the same moment.

rites.name: Amaraustium
rites.text: A stacked set of ground-shaking charms that can be surrendered to forge a single card of tremors. The bundle is traded in exchange for that card.

rites.name: Amaurus Neontum
rites.text: A learned craft lets a practitioner hold two separate sets of abilities and swap between them. Each set bundles a chosen focus with its own arrangement of skills, charms, and quick-access slots. Practitioners use it to switch roles cheaply or to test new combinations freely.

rites.name: Taulus Nernalor
rites.text: A frost-caster's gift that shortens the chant of a cold bolt spell. Even when the chant is broken off partway, a brief hidden recharge still triggers.

rites.name: Neornia Rantus
rites.text: A lingering humming force drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden in a towering prison of the cursed. It clings to the mind and grants its bearer a strange, persistent power.

rites.name: Tiantus Seontiaror
rites.text: A charged gift that stirs within certain hunters of the wild spirits. It is said to be bound to war-stones of the clans, though it cannot currently be awakened.

rites.name: Sereoranum Malles
rites.text: A practiced discipline of drawing out restorative vitality, learned by monks at a certain stage of training. Adepts of certain schools gain a deeper mastery later, greatly strengthening its mending power.

rites.name: Leostor Veosenia
rites.text: A passive craft of the balance-keepers that grants a short surge when the same rite is repeated twice. The surge strengthens the rite's counterpart and shifts the nature of its force.

rites.name: Orastia Oraullistor
rites.text: A bound craft that lets a sworn champion of judgment reflect a lord's power back at them. It is tied to a companion ward that turns aside blows.

rites.name: Coristes Reonolium
rites.text: A quiet, unbroken pledge carried by Stormcallers of the old craft, it lifts the speed of their incantations and of any companions standing near them.

rites.name: Coriantus Sornor
rites.text: A dark inner force drawn from hidden stores found within a sunken spire of torment. Those who gather these reserves can awaken its sharp, spiteful power.

rites.name: Amastes Narum
rites.text: A rogue's borrowed technique tied to a sworn faction of celestial guardians. It can be taken up by any thief who swears to that faction and is granted only for a limited time through a special task.

rites.name: Vaunor Monanum
rites.text: A stored kind of inner-spirit force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a deep, dangerous tower. Those who gather it can bind it into their own power.

rites.name: Sostarum Nasellium
rites.text: A practitioner's gift that can be called upon at the height of their training. When invoked it quickens both their spellwork and their strikes for a brief span of twenty heartbeats.

rites.name: Telontium Veollastes
rites.text: A stalker's inherited gift that sharpens a wild beast-spirit's rage once the bearer has grown seasoned. It is not granted to every follower, and the deepest bearers may claim it only after long trials.

rites.name: Neollesanum
rites.text: A built-in safeguard that every clockwork-kin carry, restoring a fixed share of their vitality whenever they sink near collapse, much like a reflex that refuses to let a body die.

rites.name: Mernanum Molesanum
rites.text: A grim honor-gift granted to a wild shaper who has reached the highest rank of the guardian circle. It lets the holder strike back with brutal, unrestrained force.

rites.name: Valirnontor
rites.text: A stealth gift that a sneaking wanderer can gain once they have grown past a certain stage of their journey. It is not promised to everyone, and it arrives only after a later stage is reached.

rites.name: Cistium Sirnausanum
rites.text: A quiet inner knack that lets a sly shadow-walker regain spent vigor over time. It is taught to those who master the craft of stealthy deception once they reach a seasoned rank.

rites.name: Amilium Maurnus
rites.text: A fighting technique available to warriors that spins them into a stronger form of sweeping motion. It is granted only after a certain level of experience, and not always at the first opportunity.

rites.name: Ceorallanum
rites.text: A subtle quickening discipline that lets a blade's strikes gain force from the wielder's inner stillness. It runs in step with several related arts of cloaking, echoing, and final blows.

rites.name: Vaurnus Orelia
rites.text: A refined spell-craft that lets a caster hurl sharpened bolts of hidden force. It is granted to practitioners who have grown in skill, though it may not come until they reach a certain height of mastery.

rites.name: Saunteoria
rites.text: A passing gift once granted to certain casters, arriving early in their growth but not promised until much later. During trial testing it was swapped out for a different boon.

rites.name: Larnor Valenus
rites.text: A refined form of silent concealment that a rogue can awaken within a trained body. It becomes available early in a practitioner's advancement, though it is only reliably gained after considerable further growth.

rites.name: Sereornolia
rites.text: A hunter's technique that enhances a special shot so it can explode. It becomes available early in a warrior's training but is not guaranteed until later.

rites.name: Sereolanum Tirium
rites.text: A ranked gift granted to nature-attuned wielders, offering an enhanced way to restore life after a set point of growth. It is not promised until a later stage of advancement is reached.

rites.name: Niantium Maunes
rites.text: A permanent bonding of a magical boost onto a piece of gear, where only one such binding holds at a time and newer ones replace older. Layering wearable pieces that carry these bindings can grow stronger than any single item alone.

rites.name: Sernus Corones
rites.text: A hunter's gift granted to those who grow in skill and strength, first possible at a modest rank and reliably earned only once the bearer reaches a high mark of mastery.

rites.name: Riallus Raurnus
rites.text: A hybrid burning craft that strikes at once and then keeps smoldering on its target. Practitioners who master it find their initial blow doubled, though the method of wielding it stays the same.

rites.name: Amania Valinterium
rites.text: A passive gift granted to blood-sworn warriors who reach a certain rank of mastery. It becomes reliably theirs only after they have proven themselves further along the path.

rites.name: Meontum Meostus
rites.text: A reward granted to a summoner of dark magic once they reach a high rank of experience. It is not handed out automatically, and must be earned through persistent effort.

rites.name: Tontium Sereornes
rites.text: A small drifting cloud of pollen grants a traveler a modest surge of quickness. It is matched in strength by two other lesser charms, though a fierce beast's frenzy outpaces it for a brief moment.

rites.name: Ceosiarnus
rites.text: A tainted dark-craft practiced by sorcerers of a bleak frontier realm, sharpened over time as its wielders grow. It becomes a reliable gift once a practitioner has risen far enough in their studies.

rites.name: Riastus Raurus
rites.text: A dark practitioner's enhanced art of stealing vitality from foes. It is gained as a reward on the path to greater mastery, though its arrival is not assured until well along that path.

rites.name: Lesum Sauliaria
rites.text: A lasting inner glow that a Vellorn-trained caster can draw upon to sustain their healing and warding craft. It is passed down among practitioners of the disciplined arts.

rites.name: Oriallornus
rites.text: A craft that binds a lasting protective charge into a traveler's cloak, shielding its wearer from hidden magical forces. Only a practitioner of high skill can perform the binding.

rites.name: Liantanum Rirnus
rites.text: A dread-touched mental craft that a priest may gain once they reach a certain level of mastery. It is not promised to every practitioner until they advance further.

rites.name: Amauntor Tirniallum
rites.text: A keeper's gift of heightened storm-craft that a caster may claim once they have grown in strength, though its arrival is never certain until much later in their journey.

rites.name: Lostium Neonaulles
rites.text: A carved guardian bond granted to a warrior of the dead after a certain rank is reached, though it only manifests once a later rank is attained. It reinforces the bearer's stone-hewn defenses.

rites.name: Veles Molleror
rites.text: A dormant gift of lunar strength that a druid may come to hold as they grow. It is not promised to every practitioner, only earned by those who advance far enough along their path.

rites.name: Liasum Mosteoranum
rites.text: A tireless practice of a dark caster's craft that drains vitality from foes to sustain the caster. It was a reward that some practitioners could earn only after reaching a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Ameonia Tianteosium
rites.text: A guardian's enduring shape gains a steady rise in its inner vigor. The gift arrives late in a seeker's journey and is not always assured.

rites.name: Tirianor
rites.text: A practiced shape-shifting craft that lets a wild caster take on a sleek hunting form. It is granted as a reward once a practitioner reaches a certain level of mastery.

rites.name: Rirus Teoriasia
rites.text: A guardian ward that a healer of the sacred arts may come to wield, granted as a reward during a long path of growth. Its gift is not always assured to every follower who walks that path.

rites.name: Teornium Ameonor
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a caster's flame-based strikes hit harder, scaling with their gathered inner power. It also lets lingering burns restore the caster's reserve of energy.

rites.name: Telantor Orirneolles
rites.text: A fiery technique that lets a dark caster draw heat from their own life force to mend a bound companion whenever it is needed. It proves most useful during lone expeditions, when the companion is likely to be battered.

rites.name: Siastellium
rites.text: A practiced gesture of feeling that a figure performs through set signs, each one sending a spoken line and a visible motion to those nearby. Some such gestures lock a figure in a resting pose until it rises to fight.

rites.name: Corentonor
rites.text: A tended growth craft that strengthens the mending spells of a healer's circle. It is a deep skill that a practitioner must invest heavily in before it takes full effect.

rites.name: Ceontales
rites.text: A rare, sworn grudge-power that a wanderer may awaken early in their journey, though it only reliably answers once they have grown much further along the path.

rites.name: Oraulestium
rites.text: A passive healer's craft that a wanderer of the mountain orders may gain once they grow far along their path. It is not certain to be learned until later still, and it has since faded from use.

rites.name: Lastium Liastum
rites.text: A discipline of the duelist's path that sits at the middle tier of a fighter's training branch. It can only be fully mastered by a practitioner who has invested heavily in the combat arts.

rites.name: Amiasanum Sontinor
rites.text: A disciplined fighting technique that monks may gain as a rewarded enhancement once they reach a maturing level of skill. Its arrival is never certain, reflecting how hard-won it is.

rites.name: Mirum Sanus
rites.text: A innate knack passed through a small folk that lets them shape clever mechanisms with ease. Their kin are widely recognized for building such devices.

rites.name: Valianium Amanolles
rites.text: A bound-ice discipline that a sworn warrior of the frozen dead can awaken from a reward offered once they reach a higher rank. It suits the chill of its school yet fits poorly with the warrior's usual battlefield duty.

rites.name: Seriantium Amintum
rites.text: A bonded oath-craft that a sworn guardian may awaken after reaching a certain seasoned rank, though it is not promised to every guardian who reaches that level.

rites.name: Varestium
rites.text: A quiet, passive gift of the wild that lets a stalking traveler move unseen. It awakens early in a practitioner's growth but may not fully settle until later.

rites.name: Rostausanum
rites.text: A hunter's gift that lets a wanderer blend into surroundings more effectively. It becomes available early in a traveler's advancement, though it is not always granted until later.

rites.name: Amestaurnum Valiasum
rites.text: A learned discipline that strengthens a hunter's body and the health of the creature bonded to them. It belongs to a branch of tracking and beast-keeping practice.

rites.name: Nellor Valintus
rites.text: A late-acquired craft that lets a warrior channel flame through their blade. It can only be learned after mastering every other discipline of the order.

rites.name: Maullania
rites.text: A refined technique that lets a battle-mage's cleaving strike recover faster, so it can be unleashed more often and deal greater added harm to foes.

rites.name: Nernium Telasestia
rites.text: A grasping rite that a dark-warrior order may draw from its inner craft at a certain rank. It is granted to those who follow the blood-keeping path, though the gift comes only after long testing.

rites.name: Seonanum Valonistus
rites.text: A rare power held by a certain breed of hunter companion, letting its wielder draw on the beast's gifts. It belongs to the creatures' unusual lineage.

rites.name: Amostus Amines
rites.text: A bonded hellspawn may grant a warlock a stronger power, offered early in a practitioner's advance but only certain to arrive after a later stage of growth.

rites.name: Nelorium
rites.text: A mechanism that draws a chosen relic from hidden storage vaults and fastens it onto a wearer. It checks the deepest vault first, then the nearby satchels, and stops at the first exact match.

rites.name: Amilum Castores
rites.text: A tactic of the shapeshifting guardians of the wild that binds the claws of a beast-form warrior with living vines, granting a skill for hand-to-hand combat in the contests of rival clans.

rites.name: Nontor Veontum
rites.text: A tradesman's technique for kindling flame into heightened bursts, learned only after long practice. Its full mastery comes to those who persist through the later years of study.

rites.name: Corollia Carnanum
rites.text: A reserve of spiritual vitality drawn from sealed hoards found within a towering prison of the cursed. It is gathered by those who dare to carry lingering ancestral force out of dark places.

rites.name: Oriarum Seones
rites.text: A bound craft that lets certain war-trained avengers cut away the spiritual essence of their foes. It is a sharpened ability awakened within the chosen.

rites.name: Nilanum Cilium
rites.text: A harmful talent of the shadow-caster's dark path that boosts the chance of deadly strikes from lingering curses. Certain drain spells can also renew a curse's hold on a foe.

rites.name: Amaurnistus
rites.text: A recovering craft that is open to practitioners who follow the healing path. It lets them restore their strength in a way that other disciplines cannot.

rites.name: Meolianium Amollum
rites.text: A drawing-craft that pulls vital spirit from sealed reservoirs hidden within a grim, towering prison-fortress. Practitioners harvest these stored essences to empower their own abilities.

rites.name: Manum Valoreornes
rites.text: A channeling art used by ale-brewing wandering sages to slip past danger. It is said to be gained from a ravenous dragon in a crimson pit and from a banished queen of the dead.

rites.name: Lernianus
rites.text: A lingering blessing that spreads to all travelers in a northern land while a chosen band holds a certain stronghold. It sharpens learning, and within the stronghold, lesser spirits reliably leave behind shards of the five elements.

rites.name: Neostus Tisanum
rites.text: A joyful inner power that is gathered from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy within a dark, shifting tower. It is drawn out of stored essence caches found in the depths of that dangerous spire.

rites.name: Leornia Miareostor
rites.text: A grave-reaching craft that draws a practitioner's power into a single collapsing point. It cannot be taken alongside a certain gaze of endless sight.

rites.name: Lontisus Niases
rites.text: A minor discipline a warrior can learn from a guiding school. It grants a chance to return part of the harm suffered from sorcery back onto the caster.

rites.name: Rauria Corisanum
rites.text: A timed watching-force that presses against those who linger in a dreaded deep vault, nudging them to depart once danger swells. It renews itself each day, but a sealed oath can silence it entirely.

rites.name: Orauntanum Voles
rites.text: A zealous discipline taught to holy warriors of the vale, sharpening the strikes of their sentences against foes. It also quiets the attention their enemies pay them.

rites.name: Corintor Sirnor
rites.text: A quiet, constant gift of strength that a balance-minded caster draws from the wilds. It becomes available once the caster reaches the seventy-second rank of training.

rites.name: Virnallus
rites.text: A faint power drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence in a dreadful tower. It lets its wielder gather what remains of forgotten recollections.

rites.name: Amiallum Maulles
rites.text: A hidden reservoir of spirit-force can be drawn upon to unleash a sweeping arc of blades. Its power is gathered from deep vaults within a dreadful, ever-shifting spire.

rites.name: Lores Telastes
rites.text: A coordinated tactic that companion beasts use together during a contest between tamed creatures. It lets several of them act as one force.

rites.name: Saustonia
rites.text: A volatile technique that creatures of the Alemental kind call upon during contests of beasts. It lets them unleash a burst of violent force in the middle of a duel.

rites.name: Valentes Teleornus
rites.text: A latent craft that lets a summoner of dark bindings draw on hidden reserves of volatile energy. It is granted to practitioners who bind lesser spirits.

rites.name: Maleontia
rites.text: A tactic creatures use during a contest between companions, granting a protective layer that softens incoming blows. It lets many battling beasts shield themselves in the moment of conflict.

rites.name: Testia Amantum
rites.text: A stealth craft that lets its practitioner dissolve into darkness at the moment of a killing strike. It binds closely with related techniques of speed and of blood drawn from the slain.

rites.name: Lantaurnes
rites.text: A restless craving carried by a wandering bandit's trinket, bound to a set of sharpened blades and a marksman's luck. It sits tied to a few related curses that follow its bearer.

rites.name: Sausernum
rites.text: A dreaming power of the mind is gathered from hidden reservoirs within a dark spiraling tower of punishment. Those who draw it share its strength.

rites.name: Amisoranum
rites.text: A volatile charge that a binder's summoned servants draw upon to fuel their unnatural powers. It can only be stored to a fixed maximum and slowly gathers back over time.

rites.name: Nesonium
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that lets a shapeshifted hunter mend tainted spirits and calm them while wearing a hunting form.

rites.name: Corosor Telaunores
rites.text: A practiced trick of the cloaked hand that halves the harm of wide-spreading blasts for a short span of six heartbeats. It is taught to scouts who must slip through volleys.

rites.name: Seranauntus
rites.text: A hunter's talent that is chosen as one option among a limited pair of exclusive paths. Taking it locks out its rival choice, shaping how the hunter fights.

rites.name: Aminia Amosenor
rites.text: A caster repeatedly inflicts terror on a foe, pelting it with lingering harms while the frightened target stays unable to strike back. Resistances, charms, and nearby allies can break this cycle.

rites.name: Nisiaria
rites.text: A flickering power of inner vitality that is gathered from hidden reservoirs in a cursed spire. Those who draw upon it gain sight beyond ordinary distance.

rites.name: Lalor Saurnesor
rites.text: A glossy status blessing that settles on any wearer dressed in a particular undergarment. It marks the bearer as stylish and grants them a fleeting boost.

rites.name: Orolausum
rites.text: A passive aura lingers around a bound shadow beast, quietly easing the mana burden of allies who stand nearby. It is gained on its own once the beast grows wise enough.

rites.name: Valantus Renaurnes
rites.text: A discipline of inner endurance drawn from dark wellsprings, once practiced by a guild of ritual binders. Its training required a deep commitment in the guild's esoteric lore before it could be mastered.

rites.name: Reontus Canium
rites.text: A small servant creature bears a crackling hellish bolt that it hurls at foes. Its bolt is a basic power of the lesser demon it serves.

rites.name: Teloliarnus
rites.text: A flurry of wing-beats that companion beasts unleash during a contest between tamed creatures. It is a battle technique used by the pets that call the arena home.

rites.name: Nolliaria
rites.text: A dark craft in which a wielder draws strength from the vanished essence of fallen foes. It joins with two other edged rites, sharpening their bite and feeding their fury.

rites.name: Nallum Norus
rites.text: A hunter's skill that hurls a burning spear from a leaping strike. It stays ready for a short span until the wielder touches down again.

rites.name: Rarnum Cialium
rites.text: A tainting power that sours a beast during a contest of creatures. It is wielded by wild companions that refuse to be leashed.

rites.name: Viasanum Tinteorium
rites.text: A learned knack for craftspeople who work the waters, letting them see schools of swimmers marked in gold on a small map. It is gained by reading a sea-worn journal found in sealed chests or among drifting broken timbers.

rites.name: Serillum Sonastum
rites.text: A old racial knack that reveals hidden chests, provisions, and certain gathered trinkets as bright marks on a traveler's small map. It guides searchers toward scattered salvage needed for their errands, though it reveals little beyond chests in the far frozen lands.

rites.name: Toreontum Telastes
rites.text: A chill power drawn from hidden reservoirs of arcane essence, gathered within a dreadful tower of imprisonment. It is harvested from these stores to fuel a freezing force.

rites.name: Seraunia Orarnolia
rites.text: A steadfast inner discipline that a bound caster draws upon to hold firm against outside pressures. It works in tandem with several other lesser disciplines of the same craft.

rites.name: Testanum Sastia
rites.text: A fiery burst that a creature of the wilds can unleash during a contest between tamed companions. It is a technique used by many such beasts when they clash.

rites.name: Cialia Coronaustus
rites.text: A bound manual that, once read, lifts its reader's skill in tending wounds to a higher ceiling. It also teaches several preparation methods for healing dressings.

rites.name: Teliranum Sereonum
rites.text: A passive battle craft learned by fierce fighters at a high level of skill. Each successful close-quarters strike may quicken the wielder's blows, and that quickening holds three stored bursts.

rites.name: Taulus Telanum
rites.text: A closing technique that a trickster or beast-shifter can unleash only after building up a stored tally against a foe. The more of that tally gathered beforehand, the stronger and longer the strike lasts, after which the tally is wiped clean.

rites.name: Valaurastes
rites.text: A specialized talent path within the hunter's craft, offered as an exclusive choice that a chosen hunter may select. It is tied to the demonic branch of that same craft.

rites.name: Raullintia
rites.text: A fiery exhalation granted to certain companion beasts, which they unleash during contests of trained creatures to scorch their rivals.

rites.name: Naurnia Miasum
rites.text: A creature abandons its usual targets and pursues one chosen wanderer for a short span. The marked wanderer must flee and lead the pursuer in circles, and a visible sign of watching eyes hovers above the hunted one.

rites.name: Vernontor Valernanum
rites.text: A learned discipline of a sworn avenger's craft that shortens the wait between strikes and sometimes spares a fraction of sacred strength. It is chosen as an exclusive path alongside a related vow of fervor.

rites.name: Vorenus
rites.text: A shapeshifting craft that a practitioner learns only after mastering the art of mounted riding. It takes the form of a great dark bird, but it can only be used in skies where the open air is permitted and has been opened to travelers.

rites.name: Tentiallor
rites.text: A kindling craft known to the scorch-workers of a distant realm, granted to those who wield fire in destructive arts. It stirs a sudden blaze within the practitioner's own hands.

rites.name: Corastor Cernium
rites.text: A fiery breath technique that companion creatures unleash during contests of rival beasts. It scorches opponents and lets a tamed animal press its advantage in combat.

rites.name: Raurises Solum
rites.text: A chosen discipline for enhancement-minded spirit-callers, in which a sudden burst of heat ripples outward. It stands as a mutually exclusive option alongside a rival cold-weather technique.

rites.name: Amenia Orentor
rites.text: A tireless inner spark drawn from hidden reservoirs within deep towers of punishment. It grants a wielder their first tentative mastery over a raw, shimmering essence.

rites.name: Oreostelum
rites.text: A hunter's technique of setting off bright bursts of flame, learned from an instructional manual. It is taught through written pages rather than through apprenticeship.

rites.name: Meneontia
rites.text: A dark fire-craft practiced by a hooded order of spellweavers, who learn it upon reaching their greatest rank. It draws on the demonic arts that some sorcerers use to call the fallen back to life.

rites.name: Vintaustium
rites.text: A flaming mark that burns within a relic and answers the wounds its bearer has suffered. It draws strength from pain and feeds on stolen power.

rites.name: Rolium Amelia
rites.text: A flaring technique that companions can call upon during contests between creatures. It lets a tamed beast unleash sparks of searing force in the midst of a duel.

rites.name: Ameollor Naulia
rites.text: A crafted blast that sends every creature of the animal kind running away from whoever sets it off. It works on wild beasts and also on tamed companions, shapeshifters in animal form, and spirit-wolves.

rites.name: Lirnor
rites.text: A mage craft that lengthens the distance a caster's flame magic can travel, with each rank adding reach. It proves especially helpful for short-ranged fire blasts and other ember-based sorcery.

rites.name: Veolentor
rites.text: A tending discipline practiced by healers in contests of skill. It makes a sustained restorative bloom cheaper to maintain while strengthening the mending it delivers.

rites.name: Nirianus Serantiares
rites.text: A flowing life-force power that is drawn from hidden reservoirs sealed within a grim, towering prison-labyrinth.

rites.name: Tarium Soraullor
rites.text: A restorative trait granted to healer-monks who channel the mist. It draws on a hidden reservoir of vitality that can be tapped to mend allies.

rites.name: Seres Seraulor
rites.text: A practitioner's craft lets them take on alternate bodily modes that unlock certain powers and sharpen their skill. Several of these shapes, such as a crouch-hidden mode or a spectral mode, are invoked through a sequence of coded commands.

rites.name: Maustiarium Valeontia
rites.text: A banned seafaring chant that is handed down by a tavern keeper in a harbor town on a gulf coast. Sailors who learn it can pick it up from him.

rites.name: Molus Ciastia
rites.text: A recipe that teaches its reader how to imbue footwear with a gust that quickens the wearer's stride. It is sold by a supply officer once a traveler has earned sufficient standing with a band of horse-riding folk.

rites.name: Corausollor Cirontes
rites.text: A lingering restraint that settles on anyone who has already received a protective blessing, preventing that same shelter from being granted again until the restraint slowly wears away.

rites.name: Lesum Amaulerus
rites.text: A flowing power drawn from hidden reservoirs of raw essence buried in a cursed, forbidden tower. It is gathered from these stores and channeled into the wielder's craft.

rites.name: Rillor Taulisanum
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that channels shifting heat through the body, drawn from a rival path of spark-working. Mastery of this craft binds it to a companion discipline that delivers jolting sparks.

rites.name: Nesontus
rites.text: A mastered discipline of herb gathering that a practitioner earns only after perfecting every method of foraging from two distinct peoples. It marks full command of the wild green arts.

rites.name: Valianum Tentalor
rites.text: A demon hunter's gift that a warrior order grants to its initiates. It lets them feed a fallen foe's remains into an endless fire, and it lasts only while they remain in one trial of the order.

rites.name: Oristialum
rites.text: A learned craft of deliberate aim that a ranger gains at the highest rank of skill. It takes the place of two older techniques and quickly sharpens the archer's next strike.

rites.name: Seronus Sores
rites.text: A disciplined stance taught in the guild halls, letting a fighter spend less of their fury on every strike. Each step of training trims a little more from the cost of each attack, up to a set limit.

rites.name: Orianasor
rites.text: A marksman's discipline that steadies the archer's hand against being jolted while drawing a precise shot. It also sharpens aim so ranged strikes land more often, a gift especially prized by apprentices still learning their craft.

rites.name: Telistes Lornistia
rites.text: A bound ward-stone set at a fixed frontier strikes a wounded foe that is lured into its field. Only the ward may deliver the final blow, and that triumph unlocks a greater honor.

rites.name: Corestia Sinaurnia
rites.text: A tactic that lets a creature in a contest of beasts dart past its rival and strike from above. It is commonly used by many kinds of companion creatures during such clashes.

rites.name: Amiastirnus
rites.text: A chilling essence drawn from hidden stores of gathered spirit-energy within a dreadful spiral keep. It grants a bearer the power to shatter and freeze.

rites.name: Valeostor Seosum
rites.text: A combat technique drawn from the rage-path of a fighter's training. Each ordinary blow has a chance to mark the enemy, dampening the restorative magics that try to mend them.

rites.name: Corolus Coreolium
rites.text: A chilling storm-craft that binds a cold wind into the grasp of certain frost-touched warriors. It is granted to those who wield the deathly cold of the ice arts.

rites.name: Telilaunor
rites.text: A bent illusion-snare that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence. Its weakening drawback can be undone by fitting a hardened housing around it.

rites.name: Oriles Serillosor
rites.text: A chill-bearing inner power that is gathered from hidden reserves within a grim, towering prison-fortress. Those who draw it are able to harness its cold energy.

rites.name: Valines Teosia
rites.text: A wild pack-cry that a beast-companion lets loose to swell the strength of its bonded tracker for a short span. Hunters who chase the sharpest output often insist on bringing such beasts along.

rites.name: Amostarum
rites.text: A craftsman's permanent charm worked into wrist guards, lent only by artisans of one trade, that raises the wearer's resistance to flame.

rites.name: Nirniallus
rites.text: A practitioner's ward-craft that strengthens frost-based protective charms by up to half again. Each rank grants a chance that an incoming elemental blow is swallowed and its force turned into restorative energy for the caster.

rites.name: Mianauria
rites.text: A learned talent that grants a blazing sphere a chill of glacial power. It can be ranked twice, and each rank reshapes the sphere in a different way.

rites.name: Moralles
rites.text: A hunter's craft that splits a foe's resolve along old hidden lines. It can only be taken as an either-or path alongside a rival blade-rage technique.

rites.name: Neollesia
rites.text: A chilling vow of the cold-bound warriors, granted only to those who have mastered the highest rank of their discipline. It sharpens the bearer's inner stillness against the frozen dead.

rites.name: Corilanum Ciasaurium
rites.text: A rage-fueled power that a dark-arts practitioner of the demonic path could have unlocked at the highest tier of mastery by choosing a volatile source of energy. It was never granted in practice.

rites.name: Amalor Orosum
rites.text: A ritual gift that a keeper of balance may call forth once a preparatory rite has been performed. Its calling in turn awakens a second, subsequent rite.

rites.name: Sorum Telanes
rites.text: A passage-bound craft that lets wandering fighters draw on a storm-spirit's rage. It is a trait sealed into the skill-lore of a disciplined warrior sect.

rites.name: Valernium Valentianum
rites.text: A soul-borne power drawn from hidden reserves kept in a towering prison-spire of the cursed. It grants its bearer a supply of spiritual essence gathered by sealed stores.

rites.name: Corestoria Veollaunor
rites.text: A lawless trait carried by certain cursed relics, binding them to a hollow spectral casing. It is tied to a pair of kindred traits that govern fate and avarice.

rites.name: Ameosirnia
rites.text: A passive blessing that doubles the standing a wanderer earns with a noble house and raises the chance of finding rare relics. It activates for everyone during set periods and remains until its keepers withdraw it.

rites.name: Lelorium
rites.text: A grim spectral power drawn from stored essence hidden in a dark, cursed spire. Its reserves are gathered from sealed vaults within that tower.

rites.name: Valenanum Ceorium
rites.text: A method that gathers several results and hands them back in a chosen sequence, useful when one call yields many outputs. Some practitioners doubt how efficient it truly is.

rites.name: Montus Valeontaror
rites.text: A chattering psychic force drawn from hoarded soul-essence stored in a dark, ruined spire. Its caches hold the power, which can be drawn out and used by those who find them.

rites.name: Amenirus
rites.text: A jet of pressurized water burst that certain tamed creatures unleash during contests of companion creatures. It is a tactic used in those contests by many different beasts.

rites.name: Leosus Seostonanum
rites.text: A woven sigil crafted by scribes who study inked patterns. It is discovered through a research trade and grants its bearer a restorative sign that mends companions quickly.

rites.name: Amastium Ninelor
rites.text: A carved sigil worn by spellcasters that lengthens how far a caster leaps when using a sudden teleporting step. It adds a little extra distance to every leap.

rites.name: Cenolles
rites.text: A bark-sealed sap-power is drawn from hidden reservoirs buried in a dark, towering prison-keep. Those who tap the reserves gain a steady inner flow of vital energy.

rites.name: Seriles Oristum
rites.text: A ward-mark that lets a caster store a small surge of celestial power whenever they use certain binding, storm, or roaring spells outside a dark-sky phase.

rites.name: Liaranes
rites.text: A carved sigil that pairs well with a second lunar mark, strengthening the steady harm it inflicts over time.

rites.name: Tarnelia
rites.text: A carved sigil that alters how quickly a fighter can unleash a ground-shaking blast. Once a shield-bearer learns the blast's technique, the sigil shortens the wait before it can be used again.

rites.name: Riastornum
rites.text: A carved sigil that makes a sickness-binding rite renew its hold on the first victim before passing the ailment onward. The renewal spares a practitioner the cost of two ritual marks, letting them invoke one more strike.

rites.name: Valestia Serisaulum
rites.text: A faint radiance gathered from a sacred ore that is drawn into the wielder's craft. It belongs to the holy healers who serve the order of light.

rites.name: Nernus Tolum
rites.text: A chilling sickness that spreads from one bearer to another through frost. It is a craft once available to those who wield cold-bound death magic.

rites.name: Lianauntus Sernanes
rites.text: A carved sigil that lets its bearer, while gliding, sprout worn and ragged brown wings. It belongs to the hunters of shadow-beasts.

rites.name: Larostia
rites.text: A carved sigil that a trained duelist of the sword-and-shadow guild may inscribe onto their gear. It grants a skilled fighter a special ability in close combat.

rites.name: Lastum Serausia
rites.text: A small inscribed mark that a spellcaster can attach to a duplicating charm, so the reflections it conjures cast a different bolt of force depending on the caster's chosen discipline.

rites.name: Narnium Laliantes
rites.text: A carved mark made with a trade-guild ink that permanently alters a water spirit's summoning rite, turning it into a freer, wilder form that serves only as an ornament.

rites.name: Oreonollus
rites.text: A battle-born gift that any fighter may awaken within their armor. It is found only in armor pieces recovered from distant hard-fought lands, from sieges, or from contests between rival warbands.

rites.name: Valanosium Reollanum
rites.text: A carved ward of the star-tenders that widens the reach of a falling-light rite, letting its wielder strike every foe within the circle at once.

rites.name: Sestor Mialeorus
rites.text: A mark that grants certain grim warriors the ability to bend the dead to their will. It is automatically learned by warriors who reach a certain level of mastery.

rites.name: Rialus Amaurum
rites.text: A carved mark that makes hostile creatures glow with a sickly green hue when its bearer uses a heightened seeing gift. It lets hunters spot their foes at a glance.

rites.name: Melleornus
rites.text: A borrowed spirit-power that is gathered from hidden reserves within a cursed tower. It lets its wielder take on the appetite and form of a voracious devourer.

rites.name: Tolum Malles
rites.text: A tactic that companion beasts employ during contests of creature combat. It lets them seize and hold an opponent's position to gain an edge.

rites.name: Corosus Amillor
rites.text: A stored vital force that is drawn from hidden reserves within a labyrinthine tower of punishment. Those who find these reserves gain a lasting power from them.

rites.name: Nallium Amiantum
rites.text: A gilded token of vital force is drawn from hidden reserves kept within a towering prison of the cursed. Its essence grants the bearer a flowing, inner power.

rites.name: Telus Oroles
rites.text: A wild, frenzied technique that a creature unleashes during a contest between tamed companions. It drives the user into an unpredictable rage that can turn the tide of a match.

rites.name: Testanum Telausanor
rites.text: A mental craft drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence, gathered within a towering prison of the cursed. Its practitioners tap it to channel raw soul-power for their own ends.

rites.name: Oreontus Lintanum
rites.text: A dormant spiritual force that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs buried within a dark, labyrinthine tower of punishment. Its stored energy grants the one who claims it a lasting power.

rites.name: Seriaranum Leontus
rites.text: A quiet inner craft that wind-readers gain once they reach full mastery. It lends swiftness and keen skill to companions who travel and fight alongside the practitioner.

rites.name: Liastus Reonum
rites.text: A stored spark of inner force that is gathered from hidden reserves in a cursed spire. Those who unlock it gain a new capacity drawn from the lessons of a master.

rites.name: Oriallum Ventaranum
rites.text: A craft that binds lasting force into a pair of hand coverings, making the wearer's grip and lifting power greater. Only a skilled artisan at a high level of practice can perform the binding.

rites.name: Amistollia
rites.text: A lasting charm worked into a traveler's mantle that sharpens the wearer's aim for decisive blows, adding a fixed measure of precision to every strike.

rites.name: Corilum Moniranum
rites.text: A bonded companion's endurance is enhanced by a talent that raises its vitality by a fixed percentage. The talent is no longer available in this world.

rites.name: Centes Vaunum
rites.text: A glowing charm a caster shapes through a practiced incantation. It can be used to restore a wounded companion's vitality in the midst of battle.

rites.name: Sereores Nilanes
rites.text: A craft taught by a brewer-scholar in a sunlit city, used to make soil lift and rise in glowing bloom. It is practiced as an alchemical art.

rites.name: Tasirnanum
rites.text: A savage tooth-technique used by river hunting beasts that weakens a wounded creature's ability to mend. It cuts the healing it receives by half.

rites.name: Cinia Sosenum
rites.text: A sacred flame-power that is drawn from hidden reserves kept within a towering, cursed prison. It gives its bearer a spark of spiritual energy.

rites.name: Telosentum
rites.text: A fighter's technique that opens a wound in an enemy which deepens each time the foe moves. Repeated movement stacks the bleeding, up to three layers, and renews its lasting time.

rites.name: Veoroles
rites.text: A hidden store of gathered spirit-energy can be drawn upon to grant a rule-breaking power. It is found only within a towering prison of the cursed.

rites.name: Coronelium
rites.text: A innate knack passed down among a hardy mountain folk, sharpening the aim of their projectile-launching devices. It grants a slight boost to landing devastating shots.

rites.name: Orillium Amerirnium
rites.text: A withering gift of slow ruin is drawn into the hands of grim death-wardens. It is one of the marked boons that those who serve the dark rites may hold.

rites.name: Collium Lasiales
rites.text: A stored blessing that strengthens a sacred binding rite. It is sometimes cited as a refinement that makes the rite more potent.

rites.name: Telalus Valirnia
rites.text: A healer's craft that softens the wariness foes feel toward every mending spell cast. It also grants a chance that the practitioner's protective enchantments will hold firm against attempts to strip them away.

rites.name: Vornaustes
rites.text: A gifted sorcerous art taught to practitioners who follow two particular disciplines once they reach a certain mastery. It lets them gather a vital essence from their surroundings.

rites.name: Risiastia
rites.text: A talent for hunters that sits on the eighth tier of the marksmanship path. Taking it closes off the alternative lighter option, so a hunter must choose one.

rites.name: Toreolia Orestum
rites.text: A reaping craft drawn from hoarded stores of spirit essence within a cursed tower. It lets its wielder gather the dark vitality that lingers in those vaults.

rites.name: Veornelles
rites.text: A ruinous craft wielded by a dark practitioner of destructive arts. It stands as a mutually exclusive path opposing another dire discipline of chaos.

rites.name: Seraurnia Coraunum
rites.text: A dark enchantment that can be attached to a fallen warrior's gear. It is available only to those who serve the undead hosts of the grave.

rites.name: Amintium Tiaror
rites.text: A refined trick of stealth-craft that sharpens a practitioner's perception once they have devoted a large share of their training to shadowed arts. It draws on a wide foundation of discipline before it can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Tirnium Rolliarnus
rites.text: A lingering sorrow that falls at random on a person offering a tender token to a stranger during the Feast of Hearts. Another person can lift it by offering a braided cord that was never given away.

rites.name: Orantium Orollor
rites.text: A dangerous inner power is gained by drawing on hoarded soul-essence stored in a cursed, towering prison-spire. Its wielders bind their spirit to the stored essence to unlock it.

rites.name: Telianteria
rites.text: A regional blessing granted to the force that holds all three contested strongholds of the marshland. Whoever seizes every outpost at once gains a strengthening boon across the whole territory.

rites.name: Ronestus Seolles
rites.text: A slow mending power that does not restore a wounded body at once but knits it back in steady pulses over time. It can be drawn from salves, wraps, rations, or charms, and it fades quickly like a passing blessing.

rites.name: Lantia Serolles
rites.text: A companion's fallen body can be called back to life by its keeper once it has died. The revival does not trigger by itself and must be deliberately invoked through a ready command.

rites.name: Amistus Amariania
rites.text: A guild-granted rite that gathers every companion in a traveling band to the caller's position at once. It is unlocked when a guild reaches its twenty-first rank.

rites.name: Risum Meontus
rites.text: A mournful tonal call that creatures use within a contest between tamed companions. It unsettles the opposing beast during the bout.

rites.name: Taureostor
rites.text: A trained gift of the wing-casters, granted by a single choice that pairs it with a sweeping strike. It cannot be held alongside its paired rival.

rites.name: Sirus Tauses
rites.text: A seasoned fighter springs toward a chosen foe, and the landing shakes the ground, striking every opposing figure nearby. Among shield-bearers, the leap also resets a taunting cry, letting the fighter draw attention again at once.

rites.name: Serallanum Valenes
rites.text: A quiet inborn bearing that lets a people stand firm against ruin. It steadily sharpens the body and the mind of everyone who carries it.

rites.name: Valisus Causanum
rites.text: A fighter's instant melee blow that strikes with raw force. It shares a short recharge with a sweeping arc, and is used to spend surplus fury when it would otherwise go to waste.

rites.name: Orilleostes
rites.text: A battle discipline that clears binding snares from its user and resets a charging lunge, allowing the lunge to be repeated again and again in quick succession. It can also free a fighter whose feet have been pinned in place.

rites.name: Sirus Malleontes
rites.text: A basic gift of the lower ranks of a sacred caste that sharpens the odds of a healer's blessed rites landing with extra force. It is an early skill that drew on the holy circle's inner discipline.

rites.name: Cornes Oriles
rites.text: A blessing that a guardian gains while holding a sacred waypoint against attackers. While defending such a site, the guardian earns greater renown from each foe felled.

rites.name: Ameontornor
rites.text: A guild blessing that raises how many merit points members collect. The first grade appears at a modest guild rank, and a stronger grade unlocks later as the guild grows.

rites.name: Coriallus Telerum
rites.text: A tribal spirit-caster who teaches apprentice shamans within a crystal chamber in a floating city. Her lineage is marked as broken and set apart from the rest of her people.

rites.name: Telisum Niareostus
rites.text: A hollowed-out drawing of spirit energy that can be gathered from sealed reliquaries deep within a dreaded spiraling prison. It grants its bearer a surge of drawn-out vitality.

rites.name: Valialostes
rites.text: A stored spirit-force drawn from hidden reservoirs in a cursed spire. It lets its wielder call on power gathered from those sealed vaults.

rites.name: Tialeror Sereostanum
rites.text: A borrowed spark of soul-essence drawn from hidden stores kept within a towering prison of the cursed. It grants its bearer a surge of power for those who seek it out.

rites.name: Reosus Telaustum
rites.text: A hidden allowance that extends how far attacks and spells can reach a large creature. Its bulk lets fighters strike from a greater distance than its visible body would suggest.

rites.name: Tines Lises
rites.text: A fiery essence is drawn from hidden reserves kept within a dark, towering prison. It grants its bearer a surge of power.

rites.name: Amines Colistes
rites.text: A hunter's bag-craft that draws stored essence from hidden reserves sealed within a dreadful tower of ruin. It lets its bearer gather and carry that gathered power forward.

rites.name: Valostia Tasium
rites.text: A chill-woven shield craft that only frost-attuned casters can learn, granted to them without effort. Casters of other elemental schools instead command their own distinct protective weavings.

rites.name: Liales Valornia
rites.text: A role that lets a bearer shift between guarding allies, mending wounds, and striking foes. Its flexibility depends on the gear the bearer has gathered for each duty.

rites.name: Neornia Velanum
rites.text: A frost-craft strike that wounds lightly but hits three times harder on a target locked in ice. When cast, it releases all the gathered shards to fly at the same foe, though a deeper ice technique cancels this effect.

rites.name: Misum Amalor
rites.text: Travelers who cannot brave dangerous roads pay a skilled spellcaster to open a gateway to a distant capital. The arrangement costs coin and skips the chance to gather route waypoints along the way.

rites.name: Sirnium Tostum
rites.text: A creature's trick in a contest between tamed beasts, where it lunges forward and strikes with its head. Several kinds of companion beast use this technique during duels.

rites.name: Viasenia
rites.text: A stored wellspring of hunting spirit is drawn from sealed reserves hidden within a dread spire of ruin. Those who gather it gain a power tied to the chase.

rites.name: Saunternus
rites.text: A chilling technique that a tamed companion draws on during a contest of creatures, sealing its rival within a frozen resting place.

rites.name: Vianum Corium
rites.text: A glyph-bound discipline that lets a wielder of cold, death-tinged craft draw strength from the blade they carry. It is learned only after a long apprenticeship in the mortuary arts.

rites.name: Valianirnum
rites.text: A caster sings a sacred chant that gently refills the reserves of nearby allies in need. The singer must keep chanting, and those who heal are always favored first.

rites.name: Valaulanum Telaulenus
rites.text: A hard-won craft of the stalking arts, passed down in fragments and drawn from sealed reserves found within a grim, climbing ruin. It bends the wielder's will toward a single prey.

rites.name: Coreosanum Ventus
rites.text: A high-rank discipline taught only to wind-walking monks, letting a practitioner unleash a whirling barrage of blows. It is reserved for those who have reached the upper tier of their order.

rites.name: Orialia
rites.text: A hunter's craft that lets a practitioner slip past pursuers by choosing it instead of a rival rite. It cannot be held alongside the Roar of Sacrifice.

rites.name: Teores Tarus
rites.text: A cold, deathly aura that a practitioner of frost-bound death magic can call upon to unsettle foes. It is learned at a high tier of the discipline.

rites.name: Narintes
rites.text: A minor sorcerer's discipline that deepens the blight of a lingering hex. It belongs to the practices of the dark-binding caste.

rites.name: Valosum Vantes
rites.text: A frost-tier discipline that a practitioner learns early, required before advancing a deeper branch of cold techniques. It sharpens a chilling strike and strengthens the lingering slow it leaves, making guardians more effective at drawing and holding foes.

rites.name: Launtum Larnontia
rites.text: A discipline of guarding that a devoted warrior can cultivate, strengthening the protective aura they radiate and deepening the restoring warmth that flows through every blessing they keep active.

rites.name: Valolaustum
rites.text: A bonded fire-core that a dark caster may draw upon for greater power. It is granted to those who have grown in skill, though not always right away.

rites.name: Serarnum Serestornum
rites.text: A keeper's gift of swifter growth that arrives in the later years of training, once a rival mark gave way to it. It was briefly swapped out for another rite soon afterward.

rites.name: Amernor Coraulanum
rites.text: A calm face-shaped trait that any wanderer of the realm can carry. It is a lasting mark gained through deep, weathered resource-sources.

rites.name: Taseria
rites.text: A hardiness quality that lets a hunter's bound relic endure punishment without breaking. It belongs to the vengeance-bearing hunters who wield these relics in the war against lesser fiends.

rites.name: Amirnium Cillum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner siphon more value from drawn essence while lessening the notice their workings draw from wary onlookers.

rites.name: Sauneornia
rites.text: A gifted skill of demon hunting, chosen as an exclusive branch alongside another hunter's talent. It lets a hunter take one path or the other, never both.

rites.name: Coralum Laurnilor
rites.text: A tier seven craft of the grove-keepers that sharpens a caster's strikes and makes a marked foe easier to harm. Its benefit to hitting accuracy lets practitioners wear different gear than they otherwise would.

rites.name: Vantiastium
rites.text: A refined technique of slipping past blows that a fighter can master after investing considerable practice in the close-combat discipline. It sits midway along the path of a warrior's training.

rites.name: Amernum Cornor
rites.text: A minor ember-binding gift that a dark caster may receive once they reach a certain stage of their growth. It is not promised until a later, higher stage is reached.

rites.name: Castium Rastia
rites.text: A caster calls a bound flame-beast from a sealed stone, and the creature burns the area around it for a short time before fading. Its searing aura shatters hold on the bearer and foes alike, making it a useful lure for distracted enemies.

rites.name: Orelorum Corones
rites.text: A refined talent of stealth found within a sly shadow discipline, reached only after a lengthy investment of training. Its mastery demands deep commitment to the quiet arts.

rites.name: Sausanum Nillor
rites.text: A practitioner's protective barrier that drinks in incoming harm and returns it as a surge of arcane reserve. While the barrier is ready, the caster's restoration of that reserve and the potency of their spells both grow.

rites.name: Niasor Vastirnum
rites.text: A minor cunning technique taught among street swindlers, it lengthens the sway of a closing flourish so that its effect lingers longer on the one who performs it.

rites.name: Oreornia Serialles
rites.text: A minor inherited craft that binds a hunter's awareness to a set of relic-marks. It is tied to two related inner forces that feed its strength.

rites.name: Seria Saurniallus
rites.text: A trained technique of a stealthy blade-user that heightens the force of a finishing strike. It belongs to the first rank of an assassin's discipline.

rites.name: Telianium Mornus
rites.text: A refined toxin brewed from serpent glands that a hunter may gain as a lasting craft, though its arrival is uncertain until the hunter reaches a late stage of training.

rites.name: Corentum Vantor
rites.text: A bonded trait that any kind of wanderer can awaken within their armor. It is gathered from relics recovered in three ancient sunken ruins.

rites.name: Villes Renallanum
rites.text: A rare blessing that a mage may receive once they reach a certain standing in the craft. It is not promised to every practitioner, since it comes only after a long apprenticeship.

rites.name: Coreonaurum
rites.text: A dark art taught to sorcerers that deepens the slow suffering a hex inflicts on its victim. It was once a standard practice of the wielders of forbidden pacts.

rites.name: Loses Rolus
rites.text: A fighter's learned talent that sharpens a sudden, untamed blow. It can be gained early in a warrior's training, though it is only reliably granted at a later stage.

rites.name: Viastes Amintes
rites.text: A grim gift of the death-bound warriors, granted early and surely only later in their rise. It sharpens their harvest of fallen foes.

rites.name: Sintus Vistus
rites.text: A discipline practiced by brawny monks who grow steadier as they advance. It is a reward that arrives only once a student has reached a certain stage of their training.

rites.name: Nostum Lialum
rites.text: A stored spirit-force gathered from hidden reserves within a grim tower of torment. It grants the wielder a heavy, unyielding footfall that resists being shoved aside.

rites.name: Neornosia
rites.text: A grave-bound art of seizing foes that a warrior may learn early, though it is only surely gained after further training. It enhances the seizing power of those who study it.

rites.name: Tisus Valeres
rites.text: A bodily craft practiced by wild shapers, sharpening the body's ability to knit its wounds when it is driven into fury. It is granted as a reward to those who have grown in skill, though the gift is not always assured.

rites.name: Voristes
rites.text: A cunning practice taught among thieves that lengthens the stunning strike of a sneak fighter and makes it cheaper to perform. It is found along the middle path of a fighter's training.

rites.name: Saulium Orineolor
rites.text: A bold fighting discipline that a warrior may gain as a lasting boon, granted once they reach a seasoned stage of their journey. Its arrival is never fully promised.

rites.name: Ceornum Lines
rites.text: A passive craft that boosts the bleeding harm a wound-inflicting strike deals, applying automatically whenever that strike is used. It needs no prerequisites, making it an inexpensive addition for fighters who rely on sustained wounding.

rites.name: Reollor Tirnollum
rites.text: A mental discipline taught among caster-scholars that shortens the recovery time of a sudden psychic shriek, letting the practitioner unleash it again sooner.

rites.name: Corausor Orostesia
rites.text: A fighter's sworn gift that sharpens a warrior's end-of-battle fate. It comes to a seasoned blade-bearer only after a long road of trials.

rites.name: Tontanum Centeornia
rites.text: A refined discipline of a living guardian shape that hardens its protective shell and lets its restorative power swell while the shape holds. The gain applies only to mending, not to striking.

rites.name: Seriarnus Ameror
rites.text: A grim gift granted to dark-blooded warriors who serve the death arts. It becomes available early on the path, though it is only assured later in the journey.

rites.name: Telantia Mistolia
rites.text: A discipline of the Redthorn path that a practitioner could fully master after investing a set amount of training. It was later stripped from the craft in an official revision.

rites.name: Costaulles
rites.text: A keeper of the grove briefly takes the shape of an ancient living sapling, gaining steadier mending of wounds, thicker hide, and protection from being transformed by enemies. The change lasts half a minute and must be chosen instead of a rival rite.

rites.name: Telerirnus
rites.text: A caster's trained skill that lowers how much reserve energy a protective barrier drains each time it blocks a blow. It matters most to those who raise such barriers often in fierce duels.

rites.name: Rolus Amernus
rites.text: A defensive discipline a guardian may take at a high rank of training, chosen in opposition to a rival discipline that cannot be held alongside it.

rites.name: Miastum Tialenum
rites.text: A dark mental discipline that a practitioner invests in deeply. When a sharp, lethal strike lands, it renews the caster's inner vitality and reserves of power.

rites.name: Velum Leorernes
rites.text: A refined mental stilling art that a warrior order can gain once they reach a mid-tier rank, though full mastery is only assured at the highest rank.

rites.name: Solor Amauntanum
rites.text: This craft lowers the strength cost of a finishing strike, letting a warrior deliver several such blows in one clash. Leftover strength is turned into extra force, so each blow hits harder.

rites.name: Corollus Monteoranum
rites.text: A minor battle technique once taught to frontline fighters, drawing enemy attention toward a guardian. It was later removed from the discipline's teachings.

rites.name: Maunteornum Viallinum
rites.text: A brief binding that locks a being in place so it cannot move or act. The hold shatters the moment it takes harm, and it is harder to escape than a simple daze.

rites.name: Valeoses Corines
rites.text: A tempered discipline that lessens the fury needed for a ground-shaking shockwave, making its blow heavier and slowing the foes it strikes.

rites.name: Amillium Mostus
rites.text: A tiered craft of the moon-keepers that deepens the glow of a silver flame, making its strikes more likely to burn hard and to bite deeper once mastered.

rites.name: Tolanum Teornanum
