rites.text: A learned craft of the fire-sorcerers that sharpens the chance of a searing blow landing with extra force against a foe already weakened below a quarter of its vitality.

rites.name: Velor Marium
rites.text: A refined marksman's technique that a hunter could learn once their skill grew, though it only came to them after considerable training. It sharpened the precision of a carefully aimed strike.

rites.name: Amaunia Taunia
rites.text: A stored fiery force that a practitioner of the healing or storm arts can draw upon. It is bound into a relic-like inscription found on the wielder's gear.

rites.name: Mornum Telesanum
rites.text: A tactical art learned in the middle ranks of a warrior's discipline, allowing a quick strike to briefly seal an opponent's ability to cast. It is feared by spellcasters in duels between rival guilds.

rites.name: Maunor Raullus
rites.text: A tier four talent from a shadow-craft tree of the Quillen order that deepened wounds made by quiet strikes. Mastering it demanded eighteen points invested in the craft's stealth branch.

rites.name: Telornaulum
rites.text: A learned discipline that lessens the lingering pause after a burst of raw sorcery and makes the blast draw less notice from foes.

rites.name: Seralintor
rites.text: A refined sorcerous discipline that stuns a transformed creature for a brief moment whenever it is harmed while in its altered shape.

rites.name: Nianium Solles
rites.text: A learned gift of the dark arts, taught among sorcerers of the fel-touched schools. It grows a practitioner's hold over summoned servants when mastered at the third rung of the demonic path.

rites.name: Telentum Lirus
rites.text: A tiered skill in the balance discipline that sharpens a caster's bolts of light when a venom-mark and a blight-glow are set upon the foe. Its power grows with each rank invested.

rites.name: Molliarnus
rites.text: A discipline a dark caster may take in place of a rival rite. Choosing it closes off the other option, binding the caster to one path of ruinous craft.

rites.name: Orauntanum Cilernia
rites.text: A tiered discipline of the bow-wielding guild, practiced along one branch of its marksman lore. It sharpens the volleys of a skilled archer.

rites.name: Oreoniantus
rites.text: A grim technique for war-scarred warriors of the dead, honed in later training. It is gained as a reward once a fighter reaches a high rank, though the reward is never certain.

rites.name: Orallium Amaustium
rites.text: A nimble rogue's skill that sometimes shakes off hindering effects on the body whenever a burst of hurried movement is called forth. It belongs to the combat discipline.

rites.name: Toraulles Teliasum
rites.text: A learned chill that a caster can weave into a storm of ice, causing every creature caught within to move sluggishly for a brief moment. It proves especially useful when many foes must be hindered at once.

rites.name: Valaunus Risauntor
rites.text: A refined hex-craft practiced by sorcerers, granting a stronger and more volatile curse that is not reliably learned until a practitioner has advanced far along the path.

rites.name: Tausium Veonostanum
rites.text: A practiced craft that a caster can gain as a refinement, arriving at a certain stage of growth but only assured once the caster has advanced much further along the path.

rites.name: Collia Riasirnia
rites.text: A mage's rite of cold-burning magic that a practitioner may gain as their skill matures. It is not certain to be granted until the mage reaches a high rank.

rites.name: Amostantum
rites.text: A cold, withering touch channeled by grim death-wardens that deals a modest frost strike and leaves a lingering chill upon the victim. Its real purpose is spreading that lasting frost rather than dealing heavy harm.

rites.name: Telistor Amirum
rites.text: A passive craft that strengthens the swift strikes granted by a wind-charged carved idol. It deepens the quickening of blows each time the practitioner invests in it.

rites.name: Amintaules
rites.text: A ward that lets a being shrug off an incoming force entirely, including its lingering burdens. Strong seals can still tear it away, and some bindings wrap a foe without harming it.

rites.name: Telenoles
rites.text: A flame-wreathing craft practiced by a shadow-binding sorcerer while in their transformed state. It can only be drawn upon during that altered form.

rites.name: Valinternor
rites.text: A practiced craft of the fire-workers that sharpens the searing bolt, so that the heat it leaves behind burns more fiercely. Its old method has since been dropped from the guild's teachings.

rites.name: Ceolor Valoria
rites.text: A dark oath sworn by spellcasters of one shadowy brotherhood, granting a grim power to those who bind themselves to it. It remains available briefly to those following a particular trial of loyalty.

rites.name: Cistus Oriallus
rites.text: A reinforced guard technique taught to fighters, granted to those who reach a certain level of training. It sharpens the defensive stance of a warrior who has earned it.

rites.name: Leolaunor Neornia
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by wilderness trackers who have mastered a venomous strike. It grants them a sharpened skill with serpent-like poison once they reach a seasoned rank.

rites.name: Nantiallor
rites.text: A stacked discipline of renewal that lets a practitioner return sooner after a rebirth ritual. Those who return are left with far more vitality and reserve energy afterward.

rites.name: Teornor Tolleonus
rites.text: A fiery surge of inner vital force that can be drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dreaded tower of punishment. It grants its wielder a burning power.

rites.name: Sauntanum Amausinia
rites.text: A learned craft of the frost discipline that shortens the chant of a cold bolt. Each step of training trims a little time from the spell until the caster can loose it nearly at once.

rites.name: Rornes Ameoranum
rites.text: A refined technique of endurance drawn from frost and grave-cold magic, learned by those who have reached a high tier of training. It lets a warrior of the cold dead harden their body against harm.

rites.name: Orosor Leostausor
rites.text: A refined flame-casting technique taught to fire adepts as a reward for their growing skill. It is not always granted, appearing only after a practitioner has advanced far enough along the path of mastery.

rites.name: Vasolus
rites.text: A battle-craft that a fighter may gain as a learned gift once they reach a certain level of experience. Its arrival is not certain, since the gift only comes to those who have advanced far enough.

rites.name: Orauntus Ventium
rites.text: A guardian's craft that sharpens a defender's shielding, becoming available to devoted wardens at an early stage of their training and assured only at a later one.

rites.name: Valeosium Seollia
rites.text: A discipline taught to cloistered caster-acolytes that sharpens a lingering curse of sorrow, making its hidden harm bite a little deeper with each stage of training.

rites.name: Valaurisus Orausum
rites.text: A deep discipline of stealthy strikes taught within a shadowy craft. Mastering it demands a long devotion to the art of concealment.

rites.name: Sauntum Oraria
rites.text: A rite-talent granted to a set of caster specialists once they reach a high tier of advancement. It lets those who master arcane and elemental arts draw more power from their craft.

rites.name: Canelum
rites.text: A lingering swarm of stinging spirits that gnaws at a target over a short span of time, dealing harm of the wild green kind. Caster-wielders of the balanced arts rely on it, alongside a flame-bright cousin, to deal a great share of their damage during battles.

rites.name: Naustor Vianes
rites.text: A battle-born talent that lets fighters of the warrior sort wear an unsettling bearing. It is carried by the armored combatants of a far-off realm.

rites.name: Tirnium Siasirum
rites.text: A hardening craft that certain tamed beasts draw upon while locked in a contest of champions. It turns their hide briefly into armor that blunts incoming strikes.

rites.name: Ventiastes
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter who stands ready in a fierce, reckless posture lunges across the field to seize a fleeing foe, closing the gap as swiftly as a charge.

rites.name: Vauneolanum
rites.text: A quiet inner drive that a trained beast-keeper gains as they grow in skill, lending steady strength to the bond with their companion creatures. It is granted at a certain stage of mastery.

rites.name: Canornia Sorilia
rites.text: A disruption that halts a caster mid-incantation, slowing or stopping the spell. It arises either from being struck during the chant or from a specific skill that breaks the working.

rites.name: Ameollum Teonor
rites.text: A glowing inner force that is gathered from hidden reserves within a deep, cursed spire. Its stored essence can be drawn out and used to strengthen a wielder's abilities.

rites.name: Venillus Teostus
rites.text: A learned hunter's technique that lets the practitioner frighten a creature into losing its focus for a moment. It is chosen as an exclusive option alongside a volatile snare device.

rites.name: Valintoria
rites.text: A mastery attained by a practitioner who has memorized two hundred preparations of the hearth. It marks a cook's long devotion to recipes learned by heart.

rites.name: Saulia Valialanum
rites.text: A mystic gift of the seeing craft, chosen as one of two mutually exclusive paths. It can only be taken alongside a bond to a spirit that keeps guard over the caster's soul.

rites.name: Taunus Riastanum
rites.text: A mental sight that certain tamed companions draw upon during a contest of beasts, granting them a quickened awareness of their rivals.

rites.name: Lenum Oriases
rites.text: A stirring chant that creatures sing during a contest of tamed beasts, lifting the spirits of their companions. It is a craft passed among the handlers who train animals for such struggles.

rites.name: Selaustium
rites.text: A learned discipline of inner fury that quickens the restoration of a fighter's battle-stances. Practitioners grow sharper and more fierce through it, gaining greater strikes and a steadier flow of wrath.

rites.name: Amianesor Niarium
rites.text: A protective green shield that a guardian raises during a contest between bonded creatures. It keeps the defender safe while the battle plays out.

rites.name: Amestor Telus
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a sworn caster's binding rites quicken their pace and steady their inner reserves. The blessing holds for a short span after each rite.

rites.name: Lantus Seristantor
rites.text: A tactic in which small companion creatures harden their hide during a contest of beasts. The shell turns a glossy green and absorbs part of the blows they receive.

rites.name: Oraurnum Vestiarus
rites.text: A learned discipline of measured guarding that lets a sworn warrior weigh each blow before answering it. Its practitioners are said to favor careful restraint over reckless charges.

rites.name: Mirus Orilles
rites.text: A rarely spoken tongue shared by the beings of the elemental realm, with several branches tied to fire, water, earth, and air. Few outsiders learn it, and some fierce warrior bands adapt its fiery branch to command raw elemental force.

rites.name: Amariastia
rites.text: A paired hunter's art that lets a trained beast-bond strike with lethal force. Choosing it closes off a rival fang-technique taught alongside it.

rites.name: Oreonus Cestollor
rites.text: A hunter's gift that grows stronger with each successive slaying. It is taught within the beast-tamer's discipline of cultivated skill.

rites.name: Meosum Corastanum
rites.text: A coldness-bound craft that a practitioner of the frozen arts can draw upon. It belongs to a specialized order of cold-touched warriors who wield the chill as a personal gift.

rites.name: Telintes Serostor
rites.text: A forceful shove that lifts a foe off the ground and hurls them backward, though riders stay in their saddles. Once prized and rarely granted, it was held mostly by great beasts and guardians before becoming a power anyone could wield.

rites.name: Lostantia
rites.text: A bonded companion skill that lets a fighter in ranked duels draw strength from a loyal creature. It is unlocked once a warrior reaches a sixtieth tier of training.

rites.name: Coresiales
rites.text: A hunter's craft trait tied to precise shooting. It links with two other trait marks, one for healing shells and one for guiding strikes.

rites.name: Corostia Valauristus
rites.text: A dormant frost-bound quality that lies quietly within certain cold-wielding warriors and stirs when their chosen craft is called upon.

rites.name: Vianellor
rites.text: A passive shaping art practiced by beast-kin wardens that raises the chance of lethal strikes for their companions. It works only while the warden takes a beast shape, so it suits those who spend much time fighting in the field.

rites.name: Riastenanum
rites.text: A clinging seed-tactic that a tamed companion uses in a contest of creatures. It drains the strength of its opponent and passes that vigor back to the caster.

rites.name: Ronanum Amialeranum
rites.text: A hidden path of teaching that guides a seeker toward kindling a sought-after inventive spark. Its later form lets the student advance without enforced pauses between steps.

rites.name: Viastum Tales
rites.text: A temporary charge gained by touching a bounding engine in a smoldering pit. It sometimes lets a traveler's next several leaps be strengthened, allowing a second lift while airborne.

rites.name: Tarnia Telosilanum
rites.text: A craft in which gloves are permanently charged with enchantment so that the wearer can survey ground and ruins more quickly. It is valued by those who study the remains of older peoples.

rites.name: Lonor Valisanum
rites.text: A former skill of the wilderness hunter that lets a practiced fighter open deep wounds with a close-quarters blade. It was taken out of the craft in a later revision of the rules.

rites.name: Seraureosum
rites.text: A siphoning craft that creatures of the trade-wilds use mid-contest. It lets its wielders draw strength from opponents, and it is shared by several kinds of crawling and winged beasts.

rites.name: Rausia Rontor
rites.text: A craft held by those who mend and display every relic of two rival peoples until each one is returned to its original perfect state. Practitioners earn it as a mark of skill.

rites.name: Corisia Nornum
rites.text: A dark inherited craft that binds a practitioner's will to a chosen power. It is tied to the hands of its wielder and to a steadfast mind.

rites.name: Amernosia
rites.text: A glowing essence called a spirit-power is gathered from hidden reservoirs within a cursed, towering prison. Those who draw it can channel it into a bright, blade-like force.

rites.name: Valausium Siniaror
rites.text: A marksman's craft in which a hunter chooses between two quiver techniques, one favoring swift and lightweight arrows. The two options cannot be held at the same time.

rites.name: Laureostes
rites.text: A practiced art of the storm-channelers that quickens their crackling bolts and forked chains, letting them unleash lightning sooner with each step of training taken.

rites.name: Amenteosum
rites.text: A quiet craft that rises within a relic when three hidden seals are unbound together. It answers to no lineage and cannot be bound to any other gift.

rites.name: Serostor Taullanum
rites.text: A binding craft that permanently sharpens a great blade held in both hands, granting it a small added measure of adaptability in battle.

rites.name: Cirallum
rites.text: A practice that a gatherer may take up once their standing with a small hidden folk reaches a set high rank. It opens only after a long bond is built with one particular companion of that folk.

rites.name: Miasus Morelium
rites.text: A mark of prowess is granted to those who keep a particular companion creature bound to them. It recognizes a feat of raw strength earned through this bond.

rites.name: Molum Reostellum
rites.text: A dark rite that lets a bearer of death-bound craft bind a restless spectral presence to their side. It is unlocked at a high tier of mastery.

rites.name: Tauralium
rites.text: A glowing craft that a battle-trained guardian can learn at a certain stage of growth. It belongs to the warriors who defend and punish in close combat against rival fighters.

rites.name: Riallor Centirum
rites.text: A heavy inner force that a wanderer can draw from hidden reserves sealed within a dark spiral tower of punishment. It grants the bearer a slow, ponderous, stone-footed bulk.

rites.name: Orollus Seraurium
rites.text: A small communal step performed by a swarm of marsh-folk while they contest a rival in a friendly trial of pets. It is used as a tactic to unsettle the opposing side.

rites.name: Oreosoranum
rites.text: A bond measured within a tamed beast that decides whether it remains beside its handler or wanders away. It rises and falls with the creature's contentment, so a new companion must be cared for right after it is claimed.

rites.name: Amoria Ceostentor
rites.text: A guardian's trained skill that quickens their running whenever they call down a sentence of judgment. It helps them close distance on rivals and keep pace during long chases.

rites.name: Corerus Amillum
rites.text: A learned knack for shapeshifters that quickens their wild gait during contests between rival bands. It keeps their pace from ever dropping beneath a steady baseline, even when hindered by binding snares.

rites.name: Seraures Oreostium
rites.text: A coined command that halts a caster's ongoing incantation. It is typed with optional modifiers to abort the spell in progress.

rites.name: Narnes Oreostilus
rites.text: A chosen mender who tends every member of a traveling band, and in great battles watches over the front-line guardian above all others. Many kinds of healers can take up this charge when properly equipped and trained.

rites.name: Seroseonium
rites.text: A weakened state that leaves a afflicted being taking a little extra harm from sorcery. It is inflicted by poisons, cursed elemental wards, and fiery or storm-charged breath, and it also worsens any lingering sorcery-fueled wounds already upon them.

rites.name: Mintanum Lantinum
rites.text: A binding craft that bars a chosen person from a shared gathering-place until its current cycle ends. The barred person cannot return until the cycle resets.

rites.name: Lanor Orantanum
rites.text: A role where one sturdy defender draws the fiercest foes onto himself, shielding allies so they can fight without being struck down. Several different forms of this duty exist depending on the situation.

rites.name: Menes Tastus
rites.text: A bound summons that calls a chosen wanderer into a shared gathering-stream. The caller speaks the gathering's name and the wanderer's name to draw them in.

rites.name: Veosanum Tauria
rites.text: A learned discipline of the sworn warriors of the grave that deepens their ward against sorcery. When fully mastered, the ward swallows every spell-born blow that strikes its bearer.

rites.name: Sentarnia
rites.text: A practiced caster's craft that sharpens two kinds of channeled spells, making their bolstering and warding effects stronger and their reach longer. It is often learned as a stepping stone toward deeper arts.

rites.name: Oreollia Nauntus
rites.text: A command that rouses a tamed companion into a fierce stance, sending it to strike nearby foes without any further instruction from its keeper.

rites.name: Oreontium Millostium
rites.text: A bound seal that stops a chosen wanderer from voicing words or inscribing messages in any shared hall of speech. The binding is set by naming the hall and the silenced one.

rites.name: Orasor Cisaullor
rites.text: A caster wraps a self-woven barrier that drinks in incoming harm, spending a reserve of inner essence for each blow taken. The ward gutters out once it has swallowed its limit or after a short span passes.

rites.name: Ronia Nalles
rites.text: A tiered art of the hunter's wilds that lets each ranged strike sometimes sharpen the wielder's aim for a short span of moments. It is taught among the advanced disciplines of survival.

rites.name: Viallum Orellium
rites.text: A ward that a keeper calls upon a companion beast to cast, lifting binding effects that hold it and an ally in place. If no willing ally is chosen, the caster receives the ward instead.

rites.name: Valauranum Masia
rites.text: A mystical power of spiritual essence drawn from hidden stores found within a dreadful, cursed spire. It is gathered from concealed reserves kept in the tower's depths.

rites.name: Corialirium
rites.text: A bound summoner's craft in which a sharp strike from the familiar replenishes the caster's inner reserve. The same drawing of life also refills a portion of that reserve into the familiar.

rites.name: Telaustinum
rites.text: A hidden inner trait that a certain kind of grim warrior-priest can awaken through a precious ore. It grants them a strengthened vital essence drawn from deep within the bone-marrow.

rites.name: Coriallor Caunolum
rites.text: A passive discipline taught to archers who strike from afar. Its strength grows as the practitioner's attuned inner gift is sharpened.

rites.name: Valosium Telialanum
rites.text: A practiced gift held by summoners who bind otherworldly servants. It strengthens the harm those bound servants inflict in battle, and its growth rises with the wielder's inner attunement.

rites.name: Castum Seroria
rites.text: A hidden art of the shadow-walkers that sharpens a wielder's strikes while they remain unseen, and lingers for a few heartbeats after concealment is lost.

rites.name: Sallonium
rites.text: A lingering kindling that a fire-caster draws from their flame strikes. It clings to struck foes and keeps them smoldering with extra harm for a short span afterward, growing more potent as the caster hones their skill.

rites.name: Orellium Valeosontes
rites.text: A permanent engraved sigil that a skilled artisan carves onto a warrior's shoulder pieces. It is made only through the scribe's craft, and it grants lasting enhancement to the wearer.

rites.name: Rerium Valolia
rites.text: A practiced hunter's craft in which a chosen quarry is branded as doomed, so that the archer's shots find it more readily. Mastery is earned through long dedication to the marksman's discipline.

rites.name: Sasum Caraunanum
rites.text: A lingering brand laid upon those who fall while locked in combat with a colossal foe. Anyone bearing it perishes at a touch of that foe's reach, yet their gear remains unharmed.

rites.name: Tasia Siasaurnum
rites.text: A tiered skill of the archer's discipline that sharpens precise ranged shooting. It sits high within the marksman's path of training.

rites.name: Laurus Riasania
rites.text: A learned discipline in which a caster reclaims part of the energy spent on a spell whenever that spell strikes its foes with a surging blow. Empowered area incantations benefit as well, so the practice steadily lowers the total cost of casting.

rites.name: Cestes Coreoles
rites.text: A volatile craft of unruly power that wielders of destruction draw upon, its strength rising as their keen instinct grows. It is the discipline by which ruin-casters channel their most erratic force.

rites.name: Lialinus Linaustum
rites.text: A distinction granted to healers who have mastered the restorative arts of tending wounds. It is recorded as a lasting mark of accomplishment earned through long practice.

rites.name: Vilor Veontellus
rites.text: A ruinous craft that a sorcerer may learn to channel wrecking force. It joins with three other arcane gifts: one hardening the body, one feeding on vitality, and one kindling infernal fire.

rites.name: Vases Oraullus
rites.text: A discipline of keeping living things intact, practiced by those who draw on preservation magic. Its strength grows as a practitioner's mastery rises.

rites.name: Seolirum Valentanum
rites.text: A guardian's gift that makes each restorative touch also raise a protective ward on the mended one. Repeated wards stack, though their combined strength is capped at a third of the caster's vitality.

rites.name: Colia Vaunirum
rites.text: A refined skill practiced by holy guardians, strengthened by a secondary attribute that deepens their radiant craft. It grows stronger as the wielder's inner aptitude is honed.

rites.name: Villeostium Seriarnium
rites.text: A bonded hunter's gift that strengthens the creatures companioning them in the wild. The sharper the hunter's inner attunement grows, the harder their animal allies strike.

rites.name: Corerum Oriarnia
rites.text: A practitioner's discipline in which a caster's striking force grows with the reserve of arcane energy held within them. Gaining its full benefit requires careful husbanding of that reserve.

rites.name: Reostontus Orasistor
rites.text: A dread-aura craft practiced by wielders who have sworn to unmake their foes. It awakens once the practitioner reaches a tenth rank of training, and its strength grows with the practitioner's inner resonance.

rites.name: Valantesium Cialarnus
rites.text: A learned discipline that sharpens a practitioner's control over the flow of hours, shortening the wait before a slowing ritual can be cast again. When that ritual ends on its own, it also restores a swift-stepping evasion so it can be used once more.

rites.name: Valaulores Amianus
rites.text: A discipline of the blood path that a warrior of the dead can draw upon. It is set in the ninth tier of the crimson branch of learning.

rites.name: Telases Maserus
rites.text: A hard-won inner stillness that a seeker gains after finishing every contemplation trial set by a guiding teacher in a royal hall of learning. Those who attain it become one with their calm.

rites.name: Veollus Reonoria
rites.text: A stone-falling technique that a range of tamed companions can call upon during contests of beasts. It brings a burning rock crashing down upon the rival.

rites.name: Losanum Coreontor
rites.text: A practitioner's trained discipline that raises the force of their sorcery in proportion to their mental keenness. The gain grows with each level of study, and gear, charms, and other learned skills all feed into it.

rites.name: Riallarnus
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by enhancers of the storm-path, converting raw battle strength into arcane force while blocking other sources of magical power. It lowers the cost of quick rites and lightning, and sometimes returns a little reserve energy after melee blows.

rites.name: Listum Visia
rites.text: A caster's trained talent lets them seize a living foe for a short span and turn it against its former allies. Most creatures fall to it, though some guardians and bound beasts resist entirely.

rites.name: Serintes Telialeonia
rites.text: A bond that a hired fighter accepts when taking up arms for a rival faction. It grants a lasting boost to the one who swears it while serving in a sworn-sellsword campaign.

rites.name: Sereontium Sentum
rites.text: A passive inner discipline lets a healer's reserves refill from quiet focus even amid battle. It awakens automatically in those who take up the mending path, and a sibling practice among monks works the same way.

rites.name: Telernanum Laustiaror
rites.text: A linked arrangement of charged stones that wakes a hidden bonus once enough matching stones are present across one's gear. Stones that carry several hues can stand in for any of them, and a bearer may sacrifice a fitting's own stone to complete the lattice.

rites.name: Saurnum Cauranum
rites.text: A caster's quick, forceful strike that hurls a burst of mental force at a foe after a brief pause. Practitioners of the shadowed arts gain a dark fervor from its use, while devotees of light trade it for a flame-based strike later on.

rites.name: Caullor Oreontia
rites.text: A discipline taught within a branch of lunar-aligned practice, mastered through a set investment of training. Its mastery quietly lowers the energy spent when casting its linked rites.

rites.name: Noneollus Leontales
rites.text: A mist-linked craft that drifting artisans of the highland monks can call upon. It is available only to those who weave fog and breath together.

rites.name: Mornus Tolisus
rites.text: A ward-craft that shortens the recharge of a protective barrier by a moment. When the barrier fully absorbs a blow, it unleashes a rush of swiftness for the caster.

rites.name: Reontarnium
rites.text: A hidden trap technique that companion beasts use during a contest between tamed creatures. It lays unseen hazards across the battle ground to wear down opponents.

rites.name: Nernium Liror
rites.text: A mental power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy kept in a forbidding tower of punishment. It lets its wielder unleash a violent burst that overwhelms the mind.

rites.name: Ventanum Tasiallia
rites.text: A learned craft lets a hunter pass the watchful gaze of enemies onto an ally for a short span. The strain of being noticed shifts away from the hunter toward a companion chosen beforehand.

rites.name: Coriarus Seonernia
rites.text: A quiet inner tide that a dark-robed caster can call upon without effort, granting a lasting boost to their mind once they have grown sufficiently practiced in the old disciplines.

rites.name: Naneoles
rites.text: A tuned spark of inner force that a bearer draws from sealed reservoirs hidden in a dark tower of punishment. It is refined from stored essence and granted as a power.

rites.name: Tarnum Vaunalus
rites.text: A quiet gift of mercy that bonds to those who heal others. It is granted to devoted healers who walk the sacred path of light.

rites.name: Taurnes Serinanum
rites.text: A craftsman's practice of studying carved marks to uncover a new minor sigil. Each day the study can be repeated, and success comes often regardless of how practiced the student is.

rites.name: Mernauranum Corisus
rites.text: A fighter's strike that hits with a weapon and draws an enemy's attention, compelling it to turn and assault the one who struck it for a short while.

rites.name: Serauntanum Varus
rites.text: A mental craft practiced by shadow-minded adepts, it takes the place of a conjured wraith-servant. Its user draws on the dark arts of the mind to fight in the wraith's stead.

rites.name: Telosus Raurosum
rites.text: A lunar-attuned gift that a caster of the wild arts may learn once they reach a modest level of skill. It is meant for contests between rival practitioners.

rites.name: Rorises
rites.text: A dark practice that lets a caster's sustained attacks leave a lingering weakness, so the target takes more harm from magic. Allies also find their spells strike more reliably against the marked foe.

rites.name: Mellium Talaurum
rites.text: A deadly blow favored by sword-masters of the iron guilds, it strikes hard and leaves the victim's wounds sealed against mending. Warriors rely on it as a core technique in their fighting repertoire.

rites.name: Valeosia Siallarus
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that settles onto the artisan who stitches a lunar mantle. It grants a temporary boost to the crafter who completes such a garment.

rites.name: Caurus Tiarnilus
rites.text: A mortal binding that a caster can choose instead of a rival spell, sharing its place in a fixed set of choices. It is a learned craft tied to a fear-inducing cry.

rites.name: Viasania
rites.text: A tier-two skill of the hidden blade path that a rogue can deepen with seven points spent in the assassin's discipline. It has since been stripped from the craft.

rites.name: Seostor Meseornium
rites.text: A starting trial in a druid's trade lets an apprentice earn a swift winged shape, once riding skill has been mastered. Completing the chain grants a commemorative mark, though the shape itself can be learned later from a trainer.

rites.name: Teleornus Soria
rites.text: A trained skill of the archer's discipline that enlarges the extra harm dealt by a precise, sharply struck arrow. It leaves the chance of landing such a blow untouched and serves as a required step toward a later technique.

rites.name: Orantium Cilleonor
rites.text: A shared band-wide blessing that quickens riders on their beasts while they travel the open lands, though it lapses within the sealed contest-grounds.

rites.name: Telarnes Moseones
rites.text: A stored reserve of spirit energy that can be drawn from hidden hoards deep within a dreadful spiral tower. It grants a power that lets its wielder bring down towering peaks.

rites.name: Ciantollium
rites.text: A learned skill that lets a practitioner change form at a lower cost of inner energy. It must be mastered before a deeper form-changing discipline can be taken up.

rites.name: Nolentum
rites.text: A hunter's exclusive talent that can be chosen alongside a companion instinct. It shapes how a practitioner moves through the dark.

rites.name: Mellares
rites.text: A quiet hardening craft that a dark-arts practitioner gains once they reach a high standing in their studies. It works continuously in the background, layering protective shielding over the caster without any deliberate activation.

rites.name: Veonor Coriasum
rites.text: A three-tier craft of the grove-healers that can be refined through thirty steps of training. It was removed from the practice of the restoration circle in a later reform.

rites.name: Meollor Linus
rites.text: A guardian technique that turns a shadow barrier into a broader shield, soaking up every kind of magical harm. It only works while the caster is wrapped in a particular infernal or fel-touched armor.

rites.name: Niantor Ceseonia
rites.text: A living skill that small chirping insects use when they clash in contests between tamed companions. It lets them draw on the surrounding growth to strengthen their side of the bout.

rites.name: Serauntus Ameonterum
rites.text: A rotting toxin drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored life-essence deep within a cursed spire. It is wielded as a spiritual power that corrupts and decays whatever it touches.

rites.name: Norium Oreoles
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that a practitioner gains only after long years of study. It draws on hidden reserves of unseen force and works without any deliberate act.

rites.name: Naunium Rintium
rites.text: A dim, pulsing force that only a certain kind of winged creature can draw upon and direct. It is one of the innate gifts granted to that lineage alone.

rites.name: Amintes Nalestes
rites.text: A seafaring discipline earned by gathering a large store of practice alongside one's wave-bound companions. It marks a sailor who has trained long beside allied crews.

rites.name: Voria Reorilum
rites.text: A quiet inner habit that lets a caster turn swift incantation into a steady replenishing of their reserves. It also draws more power back from the arcane workings they perform.

rites.name: Tollisus Neorontia
rites.text: A trainable craft that a practitioner can learn at a set stage of growth and advance to a maximum level of mastery. It unlocks a collection of specialized inscribed techniques.

rites.name: Cellasus
rites.text: A bound set of written workings that teaches how to tame a crackling storm-force into a steady, usable flow. It was once meant as a reward for finishing a long craft-trial.

rites.name: Neostor Villor
rites.text: A readied guard that settles over a bearer when a blunted practice blade is taken up. Striking another with it leaves the foe briefly stunned and dazed.

rites.name: Tirum Serontia
rites.text: A slow-acting toxin favored by sneaking practitioners, it dulls a victim's hand and mind, stretching the time needed to weave magic and slowing their strikes. A concentrated dose sharpens the effect further, and the craft forces the user to choose between this tincture and a wasting variant.

rites.name: Ameostium Amoraustum
rites.text: A lingering enchantment granted to crafters who weave a magical cloth. It is an effect that stays with the artisan after the working is finished.

rites.name: Amilestanum
rites.text: A tainted surge drawn from hidden reserves that hoards the bitter essence. It lends its bearer three layered stacks of a corrosive virulence.

rites.name: Meostia Corastium
rites.text: A bright, fleeting power that is drawn from hidden stores within a dread tower. Stronger versions of it can be gathered in several layers at once.

rites.name: Cenontor
rites.text: A stored spark of channeled essence drawn from hidden reservoirs in a ruined spire. It grants its bearer two layers of a fleeting, borrowed force.

rites.name: Tiales Nelum
rites.text: A tide of gathered gusts that can be drawn from hidden stores within a dreadful spiral tower. Each draw gives the bearer three layered charges of the storm.

rites.name: Vausenor
rites.text: A hidden wellspring of inner force, drawn from sealed reservoirs buried in a dreadful tower. Those who tap it gain a surge of arcane energy.

rites.name: Veontanum Veneostus
rites.text: A fragment of soul-power that is drawn from sealed reliquary hoards within a towering prison-spire. It grants its bearer a modest surge of inner energy.

rites.name: Cialonum
rites.text: A stagger afflicts a warrior-keeper whenever they swap their blade mid-battle. For a short while, the enchantments etched into their gear fall silent and give no aid.

rites.name: Milleosor
rites.text: A fading inner talent carried by a wandering fighter-scholar of the brew hills. It binds together two related gifts that flow alongside it.

rites.name: Corium Amosium
rites.text: A dark tincture drawn from sealed reliquaries in a cursed spire, granting its bearer two layers of corrosive potency. Each layer strengthens the wielder's toxic reach.

rites.name: Amellia Nollium
rites.text: A bound reserve of stored force drawn from sealed vaults deep within a dread spire. It grants its bearer a doubled measure of resilience.

rites.name: Nantiastes
rites.text: A tripled surge of ancient spite drawn from hidden reliquary hoards deep within a cursed spire. Each charge grants the bearer three jagged thorns of stored force.

rites.name: Corialus Corenanum
rites.text: A bought-and-sold surge of spiked force that is drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence. Stronger versions of this surge can be layered several times over.

rites.name: Aminus Veolasium
rites.text: A glimmering power drawn from hidden reserves within a deep, cursed tower. It grants its bearer three layered charges of arcane force.

rites.name: Telauria Valaurnenus
rites.text: A stored surge of inner resilience drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dark tower. It grants the bearer three layers of endurance that build upon one another.

rites.name: Vastes Orostiantus
rites.text: A trait of the ancient rune-lore that can be awakened in the wind-disciplined fighters who train in the mountain monasteries.

rites.name: Talium Vilanum
rites.text: A bound instruction tome for three glowing restoration spheres that mend a bearer's body and mind when they stand within them. Once learned, the codex grants access to these three spheres.

rites.name: Nonialium
rites.text: A bonded trait of the hunter's craft that can be claimed by those who train beasts. It marks a wilder companion as the leader of its kind.

rites.name: Valeontor Siantaurus
rites.text: A shadow-craft technique that quickens a practitioner's inner vigor while they remain hidden. Only those who have devoted deep study to the stealthy arts can learn it.

rites.name: Sestialanum
rites.text: A toxin technique that a tamed companion uses during a contest of creatures, dulling the opponent's limbs so it cannot act.

rites.name: Naurania
rites.text: A healer's restoring power pours past what a wounded ally needs, spending mana and effort on mending that adds nothing. A little excess is expected, but a lot wastes resources that matter only when they are scarce.

rites.name: Oreosanum Cilliarnus
rites.text: A life-force craft gathered from hidden reserves within a dreadful spiraling tower. It lets its wielder call up rapid, unruly green growth.

rites.name: Amornia Valosanum
rites.text: A craft of carving marks that a practitioner may begin learning at a certain stage of life. It grows through set levels of mastery and grants access to a list of specific techniques.

rites.name: Raulia Meoria
rites.text: A companion creature begins to strike out at a foe under its keeper's command. The moment it lunges is announced to all who watch the field.

rites.name: Saulia Oriniantes
rites.text: A passive craft once known to the mages of the high tower, granted to practitioners who reach their ninetieth year of study. It was later removed and became a common rule for all practitioners, letting lingering enchantments be renewed early.

rites.name: Ciarnes Melus
rites.text: A frost-touched battle gift that surges beyond ordinary limits in a wielder of death-bound craft. It is bound to two related inner traits that deepen the cold within.

rites.name: Nolles Sontestor
rites.text: A skilled thief's technique that delivers a substance causing the limbs to stop obeying. Practitioners unlock it once they reach a high tier of training in the shadowy arts.

rites.name: Veostanum Rostausanum
rites.text: A bound power of the spirit-essence that is drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dreadful tower. It can be claimed by those who seek the stored essence of the dead.

rites.name: Vianelor
rites.text: A glowing enchantment that spreads outward through the wielder's healing craft. It is available only to a sacred caretaker class of practitioners.

rites.name: Vesia Valostes
rites.text: A scented projectile technique used by a swift-footed trader's companion during a contest of beasts. It strikes an opponent with a drifting fragrance.

rites.name: Ameonus Amones
rites.text: A lasting spark of stolen spirit-force that can be drawn from hidden stores kept within a dread spire of the condemned. It grants its bearer a sustained surge of arcane power.

rites.name: Teollor Valentor
rites.text: A small creature can rouse its own spirits in the midst of a contest. The stirring is a trick shared by many beasts in such combats.

rites.name: Oreontastor
rites.text: A living craft in which creatures draw strength from light during a contest of beasts. It lets a combatant replenish its vigor while it stands in the sun.

rites.name: Amaules Sarnes
rites.text: A tamed companion gains one of three training disciplines, each suited to a different battle role. Its strikes grow stronger in proportion to its own fighting strength or its arcane power.

rites.name: Carnellia
rites.text: A mage can open a shared gateway for the companions nearby, but where it leads depends on which of two shifting states the surrounding land is held in. A seer who stands on a hill can alter that state.

rites.name: Launtum Sialenium
rites.text: A set of practical casting arts lets a caster and companions step through a shimmering doorway to any of several fixed sites, including allied seats of power. Each such art is taught by a dedicated instructor found in busy urban centers, often beside the tutors of general sorcery.

rites.name: Valaurnires
rites.text: A stored essence power drawn from hidden reserves kept in a deep, cursed tower. Its charge is gathered from caches found within that dark spire.

rites.name: Rernosanum Niarium
rites.text: A soul-energy craft drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dread tower's deep vaults. It is a power that unleashes a violent burst of spectral force.

rites.name: Rinterus
rites.text: A soft-hearted creature's trick in a contest of companions that deals no harm yet strips away protective charms from opponents.

rites.name: Collium Taulenus
rites.text: A stored spirit-essence sealed within a hidden tower of the condemned, offering the bearer a choice of brief enhancements that endure only until the current descent ends.

rites.name: Lirnaunor
rites.text: A venom-delivering craft that a hunter learns at a mid-level rank. It is chosen in place of a rival technique, so only one of the two can be kept.

rites.name: Vianelium
rites.text: A mage's craft that trades personal resilience for greater destructive force. Every spell the caster releases hits harder, while harm from magical sources bites deeper as well.

rites.name: Vaurnaria
rites.text: A mage's craft that tears open a shimmering passage, letting a companion party step through to a violet threshold in a floating city above the frozen north.

rites.name: Lorium Orollium
rites.text: A tainted vitality that creatures of the bestiary can draw upon during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets several beasts spread their corruption in combat.

rites.name: Narneria
rites.text: A piercing inner sight that is gained from sealed reservoirs of vital essence hidden within a dread spiral tower. It lets its bearer perceive what lies hidden beyond ordinary eyes.

rites.name: Seornium Riarnum
rites.text: A rank-gated skill of the hunters that fixes a foe in place with a piercing stare. It is granted as an honor once a warrior reaches an advanced standing.

rites.name: Ameorum Ceoles
rites.text: A gate-making art wielded by a caster, opening a passage that carries the caster's companions to a distant tower of the elements. The passage serves the allies of the caster's own band.

rites.name: Corisanum Corallanum
rites.text: A discipline of the hunter's craft in which the practitioner pins down quarry so it cannot slip away. It belongs to the branch of wilderness mastery and must be developed through substantial dedication before it can be fully realized.

rites.name: Amesauntes
rites.text: A bearer can take hold of another creature and perceive the world through its senses while directing its movements as if it were their own body. Those who master the craft can wield a foreign body's abilities as their own.

rites.name: Neosia Laurnor
rites.text: Adventurers pursue specialized paths of power taught through guilds and ancient customs. Each path grants focused skills and mastery in a chosen area of expertise.

rites.name: Corausanum Seristum
rites.text: A dormant inner reserve of the dead can be drawn upon by a sworn warrior of the crimson oath, quietly strengthening them once they reach mastery. It works without any deliberate command.

rites.name: Siallum Corestonum
rites.text: A practice in which a shaper drops a beast-skin and swiftly reclaims it, gaining a brief surge of benefit. The skill is valued for its quick turns between animal and human forms.

rites.name: Rerallanum Valeornum
rites.text: A practiced knack of a spellcaster that sharpens how often their magic lands true while lowering the energy each incantation drains.

rites.name: Amauntes Amellia
rites.text: A harsh caustic power that a creature can draw from hidden reservoirs of essence found inside a dark, ruined tower. It is gained by collecting these stored reserves.

rites.name: Rastia Nisum
rites.text: A ranged marksman's technique that drives a shot with such force it pushes the target backward. It is a talent a hunter may learn once they reach a high level of skill.

rites.name: Amastia Rausistia
rites.text: A craft that binds a lasting charm into handwear, sharpening the chance of a decisive blow. It cannot be placed upon gear of a greater tier.

rites.name: Vantor Serisanum
rites.text: A refined mark-craft that lets a practitioner sharpen their symbols into exact points of force. Taking it closes the option of the broader, scattered variant.

rites.name: Colum Cerniasor
rites.text: A tiered combat technique that sharpens the killing blow of a savage pounce against wounded foes. Finishing strikes may also grant a fleeting surge that lets the next nature rite be cast without delay or cost.

rites.name: Niantor Raurnus
rites.text: A stacking affliction that a drinker takes on after sipping a dark herbal tonic. Each stack repeatedly batters the body with blunt harm, and the affliction lingers for a short spell before fading.

rites.name: Amauses Seroranum
rites.text: A quiet, inborn gift shared by all of the dark-dwelling folk, which lets them act without pause the moment they are struck by harm.

rites.name: Sesor Riarium
rites.text: A swift trickster's craft that resets the timers of its other techniques the moment it is invoked. It lets a practitioner act again sooner than the usual waiting period would allow.

rites.name: Orastillus Oraurnanum
rites.text: A creature's hunting technique is used by beasts when they clash in a contest of tamed companions. It lets a bonded animal strike its rival with a fierce, sudden attack.

rites.name: Tarnesor
rites.text: A learned shield that softens every blow a caster takes, growing stronger with each study. At its fullest, it lets a vanishing spell be cast in an instant, making a practitioner nearly unshakable in duels.

rites.name: Leosium Liasirnor
rites.text: A learned instinctive discipline taught within a wild fighting school, requiring deep training to master. It shortens the time a binding force can hold a warrior in place, making it valued mainly in duels between rival champions.

rites.name: Orasanum Caustanum
rites.text: A swift, instant strike that a fighter aims at a single foe mid-incantation. It deals no harm, but it breaks the spell and locks that foe's whole school of magic for a few heartbeats.

rites.name: Corinanum Caurnum
rites.text: A measure of how near a caster must be for an effect to act, without needing a clear sightline or facing. Most ranged arms ignore it, but many enhancing and hindering arts reach anyone within its bounds.

rites.name: Serisum Teontanum
rites.text: A dark mental craft that instantly seizes a foe's mind and holds it helpless for a few heartbeats. Practitioners must pick it over a rival technique, since the two cannot be learned together.

rites.name: Sinus Viarnes
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a practitioner handle certain kinds of gear, depending on their calling. Some are granted from birth, while others are taught by masters or chosen along a path of study.

rites.name: Valeosium Teonium
rites.text: A specialist who draws a lone foe toward a group using a distant strike, while calming others and slipping away if too many follow. The most skilled one chooses the weakest isolated target and passes the threat onward to a sturdier ally.

rites.name: Coriallor Ameosor
rites.text: A mental reservoir that gathers from hidden stores of spiritual essence found inside a dreadful tower. It lets its bearer draw on the gathered force as a usable power.

rites.name: Aminornium
rites.text: A surge of mental force that creatures of the mind can unleash during a contest of tamed beasts. It sweeps across the battlefield and strikes the foe with unseen psychic pressure.

rites.name: Mellintanum
rites.text: A learned gliding craft that lets its practitioners sustain forward rushes and climb upward while they hover on the air. It is a natural gift of one winged people, unlocked through the act of hovering.

rites.name: Amaulanum Teontaunes
rites.text: A ranking method that lets fighters order their skills by how much harm each one deals per moment spent casting it. Practitioners learn the calculation so they can build the strongest sequence of strikes.

rites.name: Telolium Orauntum
rites.text: Fighters deliberately start a clash to lure a few foes away from their gathered band, aiming to defeat them before the rest notice. Skilled practitioners treat this lure as a craft that often decides the whole battle.

rites.name: Ameollus Oreolenia
rites.text: A command used by the current group head to hand leadership to a companion, who cannot refuse the transfer. The chosen member is marked with a crown symbol beside their portrait.

rites.name: Liastornus
rites.text: A seasonal trial imposed on every deep challenge, where tainted spirits rise as trash is cleared. Felling one grants a brief surge that boosts strength, swiftness and restorative flow.

rites.name: Mellia Liantus
rites.text: A channeling discipline that lets spellcasters draw steadiness from raw wilderness instincts. It is a conduit tailored to the practitioners who wield magic through invocation.

rites.name: Serarnia Corianium
rites.text: A bound-away power drawn from a devoured soul-essence, unlocked by hurling a hungry essence-vessel at a snarling captive beast within a dreadful tower of torment.

rites.name: Veonia Telosum
rites.text: A shaman's gift granted to those who pledge to a bone-warden order, letting them call forth a sweeping ancestral surge. The gift is lent for a short while to outsiders who take up a warrior's trial in a grim fortress city.

rites.name: Valisaurnes
rites.text: A learned craft of sharpened instinct that a wild-kin school refines through disciplined practice. Practitioners must invest deeply in the fierce combat branch of their training before mastering it.

rites.name: Amaulanum Raurnum
rites.text: A single signature technique granted to each practitioner upon choosing their discipline, powerful and reserved for that discipline alone. Over time the old doctrine was reshaped, and most such techniques were folded into wider repertoires, so the name for them has faded from use.

rites.name: Amaseornus
rites.text: A battle-trance talent that a guardian-kind druid of the wilds can unlock once they reach the twenty-first rank of their training. It is used in contests between rival fighters.

rites.name: Amaullor Rauliranum
rites.text: A hidden binding craft drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit-energy within a dreaded tower of punishment. Its practitioners steer the will of others as if they were marionettes.

rites.name: Telialesor
rites.text: A tactic that companion beasts use while locked in a contest of champions. It rallies the creatures into a bold, gleeful display that shapes how their duel unfolds.

rites.name: Coralles Ameorauntor
rites.text: A timed blessing spreads through every fighter gathered in the great capitals once a hero finishes a trial. It sharpens precise strikes and lifts the chosen strength of each warrior, but it cannot reach those who have already grown beyond a certain standing.

rites.name: Reornum Meonium
rites.text: A practiced hand-gesture lulls a foe into a brief stupor lasting four heartbeats, halting its actions and the wielder's own strikes. Any harm dealt wakes the victim at once, so the gesture buys time to regroup, mend, or withdraw.

rites.name: Silianum
rites.text: A discipline of the bow and sling that sharpens every strike launched from a distance. Its practitioners' shots grow heavier, though the companion beasts they keep gain nothing from it.

rites.name: Miarnistum
rites.text: A practiced gift of calling down heavy downpours from the sky. It is learned by those who follow the spirit-ways of the old tribes.

rites.name: Lisenanum
rites.text: A rite granted only to the chitin-backed beast-kin, raising the bearer's arcane might and vitality by a tenth. It outclasses lesser boons that grant only one of those gifts, while rival boons offer haste or sharper strikes instead.

rites.name: Valauntor Miania
rites.text: A bristling defensive technique that creatures of the wild use while locked in a contest of strength. It lets them answer a rival's attacks with a barrage of sharp projectiles.

rites.name: Valaneosum
rites.text: A bound craft granted to channelers who train under a dragon-mother's watch. It can be taken only alongside a companion strike that echoes a blow.

rites.name: Tenia Amelum
rites.text: A high-level craft granted to healing wardens of the wild. It lets them cultivate their nature-magic to a greater degree.

rites.name: Lontialanum
rites.text: A grim trait tied to a blood-drinking dead warrior's relic, linked to a bone-breaking talent and a fang-based one. It shapes how the bearer's gruesome craft works.

rites.name: Tinia Rilus
rites.text: A sticky sap-craft that a healer-shaman can call upon during contests between rival fighters. It is taught as a special technique once a practitioner reaches a set level of skill.

rites.name: Calium Teliasia
rites.text: A grim craft that calls forth a seeking, bursting corpse-thing a short distance from a chosen foe. The corpse-thing scatters in a random direction before it hunts its mark and detonates.

rites.name: Tiantarnus
rites.text: A trained skill of a hunter-like warrior that, when called upon, instantly resets the recovery timers on most of their other techniques. It does not affect the beasts that fight alongside them.

rites.name: Ameoniares
rites.text: A practice of taking in written marks from certain carried objects, such as bound tomes, instruction sheets, and rolled parchments. Holding one and calling up its inscribed words reveals the script.

rites.name: Coriastum Ciarallus
rites.text: A passive craft of the archer-scouts that quickens the gathering of inner vigor each time a volley is loosed in rapid succession. It is learned only after a long apprenticeship and has since been struck from the common teachings.

rites.name: Ceonintum Naustintium
rites.text: A swift art of hiding oneself, learned as an early step in a shadow-craft discipline. Mastering it demands a set amount of practice in the discipline's core techniques.

rites.name: Valanor Valareornes
rites.text: A trained warrior's discipline that cuts off an enemy mid-incantation. The target is silenced from casting spells of that same school for a short span.

rites.name: Orausianus
rites.text: A passive discipline that a sect of monks at a certain training level can draw upon. It is a quiet, self-sustaining skill.

rites.name: Telia Vontia
rites.text: A craft practiced by skilled artificers that converts a flame-bound essence into one of stone and soil. Each conversion forces the practitioner to rest for a full day before attempting another.

rites.name: Telareonium Cirenor
rites.text: A reshaping craft that teaches a practitioner how to kindle a sentient flame through transformation. It can only be learned by someone who has mastered a lower art, and its knowledge is found among the creatures of molten lands.

rites.name: Tostum Telirnia
rites.text: A transmutation formula that lets an adept turn a cold reagent into a stirring, awakened ember. It can only be learned once the adept has reached a fifty-rank mastery of the craft, and a guild artisan sells it for a modest sum of trade tokens.

rites.name: Viares Valirnontus
rites.text: A practiced art in which a crafter changes a grave-cold tincture into a clear, flowing essence. It requires a special lodestone and mastery of the craft, and the working can only be repeated after a full day of rest.

rites.name: Rillia Rintanum
rites.text: A holder swaps the stones set in an already-fitted tool for fresh ones, but the old stone is lost for good. Anyone may do this at any moment, even amid a fight, without needing a trained artisan.

rites.name: Serus Viarnenor
rites.text: A guild-granted craft that lessens how much wear a member's equipment suffers after falling. Higher standing in the brotherhood grants a stronger version of this protection.

rites.name: Renes Corialium
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures use during contests between tamed beasts, letting them turn an opponent's strike back toward it.

rites.name: Caulernus
rites.text: A bonded binding that a forge-lord bestows upon a crafter, letting worked materials slowly mend themselves. It cannot coexist with a feather-based mending gift.

rites.name: Riasirnum
rites.text: A bound force of stored spirit energy, drawn from hoards kept within a grim ruined tower. It hardens a wearer's restraints against harm.

rites.name: Males Valesium
rites.text: A restorative technique that certain creatures use during a contest between companion beasts, allowing them to mend themselves partway through the struggle.

rites.name: Teliasia Valares
rites.text: A learned knack of a sly fighter that gives each decisive blow a chance to refill their stamina at once. It rewards those who finish their foes in a flurry.

rites.name: Teornillium
rites.text: A glowing inner force that is drawn from hoarded reservoirs hidden deep within a grim spire of lost souls. It lets its wielder prod at the minds of foes with burning jolts.

rites.name: Valentium Neostia
rites.text: A bending ward drawn from a gathered reserve of wild sorcery, it turns incoming force aside. It is taken from a bound source found within a dangerous spire of ruin.

rites.name: Reorellanum
rites.text: A craft that lets a caster knit a hardened shell back over wounds. It cannot be learned alongside a rival blood-discipline.

rites.name: Roresium
rites.text: A coined armor enchantment that a defensive guardian can awaken in their gear. It hardens the protector's shell against incoming blows.

rites.name: Valestus Amolanum
rites.text: A cunning shadow-craft that lets a stealthy fighter strike more often with lethal precision. Its power only awakens when the foe slain has gathered experience or renown.

rites.name: Valaulus Nirnia
rites.text: A tireless offensive technique passed among shield-bearing defenders, letting them press forward without tiring. It is taught to guardians of several disciplined orders.

rites.name: Oreonanum Sereosium
rites.text: A tuned sense of taste that lets a drinker's elixirs linger longer in the body. It is unlocked far along a companion's branching paths of growth.

rites.name: Amostesia
rites.text: A hardened guard-talent that warriors and other close-combat fighters of many disciplines may awaken at a set rank. It toughens the body against blows during fierce melee.

rites.name: Rausonium Mialirnes
rites.text: A mirrored craft that lets its wielder's dark double split off and move alongside them. The gift is carried in the spirit of a skilled night-stalker.

rites.name: Meostanum Tosiarum
rites.text: A small guardian creature mends the wounds of its companions during a contest of trained beasts. The healing renews a fighter's strength in the middle of a bout.

rites.name: Coroses Tellanum
rites.text: A ward-power drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence within a tower of the cursed. It pushes away those who would draw near.

rites.name: Virarnum
rites.text: A ward-craft that can be woven into a guardian's sworn armor, granting its bearer fire-tempered protection. It is said to exist only in one plate of unfinished design.

rites.name: Raunallum
rites.text: A combat-skill technique for dark-cloaked hunters who face other hunters. It is unlocked once a warrior reaches a mid-tier rank of mastery.

rites.name: Amenium Tentarnia
rites.text: A channeling conduit used by healer-adepts of the mist arts. It is gained from a fallen brute of the rotting marsh and from nine foes within a warlord's stronghold.

rites.name: Cirnus Maullires
rites.text: A bounce-flame talent that lets a caster of conjured fire set their blaze rebounding from surface to surface. It is practised by those who weave flame into their spells.

rites.name: Cirium Nistarnium
rites.text: A frost-touched life force drawn from hidden reservoirs in a crumbling spire of punishment. Wielders tap it to unleash their inner strength.

rites.name: Valeosia Nillus
rites.text: A quiet inborn endurance shared by every member of one people, which slightly softens the bite of cold and wild elemental harm against their bodies.

rites.name: Valistus Sallum
rites.text: A lingering heat that clings to a bearer's tools after a fire has passed. It works in tandem with a ruinous fire-bringing power and a soul-drinking ward.

rites.name: Miallosanum Orarus
rites.text: A learned discipline that strengthens the restorative powers of certain carved wardens. It serves as a required step toward mastering a greater tide-calling ritual.

rites.name: Maraurnium
rites.text: A temporary hindrance that strikes at random upon whoever bears a certain brass-stocked launcher from a winter festival. It leaves its bearer dazed and unable to act for a moment.

rites.name: Sonum Reonelia
rites.text: A coined rite of growth that can be purchased with a sacred heart-stone. It calls forth a guardian who can summon elemental risers to aid the one who performs it.

rites.name: Coraunes Sirniarum
rites.text: A lingering stillness that clings to a wanderer who has just stepped out of a timeless pool. It stretches an earlier muting spell by a short added span, leaving the bearer unable to call upon their craft.

rites.name: Tereornes
rites.text: A steadfast inner resolve that a defender of the sacred cause can draw upon in battle. It is available to those who guard others with unwavering faith.

rites.name: Taulium Minus
rites.text: A feline shaper's final strike gathers every built-up mark into one savage slash that leaves a lingering bleed eating away at the foe. Hunters of the wilds learn it as a matter of course.

rites.name: Neoraunes
rites.text: A craft that trims a measured figure down to a chosen count of trailing digits. The keeper names how many decimal places to keep, and the figure is returned shortened to that length.

rites.name: Riarnesia
rites.text: A tide-touched craft that lets a ruin-caster gather cursed ember-stone energy. It is kept by the dark flame-wielders of the ash-marsh orders.

rites.name: Ameneores
rites.text: A stored spiritual force drawn from sealed reserves within a dreaded tower of the dead. It lets its wielder gain a hold over dreams and the sleeping mind.

rites.name: Raunornum Lausor
rites.text: A combat gift granted to a warden of the wild, allowing a practitioner to press forward with sudden and fearsome swiftness when battling rival champions.

rites.name: Telernia Tornanum
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lets a wanderer gather loose force into a rolling sphere and send it forward. Only those who have reached a high stage of mastery can call upon it.

rites.name: Amanium Ameolistus
rites.text: A combat resource drawn from six quick-renewing sigils that a fighter spends to build a fleeting store of surging power. The store can then be tapped for other feats, blending steady refilling reserves with strength earned only through clashing in battle.

rites.name: Rolentia Mentes
rites.text: A combat art lets a warrior of the dead-bound order draw foes into close duels against others of their kind. It is taught to those who reach a certain stage of their training.

rites.name: Amonium Mesteolus
rites.text: A small green-skinned folk can hurl their own bodies forward in a short leaping burst by firing a cord-harness strapped around their waist. The technique is a learned trick of their people.

rites.name: Rillanum Siasarnum
rites.text: A discipline of ruinous force that a caster can train to make the blows of their destructive magic land far harder when they strike true. Mastery doubles the extra harm dealt by a perfect strike.

rites.name: Vostia Coraunor
rites.text: A wary wanderer marked for hostility is sometimes struck without warning by an unseen hunter. Such shadow-strikers are especially feared for their silent approach, fierce blows, and swift vanishing.

rites.name: Serantes Corisium
rites.text: A tide of restless inner vitality that a fallen warrior may draw upon at a certain stage of training. It quickens the flow of the body's lifeblood and sharpens the will for battle.

rites.name: Amornor Coriantor
rites.text: A quiet, innate craft that a wandering reader of waters carries from the moment they reach full maturity. It lets them move through flowing currents and channels with uncommon ease and grace.

rites.name: Lornanus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that doubles the force of a caster's most decisive strikes. It needs no effort to maintain and works without being called upon.

rites.name: Amoneosor
rites.text: A carved mark used by armored war-smiths to bind a grim, blood-hungry craft into their weapons. It is learned only after reaching a fairly advanced stage of training.

rites.name: Teliarnia Ceorus
rites.text: A discipline that heightens the chance of decisive, devastating strikes when a warrior invokes a few sacred blows. It is taught to those who fight in the name of judgment.

rites.name: Corares Montium
rites.text: A carved sigil that a smith can etch onto a blade, unlocked once a warrior reaches a high rank in the dark arts. It lets the bearer call forth a frenzied, mind-clouding force.

rites.name: Viarnum Maustor
rites.text: A forged sigil of ruin that a practitioner can inscribe at a high tier of mastery. It is wielded by the grim warrior-priests who bind death to steel.

rites.name: Ternanum Ceontelanum
rites.text: A rank-gated honor talent that lets a hunter of the Vengeance path strike with sudden cutting speed. It becomes available once a hunter reaches a high standing in the honor ladder.

rites.name: Valostia Serentanum
rites.text: A gift of sudden life-energy that evokers may draw upon, belonging to the path of preservation. It cannot be taken alongside a certain dreamwalking discipline.

rites.name: Terum Valiarnum
rites.text: A swift strike technique practiced by monks who channel fast, fierce motion through the body. It is taught as an honored skill once a practitioner reaches a high level of training.

rites.name: Varellia
rites.text: A closing strike used by shadow-trained blades, it opens a bleeding wound that keeps draining its victim over time. Its effect lingers after the blow has landed.

rites.name: Sintes Ameolia
rites.text: A carved sigil that a warrior of the dead can etch into a blade to call forth a relentless craving that drives the bearer onward. It is an enchantment reserved for those who have risen to a certain tier of mastery.

rites.name: Lirnum Ciarnor
rites.text: A small-folk trick in which a carrier digs through a satchel of curios to swap which of its hidden knacks is ready for use. The rummaging takes a moment and changes the knack held in reserve.

rites.name: Vineosus
rites.text: A chilling enchantment carved into a warrior's blade that works alongside two related inscriptions of the same order. It draws strength from the dead and fuels the wielder's fury.

rites.name: Nirum Serenor
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that a stealthy trickster-class wanderer gains upon reaching full maturity. It works without being called upon, sharpening how the wanderer moves unseen among others.

rites.name: Neosinus Rolles
rites.text: A bound void-creature gives up a quarter of its own vitality to wrap its master in a temporary ward. The ward lasts half a minute and is learned by the creature once it reaches a set maturity.

rites.name: Sinanum Talintes
rites.text: A standing ward that a loyal follower may acquire through standing with a rogue band. It holds a chance to call forth a guardian companion to fight beside its bearer.

rites.name: Rastia Orentia
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets blood-bound warriors endure harsh wounds. It awakens in those who have reached a seasoned rank among the crimson-sworn.

rites.name: Ceoraurnium Neolum
rites.text: A discipline once taken by oath-bound champions who channeled holy vigor into their strikes. It was later struck from the training rolls and no longer taught.

rites.name: Tirnor Telanum
rites.text: A consecrated radiance that a healer's inner attunement draws toward sudden, decisive strikes. It once lent a warrior of faith sharper chances to land a devastating blow.

rites.name: Valoriasus
rites.text: A fierce kind of inner drive that a wild shaper can awaken through combat training. It lets a fighter press harder against rivals in open contests.

rites.name: Vastium Teliantium
rites.text: A ranged technique that lets a hunter fire a wide spread of projectiles at once. It stands as one of two mutually exclusive options chosen at the same rank of a hunter's training path.

rites.name: Sereonum Neorarnium
rites.text: A guardian's craft that lets a tamed beast hardened by its own shell halve the harm it takes for a short span. Only beasts of one tribe of hide-clad hunters can wield it.

rites.name: Amirernia
rites.text: A bond available only to one clan of tamed hunting beasts that lifts swiftness and endurance together. It outshines the lone-benefit bonds of other beast kinds, while a rival tribe's bond instead strengthens magical force.

rites.name: Naustus Sillum
rites.text: A fierce war-cry of a shapeshifter in feline guise, drawn from the final blow of a combo. It sharpens the wielder's strikes, raising their physical force by a third.

rites.name: Oriasanum Corenanum
rites.text: A keeping-craft that holds chosen fragments of a traveler's configuration through departures, storing them when the wanderer leaves and returning them when they come back. Each marked fragment is named in a binding scroll that the keeper reads before each journey.

rites.name: Loles Vinum
rites.text: A ritual power taught to the members of one sworn brotherhood of hexers. It is granted to those who join the order and is lent for a time to others on a special errand.

rites.name: Corallia Amintesor
rites.text: A subtle trait that lets a rogue's artifact act a second time in quick succession. It pairs with two related traits that sharpen precise strikes and piercing thrusts.

rites.name: Rollia Niarolles
rites.text: A creature's swift raking strike used in contests between tamed companions. It tears at an opponent during a duel of beasts.

rites.name: Leliria
rites.text: A hidden imbuement that a cloud-weaving monk may draw into their craft. It is open only to those who follow the mist-keeping discipline.

rites.name: Amillentor Ceores
rites.text: A trained skill of stealthy fighters that adds one extra marking point whenever a precise, lethal strike lands against a single foe in close combat.

rites.name: Oriantium Nolus
rites.text: A lasting mark etched upon the shoulder that refines the craft of those who cast spells. Its bearer must sustain a high level of skill in the art of inscribing to keep its benefit.

rites.name: Teleontor Tallestium
rites.text: A devotional sign that a sworn guardian can awaken at a certain stage of training. It lets the bearer lash out at foes with radiant force while keeping the faithful steady.

rites.name: Orasenus Tentasus
rites.text: A practice in which one member of a traveling band moves ahead unseen, using quiet footwork or a far-reaching sense, to study the path before the others arrive. The knowledge lets the group prepare for whatever waits ahead.

rites.name: Teornia Telasus
rites.text: A grim ability drawn from sealed hoards of spirit-essence kept within a towering prison of the cursed. Those who tap these hoards call forth wailing forms that answer their will.

rites.name: Ciarnor Seornium
rites.text: A hidden kind of inner charm that can be drawn from sealed reservoirs found deep within a haunted spire. Those who gather it gain a flavorful surge of power.

rites.name: Sausium Rirum
rites.text: A craftsman's research rite that reveals an unknown gem cut at random, with no waiting period before it can be repeated. It also yields a bundle of rare cut stones and small shards of broken gems.

rites.name: Corerauntia
rites.text: A tiered craft practiced within a shadow-focused discipline of stealth-trained artisans. Mastery of it requires seven measures of dedication in the shadow path.

rites.name: Valeorium Corianasium
rites.text: A quiet hunter's discipline that is always active once learned. It grants a passive bonus to those who train in the wilds at a high level of skill.

rites.name: Teliastes Nirnia
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lets a devoted healer draw restorative vapor into their hands. It is learned only once a practitioner reaches the highest tier of training.

rites.name: Corasillia
rites.text: A ritual binding worked into handwear that lets the wearer draw more strength into dark-aligned workings. It can only be set by a crafter of high skill.

rites.name: Vaullisia
rites.text: A bonded discipline that a battle-mystic draws upon to ease the strain of a thin reservoir of inner power. It keeps a fighter in the fray longer between moments of recovery.

rites.name: Valistanum Rilleoria
rites.text: A subtle trick of cunning that belongs to the rogue's craft of hidden artifacts. It is bound to several sibling traits that share its quiet, stealthy nature.

rites.name: Tialum Ventia
rites.text: A ritual bargain used by a caster of the dark arts that mends wounds at once while sharpening shadowed harm. It also reshapes the caster's sacred spells into darker forms.

rites.name: Oralia Serauntia
rites.text: A dark protective craft bestowed upon chosen wardens by a commanding entity of the abyss. It lets its bearer raise a barrier formed from living gloom.

rites.name: Varanum Serium
rites.text: A learned footwork that lets a fighter sway through empty air as though sparring with a dim double. Such skill is sought in hidden vaults where ancient caches hold its secrets.

rites.name: Corerum Oreostenus
rites.text: A dark inherited quality that binds a caster's lingering corruption to other sorrowful powers. It draws strength from the bonds it shares with those related forces.

rites.name: Marneostum
rites.text: A practiced trick of slipping instantly to a spot behind a chosen foe. The one who uses it gains a brief surge of quickened footwork afterward.

rites.name: Vonum Valosastor
rites.text: A dark art wielded by sorcerers who draw on dread to strike their foes. It is learned at a modest stage of training and used in contests between rival practitioners.

rites.name: Sestia Oriareosia
rites.text: A dark chanting technique that a caster learns to replace a familiar blasting strike. It is gained once the caster reaches a middling stage of training.

rites.name: Serollum Serillum
rites.text: A quiet discipline of concealment practiced by sly operatives. It is a passive skill that sharpens the wielder's stealth at a high tier of mastery.

rites.name: Amorneosus
rites.text: A bond-craft granted to those who join a sworn circle of wardens, allowing them to restrain the undeserving. It is lent for a time to travelers on a particular journey and ends when that journey is complete.

rites.name: Rallus Naurnisia
rites.text: A quiet passive craft that a dark-walking adept learns once they reach a certain mastery. It lets the practitioner gather a veil of gloom that shields them from harm.

rites.name: Valinia Coriastanum
rites.text: A passive craft in which dark spectral copies of a caster drift slowly toward marked foes after certain spells are cast. On arrival each copy strikes with a burst of shadow and vanishes.

rites.name: Viantaurnes
rites.text: A dim draw of hollow spirit-stuff that can be pulled out of buried stores found deep within a cursed spire of ruin. It is a power a wanderer may take up and use.

rites.name: Cornes Seornus
rites.text: A dark craft of the caster that stirs a shadowy spark within the mind. It is learned by practitioners of summoning arts once they reach a certain standing.

rites.name: Ameollanum Risiastanum
rites.text: A innate craft shared by a people of the night woods lets its practitioners fade from sight while standing still. Any step taken or wound received breaks the concealment at once.

rites.name: Sinum Coriastes
rites.text: A mutable seal-power drawn from hidden reserves of vital essence within a dark spired tower of punishment. It is gained by those who open the sealed stores hidden among its lower chambers.

rites.name: Sisum Venum
