rites.text: A borrowed fighting technique that a wild shapeshifter can grant to a battle-hardened ally. It lets the wielder tear away a protective ward or a frozen shell from an enemy.

rites.name: Corillus Leolaurnes
rites.text: A guardian's ward that a sworn defender can learn at a certain stage of training. When cast, a hurled bolt of force breaks the voices of foes gathered close around the bearer.

rites.name: Vaustanum Telosanum
rites.text: A racial training that sharpens a fighter's skill with short, one-handed blades. Each weapon in hand gains the bonus separately, so pairing two suitable blades lets every strike benefit.

rites.name: Neollernum Lenteosor
rites.text: A ghostly guard that can be drawn from hidden reserves of soulstuff within a cursed spire. It hardens into a protective barrier against harm.

rites.name: Aminia Ciantases
rites.text: A fighter's technique that raises a sturdy guarding barrier, usable once a fighter reaches a high rank of skill. It requires a defensive posture, and some battle-schools can perform it without carrying any shield at all.

rites.name: Corontestum
rites.text: A defender's technique that requires a raised barrier in hand and can cut off a rival's incantation. The interruption also locks every chant of that same discipline for a short span while stunning the foe.

rites.name: Telontalor
rites.text: A ranged craft where a wielder backs off to the farthest reach and looses a missile weapon. It finishes wounded foes or wears them down while staying beyond their grasp, and certain hunter-folk rely on it above all.

rites.name: Virnus Ceoriarnus
rites.text: A learned sky-craft that lets a practitioner's bright spells sometimes strike harder and gather a reserve of starlight for later use. It is taught to those who walk the balance of tides and heavens.

rites.name: Cintaustor Monteolles
rites.text: A stored vital essence that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a dreaded, sunken spire. It grants its bearer a sharp, piercing surge of power.

rites.name: Sontesum
rites.text: A radiant cloak-power drawn from hoarded stores of spirit essence found within a cursed, towering prison. It lets its wearer glimmer and shift like a veil of light.

rites.name: Rausoles
rites.text: A tide of defensive force that a creature of the deep sea can summon in the middle of a contest of beasts. It raises a barrier that blunts incoming blows.

rites.name: Mauntes Reornanum
rites.text: A sudden jolt of force that strikes without warning. Many distinct strains of this jolt exist, each carrying its own elemental harm.

rites.name: Tellia Noseores
rites.text: A coined practice that becomes open to a practitioner once their standing reaches a high tier, passed along through a particular guild of tribal makers.

rites.name: Valernum Mentalus
rites.text: A dark mental craft that a caster of shadow lore carries as a bound inner gift. It is tied to a second, madness-bringing mind-trait that rides alongside it.

rites.name: Mianarnia Corelium
rites.text: A bloodline craft in which a fighter's shattered bones are reknit by dark rites. It works alongside two sister arts, the clotting-binding craft and the stubborn-endurance craft.

rites.name: Amonia Corianores
rites.text: A quick cutting technique that a skilled fighter wields with a blade in hand. It can be aimed at any foe, provided the wielder faces them, and it is replaced by sharper forms for certain specialists.

rites.name: Veosium Amauntia
rites.text: A frozen veil of cold that a fighter can draw over the battlefield to dull the force of foes who strike against them. It is a craft a warrior learns once they have grown strong enough to master its chill.

rites.name: Ternoria Callanum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that settles on fully grown adventurers during a week-long gathering of the old march-host. It lends them a brief surge of strength.

rites.name: Colesum
rites.text: A hidden craft of smothering that a deadly assassin may learn from the metal of a relic. It is used only by those who walk the quiet knife.

rites.name: Ameoranum Oriantus
rites.text: A quiet inner attunement that sharpens a shadow-walker's knack for striking twice in one motion. It also heightens nimbleness and the blows delivered from behind or from hiding.

rites.name: Mantirium
rites.text: A mark of inner force that is gathered from hidden reservoirs inside a dark, cursed spire. It grants its bearer a surge of soul-energy.

rites.name: Miantum Cistus
rites.text: A reckoning-craft that forecasts how much harm a band of fighters can deal over a long engagement. Scholars use it to plan their strikes before a battle begins.

rites.name: Orernium Oralor
rites.text: A low crouching posture where a wanderer rests on the ground or a seat instead of standing. Anyone struck while in this posture rises at once, and rest there mends the body faster.

rites.name: Nises Renus
rites.text: A draining craft that lets a tamed beast-keeper pull life-essence from a companion creature during a contest of pets. The technique is practiced by a single lineage of trainers.

rites.name: Mostum Oreolesia
rites.text: A small, quiet knack that every clockwork-tinkerer of the Brasshollow folk is born with. It lets them open locks and bolts as deftly as a seasoned sneak-thief.

rites.name: Serallus Vinium
rites.text: A small gesture-command that lets a figure express itself to others without changing anything in the world. A few such gestures do alter a body's posture, like lying down or sitting, which limits how quickly it can fight.

rites.name: Nesteollor
rites.text: A discerning working that responds to circumstance with judgment. It chooses its recipients by weighing who or what is at hand, aiming for the most fitting selection among them.

rites.name: Amaraunum
rites.text: A tuning technique reserved for winged hunting companions, it sharpens a hunter's chance to strike several times in one blow. It works much like rival techniques shared by other beast kinds, yet a brawny beast's raw vigor grants a stronger edge.

rites.name: Ceornentum
rites.text: A guardian craft that lets protectors of the sworn order rise up and bear defensive light. It is shaped by the stone of the deep mines.

rites.name: Tanoranum Ceontellus
rites.text: A dormant state in which a bearer lies down and sinks into stillness, hit harder by blows while unaware. Those caught in the hush cannot move or act until the lull breaks or is shaken off by harm.

rites.name: Mantistus
rites.text: A stored inner power is drawn from hidden reserves kept within a cursed, towering prison-fortress. It is gathered by those who venture into its depths and grows stronger with each reserve claimed.

rites.name: Tistium Soliantia
rites.text: A deft manual skill taught within a tier two discipline of stealthy cunning. Practitioners must invest a set total of seven points in that discipline to master it.

rites.name: Lesonor
rites.text: A keen gust that companions can call forth in a contest between tamed beasts. It cuts through an opponent's guard to strike them.

rites.name: Liasteontus
rites.text: A combat method where a fighter chains a heavy strike with a timed swing sequence to unleash severe damage. It demands practice, sharp timing, and quick adjustment when the target moves.

rites.name: Causor Marnanum
rites.text: A borrowed surge of inner essence that a hunter draws from sealed reliquaries buried deep within a cursed spire of ruin. It grants its wielder a sharpened edge in battle.

rites.name: Amillausor
rites.text: A forceful technique that creature companions employ during contests of challenge. It lets them deliver a powerful blow to a rival.

rites.name: Oreolliasus Orirnium
rites.text: A planned craft in which a glowing essence is shaped into inscribed tokens that grant aid or smooth the way through a dead realm. Several of its token forms would later carry over into a tower's spirit-powers.

rites.name: Veontor Amiasus
rites.text: A bond between a tamer and their companion beast that slowly mends both of them over time, as long as the beast stays close and alive. It is a quiet craft of shared endurance, kept by those who train wild creatures.

rites.name: Oriastes Vaustisanum
rites.text: A blended craft practiced by robed keepers who weave two distinct channels of power together. Its workings take on the strongest bonuses of either channel and resist harm at the weaker of the two.

rites.name: Tiareollus
rites.text: A learned practice that shortens the wait between uses of a protective ward spell. It is taught as a mid-level discipline of the spirit-keepers.

rites.name: Vianes Oranesium
rites.text: A dormant craft that a dark spellcaster can attach to a ritual sigil, letting them slip across short distances without moving through the space between. It is no longer practiced in the present age.

rites.name: Viastor Teontiarium
rites.text: A bound inner force that a wielder draws from hidden reservoirs buried within a deep, sealed ruin. It is gathered from those sunken stores and channeled as a protective power.

rites.name: Amiasium Serauntus
rites.text: A passive practice of the wind-walking adepts, unlocked only after decades of disciplined training. It lets a student hone their reflexes through steady, unforced exchanges with a partner.

rites.name: Serauntum Corasiantus
rites.text: A tally of fragments kept by a caster of forbidden craft, shown beneath their vitality and reserves. It holds at most five, slowly rebuilding in quiet times and refilled by certain rites during battle.

rites.name: Sestia Leostes
rites.text: A dormant mark of craft that wakes only after a bearer has gathered every other sign of their trade. It binds the cold fury of a fallen warrior to the tools they carry.

rites.name: Oreonia Ceollantes
rites.text: A spirit-driven technique that certain companion beasts draw upon during contests of arena combat. It lets a creature surge forward in the heat of a bout.

rites.name: Venalles
rites.text: A demon hound's trained trick that cuts off a caster mid-incantation, sealing them away from one wellspring of their craft for a short span. It can only be used again after a long rest.

rites.name: Serirnus Vantiaror
rites.text: A piercing quality that lets a caster's workings slip past a target's ward, though it cannot drive the ward below nothing. It works only on foes already guarded, and is a separate craft from accuracy.

rites.name: Cosus Misteornia
rites.text: A protective enchantment that a companion creature can call upon during a contest of spirits. It shields the bearer's essence while the struggle between pets unfolds.

rites.name: Seraustor Oralliantum
rites.text: A blended craft of sorcery practiced by caster-artisans, fusing two disciplines into one. Its workings draw on bonuses from either discipline and take the weakest defense of the two, slipping past partial wards.

rites.name: Oraustia Taustus
rites.text: A quiet trait that lets a wielder slip into the dim spaces between light and dark. It works together with swift instincts and sudden bursts of darkness.

rites.name: Tenolium
rites.text: A stored spirit-force is drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dread tower of imprisonment. It grants its wielder a sharpened, piercing might.

rites.name: Mialosus
rites.text: A chilled inner essence that a caster can draw from hidden reserves of a cold, guarded vault within a grim spire of the condemned. It grants a power that is gathered from stored caches there.

rites.name: Valianes Teleontus
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that pulls an enchantment off a foe and binds it to the caster for a limited time. The borrowed boon can never outlast what remained on the victim.

rites.name: Telastus Tolliarium
rites.text: A small hunting-kin gift lets its bearer move a little quicker. Other companions grant similar swiftness, yet a rival's strength outpaces it, while a brief frenzy surges far higher.

rites.name: Coraurum Moliantor
rites.text: A fighter's trained discipline that softens incoming sorcery and can turn a hurled spell back onto the one who cast it. It holds briefly, ending early once a spell has been returned.

rites.name: Serires Tileostium
rites.text: A quiet inner vigor that slowly restores a bearer's vitality and reserve energy. Those who tend to others depend on it most, and those who fight without healing gain little from it.

rites.name: Nestaullor Linor
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by brewing-adepts that lets their presence gather restorative orbs of vital energy around them. A related gift can also shape such orbs.

rites.name: Amiarentium
rites.text: A learned discipline where a caster draws lingering vitality from a fallen foe, gaining a brief surge of inner strength and steady replenishment of energy while channeling spells.

rites.name: Tiarnor Valelorus
rites.text: A jolt of alarm that a stray shot leaves in an opponent, rousing the wounded foe to turn its attention toward the one who fired. The disturbed target becomes aware of the attacker.

rites.name: Tialum Valones
rites.text: A companion command that holds a bonded beast in place while its keeper withdraws. The beast still lashes out at anything that strikes it, and an eager beast will rush any foe that closes in, letting the keeper slip away unseen.

rites.name: Sontum Taulum
rites.text: A hunting power drawn from hidden reserves of stored vital essence kept in deep ruined towers. Those who gather these reserves can channel the force to pursue and bind their quarry.

rites.name: Vaullium Oriaranum
rites.text: A nimble strike technique taught to a flock of sky-hunting beasts, granting them a small boost to landing rapid follow-up blows in combat.

rites.name: Villianum
rites.text: A craftsman-only lasting weave stitched into a traveler's cloak that lets it slow a fall for a short spell, recharging after a minute. Once added, it no longer occupies the cloak's enchant slot, so a second enchant may also be worn.

rites.name: Amelornus
rites.text: A tuned inner-ember trait that a brewing-focused disciple of the monastic order can awaken. It empowers the practitioner's striking blows.

rites.name: Castintor
rites.text: A slow-burning ward that delays a share of blows landing on a fighter, releasing the held harm gradually over a short span rather than all at once. It is a practiced technique of the brewing-monks.

rites.name: Valaurnium Cantanum
rites.text: A channeled gift that lets healers of the restoring path draw on a surge of hidden energy. It belongs to the attuned vessels who mend the wounded.

rites.name: Amisales
rites.text: A ranged strike technique that a hunter learns early on. Later its use depends on the chosen path, fading for some and being replaced by another method for others.

rites.name: Centarnor Serauntares
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a fighter keep a portion of their built-up fury when shifting between combat postures. It is a learned technique rather than a spell.

rites.name: Telenor Cernontum
rites.text: A quickening craft drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit-essence hidden in a cursed spire. Practitioners gain bursts of swiftness by binding that stored essence to their own stride.

rites.name: Telaunus Vellium
rites.text: A caster gathers pale sky-light and shapes it into burning shards that drop from above. Each shard strikes a chosen target with explosive force, though two shards cannot hit the same foe at once.

rites.name: Caulenium Cauntor
rites.text: A ray of ghostly flame that a creature of wrath can unleash during a contest between tamed companions. It is used as a combat technique by such spirit-bound beings.

rites.name: Amillesus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that lets a dark-aligned caster sharpen their aim through the strength of their spirit. Only seasoned practitioners learn to channel it.

rites.name: Vestor Ceolanes
rites.text: A tempered gift that lets a healer's quiet, always-on blessing be called forth at will as a deliberate act. Its wielder chooses the moment the sacred force answers, turning a constant aid into a chosen one.

rites.name: Amornia Cosanum
rites.text: A foul-smelling trick that creatures call upon while locked in a contest with their companions. It overwhelms rivals and can turn the outcome of a match.

rites.name: Oraurolum
rites.text: A clinging gel technique that a creature uses in a contest between tamed companions. It binds the rival so it can fight less freely.

rites.name: Maustes Saunialia
rites.text: A hot cloud-jet technique that a creature called a mist dancer can unleash during a contest between tamed companions. It is used as a special ability in these bouts.

rites.name: Amaustantus
rites.text: A hunter's craft of tainting prey with natural venoms that wear down a target over time. Earlier versions let only one such toxin cling to a victim at once, each granting a different advantage in duels.

rites.name: Cines Vastoranum
rites.text: A temporary blessing of sharpened thought that settles on a person after they craft a keepsake from three pledge packages. It lasts about an hour and is bestowed during a seasonal festival of affection.

rites.name: Serarnes Lontor
rites.text: A borrowed-power craft in which a practitioner siphons strength from a bound wellspring. It is tied to a companion ritual that keeps the channel open.

rites.name: Viastanus
rites.text: A swift blow from a tempest-charged warrior that wounds a foe and leaves them marked for 15 seconds, making them more vulnerable to lightning and earth-shaking magic. It is the enhanced form of a more common storm strike.

rites.name: Corirus Amaustisia
rites.text: A learned craft in which a fighter draws strength from forging rhythm, letting a warrior trained in blade-work channel that practice into renewed power.

rites.name: Sestia Oraleostes
rites.text: A communal craft in which warriors gain sturdiness when they stand alongside many comrades. Only those who train for a shielding role can learn to draw on this bond.

rites.name: Valeonilium
rites.text: A discipline of the elemental tradition that lets a practitioner channel wind, stone, and flame together through the same craft. It is taught only after a long apprenticeship in the combat arts and is no longer practiced in the present age.

rites.name: Veontisum Veniarium
rites.text: A fiery ability that a molten hound uses while creatures battle for its owner. It unleashes a loud, forceful burst of heat to strike the opponent.

rites.name: Norum Varneorus
rites.text: A hidden battle-trait stirs within a war-axe, causing nearby brutes to be struck with terror for a short while. They shriek random cries as they flee in fear.

rites.name: Serantum Oraustes
rites.text: A charged power drawn from hidden reserves of vital essence stored in a dark tower of punishment. It is gathered from those stores and bound into its bearer.

rites.name: Maurnum Corausiarus
rites.text: A deep-tier combat art practiced by stealthy blade-wielders, it lets their decisive strikes land without evasion and sharpens several of their techniques.

rites.name: Ciastor Voriania
rites.text: A swift strike that strips away a foe's shell of protection, bit by bit with each application. It draws the enemy's attention toward the wielder and lets allies hit harder.

rites.name: Orinteolium
rites.text: A bound-spirit craft that a caster draws upon to command summoned lesser beings. It is tied to several other great binding powers of the same order.

rites.name: Tantoranum Nereornes
rites.text: A tactic used by tamed beasts during contests of companionship, where a creature engulfs its rival in a single sweeping motion.

rites.name: Valirum Lastintes
rites.text: A monk of the wind path can call forth a carved guardian beast of pale stone. The craft is learned once the practitioner reaches a high rank of training.

rites.name: Valium Nonum
rites.text: A dark practitioner's rite that a sigil of a shadow lord once unlocked, calling a lesser void servant in place of an older summoning rite. Later the rite was folded into a single shared ritual.

rites.name: Rentor Vistarnes
rites.text: A dark sustenance-power drawn from hoarded soul-essence kept in a towering prison-spire. It gives its wielder strength by feeding on that stored essence.

rites.name: Silum Orostanum
rites.text: A rare inner-spirit power that a wanderer can gain by opening hidden reliquaries in a dread-haunted spire. It draws out the essence of a being's soul.

rites.name: Serauntia Amintanum
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's rite unlocked through a high-rank scholarly tome, it replaces an older summoning of fire spirits. It lets the caster call a deeper, hungrier entity from beneath the world.

rites.name: Corillium Meornialum
rites.text: A tactic where a fighter chains repeated binding strikes so a foe cannot strike back or flee. The attacker gives up damage to keep the target helpless while allies strike freely, though a later rule that weakens repeated binds has made the tactic far less dependable.

rites.name: Lasaules
rites.text: A craft practiced by those who aid a band of travelers without striking foes themselves. Healers are often counted among them, though the label itself is loosely defined.

rites.name: Riasium Orasus
rites.text: A bonded order's members can unlock a rite that calls forth a servant companion. Their attendant can be chosen again through a separate bond-making ritual.

rites.name: Casor Amintiallum
rites.text: A learned knack for lasting through hardship, honed by wanderers of the wild. Each step taken in its training makes the body hold a little more endurance.

rites.name: Serorium Orastium
rites.text: A burst of swift motion that a creature may call upon during a contest between tamed companions. For one round it grants the user a sharp rise in quickness.

rites.name: Oraullores
rites.text: A dark binding rite that a caster unlocks through a high-tier tome of dominion, letting them call forth a fearsome guardian in place of an older summoning.

rites.name: Lornes Teliarnium
rites.text: A practiced skill of the fog-keeping adepts that lets a disciple draw a rising cloud of vapour around them. It is earned only after long training, once the student reaches a high rank in the order.

rites.name: Niriallia
rites.text: A bonus or active ability chosen to refine a hero's path beyond their calling and training. Each calling offers its own set, unlocked gradually as the hero grows, and the choice can be altered freely in safe places.

rites.name: Telaurornus
rites.text: A swift restorative art practiced by nature-keepers, letting a caster instantly mend a wounded ally in a moment of dire need. It is taught as one of the discipline's advanced skills.

rites.name: Tialarum
rites.text: A bonded life-force that flows from hidden reserves buried within a grim, towering prison. It can be drawn out and joined to a wielder's own strength.

rites.name: Valirnanum Rorninum
rites.text: A tricky, quiet knack that a sneaky wanderer can draw on from a certain point in their training. It works in the background without needing to be activated.

rites.name: Tolum Ronum
rites.text: A passive craft practiced by restorative mystics, it hastens the pause between their healing charms. Each gentle mending is therefore readied more quickly.

rites.name: Ameostentum Meolliarnor
rites.text: A sweeping motion that a bristled enchanted sweeper performs during a contest between tamed companions. It stirs the air to gain an advantage in the fight.

rites.name: Ceonausanum
rites.text: A dark swirling fog that a fallen knight may call forth by joining a shadowy noble brotherhood. It is granted temporarily to outsiders during a certain trial of their homeland.

rites.name: Seolum Sauntium
rites.text: A slick, hardworking essence drawn from hidden stores of stored spirit-force inside a grim tower of punishment. It lets its bearer keep a steady footing when the ground turns treacherous.

rites.name: Casus Ameraulles
rites.text: A compelled-attention craft that drags nearby hostile creatures toward its user for a brief span, ignoring who threatens them most. While it lasts, the user draws even greater hostility, and every practitioner trained for shielding bears it.

rites.name: Riallestia
rites.text: A worn-down power of inner essence that can be gathered from hidden stores within a dreadful, looming tower. Those who draw upon it gain strength drawn from the fragments of old lessons.

rites.name: Seraria Meollanum
rites.text: A dread-born technique that lets a silent stalker quicken their step to unsettle prey. It is chosen as an exclusive branch alongside a nightmare-related gift.

rites.name: Voles Montanum
rites.text: A follow-up sweeping blow that a fighter may unleash right after a precise thrust. It is unlocked through a particular trained technique and triggers only once the thrust has landed.

rites.name: Tornenus Ciasirum
rites.text: A spell reserved for one faction's spellcasters, taught by portal instructors. It transports the caster instantly to a scholars' hall within a walled capital city.

rites.name: Valirnia Varnes
rites.text: A spellcraft lets a caster step instantly to a distant battleground peninsula. Those who are aligned with the first banner arrive at a fortified encampment, while those aligned with the second arrive at a grim stronghold.

rites.name: Teosilor
rites.text: A passive enchantment granted within a few timeworn sanctuaries that reshapes travelers into other folk at random. In one sanctuary, every traveler instead takes on a single shared, moonlit form.

rites.name: Serentostum Amaunes
rites.text: A trade-learned method of renewing an old reptile form so its ridge grows back as sharp spines. Merchants in a coastal settlement teach and sell it to those who wish to practice it.

rites.name: Riarnum Millum
rites.text: A dusk-colored binding mark that a rare herb-keeper can learn from a hidden stronghold's ruling gardener. It is passed on as a single lesson rather than a tool.

rites.name: Lilarus Saullium
rites.text: A taught craft that lets a practitioner inscribe a sigil allowing them to blend into the air around them. Scribes learn it from an itinerant teacher who sells the lesson at a frontier settlement's edge.

rites.name: Leostirium
rites.text: A mage-craft that lets only a single allied caster step instantly across the veil to a high ridge lying within a shielded storm-bound realm.

rites.name: Amallus Teliastium
rites.text: A learnable craft that lets a practitioner inscribe a mark which summons unseen foes from the dark. It is taught by a trader who sells it in a hidden lower district for a costly token.

rites.name: Vostium Terus
rites.text: This craft teaches inscribers how to bind a sealed pact of passage through a grave-bound oath. A noble trader offers it to followers in exchange for favor with a guild of mourners.

rites.name: Amirneontus Caurnes
rites.text: A dark craft that binds a summoner's will to a sealed relic, granting shadowed power. It links with other relics that share its hunger and its binding.

rites.name: Loranum Rausallia
rites.text: A stored craft of inscribed sigils that releases a blinding burst of light and sound when triggered. It is taught by a hidden dealer who sells it for a rare token.

rites.name: Amines Monantum
rites.text: A trader in a floating-market city sells a craft that lets its user perceive what lies beyond ordinary sight. The price is left unstated.

rites.name: Vantirnum Santelium
rites.text: A stored spirit-energy that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a grim, towering prison-spire. Wanderers gather it from these reserves to empower their own abilities.

rites.name: Ranontor Monium
rites.text: A fighting method taught by a merchant of combat arts in a walled trading quarter. Practitioners learn it from vendors who sell instruction at a set price.

rites.name: Rasia Valesium
rites.text: A taught craft that shows a practitioner how to bind a pact that raises a standing host of the restless dead. Trained tutors sell the lesson at fixed rates in two distant trading seats.

rites.name: Monium Ameosialus
rites.text: A dark sorcerer's inherited trait that can only be claimed after all other foundational gifts have been acquired. It grants a lasting arcane edge to a bearer who has mastered the rest of the craft.

rites.name: Nianes Tialor
rites.text: A ward-craft that a caster learns from any gate keeper, carrying them to one of two destinations depending on the tide of a hollow valley. Speaking with a tide-reader alters which destination the gate chooses.

rites.name: Coriles Amasaunia
rites.text: A mage's craft that folds the caster through space and sets them down at a floating sky-city above a shattered archipelago. The arrival point is a landing stone in that cloud-held city.

rites.name: Valeonium Cantum
rites.text: A ritual of folding space that a caster learns from a portal keeper in any gateway hall. It carries the user instantly to a sacred spring atop a high mesa.

rites.name: Amarnoria
rites.text: A carved sigil of heated rage that can be learned by those who hunt the great drakes of the deep sea. It is passed on as a reward from certain foes defeated in the sunken coastal lands.

rites.name: Maurnium Amontor
rites.text: A hidden energy that can be recovered from a forgotten arcane artifact. It is gathered by plundering the relic's remains.

rites.name: Veollestium
rites.text: Sorcerers bend the weave of reality to cross a gap between two places in an instant. The caster's own body becomes the doorway, and the simplest form of the craft lets the user step to a fixed destination.

rites.name: Ceonaustor
rites.text: A mage's gate-spell that folds the caster across the realm into a sheltered hall within a busy coastal port. Only members of one banner may invoke it.

rites.name: Valostum Orisorum
rites.text: A stacking boon that strengthens the outnumbered party during a contested siege, raising their vitality, healing and harm, and empowering their war engines too.

rites.name: Amesum Orilles
rites.text: A bound craft that renews a hunter's throwing spear the moment a foe falls. It is tied to two sibling rites that answer the same call.

rites.name: Amalanum Amesium
rites.text: A temporary honorific earned by slaying a rival hunter and claiming their gift. It is held only by fierce damage-dealers and fades after an hour of bloodlust.

rites.name: Oronor Amaustes
rites.text: A combat technique taught by a trader who sells it in a fortified haven. It can be bought from two merchants in a walled market town.

rites.name: Amonausium
rites.text: A learnable craft that lets a scribe inscribe a rune which lets a bearer blend into surroundings and move quickly. It is taught by a trader who sells the knowledge to those who seek it.

rites.name: Tilentanum
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster step instantly to a bright vault within a great floating ship. Only one faction may learn it, taught by certain portal masters.

rites.name: Amornum Orenaullus
rites.text: A trade-sold craft that a merchant teaches at a market town, marking a practitioner's hand with a dark wing sign. The lesson is offered for a set price.

rites.name: Rornallia Teonor
rites.text: A tradeable combat technique sold by a merchant in a fortified refuge of a bustling walled city. It is offered for sale among other martial goods.

rites.name: Liranum Amoniallum
rites.text: A combat discipline taught through carved staves, and the teachers who sell it are found in several distant trading settlements.

rites.name: Nauntores Leornistor
rites.text: A scribe's craft for inscribing a sigil that lets the bearer blend into water and shift color like a sea lizard. A traveling merchant on the coastal edge of a trading town sells the lesson.

rites.name: Collia Ceontiases
rites.text: A reserved essence that gathers its power from the favor of allied communities. Only those who strike hard and fast in battle can draw upon it.

rites.name: Oreliasus
rites.text: A standing earned by repeatedly calling upon a courteous spirit of the elements for help. Each request made during long expeditions raises a traveler's esteem among such allies.

rites.name: Seontia Toria
rites.text: A temporary honor claimed by a healer who defeats a crystal-minded guardian and absorbs its gift. It lasts an hour and marks the bearer's name with a lasting epithet.

rites.name: Verniasanum
rites.text: A shared guild blessing lets members drift swiftly while spectral and return with heartier vitality after falling. It holds no effect inside sanctioned contest grounds.

rites.name: Nenor Tausum
rites.text: A temporary honorific bestowed on one who defeats a swarm-lord and absorbs its gift during a trial of champions. It fades after an hour, leaving only the title shown beside the bearer's name.

rites.name: Vaustianus
rites.text: A flying craft is awakened in a rider who completes a particular trial of training. Once learned, it lets the rider soar through open air on a winged beast.

rites.name: Valestanum Telornum
rites.text: A restless craving that settles on a wanderer who handles a sailor's cap from a harbor town. It grants a temporary surge of boldness to whoever carries it.

rites.name: Teliasernes
rites.text: A fierce burst drawn from a shifted beast form that quickly refills vital energy and briefly sharpens strikes. It leaves stealth intact and costs nothing to invoke, so it is best called before other actions.

rites.name: Lestiaror
rites.text: A lingering urge that settles on a traveler after they study a sea-chart of buried riches at a harbor town. It sharpens their instinct for finding hidden goods.

rites.name: Nauntaria
rites.text: A reasoning power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy sealed deep inside a dread spire. Those who gather these reserves can channel the power to weigh wrongdoing and fairness.

rites.name: Teorus Vasiaror
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets a warrior fight with a blade in each hand without losing strength. Strikes made with the off hand now count fully toward the damage of the chosen techniques.

rites.name: Oriarneonia Seralum
rites.text: A learned discipline of the monastic brewing orders, granted to every initiate who walks the path of the master brewers. It is absorbed without study once a monk takes that vocation.

rites.name: Serellum Telales
rites.text: A tide-born ability that any kind of wielder may awaken, but only through a certain kind of woven armor drawn from two storm-lashed coastal sites.

rites.name: Saunus Tenes
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack shared by every member of one small-folk people, which lets them move with quickened speed.

rites.name: Meostor Teleostares
rites.text: A tiered skill of the Arms discipline that a fighter unlocks at a high rank. It lets the practitioner hurl a foe to the ground with a single forceful move.

rites.name: Vinialium
rites.text: A lingering restorative sensation that a traveler gains after sampling a dark, bitter drink sold at a harbor market. It fades slowly and keeps the drinker alert.

rites.name: Telirenus
rites.text: A cunning practice that lets a wary trickster turn a rival's own greed against them. It is learned by those who have climbed far in the shadowy guilds of the trade.

rites.name: Veolus Variallanum
rites.text: A dark craving for drawn-in vital essence that a sworn caster may awaken at a shadowed sanatorium. Each day the draught grants a lasting strength for wandering the wilds until the next dawn of renewal.

rites.name: Tialentium
rites.text: A tide-like rush of water that a creature unleashes during a contest between companions. It sweeps across the field and batters the opponent.

rites.name: Tilentia Vaurernanum
rites.text: A crackling strike of stored energy that creatures of the arena can unleash against rivals during contests between tamed companions.

rites.name: Aminia Nausor
rites.text: A binding craft that carries a traveler back to an earlier moment, letting them undo a decisive happening that once reshaped a region. Keepers of the old hours wield it.

rites.name: Amentolor
rites.text: A practice that lets beings step across the flow of time as easily as crossing a room, often through arcane means. Some travelers alter past events while others only guide the course of a future they hope to reach.

rites.name: Sereolus Teleolum
rites.text: A stored inner force that a wanderer can draw out of hidden reserves tucked away in a dark, ruined spire. It bends the flow of moments and grants a power to whoever claims it.

rites.name: Lastirnum Ciastarnia
rites.text: A woven binding craft used by spellcasters to reinforce a charm. It connects to two other enchanted threads that share its magic.

rites.name: Neornia Valentiria
rites.text: A faint invisible sense that stirs within a bearer, drawn from hidden reserves found deep inside a grim dungeon-tower. It lets its user brush against things no eye can catch.

rites.name: Serauntonia
rites.text: A minor enchanted quality that any practitioner can draw out of a particular kind of protective garment. It is only found in garments recovered from two coastal holdfasts.

rites.name: Tentium Rernum
rites.text: A venom-laced strike used by reptilian beasts during contests between tamed companions. It poisons the target when it lands.

rites.name: Liasanum Tauntelanum
rites.text: A huntress uses this craft to sense the wild creatures nearby, revealing which ones are calm and which are hostile. It helps her shadow a prey, slip past dangerous packs, or locate a creature she hopes to tame.

rites.name: Casus Corillor
rites.text: A creature's protective secretion that a small amphibious beast releases during a contest of tamed companions. It is a defensive craft used in battles between pets.

rites.name: Narnus Coniasium
rites.text: A whirling strike that a small creature unleashes during a contest between tamed companions. The blow spins the air around its fist into a violent gust.

rites.name: Ameoristum Corentus
rites.text: A traveler accepts a summons and is whisked away to a distant resting place, unless a shifted form or a bound steed blocks the passage. Those refused must withdraw the call and seek it again.

rites.name: Neorosia
rites.text: A practitioner can call upon a bound technique that carries them instantly back to the spot where they last left a spiritual imprint. Another inner discipline shortens how long the technique must rest between uses.

rites.name: Ameollor Nestor
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a creature push through its opponent's defenses to strike at a fighting companion. The move is a common tactic among beasts that battle beside their trained partners.

rites.name: Tillor Reliasium
rites.text: A tide-bound power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit-essence within a dark, ruined spire. Its strength is gathered by those who venture into the tower's deepest vaults.

rites.name: Serillarnus Telinteorus
rites.text: A practice in which a teacher or book grants a student new abilities for payment. It can also describe a group pulling many foes at once, or several travelers moving in a single winding line.

rites.name: Vinalanum
rites.text: A transformative craft that reshapes common materials into a potent, living flame. It is passed down through written instruction sets taught to apprentice makers.

rites.name: Teleranum Rilium
rites.text: A passive hunter's discipline that shortens the recharge time of every snare a trapper sets and strengthens their effects. It is taught to specialists once they reach a high level of skill.

rites.name: Lentes Viasestium
rites.text: A lingering trait that lets practitioners of flame-craft carry faint sparks behind their workings. It is available only to those who wield fire.

rites.name: Ameonus Valiarnor
rites.text: A learned knack of the shadow-blade craft that sharpens a fighter's follow-up strikes whenever a companion turns aside an assault. It belongs to the deadly path of stealth killers and must be practiced for some time before it can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Nernor Corestus
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught to mender-keepers of the grove, letting their restorative rites draw less from their reserves. It sits in the fourth rank of the healing path and was later abandoned by the orders.

rites.name: Vestania
rites.text: A rogue's technique that passes the attention of foes from the thief to a chosen ally for a short span. The shift lapses if the rogue fails to strike soon after it is cast.

rites.name: Naustentia Teliasarnus
rites.text: A three-point formation where a single guardian faces the foe at any moment while the others strike from behind. Those fighting the beast spread themselves at equal angles to avoid crowding, though it struggles when the group must keep moving or evade hazards.

rites.name: Saunarnium
rites.text: A writhing limb conjured by a dark taint that seizes a chosen foe, draining their mind for ten seconds once the curse takes hold.

rites.name: Vares Lolum
rites.text: A dark devotional discipline practiced by sworn caster-clerics, it sharpens their shadowy incantations and steadies their aim, with the boost drawn from their inner spirit.

rites.name: Corenanum Cintia
rites.text: A fighter's skill that sometimes stirs a surge of fury with each blow landed in close combat. It suits warriors who strike rapidly with a weapon in each hand.

rites.name: Rirnum Amosentanum
rites.text: A learned talent of the spell-binding caster that lets a practitioner push past normal limits of inner power. It was once offered to casters who had reached the highest tier of their training.

rites.name: Rastus Vireonum
rites.text: A movement technique that lets a wanderer stroll along the bottom of the deep as though walking on dry ground. The wanderer can breathe, eat, drink, and ride a mount there, and moves faster on foot than before.

rites.name: Lialus Leonaulor
rites.text: A defensive art that a fighter masters only after gaining every other basic skill. It stands alone and is connected to no other skills.

rites.name: Telastanum Vontium
rites.text: A temporary blessing of sharpened thought that a person gains after forging a bond of fellowship. It lasts about an hour and is offered during a seasonal gathering of goodwill.

rites.name: Miarelor
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a bearer's hunger feed on life without ever being sated. It is bound to a second craft that spreads decay through the flesh.

rites.name: Telolaurum
rites.text: A withering curse that slowly drains a marked foe over time. Anyone who tries to strip the curse away is struck by a rebounding burst of harm and falls silent for a short while.

rites.name: Virnauranum
rites.text: A grim craft that lets a hunter of fiends turn their rivalry against rival hunters in open combat. It is gained once a practitioner reaches a set level of mastery.

rites.name: Marilor Sasium
rites.text: A deep-tier skill of the trickster's art that rewards a fighter who evades a blow with a counterstrike from their primary blade. It belongs to the upper ranks of the combat discipline.

rites.name: Amiantor Lireontes
rites.text: A sly skill of cunning hands that binds to a particular form of tainted cunning. It may only be chosen as an alternative to a rival talent.

rites.name: Coriraustum
rites.text: A learned knack held by those who train beasts for the hunt. It sharpens the blows a tamed companion deals in battle.

rites.name: Vaurniarus
rites.text: A bound-spirit gift lets a fierce blade-wielder unleash hidden fury. It is joined to a pair of chaos-forged twin weapons, a balanced-edge gift, and a swift-stride gift.

rites.name: Vaustus Nisialanum
rites.text: A passive defensive skill that a fighter of the warrior path gains upon reaching a set tier of experience. It keeps the bearer steady and shielded without any command being given.

rites.name: Tiaralles Canternus
rites.text: A tiered craft of wild shapeshifters that tears open the lifeblood of foes. It is an either-or choice paired with a savage rending art, drawing on the same well of ferocity.

rites.name: Taurnia Serialles
rites.text: A tireless arcane force that can be drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence. It lingers within deep, forsaken towers where wandering souls gather.

rites.name: Siarnus Voneoranum
rites.text: A ravenous craving that can be gained by touching one of the ancient scrolls found in a scorched realm. It is one of three possible blessings that such scrolls bestow on those who handle them.

rites.name: Valintum Valeontus
rites.text: A glyph-based craft that is drawn from a creature found in a dark stronghold. It is gained as a reward from defeating that creature.

rites.name: Nenus Seolor
rites.text: A dropped method of inscribing sigils that bends time, found within a fractured temporal rift in a sealed fortress. Its lore links it to that rift.

rites.name: Tiaralia
rites.text: A fierce surge of inner force is drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dark, cursed tower. Those who seize it gain a sharpened, reckless drive to break things apart.

rites.name: Teornium Seolaunia
rites.text: A dormant spiritual force that can be drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden deep within a grim, haunted spire of punishment. Wielders gain its power by seeking out these hoarded stores.

rites.name: Amornes Nialia
rites.text: A blood-bound trait that clings to a wielder's weapon and binds it to a feeding rite. It stands in close connection with two related rites that share its hunger.

rites.name: Lornia Amonor
rites.text: A carved mark that grants a short-lived boost of adaptability against a single chosen foe. Only one foe and one mark may be bound at a time for a span of seven days.

rites.name: Valantia Neollostus
rites.text: A volatile trick of drawing spectral energy out of hidden stores, found in buried reserves within a dreaded spiral prison. It is gathered by those who dare to raid such hoards.

rites.name: Cianentum
rites.text: A bloodthirsty trait carved into a sanguine weapon of the death knights. It works alongside several other inherited traits that share its dark kinship.

rites.name: Orasus Corirnoses
rites.text: A practitioner slips out of sight for a short span, becoming harder to perceive even amid fighting. Those who harm them still feel the blows, and the craft also shakes off binding snares.

rites.name: Oreosenium
rites.text: A disciplined art of drawing water-storm energy from the body. It is an exclusive path that cannot be taken alongside its paired technique, Vorthan Clasp.

rites.name: Maustares
rites.text: A practical craft of effects that aid travel, provisions, and perception rather than battle. Some strange battle-workings are also counted within it, and gentle versions may be cast only upon one's companions.

rites.name: Telosus Corestirnus
rites.text: A high-rank fighter's gift that can be chosen only by shieldbearers of one defensive discipline. It opens as an either-or branch alongside an opposing endurance gift.

rites.name: Monteorium
rites.text: A paladin's power of the bone-clad Ossuary Pact, open to any holy warrior who swears to it. It is granted temporarily during a certain trial and fades once that trial's tale is completed.

rites.name: Mostor Sintia
rites.text: A guardian's discipline that a warrior trains in a defensive path of study. Mastering it strengthens two of the warrior's strike techniques against foes.

rites.name: Corirum Serosia
rites.text: A trained discipline of a shadowy guild that raises a practitioner's stamina reserves, and its old teachings still shape how the guild's apprentices pace their strength.

rites.name: Vollentia
rites.text: A withdrawing strike that a wrathful hunter of fiends learns on their own. It lets the warrior fall back and gain ground at once, and it comes naturally to those who follow the reckless path of the hunt.

rites.name: Maselus
rites.text: A learned mark of rage that a hunter of the dark may carve into their craft once they reach a high level of skill. It drives them toward retaliation against those who have wronged them.

rites.name: Tistes Corases
rites.text: A pause-rite lets a caster delay the next rite for a set span, then calls it with chosen offerings. It helps when messages from the great hall arrive before their results have settled.

rites.name: Mentus Niaria
rites.text: A dark-leaning craft that a trained caster may use once a particular transformation is active, taking the place of a lesser flame technique. It belongs to a practice of summoning and binding.

rites.name: Tasanum Ameornaunus
rites.text: A kindled power of the soul that is gathered from hoarded reserves hidden within a dark, towering prison-keep. It lets its bearer clothe themselves in a fiery, feathered sheen.

rites.name: Tarelles
rites.text: A tamer's command that rouses a companion from feigned slumber. It is learned from a training manual and used by hunters on their beasts.

rites.name: Mastia Colium
rites.text: A withered art of spreading sickness that once belonged to a order of grave-warriors. It was later stripped away from their craft and no longer lies in use.

rites.name: Rarnontum Oriarillum
rites.text: A clever technique that lets a traveler slip past nearly any barrier by bending the way the world's physical rules behave. It was eventually removed from common use.

rites.name: Restianor Centilor
rites.text: A constant, unspoken instinct granted to a bound summoned guardian that sharpens its ability to evade blows and turn aside strikes. Guardians of a summoner's household rely on it in combat.

rites.name: Amirnalanum
rites.text: A charged rod that conjures a mirrored copy of a chosen ally. The copy cannot harm foes, is easily undone by blows, and fades after a short while.

rites.name: Nelliarum
rites.text: A innate gift that lets the people of this folk shift between their true shape and a second face they wear. The change moves freely between the two forms.

rites.name: Teliares Ventiaria
rites.text: A restless life-force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a grim spire of punishment. It grants its bearer an unstable surge of vital energy.

rites.name: Corium Orallernium
rites.text: A life-draining power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit energy hidden within a towering prison-fortress. It is gathered from those hoards and channeled as a force of vitality.

rites.name: Morus Teonoria
rites.text: A trained guardian's skill that draws the attention of hostile foes, compelling them to turn their strikes toward the one who holds the line. It is learned only after a long apprenticeship in defense.

rites.name: Amaullus Valirnes
rites.text: A permanent craft that imbues a blade with a rising stream of focus, each surge building quickly until it crests into a brief burst of heightened skill.

rites.name: Tisia Teleolanum
rites.text: A light effect that shines from enchanted blades and staves, appearing in many shades and strengths. Some luminous markings arise naturally from magical arms and cannot be replaced by any enchantment.

rites.name: Masauror Coronia
rites.text: A drifting power that lets a bearer shed their heaviness, gathered from sealed reservoirs hidden deep within a grim spiraling prison-tower.

rites.name: Oreolorium
rites.text: A set of ready combat postures a fighter chooses between, each granting distinct advantages suited to a particular battle role. Shifting between them carries a brief recovery delay.

rites.name: Neorenes
rites.text: A learned skill that a fighter studies in the combat path of a cunning trickster's craft. It must be pursued through many points of prior training before it can be mastered.

rites.name: Rauniasor
rites.text: A standing mark of renown earned by a traveler who has mastered every skill within the provisioning guild's craft of gathering and packing goods. It signals that the bearer is fully prepared for any journey.

rites.name: Meoles Seosanum
rites.text: A learned talent of cunning that a rogue chooses from a single exclusive branch of skill. It pairs with a planned-execution technique to sharpen how a schemer strikes.

rites.name: Teorium Vonirnor
rites.text: A fleeting hindrance that dulls a warrior's protective plating for half a minute. Several strikes can deepen the dullness, up to three layers.

rites.name: Coriarnia Liantes
rites.text: A mechanical sentinel draws on a sudden clamor to alert its allies during a contest of tamed creatures. The cry rouses the companion's side before a rival strikes.

rites.name: Tausonus Vistanum
rites.text: A gust-craft taught to wind-dancing adherents that heightens the strikes of companions standing nearby. It spreads a restless gale that makes every blow of the allied group land more often.

rites.name: Malestes
rites.text: A basic strike a fighter delivers without spending any stored resource. The harm it causes is marked with a pale glow, and a stronger version of such a blow is called a pale surge.

rites.name: Lasonor Seraurus
rites.text: A coming rite lets a wild shapeshifter fight with cruel, sharpened fingernails. It is learned by a fighter once they reach a set rank of experience.

rites.name: Amellia Lisauror
rites.text: A raw, untamed energy that creatures call upon in the middle of a contest of companions. It lets many different beasts unleash sudden, unpredictable power when they clash.

rites.name: Melleostia
rites.text: A fighter's technique that can be called up at a certain skill level. A chance-based surge grants two uses that cost no fury-energy.

rites.name: Viales Lesus
rites.text: A tiered practice that lets a fire-hurling charge shift into one of three alternate forms after each use. The next form can be foreseen while the charge gathers strength again.

rites.name: Leontoranum
rites.text: A dead people's inborn resolve that strips away enchantments of dread and dreaming from the mind. It cannot undo every hold on the soul, and it stands apart from a stronger, rarer resistance that bears its own cooldown.

rites.name: Tarolles
rites.text: A dark sorcerous trait that separates the afflicted caster's powers into fine layers. It is bound to a corrupting harvest-curse and to a companion trait that plants malignant seeds.

rites.name: Corallum Cirnaunium
rites.text: A swirling spinning maneuver that creatures of the sea and shore perform while locked in a contest of companions. It is used during the friendly bouts between tamed beasts.

rites.name: Sentum Telinus
rites.text: A tamed beast's lofted flight is triggered by a sharp command during a contest between companions. Its crowd-pleasing burst lands with surprising force.

rites.name: Sireolium Cellisor
rites.text: A consumable tincture that is brushed onto a blade to lend it arcane potency for a short time, sharpening its spellcraft and sometimes its chance of a deep strike. Most are brewed through the craft of runic binding, and later refinements forbid their use on finer, more advanced blades. A related elixir instead quickens the wielder's inner reserves of power.

rites.name: Cosillus
rites.text: A learned gift that sharpens the chance of a caster's fiercest blows. Each rank adds a little more likelihood of a devastating strike, from several fire and frost incantations alike.

rites.name: Reonanum Vintases
rites.text: A method of getting a fallen party back on its feet without sending anyone back to where they fell. It matters most when the path back is long and new foes may have appeared along it.

rites.name: Coraunum Teleosia
rites.text: A crafted toxin that could once be prepared by a shadow-trained fighter using a special technique. It is no longer available to make.

rites.name: Rolliasia
rites.text: A transforming blight that turns people into savage beast-folk, spreading through claws, bites, or tainted drink. Its victims debate whether it is a sickness or a gift, and no full remedy is known.

rites.name: Laustum Cantes
rites.text: A learned discipline that a novice of the timekeeping guild may choose to pursue once they earn standing with their order. It pairs with a companion practice that hastens a fighter's recovery between bouts.

rites.name: Orontus Tauristes
rites.text: A gathering craft that lets a practitioner draw raw ore-gems from the earth. It is picked up automatically once the cutting art of gem-working is mastered.

rites.name: Nianostus
rites.text: A learned gift of quickened motion that a follower may choose once their standing with the young ones reaches a modest rank. It stands as a branch alongside a power that halts the flow of moments.

rites.name: Siantenia
rites.text: A craft milestone reached by gathering and spending ten threads of a rare drawn fiber, which permanently strengthens a crafter's loom-line. Practitioners pursue it as a mark of skill.

rites.name: Mestium Taustes
rites.text: A protective craft that can be learned at a guild outpost once a practitioner earns favor with a particular circle of artificers. Learning it requires a sum of trade goods.

rites.name: Maullosia
rites.text: A tinkerer's mechanical forearm fires a concentrated burst of energy to strike an opponent during a contest between creatures. It is a technique a builder uses while her companion beasts battle.

rites.name: Nintium Lianes
rites.text: A tracking gift that lets a hunter take a single chosen path among several shooting arts. Choosing it locks out the other paths, and it pairs with a cunning trick of arrows.

rites.name: Amiarnelia
rites.text: A heavy technique in which a small creature hurls a weighty iron block onto a rival during a contest of tamed beasts. It is a signature move of its wielder.

rites.name: Amiastallus
rites.text: A mystic protective discipline that binds a woven ward to a bearer's defense. It is a single exclusive option that cannot be combined with a rival ward of the same craft.

rites.name: Mentiastum Telinia
rites.text: A tactic used by a tamed companion during a contest of beasts. It raises a nuisance barrier that wears down the opposing creature's attacks.

rites.name: Rollaurnes
rites.text: A card-borne craft that lets a wielder boost the strength of a chosen ally for a moment. It belongs to a set of tide-themed crafts.

rites.name: Ciaria Serintanum
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a wild shapeshifter draw upon the open air around them. It is shaped by the sky and bound to those who walk the wild paths.

rites.name: Telontum Sernosor
rites.text: A bowman's discipline that sharpens aim and lets the archer call a great hawk to retrieve fallen quarry. It must be chosen in place of a rival bond that ties the hunter to a single companion.

rites.name: Meosor Valintor
rites.text: A chosen gift of sunlit power that a warrior may claim along a particular path of devotion. Taking it excludes the rival gift that sits beside it on the same branch of training.

rites.name: Canteres Orisiastor
rites.text: A temporary blessing granted to those who stand within a gathered council of blue-robed envoys. It is earned through steady favor with that assembly and can be secured at a distant trading post in exchange for a modest sum of provisions.

rites.name: Callus Sereornium
rites.text: A bolstering effect that settles over a traveler while they remain within a certain assembly hall. It can be unlocked through study at a distant outpost once a person has earned favor with that hall's members.

rites.name: Amauntor Rerales
rites.text: A ruined craft that lets a wielder shatter armored metal with a single blow. It belongs to the trickster-scouts who fight by stealth and cunning.

rites.name: Amintiania
rites.text: A grim, heavy technique bound to a card of the Oathbreaker deck, used in a struggle to strike down a foe. It belongs to a set of cards born from a shattered vow.

rites.name: Manaulanum Ceonor
rites.text: A marksman's exclusive gift that is chosen as a single branch, set against another firing technique so that only one of the two may be learned.

rites.name: Misium Leostirnus
rites.text: A gathering trait that builds slowly across a bearer's ranks, bound to an exclusive choice that competes with a rival surging power. It draws on the craft of the artifact.

rites.name: Veontia Ceseornes
rites.text: A craft drawn from a tinker's satchel that calls forth a clockwork guardian to stand between its wielder and harm. The guardian serves as a shield for the one who summons it.

rites.name: Orilor Torium
rites.text: A channeling art wielded by a single kind of disciplined mender, drawing on heavenly currents. Other kinds of practitioners are instead granted a guardian spirit in its place.

rites.name: Vialleostes Sereores
rites.text: A restless tide-power that a bearer can call upon to stir the sea into turmoil. Its strength is drawn from the cost paid to awaken it.

rites.name: Meria Maurneranum
rites.text: A tuned gust-charm that a wielder can summon to lift and carry them across the field. It holds its breeze for a dozen heartbeats before fading.

rites.name: Seraulium Lialastia
rites.text: A bright, short-lived fervor that spreads through a bearer's ranks in an attacking push. It holds for a brief span of time before fading.

rites.name: Ceorolus Launasium
rites.text: A mage's craft that empowers hurled bolts with crackling energy. It can be chosen only in place of a rival technique that stores the same surge.

rites.name: Sones Serausum
rites.text: A keeper of bright sky-bursts lights colorful lanterns in a dusty trading town during a treasure festival. Travelers gather to watch the shimmering displays.

rites.name: Nosirnium
rites.text: A bound trait that a worker can draw upon to call forth one of three ruinous Netherkin servants. The cost of invoking it grows with each rank the bearer attains.

rites.name: Telanes Viastium
rites.text: A craftsman's attainment granted once a worker has gathered two hundred fifty bundles of dense timber. It allows the bearer to harvest that hard wood while remaining seated upon a mount.

rites.name: Corestirium
rites.text: A catching toxin that a bearer may spread to others through contact. It is recorded as a card-borne power of an ancient breaking-order.

rites.name: Lanium Manor
rites.text: A raging hunter's craft in which a burning aura is reshaped into a more ferocious blaze during a transformation, drawn out by a special inner talent.

rites.name: Rentes Taneria
rites.text: A disciplined practice that hardens a hunter's endurance through repeated training. It must be chosen in place of a rival watchful art, so only one can be taken.

rites.name: Valastentia Telontium
rites.text: A binding craft that a skilled inscriber can learn and perform to forge a sealed agreement. The renown earned from it grows with the quality of the object used.

rites.name: Larnium Serintus
rites.text: A bound ward-token that a holder may draw upon to call forth a defensive protection. It is one of the cards gathered within a sacred sky-crown collection.

rites.name: Viales Sarnaunium
rites.text: A trade-sold skill that a merchant in a harbor town offers to buyers. It is traded for coin.

rites.name: Ceolor Valelaranum
rites.text: A paired technique of a fighter's trained craft that is chosen exclusively alongside another skill from the same discipline. It sits as a single decision point in a warrior's developing repertoire.

rites.name: Corneontes Amasium
rites.text: A fighting technique that a skilled warrior may choose as a special path, requiring a finishing strike to be learned first. It can only be selected in place of other options.

rites.name: Telernor Tianontus
rites.text: A glowing thread is spun by skilled weavers at dawn, binding a wearer's mind to sharper clarity and a deeper well of inner energy. Higher grades of the thread grant greater strength to both.

rites.name: Oraullus Sirnor
rites.text: A bound flame-art that a chosen champion gains through the favor of a chaos-mother. It lets the user hurl a rapid volley of burning force across a battlefield.

rites.name: Niasia Rellium
rites.text: A narrow path of gathering darkness that a chosen caster can follow to deepen their hold over shadow. Choosing it closes off a rival path of the same circle.

rites.name: Orasum Meosontanum
rites.text: A rogue's gift of fate that is a single chosen node, held exclusively alongside a fortune-filled pouch. It marks a path of prophesied luck for those who take it.

rites.name: Corauntum Nialleoses
rites.text: A grim chill-craft that a warrior of the frozen north can learn once they have grown strong enough. It is used when fighting against other warriors in duels.

rites.name: Ceneollia
rites.text: A bonded hunter's path that empowers a transformed warrior's signature strikes. Each enhanced technique takes on a fiercer, renamed form while the warrior holds the altered state.

rites.name: Sesiarum
rites.text: A shadowy gift that a hunter can take as a chosen ability, locked against a rival grave-harvesting path. Choosing it closes off the other option.

rites.name: Lianum Valesia
rites.text: A gift of dark, scarred strength granted to certain hunters of fiends. Those bearing a different kind of inner void receive a related but separate surge instead.

rites.name: Naulasus Amastor
rites.text: A tactic that companions use during contests between tamed creatures. It lets a fighter probe a foe's weaknesses before striking.

rites.name: Telauleones Vontiranum
rites.text: A tactic that lets a trained companion creature withdraw from a contest of skirmishes on purpose. The beast falls back to safety instead of pressing on.

rites.name: Mauror Teosenor
rites.text: A specialized calling taken by a caster of fire-magic. It is a choice path that binds its user to a particular ember-linked discipline.

rites.name: Casiastanum
rites.text: A trait of resolute stamina that a traveler gains by earning standing with a guild of time-wanderers. It works as a branching choice tied to a charismatic temporal gift.

rites.name: Liarus Valiares
rites.text: A hunter's exclusive talent that competes with a rival calming technique for the same choice slot. The two cannot be learned together.

rites.name: Amasiallia Veoniantia
rites.text: A mage's innate attunement to the forces of heat and cold, chosen as one of a select pair of paths. Taking it locks out the other options in its branch.

rites.name: Telistes Telestia
rites.text: A binding ritual etched onto a wrist guard that draws life from wounds into the wearer. The strength of the drain depends on how finely the rite was carved.

rites.name: Riallonus
rites.text: A peak gift granted to spellcasters who wield ruinous fire. It marks the highest mastery available to those who channel devastating flame.

rites.name: Reonia Saunernium
rites.text: A crafted inscription that is forged through a skilled arcane discipline and imparted by a written formula. It is applied to headgear to grant the wearer heightened evasion.

rites.name: Valostes Cialleres
rites.text: A tempest-craft gift that lets a spirit-caller unleash a jolt of crackling sky-fire. It is chosen alternately with the lightning-channel path.

rites.name: Amirnaunor
rites.text: A craft that binds a swift wind-spirit into a wearer's torso, lending nimbleness and quickness. The strength of the blessing grows with the skill of the binding.

rites.name: Reorum Seroraules
rites.text: A craft-binding laid upon a garment that draws a portion of harm dealt by its wearer back into their own flesh. The strength of the drawing depends on how finely the binding was made.

rites.name: Oreorium Reostor
rites.text: A craft of binding quickness into a worn outer garment, so that the wearer moves faster. The strength of the swiftness depends on how finely the binding is made.

rites.name: Seresorium
rites.text: A carved mark is inscribed onto a lengthy war-blade's haft, giving its wielder greater striking force. It is made by applying a prepared binding to a sheet of cured hide.

rites.name: Listium Coreontium
rites.text: A tailoring rite woven into a cloak that draws a small share of the wearer's harm back as restorative vitality. The strength of the binding decides how much mending the cloak can provide.

rites.name: Manteonus
rites.text: A craft of inscribing rings with a binding script that raises the wearer's adaptability. The strength of the bonus depends on how finely the inscription is made.

rites.name: Coraustia Vauntus
rites.text: A crafting technique that can be applied to a tool to make it handle more nimbly. The strength of the bonus depends on how refined the working is.

rites.name: Sauronum
rites.text: A crafted enchantment that is made through a practiced arcane discipline and learned from a written formula. It is passed down to those who study the recipe.

rites.name: Veosistum
rites.text: A craftsman's inscription that is set into a torso garment during forging, granting the wearer greater mental clarity and reserves of arcane energy. Its strength depends on how skillfully it was carved.

rites.name: Riallontus
rites.text: A ward of binding wrought onto a torso garment, granting its wearer added brawn and endurance. The strength of the blessing rises with the skill of the artisan who inscribes it.

rites.name: Talles Naullontium
rites.text: A craft inscription that is worked onto a wrist guard to draw vitality from the wearer's foes. How much is drawn depends on how finely the inscription is made.

rites.name: Cirneones
rites.text: A concealed trick that lets those who hide among furnishings send out a brief burst of strange energy. It is awakened through a special refinement that a practitioner must earn.

rites.name: Cestanum Telintia
rites.text: A craft that binds a glowing boost to a ring, strengthening the wearer's adaptability. The strength of the gain rises with the quality of the binding.

rites.name: Valirnum Orelium
rites.text: A ritual inscription that a skilled artisan can channel into a blade, granting it a greater chance to land decisive strikes. The potency of the bond depends on how fine the craft was.

rites.name: Oreosenium Amiastontia
rites.text: A craft that binds swift, restless energy into the edge of a blade, letting its wielder move faster in battle. The strength of the bond depends on how well the craft is performed.

rites.name: Rellum Oranentes
rites.text: A taught inscription that a practiced artisan can etch onto a blade to sharpen its power. The strength of the boost rises with the quality of the etching.

rites.name: Amesanum Verasus
rites.text: A craft of binding a swift, nimble spirit into footwear so the wearer moves with quickened agility. The art is learned automatically once a particular martial discipline is mastered.

rites.name: Seralium Nontia
rites.text: A binding ritual etched onto wrist guards that grants the wearer quicker movement. The strength of the swiftness depends on how skillfully the rite was performed.

rites.name: Lentor Senium
rites.text: A craft that binds a faint shimmer into a cloak, granting its wearer a greater ability to slip past harm. The strength of the effect rises and falls with the skill of the maker.

rites.name: Tasum Tistus
rites.text: A chosen discipline of the night hunter, bound to a special path where a smoke-cloud veil is taken alongside it. Only one of its paths may be walked by a given marksman.

rites.name: Tiallornia
rites.text: A craft by which a wearer's footwear is infused to hasten movement across the land. The strength of the swiftness depends on how refined the infusion is.

rites.name: Soleria
rites.text: A craft-binding that a skilled artisan can impress upon a blade, granting the wielder swifter movement and quicker strikes. The strength of the blessing rises with the care and skill of its making.

rites.name: Lirniarium Oresanum
rites.text: A craft applied to a blade that grants its wielder added adaptability in combat. The strength of the effect rises and falls with the skill and quality of the inscription.

rites.name: Riantia Oreonia
rites.text: A battle-craft practiced by the Ashen Vanguard, a sworn order of blade-wielding hunters of monstrous beings. It is a rising style of combat that grows fiercer as a fight goes on.

rites.name: Telesalanum Launtinium
rites.text: A dormant trait that a certain war-bearing wielder can awaken to heighten their combative fury. Its cost is left unspecified in the record.

rites.name: Rauntum Neontilia
rites.text: A set of four ways to move between marked points: straight-line blending, instant snapping, gentle wave smoothing, and a finer curved smoothing that needs at least four marks, otherwise it falls back to the gentle wave.

rites.name: Amelintium
rites.text: A learned gift of the breath that enlarges the chest and wind of a fire-wielding caster. It can be taken in place of its paired ember-kindling art, never both at once.

rites.name: Valiantus Seristanum
rites.text: A practiced trick that lets a user slip a short distance in a blink and remain unseen for a few heartbeats. It is a utility craft used to escape or reposition unnoticed.

rites.name: Mesaurnanum Oraunes
rites.text: A tactic used by companion beasts during contests of skill, where a creature delivers a sharp blow aimed at the opponent's head.

rites.name: Ameolianor Corelantus
rites.text: A glimmering state of sight that is awakened when a bearer uses a bundle of prize tokens won by a zealous hero. It alters how the wearer's gear appears.

rites.name: Conium Sesialum
rites.text: A watchful dimming laid upon outsiders who enter a distant grove, causing the local guardians to regard them as hostile. It spreads a sense of being observed by unseen wardens.

rites.name: Oreornium Venallor
rites.text: A restorative gift granted to believers within a sealed order of crowns. It draws strength from devotion to mend wounds and weariness.

rites.name: Niseoles
rites.text: A passive gift that a hunter selects from a branching set of options, paired with a rival gift that cannot be taken alongside it. It belongs to the Havoc path of hunters.

rites.name: Telaustilia
rites.text: A driving inner drive that a certain artifact trait bestows, pushing its bearer toward relentless striving. It is tied to a costly bargain, though the exact price is not specified.

rites.name: Sontia Marisia
rites.text: A sharpened inner clarity that a bearer can draw upon to steady their attention. It is bound into a card-like sigil and belongs to a sealed collection of similar gifts.

rites.name: Varnum Lentarium
rites.text: A tracking charm that a hide-cutter can cast to reveal creatures carrying richer hides. Marked beasts glow with a crimson rim and sparkle, and show on the hunter's map.

rites.name: Tiarneosus
rites.text: A trained maneuver in which a warrior slips away from danger in a sharp, precise motion. It can be taken only in place of another technique that favors relentless attack.

rites.name: Oraliares Loria
rites.text: A swirling technique of the battlefield that lets a wielder move far more swiftly. It is used for attack and rushing forward across the field.

rites.name: Nastes Tolliasum
rites.text: A card-borne ability that lets its bearer take on a fierce feline shape. It belongs to a set of heavenly crown relics.

rites.name: Sintia Salus
rites.text: A glowing sphere of fire-craft that a caster can choose to draw alongside a companion lung-breath discipline. The two are mutually exclusive, so only one can be taken.

rites.name: Malorum
rites.text: A craft of reversed power drawn from a bound collection of deeds. It belongs to a set that marks a broken oath.

rites.name: Relor Contes
rites.text: A learned craft of ruinous flame that a practitioner masters at a high level of skill. Its effects grow stronger as the practitioner's inner attunement deepens.

rites.name: Maleria Miseria
rites.text: A small burst of insight into gem cutting that is granted as a reward for completing commissions from patrons who order jeweled works. It arrives as a fleeting spark of craft understanding.

rites.name: Viales Taurnum
rites.text: A bound technique that channels a stream of fire along a thrown shaft. It belongs to a deck of ability cards tied to a single collected set.

rites.name: Taullenes
rites.text: A hunting trick taught to falcon handlers in an early trial period. It lets a trained bird dive upon prey from great height.

rites.name: Tianes Teontes
rites.text: A grim inner discipline that lets a bearer answer an injury by reaching across time. It grants a rank of retaliation that bends the moment of harm back against its source.

rites.name: Teleostium Coriasium
rites.text: A shimmering formula that conjures a false layer of brilliance over a wearer's garments. It is found inside a sealed cache that opens only once a week after a particular errand is completed.

rites.name: Ceranum Coreostanum
rites.text: A rite that appears within a contest between tamed creatures, used by beings who hold a steward's authority. It is said to belong to the mightiest keepers' companions.

rites.name: Amilium Valisolor
rites.text: A dark mark that strengthens every foe within certain deep vaults while a guardian ward is raised. It alters how the hostile creatures fight during a sealed trial.

rites.name: Risellus
rites.text: A bound book of enchantment formulae that a trader offers for sale at a coastal harbor, priced in a common craft currency and a rare glowing mineral.

rites.name: Visus Niraullor
rites.text: A bound scroll of recorded arcane patterns, traded by a wandering researcher from a windswept cliff amid unstable skies. Its price is paid in a rare crafting reagent and a dim glowing powder.

rites.name: Carninor
rites.text: A fierce bound technique a tracker may learn along a leader's path of the wild. It can be taken only in place of another allied skill.

rites.name: Orasanum Sarnanum
rites.text: A moon-marked card crafted through a special inscription method, or acquired from a traveling sage on an island. Gathering several cards from the same moon suit combines them into a deck.

rites.name: Conteornia
rites.text: A reagent-bound scroll of arcane instruction that can be won as a spoil from three distant bosses. Studying it lets a crafter inscribe a deep-sea dominion into a blade.

rites.name: Nestia Collantium
rites.text: A mountain warrior's gift that draws storm-heavy skies overhead. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside the Thunder Oath mighty pact.

rites.name: Oreornanum Corialus
rites.text: A tamed companion unleashes a flaring burst of force during a contest between beasts. It is a technique that creatures employ when battling in the ring.

rites.name: Venasus
rites.text: A bound grasp of cursed force that a lone bearer can call upon. It drags down foes through a card-like sigil of old craft.

rites.name: Rantanum Larus
rites.text: A dark-craft talent that a soul-reaping sorcerer may choose in place of another. It stands opposed to a rival way of grasping shadowed allies.

rites.name: Amaliarnia
rites.text: A crafted enchantment that is made by a skilled artisan and can be used to take on the appearance of a stone-kin for a while. The length of the disguise depends on how fine the enchantment is.

rites.name: Rernia Valolaurum
rites.text: A dark practice a summoner learns to draw forth a devouring art while the beast-servant is not standing at their side. It cannot be combined with its rival practice, the lord of lesser fiends.

rites.name: Telirnus Amornum
rites.text: A tracking gift once granted to a companion beast at a certain stage of its training. It let the bond-keeper sense certain kinds of wild creatures, though each companion could only follow its own kind, and the gift was later replaced by more focused tracking techniques.

rites.name: Vialium Leorus
rites.text: A craft that opens to those who have earned high standing among a guild of underground traders. It is granted only after a long climb through the rankings of that guild.
