rites.name: Casum Naulleontor
rites.text: A chilling blessing that a hooded trickster may call upon during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets the caller's companion weather hardship in the struggle.

rites.name: Sastianor
rites.text: A bitter technique in which a wielder channels a fierce spite into a contest between tamed companions. It is used during such bouts to unsettle the opposing beast.

rites.name: Amarnus Orises
rites.text: A chosen discipline among three options that a practitioner reaches at a mature stage of training. Taking it means forgoing the other two alternatives.

rites.name: Taullor Ceolus
rites.text: A soothing binding craft used by allied creatures during a contest of tamed beasts. It mends the wounds of a companion in the middle of the fray.

rites.name: Cinor Amaullenor
rites.text: A brief reckless surge of motion that a wanderer can pick up alongside a related fierce dash, the two choices locking out one another.

rites.name: Cises Ceosum
rites.text: A dormant trait lying within a thief's cloaked blade that awakens a hidden form once its bearer finds it. Reaching this unseen potential marks a rare mastery earned by the wandering shadow-stalker.

rites.name: Tiarnasia Orisarnes
rites.text: A bound oath that lets a fallen warrior call upon the mounted dead. Choosing it closes off a rival pledge taken alongside the same sworn covenant.

rites.name: Telauntus Tianisum
rites.text: A mark-bearing trait that a wielder can take on, with its cost rising as it is strengthened in layered grades.

rites.name: Cirnor Tiases
rites.text: A creature's bellowed declaration that it has taken its own form during a contest between tamed beasts. The call strengthens its bearer for the duration of the match.

rites.name: Ronallium
rites.text: A tactical trick that amplifies the strength of a nearby power for a short time. It is drawn from a card-based contest of rival elemental forces.

rites.name: Malaurum
rites.text: A craft that weaves a shimmering false glow over a wearer's gear. The duration of the glamour depends on how skillfully the charm was worked.

rites.name: Sistum Nillanum
rites.text: A covert technique in which a practitioner slips unseen into a guarded territory. It belongs to a shared craft of carefully arranged battles between elemental forces.

rites.name: Rises Sariantium
rites.text: A glamour inscribed with glowing marks that disguises the surface of an object with a false appearance. Its duration depends on how finely the inscription is crafted.

rites.name: Cania Marnum
rites.text: A ranked gift of kindling for spellcasters, granted as one exclusive path that pairs with a deeper study of fire-binding. Choosing it closes off rival paths.

rites.name: Viasantanum Laustonanum
rites.text: A craft that wraps an object in a shimmering frost-like illusion. The glamour's duration depends on how well the enchantment is made.

rites.name: Seostenanum
rites.text: A craftsman's trained skill that sometimes returns part of the focus spent while making goods. It is a knack for working a trade with a clever hand.

rites.name: Tirnia Valeornia
rites.text: A refined mode of drawing on the emptiness between worlds, granting a practitioner an enhanced surge of dark force. It can only be chosen in place of one other discipline.

rites.name: Mises Meonastanum
rites.text: A refined skill of the hunter's craft that refines the flow of aimed shots. It cannot be taken alongside its rival technique, forcing a choice between paths.

rites.name: Coresium Veoses
rites.text: A fighter's talent that a single battle discipline may learn. It forms one of two mutually exclusive options that cannot be taken alongside its rival technique.

rites.name: Vernia Vaulanum
rites.text: A fiery craft that a fire-wielding duelist can learn once they reach a certain stage of training. It is used in contests between rival practitioners.

rites.name: Caustum Sallus
rites.text: A bound talent of relentless advance, granted to one who has already chosen a particular ending. It is a choice that cannot be taken alongside another paired path.

rites.name: Siastum Tosaullor
rites.text: A learned gift of boundless swiftness that a practitioner can choose once their standing with a temporal mending guild is high enough. It pairs with a rival craft of preserved memory.

rites.name: Lenaurium
rites.text: A dark talent that a warlock of the cult may choose, sharing a branch with another paired gift. Taking one of the two closes off the other.

rites.name: Ceollentor Caunia
rites.text: A refined technique of sacred striking that was once taught as a separate art. It was later folded into the basic form of the strike, so every practitioner now learns it from the start.

rites.name: Tianum Valenanum
rites.text: A shimmering veil of borrowed sky that a crafter weaves over a surface to mask its true look. The finer the weaving, the longer the deception holds before it fades.

rites.name: Nastanum Reostum
rites.text: A hunter's talent that forms an exclusive choice alongside another tranquilizing technique, so only one of the two can be taken.

rites.name: Meosilum
rites.text: A bound tome of swift blessings is offered for sale by a merchant in a harbor town. It is traded for coin in a busy port market.

rites.name: Sauntor Rastum
rites.text: A bound book of sacred writings that a merchant sells in a harbor trading town. It is offered for a price left unstated.

rites.name: Lanus Oranialus
rites.text: A tangled binding technique used by the brood of a serpent deity during contests between tamed creatures. It entangles an opponent in a coil of scales.

rites.name: Sernostum
rites.text: A swift aerial technique that lets a rider surge through the sky. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive option alongside a spinning momentum technique.

rites.name: Nases Sastanum
rites.text: A bound volume of sacred writings that a merchant offers for sale in a coastal harbor town. It is sold for an unstated price.

rites.name: Coreontilus
rites.text: A proven triumph awarded to those who clear a dangerous gauntlet at a high challenge tier before the clock runs out. It grants the bearer a hidden passage spell tied to a rogue's path.

rites.name: Vestiantes Oraureones
rites.text: A tuned sight that lets a caster perceive the threads of hidden energy running between places. It is a restricted choice that cannot be taken alongside a shard of pure essence.

rites.name: Saures Varum
rites.text: A draining contagion that a card-borne craft can call forth, sapping the vigour of a foe over time. It belongs to a set of craft-scrolls bound to a celestial relic.

rites.name: Norum Coraulium
rites.text: A mastery of tidal lore is earned by a seeker who has studied every guild ward upgrade of the storm-caller craft. It marks full command of the mentor-circles' teachings.

rites.name: Ciallus Telernaunes
rites.text: A grim ledger-curse marks a sovereign's victims, binding her strength to a timed frenzy that lapses unless another falls before the count runs out. Those who wish to break it must sacrifice someone in a precise cycle.

rites.name: Amistus Misum
rites.text: A bonded trial that a devoted patron takes up within a merchant guild's reward circle. Completing it strengthens the wielder's striking power and capacity to mend allies.

rites.name: Vintaulanum
rites.text: A flowing charge of arcane energy that a caster can draw upon during battle. It is drawn from a card-based set of ancient war lore.

rites.name: Meornentor Relaurnanum
rites.text: A tiered reward bond offered by a merchant guild to its most faithful clientele. Completing its final trial strengthens a member's offensive and restorative power by a larger share than before.

rites.name: Teleornus Melonia
rites.text: A crafted charm that calls forth a sky-bound healer to restore a fallen wanderer and their companions to life. It is assembled by a skilled artificer and learned through a specialized path of mechanical study.

rites.name: Valianostia
rites.text: A dimly glowing rule that marks certain lesser foes with shimmering dust, weakening them slightly and offering a steady route for newcomers. Defeating the marked foes counts toward the full tally, and falling in battle does not shorten the countdown.

rites.name: Amallum Maurnor
rites.text: A dark binding craft that replaces one summoning rite with another, calling forth a shadowed hound instead of a vile beast. It cannot be chosen alongside a rival sigil of the same school.

rites.name: Caullum Menium
rites.text: A stalker's rite that brands a chosen foe with a hidden sigil, granting the wielder a deadly edge against that target. It is a talent passed down among cunning hunters.

rites.name: Neristum Laserum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of the wild can call upon during contests of beasts. It lets a companion summon a buzzing horde of insects to strike its rival.

rites.name: Viliaria
rites.text: A bearer gathers charged air for a brief moment and holds it as a shield that absorbs the next blow. Any strike, however small, sets off the shield's secondary effects.

rites.name: Orellus Vintoles
rites.text: A high rank of standing that a patron earns by completing a loyalty trial for a merchant guild. It strengthens the bearer's strength in both harm and mending.

rites.name: Valeosum Seoniallium
rites.text: A reward-bound oath that a loyal patron earns from a merchant guild's favor circle. Upon completing its trial, the bearer's strikes hit harder and their mending grows stronger.

rites.name: Amialanus
rites.text: A ritual gift granted to devoted caster-healers that lets them choose one exclusive path of lunar power. Choosing it closes off the alternative branch that rests on arcane attunement.

rites.name: Ciastelus
rites.text: A coined transmutation craft drawn from an alchemical tradition of an eastern realm. Practitioners discover it through a study of changing matter and can use it once per day to make mercury-based reagents, such as a flowering blessing bloom and a clawed iron ore.

rites.name: Viantia Tiastilia
rites.text: A potent enchantment lets a wielder seize the will of a wild beast in the barren wastes, binding it as a loyal guardian for a short while. The bond holds across returns to the region until a different enchantment is chosen.

rites.name: Varostor
rites.text: A reckless burst of hostile momentum that a wanderer can channel to drive forward with intimidating force. It can only be chosen in place of a rival technique that amplifies the same rush.

rites.name: Amiallor Tarentium
rites.text: A passive craft of dark binding that lets a practitioner invoke a lingering curse while in their transformed shape. It belongs to the arts of summoned shadow-servants.

rites.name: Liror Serenium
rites.text: A binding technique that companion beasts use during contests of trained creatures, swathing an opponent in layered bands to hinder its movement.

rites.name: Cisarnor Nellosium
rites.text: A dark practice in which a caster draws strength from the fallen, granting a hero a sinister talent drawn from draining souls.

rites.name: Masteonor
rites.text: A fleeting skill of the hunter's craft that a wanderer may take as one choice, and it cannot be paired with the Pathfinder's gift.

rites.name: Collus Lales
rites.text: A tide of shadowed wingbeats that a dragonrider draws upon as a personal power. It marks the warrior as a commander of the reptilian skyfolk.

rites.name: Visarum
rites.text: A hidden store of nightly study that must be earned before it can be spent. It advances a crafter's chosen branches of arcane work once the crafter reaches a basic level of skill.

rites.name: Valauseolum
rites.text: A dressing that is unlocked by performing a particular guiding rite. It is granted only to those who have mastered that rite's method.

rites.name: Viastanum Valeontia
rites.text: A protective technique that a tamed companion raises during a contest between beasts. It guards the creature from incoming harm for the length of the match.

rites.name: Amaurnes Mallium
rites.text: A nocturnal craft of marking runes onto surfaces under darkness. Practitioners learn it from masters in distant cities and can advance steadily through its stages.

rites.name: Mirnia Amantus
rites.text: A tactic that companions employ during a duel between beasts, letting them churn the ground beneath foes. It belongs to the combat craft of tamed creatures.

rites.name: Valausia Valor
rites.text: A recurring alchemical change that can be performed once each day. It yields a set of crafting reagents used to create other magical materials.

rites.name: Vaullum Leosaunum
rites.text: A dark craft that transforms materials through a daily-limited process. It yields murky reagents used for crafting shadowy components.

rites.name: Tausanum Malesium
rites.text: A tactical technique that companion beasts use while contesting a duel between tamed creatures. It lets a fighter strike with sharp, precise force.

rites.name: Narelles
rites.text: A standing honor granted once a single member of a traveling band has reached the highest tier of skill. It grants the whole company a modest boost to how quickly they learn along the path toward that tier.

rites.name: Rirnes Orellanor
rites.text: A transforming craft of the alchemists that can be performed once each day. It turns plant matter into several kinds of herbs used in brewing and preparing remedies.

rites.name: Riantor Ceornanum
rites.text: A skill that lets a digger who holds a single rank in a sealed mastery tradition gather a surge of fiery essence from the earth. The gathered essence is stored for later use.

rites.name: Tiastellus
rites.text: A hidden route that carries a traveler instantly to a waiting threshold, granted as a prize for completing a dangerous trial. It lets its bearer slip past guards and checkpoints without being seen.

rites.name: Serintalia Ristanum
rites.text: A hunter's technique that tears through the shadowy barrier between worlds. It arises when a bladed weapon transforms during a surge of fierce, ravenous power.

rites.name: Nauntestus
rites.text: A learned skill that comes automatically to anyone who has mastered a gem-working craft. It lets the practitioner search raw stone for valuable ore.

rites.name: Teristes Males
rites.text: A ward-craft is gathered from hoarded relics found while descending into deep caverns. Its bearer draws on it to repel harm during such descents.

rites.name: Vaulintia
rites.text: A finishing dressing that a crafter can prepare and apply while sewing garments, keeping stitched work from fraying. It is learned by those who master fine weaving and decorative needlework.

rites.name: Orestium Naustum
rites.text: A bonded power that is unlocked when a wearer fully empowers a binding garment by gathering fifteen drifting threads. These threads can be collected from many hazardous places and contests alike.

rites.name: Neostanum Moranor
rites.text: A sealed vial of tainted residue that can be bought from a hollow keeper in a sanctum of blood. The stronger the taint it carries, the greater the potency it bestows on its bearer.

rites.name: Amireostus Meosus
rites.text: A sealed vial of murky residue that a keeper sells in exchange for gathered gloom. Stronger doses grant greater effects, scaling with how much darkness they carry.

rites.name: Raunus Soliastor
rites.text: A minor enchantment that can be bestowed upon a wrist guard, appearing now and then during trial periods. Traders known for their sorcerous wares sell it to those who seek it.

rites.name: Ceornenor
rites.text: A minor charm of cloth-binding that a few traders sometimes offer for trial use. Two merchant-sellers are said to carry it, lending the wearer a small boost of nimbleness.

rites.name: Telestia Coriales
rites.text: A caster's incantation is stalled whenever a blow lands during the working, lengthening the wait before it completes. Sustained rituals, by contrast, are cut short by such strikes, ending sooner and wasting their stored power.

rites.name: Vostor Oriastaunus
rites.text: A piercing mental shriek that a gifted caster can unleash to rattle the minds of nearby foes. It belongs to a deck of abilities drawn from an old sea-cycle.

rites.name: Oreonoria
rites.text: A touch-based power that reveals the past of a held object, though it drains the wielder's mind and is never precise. Later, a lens-and-rune device lets its user view such echoes as moving images.

rites.name: Amauleoses
rites.text: A trial enchantment that a few traveling merchants offer now and then, sold by sellers of charmed goods and hard-bargaining peddlers alike.

rites.name: Siastium Seranintium
rites.text: A minor sorcerous inscription that a few traders offer to people who test new wares. It is sold by two merchants known for their bony, weathered looks and their dealings in such enchantments.

rites.name: Relles Salliarus
rites.text: A minor enchantment that can be bound onto a pair of boots, sometimes offered by traders who deal in such magic. It is occasionally found in circulation during the trial period of a new craft.

rites.name: Relantes
rites.text: A fallen ally can be roused back to standing by a helper who channels a restoring spell at their side. If no one intervenes within half a minute, the ally rises alone, though without earning any honor.

rites.name: Vestilor
rites.text: A specially earned training pattern that becomes available once a particular arsenal of arms is put to use. It changes how the arms are carried and shown in practice.

rites.name: Telesteosor Seriales
rites.text: A specialized calling that a monk may take up in place of rival paths. It is a chosen discipline whose force lands hard upon whoever wields it.

rites.name: Oreoliria
rites.text: A dark mustering rite in which a grim warrior gathers twenty hall-bound fighters into their ranks. Completing the call marks the commander as a worthy recruiter of this sworn host.

rites.name: Riallus Vaules
rites.text: A quickening that is gained from a wild secret art, granted within a blue gathering hall of the assembly. It is sought by those who wish to swiftly sharpen their own abilities.

rites.name: Teollium Orestus
rites.text: A lasting blessing spreads across every member of a gathered company, growing stronger each week until it reaches a quarter of its full measure.

rites.name: Valareosia
rites.text: A protective charm that a caster binds onto allies, shielding them from burning harm. It can be layered together with other guardian wards for added defense.

rites.name: Orosium Laustorus
rites.text: A tuned discipline that becomes open to practitioners once they reach a set standing within a ruling council's favor. It draws on sympathetic vibration to strengthen one's presence.

rites.name: Mirnum Rintarnus
rites.text: A passive quiet-rider discipline that switches off the bond of carrying companions for mounts able to bear them. It is a mutually exclusive option against the open-carry bond.

rites.name: Maustor Corerus
rites.text: A glowing technique that creepbeasts employ while contesting one another in a bout. It lets a captured companion unleash bright beams during such contests.

rites.name: Lasor Seostor
rites.text: A practitioner's trained technique of striking with a sudden rush of breeze-swift motion. It belongs to one lineage of chosen disciplines, and it can be taken in place of a rival path.

rites.name: Taustarnia
rites.text: A carved mark set into a ring that teaches its bearer how to fight with short blades. It is passed on through workshops that train apprentices in the knife-craft of the old guilds.

rites.name: Orontauria
rites.text: A learnable discipline that can be studied at the cost of a set sum of awakening currency. Once learned, it joins the pool of powers that a special crafting kit can grant during a mechanical awakening.

rites.name: Seriseontor
rites.text: A loose parchment found as a common spoil of the field. When paired with a mind-sharpening charm or a reading incantation, it can be shaped into a practical tool.

rites.name: Taulostanum
rites.text: A craft of examining raw earth to draw out hidden gems. Anyone who learns the gem-cutting trade picks up this sifting skill along the way.

rites.name: Nausellor
rites.text: A glowing marking that a crafter can unlock by using a particular set of tools. It changes how a tool looks without changing what it does.

rites.name: Orenum Tasorus
rites.text: A week-long blessing that stays alive while a certain dark forge trial holds its rotating challenge. It amplifies the standing a traveler earns with four named patrons.

rites.name: Veollianum Orauntor
rites.text: A hunter's rune that changes its shape during a fierce transformation. Once the hunter enters that state, the mark becomes a stronger, darker version of its former self.

rites.name: Nintium Meorolium
rites.text: A week-long blessing that stirs while the Hollow Sanctum stands as the current trial. It boosts standing earned with three allied clans by half again.

rites.name: Caurnum Taurnes
rites.text: A protective technique that creatures of the wild sometimes call upon while contesting in a beast duel. It hardens the body into a guarding shell.

rites.name: Viarneolor
rites.text: A temporary blessing sealed onto travelers during a festival of descent into the deep places. It enlarges the bounty gathered from each underground expedition by a quarter.

rites.name: Ciallintes Serilonium
rites.text: A discharge of sudden force that a priest may channel as a heroic talent. It is chosen in place of a rival talent, never alongside it.

rites.name: Amirialanum
rites.text: A set of later-added tomes that grant lasting, always-available skills, smoothing out everyday inconveniences. Unlike temporary inscriptions, a learned skill never fades away.

rites.name: Varillanum
rites.text: A combat skill that lets a warrior of the holy order unleash a flash of radiant light against rival fighters in open contests. It becomes available once the warrior reaches a mid-tier rank of training.

rites.name: Taulum Neostanus
rites.text: A lingering mark that settles on fully grown travelers during a recurring week-long festival of time. It grants them a temporary boost of strength.

rites.name: Cernosium
rites.text: A resonant strike technique that a tamed companion unleashes during a contest between beasts. It shatters the foe's guard with a burst of humming force.

rites.name: Amiasteones Verniasum
rites.text: A tracking technique that companion creatures employ during a contest of beasts, letting them detect hidden foes by their scent.

rites.name: Viallanum Orianornes
rites.text: A tactic that lets creatures bound to a battle-partner unleash a surge of thick muck to strike their rivals. It is used during contests between tamed companions.

rites.name: Teollanum Orenorum
rites.text: A recorded trial of learning by reading scattered texts while drinking a tincture that lets the reader understand a foreign tongue. Its completion marks a reader's growing mastery of distant archives.

rites.name: Valesia Centor
rites.text: A craft-marking that a skilled maker unlocks through a gift of inherited talent. It grants a distinctive look to whatever bears it.

rites.name: Sereolus Naustollus
rites.text: A people's innate knack for perceiving the flow of unseen currents across the sky. Those born with it can deliberately sharpen this sense to read those hidden paths.

rites.name: Orolium Seraullus
rites.text: A caster unleashes a sequence of three forceful attacks that rise in a line before them, each striking with equal reach and power. The three effects are identical in strength.

rites.name: Leolor Telirniases
rites.text: A tradeable craft that a group of rival forgers unlocks once their standing among the guild reaches a third tier. It lets practitioners draw swiftness out of lesser things.

rites.name: Meostor Cauleontes
rites.text: A learned craft in which practitioners bend the arrangement of distance and room. It is chosen as one exclusive path among the disciplines of the reflective arts.

rites.name: Orialus Santum
rites.text: A monk-hero talent drawn from the Celestial conduit, reserved for mist-weaving practitioners. Wind-walkers receive a different conduit ability instead.

rites.name: Selosum
rites.text: A fizzing tonic that thieving sprites carry and sometimes drop during a festival of greed. When poured near a gateway to the underworld, it pushes a new trait onto that gate and calls forth a small scavenger bearing the same gift.

rites.name: Seonus Coreostosia
rites.text: A tradable craft-boon sold by a merchant at a lounge in a mountain holdfast, offered for coin or in exchange for a cloddish gem.

rites.name: Valornelus
rites.text: A tactic of the wild-hunter path that lets a shapeshifting caster choose between this talent and a rival one. It is a paired option within a branching set of abilities.

rites.name: Valeorus Cantes
rites.text: A deadly ability that a grave-warrior may choose, linked with another tormenting technique. It grants a quick and merciful end to the foes it strikes.

rites.name: Miarium Vistium
rites.text: A specialized talent for shapeshifting hunters that lets them choose between two linked abilities, one of which is a deliberate strike aimed at vital points. Taking one option closes off the other.

rites.name: Caustontor
rites.text: A trained method of writing that merchants offer for sale in a bright elven capital. Buyers pay a set price in a local currency to learn the skill.

rites.name: Valeosenus
rites.text: A learnable method of binding oneself to a guild of shadowy traders. Its teacher offers it to those who have earned enough standing within that guild.

rites.name: Ciarnor Sialles
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster of one faction step instantly to a distant hidden city. Its method of acquisition remains unknown to the wider world.

rites.name: Niastia Valilum
rites.text: A resonant craft that lets tamed companions strike with a booming vocal force during contests between beasts. Trainers rely on it to overwhelm opposing creatures in staged duels.

rites.name: Serarnanum Nallanum
rites.text: A second stage of a crafting enchantment that requires gathering a rare essence from a fallen beast and repeatedly defeating powerful foes to collect fleeting remnants. The process is limited by a timed gate.

rites.name: Coriantum Teleonanum
rites.text: A rogue's inscribed mark that changes how a ranged firearm strike looks when it is fired. A dealer on a distant island sells the inscription for a set price of a rare metal.

rites.name: Niantum Coraniastus
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner bend the flow of hours around them. It is taken as a single exclusive path among a circle's stored sparks of quickening.

rites.name: Causes Tialinia
rites.text: A closing rite that finalizes a glowing crown enchantment, but its trial can only be attempted once a set waiting period has passed.

rites.name: Nallanum Seriantus
rites.text: A tidal inscription technique that a merchant of a harbor town on a curled island offers to buyers for a set price in trade currency. It is bought and sold like any other craft lesson.

rites.name: Niantarus Maullernium
rites.text: A specialized kind of transmutation practiced by alchemists to uncover new formulas. It can only be performed once per day and consumes a batch of matching raw materials in the process.

rites.name: Tisalia Telistus
rites.text: A trade-bound technique taught by a merchant contact once a standing with a guild of underground traders is earned. It grants a rune-based practice tied to the guild's hidden networks.

rites.name: Orostia Sallus
rites.text: A rogue's marking that changes how a ranged gunshot looks when fired. Those who wish to learn it must lift coins from raiders on a lonely sea-island.

rites.name: Vialor Amausia
rites.text: A carved marking taught by a sellers' engraver that lets a wielder of a long spear channel their craft. It is traded in a deep underground market.

rites.name: Telornises
rites.text: A trade-bought craft that a rival contestant may learn from a merchant in a bright capital city for a large sum of honor. It grants the practitioner a marking of speed earned through rivalry.

rites.name: Teliares Rostiasum
rites.text: A carved sigil that can be found in the wild after a long fall of cold. It is said to hold a craft of stillness that the finder may learn.

rites.name: Caurium Oranes
rites.text: A thin scroll of gusting enchantment that a traveler can unroll to conjure a swirling wind for a short while. It is found wild on open grasslands and traded by merchants in crowded river cities.

rites.name: Telerniases
rites.text: A trained method of movement sold by a vendor in a river-port city, and sometimes found hidden inside chests in contested frontier lands. Practitioners learn it to compete against rivals.

rites.name: Rasaunia
rites.text: A coined craft of inscribed marks that alters how a particular ranged shot looks when fired. Its lore is kept in hidden stores along a remote sea-girt shore.

rites.name: Raustum Celiasum
rites.text: A set of cleansing rites that can be bought from a wandering mechanical trader for a small sum of salvaged parts. Sworn members of a local defiant band may learn them, and pouring them into a sacred forge bestows a first measure of refining power.

rites.name: Nauntia Tianilanum
rites.text: A branching choice within a mage's path of gifts, set against an opposing gift that offers a lesser trial. Choosing one shapes how the mage's powers unfold.

rites.name: Valerus Tania
rites.text: A crafting rite that turns bright lumina sparks into wild, untamed essence. Apprentice alchemists must master the trade before they can learn it from the guild's masters.

rites.name: Tirnium Valornes
rites.text: A bound codex sold by a robed keeper in a river market town. It teaches its reader a rite for taking the form of a humming winged insect.

rites.name: Meorontum
rites.text: A tactical technique where beasts bound into a companion's service strike with sharpened talons during a contest of creatures. It is a common combat method among tamed animals.

rites.name: Oraurnantus
rites.text: Before a crushing contest begins, a raiding band casts a quiet ballot on whether to flinch from or embrace a monstrous foe. The collective choice then reshapes how hard the creature strikes and how well it endures the fight.

rites.name: Caunestus
rites.text: A tracking craft that reveals constructed engines as glowing marks on a small map held by the seeker. Certain small folk know it from birth, while others may gain it through a binding charm.

rites.name: Orillia Rastanum
rites.text: A lasting blessing that lets wayfarers who walk through shifting eras gain more from their gathered tokens. It doubles the worth of bronze chests and triples the worth of thread-bound scrolls.

rites.name: Launium Amellus
rites.text: A specialized combat talent for a watcher-hunter, chosen from a single exclusive branch. It pairs with a stalking skill and a striking skill to shape how the hunter fights.

rites.name: Tauleosanum Lares
rites.text: A practiced knack that lets a caster who takes it shape their craft with near-flawless accuracy. It works only in place of one rival gift that channels volatile energy.

rites.name: Sintiares
rites.text: A volatile craft that lets small companion creatures tinker with their gear in the middle of a contest. It is a risky technique used by many such companions during duels.

rites.name: Coraunirium
rites.text: A sealed ember-rite that a bearer releases to call forth a roaring blaze. It belongs to a set of heavenly crown-relics, drawn from their shared stored power.

rites.name: Valernanum Teosanum
rites.text: A stored watchfulness that a bearer can call upon to guard a companion's spirit. It is drawn from the set of old oath-cards kept by the mapmakers of the Ashen Reach.

rites.name: Mirnium Amistanum
rites.text: A creature delivers a sharp blow drawn from empty space during a contest between tamed companions. It is a technique used by many kinds of beast in such bouts.

rites.name: Villor Reolles
rites.text: A fierce inner shift that a battle-hardened hunter of night-spawn can call upon, marking the body with scars as the change takes hold.

rites.name: Casanum Marillum
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a practitioner draws vital essence out of a foe and channels it into their own body. The method is recorded as a card-like artifact belonging to a sacred collection of heavenly relics.

rites.name: Telesiror Amernanum
rites.text: A bonded trait that a relic-bearer may claim, costing nothing to adopt. It cannot be paired with four rival traits, each carrying its own mystic discipline.

rites.name: Teliasanum Veriarnes
rites.text: A hollow spectral projection that is called forth when a commander and a blade-bearer join their will in a slipping rite. It appears as a faint reflection of the summoners.

rites.name: Rania Rausistia
rites.text: A coiling growth appearance that a bearer can unlock by invoking a specific dread-bringing power. It takes its shape from the power used to call it forth.

rites.name: Coseones
rites.text: A tactic used by a rival beast-tamer when a battle with a creature of their kind reaches its height. It unleashes a surge of emptiness that strikes the opposing creature.

rites.name: Leontinum
rites.text: A dawn-bound inner resolve that a sworn champion of the first light can take as a mutually exclusive path, in place of another radiant gift.

rites.name: Rausarum
rites.text: A transmutation craft that turns raw matter into unstable reagents used for further creation. Its practice is limited by a daily recovery period before it can be performed again.

rites.name: Coreosum Voseontor
rites.text: A shared bond that lets every bearer within one fellowship gain experience faster as they climb toward the highest rank. Each completed trial in a lineage of trials adds a further bonus to that quickening.

rites.name: Canum Teosiarnium
rites.text: A defensive technique that creatures of the battling companion kind raise during a contest between tamed beasts. It shields the caster for the duration of a bout.

rites.name: Viasenanum
rites.text: A stored magical charm held by mages of the far halls. It is a sealed glyph that can be spent to tear open a sudden hole in the air.

rites.name: Sisollum
rites.text: A hunter's trained knack for loading volatile flaming casings. It works as a special choice that pairs with a second tactic for stronger hunting.

rites.name: Coreonales Viallanum
rites.text: A dark craft of the summoner's guild. For a short span after calling forth stalkers, the caster's shadow fire burns with greater force.

rites.name: Laurneosor
rites.text: A trade-bought skill that a merchant offers in a lounge of a market town, available for coin or in exchange for a rare earthen gem.

rites.name: Amanausia Ciasia
rites.text: A bonded trait that a wielder carries as a crafted gift. It is set against a fixed cost paid to the wielder's sorcery.

rites.name: Oriasalus Oriallia
rites.text: A companion-bound talent that a tamed creature can call upon while locked in a contest against another beast. It lets the animal channel cold energy during such duels.

rites.name: Telauses Veonus
rites.text: A specialized battle talent taken by a class of monster-hunting fighters. It belongs to a cult of blade-wielding warriors and serves those who pursue creatures of the dark.

rites.name: Ceollia Saustia
rites.text: A dread-born technique that a tamed companion calls upon during a contest of beasts, unsettling its opponent with the terror it draws from its own heart.

rites.name: Oriirleth
rites.text: Oriirleth is a luminous sea of living radiance that lies beyond the walls of reality, where it kindles faith and willpower into healing and shielding. Its wielders must first quiet their own selves through long meditation before the radiance will answer them. Its fires can mend a dying kingdom or scour a fortress of shadow.

rites.name: Vorugarnoth
rites.text: Vorugarnoth is the concept of a wall that is also a promise, held by the orders of Siluanae during the Walled Age to keep the flame of the Holy Age from spilling beyond the temple precincts. It is remembered as the discipline that makes a vow binding enough to stop a fire.

rites.name: Neonausum
rites.text: A spoken rite that lets a fallen warrior join a waiting queue for revival at a nearby shrine while standing within the battle's reach. It is invoked by calling its sacred formula aloud.

rites.name: Lirnanum
rites.text: A retired rite that joins two companions into a shared channel of speech. It takes two presence marks as its inputs and binds them together.

rites.name: Leosontum
rites.text: A reckoning-craft that lists every known incantation whose opening sounds match a spoken fragment. The caster speaks the fragment and the full list of matching incantations is recited aloud.

rites.name: Amiaresum
rites.text: A signal-craft that sends a private murmured message to a chosen companion across the realm. The sender names the recipient by a registered number and then speaks the words.

rites.name: Tianerum
rites.text: A reckoning craft that takes a rating gathered from several trial marks within one proving ground and returns the shade that signals how strong that rating stands.

rites.name: Rinor
rites.text: A calendar check that reports whether a scheduled entry may be altered. It returns a simple yes or no answer when called.

rites.name: Amestaullor
rites.text: This rite returns the identifier currently bound to a practitioner's chosen discipline. It is a separate matter from the identifier of a sealed loadout of gathered skills.

rites.name: Caliania
rites.text: A closing command that shuts a campaign picker panel for revisiting older eras, then signals the surrounding system that the panel has been dismissed.

rites.name: Viarnia
rites.text: A reader-side craft that gathers every currently shown speech bubble into one list. The caller may choose to include bubbles that are otherwise hidden from view.

rites.name: Marnelus
rites.text: A coded scribe-rite that swaps shorthand emblem marks inside a message for their full glyphs. Callers may choose to leave either the emblems or the group marks untouched.

rites.name: Aminor
rites.text: Checks whether a dated gathering entry may be taken off a shared ledger. It answers yes or no based on the month offset, the day, and the entry's position in that day's list.

rites.name: Valeostium
rites.text: A dormant ward that cancels a standing rule of automatic acceptance. Once invoked, every incoming summons must be answered by hand again.

rites.name: Vistausum
rites.text: A reference routine that looks up a sealed keepsake by its catalogue number and returns its name, equipment slot, combat flag, appearance, and rank. It is a tool for scribes who track such relics.

rites.name: Corianolum
rites.text: A reckoning craft that marks the boundaries of how long a bidding sale remains open. It returns the lower and upper limits of seconds for a given band of remaining time.

rites.name: Leorises
rites.text: A readiness check that reports whether the next request will be held back or refused by a rate limiter. Callers consult it before sending a queued message.

rites.name: Valenteolus
rites.text: A reckoning-engine reports the present condition of a construction project, how far along it stands, and when its next phase will begin. Its keeper queries it by a single registered mark.

rites.name: Ciasirnanum
rites.text: A mechanical rite that returns the written description of a structure when given its identifying number. It serves as a lookup used by keepers who record the works of a city.

rites.name: Ceostinum
rites.text: A silencing rite that lets a named wanderer be barred from speaking through the shared hearing-stones. The bearer invokes it by calling the wanderer's given name aloud.

rites.name: Mosintor
rites.text: A ritual reckoning that reports which entry in a private ignore roll is currently chosen. The reckoner hands back a single numbered place within that roll.

rites.name: Leostia
rites.text: A tool that splits long strings of digits into smaller clusters, separated by a delimiter character that adapts to the local tongue. It takes one value and returns the marked-up text.

rites.name: Oristum
rites.text: A ready waiting line can be let into the arena by this rite, which takes a slot number and a yes-or-no choice. It is reserved for trusted officers only.

rites.name: Rentilium
rites.text: A query that asks whether a given spell identifier is registered as a tracked offensive aura. It returns a true or false answer used to flag triggers.

rites.name: Launtes
rites.text: A reference routine that reports the ways a bearer can bring themselves back from the brink of death. It returns a list of available self-revival options, including those drawn from bound stones.

rites.name: Caror
rites.text: A query routine that reports the details of an ongoing effect attached to a creature during a contest. It returns an identifier, a counter of remaining rounds, and whether the effect helps or hinders.

rites.name: Valaserum
rites.text: A reckoning that reports whether a creature's chosen technique can be used right now, how long until it recovers, and how long it stays locked. It is consulted by a keeper during a contest of tamed beasts.

rites.name: Valaustalor
rites.text: A signal-craft that restores a silenced voice to a shared channel. The caster names the channel and the speaker, and the speaker may talk again.

rites.name: Centeollor
rites.text: A ritual invocation that runs a named working while keeping its corruption from spreading back to the one who called it. Two forms exist, one that takes a working by name and one that takes it directly.

rites.name: Teontium
rites.text: A query that reports whether a glass pane can sense a hovering pointer. It answers with a simple yes or no.

rites.name: Restiarum
rites.text: A query reports a creature's distant striking power and its bonus value. Supply the subject and it yields two figures, the base strength and the added modifier.

rites.name: Riasillia
rites.text: A measure that reports the greatest reserve of arcane energy a given bearer can hold. Scribes consult it by naming the bearer and receiving a single figure in return.

rites.name: Corinus
rites.text: A ledger-rite that lets a seeker read the recorded profile of a wanderer waiting in a gathering board. It reveals rank, home region, chosen calling, party ties, and a long list of measured combat virtues.

rites.name: Lauria
rites.text: This is a reporting routine that tells a caller what enchantment a chosen bearer is currently drawing forth. It hands back the working's label, its visual mark, its timing window, and whether it can be broken.

rites.name: Mintalum
rites.text: A coded routine that assembles a written sequence from a list of numeric symbols given to it. The numbers it accepts may not carry the same meaning across different systems.

rites.name: Serinor
rites.text: A bronze-tinted ledger rite that divides a chosen sum of small coin evenly among every companion in the traveling band. When no sum is named, the rite shares out the entire purse.

rites.name: Rernasus
rites.text: A method that tints the edge frame of a backdrop. Given red, green, blue and alpha values, it recolors the border of the element it is called on.

rites.name: Tellintanum
rites.text: This is a routine that marks one relic as the chosen find for a digging contest. It takes a single numeric index that picks which contest is being run.

rites.name: Coreoranum Manestanum
rites.text: A signal that broadcasts a notice in bright amber text to everyone in the listening hall. It takes a single spoken phrase as its only input.

rites.name: Lelia
rites.text: A signal that a chosen guide for training has been picked and reported to the central keeper. It takes one numbered position as its input to identify which instructor was selected.

rites.name: Millum
rites.text: A method that takes a portion of the goods stored in a container and places that portion onto the holder's hand. It is called with a container identifier, a slot position, and an amount.

rites.name: Rines
rites.text: This check reports whether a chosen being is currently being brought back from death. It answers yes or no for any being named to it.

rites.name: Corenum
rites.text: A mode that places the cursor into a state for mending faults. It is invoked by a single call to a routine that switches the pointer over to this repairing state.

rites.name: Loliantus
rites.text: A procedure that removes the monetary attachment from a message at a chosen position in a mailbox. It is invoked by supplying that position as its single argument.

rites.name: Serariles
rites.text: A tool that draws every stored value out of a collection's ordered slots and hands them back together. The caller can choose where the drawing starts and where it stops.

rites.name: Vonternus
rites.text: A binding rite that attaches a handler to a shard of a region, so the shard reacts when a named trigger occurs. The caller provides the trigger's name and the handler to run.

rites.name: Sarnia
rites.text: A tool that lets a clickable zone pass presses through to whatever lies beneath it. It is controlled by naming which press types should continue downward.

rites.name: Mornia
rites.text: A check that tells whether a clickable zone can respond to pointer presses. It gives back a plain yes or no answer for that zone.

rites.name: Reoneles
rites.text: A query that reports whether a given creature has been barred from being claimed by a touch. The answer comes back as a true or false signal.

rites.name: Molanum
rites.text: A guarded rite that runs a ritual chant under a borrowed set of wards, catching any failure so the caller survives. It reports whether the chant held and returns what it produced.

rites.name: Viallirum
rites.text: A corrosive downpour that companion beasts can call upon during contests of creatures. It weakens opponents by eating away at their defenses.

rites.name: Seles Corastisum
rites.text: A check that reports whether a chosen being is currently linked to the realm, returning true when the link holds and false when it has been severed.

rites.name: Leonia
rites.text: This craft reports whether a pointer currently rests over a marked zone of the interface. It answers with a simple yes or no each time it is consulted.

rites.name: Seosia
rites.text: A query that reports whether a region is currently being pulled along by a held motion. It answers yes or no for the moment it is asked.

rites.name: Tasiastor
rites.text: A query that reports the temporary enhancements and afflictions currently bound to a chosen being. Its results list each effect's name, strength, remaining span, and origin, sorted by slot.

rites.name: Oriastes
rites.text: A sealed measuring rule that a crafted surface consults to nudge its fine grid points toward the nearest fixed mark. It answers with a single offset value when asked.

rites.name: Lantor
rites.text: A signal that tells whether a given being has taken on a spectral form. It answers yes or no for any chosen target.

rites.name: Nostes
rites.text: A ritual reckoning that arranges a traveler's chosen tasks by how near each one lies to the wanderer. Its verdict reports whether the order shifted.

rites.name: Celia
rites.text: A reckoning-rite that turns angles into ratios of sides and ratios back into angles. It offers paired forms working in either degrees or radians.

rites.name: Meontus
rites.text: A search-craft that scans a body of text for a given sequence and reports where its first appearance begins and ends. It can start the search from a chosen point or match the sequence literally.

rites.name: Telornus
rites.text: A dim rite that adjusts how wide and tall the painted window of the world appears. Keepers call a number, and the view reshapes to match it.

rites.name: Cauntases
rites.text: A technique for cropping or reshaping a surface image by specifying the edges or corner points that frame the visible portion. It can be given either four edge values or eight corner coordinates.

rites.name: Serirnus
rites.text: A rite that selects which speaking channel is currently in use by its session identifier. It returns a flag reporting whether the selection succeeded.

rites.name: Rellaustes
rites.text: A rite that refreshes a framed display surface while it runs in a boxed arrangement. It lifts the frame to the uppermost edge of the view and stretches it to the largest permitted extent. It is invoked by its bare sigil.

rites.name: Seonum
rites.text: A halt command that ends a panel's drag or stretch motion that was begun earlier. The panel stops following the pointer and may shift its anchor point.

rites.name: Tialernia
rites.text: A bound practitioner sets which stored skill-set is currently active, completing a five-count ritual of attunement. It is begun by pressing a dedicated seal in the skill-chart chamber.

rites.name: Mistarnum
rites.text: A reckoning that tells whether a given traveler is currently seated inside a conveyance. The answer returns as a simple yes or no.

rites.name: Coraria
rites.text: A learned effect that a bearer can draw upon, such as a trained craft or a strike performed in battle. Some are called upon deliberately while others work quietly without any effort from the bearer.

rites.name: Valiasor
rites.text: A silencing rite that halts a chosen sound from ringing. The caster names the sound's binding token, and may add a span of time over which the sound slowly fades away.

rites.name: Oresium
rites.text: A craft for assigning a shape to the body that holds it. The bearer names a new host, and the shape then answers to that host's position and movement.

rites.name: Montaurnor
rites.text: A defensive discipline in which a guardian must keep moving and acting to blunt incoming harm, rather than relying on passive armor alone. It was first taught to the wardens of a mist-shrouded isle.

rites.name: Oriasor Manintor
rites.text: A ritual that visits every paired entry of a ledger in turn, applying a chosen rite to each, while keeping any corruption from seeping back into the one who performs it.

rites.name: Amiales
rites.text: A shading craft that blends one hue into another across a surface, moving from a lower tone to a higher one along a chosen direction.

rites.name: Oreosellus
rites.text: A volatile enhancement that a practitioner of ruinous fire arts could draw upon to make their flames spread faster and burn hotter. It was available only to those who followed the path of wanton destruction.

rites.name: Nonaror
rites.text: A ritual rite that restores the voice of a bound recording. It is invoked by naming either the recording itself or its keeper's marker.

rites.name: Serilia
rites.text: A calling rite that lifts a chosen parcel out of a sealed message-vessel by its numbered place and its slot within. It removes the carried object from the container.

rites.name: Coreontia
rites.text: A protective craft that lets certain battle-hardened guardians gain a layer of defensive resilience. It is open only to those trained in the front-line defender's path.

rites.name: Cisiaria
rites.text: A signal-craft that redirects a chosen bearer's focus onto the bonded companion they keep beside them. If no companion is bound, the aim remains where it was.

rites.name: Oranteornia
rites.text: A tabled rite that walks through every pair held in a collection and hands each pair to a chosen rune-bearer. If that bearer yields a value, the walk stops early.

rites.name: Ceorases
rites.text: A reckoning that reports why a bearer stands apart from the shared rhythm of its circle. It is consulted by naming the bearer, and it yields the cause of the mismatch.

rites.name: Rasterus
rites.text: A signal is raised when a unit quietly begins trailing a chosen companion on its own. The notice names the companion that is being shadowed.

rites.name: Oraustanum
rites.text: A binding ritual that writes a value into a keyed ledger while ignoring every hidden override attached to the ledger. The ledger keeps its original sealed contents.

rites.name: Ameostia
rites.text: A check that reports whether another being or companion counts as a member of the shared group. It answers yes or no for any queried presence.

rites.name: Vaunium Virnallium
rites.text: A guarded rite that runs a chosen working within a shield, passing its arguments through and returning a success flag with results. If the working fails, a custom handler is called to shape the reported failure.

rites.name: Amentillus
rites.text: A reckoning that reports whether a designated realm is currently shielded from harm. It yields two answers, one for the shield itself and one for whether it was set deliberately.

rites.name: Amestium
rites.text: A binding rite that wraps a sentinel's inner chant with short restricted incantations, which run inside a confined ward. It can be invoked directly or through a shared sigil template.

rites.name: Ciallum
rites.text: A spell that reads a line of written instructions and turns it into a callable working. If the instructions are malformed, it gives back a message describing the fault instead.

rites.name: Colia
rites.text: A reckoning-rite that reads a spoken sign-string and attempts to draw out the count hidden within it. Practitioners may name a base for the reading, shaping how the sign-string is interpreted.

rites.name: Tiraullanum
rites.text: A signal that tells a caller a standing offer to bring a fallen wanderer back to life has run out. It is sent to the client when the window for revival closes.

rites.name: Corum
rites.text: A tool-level rite that answers when a linked token is touched inside a message stream. It takes the token, the written words around it, and the press of a hand.

rites.name: Nalliastum
rites.text: A corrosive contact technique that creatures of the battling beasts employ during contests of tamed companions. It dissolves whatever it touches while the bouts unfold.

rites.name: Cestium Valentum
rites.text: This check reports whether a given zone is able to respond to scroll input from a pointing device. It returns a yes-or-no answer when it is consulted.

rites.name: Manisor
rites.text: A measuring rite reports the lowest and highest readings held by a gauge-bearing device. It hands back two numbers, the floor and the ceiling of its scale.

rites.name: Valantolium
rites.text: A signal that marks a chosen allegiance as dormant within the standing ledger. It is invoked with a single numeric key identifying which bond is set aside.

rites.name: Vauntinum
rites.text: A lingering path of growth that unlocks across a whole household of wanderers once the first traveler finishes a set of regional tales. It reshapes every unfinished task so it scales to match the newcomer's strength, while leaving the original storylines untouched.

rites.name: Amilor
rites.text: A tumbling-skill power drawn from hidden reserves of arcane essence stored in a dreadful spiraling tower. It lets a wielder move with a slicing precision.

rites.name: Amistium
rites.text: A shifting hive-craft that druids of the Bone Warden faction may join, letting them call on a restless swarm of small creatures. The craft is granted for a limited span during a martial chapter of a wider saga.

rites.name: Veoranum
rites.text: A term for a novice who lures far stronger foes toward themselves through an unusually wide pull radius. It can also describe a companion who mishandles their hold on enemy attention during a group fight.

rites.name: Oresauria
rites.text: A mark of enhanced sorcery that bolsters the foes gathered within a sealed chamber whenever a particular defensive ward is engaged. It makes every opponent in the trial more formidable.

rites.name: Lontum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that transforms its bearer into a fel-touched shape and lets them gather unbroken eyes torn from demons in a scorched wasteland.

rites.name: Amarnum
rites.text: A measured reach around a wanderer within which a creature stops idling and turns to fight. Its size depends mainly on how far the creature's rank sits below the wanderer's own.

rites.name: Listus Viallauntia
rites.text: A tactical allowance held in reserve by envoys during a tense negotiation. Invoking it extends the current round's clock by one minute.

rites.name: Oriastor Rinanum
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a dark, towering prison-spire. Those who gather these reserves gain a lasting power over the soul.

rites.name: Vollum
rites.text: A bound trapping craft that a combat companion uses during a contest of creatures, locking an opponent in a preserved shell so it cannot act.

rites.name: Orausor
rites.text: A discipline of the frozen branch that a practitioner can learn at the third stage of training. It is one of several refinements available within that path of study.

rites.name: Orarnanum
rites.text: A stored spark of raw essence that can be drawn from hidden reserves and sharpened into a stronger form of power. It is found within sealed vaults of a dreadful, towering prison.

rites.name: Serires
rites.text: A rare inner trait that a spellcaster of the arcane arts can awaken from a strange ore. It grants a sorcerer an unusual, lingering influence over their magic.

rites.name: Serollum
rites.text: A sudden burst of speed that companion creatures unleash while engaged in a contest of beasts. It lets them rush ahead of their rivals in the middle of the fight.

rites.name: Corostillor
rites.text: A set of temporary transformations that reshape a wanderer's form, size, or kind beyond what a barber can do. They are gained through trinkets, charms, enchanted places, or sorcery, and are mostly worn for vanity, play, or acting out a role.

rites.name: Raustasum
rites.text: A mage's learned technique found on the third tier of the arcane branch. It shortens the recharge time of four separate spells, letting the caster use them again sooner.

rites.name: Corontum
rites.text: A tuned resonance that certain shapers of the balance arts can draw upon. It is a faculty granted to practitioners who walk the path of equilibrium.

rites.name: Casaunor
rites.text: A quiet inherited gift that lets a spellcaster speak and grasp the tongues of companions from other peoples. It is taught through a bound scroll offered by a sisterhood of sorcerers in a northern city.

rites.name: Valaror
rites.text: A combat-oriented gift of arcane skill that a battling caster can awaken once they reach a seasoned stage of growth. It is used when contesting other casters in duels.

rites.name: Lerialium
rites.text: A stirring force that breathes life into weapons, letting them move on their own. Its essence is drawn from hidden reservoirs found within a towering prison of the lost.

rites.name: Seralliria
rites.text: A caster releases a ringing wave of force that harms foes gathered close around them. Those who channel the arcane also gain a stored surge of power whenever the blast strikes anyone.

rites.name: Cirnum Oroseontus
rites.text: A quiet, innate sorcerous talent that a practitioner can call upon without active effort once they reach a high tier of mastery. It cloaks the caster's craft in a gloom that works on its own.

rites.name: Seronor Meones
rites.text: A tuned rhythm of hidden energy that a caster can harness to strike foes in quick succession. It is available only to practitioners of the arcane craft.

rites.name: Vesia
rites.text: A dormant craft once granted to spellcasters who wield raw arcane force. It was tested in an early trial stage but no longer seems to be accessible.

rites.name: Serenus
rites.text: A caster's craft that sometimes grants a brief state of free working after a harmful spell lands. The surge lets the next harmful working cost no reserve, which helps most during long contests.

rites.name: Ameosium
rites.text: A passive gift that a caster receives upon choosing the path of pure mystery at a set rank. It strengthens the caster's mystical blasts so that the caster leans toward those rather than flame or frost.

rites.name: Serarium
rites.text: A paid rite once let a traveler reshape their own form and, optionally, their chosen name. Its options were later folded into a communal grooming hall, so the rite no longer stands on its own.

rites.name: Veosallum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of a tamed companion kind use during contests of beasts. It strikes with a magical edge and is shared by many different companions.

rites.name: Telaurum Corellanum
rites.text: A blessing granted to combatants the moment they step into a contest ring. It lets them empower themselves without spending any vital reserve, and reshape their skills and sigils freely without consuming a sealed ledger.

rites.name: Amalus
rites.text: A tactic in which one working touches several figures inside a set ring, striking the center hardest and fading toward the rim. Some versions strike every figure in the ring equally.

rites.name: Telesirum
rites.text: A starry downpour that occurs as one of three phases of a fierce struggle with a sorceress within a sacred vault.

rites.name: Rinia
rites.text: A paladin power granted to members of a shadowy oath-band, lasting only while one is bound to their sworn land. It can be borrowed for a time by those who take up a particular local trial.

rites.name: Ceosus
rites.text: A resonant sound-power drawn from hidden stores of spirit essence buried in a towering prison-spire. Those who harvest these caches can unleash the power as a shattering force.

rites.name: Oraria
rites.text: A learned gift that every practitioner in the order can draw upon, though its effects shift with the path each one has chosen. It is a branching choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival rooting technique.

rites.name: Vinallanum
rites.text: A dormant inner ember can be roused by a chosen wielder at a high tier of training. Once kindled, it grants the bearer a rare honored gift of battle.

rites.name: Teleoneres
rites.text: A disciplined inner training that a practitioner must invest heavily in to master. Once fully developed, it shortens the recovery time between every technique learned through that same schooling.

rites.name: Orines
rites.text: A safeguard that frees a wanderer trapped in an impassable spot. It returns the fallen to their nearest resting place, or sends the living back to their home stone or nudges them loose.

rites.name: Corasornium
rites.text: This craft quickens how fast a wielder gathers inner relic strength. It follows the same method used for a sacred core that keeps a realm's lifeblood.

rites.name: Leorastes
rites.text: A directive that a wielder issues to their own fighter or their companion beast, prompting them to lash out against a foe. It is a basic instruction shared between a master and their servant.

rites.name: Taulostium
rites.text: A hooked sting technique that creatures of a tamed beast-keeping contest use during their bouts. It lets the attacker lodge a barb in an opponent for lingering harm.

rites.name: Vostaunor
rites.text: A glowing enhancement that settles over a person upon touching a shimmering liquid essence. It grants a temporary surge of strength to whoever bears it.

rites.name: Teosiarum
rites.text: A tactic that a trained companion creature may unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a special move used during a duel of captive creatures.

rites.name: Seostiallia
rites.text: A loud vocal technique that a small companion creature uses during a contest of tamed beasts. It is a sharp, startling cry meant to unsettle the opposing creature.

rites.name: Telaustium
rites.text: A tuning enchantment is laid over newcomers entering a trial chamber during a testing phase. It lifts their strength and gear to a set standard so they can face the chamber's challenges.

rites.name: Sereoles Amirnes
rites.text: A sacred gift that a devoted guardian can select, chosen in exclusive opposition to another path of blessing. It is paired with the Ashenveil infusion of radiant grace.

rites.name: Nauror Oralium
rites.text: A learned craft in which a caster draws on a reserve of blue energy, granting a passive surge of power to those who master it. It belongs to the destructive path of spellcasters.

rites.name: Nastanum
rites.text: Passive enchantments carried within bonded armor, each chosen from a unique set of options. Stronger when the armor is of higher quality, and they fall dormant in the realm of the dead.

rites.name: Amastinanum
rites.text: A set of bound powers that can be drawn into a central heart-stone through a forge once a traveler has finished a long trial. Which powers a person may hold depends on the role they fill in battle.

rites.name: Corenastes
rites.text: A moving strike that companion beasts unleash during a contest between tamed creatures. It is a skill that wild partners use to hit their opponent.

rites.name: Telialanus
rites.text: A small wailing infant uses a shimmering field of force to protect itself during a clash between tamed beasts. The shield blocks incoming harm for the duration of the contest.

rites.name: Ceoses
rites.text: A martial enhancement that can be acquired from two different quartermasters in rival cities, at the cost of a fixed sum of earned honor tokens.

rites.name: Amistus
rites.text: A creature sliding low across the ground on its underside during a contest of beasts. It is used by small flightless swimmers as a technique in such bouts.

rites.name: Coreontia Corentia
rites.text: A stored surge of inner force that a fighter draws from hidden reservoirs within a tower of punishment. It can be gained by breaking open the caches tucked away in its deeper halls.

rites.name: Valeontes Listes
rites.text: A bond-born gift that steadies a fighter's nerve during battle. It is passed along by a commander who binds it to the warriors under their command.

rites.name: Sellarnes
rites.text: A craft of sharpened aim that any kind of fighter can learn, carried only in armor pieces recovered from a particular highland battle or from contests between rival warbands.

rites.name: Corallintum
rites.text: A recurring hex that cloaks certain shadowy envoys and tide-bound agents in deceptive enchantment. Those agents strike back at intruders, resist being halted, and vanish when pressed too hard.

rites.name: Liarnes Amarnus
rites.text: A keeper's craft that lets a wanderer raise, drill, and follow the progress of small companion beasts in contests of strength. It opens to novices at an early stage of their journey.

rites.name: Oranisia
rites.text: A high-tier discipline of vengeful hunters in which the practitioner douses themselves in searing fire to draw out hidden power. The rite is reserved for seasoned avengers who have earned its burning trust.

rites.name: Seranillia
rites.text: A defensive craft that a tank-minded practitioner learns early in a branch of the Blood discipline. It holds little value for those who focus on dealing damage.

rites.name: Lasor Orirnolles
rites.text: A glowing power that grants its bearer fiery wings, much like those worn by a mighty winged foe found in a volcanic lair. The wings let the bearer soar through the sky.

rites.name: Vausterium
rites.text: A tactic that lets a companion creature strike with a dark, raking blow during a contest between tamed beasts. Many such creatures across the land can call upon it when pitted against rivals.

rites.name: Vauntia Nilonium
rites.text: A grim discipline in which a hunter draws strength from sorrow, sharpening the hunt against foes who wronged them. It is learned only after long and dedicated practice.

rites.name: Naustiantor
rites.text: A companion-bound gift that only the great ape kin of wild beast hunters may grant. It sharpens the bearer's might, nimbleness, and reasoning by a small fraction.

rites.name: Ciaria Tauror
rites.text: A guardian's art that unleashes a flash of harsh light, striking and dazzling every foe nearby. It was planned as a rite of the sworn defender but was later cast aside.

rites.name: Oraunornes
rites.text: A nightly enchantment bestowed through a sequence of trials, granting a warrior a shadowy mark that can be adjusted to suit personal style. The first trial begins the granting, and a later trial completes it.

rites.name: Meonentia
rites.text: A learned discipline of hardened plating that a warrior of the blood-lodge can draw upon. It is valued by all practitioners, and most of all by those who stand at the front line to guard their companions.

rites.name: Lilanum Valernanum
rites.text: A tiered talent within a branch of martial learning that lets a sworn warrior of the death-bound order gain strength from spilled blood. It sits deep within the sanguine discipline.

rites.name: Oraunus Vaulornus
rites.text: A guardian's defensive ceiling where every incoming strike is stopped or deflected, so no blow can break through against even the mightiest foe. Only certain shield-bearing defenders can reach it.

rites.name: Rarnia Amausenus
rites.text: A dark, life-draining craft that is gathered from hidden reserves held within a cursed, towering prison. It is drawn out of sealed hoards and channeled into a deadly, bloody edge.

rites.name: Serantium Rantostus
rites.text: A stored spiritual charge is drawn from sealed reliquaries within a cursed spire. It grants its bearer a surge of inner force.

rites.name: Orontus
rites.text: A two-point technique of the shadow-striker's discipline, learned in the second rank of the killing path. It strengthens the choking wire and the deep wound.

rites.name: Teleornum Vesiallia
rites.text: A tuned fighting instinct that a tamer of beasts can choose along a branch of growth. It stands opposite a rival instinct, so only one may be taken.

rites.name: Neorum Loses
rites.text: A combat discipline that a shield-bearing fighter can learn to sharpen their skill in battle. It is open only to those trained in the defensive arts.

rites.name: Telentia Tialus
rites.text: A crimson sorcery drawn from vital essence hidden in deep vaults of a dark tower. It is gathered from sealed reservoirs of stored spirit energy and wielded as a power.

rites.name: Vasternium
rites.text: A grave-dweller's power that draws spectral energy from sealed reliquary hoards buried within a dreaded spire of torment. Its wielders hurl jagged shards of pale essence to pierce their foes.

rites.name: Velles Tesostia
rites.text: A siphoning craft that draws vital essence from hidden reservoirs in a cursed spire. It grants its wielder a stolen, rhythmic power pulled from those sealed stores.

rites.name: Leolaunor
rites.text: A shared inner gift that any kind of fighter may awaken. It is found only in a particular set of armor worn after a great clash of warring peoples.

rites.name: Amaurontes
rites.text: A tactic where a guardian of the party draws a single foe toward itself by drifting near it, causing little hostility. It can split crowded enemies apart, and a careless wanderer who triggers it by accident is said to stir up extra foes.

rites.name: Oraurnasium
rites.text: A tactic in which a small creature hides a trap inside a wrapped offering. The trap is sprung against an opponent during a contest between companion beasts.

rites.name: Serallium Lenises
rites.text: A reserve of inner endurance drawn from sealed wells of stored essence found within a dread spire of the lost. It lets a bearer withstand far more punishment than their body should allow.

rites.name: Tinanum
rites.text: A swift, shifting technique that lets a tracker of the wild move unseen through the hunt. It is a gift drawn from a rare crystalline ore, usable by those who follow the path of the stalker.

rites.name: Sereostia Valastes
rites.text: A volatile inner power that is drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dreaded spiral prison. It unsettles whoever carries it and grows stronger as its bearer risks more.

rites.name: Telintoses
rites.text: A stored inner-force power drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, towering prison-keep. It can be gathered from these concealed caches and used as a mark of its bearer's will.

rites.name: Sianor
rites.text: A fragile silken snare that creatures weave during a contest of tamed beasts. It is a tactic used by arachnid companions to hinder their rivals.

rites.name: Valles Ciastus
rites.text: A practice where a traveler uses a return token and then must wait a long time before it works again. Some fighters instead unleash wasteful strikes to bring down a foe as quickly as possible.

rites.name: Toreostia
rites.text: A ward that limits how far above its recipient's own standing an enchantment may reach. Lesser bearers are shielded, yet friendly charms quietly resize themselves to fit whoever receives them.

rites.name: Ciaranum Ceostia
rites.text: A shared inner ward that any practitioner of any craft may draw upon. It is a trait gained through a glowing crystalline resource.

rites.name: Valires Amollus
rites.text: A shield-bound discipline that a guardian warrior can draw upon to fortify their defense. It belongs to the armored tradition of sacred protectors.

rites.name: Tiastaullus
rites.text: A chilling gust that creatures of a tamed beast-bond can summon during a contest of companions. It drives a sudden freeze across the field.

rites.name: Vantes Sillor
rites.text: A mind-bound force drawn from a gathered reservoir within a towering prison of the cursed. It lets its wielder strike with measured, deliberate precision.

rites.name: Liarnistus
rites.text: A hardened retaliation technique that lets a defender strike back with cold indifference. It is available to shield-bearing guardians who train in that discipline.

rites.name: Leres Teliasauror
rites.text: A tamed companion calls its kin into a contest of creatures. The summoning draws allies to the fray and widens the battle.

rites.name: Veonases
rites.text: A tracker can recall a beast from its keep to their side from any distance. The summoning may be used once every few minutes.

rites.name: Tantia Tontianor
rites.text: A tamed companion can draw a shadowy force over the field during a contest of creatures. The technique is used in such duels by many kinds of beasts.

rites.name: Visus Nianes
rites.text: A tactical trick that creepers and beasts can unleash in a contest of tamed companions. It lets a trainer's creature act during the bout.

rites.name: Tiarnes Orisorus
rites.text: A festering affliction that a grim warrior order can draw upon. It is a trait tied to a specific class of dark fighter.

rites.name: Telistum Tirnontus
rites.text: A practitioner's trained discipline that amplifies every fiery incantation they cast. It was once a benefit reserved for those who specialize in ruinous magic.

rites.name: Nintor Orarnanum
rites.text: A spinning snare-technique that a creature called a Brood-Warden uses while contesting a ritual trial of beasts. Its hooks whirl outward to tangle rival companions mid-contest.

rites.name: Telistor Tirelor
rites.text: A timed interval that every charged working must endure before its effect manifests. Lasting contests of skill are decided by whether the wait can be seen, interrupted, or quickened.

rites.name: Vostor Seles
rites.text: A stored vital energy drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dreadful, spiraling prison-tower. Those who gather it can unlock a powerful inner force.

rites.name: Valaunor Siseornanum
rites.text: A borrowed craft that lets a shaman gather fallen spirits bound in iron links while they are sworn to a shadowed order. It lasts only while the bearer walks an appointed path of trials.

rites.name: Sallia Ameseonor
rites.text: A dark rite that lets a caster call forth a seething cloud of scavenging vermin. The swarm feeds on the dead and is bound to the caster's will.

rites.name: Vauntorum
rites.text: A skilled cleric's gift lets the practitioner unleash a rippling wave of power. It becomes available once the practitioner reaches a high tier of mastery.

rites.name: Amosterum Tolia
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that can be gathered from hidden reserves within a towering dungeon prison. It grants the bearer a particular kind of power.

rites.name: Rintor Nantium
rites.text: A taught ritual that lets its learner call forth a small leafy companion from the woods. It can be bought from several merchants, but only by those who belong to a particular society.

rites.name: Varnus Liasanum
rites.text: A tactical gift wielded by nature-attuned combatants, unlocked once they reach a mid-tier rank. It is used in contests between rival fighters.

rites.name: Seraustium Tiares
rites.text: A dark talent that a class of spellcasters can draw upon. It spreads ruin outward from a single strike, touching nearby foes.

rites.name: Reorum Orolistia
rites.text: A bonding discipline that amplifies two war-rites of the faithful. Its power grows the restorative force of a healer's art by a quarter, or by half for guardians and avengers.

rites.name: Meles Laliasor
rites.text: A piercing vocal cry that a young winged creature lets out during a contest between tamed companions. It is used as a tactic in these staged duels.

rites.name: Teliarium Valesiastum
rites.text: A method where a newly made traveler is hauled swiftly upward by a far stronger companion of one's own making. The practice grants a great store of wealth, rewards, and gear in a brief span.

rites.name: Sausia Volum
rites.text: A tactical technique used by a small creature during a contest between tamed companions. It shapes the outcome of the duel by drawing on the creature's inner energy.

rites.name: Coraunorus
rites.text: A volatile power drawn from hidden reserves of spirit essence stored within a dark tower of punishment. It channels raw, unpredictable energy into its wielder.

rites.name: Meosantia
rites.text: A stored inner force that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a grim tower of punishment. It empowers whoever claims it from those caches.

rites.name: Taulum Vaurnisanum
rites.text: A volatile force that unsettles the power of a ritual caster's bound relic. It links with several other inherent traits that bend the relic's energies toward ruin.

rites.name: Liles
rites.text: A paid rite that lets a traveler move a bound persona to another realm or to a different keeper's ledger. Each passage costs a sum that varies by region, and the crossing can take three days. Stepping in too early ruins the crossing and seals the persona.

rites.name: Listor Mirnalanum
rites.text: A volatile reservoir of unstable power that a caster may draw upon once they have reached the highest tier of their training. It is a craft learned within a practitioner's study of dark arts.

rites.name: Laustirum Malor
rites.text: A talent that trained hunters of wicked beings may choose, exclusive to one path and paired with an empowering force.

rites.name: Serestia
rites.text: A volatile surge of unstable fire that a dark caster can channel through their craft. It is bound to practitioners of destructive sorcery.

rites.name: Rianaures
rites.text: A paid rite that lifts any bearer to a higher rank than they have earned. Each new purchase of this rite is held in reserve and does not replace a lift still waiting unused.

rites.name: Corausentum
rites.text: A dark-craft technique available to adepts of the Gloam Circle once they reach their sixty-second rite. While a binder is wrapped in the shifting form, it takes the place of a seized-hand strike.

rites.name: Telosilanum
