rites.text: A form of crowd control that lets a caster take over a victim's will. The controlled target may serve the caster directly or turn on its former allies, and the effect is cut short if the caster is harmed or interrupted.

rites.name: Nialus Terniasus
rites.text: A learned craft of dark sorcery that lets a caster draw lingering burn-marks from fallen foes. It is gained once a practitioner reaches the highest tier of their training.

rites.name: Ciarnus
rites.text: A mind-bending chant that a dark caster can draw upon as a learned trait. It is available only to shadow-aligned casters who study the craft.

rites.name: Telalirum
rites.text: A keeper's talent from an old order of shapeshifters grants a wild-bodied practitioner sharpened, rending strikes. It is a learned skill that sits among the highest ranks of such mastery.

rites.name: Serorneles
rites.text: A tuned inner discipline that shortens the wait before a protective shell can be woven again. It cannot be paired with a certain burst-of-vitality practice, forcing a choice between the two.

rites.name: Veolium Venaustor
rites.text: A ritual power drawn from reserves of stored essence left behind after a dread overlord is brought low within a cursed spire. Those who harness it gain a fearsome grasp of their own.

rites.name: Corilium Tolum
rites.text: A bonding trait granted by a master smith of a metal-working circle. It cannot be held alongside a rival filtering craft.

rites.name: Orauntalia
rites.text: A tortoise-shell gift of inner vitality that is drawn from sealed reservoirs in a cursed spire of deep dungeons. Adventurers gather it from these hidden stores to empower themselves.

rites.name: Caullestus
rites.text: A cold inner gift that is drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence found within a dark, forsaken spire. It lets its bearer chill the living with a single touch.

rites.name: Amosus
rites.text: A bite-based maneuver that creatures of the herd-beast kind perform while contesting in a sanctioned pet duel. It is a common technique among their kind during such matches.

rites.name: Cestium Marenium
rites.text: A temporary rune etched onto a blade that briefly stirs restorative energy into its wielder. It is inscribed using a special craft and is learned through a dedicated training method.

rites.name: Teorus Telaunia
rites.text: A soothing shower that a tamed companion can call upon during a contest between beasts. It washes away harmful afflictions from the creatures taking part.

rites.name: Sereonalor
rites.text: A practiced discipline that lets a trained adept unleash a burst of stored inner energy. Each school of practice shapes the burst in its own distinct way.

rites.name: Cilliastium
rites.text: A grasping technique that creatures use during a contest between tamed companions. It lets one combatant hold its rival in place.

rites.name: Valoreosus
rites.text: A reflex talent that lets a skulking fighter endure a fatal blow in a clash against rivals. It buys a precious moment so a restorer can mend the wounded.

rites.name: Sirnaunia
rites.text: A bound inner force drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a towering prison-keep. It is gathered from those hoards and channeled by its wielder as a restraining power.

rites.name: Corestanum Valaustanum
rites.text: A specialized gift for casters that grows from a single chosen path. It cannot be taken alongside a certain dangerous fate.

rites.name: Vianausum
rites.text: A set of channeling crafts that anyone can gain without cost, each one strengthened over time. Instruction on them is offered by a traveling merchant in a sacred city during trial periods.

rites.name: Vostum Tenilium
rites.text: A passive discipline that a skilled archer gains upon reaching a certain mastery. Certain volleys of arrows send a jarring shock through their targets, leaving them stunned for a brief moment.

rites.name: Saullonium
rites.text: A shared inner resolve that any wielder of any craft can awaken, but only through certain rare trials of ancestry or open conflict between rival peoples.

rites.name: Nastilor
rites.text: A hunter's technique tied to a beast's striking venom. It is not currently known to be available to practitioners.

rites.name: Sereontinum
rites.text: A companion's trained instinct that sharpens its strikes for a while. It is a talent found in the first tier of every companion's skill ladder.

rites.name: Teosilum
rites.text: A passive gift borne by every clockwork tinker of one folk, it steadily sharpens the bearer's chosen core strength each few heartbeats of battle, up to ten layers. When the fighting ends, the layers fade slowly, one at a time.

rites.name: Corinallor
rites.text: A guardian's discipline that makes their protective wards also empower nearby allies with extra strength. It likewise restores a flow of vital energy to the group.

rites.name: Seraullanum Ciarnaria
rites.text: A shared power that any kind of fighter may draw upon, awakened through a special armor found in contests among rival warbands or at a roaring stronghold in the highlands.

rites.name: Ameontor Amiantus
rites.text: A dazzling flicker technique that small glowing insects and drifting spore-winged creatures use during contests between tamed beasts, leaving opponents disoriented.

rites.name: Telaurostia
rites.text: A repeated skill of ranged hunters that strikes the same foe again and again in quick succession, usable in contests between wanderers. It is unlocked once a hunter reaches a set level of growth.

rites.name: Ceontiarnus
rites.text: A creature's instinctive technique of devouring a rival during a contest of beasts. The act lets the feeder gain strength from its defeated opponent.

rites.name: Vaullia Marniantes
rites.text: A learned rite of scornful preaching that a cleric of the discipline tradition can draw upon. It is one of the attuned gifts a practitioner may carry.

rites.name: Vaurnanum Salornium
rites.text: A tactical skill that lets a tracker of the wilds strike alongside allies at once. It belongs to the middle tier of a hunter's training path.

rites.name: Amaullania
rites.text: A deadly curse is cast by a dread ruler in a sealed temple, dealing harm and wounds to foes nearby. Its wicked sickness leaps from one person to the next, spreading across whole lands as a plague.

rites.name: Oreneostum
rites.text: A tally rite that counts how many times a small marker appears inside a larger sequence of symbols. The result is handed back as a plain whole number.

rites.name: Lestarum
rites.text: A discipline that a holder cultivates after landing a decisive strike, building layered resolve that empowers both harm and mending. The resolve can accumulate up to three times.

rites.name: Vernia Meontor
rites.text: A dueling essence that a warrior earns by fighting in ranked contests against rivals. It is drawn from the wearer's struggles with opponents and empowers their combat skill.

rites.name: Rellia Amintes
rites.text: A sealed, ever-burning blast that is drawn from hoarded reserves found within a grim vertical prison-tower. It is a power a wielder can take and use.

rites.name: Lilum Corinus
rites.text: A spell-craft once granted to the sworn members of a death-bound brotherhood, it passes sickness from one body to the next. Later it was overtaken by a rival craft that took its place.

rites.name: Mauror
rites.text: A spreading wedge of harm that fans outward in an arc from its wielder, reaching a distance that varies with the power used. Its shape widens like a funnel opening away from the one who releases it.

rites.name: Talestus
rites.text: A tactical ability drawn from the balance path of nature-shapers, learned upon reaching a modest rank of experience, and used in contests between rival fighters.

rites.name: Amaurnantes
rites.text: A passive discipline of holy wrath that a sworn champion of the light could awaken once they reached full mastery. It worked silently in the background, sharpening their resolve without any active command.

rites.name: Coraurisum
rites.text: A dwindling protective force drawn from hidden reservoirs of vital essence within a dread spire of imprisonment. It shields its bearer while the stored reserves last.

rites.name: Voniantor
rites.text: A slow mental unraveling that a creature can inflict on its opponent during a contest of tamed beasts. It gradually wears down the target's focus and resolve over the course of the struggle.

rites.name: Orillus
rites.text: A tactic available to fighters who wield heavy two-handed blades. It lets them deliver a devastating blow that overwhelms the enemy's guard.

rites.name: Saleontanum
rites.text: A chilling power that a mage can claim from hidden reserves found in a dreadful tower. It can only be chosen once a warming garment has been unlocked first.

rites.name: Orosteolum
rites.text: A dark, glassy inheritance that clings to a caster's craft of draining life. It is bound to three other unsteady gifts that feed on one another.

rites.name: Miarnenum
rites.text: A typed chant lets a wanderer speak to the hidden spirits of a crafted charm. Each spirit answers to its own set of spoken keys, bound to a single listening rite.

rites.name: Sollauria
rites.text: A defensive posture that certain companion beasts adopt during contests of trained creatures. It lets them brace low to the ground and gather themselves for their next move.

rites.name: Lenanum Coriantinum
rites.text: A dampening principle that lessens the force of incoming strikes and spells. Some blows are softened, others fully swallowed, yet a softened blow still bruises, unlike a blow that is dodged clean away.

rites.name: Liasaurium
rites.text: A stored spirit-energy power that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a deep, dangerous tower. It is gathered from caches tucked away in its halls.

rites.name: Sereornisum
rites.text: A small creature of soft charm draws attention away from attacks, causing blows to slip past it more often. Its gentle presence gives it a quarter more chance to dodge incoming harm during a contest between companions.

rites.name: Maurnes Oraurnes
rites.text: A charming expression that a tamed companion can display during a contest between beasts, softening the foe's resolve. It is a learned trick used by many kinds of creature.

rites.name: Amernia Nirnium
rites.text: A ward that is set off and then silences minor incursions aimed at a single bearer. It is activated only when the bearer chooses to switch it on.

rites.name: Ronanum Nerus
rites.text: A rhythmic gift of motion that is granted to tamers of wild beasts. It lets such a hunter move in a way that is bound to the creatures they guide.

rites.name: Coraustia Vernones
rites.text: A trait that can be gained by certain monk fighters who follow the path of the wind. It is a sort of inner gift tied to their fighting style.

rites.name: Voniales
rites.text: A mage's gentle enchantment that softens harm from hostile spellwork while also dulling restorative magic cast upon allies. It mirrors a rival working that heightens such effects.

rites.name: Sereontia Valontes
rites.text: A cosmetic enchantment that once existed only for display, matching a sibling spell in effect but differing in its visual flair. Scholars could acquire it from a tome sold by a sisterhood of mages.

rites.name: Raures Telaustanum
rites.text: A shadowed inner power drawn from hidden reserves of soul-essence buried in a grim, towering prison-spire. Practitioners tap these stored reserves to channel their own inner force.

rites.name: Raulles Oriraullus
rites.text: A stored essence of hopeful visions, gathered from hidden reservoirs within a dark spiraling tower. It is drawn out and used as a source of power by those who seek it.

rites.name: Corantanum Rinor
rites.text: A quiet, always-on dark emanation worked by practitioners of forbidden binding arts. It requires no deliberate call, lingering about the caster and affecting nearby foes.

rites.name: Sonteonia
rites.text: A fortifying gift of inner light once granted to guardians who shield others. It bolsters the bearer's resolve and steadies their stance in battle.

rites.name: Valintia Vonanum
rites.text: A dark inner art drawn from a bound shadow-spirit, granting a sorcerer a grasp of forbidden lore. It is unlocked only by a practitioner who has risen to a high rank of summoning mastery.

rites.name: Santes Coreonia
rites.text: A hex that creatures of the menagerie call upon during contests of bonded beasts. It is wielded by many companions in those battles, weakening rivals through dark sorcery.

rites.name: Cesus Orileornium
rites.text: A bound-spirit power that is gained by consuming a hungry essence fragment after striking a scavenging wraith within a shattered spire. Selecting it immediately grants a spectral restraint worn by a hunting beast.

rites.name: Ciasanus
rites.text: A combat craft in which a warrior of the dead-bound order links foes together so that a wound on one spreads to those it touches. It is learned at a modest rank of skill within a contest of duels.

rites.name: Siaristanum
rites.text: A destructive sorcerous craft in which a practitioner holds volatile shadow-energy within their body. Once unlocked, it lets the caster strike with a flare of unstable power.

rites.name: Oranirum
rites.text: A dimming discipline practiced by a caster that quickens the pace of all their spells. It was once taught on the lowest rung of a shadowy training path.

rites.name: Meontium Raulontus
rites.text: A quiet, dormant gift of cold and grave-touched power that a warrior of the dead carries within, working unseen at the peak of their growth.

rites.name: Nosialus
rites.text: A companion creature can draw on shadowy energy during a contest of beasts, restoring its strength in the middle of the fight.

rites.name: Reorialum
rites.text: A shadowy clawing technique that creatures of the wild may unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. Several kinds of companion animals are able to perform it.

rites.name: Oresastia
rites.text: A deep-tier technique of the shadow-stalker's craft, mastered only after much study in the quiet arts. Its full power is unlocked by a long apprenticeship in stealth and misdirection.

rites.name: Mauntium Vonanum
rites.text: A gathered inner force that a wielder can draw from hidden reserves stored within a grim, cursed tower. It is used as a striking, lashing power.

rites.name: Ninteosia
rites.text: A dying-moment surge that practitioners of the shadow arts can call upon. It is one of the gifts drawn from a strange mineral that channels power into the caster's mind.

rites.name: Nernium Milleosor
rites.text: A withering dread radiates outward from a fighter of the blood arts, hindering the foes that draw near. It is a trait gained by warriors who have risen to a certain tier of skill.

rites.name: Tiasum Saullus
rites.text: A grim discipline that lets a hunter of fiends draw dark power from their own wrath. It is taught only to the most advanced hunters who have reached the highest rank of their craft.

rites.name: Tistaulum
rites.text: A bonded trait granted to certain caster-healers that was later superseded by a newer form of omen-blessing before the testing phase concluded.

rites.name: Selus Tantolles
rites.text: A bound inner force that a wielder can draw from hidden reservoirs of stored essence. It lets the one who gathers it refuse the end that would otherwise claim them.

rites.name: Cirus Telenialia
rites.text: A tactic in which a creature wielding a companion beast unleashes a searing, slow-building heat that tends to hit hard during a contest between tamed creatures.

rites.name: Serillum Siranum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline that a wandering mist-keeper learns once they reach a mature stage of training. It works constantly in the background, loosening the body's hold on solid form.

rites.name: Corallus Orarnesanum
rites.text: A dark practice where a caster draws strength from summoned lesser beings. It is taught to those who study the art of binding such creatures.

rites.name: Vestirnium
rites.text: A dark practitioner's inner attunement that quietly sharpens their hidden affinity, deepening their skill with each use of the craft.

rites.name: Amalium Nornia
rites.text: A tactic in which a companion creature sinks its teeth in with great force during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used by many of the captured animals fighting in these bouts.

rites.name: Nalonum
rites.text: A tactic that lets creatures in a contest tear down an opponent's defenses. It is performed during a match between tamed beasts.

rites.name: Solliantum
rites.text: A mark of ore-infused power that can be woven into the blood-sworn warriors of the dead. It is held only by those who follow the crimson path of the unliving.

rites.name: Lilaustor
rites.text: A combat gift that lets a frost warrior of the dead strike hard against rival champions in duels. It is unlocked once a fighter reaches a modest rank of experience.

rites.name: Amiantes Neostum
rites.text: A ritual cry that a shapeshifting warden can unleash to weaken the resolve of rival duelists. Only those who reach a certain rank of training may wield it.

rites.name: Nollus Resteollium
rites.text: A stance a companion beast can hold, where it strikes back only at foes that lash out at it or its keeper. Left alone, it stays put until someone is hit.

rites.name: Tonanum Taustia
rites.text: A guardian's learned discipline that spends points from a defensive path. It amplifies every restorative touch, both given and received, by a share of the mending itself.

rites.name: Viarnia Mianastia
rites.text: A stealth technique taught to cunning thieves that lets them incapacitate foes and blind them from farther away while spending less of their vital energy.

rites.name: Veonalum
rites.text: A grasping inner mind that certain tamed companions draw on while contesting another creature in a duel. It lets the companion take hold of a rival's strength during the fight.

rites.name: Serallanum Oreosum
rites.text: A combat technique that certain tamed companions employ during a contest between animal partners. It lets the user consume an opponent's resource in the middle of the match.

rites.name: Telernasum
rites.text: A combat craft that lets a fighter bind an opponent from a greater distance. It extends the reach of a restraining technique by a set measure.

rites.name: Vosteornes
rites.text: A brief binding that strips a foe of the weapon in their dominant grip, and when wrought by a wielder also seizes any shield or blade held in the other hand. The bound foe strikes weaker and cannot call upon arts that demand a drawn implement, though repeated binding yields ever less effect.

rites.name: Collia Liania
rites.text: A grim inherited craft that hunters of the wild may draw upon through a bond of ancient, sealed knowledge. It belongs to those who track beasts and survive in untamed lands.

rites.name: Ciarestes
rites.text: A bound-oath craft that steadily swells a sworn guardian's raw power with each tier learned. At its peak every point of that power is reshaped into added striking force, so gear favoring power over striking force is worth choosing.

rites.name: Amirnaustus
rites.text: A creature or servant vanishes from sight all at once. Hostile beasts sometimes flee or are pulled into another realm when their master falls.

rites.name: Oriasernus
rites.text: A sacred authority once granted to holy champions of the striking hand, lending them a measure of the divine will. It belonged to the avenging order's warriors and could be drawn upon in combat.

rites.name: Teliaria Orollintum
rites.text: A practitioner gathers drifting essence into the palm and releases it as a sudden burst. The technique is learned by adepts of a mist-attuned discipline once they reach a high rank of mastery.

rites.name: Amiastilia
rites.text: A dissolving craft mark that a practitioner earns after unmaking a large quantity of enchanted goods. It records long, patient work at breaking charged objects down.

rites.name: Lernium Telestalor
rites.text: A withered inner craft practiced by a wayward order of warriors who draw on the dead. Adepts must first devote a great deal of their training to the dark arts before they can master it.

rites.name: Sianoria
rites.text: Casters choose a weaker tier of a spell to save mana, trading raw power for efficiency. Over time the practice was curtailed until it was removed entirely, with spells growing alongside the caster.

rites.name: Corallia Veontastium
rites.text: A dark passage ability that members of a secretive oathbound society can unlock. It lets them slip through the veil between places.

rites.name: Corastum Coraullesor
rites.text: A restorative technique that creatures in tamed companion contests may invoke while contesting in a match. It is a skill that companions draw on mid-bout.

rites.name: Valernor Coreosornum
rites.text: A tactic in which small companion creatures draw strength away from their rivals during a contest between tamed beasts. The drained energy is then used to bolster the caster.

rites.name: Cintor Nastanum
rites.text: A paired-effect craft that a skilled cutthroat can channel to repeat a lethal strike. It is practiced by those trained in the art of quiet killing.

rites.name: Neonia Cintosium
rites.text: A tactic used by companion creatures during contests of training, where a beast siphons vitality from its opponent to restore its own strength.

rites.name: Vornianes
rites.text: A fearsome exhalation a creature unleashes during a contest between tamed beasts. Those who face it are rattled by its menace.

rites.name: Amalia Serollanum
rites.text: A dark inner gift that certain cursed sorcerers can awaken within themselves. It is drawn from a crystal-like substance found in their gear and is suited to those who wield plague-like curses.

rites.name: Voles Tialia
rites.text: A dark talent a warrior of the grave cult can learn once they reach a certain rank. It lets them unleash a sudden blast of cursed energy against rival fighters.

rites.name: Niarnor Neosanum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a rider fly alongside a winged beast. Once taught through a trial, it grants two aerial techniques: a burst of speed and a steep climb into the sky.

rites.name: Oriarenanum
rites.text: A dulled state that a wanderer falls into after swallowing several strong brews in quick succession. Their steps wander off course and their written words slur into comic stutters.

rites.name: Tisor Teliales
rites.text: A learned knack carried by wardens of the carved stone idols. Each time the stone pulse rings out, it has a chance to loosen binding cords from the warden and allies standing close by.

rites.name: Amialeontes Tornanum
rites.text: A quickening craft granted to practitioners of the healing arts at a certain stage of their training. It lets their bloom-spells take hold instantly and spread a lingering renewal to nearby companions.

rites.name: Larnum Cestium
rites.text: A dark-toned resonance that settles over a sunken hollow, bestowed on wanderers who have completed a shattered-sword trial. It grants a temporary power while they remain within that gloomy realm.

rites.name: Mirnauranum
rites.text: A copying trick that duplicates a holding, either a carried object or a store of coin, and circulates as either a tool or a whispered set of steps. Using it breaks the realm's binding covenant and can strip a traveler of their standing forever.

rites.name: Tallus Maullum
rites.text: A lingering charm settles on a companion the moment they enter a subterranean delve with a group. For a brief span it lets them reshape their learned abilities without cost, though newer systems have made this boon unnecessary.

rites.name: Sisentia
rites.text: A tidal craft once practiced by healers who drew strength from rising and receding energies. It was an attunement that a restorative caster could call upon in battle.

rites.name: Mintollum
rites.text: A lingering curse that settles upon any wanderer who withdraws from a shared delve before the chamber's guardians have fallen. It marks the one who fled and weakens their resolve for a time.

rites.name: Amanauntia
rites.text: A combat art a Balance spellcaster can learn once reaching the thirtieth rank of training. It lets the caster fight other practitioners in open contests and draws on the fading light of worlds.

rites.name: Sosaullor
rites.text: A coordinated technique that creatures employ during contests between tamed companions. It lets a combatant deliver a sharp, rapid attack in the middle of a match.

rites.name: Amellor Marneolia
rites.text: A resonant trait that certain spirit-channelers can awaken, letting their elemental forces echo and repeat. It is shared among practitioners who call upon the raw powers of the world.

rites.name: Oralus Amiarus
rites.text: A resonant cry that lingers in the air after a warrior of the frozen ranks lets loose a bellow. Its lingering echo is harnessed as a gift within the cold-bound martial arts.

rites.name: Miastintus
rites.text: A disciplined warrior's technique that releases a bound captive from a hold by striking the chains of their control. It is learned by fighters who have reached a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Rantia Collastanum
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures can call upon while they fight alongside their keeper in a contest of beasts. It lets the helpers lend their strength to the struggle.

rites.name: Venium Nanteostum
rites.text: A bonding quality that a master artificer bestows upon a chosen vessel. It binds a spirit to the bearer and grants an enhancing gift of vitality.

rites.name: Oresanum Mirum
rites.text: A hidden power of the soul is gathered from sealed reservoirs within a dread spire of the cursed. Those who draw it strengthen their inner essence in a manner that cannot be shared freely.

rites.name: Amauranum Oriantonor
rites.text: A tide-born talent that any kind of wanderer can awaken within themselves. It draws on a restless current of the sea's hidden energy to strengthen the bearer.

rites.name: Amernaunes
rites.text: A stacking surge of crackling energy that builds up in a caster after a powerful strike lands. Each layer stacks up to three times and is granted by a humming conduit device.

rites.name: Reolium Ameonia
rites.text: A ritual power taken up by hunters who swear to a sworn circle of guardians. It works like a marked sigil, so effects that boost sigils also empower it, and it is granted temporarily during a trial.

rites.name: Nentia Vestium
rites.text: A hidden current of spirit-force that can be drawn from sealed reservoirs within a dark, ruined spire. It grants its wielder a lurking, shadowed power.

rites.name: Serillium Serialus
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that amplifies a fiery burst, becoming available to those of a certain seasoned rank, though it is not always granted until later.

rites.name: Teliares Lilores
rites.text: A heavenly-tinged power of the sword, drawn by the oath-bound fighters who wield it in judgment. It is one of the mystic gifts a judge of the blade can awaken within their craft.

rites.name: Ceoneria
rites.text: A companion-enhancing craft that a hunter could acquire at a certain level, though gaining it was never certain until a later level was reached.

rites.name: Corirnus Terilium
rites.text: A dark inherited gift that a class of grim warrior-priests may draw upon. It is shaped by a hidden resource found within their bodies.

rites.name: Cinares
rites.text: A passive gift borne by healers of the Crane's path, it mends the most wounded ally nearby using a share of the harm they deal. Two such gifts may stack their mending.

rites.name: Larnaures
rites.text: A passive gift of the wild that lets a shapeshifting caster draw starlight into their craft, granted to those who have grown into the trade of the wilds.

rites.name: Nillaustus
rites.text: A discipline of the cold arts that a caster may train through dedicated study. It requires a deep commitment within one branch of frost craft before it can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Saunollium
rites.text: A marksman's refined technique that a hunter can gain as a passive talent once they reach a certain standing, though the gift is not always assured until a later stage.

rites.name: Raulium Corianterus
rites.text: A battle-hardened fighter's gift that a warrior may awaken at an advanced stage of growth, though it is not always granted until later. It sharpens a warrior's decisive blows.

rites.name: Rostauntus
rites.text: A paired talent that a holy champion can choose, granting one of two mutually exclusive gifts depending on the discipline they follow. Choosing one path shuts out the other.

rites.name: Saurnanum Oresiarium
rites.text: A blessing that a priest may gain as they grow in power, though it is not promised until later in their journey. It grants a heavenly strengthening drawn from a radiant celestial messenger.

rites.name: Veontoles
rites.text: A monastic gift that channels a rolling mist to strengthen its bearer. It is granted to devotees who have reached a certain standing, though the blessing is not always assured.

rites.name: Telires Neostaurnus
rites.text: A sacred light craft that a warrior-healer can sharpen as a gift granted once they reach a certain rank. The gift is not promised to every devotee until they have advanced further.

rites.name: Amosaulia
rites.text: A learned knack of a tracker that sharpens ordinary strikes into stronger blows. It may surface early in a hunter's growth, though it is only assured later.

rites.name: Norium Miror
rites.text: A bonus gift granted to certain practitioners of the wild arts, which may come early in their growth but is only assured once they reach a high rank of mastery.

rites.name: Seraunesia
rites.text: A tempered inner force that a practitioner of the monastic path may awaken during their training. It is not guaranteed to surface for every follower, and it arrives only after a considerable stretch of advancement.

rites.name: Centia Rellia
rites.text: A reckless combat art in which a trained fighter strikes many times in rapid succession with a blade. It is learned only after long practice, and it is never certain that a student will master it.

rites.name: Sillor Tonum
rites.text: A cunning talent gifted to sly thieves who gain it as they grow in skill, though it is never guaranteed to arrive before they reach a late stage of their training.

rites.name: Tiasellanum
rites.text: A bargain-born gift for dark casters that can be granted in later stages of a journey, though it may take a while before it is reliably earned.

rites.name: Coraurnanum Sontanum
rites.text: A passive discipline practiced by a certain class of wandering ascetics, granted once they reach a high rank of training. Its arrival is not certain until they have advanced further still.

rites.name: Amausor Sereonum
rites.text: A heightened war-frenzy that a shapeshifting caster can awaken within itself. It is granted as a reward for training, though it may take a long time to be earned.

rites.name: Leolum Linernium
rites.text: A passive gift of renewal that a nature-keeper may come to possess once they reach a certain height of skill. It is never assured, and it can be earned only by those who have grown well beyond their early training.

rites.name: Tallor Corentanum
rites.text: A bonded gift that a patron bestows, letting the bearer's living body move and change in ways that cannot coexist with a certain other bodily blessing.

rites.name: Amerium Teliasor
rites.text: A grim blessing once granted to a warrior of the dead, appearing early in their growth yet only assured near the peak of their power. It strengthens a bonded undead soldier's resolve beyond the grave.

rites.name: Rilanum Resor
rites.text: A refined hunter technique that a skilled archer could acquire once they reached a high rank of experience. It was not handed out to every practitioner, since mastery arrived only near the top of the path.

rites.name: Amelium Cosiles
rites.text: A sharpened inner resolve that a healer-priest can draw upon, granted to those who grow in mastery. It may arrive early in their training, though it is not promised until later advancement.

rites.name: Raurium Oranauntor
rites.text: A tactic used by companion creatures during a contest of pet duels. It lets a beast strike with a sharp bite that the battle rules permit.

rites.name: Oraleranum
rites.text: A green-glowing talent that creatures of many kinds draw upon while engaged in contests of companion-beasts. It lets a summoned ally call on its inner strength during a bout.

rites.name: Naurnilum Coriraunes
rites.text: A chilling blessing that a warrior of the dead can awaken within itself once it grows strong enough. The gift is not promised until the bearer has reached a high threshold of mastery.

rites.name: Amauntor Amaliarnium
rites.text: A ring-bound discipline a fallen warrior can awaken as the years of their path deepen. It is not granted to everyone, and its arrival is uncertain until the very end of the climb.

rites.name: Orestes
rites.text: A dark-touched power that a trained fighter may unlock once they reach a certain rank of mastery. It is not promised to every practitioner, since it only comes after a long proving period.

rites.name: Tiasollor
rites.text: A sacred blaze that priests of the old order could draw upon, granted as a gift once they reached a certain standing. Its arrival was never assured until they had advanced far.

rites.name: Cirnum Rorentanum
rites.text: A protective ward that a shadow-wielding hunter can raise to strengthen their own resolve. It draws on the vengeful energy of the hunter's craft at a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Coreraustus
rites.text: A rogue's gift of sudden darkness-born grace that can awaken early in a fighter's training, though it is not always granted until later mastery is reached.

rites.name: Vauntiania
rites.text: A refined technique that lets a ranged marksman strike with greater precision, earned by those who reach a certain level of mastery in their craft.

rites.name: Meostarium Seralentor
rites.text: A ranked gift of the wild-kin that a seeker may earn after reaching a certain stage of growth, though it is never certain to come. It was later swapped for a different blessing during a trial period.

rites.name: Nasia Orases
rites.text: A charged current flows into the bearer from a glowing shard of core power. It lets them wield a sludge-clearing device.

rites.name: Rollausia
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a storm-attuned caster strengthen the lightning-whip strikes they hurl in battle. It is available to practitioners who have reached a high tier of mastery.

rites.name: Valaurium Tianes
rites.text: A deadly craft that lets a skilled trickster strengthen their poisons, becoming available to practitioners once they have grown considerably in experience. It is not always granted, even to those who have reached the later stages of their training.

rites.name: Valarnolus
rites.text: A hereditary inner gift of the dark-hearted folk that sometimes awakens during a clash of arms or a mending of wounds. When it stirs, it briefly echoes a fraction of the harm and restoration just delivered.

rites.name: Tarnolium
rites.text: A quiet inborn gift shared by an entire people, which lowers the cost of hiding goods in the dark and of reshaping matter. It is passed through the blood of every member of that folk.

rites.name: Serauranum Telorium
rites.text: A transformative power that certain companion beasts can awaken during a contest between tamed creatures. It lets them change form and grow stronger mid-match.

rites.name: Raurium Minolium
rites.text: A grim vow-craft in which a hunter of vengeful fiends carves a lasting mark into their own skin. The skill is learned at a high stage of mastery.

rites.name: Orilus Valaunor
rites.text: A fading inscription-craft that could be shaped into lasting resilience. It belongs to the practice of binding meaning into a spirit's essence.

rites.name: Varaunes
rites.text: A glowing life-force power that can be gathered from hidden reservoirs buried deep within a dreadful spiraling tower. Those who collect it gain strength from the stored essence.

rites.name: Visenia
rites.text: A lasting binding that can be worked into a close-combat blade so it becomes far more adaptable. It only takes hold on a sufficiently high-tier implement.

rites.name: Taranum Vostus
rites.text: A rare milestone reached when a sacred crystal is filled with every available essence of a rising age. Those who attain it are honored for mastering all of its gathered powers at high rank.

rites.name: Lilanum Oraurnus
rites.text: A passing spirit-force that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence in a deep, dangerous spire. It is a fleeting power gathered through hazardous, tower-bound searches.

rites.name: Amiales Seneollia
rites.text: A trait carried by arcane spellcasters that lets their power be felt in many places at once. It is tied to three other related gifts that deepen a caster's reach.

rites.name: Coreolia Valiarosum
rites.text: A companion can be studied through a chosen gesture that reveals their current standing, their attire and gear, and any charms or boosts they carry.

rites.name: Liasor Sillosanum
rites.text: A carved inscription power drawn from a recollection of a distant emptiness. It lets its wielder call on that ancient emptiness through etched sigils.

rites.name: Senum Corollum
rites.text: A calling of the guardian-knights that lets their sacred blessing sometimes be spent without drawing down the reserve of holy light. It is a rite of thrift for those who shield others.

rites.name: Conum Coreontia
rites.text: A bond-skill shared only by one line of hunting companions, letting them stand watch over their keeper without end.

rites.name: Valolasium
rites.text: A curse sold by a merchant within a walled settlement. The text gives no further details about what it does.

rites.name: Seranum Ceonasium
rites.text: A fading craft that lets small tamed companions slip out of sight during a contest of creatures. Trainers use it to dodge incoming strikes in mid-duel.

rites.name: Valernum Calus
rites.text: A tactic that lets a tamed creature slip past attacks during a contest between beasts. It is performed while the creature moves through the fight.

rites.name: Rinentor
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that a seeker can draw from hidden reserves within a dreadful, towering prison-sanctum. Its essence is gathered from the vaults hidden in that fortress.

rites.name: Teleones Lausteontor
rites.text: A drawn-out craft of unmaking, gathered from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence sealed deep within a grim spiral prison. Practitioners tap its stored force to annihilate vermin and blight.

rites.name: Vausia Meraurnia
rites.text: A learned sorcerous trait that lets practitioners of the arcane art gain a lingering, detonating resonance from their spells. It is open only to scholars who wield the mind-bending craft of conjured force.

rites.name: Valiarnium Viallium
rites.text: A visual technique that companion creatures use while contesting one another in a staged duel. It is employed by a range of beasts during these matches.

rites.name: Amostum Cenostium
rites.text: A tumbling strike that a trained beast of burden performs against rivals in beast contests. It drops the animal forward onto its own face, dealing damage to the opponent.

rites.name: Lianum Seollasanum
rites.text: A fury-kindled gift of sight that a Havoc-aligned fighter of the shadowed arts may awaken through a sacred ore. It sharpens the wielder's wrath into a visible, empowering force.

rites.name: Valiania Valastes
rites.text: A paid blessing that quiets the flow of learning, so a traveler gains no lessons from their trials. Two keepers in separate strongholds sell it to those who ask.

rites.name: Laurisor
rites.text: A tiered arcane gift that reshapes itself to match the practitioner's chosen discipline. It is unlocked once a caster reaches the highest rank of training.

rites.name: Ronanum Orianesum
rites.text: A hidden reserve of spirit energy that can be drawn from deep vaults in a towering prison. Those who unlock it gain a swift, silent power of movement for their feet.

rites.name: Ninasus
rites.text: A stripped-down enchantment that a warlock of the summoning arts could draw from a particular hooded garment. It is found on only one specific piece of worn cloth.

rites.name: Lolauntanum
rites.text: A dormant power of the mind that is drawn from hoarded reservoirs of spirit-essence kept in a towering prison. Those who gather such essence can wield this sight.

rites.name: Viasor Coristellor
rites.text: A stored vital essay power that can be gathered from hidden reservoirs deep within a dread spire. Those who draw it upon themselves gain its strengthening force.

rites.name: Vornintium
rites.text: A signature technique a mechanical beast unleashes during a contest between tamed companions. It spews a burst of tainted vapor to overwhelm the rival.

rites.name: Miastirnum
rites.text: A stored binding-force that a seer can draw out of hidden reserves within a dread tower. It grants a sharp, decisive power to whoever claims it.

rites.name: Nastes Valentaules
rites.text: A volatile force is called forth during a boss struggle, first gathering into a dangerous charge. When it is disturbed, it breaks into small restless sparks, and each spark cleared grants lasting bolstering strength to those who remain.

rites.name: Larnianes
rites.text: A grim craft a hunter of avenging shadow-warriors can wield at a high level of mastery. It draws on dark wrath to strike back at foes.

rites.name: Amianastum
rites.text: A protective force drawn from stored essence hidden in a dark spiraling tower. Those who gather these reserves can channel them into a defensive barrier.

rites.name: Amentauria
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a creature in a contest of beasts unleash a burst of corrupted, scorching energy. It is practiced by many different companion creatures during these bouts.

rites.name: Rostanum Orontestus
rites.text: A glimmering inner power that a wanderer can awaken by drawing on hidden reservoirs of essence found within a dreadful, towering prison-fortress.

rites.name: Cauror Rastum
rites.text: A learned discipline of sorcery that a practitioner trains in a deep branch of study. It requires a set investment of effort before its full benefit can be reached.

rites.name: Mantor Telarnum
rites.text: A soul-borne power gathered from hidden reserves within a grim, layered tower of ruin. It draws upon many kinds of wings at once.

rites.name: Orisium Lonanum
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark tower of punishment. Those who gather it gain a new power tied to its essence.

rites.name: Ciastus Mauneoranum
rites.text: A bound-spirit power drawn from hidden reserves kept within a dread tower of the lost. It lets its wielder gather and channel the vital essence stored in those hoards.

rites.name: Oreonor Molleontum
rites.text: A hidden power of the mind that is gathered from reserves stored deep within a grim, towering prison. It is drawn out by those who seek sight beyond the ordinary.

rites.name: Naurum Leornentia
rites.text: A dark sorcerous mark that could be bound to a grim warrior of the dead. It belonged to those who serve the wicked craft of undeath.

rites.name: Seorelium
rites.text: A gatherer's craft that reveals nearby wild plants as glowing marks on a small map. Hovering over a mark shows the kind of plant it holds, and dim marks indicate plants growing beneath the ground.

rites.name: Amaulosanum
rites.text: A fiery inner quality tied to a bearer who hunts vengeful spirits. It works in tandem with two linked traits that surge and align among the bearer's kin.

rites.name: Menia Visaunus
rites.text: A coordinated gathering maneuver used by feathered companions during contests of beast-tamers. Winged creatures perform it to rally together in combat.

rites.name: Seorellium Mellium
rites.text: A caster can hurl a glowing sphere straight ahead along the line they face. It speeds forward until it finds a foe, then slows and strikes the nearest enemy within reach.

rites.name: Vintes Mianaules
rites.text: A timed lull that stops a caster's reserve from refilling for a short span after each spending of its power. Free workings that cost nothing leave the refill running, while a steady drip of restoration still flows regardless.

rites.name: Teollonor
rites.text: A passive gift a caster gains upon committing to the flame path at an early rank. It strengthens all of the caster's heat-based incantations, steering them toward a single fiery identity.

rites.name: Telentirum
rites.text: A companion-beast talent granted only to a certain family of hunting creatures, which lets them evade incoming blows far more often. It sharpens their ability to slip past attacks aimed at them.

rites.name: Ameoneles
rites.text: A reactive inner trait that can be found only in armor gained through contests between rival bands. It is shared by every craft and can be unlocked in supply cache bundles.

rites.name: Cintus Oreonanum
rites.text: A dormant inner skill that quietly strengthens a fire-kindling technique and grants an extra reserve of ignition to a related ritual. It awakens once a practitioner reaches a mid-level of mastery.

rites.name: Orirum Nauntillor
rites.text: A dark ember-craft that channels searing fire through a warlock's destructive arts. It is bound to a sister craft of the same burning lineage.

rites.name: Lirneolia
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that companion creatures perform during contests of skill against one another. It is a quick strike used to gain an advantage in such a bout.

rites.name: Corallium Corinia
rites.text: A fiery spear-shaped power drawn from hidden reservoirs of essence buried within a cursed, towering prison-labyrinth. It can be gathered from these deep caches by those who venture inside.

rites.name: Sillum Callor
rites.text: A hunter's technique in which a beast companion strikes with gleaming teeth, granting a sharpened edge in battle. The technique is not currently known to be obtainable by anyone.

rites.name: Caustes Malium
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of tamed companions use during a contest between beasts. It lets a creature strike from the side while its opponent is focused elsewhere.

rites.name: Tollaror
rites.text: A sealed power of spirit-essence is drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, tormented tower. Those who gather it can bend its force for themselves.

rites.name: Amauror Sianium
rites.text: A hunter's technique granted to those who swear to a shadowed brotherhood, usable by anyone joining that order. It is also briefly lent to visitors of a dark province through a sworn task, lasting until their journey there ends.

rites.name: Amaunia Collanum
rites.text: A quickening heat that is channeled by fire-wielding casters, sharpening their spells and hastening their casting. It is drawn from a rare trait that only practitioners of the flame arts may awaken.

rites.name: Lelantanum
rites.text: A sealed grant that lets airborne steeds carry their riders across three broad realms. It is taught by any sky-master at a set rank, though it has no effect in several older border lands.

rites.name: Oristium Teliarnasum
rites.text: A kindred trait that a brewing-focused guardian of the monastery can draw upon. It lets the adept strengthen their craft when the moment demands it.

rites.name: Leonus Tisanor
rites.text: A tactic that lets a combat creature hurl a burst of fire during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used by the creatures in such bouts.

rites.name: Valauntinum
rites.text: A tiered skill taught to thieves in a guild's deadly training path. When a blade lands a critical blow, it grants the wielder a brief surge of renewed vigor.

rites.name: Ternasus
rites.text: A tightly gathered ray of light that a creature can loose during a contest between tamed companions. It is a technique shared by many of the beasts that fight in these bouts.

rites.name: Nistus Corelum
rites.text: A coordinated tactic where a band of fighters pours all their strikes and restraints onto one foe, usually the support who keeps the rest alive. It is used in duels and in larger battles against tough foes.

rites.name: Amiarum Meorialum
rites.text: A reckless inner power that a wanderer draws from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dark, towering prison. It lets the bearer stake their own vital essence on uncertain outcomes.

rites.name: Oriantes Oriseontia
rites.text: A dimmed spark of inner force that can be drawn from hidden reserves kept within a grim, towering prison. It is gathered from stores scattered through its dark halls.

rites.name: Telaulonia
rites.text: A flowing energy power drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit essence within a dark, cursed tower. It is gathered from these storehouses and used as a wrapping of drifting force.

rites.name: Narium Corolanum
rites.text: A battle technique that certain creatures use while locked in a contest with another creature. It lets them shift their stance and tactics mid-fight.

rites.name: Centeornus
rites.text: A planned life-energy that a monk gathers by building up an inner flow called chi. It has a bright face and a shadowed face, each granting its own kind of benefit to the one who wields it.

rites.name: Oreollium Narniria
rites.text: A resonant sound-craft drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence, gathered within a shadowed tower of punishment. Its wielder channels the vault's gathered essence into a piercing, tuneful power.

rites.name: Celleontes
rites.text: A bonded beast-companion's steadfast spirit lends its hardiness to its handler, temporarily swelling both of their endurance. Lone hunters without a companion may still draw on this gift through a commanding gesture.

rites.name: Meornor Telaronium
rites.text: A passive skill of fallen champions that sharpens their ability to turn aside blows, with the boost scaling to a quarter of their raw might.

rites.name: Amistaulles Valantium
rites.text: A shadowy inner power that a wanderer can draw from hidden reservoirs of stored essence found within a dark, haunted tower. It lets the bearer take on a murky, obscuring shape.

rites.name: Valenaror
rites.text: A learned combat discipline that sharpens a practitioner's two signature blows, making them strike harder. It is taught within a branch of the storm-wardens' training.

rites.name: Teleornium Rarus
rites.text: A learned discipline that lowers the mana drain of a caster's spells and softens the attention their cold workings draw from foes. Its practitioners are usually battle-scholars who need endurance during prolonged campaigns.

rites.name: Reonestum
rites.text: A restorative craft that lets every companion in a contest of tamed beasts recover its strength at once. It is used during a match between trained creatures.

rites.name: Telantus Launtes
rites.text: A hunter-born skill of the wild shapers that lets them tear deeper marks into a foe during open combat. It is learned by those who have grown into their craft.

rites.name: Loniasor
rites.text: A tempered inner ember that flares within the frozen warriors of the north. It is a trait that only those bound to the cold craft may awaken.

rites.name: Caseorus
rites.text: A tiered inner talent that channels a grove's living sap into those who tend the healing arts. It was granted through a sacred ore that binds itself to a practitioner's gear.

rites.name: Vintelia
rites.text: A fighter's trained rage that lets a skilled warrior spin blades in a violent storm. It was later replaced by a similar whirling technique taught to newer disciples.

rites.name: Mausum Vorianium
rites.text: A playful technique that beasts of a caged arena employ during contests against rival companions. It lets them spring into action with bouncing energy when battling for dominance.

rites.name: Cerneontia
rites.text: A fiery inner power that certain shadow-trained wielders of the blade may awaken. It is tied to a mark of their discipline.

rites.name: Calliaror
rites.text: A dual craft that braids two opposed elemental arts into one working. Its workings gain strength from either art, bypass partial wards, and still function when one of the arts is silenced.

rites.name: Veonternes
rites.text: A dormant inner fury kindled in guardians of light, said to lie beyond reach of any who would summon it. Its current availability is unclear.

rites.name: Niriarnium
rites.text: A caster's protective enchantment that raises a temporary barrier against cold harm, fading after a short span or once enough harm has been soaked up. It was later replaced by a broader ward that also guards against flame and arcane forces.

rites.name: Reontales Mestonum
rites.text: A frosty ability borne by a cold-bound undying warrior, tied to two other winter-linked powers that share its icy nature.

rites.name: Vostium Valiastores
rites.text: A passive gift granted to a caster who devotes themselves to the icy path at a set tier. It strengthens all cold-based incantations, steering the caster toward chilling magic over other elemental arts, and sharpens one particular frost bolt.

rites.name: Seoliarnor
rites.text: A charged enchantment that a practitioner of the arcane arts can draw upon as a special inherent gift. It is open only to those who study the arcane craft.

rites.name: Valiantia Tiarausium
rites.text: A technique that lets a traveler cross a moderate stretch of ground in an instant or very swiftly. Fighters in contests of close combat rely on it to reach their rivals quickly.

rites.name: Mosanum Serontaulus
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures use when they clash in a contest of champions. It lets a bonded beast strike its rival in a swift, sweeping cut.

rites.name: Vaustiasor
rites.text: A stored charge of vital essence that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, cursed tower. Those who gather it can channel it as a crackling power.

rites.name: Coriarnum Tonia
rites.text: A creature-training tactic used by companion beasts during a contest of tamed creatures. It lets the animal lash out at an opponent in a sudden attack.

rites.name: Lernaustor
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a glittering strike during a contest between tamed beasts. The technique is a special move that only animal partners may perform.

rites.name: Oristus Seonellus
rites.text: A borrowed power of the spirit kind, drawn from hidden reservoirs found within a grim, looming tower where the cursed are held.

rites.name: Mianium Amallum
rites.text: A dark mental power drawn from sealed reservoirs of stored essence within a towering prison of the cursed. Those who harvest these caches gain the ability to unleash a deadly glare.

rites.name: Sirium Valiaranum
rites.text: A spectral nip that creatures of the lesser realms deliver during contests of trained companions. It lets the attacker strike with a chilling, ethereal jaw.

rites.name: Nausum Oraunornum
rites.text: A bond-beast's gift that lets a companion restore a fallen ally partway, even mid-clash. Several related beast kinds share the same power, though it cannot be used in sanctioned duels.

rites.name: Montium Telernus
rites.text: A quiet technique of a shadow-trained fighter that grants a brief, lightly-held ability to slip past blows. It is practiced in the third tier of a stealth discipline and is meant to be used often.

rites.name: Teoliastum
rites.text: A spectral force drawn from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence sealed within a towering dungeon of punishment. It lets a wielder call on the lingering power of the dead.

rites.name: Nolor Rilor
rites.text: A blessing is bestowed upon those who finish the final trial of a sealed tower's guardian. Once every half hour, the bearer may return to life at the place where they fell.

rites.name: Orintia Serasium
rites.text: A spectral force drawn from hidden reservoirs of stored essence within a dread tower of confinement. It is gathered by those who venture into the tower's depths.

rites.name: Valentia Meontanum
rites.text: A clinging sphere of gloom that can be drawn from hidden reserves of soul-essence within a towering prison. It grants its bearer a power of smothering shadow.

rites.name: Serornum Collestor
rites.text: A carved sigil that reshapes a caster's lunar flare so it burns sparingly at first but scorches steadily afterward. It gives up the sudden burst in exchange for a longer, heavier smoulder.

rites.name: Amornes Corinollor
rites.text: A combat discipline that a fighter of high standing learns to hold their ground under pressure. It is attained at the highest tier of martial training and was introduced in a later age of conflict.

rites.name: Valolus Orirniastus
rites.text: A high-tier fighting discipline that a shield-bearing combatant unlocks upon reaching the peak of their training. It is taken by those who follow the path of the unyielding defender.

rites.name: Serintum Neosaulor
rites.text: A scribed mark that a crafter learns through research and records with ink-work. It is inscribed onto a tool or gear to lace its strikes with a lingering toxin.

rites.name: Relus Ciarnium
rites.text: A frozen craft drawn from the deep ore that lets practitioners of the cold arts gain a sharpened edge in their chilling spells.

rites.name: Amirnestus
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a wielder hurls a volley of spinning blades that devastate foes. It can be learned only as an alternative to a closely linked discipline.

rites.name: Telintes Toliases
rites.text: A tier-one cold discipline that makes chilled foes suffer extra harm from frost strikes whenever a lingering sickness already festers within them. Keeping that sickness active on every target makes the boost a steady gain.

rites.name: Orosum Launor
rites.text: A mark of rending that a wild-hunter learns in the early stages of training. Once a stronger technique takes its place, the old mark is set aside and no longer used.

rites.name: Liastor Silleonia
rites.text: A sigil etched into a caster's focus that, while a surge of rising sorcery flows through them, clears the brief pause that normally follows their quickest shielding, leaping, and illusion charms.

rites.name: Tintia Telaurnes
rites.text: A former hunter's talent that once let a pursuer of vengeful demons grow stronger through insatiable appetite. It was an ability that never fully took shape in the hunter's craft.

rites.name: Sosium Lesilor
rites.text: A luminous venom technique that companion creatures unleash while contesting in organized duels. Many different beasts can call upon it during these bouts.

rites.name: Serostillor
rites.text: A glimmering inner force that can be drawn from hidden reserves buried deep within a dark, ruined spire. Those who gather it gain a shining power of their own.

rites.name: Cianaules
rites.text: A tactic where fallen fighters rush straight back from their remains to rejoin a clash against a towering foe. Makers of the realm installed a stalling curse so the slain cannot simply crowd back in.

rites.name: Moserium
rites.text: A tugging force that certain companion creatures call upon while locked in contests with their tamers' rivals. It drags opponents downward to weaken their hold on the field.

rites.name: Amastaunium
rites.text: A ritual craft that lets a warden mend their own flesh by spilling blood. It is practiced by guardians who channel the power of a sacred mineral.

rites.name: Corastanum Mintiaria
rites.text: A channeling conduit that empowers casters who draw on it. A higher-grade version is granted as a reward through several bonding trials and shared journeys.

rites.name: Neornastia
rites.text: A fire-wielding caster may learn a stronger version of a flame bolt. It works as its own separate technique and leaves the original spell untouched.

rites.name: Reonisum
rites.text: A dark, clinging gloom that a warden of the ruin conjures during wartime campaigns. It occasionally drags nearby travelers into its grasp, wounding them with a chilling corruption until they tear free.

rites.name: Renes Senus
rites.text: A bonded companion skill that a keeper can develop through the third level of a discipline tree. It lets a loyal beast stand guard and protect its master.

rites.name: Tisolles
rites.text: A bound protective presence that a healer may call upon an ally. While it lasts, the ally takes greater restoration from healing, and if the ally would fall, the warden gives itself up to save them, restoring a portion of their vitality. Overwhelming blows bypass its protection.

rites.name: Orasum Sereoles
rites.text: A protective surge of fury that a sworn keeper of the wild can call upon. It is available to those who walk the path of the warden-shapers.

rites.name: Telerium Mausiarus
rites.text: A small creature's innate talent that it draws upon while contesting a battle with a tamed companion. The gift is one of its quiet natural powers, used only in those bouts.

rites.name: Nianisus
rites.text: A bleeding-wound technique practiced by shapeshifting beast-wardens. It is a trait that can be gained by those who take the wild form of the beast-kin.

rites.name: Sirniantes
rites.text: A recurring restorative quality found on certain gear, mending the bearer's vitality in brief pulses rather than all at once. Some natural mending depends on inner calm, while this quality keeps working regardless of the bearer's state.

rites.name: Moles Veolum
rites.text: A shared privilege among a fellowship of allied members lets their written messages reach one another without any delay. It belongs to the community's network of bonds.

rites.name: Valor Amestia
rites.text: A tiered discipline of shapeshifter training that sharpens the mind in every guise, hardens the body of the bear form, and strengthens the limbs of the cat form. It is taught in three graded steps within a combat school.

rites.name: Monanum Coraurnia
rites.text: A fog-like bloom of fury that settles over a hunter's kin-beasts and sharpens their wild temper. It is a craft known only to the tamers who train creatures for the chase.

rites.name: Rornes Tinaulia
rites.text: A tactic that lets a creature companion act wildly during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used by many of the beasts in such bouts.

rites.name: Ameosus Vires
rites.text: A stored vital essence drawn from hidden reservoirs in a towering prison of the cursed. It grants its bearer a surge of strength.

rites.name: Laustor Nauntoles
rites.text: A bound power of spiritual essence drawn from hidden stores kept within a dreadful tower of endless ruin. It is gained only by those who dare to seek those reserves out.

rites.name: Tausia Telistum
rites.text: A passing blessing that doubles the rewards gathered by a traveler's honor tokens during set periods. It leaves the yearly ceiling untouched and lingers through falls and departures until the keepers lift it.

rites.name: Amostor Lelia
rites.text: A soothing warmth that companion beasts can call forth during a contest of creatures, restoring their strength in the middle of the match.

rites.name: Carernus
rites.text: A combat technique employed by beasts of the wild during a contest of champions. It is used by many creatures during such a duel.

rites.name: Niastor Cereornanum
rites.text: A bright inner vitality that can be drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence found within a towering prison of the cursed. It grants its wielder a surge of protective power.

rites.name: Teleonor Telarium
rites.text: A standing communal blessing that shortens the return-stone recharge for every member of a fellowship. It also quickens two other homeward rites and several charms won during festivals.

rites.name: Meornestes Sernistanum
rites.text: A measure of how quickly a body mends its own vitality over time. The mending comes in steady pulses and grows stronger when a being rests, while the strength of each pulse fades as its bearer grows.

rites.name: Telarnes Vausinum
rites.text: A ritual trait that can be awakened by the keepers of two gentle nature-healing and shapeshifting paths. It is a mark of attunement to the sun's peak.

rites.name: Tirnauria
rites.text: A quiet, passive gift that a sacred caster gains at a high level. Each time other spells are cast, the sanctified words recharge faster.

rites.name: Orellintor
rites.text: A sacred rite of the healer-caste that mends every companion nearby and sets lasting restorative wards upon each of them. Its recharge grows shorter when other blessed rites are performed, and it may be called even while the healer stands in a state of spirit-transformation.

rites.name: Lianes Rarnes
rites.text: A tactic that lets small companion creatures spend their turn during a contest of champions. Its use calls on the animal's own agitated voice.

rites.name: Nantum Teleoses
rites.text: A small guardian creature can unleash a sacred surge in a companion duel. The surge is a special technique reserved for these tiny contests of pets.

rites.name: Oriarnes Niarillum
rites.text: A tactic that lets creatures in a contest of tamed beasts draw strength from roughage. It is used by many of the animal companions that battle one another.

rites.name: Valauranum Sauntia
rites.text: A scholar's milestone earned by studying every part of a primer on tearing open the fabric between planes. The primer grants access to sealed texts and to remote locations that ordinary travel cannot reach.

rites.name: Sereonum Coreolania
rites.text: A form of forced restraint in which a bound creature is held in place or sent staggering in a random direction, unable to act for a time. The hold is a magical affliction that can be cleared by a counterspell, and some shadowed workings can be shrugged off entirely.

rites.name: Molia Virnialium
rites.text: A piercing vocal cry that creatures of the companion kind unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used as a tactic within such duels.

rites.name: Leniastia
rites.text: A bonded talent that gifts the wardens of vengeance who wield the cursed blade. It can be awakened only by those who have sworn oaths of retribution.

rites.name: Riallornus
rites.text: A stored spiritual power drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, ruined tower of torment. It is gathered there and then unleashed by a skilled hunter.

rites.name: Oristium Lirnalia
rites.text: A tracker's discipline that sharpens a huntsman's aim from a middle rank of training. It lies within the marksman's branch of the hunter's craft.

rites.name: Orollus Toneranum
rites.text: A ravenous inner force that is gathered from hidden reserves within a deep prison-tower. Those who draw on it grow stronger by feeding on stored essence.

rites.name: Telaustor Oraustarnia
rites.text: A minor frozen attunement that a cold-channeling caster draws upon, aligning the chance to strike several times at once. It belongs to the frost-working arts of a bygone craft.

rites.name: Lornum Causinum
rites.text: A hunter's talent that stands among the choices of a tenth tier of skill. Taking it locks out a rival option and pairs with a venom-delivering technique.

rites.name: Naurium Valoseonium
rites.text: A siphoned spirit-essence is drawn from hidden reliquary vaults within a towering prison of lost souls. Wielders gain a power fed by this stored vital energy.

rites.name: Vaularnum
rites.text: A high-tier demon-hunter technique in which the practitioner consumes the essence of their foe. It is a talent awakened by a fierce battle-hardened style.

rites.name: Telauntes Tintor
rites.text: A dread-laden lexicon of forbidden words that channels a spiritual force, drawn from hidden stores found within a condemned spire. Its wielders gain strength by speaking its terms aloud.

rites.name: Valialesor
rites.text: A stored spiritual power that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs within a dark, towering prison-fortress. It grants its bearer the strength to hunt.

rites.name: Serostellia
rites.text: A hunter's craft that draws a binding force from stored spirit-essence hidden in a dark tower of the condemned. Its power is gathered from those hoarded reserves.

rites.name: Corastus Sonum
rites.text: A tooth-sharpening technique that a number of tamed beasts draw upon during contests of companionship. The strengthening it grants lingers even when a creature is swapped out for another.

rites.name: Selares
rites.text: A tracker's craft that sharpens the mark a hunter lays upon prey, making the shot strike harder while costing less of the caster's reserve. It belongs to the archer's discipline of aimed fire.

rites.name: Oristelus Ameontia
rites.text: A refined purifying rite granted only to devoted champions of the light, while rival orders are taught a different cleansing art instead.

rites.name: Orelor Oraulus
rites.text: A refined summoning craft that lets a dark caster call forth stronger hunting hounds of the abyss. It is learned by practitioners who have reached a high tier of demonic study.

rites.name: Sereontanum Valosor
rites.text: A holy blessing that a champion of the order can gain as a reward for growth. It may become available early in their advancement, though it is not promised until they reach a later stage.

rites.name: Amauntor Nausellium
rites.text: A minor trained skill of a shadow-stalker's discipline, placed deep within a guild's teachings. It sometimes returns the gathered strikes-of-focus spent on a piercing technique.

rites.name: Nisor Meosaules
rites.text: A healing craft that was tested briefly and then set aside before ever being put into common use. It took the place of an older key-like art, and a later growth-based remedy took its place.

rites.name: Cenum Centaunum
rites.text: A fighter's trained skill that lets a warrior vault across the battlefield toward a foe. It may be learned from a fairly early point in a warrior's growth, but the full gift is not promised until later.

rites.name: Serinanum Amelanum
rites.text: A quiet passive craft granted to spellcasters of high standing, it lets a stilling pulse halt all incantation at any moment for a brief span. The pulse works beyond the ordinary sealing of one school of magic, and the original binding still functions as before.

rites.name: Ameollium Ameostus
rites.text: A chilling enhancement granted to mages that can be gained at an early stage of advancement, though it is not assured until later. It sharpens the wielder's command over cold.

rites.name: Narus Teleontises
rites.text: A caster's trained knack that lets a practitioner move with rapid speed for a brief moment right after a sudden short teleport. It is mostly used in duels and in battles that demand constant repositioning.

rites.name: Valeorolium
rites.text: A discipline taught in the first rank of a warrior's training path. It extends the distance from which a fighter can pass sentence on a foe.

rites.name: Nilianium
rites.text: A tainted rending technique that companion beasts use when they clash in organized contests. It is performed during pet duels to strike opponents.

rites.name: Rianium Saustania
rites.text: A refined technique a tracker may learn once they grow seasoned, though it is not assured until a later stage of their training. It sharpens how a hunter cuts down beasts.

rites.name: Amalornum
rites.text: A refined tidal technique practiced by water-wielding spirit-casters, granted to adepts who reach a certain stage of their training. Mastery is never assured until the caster advances further.

rites.name: Tiarnaulia
rites.text: A refined hearth-rite practiced by wandering monks, granted to initiates once they reach a certain depth of training. Its full mastery is not assured for those who study it.

rites.name: Oralles Maustanum
rites.text: A refined technique a hunter may gain as they advance, though it is not promised to every hunter. It sharpens the aim of a focused volley.

rites.name: Sereolaurum
rites.text: A practitioner's refined talent for summoning arcane forces, granted in stages as the caster grows in skill. It is not always awarded as early as hoped.

rites.name: Tillium Valasiastia
rites.text: A learned discipline of dark-flame craft that a practitioner refines through five rungs of study within one school of forbidden arts. Its mastery sharpens the force of a common shadowy bolt.

rites.name: Tiaranum Orauntolles
rites.text: A refined surge of raw magical force that a caster may claim as a lasting gift once they reach a certain standing. The gift is never fully promised until a later stage of growth is reached.

rites.name: Oriastornes
rites.text: A refined form of divine striking that a holy caster can learn when reaching a certain tier of mastery, though the gift is not promised until later growth. It is a boon granted to devout practitioners of the sacred arts.

rites.name: Tostillanum
rites.text: A learned skill of the archer's discipline that lengthens how long a jolting strike keeps an enemy dazed. It sits near the base of the marksman's branch of training.

rites.name: Rolus Raularnus
rites.text: A practiced caster gains a guaranteed surge of heat after two sharp successive strikes from fiery spells. The surge can be carried on the move and costs nothing from one's reserves.

rites.name: Ceres Rarnium
rites.text: A bonded power that a sorcerer may gain as they advance, granting enhanced infernal allies. It is not promised until the sorcerer reaches a late stage of their ascent.

rites.name: Naurneostus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a caster conjure extra bolts of arcane force whenever they launch their basic missile incantation. The added bolts strengthen the spell's barrage.

rites.name: Rialles Sornium
rites.text: A combat technique available to a shadowy hunter of demons, unlocked once a warrior reaches a certain rank. It lets the user seize and hold a foe in a contest between rivals.

rites.name: Mastelles
rites.text: A bearing a warrior-guardian can gain as they grow, offered from an early stage of their advancement and assured only at a later one.

rites.name: Amauses Caunor
rites.text: A trained skill of the shadow-striker's school. It raises the harm of a quick blade strike while lowering the strain it costs the wielder's reserve of vigor.

rites.name: Maneores
rites.text: A refined reserve of magical strength that a spellcaster can unlock, with the gift arriving at a certain stage of growth but not always surely granted until a later point.

rites.name: Amarnoles
rites.text: A refined surge of volatile power that a dark-arts practitioner can gain as a reward for advancing through their path. It is granted only after a certain stage of growth, and its arrival is never fully assured.

rites.name: Corernes Orelanum
rites.text: A passive craft from a deep branch of cold-focused training that, once fully learned, sharpens the wielder's frozen strikes. It requires heavy investment in the frost discipline before it can be fully mastered.

rites.name: Tiarnus Teliantor
rites.text: A dizzying technique that a fermented elemental creature uses while contesting a bout between tamed beasts. It clouds the opponent's senses in the arena.

rites.name: Corolus Ronteornium
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a caster's sparks sometimes recharge a fiery blast, stunning the struck foe briefly and scattering lingering burns to nearby enemies.

rites.name: Tausores
rites.text: A personal silencing rite lets a wanderer hush the voices of one chosen figure. Their speech, messages, and summons no longer reach the wanderer, and the silenced figure is informed of the choice.

rites.name: Sosilum
rites.text: A tenth-tier vengeful craft practiced by hunters who strike back at demonic foes. It is a technique bound to a wrathful, retaliatory style of combat.

rites.name: Larnus Veontanum
rites.text: A withering blessing granted to a dread warrior of the undead, offered only after a long climb through the ranks. It once replaced an older strike, but was dropped from the craft when the list of boons was trimmed down.

rites.name: Caunanum Coreria
rites.text: A frost-binding craft that lets a bound water spirit occasionally bestow two shards of winter's grasp upon its keeper. The gift strikes at random, rewarding a bond that has been well shaped.

rites.name: Valaurus Raullires
rites.text: A fighting discipline taught to frontline guardians, which sharpens a counterstrike so it hits harder and can cut down a second foe nearby.

rites.name: Nentallus
rites.text: A learned talent that a Vessan wayfarer can unlock early in their journey, though it only reliably appears after they have grown considerably more experienced.

rites.name: Saustum Launtasium
rites.text: A refined sorcerous volley that a spellcaster could unlock once they reached a certain standing in their craft. It was not granted to every practitioner, only those who advanced far enough.

rites.name: Telesontes
rites.text: A learned craft that a spiritual practitioner may gain from a set of trials, becoming available early in their training but only assured later on.

rites.name: Rentanum Seror
rites.text: A restorative surge of inner vitality that a wielder draws from stored reserves hidden in deep vaults. It mends wounds and strengthens the one who calls upon it.

rites.name: Sosia Mantiases
rites.text: A bottomless vision of endless dark that a seer glimpses while peering into the gaze of a fallen titan during a clash between a wise mage and his terrible double.

rites.name: Amenium Telantus
rites.text: A reward that opens once a seeker has finished gathering a certain collection of salvaged parts. It marks that the seeker has earned the right to draw inspiration from unexpected sources.

rites.name: Amausinum
rites.text: A grown-in boon that a nature-shaper can claim early in their path, though it is not promised until a later stage of growth. It sharpens the anger a druid channels.

rites.name: Lalor Lalia
rites.text: A refined fire-casting technique practiced by spellcasters, available to practitioners once they reach an advanced stage of training. It is not automatically granted to every caster who approaches that stage.

rites.name: Telintanum Cales
rites.text: A refined killing blow practiced by Blood-path warriors of the dead-bound order. It sharpens the strike but does not raise the floor of restorative mending.

rites.name: Seresium Corollanum
rites.text: A knight's sworn blessing that can be earned once a warrior grows seasoned, though its arrival is never certain until much later. It belongs to the paladin path of a distant frontier realm.

rites.name: Lausontanum
rites.text: A high-tier discipline of the shadow-hunters that releases a bursting wave of unstable energy. It is learned only after reaching the upper ranks of training.

rites.name: Seraleonus
rites.text: A dark practice that a caster can gain as a late-stage reward, though it only comes to those who reach a high mastery of their craft. It enhances the shadow arts with an improved ember-based burst.

rites.name: Leranum Lalum
rites.text: A learned discipline within a grim order of warriors who draw vitality from their own lifeblood. It belongs to the tradition of the crimson arts and is practiced by those who master the inner current.

rites.name: Telauntiles Seolus
rites.text: A vital force that grants its wielder greatly enlarged bodily proportions. It is drawn from a laboratory-grown vessel of raw life-essence.

rites.name: Ristanum Vaurnor
