rites.text: A rage-born gift that a battle-hardened fighter of the crimson-bladed sort can draw upon. It fuels the wielder's wrath and binds it to their combat craft.

rites.name: Raureoles
rites.text: A fighter's fury wells up faster than it can be spent, letting them unleash their skills again and again for the length of a clash. Battle-hardened guardians welcome this flood, since it keeps their foes locked onto them.

rites.name: Oresiallia Resallia
rites.text: A jaw-born affliction carried by the wild pack-hunters of one clan. It halves the mending a struck creature can receive from restorative magic.

rites.name: Oranornium
rites.text: A stillness-craft that binds a hunter's strike to the rhythm of motion. It is chosen as an exclusive path alongside a related flow of momentum.

rites.name: Mastus Taulonium
rites.text: A stored surge that a small adorned companion draws upon in a contest between captured creatures. It lets the companion bloat its strength for a moment during such a match.

rites.name: Teorniarum
rites.text: A latent vital force that awakens inside a person, drawn out through a specialized laboratory cell. It is a power that flows from the cell's experimental essence.

rites.name: Telolia Mostanum
rites.text: A stare that breaks into a creature's focus during a contest between tamed beasts. It lets a companion disrupt its rival's next move at the right moment.

rites.name: Serosia Siasum
rites.text: A tactic that creepers of a certain kind use in combat contests between beasts. It destabilizes their rivals during each contest.

rites.name: Neosentia
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that lets a practitioner harden the hands into weapons. It is open to those who train in the fighting arts of a certain order of wandering healers.

rites.name: Teleornanum Corantosium
rites.text: A spell or ability that takes no casting time, so it can be used while moving. Some are damage over time, some heal over time, and others strike at once, and they differ from channelled effects that must be held before they finish.

rites.name: Cisum Serintor
rites.text: A calm, passive gift that lets a wanderer gather twice the restful renewal while idle. It needs no effort and works quietly in the background.

rites.name: Cornus Viases
rites.text: A bound skill that stirs a relentless craving within a fighter's strike, feeding them as they press their attacks. It is taken as a mutually exclusive option alongside a single blade-based technique.

rites.name: Amisia Miantenus
rites.text: A ritual inscription of guardian light that is etched onto the armour of sworn defenders. It grants its bearers a measure of protective resolve that can be drawn only by those trained in shield-keeping.

rites.name: Rorus Coranaulles
rites.text: A method of restarting a shared enclosed domain so that its creatures return and certain faults are cleared. It may be applied fully or only in part.

rites.name: Coroneorum
rites.text: A battle technique where creatures strike their foes with a sharp green-hued swipe. It is performed by beasts that fight at their companions' side.

rites.name: Niasinor Meonaures
rites.text: A sudden burst of disruptive force that a companion creature can unleash in the middle of a contest between tamed beasts. It breaks the rhythm of a duel.

rites.name: Oreostum Serauntia
rites.text: A charged-particle blast that creatures of the tamer arena can unleash during a contest between companion beasts. It is a technique wielded in bouts between pets.

rites.name: Mentor Velleonum
rites.text: A bonded ritual grants a traveler lasting entry into a sealed chamber. Once granted, the passage stays open, though older gates once demanded a trial or a relic first.

rites.name: Amarnium Amarneores
rites.text: A craft practiced by evokers that strengthens their gift. It is an exclusive option that binds to another paired ability, so that only one of the two can be chosen.

rites.name: Telantes Corenum
rites.text: A tactic that lets a chosen warrior mark a rival for judgment, empowering a holy oath against those who clash with them. It is unlocked at a set point of training, with different paths granting access to it.

rites.name: Telanentia
rites.text: A ruthless combat technique that lets a hunter of avenging demons strike rivals in open contest, unlocked once a fighter reaches a twentieth rank of skill.

rites.name: Serines Vestorium
rites.text: A secondary attunement that tunes a practitioner toward repeated strikes. It also strengthens a healing mist technique and a rising kick.

rites.name: Valeosinor Ameolenor
rites.text: A free rite offered by the guild-keepers that restores lost or discarded relics to their owners. Each traveler may call upon it only a limited number of times within a set span of days.

rites.name: Caulornium
rites.text: A quiet discipline that lets a guardian's strikes of judgment kindle a small reserve of sacred force. Each judging blow stores one measure of that radiance for later use.

rites.name: Vaustium Nanum
rites.text: A sudden burst of electrical energy that companion beasts unleash during a contest between tamed creatures. It is a tactic used by many of these animals in such battles.

rites.name: Tallium Valeornia
rites.text: A keen perception granted to a family of serpentine hunting companions, sharpening their owner's skill in proportion to their rank. It works just like the blessings shared by several other companion lineages.

rites.name: Veliaror
rites.text: A bounding enchantment granted when a sealed tuning stone is struck against its matching lantern. The bearer leaps with renewed vigor for a time.

rites.name: Amiranum Telalenanum
rites.text: A passive scheming art practiced by spellcasters of dark arcane orders, granted once a practitioner reaches a high rank of mastery. It works quietly in the background without any deliberate action.

rites.name: Valilum Ciallostor
rites.text: A mark of mastery granted to those who finish a perilous fog-shrouded trial at the highest challenge tier before the clock runs out. It bestows a swift passage spell that lets the bearer step through the veiled woodland.

rites.name: Testum Valestor
rites.text: A hunter's innate skill that is granted automatically to those trained in precise ranged marksmanship. It is a foundational talent placed on the first tier of the hunter's skill tree.

rites.name: Mollentus
rites.text: A tactical technique that companion creatures employ during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used by many different pets in these battles.

rites.name: Tornasus
rites.text: A guardian technique taught to defenders who stand before their lord. It is a trait of protective fighters, though it is rarely seen in practice.

rites.name: Coristor Mentes
rites.text: A mental power that grants a wielder awareness of how fleeting life is. It is gathered from hidden reserves found inside a vast cursed spire.

rites.name: Cialium Ceornus
rites.text: A dormant toxin lies sealed within the bearer's craft, quietly available to those who walk the wild paths of the hunt. It is a gift granted by a crystalline ore to skilled trackers.

rites.name: Rarestes
rites.text: A drifting spirit-power gathered from hidden reservoirs of soul-essence in a dread tower of punishment. It flows through the bearer like a leaf carried on still water.

rites.name: Valontes Saurneosia
rites.text: A focused beam of light that certain companion beasts can unleash during contests between tamed creatures. It is one of the striking techniques they use to wear down their rivals.

rites.name: Serenia Neornollum
rites.text: A faded residue of spent spirit is gathered from hidden reliquaries in a dreadful tower of trials. Those who draw upon it wield a weakened, lingering essence of the soul.

rites.name: Niaseollus
rites.text: A borrowed spiritual gift that is drawn from stored reserves of essence hidden deep within a grim, towering prison. Those who seek it must delve into dangerous, shifting depths to gather it.

rites.name: Teolliantia
rites.text: A tactic that companion beasts employ during a contest between tamed creatures. It is used by many of them in those duels.

rites.name: Neostium Valonaustes
rites.text: A hidden reservoir of vital essence can be drawn from sealed caches inside a dreadful spiraling prison. Its power lets the wearer tap these stored reserves for strength.

rites.name: Vantenium
rites.text: A quick strike technique that creatures of many kinds use during contests between tamed companions. It is a common move in these organized bouts of skill.

rites.name: Corontium Rauliarnus
rites.text: A flight technique that certain companion creatures perform during contests between tamed beasts. It lets them launch themselves skyward to strike an opponent from above.

rites.name: Seolum Lesaror
rites.text: A hidden trait that lingers within the dark-bound warriors of the grave. It grants them a final unexpected advantage in their most desperate moments.

rites.name: Niantes Sentiria
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that a wielder draws from hidden reservoirs found within a dark, sprawling tower of punishment. It empowers those who gather it.

rites.name: Oraulanum Vostus
rites.text: A member withdraws from a shared company by issuing a single command or gesture. If only the leader remains, the company dissolves entirely.

rites.name: Listor Sontia
rites.text: A drawing power that siphons vital essence from hidden reservoirs of stored energy found within a deep, haunted tower. Its user gathers the stolen force to strengthen themselves.

rites.name: Renor Seriastanum
rites.text: A combat technique that lets a bladed fighter hold a final, deadly movement on the verge of death. It is learned by warriors of the dueling arenas once they reach a certain rank.

rites.name: Mellaurnum
rites.text: A minor trait that lets a wielder reclaim a portion of their vitality each time they strike or mend. The returned strength scales with how much of the trait they hold.

rites.name: Cisestum
rites.text: A surge of molten heat that a practitioner of the elemental arts can draw upon. It belongs to a set of inherited marks that are gained through a sacred metal.

rites.name: Tarnum Niallentia
rites.text: A bound quality that grants a shadow passage one extra use while lengthening the wait before it can be called again. It is drawn from a lineage of ambitious lords.

rites.name: Corantor Oreosilor
rites.text: A channeled gift that lets an elemental-attuned practitioner draw storm energy through their body. It belongs to the arts of the close-combat storm-wielders.

rites.name: Orirelum
rites.text: A sacred blessing that a holy warrior of the radiant order can call upon in battle. It grants a bond to the divine flame and strengthens the wielder's strikes against foes.

rites.name: Lintes Mentum
rites.text: A tactic that a winged creature uses during a contest between tamed beasts, allowing it to launch itself skyward. It is commonly employed by feathered fighters.

rites.name: Seraulles Ciantes
rites.text: A dazzling light-scatter technique that a mechanical companion unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. It blinds and confuses rivals in the arena.

rites.name: Raunernum
rites.text: A glowing inner trait of the wild-caller order, a hidden spark that rouses restorative and balanced healers who draw upon the living grove.

rites.name: Valontarum Rastelles
rites.text: A dark inner power that is drawn from hidden reservoirs within a sealed tower of the condemned. It clings to the bearer and slowly gnaws at their spirit.

rites.name: Sonia Orantosanum
rites.text: A traveler's rite of withdrawing from the shared realm back to the choosing hall. It takes a short wait outside safe havens, but is immediate within them, and cannot be performed while a battle rages.

rites.name: Coralor Tiallum
rites.text: A bestowed token that teaches its bearer to take on a dragon's face-form. It is kept in a traveler's ledger of mounts, so no separate ceremonial staff is needed to call upon the change.

rites.name: Rillum Neoses
rites.text: A dormant craft that a sky-worker's kind of caster can draw from storm-fire. It is not currently available to anyone.

rites.name: Corelia Raules
rites.text: A weakening effect that is placed upon a recharging hub, reducing the energy it can supply to nearby devices.

rites.name: Orallisum
rites.text: A persistent taint that remains within a sealed ancient vault after a great assault on a fortress city. It is said to linger in the chambers beneath a fallen stronghold.

rites.name: Orintesanum
rites.text: A dormant mystical attunement shaped for three kinds of keepers of the wild. It is recorded as not presently accessible to anyone.

rites.name: Losus Mosenium
rites.text: A bond-born quality that any practitioner may awaken, but only through certain sea-forged armor or relics drawn from a deep sunken citadel.

rites.name: Tirus Caurus
rites.text: A small creature's mind-based technique that it draws upon while locked in a contest against another captive beast. It is a crafted way of thinking that guides its moves.

rites.name: Tentallum
rites.text: A shimmering aura that settles over a band of strangers gathered by chance for a trial below ground. It grows stronger with each unfamiliar companion, easing the clumsiness that comes from teams who have never fought together.

rites.name: Telestor Verosanum
rites.text: A dazzling charm technique that a wandering trader-beast uses when pitted against a tamed companion in a contest of creatures. It leaves opponents smitten and slow to act.

rites.name: Tostus Serosanum
rites.text: A tactical technique that lets a creature fix its attention on a chosen foe during a contest between beasts. Many kinds of companion creatures can perform it when a battle begins.

rites.name: Amaureosor
rites.text: A command-driven rite that strips the authority of a chosen member within a shared gathering space. It is invoked by naming the gathering and the member to be stripped of their office.

rites.name: Nentiasum
rites.text: A signal-binding craft that quietly reselects the most recent allied companion whenever a user calls it. Its invocation accepts optional modifiers.

rites.name: Telirnonium
rites.text: A stored arrangement that swaps a wearer's gear in one command, pulling a saved loadout from the keeper's ledger. Names and options are given to the call so it knows which set to bring forth.

rites.name: Valirnanum Teollus
rites.text: A grant of watchful authority that a chosen participant receives within a shared gathering space. It lets that person oversee the room and keep order among those present.

rites.name: Caustes Reorneles
rites.text: A keyed command that brings up a window showing the details of whatever is currently being looked at. It lets a traveler study the chosen subject closely.

rites.name: Lantum Liales
rites.text: A mysterious headpiece-based technique that a small frosty companion uses during a contest between creatures kept as companions. It lets its wearer act in a special way within these battles.

rites.name: Tialus Coreontum
rites.text: A spoken rite that carries a short message to every gathered soul within a sixty-stride reach, sounded by a caster who speaks the words aloud in a shared circle.

rites.name: Taulium Orelontium
rites.text: A quiet arcane tendency that a caster gains upon reaching a high rank of study. Taking a rival sorcery of the same tier removes it from the caster's practice.

rites.name: Mistiantium
rites.text: A signal rite that lets a bound speaker voice their words again within a shared channel. The caller names the channel and the silenced one, and the restored voice may then speak or write freely.

rites.name: Lenium Ciallium
rites.text: A caster's gift that raises defense against every kind of arcane force, and refills their reserve of power each time a hostile working is turned aside. Its value grows with the size of the caster's reserve.

rites.name: Vesteonium
rites.text: A mechanic lets one actor adopt the focus of another by a simple command. Invoking it with a chosen companion's name, or with nothing, copies that companion's chosen foe.

rites.name: Ciales Oraurnistum
rites.text: A coded rite lets a member of a gathered band be named as the chief aide. The naming is set by speaking a short invocation followed by the chosen member's name.

rites.name: Valornes Valliaria
rites.text: A guardian's enduring vigor is awakened upon reaching the highest rank of training. It is available only to those who take the path of a sworn protector of the grove.

rites.name: Telaulinus Orarium
rites.text: A command that switches on automatic casting for a companion's spell. It takes optional settings followed by the name of the chosen spell.

rites.name: Orontirnia Seriastum
rites.text: A signal-command that exchanges the arrangement of two stored ability panels at once. The user names both panels, and optional modifiers adjust how the swap is carried out.

rites.name: Amorium Tiastor
rites.text: A molten-earth trick used by a small fire creature during a contest of tamed beasts. It seals an opponent's movement under heated stone.

rites.name: Serauntes Seollonum
rites.text: A bundled sequence of several short commands that fires together when a single button is pressed. Users keep a set number of these saved for themselves and for each figure they control.

rites.name: Amauliaror
rites.text: A signaling craft that lets a practitioner cycle their focus through nearby allied travelers. It is directed by a chosen heading and tuned by a few optional settings.

rites.name: Telantus Mialia
rites.text: A user-made command sequence that cycles a chosen target among allied beings nearby. It is entered with a short command followed by a direction to pick which ally comes next.

rites.name: Nonium Launtium
rites.text: A command technique that swaps the active row of hotkey slots to a chosen set of abilities. The user types it with options and the number of the set to bring forward.

rites.name: Vellium Ceornontia
rites.text: A learned gift of dark magic that a caster can draw upon once they reach a high level of mastery. It is practiced by those who wield forbidden sorcery.

rites.name: Reornium Meorialia
rites.text: A guild-bound rite that revives every companion in a shared band at once, open to anyone standing in the group. Each person can be restored this way only once every ten minutes, shown by a marker hovering over them.

rites.name: Nantiria
rites.text: A grim, rank-tier craft of the blood-bound fighters that lets a practitioner call upon a host of restless dead when their chosen path of study is reached. It is learned only after long mastery of the lineage.

rites.name: Cosiarnanum
rites.text: A lingering curse that settles on a fallen wanderer when they die near a great beast. Paired with a surrounding aura, it binds the afflicted into a long, helpless slumber that halts all action.

rites.name: Naullanum Amonialium
rites.text: A learned technique of the restorer's path lets a shapechanger gain one of four passive boosts, shaped by the animal guise taken. Each boost raises a different measure of power by a fixed share.

rites.name: Cianisanum
rites.text: A stored reservoir of arcane vitality is drawn from sealed vaults within a cursed spire. It grants its bearer a surge of magical strength.

rites.name: Raullerium
rites.text: A sacred gift that holy warriors may draw upon, granting them a lasting spark of their faith through the vital currents of their inner strength.

rites.name: Nintia Sauntia
rites.text: A deep-winter discipline that a frost-touched warrior of the cold order draws upon. The more one grows attuned to the wellspring of inner strength, the stronger the chill becomes.

rites.name: Teliaralus
rites.text: A reflex bestowed upon a sworn wardbearer of the wild paths, granting an innate sense of timing that guides the bearer's movements. It belongs to those who take the form of beasts to defend the grove.

rites.name: Testium Seriarnanum
rites.text: A discipline practiced by augmenting casters, whose skill grows as their mastery of secondary attributes deepens. It lets the practitioner bend the flow of moments around their allies.

rites.name: Silarnum
rites.text: A mastery that a wanderer gains by building up layered insight during a stormy passage of time. Insight can only be gathered once each cycle, and collecting it repeatedly earns a lasting title among scholars of the tide.

rites.name: Teostes Ceonanum
rites.text: A growing inner attunement that strengthens a healer's restorative power for each lingering mending effect on an ally. Mending drawn from outside sources does not count toward its strength.

rites.name: Terum Coralaunum
rites.text: A practiced discipline of the sacred healers that makes most restorative touches leave a lingering warmth, slowly mending the one they reach. Its strength grows as the healer's inner attunement deepens.

rites.name: Relostor Serestium
rites.text: A passive inner talent that each practitioner unlocks at a set rank and can strengthen through attuned gear. It grants percentage-based boosts to abilities, conditional bonuses, or occasional extra effects.

rites.name: Mellor Reontisium
rites.text: A foundational craft taught to practitioners of the shadowy trades at the beginning of their training. It sharpens the basic methods of stealth and quick strikes.

rites.name: Seraurnum Nesia
rites.text: A quiet ward that masks coarse speech so listeners see only scrambled glyphs in place of harsh words. Many travelers choose to lift the ward and hear everything plainly.

rites.name: Teolanes Amiastontum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets hunters bind themselves to artificial war-beasts, guiding and following them across the land. It is taught as a disciplined practice of taming and tracking.

rites.name: Veosillium
rites.text: A fiery sky-born craft tied to the dark summoners of the demon arts. It is said to be currently out of reach to those who seek it.

rites.name: Tolliarnum
rites.text: A learned talent that any practitioner of any calling can cultivate. It is found woven into a suit of protective gear recovered from several distant ruins.

rites.name: Taunum Telenteoria
rites.text: A stored tide of learned power that a hall's keepers can purchase to call a conjurer-scholar into view. It is unlocked for the hall's guardian.

rites.name: Lintornia
rites.text: A keepsake earned by strengthening the companions who fight beside you in a distant realm. It draws on the power gathered from those allies as they grow.

rites.name: Oreonaustus
rites.text: A battle technique in which a companion creature strikes its foe with a hardened, armored forelimb during a contest of trained beasts.

rites.name: Corarnes Orinastia
rites.text: A learned technique that lets a fighter of the wandering monk discipline strike with heightened precision. It is drawn from a crystalline essence bound into armor.

rites.name: Volleornor
rites.text: A swift burst of heightened vitality that a small pet can call upon during a contest between tamed creatures. It lets the creature act with greater energy for a short time.

rites.name: Serillores Serantaulia
rites.text: A tier-six discipline of the frost branch, where a fighter's blows grow more pitiless against foes who are already faltering. It is taught through a tree of learnable arts.

rites.name: Vollinus
rites.text: A reflexive gift of swift thought, granted to rank-sixteen casters of certain arcane and elemental schools. It sharpens how quickly they can weave their spells in battle.

rites.name: Coriarnium Volus
rites.text: A brief lull of calm that a caster of the healing arts can draw upon as a gift woven into their gear. It is open to those who follow the path of restraint and shielding.

rites.name: Varnelus
rites.text: A savage biting technique practiced by beast companions bred for hunting. It is a special ability that a tamed creature of the hunter lineage can use in battle.

rites.name: Neolus Telirnium
rites.text: A practiced discipline in which a trained adept gathers drifting vapor around the body. It is one of two mutually exclusive paths a student may take within a cultivator's training.

rites.name: Nellium Mirnostum
rites.text: A stolen life-force skill drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden in a dread tower of punishment. Those who harvest its essence can bind it into their own being to gain new strength.

rites.name: Varostus
rites.text: A fearsome fighting class whose strikes spring from a striking crest of hair. Its power was slipped into a vast digital realm by a famously brawny machine-savvy warrior.

rites.name: Vornauntia
rites.text: A tactical craft in which a bound helper is hindered by slowing and stunning effects, useful for groups that lack strong damage output.

rites.name: Orolastes
rites.text: A priest-only mental technique passed to members of a secretive oath-sworn sect. Its use is granted to initiates and lent temporarily to outsiders who finish a particular ordeal.

rites.name: Sornes Celostium
rites.text: A ranged projectile technique that creatures use during a contest between tamed beasts. Its arc and impact let a companion wear down an opponent from a distance.

rites.name: Cistantum Valiastor
rites.text: A tactic that lets a trained companion strike several times in a single contest of arranged creatures. It is used only while the opposing creatures are being matched in combat.

rites.name: Amarnanum Viarnales
rites.text: A bonding rite that is set alight by spending a special charm token. It draws out a surge of wrath that binds the wielder's temper into a lasting force.

rites.name: Rintaustes Sintes
rites.text: A tactic in which small creatures hurl wet earth at their opponents during a contest of companion beasts. The sludge clogs the enemy and slows its movement for the round.

rites.name: Voneollor Meonia
rites.text: A passive enchantment that wakes whenever one of two linked charms is invoked. It lets its bearer carry a small glowing fire-spark along with them.

rites.name: Viarornus Miarnelum
rites.text: A creature's form is altered mid-contest by a skill that turns its body into a new shape. It is used by a beast-tamer's companion during a staged duel.

rites.name: Rarus Teliarnium
rites.text: A spoken command that makes a rider's steed or shapeshifted form perform a showy trick while standing still. Some trick moves can only be called out by the command, and it works only when the rider is on solid ground.

rites.name: Orillianus
rites.text: A paid rite lets a wanderer take a fresh calling-name for their bearer-self. The old name lies dormant for ninety days, and the rite cannot be undone once sealed.

rites.name: Corosia Viaria
rites.text: A tactic that a winged scavenger bird calls upon during a contest between tamed beasts. It lets the creature unleash its ability in the midst of a bout.

rites.name: Miastium Narum
rites.text: A creature's ability that unleashes a sudden burst of power during a contest between beasts. It is used by many companions when they battle one another.

rites.name: Neonirus
rites.text: A stored inner power is drawn from hidden reserves in a grim, ruined tower of torment. It grants whoever claims it a surge of borrowed strength.

rites.name: Ameolum Sereonosor
rites.text: A caster's gift that, once invoked, makes the next restorative or binding rite happen at once, with greater healing and lasting longer. Rites that must be sustained over time are unaffected.

rites.name: Seoriastor
rites.text: A learned instinct drawn from the wild-fighting discipline, unlocked once a practitioner has invested heavily in that discipline's training path. It is a talent that must be fully developed before it can be mastered.

rites.name: Valeornes Teornanum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of the hollow beasts employ during contests of tamed companions. It lets a companion slip past opposing defenses in a single decisive move.

rites.name: Telirnanium
rites.text: A dark craft that lets a fighter who wields a cursed blade make open injuries fester and decay, sapping the strength of a foe in close combat. It is learned once a warrior reaches an early ripening of skill.

rites.name: Ameoses Sauntus
rites.text: A shielding technique that companions of many kinds call upon while they contend in a contest of tamed creatures. It lets them weather an opponent's assault with greater resilience.

rites.name: Teleonum Telenia
rites.text: A bond-born resilience reserved for one kin-line of beasts of burden and their hunting companions. It lets such animals shrug off harm that would fell other creatures.

rites.name: Reostus Cinanum
rites.text: A minor protective gift that a certain order of brewing-artisans could draw upon. It was an enchantment tied to the craft of their hands, arising from a deep-rooted attunement with their work.

rites.name: Orisanum Cellosanum
rites.text: A small biting technique that wild companion creatures use in contests between tamed beasts. It is commonly relied upon by the lesser creatures that travel alongside their keepers.

rites.name: Orelorium
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures employ during contests between tamed beasts. It lets many of them act in the dark and strike unexpectedly.

rites.name: Oreontes Villiantium
rites.text: A learned hunter's craft that lets a trapper's venom-bearing snare hang on longer and spread its poison. It can only be studied once the sharpshooter's deeper snare-technique has been mastered.

rites.name: Valeoloria
rites.text: A shadowy talent that lets stealthy skirmishers draw on the dark to strike back. It belongs to the craft of silent blades who move unseen among their foes.

rites.name: Amaurelus Serilia
rites.text: A quiet inherited craft that lets slayers of a certain bent gain an edge in their deadly work. It is granted only to practitioners who walk the path of the silent killer.

rites.name: Merneostus
rites.text: A devastating blow that can slay nearly any fighter from full strength in one stroke. Crews plan ways to dodge it, weaken it, or have a guardian soak it up.

rites.name: Rinernes
rites.text: A slick, clinging trick that creatures of gooey and shelled kind use when they face off in a contest of tamed companions. It lets them slow an opponent's grip and sway the outcome of a bout.

rites.name: Minor Cirollum
rites.text: A dark power drawn from sealed reservoirs of captured spirit energy found within a grim prison-spire. Those who tap these hoards gain strength by feeding on stored essences.

rites.name: Linium Nintus
rites.text: A quiet inner gift that sometimes lets a fighter's next strike or a healer's next mending come without drawing on their strength. Its chance arises from steady, repeated actions.

rites.name: Ceolor Tistor
rites.text: A ghostly power of the soul that is gathered from hidden reserves found within a dark, cursed tower. It is drawn out of stored essence rather than made from matter.

rites.name: Rasor Amornentor
rites.text: A tiny companion draws on a rapid flurry of strikes during a contest between tamed creatures. It is a technique a small ally can call upon in such duels.

rites.name: Nestor Ranes
rites.text: A cold-bound craft tied to a sky-falling bombardment. It is paired with two sister traits that share its frosty nature.

rites.name: Corantia Telantanum
rites.text: A bound force of inner essence drawn from hidden reserves within a deep, ruinous tower. It is gathered from stored caches and lends its wielder a dominating power.

rites.name: Seranolanum
rites.text: A deep-tier shadow craft in which a practitioner's mind-blasts sometimes freeze a foe's movements. The stillness lasts only a brief span before the victim can move again.

rites.name: Nalonor
rites.text: A reserved technique that certain tamed companions can call upon while contesting a bout between beasts. It lets them surpass their usual limits for a short moment.

rites.name: Valiasilus
rites.text: A rare surge that a wielder's radiant weapon can build up. When it takes hold, it multiplies the striking power of the holy wrath the weapon releases.

rites.name: Ciantes Taria
rites.text: A tactic where a balance-focused caster takes a sturdy beast-shape wearing defensive gear to hold enemy attention. It is a lesser stand-in for a dedicated guardian form, but it still draws blows when needed.

rites.name: Vaulornia
rites.text: A dark strength drawn from the tide of unleashed chaos, it binds closely with two other forsaken gifts that sharpen a wielder's sight and fury.

rites.name: Ameornirum Vaurosum
rites.text: A tidal craft that lets a restoration healer draw strength from the sea's surge. It belongs to the healer's path of mending and bears the mark of an ancient attunement.

rites.name: Lernor Veonum
rites.text: A bristling jolt of force that companion beasts unleash during contests of creature against creature. It locks an opponent's limbs in place, leaving them unable to act.

rites.name: Amentarnes
rites.text: A mystical gift of swirling vapor that is granted to the monks who weave mist. It empowers their craft through the flowing essence of the fog.

rites.name: Marniastus
rites.text: A combat technique in which a tamed creature hurls a sealed bundle onto the field during a contest between beasts. The bundle breaks open and strikes the opposing side.

rites.name: Nosarnor
rites.text: A borrowed surge of inner vitality that swells a wearer's footwear beyond ordinary size. It is drawn from sealed reserves found within a grim, towering prison-spire.

rites.name: Telornia Coreontes
rites.text: A dark rite of spreading sickness that only the sorcerers of the withering arts may call upon. It lets their curses leap from one victim to the next.

rites.name: Amenanum Mianernus
rites.text: Every fighter carries an emergency technique that grants a swift escape from sudden doom. These instant bursts recharge after a pause, so they can be called upon often but never without limit.

rites.name: Rollasus
rites.text: A formula is used to find strings that follow a set design, with its syntax changing according to the search method. One scripting tongue in a fantasy realm uses a simpler matching rule that shares many traits with such formulas.

rites.name: Corelor Niantus
rites.text: A talent that augmenting casters may choose, forming an exclusive pairing with a protective timekeeping ward. Taking one closes off the other.

rites.name: Lanum Lianes
rites.text: A tactic where one fighter pulls a hostile creature away from an ally who is being attacked, redirecting its attention elsewhere. It can also be done by a fighter pulling an enemy away from themselves to escape pressure.

rites.name: Coreontales
rites.text: A companion creature uses a quick jabbing attack during a contest between tamed beasts. It is one of the moves a pet can call on when battling.

rites.name: Reonelia
rites.text: A deep-tier hunting skill in which a tamed beast's bite is sharpened, and it can be chosen only in place of another, rival technique.

rites.name: Amaunia Amanium
rites.text: A tactical technique that lets a creature slip out of phase during a contest of tamed beasts. It is wielded by a luminous companion creature.

rites.name: Nillanum Sentornor
rites.text: A caster fuses a sudden clarity of mind with a blazing fire bolt, releasing it without any delay. The stored force can strike a rival hard in a single blow.

rites.name: Naulleonia
rites.text: A reach-through sight drawn from hidden reserves of charged essence found deep within a dark spire of punishment. It lets a wielder look past barriers and see what lies beyond them.

rites.name: Ciror Veorus
rites.text: A spell that lets a caster open a shimmering gateway for their companions, carrying them instantly to a distant ancient hall. Only one faction of practitioners may wield it.

rites.name: Veornones
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that a mechanical companion performs during a contest between tamed creatures. It alters the flow of the match in an unexpected way.

rites.name: Sentollus
rites.text: A tactical technique that certain tamed companions employ during contests against rival beasts. It lets them strike swiftly during a duel of creatures.

rites.name: Centor Lastintor
rites.text: A spellcaster's art that tears open a shimmering passage for their companions, leading to a floating sanctuary high above a fractured archipelago.

rites.name: Vonum Viaresanum
rites.text: A bonded ability conferred by a sickness-engineer that cannot coexist with two rival gifts. It grants its holder the power to strike first against an illness before it spreads.

rites.name: Coroniasium
rites.text: A portable sustenance power that is gathered from hidden reservoirs of spirit essence found within a dark, tormented tower.

rites.name: Cesium Oraunor
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures use during a contest of beasts. It lets a tamed animal surge into a feeding frenzy to gain an advantage in the fight.

rites.name: Tesus Tirium
rites.text: A devout caster draws on an empty dark force to strengthen their faith-touched arts. It is a late-gained talent that the master-craft of the modern age has added to the priestly path.

rites.name: Valaulernus
rites.text: A tidal gift of silver-light that lets a practitioner of the balance path draw strength from the night sky. It is bound to the heavens' pale wanderer.

rites.name: Ciantes Raullum
rites.text: A standing blessing that weakens every foe in a designated stronghold, lowering their vitality and the harm they inflict. Its potency rises week by week, and a leader can be petitioned to lift it for those who wish to face the trial unaided.

rites.name: Orernaustia
rites.text: A specialized technique of inner force that a disciplined fighter of the drifting wind sects can channel. It is available only to practitioners who follow the wind's path.

rites.name: Valeneornia
rites.text: A caster-made ward that waits on an ally and, when that ally is struck, mends them and leaps to another nearby companion. It holds several charges and ignores harm from the land or from absorbed blows.

rites.name: Cesaunor
rites.text: A quick knack that a creature can call upon while it contests a bout against a tamed companion. A later technique is later given the same signature.

rites.name: Caustiallia
rites.text: A defensive craft known to wardweavers, in which the caster's skin bristles with barbs that wound any foe who strikes it in close combat.

rites.name: Telilenor
rites.text: A soul-drawn power that a wind instrument channels, gathered from hidden reserves in a dark, ruined spire where lost spirits are held.

rites.name: Teloreosum
rites.text: A cunning skill of a hidden stalker that deepens the blow when a strike lands on a foe who is wounded and weaker than the wielder. It belongs to the upper ranks of a fighter's discipline.

rites.name: Neorus Ternaustia
rites.text: A mental strike that creatures can unleash during contests between tamed companions. It lashes out with focused thought to damage an opponent.

rites.name: Siastonia
rites.text: A mastery distinction earned by a worker who reaches a high level of skill in a disruptive field of craft. It marks a practitioner who has grown proficient in the destructive arts of their trade.

rites.name: Teoses Seornanum
rites.text: A innate instinct that a wilderness tracker can draw upon. It is available only to those who walk the hunter's path of survival.

rites.name: Sauranum Santerium
rites.text: A modern training trait that a fighter of the storm-and-stone arts can gain by drawing on power stored in a special crystal. It is open only to those who follow the path of close, swift combat.

rites.name: Tirneolus
rites.text: A shadow-crafted talent that conjures a small spectral companion beside its caster. The companion lasts a short while and harasses a foe with draining whispers.

rites.name: Coroselanum
rites.text: A savage inner-tide gift that lets a wild shapeshifter hunter tear deeper into foes. It is bound to the wardens of the feral path who draw on living strength.

rites.name: Tolanum Nornaullium
rites.text: A duelist's skill that lifts the wielder skyward, granting a borrowed aerial stance from which a cursed spear can be hurled. The stance lasts only briefly before the wielder returns to the ground.

rites.name: Telontes Vilanum
rites.text: A shapeshifter in winged form plunges from the sky, changing mid-fall into a beast that charges the foe below. When done well, the diver lands without suffering any harm from the fall.

rites.name: Mentia Viaria
rites.text: A blended craft that braids two sacred disciplines into one current. Its workings gain benefits from either strand, face the weakest defense of the two, slip past selective shields, and still function when one strand is sealed shut.

rites.name: Mistum Amariarnum
rites.text: A tactic that a trained companion creature uses during a contest of beasts. It is a set of shaking strikes that the creature performs in combat.

rites.name: Mastium Vistausor
rites.text: A piercing technique that companion creatures use during a contest between tamed beasts. It lets a creature strike a rival with a narrow, deep-reaching jab.

rites.name: Teliantes Naulor
rites.text: A learned fighting technique that a berserk warrior can channel to break stone and bone. It is granted through a glowing relic bound to the wielder's gear.

rites.name: Meoranum Cirneontium
rites.text: A volatile inner force drawn from sealed reservoirs hidden within a dreadful spire of punishment. Wielders tap it to unleash fierce, reckless strength.

rites.name: Amallausia
rites.text: A tactic used by creatures bonded to trainers during a contest of companion battles. It lets them slip away from an opposing lineup at the right moment.

rites.name: Rantiases
rites.text: A tactic used by creatures bonded to tamers during contests of companion combat. It is a sudden forceful blow delivered in a duel between pets.

rites.name: Coriastium Oraustosium
rites.text: A glowing power drawn by spellcasters who pledge to one hallowed sworn order. It can be borrowed for a stretch while travelers journey through a distant bastion, lapsing once their trial there concludes.

rites.name: Orausistum
rites.text: A ferocious technique that creatures of tamed beasts unleash during contests between companions. It hits hard and marks the moment a bonded animal fights with wild abandon.

rites.name: Launeolus
rites.text: A tool-craft technique that a mechanical sprite uses to fling a hurled shot during a contest between tamed companions. It works only within those contests of trained creatures.

rites.name: Rorum Mosor
rites.text: A shifting, yielding ground-craft that a living sand-creature draws upon during a contest between tamed companions. It swallows an opponent's footing and drags it downward.

rites.name: Callanum Tirnolanum
rites.text: A glowing inner-light craft that lets a healer of the sacred oath draw brilliance from a bonded ore. It is practiced only by devoted champions of the light.

rites.name: Nosistor
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of the stable use while contesting a duel with their companions. It lets them strike back in the match.

rites.name: Coreonum Rasia
rites.text: A swift hunter's technique that quickens the draw of ranged shots and shortens the wind-up of precise arrows. Skilled use of it lets a marksman unleash a brief, fierce barrage that a band of fighters relies upon in battle.

rites.name: Calia Lauliranum
rites.text: A mechanic that picks a random member of a group to be struck, bypassing whoever is most threatened. It keeps fights varied by forcing others to react to unexpected targets.

rites.name: Tolium Miastilium
rites.text: A system where each wanderer picks up to three combat-focused boons that wake when clashing with rivals. The boons stay dormant during guided trials and idle roaming unless a special stance is enabled.

rites.name: Veontium Reoresanum
rites.text: A refined ritual essence granted through allegiance to a rebel band of tinkerers. Only those who wield destructive arts may draw upon its power.

rites.name: Oraullornus Vintesanum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a ranged hunter refill their weapon faster. It can be gained by hunters who follow the beast-bond path or the precision path.

rites.name: Lintia Seornanus
rites.text: A restorative technique that creatures use while locked in a contest of strength. It lets them mend themselves and recover lost vigor during the fight.

rites.name: Oraneolles
rites.text: A craft of directing many moving forces at once, where decisions must flow continuously rather than waiting for turns. Practitioners queue orders while the world keeps advancing around them.

rites.name: Orenes Tolles
rites.text: A dormant ward that wakes whenever a strike lands or a guard is raised, answering the impact with its own stored force. Some bearers rely on such ready replies more than on raw strength.

rites.name: Cauror Valausor
rites.text: A timed sequence of restorative enchantments is laid upon a band of allies so they swell with healing at a precise moment. Practitioners of several disciplines train this technique to produce sudden bursts of mending when harm arrives.

rites.name: Sinia Ralor
rites.text: A bonded attunement that a master artificer grants to a holder, allowing their gear to reshape itself in response to circumstances. It cannot coexist with a rival attunement that reads the wearer's inner light.

rites.name: Seraullanum Corillia
rites.text: A sharp-edged inner force drawn from hidden reservoirs buried deep within a cursed spire of ruin. Those who gather its stored essence can channel it as a mighty power.

rites.name: Meornistium
rites.text: A stored vital energy that can be drawn from hidden reserves within a dreadful tower prison. It grants its bearer a special capacity for those who seek it out in the depths.

rites.name: Vialanium
rites.text: A shapeshifter's stealth strike that lands heavy damage when the wielder crouches unseen behind a foe. It belongs to a feline form and is granted to practitioners once they reach a certain mastery.

rites.name: Corentium Rialia
rites.text: A practiced gift of attunement that lets a spiritual caster draw upon the raw forces of nature. It is granted to those who reach the highest tier of their craft.

rites.name: Teleones Caunillum
rites.text: A skill that lets a fighter move stored strikes from a lost foe onto a new one. It also lets self-empowering rites be cast without choosing a target.

rites.name: Visus Teleres
rites.text: A defensive discipline taught within a guardian's training path that grants a rising chance of an extra strike on the next blow, building up to four times.

rites.name: Ameonesus Reollus
rites.text: A combat technique used by creatures during a bout between companion beasts. The user hurls itself forward with heedless force.

rites.name: Rasontus
rites.text: A reckless surge of strikes available to fighters who favor fury. It lets the warrior unleash rapid, careless blows in a single burst.

rites.name: Rialor Coreollium
rites.text: A timed restorative flow that spreads a steady trickle of reserve energy across up to ten allies who are running lowest. Certain skills and learned disciplines can call it forth, and each new call selects the neediest again.

rites.name: Coriarus Tillia
rites.text: A tireless skill that lets a combatant press onward despite setbacks. It was available to every fighter and combat style once they reached the twentieth rank of growth.

rites.name: Miarus Rausiantor
rites.text: A defensive craft that creatures of a bonded companion pair use during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets a companion withdraw from harm and wait for its moment to return.

rites.name: Caulanus
rites.text: A returning message sent back through a hidden private channel, visible only to the two speakers. It can only be answered when someone has first sent a secret message, and the answer is given by a quick keyed signal.

rites.name: Lornares
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of the arena use during contests between tamed beasts. It lets a combatant pull back a companion from the fight.

rites.name: Meosia Telilus
rites.text: A discipline of gentle healing practiced by monks who weave mist. It is taught as one of two mutually exclusive paths, the other being a rite of rising from death.

rites.name: Tornasus Teolum
rites.text: A defensive craft used by guardian warriors of the oath. Its availability is uncertain, as no one has been seen wielding it lately.

rites.name: Liasum Serolium
rites.text: A spinning-edge enchantment that can be drawn into the blades of a rogue fighter. It lets the wielder strike again and again with a single flowing motion.

rites.name: Amernantium
rites.text: A hunter's talent that lets a vengeful warrior draw strength from suffering. It was planned to unlock at a high level of mastery.

rites.name: Rialanum Amaleranum
rites.text: A learned discipline that quickens the recovery of a caster's sudden jolt-spells. Practitioners must first invest deep study in the elemental path to master it.

rites.name: Rianaulum
rites.text: A set of protective enchantments that cannot be layered together when cast by different allies. Solitary wardings, however, can be added on top of one another without conflict.

rites.name: Rollentanum
rites.text: A ward-craft that any practitioner may draw upon, using resonant vibration to shield its bearer from harm. It grows stronger as the wielder's inner reserves gather.

rites.name: Cirialanum
rites.text: A tuned attunement that lets practitioners outside the healing discipline draw on restorative workings they could not otherwise reach. It is earned only after long mastery of one's own path.

rites.name: Lialanum Valanium
rites.text: A crystal-born trait that any fighter can awaken within certain armor pieces recovered from ruined vaults. It grants its bearer a surge of wrathful power.

rites.name: Nisallium
rites.text: A contested power drawn from the struggles between rival factions in a remote frontier realm. It is gained through open clashes between wandering warbands rather than through quiet study.

rites.name: Nanerum
rites.text: A gifted tamer can restore all allied companion beasts to full vigor, even raising the fallen. The restorative waiting period keeps counting down while the tamer is away from the world.

rites.name: Vaunerium
rites.text: A hardened outer shell that a warrior of the vengeful hunters can draw upon, granted by a special mineral resource to those who walk the path of retribution.

rites.name: Callaurnium
rites.text: A learned talent of the destruction-practicing casters that forms an either-or choice with another mastery. It is taken in place of that alternative and cannot be held alongside it.

rites.name: Orasestum
rites.text: A churning tempest that can be drawn into the craft of a shaman of the storm-path. It answers only to those trained in the sky-arts.

rites.name: Serestium Rellor
rites.text: A talent granted to channelers of destructive magic. Learning it unlocks a passive power that empowers their essence-driven blasts.

rites.name: Valerus Rinauses
rites.text: A hunter's gift chosen at the seventh tier of training, set in opposition to a rival evasion skill. Only one of the two may be taken.

rites.name: Cianallanum
rites.text: A hidden command-weaver takes a spoken directive and seeks out the matching sigil in a registry of invocations. When it finds one, it carries out the bound action with the remaining words as its argument.

rites.name: Rernanum Ameollium
rites.text: A bold combat technique that lets a seasoned warrior unleash a frenzied strike at a high standing of honor. It is a prized talent among elite hunters of the Havoc order.

rites.name: Cisium Nianirus
rites.text: A tearing power drawn from hidden reservoirs of vital essence. It is gathered from sealed caches within a dreaded tower of punishment.

rites.name: Maunium Oreolinum
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a sudden burst of forward momentum during a contest of champions. The surge lets it strike ahead of its rivals before they can react.

rites.name: Serontor Teontianus
rites.text: A tiered rank-25 honor talent granted to swift shadow-warriors who wield chaotic fury. It rewards those who strike with reckless speed.

rites.name: Orantia Sallium
rites.text: A secondary attunement that channels a practitioner's combat strength into repeated blows, letting a single strike land again as an echo. It is studied by blood-bound warriors who favor layered assault.

rites.name: Visellus
rites.text: A creature-companion uses this technique during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a combat move that a machine-like pet performs against an opponent.

rites.name: Cillor Sastanum
rites.text: A signal that rings out whenever a stored incantation becomes ready for casting or falls silent again. Scribes track these shifts to know which rites a caster may invoke at any moment.

rites.name: Oreosor Cisaules
rites.text: A signal sounds whenever a caster begins an incantation that takes time to complete. Spells that resolve instantly sound a different signal when they finish.

rites.name: Marnor Vonauses
rites.text: This happens the moment a caster releases a magic working, and again every heartbeat while a caster holds a working steady. It signals that the cooldown state of the working has changed.

rites.name: Lialium Ceolles
rites.text: A dusty technique that a grit-born companion unleashes during a contest of tamed creatures. It hurls a stinging flurry of fine particles at a rival.

rites.name: Sanistanum Vaseolles
rites.text: A bloodline-bound gift that a crimson-sworn warrior carries within a relic. It answers to the hunger of a wielder and ties together a trio of linked dark arts.

rites.name: Villonia
rites.text: A tailored leg-binding craft that is permanently woven into garments and enhances the magical abilities of those who cast spells.

rites.name: Amaulium Caullum
rites.text: A sworn discipline of the holy warrior that binds a chosen oath against a rival path. It cannot be taken alongside a companion rite of forward momentum.

rites.name: Amornium Amaurosum
rites.text: A dormant inner gift that awakens in those trained to mend others, granting restorative power. It is shaped only for practitioners who follow the arts of healing.

rites.name: Merises
rites.text: A timid power of the spirit-essence that is gathered from hidden stores within a dread tower. It stirs a small creature's instinct to flee.

rites.name: Amornenia
rites.text: A mystical power drawn from hidden reserves of refined essence in a dread tower of imprisonment. It can be gathered by those who seek the hoarded stores buried within that cursed place.

rites.name: Nianores Siasium
rites.text: A faint inner force that can be drawn from hidden stores kept within a towering prison-fortress. It grants its bearer a modest, sharpened edge.

rites.name: Maulastia
rites.text: A restless inner current that hunters of the Havoc path can draw upon to fuel their strikes. It is one of the gifts gathered from a rare mineral vein.

rites.name: Siantauror Reosirnia
rites.text: A fiery enchantment that could be woven into the edges of a warrior's weapon. It appears to be unavailable to those who seek it.

rites.name: Terniaria
rites.text: A tactic channeled by companion creatures during contests of skill, letting them unleash a burning surge in the middle of a duel.

rites.name: Vellor Rollarnum
rites.text: A bound inscription that runs small rites whenever a marked vessel's inscribed markings shift. Only certain runes may be touched, and it works inside a guarded circle.

rites.name: Nellor Miastus
rites.text: A bound rite of gesture that answers a tap of the hand with a sealed charm, but only within a narrow ward that reads a few carved words to decide what it may do.

rites.name: Ronum Ameollaures
rites.text: A grinding metallic shriek that a creature unleashes during a contest between tamed beasts. Many companions can call upon this harsh noise to unsettle their rivals in the ring.

rites.name: Seraurnanum Rellor
rites.text: A tremor-channeling technique that a fighter with a heavy blade can learn. It lets the wielder send a shuddering force through the ground.

rites.name: Viantus Viarinanum
rites.text: A flame-born strike cast by dark-binding caster-folk, it hurls scorching heat that draws the attention of foes. Its pull makes it the chosen blow for holding back the mightiest beasts, though it is seldom used for raw destructive output.

rites.name: Corerium Raseoria
rites.text: A signal device that calls down a devastating energy barrage from a coastal war-engine onto a marked zone. Those caught inside are harmed, but the ruined ground yields a rare dark essence that can be gathered.

rites.name: Leornilor
rites.text: A practitioner's unseen sense reveals bound otherworldly servants near them. Hostile ones appear as red marks on a map, while allied ones show as green.

rites.name: Villium Nentium
rites.text: A glowing exchange of charged words that lets certain spellcasters of the shadowed arts draw on a hidden inner resource. It is a technique shaped by a particular craft.

rites.name: Rastus Reorontes
rites.text: A jagged-edged gift that hunters of the wild can grow within their craft. It is available to those who train beasts or stalk prey in the open wilds.

rites.name: Vantaustus
rites.text: A hunter's craft that grants a quickened pace to those who train within the beast-taming branch of their discipline. Practitioners may invest up to five points into it, though its place was later removed from the training paths.

rites.name: Orellum Miria
rites.text: A dark flame that a practitioner can hurl instantly at a foe. If the foe falls soon after, the caster gathers two stored fragments of spiritual essence.

rites.name: Amiaria Lerneolium
rites.text: A dark strike technique that creatures of many kinds may unleash during a contest between tamed companions. It turns the attacker's gloom into a sudden, hard-hitting blow.

rites.name: Telonium Milaunium
rites.text: A dark-spirit power that is gained from hidden stores of soul-essence kept within a towering, cursed prison-tower. It is claimed by those who dig through its caches for their gains.

rites.name: Corauntium Castaunes
rites.text: A dark mastery studied by shadow-minded casters, letting their spiteful curses and draining spells have a chance to strike a second time each time they hit.

rites.name: Teleostium Nalentia
rites.text: A stealthy craft that sharpens a rogue's strikes and lets them gather finishing marks faster. It is studied as a refined technique of silent combat.

rites.name: Oreolistor
rites.text: A bonded sigil-power drawn from sealed reliquary vaults within a towering prison of the cursed. It grants its holder a measure of arcane might sourced from hidden stores.

rites.name: Lenauntes
rites.text: A powerful mending craft that restores a wounded companion far more strongly than a quick ward. The mended one bears a lingering drain that fades once enough harm reaches them or the struggle ends.

rites.name: Neornasia
rites.text: A stealth craft that a shadowy skirmisher can call upon, and it is set on its own bar for quick use. Those trained in the quiet arts can learn it again to store an extra use.

rites.name: Senornus Siallintus
rites.text: A quiet skill of stealth-trained fighters that lets them brush past foes unseen. It is granted to those who have proven themselves in the shadows.

rites.name: Saleranum
rites.text: A dark gift that a gifted caster can call upon at a certain rank of training. It works as the shadowed twin of a related restorative art.

rites.name: Orisialor
rites.text: A dark-touched binding power that is drawn from hidden reservoirs in a dreadful tower. It lends its strength to a wielder's weapons and gear.

rites.name: Orosus Telastor
rites.text: A hidden arcane power that a wielder gains by drawing on reserves of stored essence found within a dark, towering prison. It is gathered from caches hidden in its depths.

rites.name: Misor Corirastium
rites.text: A dark, unsettling technique that a tamed companion creature can unleash during a contest between beast-trainers. It is shared among many different creatures.

rites.name: Miasium Ceonium
rites.text: A piercing technique a creature uses in a contest between tamed companions. It is wielded by a small, quick beast during bouts of companion combat.

rites.name: Liastia Telaustor
rites.text: A glimmering trail of soul-essence that follows the wearer's cloak, gathered from hidden reserves held within a cursed, towering prison. It can be drawn out of those stored caches.

rites.name: Nistum Tasium
rites.text: A glimmering quality that can be drawn into certain sworn defenders of the realm. It is shaped by the crafts of those who take up the shield and bear the front line.

rites.name: Seolernor
rites.text: A tactic practiced by brewing-monks that lets a warrior of their order reposition quickly in combat. It becomes available to those who have reached a high standing in their craft.

rites.name: Corianes Telisanum
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a caster reshape how they see the flow of their inner power. It is granted to healers who take up the path of the void.

rites.name: Neornollum
rites.text: A minor craft-path that favors aggressive radiant technique over steady mending. It performs adequately in small groups and excels in duels between rival practitioners.

rites.name: Ciastosum
rites.text: A piercing vocal technique that certain tamed companion creatures unleash while locked in a contest of strength. It is used during matches between beasts.

rites.name: Liarnaustia
rites.text: A quiet vital force that can be gathered from sealed reserves within a dreadful spire. It grants its bearer a power that moves without sound.

rites.name: Sereliaria
rites.text: A quiet resonance drawn from sealed reserves of vital essence hidden within a towering prison-spire. It grants its wielder a stored force gathered from those hoards.

rites.name: Causirnium Tasor
rites.text: A lingering blessing that a messenger can carry during roaming errands for the realm. While it holds, the favor earned from those errands rises by half again.

rites.name: Amesia Tenum
rites.text: A dark mental craft in which a broken binding of a drained life-hex sends terror through whoever cleansed it and those nearby. Each piercing strike of a mind-drain can also hasten the return of a summoned shade.

rites.name: Miales Liarinus
rites.text: A temporary blessing that settles upon fully grown wanderers during a week-long festival of drifting time. It grants them a passing enhancement while the event lasts.

rites.name: Oriasum Saunes
rites.text: A temporary blessing that settles upon fully grown adventurers during a week-long festival of an old lich's wrath. It lingers only while the event runs.

rites.name: Risium Amellus
rites.text: A resonant inner force gathered from sealed reservoirs hidden within a grim, spiraling tower of punishment. Those who draw upon it channel its energy to empower their abilities.

rites.name: Seraunanum Listum
rites.text: A mark of shadowed oath borne by hunters of the night. It is granted to those who join a dark order, and it lingers for a time for those who follow a particular trial of the realm.

rites.name: Ceollus Oriarnium
rites.text: A marksman's instant strike that stifles a foe's chanting for a few heartbeats. It breaks spellcasting even against targets resistant to silence, and can be loosed between ordinary volleys.

rites.name: Montum Corenilanum
rites.text: A slow-building fury stored within a warrior's bearing, available only to those who wield the blade in the manner of a berserker. It is a trait of the hardened battle-born.

rites.name: Sianeontium
rites.text: A temporary blessing that settles over fully grown adventurers during a week-long festival of revisited ages. It strengthens those who bear it while the timeworn celebration lasts.

rites.name: Valosanum Amesium
rites.text: A withering force drawn from hidden reservoirs of bound essence sealed deep within a dark spiral tower. It lets its wielder break fortified defenses.

rites.name: Montaustium
rites.text: A temporary blessing that settles upon fully grown adventurers during a week-long festival of time-bent trials. It bolsters them while the event lasts.

rites.name: Nostiasia Valeosianum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that a traveler gains during a special gathering of hallowed halls. It grants an extra reward from the final guardian of each sacred hall.

rites.name: Amania Amaurnolles
rites.text: A tactic in which a tamed creature hurls a bony trophy at an opposing beast during a contest of companions. It is a combat move used by many kinds of pets.

rites.name: Vereostum Naustium
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of a tamed beast-keeping contest can call upon while battling each other. It lets companion animals act together in combat.

rites.name: Cirneles
rites.text: A rising gift that lets a wielder lift off into open air. It only works while the wielder is gliding on a drifting current.

rites.name: Niarnolia
rites.text: A tactic used by trained creatures during a contest between their owners. It lets them cloud the field with a murky haze that blinds their opponents.

rites.name: Mallor Laureosor
rites.text: A sharp flash-craft practiced by fire-channelers that rapidly releases stored heat. It cannot be learned alongside the great blaze discipline, so a student must pick one path.

rites.name: Oraullus Seonor
rites.text: A innate gliding power that lets a winged folk rise into the air. It is awakened through a trial of stretching the wings for the first time.

rites.name: Cosaurnanum Amallinum
rites.text: A practice in which one member of a group willingly absorbs a heavy blow meant for everyone, shielding the rest from far worse harm. The sacrifice keeps the whole company alive during fierce encounters.

rites.name: Nornium Valarum
rites.text: A hunter's technique in which a tamed beast is trained to strike with venom. It is a choice that can be taken only alongside a separate mastery of handling animals.

rites.name: Telinum Salanum
rites.text: A tactical maneuver where companion creatures unleash an eerie, insubstantial assault during a contest between animal companions. Many such beasts can perform this technique.

rites.name: Amosteosium
rites.text: A high-tier technique available to elemental and enhancement practitioners who take a particular path of reach. It lets them unleash molten fury from the earth they command.

rites.name: Valisiarnor Telantium
rites.text: A dark working that a sorcerer performs under a rare sky alignment to tear open passages toward unclaimed lands. Its raw energy splits the world it is cast upon, bringing waves, quakes, and fire that break the homeland apart.

rites.name: Tostum Valaustum
rites.text: A bristling outer covering that creatures call upon during contests between tamed companions. It lets a beast answer harm with a sharp, stinging retaliation.

rites.name: Seraunum Teoseres
rites.text: A spinning burst of flame that a wind-trained fighter can unlock once they reach a high level of mastery. It is a special technique belonging to an elite martial discipline.

rites.name: Amollintor
rites.text: A innate gift shared by all void dwellers that lets them step through tears in space. Those who carry it can pass between distant places by opening such seams.

rites.name: Moresia
rites.text: A spectral craft that lets a wearer draw power from hidden reserves of essence gathered in a dark, cursed tower. The gift is unlocked by recovering these stored caches.

rites.name: Riallistus
rites.text: A short-lived ability once available to frost-aligned death knights at a high rank. It was removed early in testing and replaced by a different skill.

rites.name: Lonus Veostornes
rites.text: A spirit-forged power drawn from hoarded essence stores within a haunted, towering prison. It is gathered from those hidden reserves by those who seek to wield it.

rites.name: Vostarnes Ameollernia
rites.text: A ruinous craft of the inner flame, drawn by a caster from their own spirit to strike with searing force. Each casting leaves behind four glowing fragments of stored essence.

rites.name: Selostum
rites.text: A ruinous craft that lets practitioners of the evoking arts seize control over others' magic. It belongs to the destructive branch of their discipline.

rites.name: Marnum Seraullus
rites.text: A dark practitioner's gift that channels a stored spirit-flame into a lingering, restless presence. It was once a late-stage ability for those who bind souls, then faded from the craft's teachings.

rites.name: Serirnalia
rites.text: A practiced battle discipline lets a grim warrior of the blood-tide turn aside phantom strikes. It is learned only when the wielder reaches a high rank of mastery.

rites.name: Serilium Mausillor
rites.text: A spirit-binding craft drawn from hoarded essence-stores within a towering prison of the cursed. It grants a wielder the power to fasten and draw upon captured souls.

rites.name: Carnor Valasanum
rites.text: A tactical discipline that lets a warrior bind an opponent's magic to hold them in place. It is learned at a modest tier of training and used in contests between rival fighters.

rites.name: Monor Ristanum
rites.text: A craft in which a technique carries no recovery period and is restrained only by a shared pause that follows every action taken by its user.

rites.name: Niastor Sereneolium
rites.text: A dark craft wielded by spellcasters who pledge to a shadowy fae pact, granted to them for a time through a trial. It is available to all of their practitioners who join that pact and lasts until a particular storyline ends.

rites.name: Telirnor Viarantanum
rites.text: A drained essence-power that can be gathered from hidden reservoirs inside a cursed spire of the dead. It lets a wielder draw stored spirit-energy into their own strikes.

rites.name: Teolianum
rites.text: A combat technique used by creatures that tame small companions during contests of skill. It is applied while two bonded beasts clash in a sanctioned duel.

rites.name: Nellirus
rites.text: A ranged combat technique that lets a spellcaster loose a sudden flare of stored light at a chosen foe. It is learned by practitioners of the balanced path once they reach a certain standing.

rites.name: Vistaranum Vasia
rites.text: A cold-channeling craft in which a practitioner must choose between two arts of frost. It draws on the discipline of chilling the body.

rites.name: Vastausanum Cauntia
rites.text: A malevolent trait that lets shadow casters call forth vengeful phantoms. It is passed down among practitioners of the dark arts.

rites.name: Orellor Rostus
rites.text: A discipline of weaving starlight into a cosmic pattern, practiced by one branch of healers who draw from the heavens. It stands as an exclusive choice paired with a sky-shaking art.

rites.name: Lornanum Valeolantor
rites.text: A tamed serpent-bond that lets a beast-keeper's creature hurl venom from its fangs. It works alongside traits tied to beast-keeping, quick reflexes, and the spirit bond between hunter and animal.

rites.name: Causteria
rites.text: A knack that lets a ranged marksman keep a hand unshaken while aiming. It is open to those who practice the bow and long gun.

rites.name: Vontiranum Oralontus
rites.text: A common habit where wanderers learn to step away from harmful ground effects and hostile spell zones. Many neglect it, and healers grow frustrated when those who fail to dodge fall quickly.

rites.name: Valontilum Valiniarum
rites.text: A tier-six discipline for healer-monks that shortens the recharge of their attunement technique. An earlier version instead lengthened how long the attunement lasted, letting practitioners hold the state for long stretches, but that ability was replaced and continuous holding is no longer possible.

rites.name: Sinaulanum
rites.text: A bright burst of arcane fire that a nature-keeper can shape and call forth. It is chosen as one option among several paths of growth that competes with a wild surging power.

rites.name: Cantum Telialium
rites.text: A glowing trait that a balance caster can carry. It lets the wielder call down streaks of starlight to strengthen their magic.

rites.name: Vilenum
rites.text: A tempest-bound craft that a practitioner of the storm arts may take up. It is granted to those who follow the rain-wielding path of the elemental and enhancing disciplines.

rites.name: Tauntanum Telolium
rites.text: A passive boon granted only to a single brood of burrowing hunter beasts. It raises strength, agility, and mind together, along with a smaller increase to adaptability, outclassing the other families' lesser bonuses.

rites.name: Laurnesus
rites.text: A raw, unmixed discipline that brewers can draw upon as a quiet inner talent. It shapes how a practitioner of the brewing arts channels their craft.

rites.name: Millaunum Ameneosia
rites.text: A bound power that can be drawn from a lodestone-marked blade by a cunning raider. It belongs only to those who walk the path of the lawless skirmisher.

rites.name: Corirauntes
rites.text: A winged creature delivers a dazing jab during a contest between tamed companions. The blow leaves the rival briefly stunned.

rites.name: Aminteorium
rites.text: A nature-aligned rite that a wise practitioner unlocks at a high rank by altering a celestial strike with a sun-marked sigil. It hurls the same falling light as its base form, but its force flows through living growth rather than arcane energy.

rites.name: Oraullosia
rites.text: A flash of sudden insight that a caster can call upon as a learned gift of the mind. It belongs to those who practice the healing and shielding arts.

rites.name: Maullernus
rites.text: A mystical enhancement that can be drawn from a special resource, granted to those skilled with ranged weapons. It empowers archers who follow a precise, marksman-like discipline.

rites.name: Vialum Celor
rites.text: A radiant technique that creatures of the arena call upon during a contest between tamed companions. It lets the caller's ally harness bright, warming energy in combat.

rites.name: Orintium Oreostires
rites.text: A bonded rite in which a radiant battle shell is called forth from a central resonance node. It can only be invoked at that node's core chamber.

rites.name: Sauror Valeonum
rites.text: A tactic where a creature in a contest of beasts releases a sleep-inducing burst that leaves its rival unable to act for a turn. Many companions in these bouts learn to use it.

rites.name: Telesiastor
rites.text: A hardy endurance drawn from a hunter's beast companion, it lends its bearer a steadier body. Older, stronger bonds of the same kind have since eclipsed it.

rites.name: Amalernum
rites.text: A quiet ritual gift that a holy warrior of the vengeful path carries within them at all times. It becomes available once the bearer reaches a high rank of mastery.

rites.name: Tentum Valaurium
rites.text: A bursting skill that creatures of a tamed companion sort unleash while contesting a match between beasts. It lets the animal drive its strength far beyond its normal limit for a short span.

rites.name: Tiasia Lontirnes
rites.text: A rite available only through a sworn companion scheme lets one bonded ally pull the other to their side. It cannot be written into a tome or bound to a quick-slot; it is invoked by choosing a summon option from a companion's roster entry.

rites.name: Rintollia Lerniasia
rites.text: A learned bodily discipline that practitioners of certain monk traditions can draw upon. It is a trait that can be attached to a wielder's gear and used by specific kinds of disciplined fighters and healers.

rites.name: Leorum Serolanum
rites.text: A tuned resonance that lets those who follow a restorative calling draw extra vitality from their combined efforts. It is available to practitioners who mend others.

rites.name: Taulliarnes Launaranum
rites.text: A tactic where a creature drives its trailing appendage through the battlefield during a contest of tamed beasts. Many companion animals use this sweeping strike when they face rivals.

rites.name: Causes Oreristium
rites.text: A creature-tamers' technique in which a companion beast swings its rear appendage to strike a rival during a contest of bonded animals.

rites.name: Vollantium Meollauses
rites.text: A tidal craft that a restoration healer can draw upon, letting the healing waters rise in a sudden surge. It is a trait gained through a shaped silvery ore.

rites.name: Rinernia
rites.text: A bonding rite that lets a shelled, snail-like prime creature be brought under the control of a tamer. It works on a single great mollusk-beast dwelling in a distant, twisted realm.

rites.name: Taustum Lausor
rites.text: A stored burst of forward momentum that a winged glider can unleash only while it is already airborne and gliding. It is a natural gift of its kind.

rites.name: Orestauria
rites.text: A combat technique that a range of tamed companions can perform during a contest between them. It lets the creature hurl itself forward to strike an opponent in a sudden charge.

rites.name: Rellaustes Venes
rites.text: A bonding rite that lets a keeper bring a stone-cracking beetle lord under their command. It is granted to the one who has earned the beast's trust.

rites.name: Veornium Tosintor
rites.text: A proven feat of lasting strength that is granted to every hero of one shared lineage once a champion has conquered a dread necromancer in a fortress of the dead while never falling, bound by an iron spirit's ward.

rites.name: Raunistes Maustes
rites.text: A charged jolt of inner current that a practitioner of the storm arts can draw from the mind. It is tied to the craft of elemental casters and can be awakened through a special attunement.

rites.name: Nasium Millus
rites.text: A buzzing cloud of insects that creatures call upon during a contest of tamed beasts. It drains the foe's focus while the summoner's companion presses the attack.

rites.name: Viarnus Ceostiales
rites.text: A fleeting craft practiced by wandering fighters of a certain order. It grants a quick, sweeping turn to those who learn it through a sacred mineral.

rites.name: Nontialles
rites.text: A common tactic where one sturdy guardian draws the attention of foes while attackers strike and healers mend the guardian. Attackers must avoid drawing too much notice away from the guardian, and the tactic is sometimes mocked as too simple.

rites.name: Sereonantia
rites.text: A coordinated flurry of stinging insects that a tamed companion can unleash during a contest between beasts. It is a tactic used by many different animal partners in these duels.

rites.name: Tiantium Varnolanum
rites.text: A tide-binding craft that a healer of the restorative arts can draw upon. It lets the practitioner's mending spells grow stronger as the flow of their power gathers force.

rites.name: Seoriastia
rites.text: A chosen focus that gathers a wielder's strikes, spells and restorative power. Picking it out is the act of directing those workings toward one foe, friend or spot.

rites.name: Rerneosia
rites.text: A combat maneuver where a creature whips its trailing appendage against an opponent during a contest between tamed companions. Several kinds of beasts can perform it.

rites.name: Orianor Ameontones
rites.text: A shapeshifting rite lets a caster take on a form that moves quickly through the sky. Trainers teach it to those who reach a certain standing, though an older trial still governs its full mastery.
