rites.name: Serollerum
rites.text: A tracing of ink-marks that a scribe can inscribe onto a tool to alter how it looks. The trace was once sold at a remote trading post.

rites.name: Liles Seralenes
rites.text: A practitioner's gift that restores spent reserves whenever a crackling bolt strikes its target. Stronger channelers draw back more from each discharge, so the gift grows sharper as their power matures.

rites.name: Viastium Teleolium
rites.text: A caster's gift that folds the practitioner through the air and sets them down at a distant high hall where ancient guardians hold their council. The spell carries its user straight to that seat of power.

rites.name: Valanelium
rites.text: A ward-inscribing method that a dealer sells in a remote mining settlement. Practitioners use it to shape a phantom wolf-like presence.

rites.name: Tares Rontus
rites.text: A spellcaster uses this craft to step instantly to a violet threshold in a floating city above a frozen land. Students learn it from a tutor who opens arcane passages or through a bonding ritual.

rites.name: Cirnium Talor
rites.text: A mage spell that instantly moves its caster to a sacred hall of old roads within a distant fortress city. Only members of one particular warband may learn and cast it.

rites.name: Tiror Rinteollium
rites.text: A dread-born mental power that practitioners of dark arts can draw upon to unsettle the minds of their foes. It is a trait tied to the arcane craft of hexers and summoners.

rites.name: Valostium Corantolles
rites.text: A spell that carries a traveler across the realm to one of two places, chosen by the state of a distant coastal region. The coast's shifting condition can be altered by a keeper of time found to the south.

rites.name: Tellanum Vaustum
rites.text: A coiled limb strikes an opponent in a contest of tamed beasts. Creatures of the menagerie use this sweeping blow during their bouts.

rites.name: Orinia Teleoses
rites.text: A tireless power drawn from the earth's shifting plates that lets a caster channel the restless force of stone into their own spells. It is granted to those who follow the elemental arts of storm and stone.

rites.name: Sereosarum
rites.text: A spellcaster's craft that instantly carries the caster across the distance to a far-off western point of a sacred city. It is used to move a mage in a single moment.

rites.name: Coriasanum Orantosor
rites.text: A private spoken note passed from one wanderer to another, marked in a soft rose hue. It cannot slip past a silence a listener has chosen, and it cannot reach those sworn to rival banners.

rites.name: Orerialanum Valonum
rites.text: A dread-inducing technique that a trained companion creature uses during a contest between tamed beasts, causing the opposing animal to falter in fear.

rites.name: Rintes Taustiaror
rites.text: A coiled ability that a small creature unleashes against a rival during a contest of pets. It delivers a crackling charge of energy in a single burst.

rites.name: Tiarnium Veonia
rites.text: A closing burst of energy that a tamed creature can unleash during a contest between beasts. It is a last-resort technique used in those duels.

rites.name: Ventaurnes
rites.text: A high-tier discipline for holy warriors that channels righteous judgment into raw striking power. It is learned by fighters who have reached a late stage of their training.

rites.name: Vestollor
rites.text: A tactic known to a summoner of shadow beasts, lending their attacks a burning dark power for a short span after the beasts are called forth.

rites.name: Nolliasus Cialarnor
rites.text: A rhythmic knack taught to shadow-walkers of the Quillen guild, letting them move unseen through crowds. Only those who train in silent footwork can learn it.

rites.name: Tastia Ceollarnium
rites.text: A stored spiritual force that can be drawn from sealed reserves found within a grim, dark spire of trials. It grants its wielder a final, decisive strike.

rites.name: Varnium Coreollum
rites.text: A dark craft of summoning that a sorcerer draws upon through a bound relic. It is tied to two other arts of binding and calling forth.

rites.name: Tinteria
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a hunter of demons draw strength from disorder. It belongs to the skill-sheets of those who fight the dark.

rites.name: Amiastus Nisum
rites.text: A stormborne gift that a shaman of the Enhancement path can awaken within themselves. It lends its bearer a fiercer hand in close combat.

rites.name: Naurialum Serantus
rites.text: A healer's tide-craft that turns a restorative mending into a charge, hastening the next healing spells and sharpening the chance of a powerful recovery. The charge can build up twice over.

rites.name: Oreornausia
rites.text: A grim mental technique once wielded by a dark warrior class at a high tier of mastery. It was later swapped for another craft during trials and never reached the wider world.

rites.name: Maunium Vosium
rites.text: A recorded trial grants a person a brief surge of borrowed power after drinking a vial brewed from a common reagent and felling a giant wrought of living stone. Completing it unlocks a further honor that depends on it.

rites.name: Teostia Valosia
rites.text: A practiced discipline taught to hunters of the lightning arts, sharpening the chance that both spell and blade strike with decisive force. Its gift flows equally into wounds dealt and wounds mended.

rites.name: Rontum Teonelum
rites.text: A mental siphon attuned to shadow magic that a dark caster may draw upon. It is available only to practitioners of that shadowy discipline.

rites.name: Nernus Liasanum
rites.text: Every minute in battle, each person is marked with a charge or a gust, which boosts their strength and shielding against binding. When opposing marks run out together, they discharge into a stunning burst.

rites.name: Seristor Rirnium
rites.text: A dark inner art that a caster can draw upon, shaped by the mind's suffering. It is described as not currently attainable by anyone.

rites.name: Tarnauntum
rites.text: A seasonal trial rule attached to every high-level challenge run, summoning four servants of a hollow army to test those who take it on.

rites.name: Valaustinum
rites.text: A hunter's skill that reveals every nearby foe of the fiend kind upon the map held in the hand. It lets the wielder sense hostile shadows gathering around them.

rites.name: Orellostium Lianeontor
rites.text: A combat art that lets a skilled fighter pursue rival fighters in open contests of skill. It is unlocked once a warrior reaches a modest level of training.

rites.name: Males Reolum
rites.text: A learned craft that a practitioner of the wild arts can take up at the highest tier of training. Its effect shifts according to the discipline the practitioner has chosen.

rites.name: Vausum Maurnium
rites.text: A calculating rite that cuts a value short, keeping only a set number of its leading parts and discarding the rest. The caster names how many parts to keep and the value is shortened to match.

rites.name: Sellor Corisium
rites.text: A lingering essence gained by a traveler who shares a meal and then tastes every dish once more. It rests within the spirit of generosity, rewarding those who keep sampling what their companions bring to the table.

rites.name: Orintia Sarolor
rites.text: A battle technique used by small creatures during contests of trained beasts. It lets reptiles and stinging companions strike in quick succession.

rites.name: Cesus Tastor
rites.text: A tidal current of hidden power that a healer of the old circles can call upon. It turns the ebb of a flowing force back toward those who summon it.

rites.name: Nolleontia
rites.text: A tactic a creature companion uses during a bout of contests with other tamed beasts. It raises the intensity of the fighter's assault.

rites.name: Ceornor Restaullia
rites.text: A battle discipline that lets fighters of a restless warrior tradition press harder against outmatched foes. Its power is drawn from a mineral-infused gear enchantment.

rites.name: Meonium Leoniasum
rites.text: A raw inner force that a wielder can draw from hidden reserves kept in sealed vaults within a dreaded spire of punishment. It grants lasting resilience to whoever gathers it.

rites.name: Lianistia
rites.text: A volatile inner force once drawn from crystalline ore that let a class of fierce hunters of demons channel raw disorder into their strikes.

rites.name: Ceollanum Torniallum
rites.text: A signature rite of a sworn bloodline once displayed at a great gathering, later set aside as an active practice. Its lingering effect persists as a blessing carried along the bloodline's travel routes.

rites.name: Rintia Saunum
rites.text: A paired flame drawn from two moons, a gift of balance cultivated by skilled casters at the highest rank of their training.

rites.name: Tenorus Neres
rites.text: A rhythmic outburst that creatures of a tamed beast-bond can unleash during a contest between companions. It is a technique wielded in staged duels.

rites.name: Maurium Rirnium
rites.text: A foundational talent taught to practitioners of the healing arts. It amplifies every ritual they perform, so all their restorative and harmful workings grow stronger.

rites.name: Tiarnilus
rites.text: A raging inner power that warriors of the Fury discipline can draw upon. It is awakened through a mysterious ore-born gift.

rites.name: Varelium
rites.text: A battle technique that lets a creature in a contest of beasts rise into a stronger form. It is used by many kinds of pets during such a match.

rites.name: Meolaunium Cintor
rites.text: A stored surge of inner potency that a traveler can awaken once their heart-core reaches a high rank. It is gathered from one of two distant trading cities.

rites.name: Ciarestanum
rites.text: A martial discipline of rage that a warrior learns after deep investment in its branch of training. Each rank of mastery makes three of the warrior's strike techniques hit harder.

rites.name: Varium Corernanum
rites.text: A dark, corrupting gift that a fallen warrior may gain once they reach the highest tier of their order. It is a strengthening honor that twists the body of its bearer.

rites.name: Niasanum Tosor
rites.text: A sharpened sight-craft that marksmen of the hunter's tradition can awaken within their gear. It grants a steady, flawless aim to those who bear the mark of the bow.

rites.name: Collium Veseontanum
rites.text: A discipline of the Thessaly arms-path that a fighter must train deeply to master. Its practitioners gain an unbroken surge of martial pressure once they have committed a large share of their study to that path.

rites.name: Masterium
rites.text: A priest's gift of dark power, granted to those who pledge to a warlike brotherhood of the dead. It is lent temporarily to newcomers during a trial of loyalty.

rites.name: Ameonanum Nialantus
rites.text: A lasting inner firmness earned by raising a mantle of resolve to its fifteenth tier. It marks a bearer whose will no longer bends under pressure.

rites.name: Taurneosum Oraullor
rites.text: A shadow-wielder's curse siphons life slowly from a target, feeding the caster while fueling a dark frenzy. Anyone who tries to strip it away is punished with a jolt of fear.

rites.name: Cantia Orerniastus
rites.text: A borrowed power that lets any practitioner, regardless of calling, move with unnatural haste. It is drawn from a rare ore found in the deep veins of the mountains.

rites.name: Telentanum Valeorium
rites.text: A lasting blessing that lets a person's other companions in the same realm gain extra merit once one of them has reached the highest tally in a single cycle. It holds until the cycle turns over and survives even a fall in battle.

rites.name: Amastontium
rites.text: A siphoning craft that draws vital essence from hidden reservoirs buried deep within a dark, towering prison. Practitioners tear open these hoards to gain its strength.

rites.name: Seriarnes Miastor
rites.text: A tactical knack granted to scouts who fight in tight quarters. It rewards the wielder for staying near their target instead of keeping distance.

rites.name: Sonteores Raunostum
rites.text: A volatile fire-craft that can be bound to any practitioner, regardless of their discipline. Its power is shaped by the wielder's own attunement to the ember.

rites.name: Seres Valisanum
rites.text: A talent that augments evokers, offered as an exclusive choice alongside another node. Taking one path rules out the other.

rites.name: Coraunor Vonum
rites.text: A wild, unrestrained surge of savage power that a shapeshifting beast-caster can draw upon. It is a trait gained through a glowing mineral artifact and bound to those who walk the path of the feral wild.

rites.name: Coriselor Morniarium
rites.text: A minor discipline practiced by dark-robed scholars that shortens the waiting period before a caster can vanish from sight or summon a shade-servant again.

rites.name: Raunalanum Sereornus
rites.text: A mystical attunement that certain spirit-channeling healers can awaken within their craft. It lets them draw strength from the spirits they guide.

rites.name: Coreontes Serillostum
rites.text: A volatile inner power that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs within a deep, perilous tower. It lets its wielder take on a shifting, unsettled form.

rites.name: Sausum Maunalum
rites.text: A shaman's bound ceremony of a sworn faction, granted to all who join its ranks. It is lent briefly to those walking a distant borderland trial, lasting until that trial's tale is completed.

rites.name: Coriantus Oriallanum
rites.text: A hunter's craft in which each strike from a coiled serpent-shot quickens the wielder's rage-trance, letting the fury return sooner. It is learned once a beast-tamer reaches the sixtieth rung of skill.

rites.name: Ceostus Neorum
rites.text: A bonus gift that healers unlock upon reaching a high rank. It grants a boost to restorative magic and is open to several kinds of mending practitioners.

rites.name: Seoserum
rites.text: A poison-bearing bite gift that a wilderness tracker can awaken within their hunting craft. It belongs to the skill-set of those who stalk prey alone in the wild.

rites.name: Rianum Sereollasor
rites.text: A tactic used by companion creatures during contests of their own. It delivers a cutting strike that wears down rivals in a battle.

rites.name: Vernia Ceonia
rites.text: A quiet, constant gift lets a tracker survive in the wild. It is always active and draws upon the long practice of pathfinding.

rites.name: Sarnia Teloranum
rites.text: A combat-skill technique available to warriors of the blood-bound fighting order once they reach their twentieth year. It lets a fighter remain standing against enemies in close duels and is practiced by those who meet in ritual contests.

rites.name: Seorenor Nalus
rites.text: A chosen talent of the devout that offers a single path, excluding another. It is exclusive with the dread-inducing art of Vallin Serrat.

rites.name: Coreontor Celles
rites.text: A dormant mark of martial craft that once bound a fighter's blade to a restless fury. It remains tied to the Ever-Burning Wrath and cannot be used on its own.

rites.name: Varnanum Nellarnium
rites.text: A dark-touched caster draws emptiness into an ancient beast's bones during a wartime expedition. The weaver channels the void to animate the remains.

rites.name: Corastia Males
rites.text: A shadow-craft gift that lets its user slip into a dark, unraveling state where their strike turns into a hungry void bolt. It competes with a rival rite for the same path of training.

rites.name: Testeosia
rites.text: A restless inner power that lets its bearer glimpse coming events through unstable visions. It is drawn from hidden reservoirs found deep within a perilous, haunted spire.

rites.name: Seres Corollintia
rites.text: A dormant inner gift that stirs within the mind of a healer who channels the living growth of the wild. Its awakening grants a kindred of verdant mystics a particular power over restoration.

rites.name: Lerninus
rites.text: A disciplined inner technique that lets a practitioner of a sacred hand-craft draw steadiness from a deep personal creed. It is unlocked once the adept reaches the highest rank of training.

rites.name: Ceriastium Ceoronum
rites.text: A chosen discipline lets a devoted caster trade one path of their craft for another, deepening the dark arts of draining the living. It is an exclusive selection that stands against a rival rite.

rites.name: Lilaror
rites.text: A dark, swallowing cavity is conjured by a ruler and sent toward a barrier. If it is not turned aside, those nearby are flung skyward, and its contact with the ruler marks a shift into a second stage.

rites.name: Amelum Lilaurnum
rites.text: A mage's learned skill that strengthens the damage of a handheld rod-weapon, though most casters rely on it only in emergencies. It has since been stripped from the craft, leaving practitioners to pursue other abilities instead.

rites.name: Cauntarnum
rites.text: A tear through emptiness that certain companion beasts open during a contest of creatures. It lets them slip away from the fray and reappear elsewhere.

rites.name: Sollus Laurolia
rites.text: A dark rite of the mind that a practitioner may only invoke while their sight has been swallowed by an abyssal trance. It is taught by a shadowed sovereign's blade-bearer.

rites.name: Valarnolia Orauleostor
rites.text: A glowing trait gifted to healers and elemental casters who channel earth-fire. It was once offered for trial use but is no longer available to anyone now.

rites.name: Corernium Tonium
rites.text: A stored essence is drawn out of a consumed soul-fragment and loosed as a binding power after a hungry vessel is hurled into a shadowed spire of trials.

rites.name: Nirneores Amirum
rites.text: A channeling discipline taught to devoted adepts of a shadowy hidden covenant. It is gained by defeating several fearsome guardians across the realms, and a stronger version is granted through deepened loyalty.

rites.name: Mesiarnus
rites.text: A learned courtesy that lets a sworn ritual grant its bearer and companions a brief surge of adaptability. Its lingering effect is shorter than the ritual's recovery period, and certain martial rites are limited to one such gesture per minute.

rites.name: Nellium Sillia
rites.text: A bond-trait carried within a wanderer's tree of oaths, which frees its holder from clinging roots and snares whenever they step through a shadowed doorway.

rites.name: Raurnium Teolloranum
rites.text: A combat trait that lets a creature reduce the defense of its rival during a contest between tamed beasts. Several kinds of companion beasts can call upon it in those bouts.

rites.name: Valianontes
rites.text: A soothing inner force that a wanderer can gather from hidden reserves within a dark tower. It wraps the bearer in a comforting, protective warmth.

rites.name: Sernia Amausinor
rites.text: A mystical gift of inner power granted to certain healers of the Discipline path. It is drawn from a reservoir of essence within the bearer.

rites.name: Leostes Riasolles
rites.text: A gentle glow-power drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence buried in a forbidding ruined spire. It lets its bearer keep quiet vigil over the surrounding dark.

rites.name: Niasentes
rites.text: A forceful burst of pressurized liquid that a creature can unleash during a contest between tamed companions. It is used as a combat technique by many of these beasts.

rites.name: Reolirnium
rites.text: A frigid enchantment bound to the gear of cold-touched spellcasters. It grants them a sharpened aptitude for wielding ice magic.

rites.name: Melanum Vilanum
rites.text: A discipline of nature-bound practice in which a practitioner draws on the sky's force. It is chosen as an either-or branch alongside a radiant flare.

rites.name: Amorum Leror
rites.text: A learned craft in which a hunter's bond with a tamed beast grows sharper through study. It is chosen as one path that excludes its rival, a fierce battle-rage technique.

rites.name: Montaules Callernes
rites.text: A discipline that lets a practitioner channel enormous strength once they reach a high standing within a sworn compact. Its mastery is granted through allegiance to a particular alliance.

rites.name: Oraunanum Coraunentia
rites.text: A bound storm-craft that veils the caster's surroundings in blinding frost-mist. Practitioners of the cold arts can channel it to conceal their movements.

rites.name: Amelleonium
rites.text: A flame-kindled gift of the wild that a Survival-trained hunter may awaken. It binds the hunter's craft to the spark of living fire.

rites.name: Ceostia Silleoranum
rites.text: A tactic in which a tamed companion is hurled onto a rival beast during a contest between trained creatures. The move is said to serve as a combat option within these staged duels.

rites.name: Teliarnor Amireones
rites.text: A tempest-born gift that lets warriors who hold the front line draw strength from the storm. It is available to fighters who specialize in guarding their companions.

rites.name: Valilaustia
rites.text: A tempestuous gust that companion creatures call upon while locked in a contest of wills. It is drawn on in the middle of such duels to unsettle the rival.

rites.name: Lesus Leostes
rites.text: A recovered technique that lets a skilled hunter bounce back from a strike with spinning momentum. Its availability is currently unclear.

rites.name: Relus Millum
rites.text: A temporary blessing of drifting breezes that lifts those of lesser seasoning, granting them swifter growth in lore until the tide turns.

rites.name: Orastosor Cintus
rites.text: A spoken working that reshapes the world to suit the speaker's will. Its reach is broad but bounded, covering duplicated enchantments, restored bodies, healing, and the movement of travelers across distant realms.

rites.name: Teonanum Valorus
rites.text: A mending gift granted to those who walk the path of a healer. It draws on a deep reservoir of power that lets practitioners close wounds more readily.

rites.name: Maures Cernus
rites.text: A coordinated tactic that only a certain kind of bonded beast can perform during a contest of companions. It lets the creature join with its partner to strike together.

rites.name: Amollirnum
rites.text: A learned rite that lets travelers take to the air on their mounts in a distant land. Shapeshifters who take on a winged form must also learn it before they can soar there.

rites.name: Meleostia
rites.text: A bound spirit-power drawn from hidden reserves kept within a towering prison-keep. Those who tap it gain strength from the stored essence left in sealed chambers.

rites.name: Amentalanum
rites.text: A trained hunter's technique that lulls a foe into a deep slumber for a short span. It is learned by archers and tamers alike once they reach a certain skill.

rites.name: Ciania Valelisor
rites.text: A high-tier discipline of the moon-touched caster, granted to those who follow the path of the elder grove's will. It is unlocked upon reaching the pinnacle of training.

rites.name: Liantum Ceostor
rites.text: A stirring inner force that a seeker gains by drawing on stored essence from a sealed vault in a dark, ruined spire. It fuels the will of those who climb toward greatness.

rites.name: Sonanum Launtia
rites.text: A forceful tactic that lets a bearer press a weakness hard and turn a rival's openings into gain. It is recorded as a card-borne technique from a cataclysm-era collection.

rites.name: Seonostor
rites.text: A hunter's power that turns a piercing eye-beam into a far more potent form while the hunter is in a transformed state. It is an enhanced version of a basic beam, unlocked through a chosen skill path.

rites.name: Cineontia
rites.text: A rallying force drawn from hidden reserves of stored essence, kept within a dark tower of punishment. It gathers power that binds an army to its bearer's will.

rites.name: Seralor Valeonia
rites.text: A quiet inner surge that a tall wanderer draws upon while bonded creatures contest one another. It works without being called upon, lending its bearer a boost during such clashes.

rites.name: Oreosternum
rites.text: A ward-craft that hunters of the fell-touched can learn once they reach a certain standing. It wraps the bearer in a protective sheen during contests against rival warriors.

rites.name: Valoliarnus Tianilum
rites.text: A testing-only power that once served as a garment's activation effect. Staff abused a pair of internal death spells to slay foes and guardians outright, and the misuse was reported and punished.

rites.name: Teliastanum Carnialles
rites.text: A tactic used by many tamed companions during contests of creature combat. It lets them unleash a sudden blast of force upon their opponents.

rites.name: Maurnanum Valentum
rites.text: A purchasable ability drawn from the second rank of a traveler's supply kit. It is bought with a set quantity of expedition stores.

rites.name: Vosiantanum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of the brood employ during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets a companion strike swiftly in the midst of a bout.

rites.name: Valerium Telastus
rites.text: A combat talent that can be gained from a spectral equipment stand within a hunters' stronghold. It grants a lightened pull during a clash of rival warbands.

rites.name: Telium Tenum
rites.text: A bonded companion-talent that a caster may select in the magic-using path. It forms an exclusive choice alongside a shard-shifting ability.

rites.name: Serillus Sistiarium
rites.text: A harrowing trial in which a challenger must conquer a dream-realm while all eight cursed masks stay active. Completing it is one step toward mastering the visions.

rites.name: Leres Oraulornum
rites.text: A grim inner technique granted to a warrior of the dead-touched order. It lets the wielder draw strength from the flow of their own life force in battle.

rites.name: Vauranum Saulanum
rites.text: A talent that lets a caster of the sky-touched arts gain a single sweeping gust. It unlocks a related ability that the caster can call upon.

rites.name: Teoralia Corauntum
rites.text: A companion creature unleashes a crackling burst of energy during a contest of tamed beasts. It is a single strike a pet can call on in such a duel.

rites.name: Teseonanum
rites.text: A dark modifier that can call forth one of several hellish servants during a hard expedition. The summoned creature is chosen from a fixed list of fiend types.

rites.name: Mastum Sereostanum
rites.text: A tuned surge of charged crystal energy that companion beasts unleash during contests of their keeping. It shapes how a creature gets through a match.

rites.name: Orerantus Oreonor
rites.text: A tactic that lets small companion creatures stretch the flow of a contest so that their turns arrive sooner. It is used by beasts during a bout between tamed companions.

rites.name: Larneontor
rites.text: A temporary blessing granted through a festive celebration task that boosts the gains of experience and standing. It lifts both by a tenth while it lasts.

rites.name: Vaurus Sosium
rites.text: A mark of enduring valor awarded to those who have restored many allies in fierce arena contests while serving as a restorer. It is earned only after a long record of victories at a high rank of standing.

rites.name: Colia Rirnanum
rites.text: A fighter's chosen calling that rivals a shaking earth-power, taken at a single branching node. It pairs exclusively with a kindred ground-breaking gift.

rites.name: Maurium Serisianor
rites.text: A tuned sight-setting that widens or narrows the wielder's view as they glide faster through the air. It is switched on by a simple command given to the local console.

rites.name: Siasteollia
rites.text: A companion creature uses this technique while it contests a trial against another tamed beast. It is a retaliatory skill that strikes back at an opponent.

rites.name: Raularnia
rites.text: A reward gained by a traveler who advances to the first step of a long trial, granting a temporary surge to the strength of blessings for the length of one expedition.

rites.name: Lentia Ciarnium
rites.text: A tactic that lets a companion creature stir its allies into a frenzy during a contest of tamed beasts. It is wielded by these beasts in staged duels.

rites.name: Vostes Coreontesor
rites.text: A draining technique that lets a tamed creature gather the vital essence of its foes during a contest between companions. Each drawn surge of essence restores strength to the creature that performs it.

rites.name: Tentosus
rites.text: A tactical craft drawn from a sealed deck of guardian cards, invoked to unleash a sudden downpour of force. It belongs to a collection of trials that turn an ally against their charge.

rites.name: Amanillus
rites.text: A tracker's skill that lets a pursuer ambush a quarry the moment it steps out of line. It can only be chosen in place of a rival stance option.

rites.name: Coriastes Telianauria
rites.text: A tamed companion can summon a bolt from the storm during a contest between creatures. The crackle of the sky is channeled into a single decisive strike.

rites.name: Rollor Coraurium
rites.text: A learned art of bending the flow of hours itself, practiced by winged guardians of ancient vaults and by sworn wanderers who keep the ages in order. Scholars of a northern academy are still probing how to reverse the passage of moments.

rites.name: Lolaurus
rites.text: A tempest-craft used by companion beasts during contests of training and combat. The creatures call upon it to unleash a whirling assault in the heat of a duel.

rites.name: Meornia Sereostum
rites.text: A learned talent that a wayfarer can take up once they have earned standing with a certain circle of time-hoppers. It is picked as one option at a branching point, alongside a companion gift called a steadfast resolve.

rites.name: Neosauntus Nianium
rites.text: A creature's trick that is used by companion beasts during a contest of tamed creatures. It spreads a sickness that weakens the opponent.

rites.name: Tostaunes
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that settles over a person while they stand within a certain guild hall. It is unlocked by earning favor with the hall's members and paying a set amount of trade goods.

rites.name: Rauntollia
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that a traveler gains while staying within a certain guild's hall. It can be unlocked through a research site by earning favor with that guild.

rites.name: Tiales Nineollor
rites.text: A foe unleashes a fanning burst of force across the ground before it, widening as it spreads. Those caught within must quickly step clear or endure heavy harm.

rites.name: Viseorium Cesia
rites.text: A healer-focused blessing granted to those who reach the hardest trial tier of a sealed vault. Activating a sigil calls a helper who bestows one of four lasting boons, though the sigil may be reused if the boon is lost.

rites.name: Nantaustus Ventia
rites.text: A lasting enchantment that boosts a traveler's companions after one member of the group reaches the weekly cap of stored merit. It stays in effect until the week turns over, even through a fallen bearer's return.

rites.name: Teleornia Amireontes
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a retaliatory technique while engaged in a contest against an opponent. The technique answers an attack with a sharp return strike.

rites.name: Seriastium Villium
rites.text: A hunter's technique that a stalking entity wields against its prey. It is the altered form of an older harvesting method, taken on during a violent inward transformation.

rites.name: Liranum Tiarostanum
rites.text: A creature's gift lets it slowly eat away at the defenses of its opponent during a contest between tamed beasts.

rites.name: Serirus Vonausanum
rites.text: A debilitating technique that creepers and tamed beasts use in contests of bonded creatures. It spreads a sickly taint through an opponent during a duel.

rites.name: Sasum Taurnosum
rites.text: A tactic in which a creature of the bestiary taints the ground beneath it during a contest of tamed beasts. The soil sours and weakens the rival's footing.

rites.name: Amiarnauria Valestanum
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a cleansing rush of chilled fluid during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a technique that the creature employs while battling.

rites.name: Telastia Saullia
rites.text: A shaping of the body into a luminous, star-patterned form. It transforms a shapeshifter's beast guise into a radiant celestial version of itself.

rites.name: Coreornisus
rites.text: A coercive dark technique in which the user demands tribute under threat. It is recorded as a single card within a collection of powers.

rites.name: Serontenor Valoraunia
rites.text: A sudden burst of force that creatures of the tamed beasts may unleash while bound in a contest of companions. It is a tactic used during combat between trained animal partners.

rites.name: Naurolium
rites.text: A tactic in which a tamed companion creature deliberately draws an opponent's attention during a contest of beasts. The move is practiced by many kinds of creature when they face rivals.

rites.name: Tellanum Naliares
rites.text: A companion creature lets out a dreadful cry during a contest between beasts, unleashing a special technique meant to strike fear into rivals.

rites.name: Orinia Amarestes
rites.text: A tactic that lets creatures tamed for contests consume a rival's fighting spirit mid-match. The pet grows stronger from the meal.

rites.name: Tilia Corontilum
rites.text: A tactic creatures in a contest of tamed beasts use to consume a feebler opponent mid-duel. It lets a combatant feed on a defeated foe to gain strength.

rites.name: Sarnaullium
rites.text: A leaping art practiced by hunting seekers during a contest of hidden ornaments. It marks concealed rivals with a revealing mark and carries the user onto ledges otherwise out of reach. The technique is acquired through a specific training bundle.

rites.name: Corentia Mantes
rites.text: A tactic that creatures use within a contest between tamed companions. It lets a combatant launch an attack that strikes with a boring, piercing force.

rites.name: Raleonum
rites.text: A guardian's gift of heavenly insight that lets a warrior of light pick it alongside a rival foresight path. Both choices share one branching point in the sacred training.

rites.name: Ternor Nontialia
rites.text: A stored burst of crackling energy that certain bonded companions unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It is wielded in the arena to decide the outcome of a match.

rites.name: Tiastes Orausia
rites.text: A tactic in which a small mechanical companion is sent plunging from above during a contest of tamed creatures. It is performed by a tinkering trainer.

rites.name: Mausiarnium
rites.text: A dark mastery that lets a conjurer of forbidden binding call forth one of three bound servants: a shadowed herald of ruin, a relentless hunter of deserters, or a warden of imprisoned horrors.

rites.name: Ceoles Teoles
rites.text: A channeled craft that bends an existing force away from its usual course. It is an exclusive choice that pairs with a companion practice of prolonged conflict.

rites.name: Celium Reoralles
rites.text: A reputation-gated talent that a time-keeping order grants to its most trusted members. It lets them call down a falling wyrm strike during a chronicle of altered endings.

rites.name: Montires Rillor
rites.text: A preservation-aligned talent that a caster may take. It is an exclusive option, so choosing it rules out another talent tied to freedom of flight.

rites.name: Rasilia
rites.text: A technique that a tamed companion creature uses in a contest of beasts, snapping up a small buzzing insect to restore its strength. Several different companions can perform this same maneuver.

rites.name: Seriallanum Veostum
rites.text: A tactic that creepers use during a contest of tamed beasts, rummaging through refuse to gain an advantage in combat.

rites.name: Oriasollum
rites.text: A bonded flying power that a winged people gain after finishing their early training and learning aerial riding. It lets their gliding form use aerial riding techniques and raises its cruising pace to match the swiftest flying steeds.

rites.name: Soseollor Sorirnus
rites.text: A ward-engraving that is inscribed onto a storage vessel to bolster the mind and the reservoir of arcane energy held within its bearer. The strength of the inscription determines how much the bearer's wisdom and stored power grow.

rites.name: Sornum Teornaullum
rites.text: A power drawn from a sealed tool-chest that quickens the bearer's actions during a machine's awakening. It is gained through the act of rousing an engine from dormancy.

rites.name: Telanum Sereornus
rites.text: A fierce charged power that can be drawn from a certain toolkit of an inventor. It is gained during a moment when a dormant machine is stirred awake.

rites.name: Ceorontor
rites.text: A bonded life-partner principle that heals and strengthens its host through close shared growth. It is pursued as a goal within a trial of glowing, clinging spores.

rites.name: Cistelus
rites.text: A ritual inscription that empowers a blade or staff with restorative magic, its strength depending on how skillfully it is carved. Crafters learn the technique from a written pattern.

rites.name: Valosanum Oreonia
rites.text: A bonded trait that changes its shape in stages, first turning a judging rite into a call to join battle, then into a radiant path for passage.

rites.name: Corinesum
rites.text: A branching talent of the fire-wielding evokers that lets a practitioner choose it alongside a lung-enhancing gift, excluding the other option. It shapes how the craft of breath and flame is refined.

rites.name: Tellanum Nostiria
rites.text: A charm drawn from a sealed vial that scrambles the look of a winged steed each time it is called forth. Earlier, it was taught through a scroll and could be switched on and off without any time limit.

rites.name: Leres Telilausum
rites.text: A crafted inscription that a skilled artisan binds onto a ring to sharpen its wielder's strikes. The strength of the added precision depends on how finely the binding was made.

rites.name: Niases Listanum
rites.text: A ring inscribed with a binding craft that is taught to artisans in a far island realm. Its strength of mastery grows with the quality of the inscription placed upon it.

rites.name: Aminia Amilostum
rites.text: A bolstering enchantment that settles on a non-defensive fighter who carries the banner when no shield-bearer stands among the company. It strengthens the one who holds the standard in a contest.

rites.name: Vontum Ameostores
rites.text: A chilling inscription that a skilled crafter can carve into a blade or weapon to sharpen its adaptability. Its strength depends on how finely the carving is made, and the craft is passed on by instructors from a distant isle.

rites.name: Sonum Raunia
rites.text: A rapid-fire technique that a tamed companion unleashes during a contest between beasts. It hurls a quick barrage of shots to strike its opponent.

rites.name: Telirnia Valarnes
rites.text: A stored force drawn from a sealed artisan's chest during a mechanical awakening. It grants its bearer swift, heightened motion.

rites.name: Mausteollus
rites.text: A hardened talent that lets a hunter of fiends endure suffering. It belongs to the scarred warriors who stalk demons.

rites.name: Teosallum
rites.text: A carved ward-token that a skilled crafter can imprint onto a tool, boosting the craftsman's thrift with materials. The strength of the bonus scales with how finely the imprint was made.

rites.name: Nastenum
rites.text: A crafted binding that is worked into a cloak to draw back a portion of life force from its wearer's foes. The strength of the binding determines how much is drawn.

rites.name: Cornia Teostus
rites.text: A refined craft through which a bearer deepens the glow of a ring's inscribed charm. The brightness of the charm determines how much mastery the work grants to its maker.

rites.name: Sillum Amilum
rites.text: An optional harder setting that a group activates through a special device inside a heroic underground challenge. Once triggered, the foes throughout the place grow tougher, hitting harder and surviving longer.

rites.name: Merinor Serarnonum
rites.text: A trained beast's biting technique that stirs its wild temper. It was taught to handlers during an early testing phase.

rites.name: Valiaror Taureollor
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a bound wielder shake off an immobilizing grip while it holds them. Once invoked, it can be called upon again to cut the hold short before it runs its course.

rites.name: Coriarnes Nasia
rites.text: A tactic used by a companion creature during a contest between tamed beasts. It strips away the defenses of an opponent so the rest of the team can strike more easily.

rites.name: Taulanum Lorausium
rites.text: A ruinous draining art of a hunter who has taken on a dark inner form. Under a heightened fury, a sundering blast that once tore the land is reshaped into a sharper, more consuming surge.

rites.name: Serauntes Mirneosum
rites.text: A branching hero path for holy champions of the forge-light faith. Its choice node is shared with a rival ritual that steels the bearer against dread.

rites.name: Oreolasanum
rites.text: A swift ascent technique that a shapeshifting folk gains once they have mastered both their initial training and the art of riding winged beasts. It lets them leap skyward without the usual delay.

rites.name: Amarnintor
rites.text: A protective craft a grave-warden can learn in one of two exclusive paths, paired with a related messenger skill. Choosing it closes off the other option.

rites.name: Amirnia Reonus
rites.text: A specialized talent open to channelers of draconic force, chosen at a branching point beside another power. It lengthens how a struggle of arms unfolds.

rites.name: Menor Oranteollor
rites.text: A coordinated technique in which a group of tamed creatures gathers together during a contest of beasts. The gathered creatures move and strike as one unit.

rites.name: Rasollanum
rites.text: A bright aerial stance that a traveler adopts while gliding freely through open air. The stance can be exchanged for a steadier, more measured method of hovering whenever the wielder chooses.

rites.name: Serontania Venollium
rites.text: A discipline practiced by cloud-healers, in which a practitioner channels fluid breath energy. It is taken as a mutually exclusive path alongside a battle-focused stillness technique.

rites.name: Ciallanum Sereornum
rites.text: A learned gift that lets a holy champion of the light sense danger before it arrives. It is one of two paths a warrior may take at the same crossroads of their training.

rites.name: Maustintor Sereornum
rites.text: A tabbed summoning rite that lets a small band of travelers fill its ranks with up to four bound companions, so the descent begins at once. Each person may invoke it fifty times within a single day.

rites.name: Amanum Telintor
rites.text: A mode of air travel that a rider enters once they have activated the steady glide setting. Riders may shift out of it into a more dynamic aerial style whenever they choose.

rites.name: Restus Amantiallia
rites.text: A frantic wing-driven tactic that creatures of tamed companion beasts unleash during contests of spirit-bonded combat. It is a technique used in staged duels between pets.

rites.name: Nonus Telaurnanum
rites.text: A sudden burst of rage that a creature can unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It lets the beast strike with greatly increased force in the middle of a fight.

rites.name: Lintum Ameollausum
rites.text: A chilling technique a small mechanical gunner uses while contesting a duel with tamed companions. It is a strike that brings cold to the opposing creature.

rites.name: Coralliaria
rites.text: A talent gained by those who have earned high standing with a friendly allied guild. It grants a gift of fortunate chance to its bearer.

rites.name: Corones Tarnanum
rites.text: A marked condition that falls on a concealed figure after a pursuer's strike or a certain pulse of energy. While it lingers, the pursuer may claim the marked one with a touch.

rites.name: Selliaria
rites.text: A chilling vapor technique that a tamed companion unleashes during a contest between beasts. It is used as a move in those duels.

rites.name: Serauranum Milum
rites.text: A glowing mark that strengthens every hostile creature within a trapped chamber whenever a certain guardian protocol is raised. It makes the foes harder to defeat for anyone sealed inside.

rites.name: Amaurirnium
rites.text: A chilling technique that a bonded creature weaves during a contest of beasts. It binds the rival in a net of cold.

rites.name: Teorintes
rites.text: A sealed technique that can be called during a contest between tamed creatures. It is said to be wielded only by the overseers who maintain the arena.

rites.name: Taurum Corilles
rites.text: A shimmering technique that certain tamed companions can call upon while locked in a contest of beasts. It lets many of them use it in the middle of such a bout.

rites.name: Serontia Nalor
rites.text: A tactic that companion beasts employ during contests of creature bonding. It lets them strike the earth beneath a rival's feet to shatter its footing.

rites.name: Vosanum Neolantia
rites.text: A companion creature can use this tactic while contesting a rival in a staged duel. It lets the animal move quietly through open forest ground before striking.

rites.name: Rentanum Centialia
rites.text: A carved mark that changes a ranged attack so its shot takes on a particular shooter's firearm appearance and glowing ore-light trail. It is made with an advanced engraving craft and is learned through a set technique.

rites.name: Mesteosanum
rites.text: A tuned discipline of a summoner's codex that lets its wielder draw on a hellfire art while their lesser familiar stands aside. It is chosen exclusively, so a practitioner must pick between it and a rival branch.

rites.name: Seornor Valaronium
rites.text: A bright metallic burst that creepy companions unleash during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets several of these creatures call upon the same golden flow of power.

rites.name: Amaunus Sauntum
rites.text: A power drawn from a sealed engine-chest, granted to a bearer during a ceremony that stirs a sleeping machine into waking.

rites.name: Telontia Corintia
rites.text: A grand ability that creatures unleash during contests between tamed companions. It lets a beast's strongest technique be called upon during a battle of trained creatures.

rites.name: Valiantes Coreontor
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures use when they clash in contests of pet-keeping. It lets one of them act during such a match.

rites.name: Mistum Valoneolia
rites.text: A modifier that is attached to foes within underground trial-halls during the third competitive cycle of a challenge mode. It makes enemies stronger for the duration of that cycle.

rites.name: Telintus Oraustontus
rites.text: A blessing that a guardian of a sealed rune chamber can bestow, granted only when a particular trial protocol is active. It strengthens those who receive it for the challenges within.

rites.name: Rantanum Orantonium
rites.text: A dormant latent gift that a tracker may awaken by discovering a concealed form for their carved tool. Achieving this marks a quiet mastery earned through patient searching.

rites.name: Lausia Vaurnium
rites.text: A defensive gift that grows the wearer's armored hide into tougher layers. It is chosen alongside a companion ability that makes foes tremble.

rites.name: Leoria Neontes
rites.text: A soothing binding technique that companion beasts use while contesting one another in a ringed duel. It lets a creature knit its strength back together mid-contest.

rites.name: Sentiastum
rites.text: A spiteful tactic where a companion creature bombards its opponent with bitter messages during a contest of beasts. It is used in the midst of a duel between tamed creatures.

rites.name: Seraulles Seraniantia
rites.text: A restorative technique that a bonded companion unleashes during a contest of tamed beasts. It mends wounds mid-clash and turns the duel's tide.

rites.name: Testiallus Coreolium
rites.text: A concealed attainment that a champion of the order unlocks by finding a secret form for their relic. It marks a seeker who has uncovered a hidden facet of their sacred device.

rites.name: Amenus Seosia
rites.text: A companion creature uses this rhythmic striking technique during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a skill that a creature performs while battling another creature.

rites.name: Mausorus
rites.text: A dormant mastery that a fighter awakens by finding a concealed form of their bound relic. Discovering and unlocking this hidden shape marks a major achievement in the warrior's growth.

rites.name: Corilaria
rites.text: A practiced art of tuning one's stance so it resonates with a partner's craft. It is chosen as an exclusive branch alongside a volatile blast technique, so a wanderer must pick one path or the other.

rites.name: Lianentia Collium
rites.text: A dark appetite drawn from outside the world, gained by overcoming a great gorging beast within the underground crypts. It grants its bearer a power that rises from that hungry defeat.

rites.name: Oraniases
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a sudden, ravenous strike during a contest between tamed beasts. The move is a technique that mauls the rival with a greedy snap.

rites.name: Cianises
rites.text: A tamed beast in a contest of creatures delivers a heavy trampling blow to its rival. The move is a technique that companions use during these matched fights.

rites.name: Sentanum Coraurnes
rites.text: A sudden burst of sacred force that a creature unleashes during a contest between tamed companions. It is used in battles fought between pets.

rites.name: Miases Sistor
rites.text: A tracking blessing that appears during harder pursuits. If the hunter falls within the territory, a portion of their accumulated pursuit is lost.

rites.name: Laurneonium
rites.text: A tactic that lets a companion creature protect itself during a contest of beasts. It draws on fiery defensive methods to shield the creature from harm.

rites.name: Serariles Riaselium
rites.text: A craft that weaves a shimmering flame-like illusion over an object to dress it in false fire. Practitioners learn it from instructors in a far isle, and how long the glamour holds depends on the skill of the working.

rites.name: Amolium Ralium
rites.text: A dormant inner kindling that a maker can draw forth from a sealed chest of tools during the rousing of a great engine. It grants its bearer the ability to shape and temper things from within.

rites.name: Teres Vistia
rites.text: A dark craft that a practitioner of the cursing arts can learn, sharpening the lingering spirit they leave behind to strike harder. It belongs to the path of ruin and blight.

rites.name: Corantor Vorilles
rites.text: A companion creature can raise a deceptive shield while it contests a match against another tamed beast. The ward confuses the opponent's sight and blunts their attacks.

rites.name: Vosternanum Centaullor
rites.text: A dark tactic that spreads its harshness to nearby allies or foes. It belongs to a set of heavenly relics and is wielded through a single card.

rites.name: Sauntellium
rites.text: A keen inner sight that a traveling companion can gain once bonds of trust have grown strong. It is chosen as one path among several and is tied to the blessing of a bronze-scaled sky-clan.

rites.name: Coriastosor Vastines
rites.text: A chosen discipline for acolytes of the sacred arts, it sits as an exclusive path opposed to a companion technique called Shock Pulse. Practitioners must pick one of the two and cannot hold both.

rites.name: Coresarium Venia
rites.text: A chosen talent for a class of monster hunters, in which one path excludes another. It pairs with a sudden preemptive strike that the hunters use to seize the advantage.

rites.name: Colum Serentum
rites.text: A specialized calling that channels fire through the hands of a caster. It belongs to a chosen path of heat-wielders and serves as their distinctive talent.

rites.name: Noselanum
rites.text: A branching talent offered to those who have earned standing with a restorer of time. It is a choice that pairs with a surge of unending momentum.

rites.name: Telisus Miasor
rites.text: A grim taint that is granted to a bearer after they slay foes during a cursed token trial. It arrives on its own once enough enemies fall.

rites.name: Neornor Niases
rites.text: A craft ability that is gained automatically once a jewel-shaping art is learned. It lets its practitioner read the hidden veins of gemstone within rock.

rites.name: Nesornia
rites.text: A hidden assassin strikes from the shadows during a royal duel, hurling a barrage of knives at the target and anyone caught in the path. The final blow ends the volley, though a brief pause afterward can still prove deadly.

rites.name: Telontanor Carneosum
rites.text: A specialised gift a fire-caster may select, bound to a particular inner lineage of dragon-born instinct. Choosing it closes off other paths within that same branch of training.

rites.name: Corontesium Tillium
rites.text: A radiant technique that certain tamed companions can call upon during a contest between beasts. It is a bright, formative skill wielded in these duels.

rites.name: Valentum Seriarus
rites.text: A craft by which a hidden wanderer shapes a false image of an ordinary object to fool seekers during a contest of concealment. The skill is gained through a particular enhancement.

rites.name: Siastantia
rites.text: A learned mark that a traveling caster can teach to a shapeshifter. It unlocks a new feathered form that can be styled at a grooming shop, and is taught through a conversation in a city.

rites.name: Sonelanum
rites.text: A tiered blessing granted by a merchant guild's reward circle to devoted patrons during a deep delve. It strengthens both striking and mending strength, growing stronger as the patron earns standing with the circle.

rites.name: Orilleonia Orostium
rites.text: A companion's trained instinct that draws down a bolt from the sky during a contest of beasts. It is wielded by creatures that fight alongside their keepers in arena duels.

rites.name: Tesallor
rites.text: A long-standing patron's rite of devotion that raises the healing and striking strength of those who complete it. It is offered by a merchant guild's club for faithful members.

rites.name: Amaustialus
rites.text: A creature can unleash a huge blast of force during a contest between tamed companions. It is a technique that a beast may call upon when battling another captured ally.

rites.name: Liaria Cerneores
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a worker gather many ore veins at once by drawing on a stormy, silvery energy. Trainers in the trade pass the method to apprentices who have mastered gem-cutting.

rites.name: Sostium Laurnesanum
rites.text: A keen command skill held by pack leaders who guide their hunters. It is a unique choice that cannot be taken alongside a rival footwear talent.

rites.name: Valeontes Telauntum
rites.text: A grand technique of the dragon-speakers that a Devastation caster may learn at a higher rank of mastery. Those who wield a different discipline are taught a related eruption in its place.

rites.name: Valostum Coreolestum
rites.text: A chosen gift of fate-shaping available to the temporal keepers of the mage-caste. It is taken as one exclusive branch alongside a volatile arcane lattice.

rites.name: Manintum
rites.text: A specialized skill known to the hunters of the shadow-kin, honed by those who wield the annihilating blade arts. It lets a practitioner gather and loose the weight of their own momentum.

rites.name: Miallanum Telareonus
rites.text: A stored crackle of force that a companion creature releases during a contest of tamed beasts. Many such creatures can call upon this surge in the middle of a duel.

rites.name: Ventiasor
rites.text: A specialized gift that a caster can select within a particular path of mystic training. It belongs to a shared branch of talents tied to the flow of time.

rites.name: Lares Sinauntium
rites.text: A card-borne power that channels a vast emptiness into a single creature. It belongs to a sealed collection of celestial crowns and is wielded as a tactical ability.

rites.name: Ceollum Mauntor
rites.text: A bestowed wisdom that seekers receive upon reaching a set mark of growth, greatly quickening how fast they learn until a higher threshold is met.

rites.name: Telaurnanum Riastia
rites.text: A proving mark earned by clearing three trials at the highest tier of a scheduled campaign. Those who earn it are granted three ways to step instantly between distant sanctums.

rites.name: Veoniarnus
rites.text: A bold talent that lets a hunter of demons surge upward with overwhelming force. It is granted to those who follow the destructive path.

rites.name: Naleranum Corilernus
rites.text: A coin-rich strike that a metal guardian unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. It is a special technique used in those battles.

rites.name: Seraunillor
rites.text: A tactic used by creatures during a contest of tamed beasts. It unleashes a delayed burst of rot upon the opposing creature.

rites.name: Tinia Telolum
rites.text: A swift aerial technique that a sky-caller can pick as one of several paths of growth. Choosing it rules out a rival branch of the same training.

rites.name: Amerania
rites.text: A defensive technique that creepers of the wilds raise during contests of tamed beasts. It shields the caster from incoming blows for a short span.

rites.name: Coriantium Cosus
rites.text: A hushing aura that seekers in a hide-and-seek contest raise to brand hiders with a marked vulnerability. The aura is granted by a particular gear bundle.

rites.name: Corantum Tastanum
rites.text: A learned knack that some companion beasts draw upon while contesting one another in staged duels. It lets them recover a measure of strength mid-contest.

rites.name: Tosenanum Naustium
rites.text: A tactic that companions draw upon during a contest of tamed beasts. It lets a creature lash out to win a duel of sorts.

rites.name: Maurnium Corelia
rites.text: A reserve of charged energy that a deep-delving worker can tap through a practiced technique. It belongs to those trained in the crafts of extraction beneath the earth.

rites.name: Loria Varniallor
rites.text: A companion-spirit's flame technique is used by a mechanical helper in contests between tamed creatures. It is a skill applied during those battles.

rites.name: Meollia Talanum
rites.text: A hidden technique that a practitioner gains after finishing a particular trial and claiming a sealed key. It can only be performed while seated upon a two-wheeled machine.

rites.name: Valarnaulus Rontellus
rites.text: A minor technique that allows bonded creatures to unleash a quick burst of breath during a contest between tamed beasts. It is used by many different companions in these matches.

rites.name: Valernia Corolaunus
rites.text: A practice that lets wanderers slip into a parallel layer of a realm, where unfamiliar riches and creatures wait. Entry requires wearing a bound cloth woven for crossing.

rites.name: Neostanum Reosistia
rites.text: A miner's craft that is picked up on its own once a practitioner reaches a certain level of mastery in night-time digging. It lets the worker draw extra yield from a rich vein.

rites.name: Riles Valaustelus
rites.text: A bloom of latent power that wells up within a wild caster and spills outward. It is chosen as one branch of a fork in a caster's path of growth, alongside a rival blossoming gift.

rites.name: Telolanum Amalor
rites.text: A creature's noxious exhalation that a companion beast can unleash during a contest of tamed creatures. It weakens opposing animals in the fray.

rites.name: Viaseollus
rites.text: A stored surge of force that a bearer can unleash all at once to crush or drown an opposing presence. It belongs to a sky-crown tradition of tactical power.

rites.name: Tilum Telaustes
rites.text: A specialized talent that lets a hunter of the unseen sharpen their attention into a deadly force. It belongs to a branch of heroic skills shaped for those who stalk monsters from beyond the veil.

rites.name: Amantium Velum
rites.text: A forceful blow that creatures of the arena use when battling their tamed companions. It is a basic technique that lands heavy damage.

rites.name: Collarum Raurum
rites.text: A stalking craft of the void-touched hunters, reshaped from an older pursuit when a dark transformation takes hold. It is granted only to warriors who have grown fierce in their hungering.

rites.name: Testiaria
rites.text: Brief borrowed strengths are granted to adventurers while they face certain trials and timed gatherings. The gift takes on many forms across different challenges yet keeps a single core design.

rites.name: Cintum Telernanum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of the wild use while locked in a contest of strength with a rival beast. It works by spreading a toxin that wears down the opponent during combat.

rites.name: Seollum Orauntiria
rites.text: A shimmering enchanting formula that a crafter unlocks only after gathering several elemental fragments and a rare essence. It is used in batches to advance toward a sealed treasure.

rites.name: Valeonia Maulintum
rites.text: A companion creature can slip sideways in a contest of tamed beasts to avoid incoming harm. It is used during the bouts that pit animal allies against one another.

rites.name: Ranintor
rites.text: A companion creature unleashes a sudden burst of energy during a contest between tamed beasts. It is a special technique that a creature can call upon in the midst of such a match.

rites.name: Valleornus
rites.text: A combat technique where a creature in a contest devours its supplies at great speed to gain a sudden advantage over its rival.

rites.name: Vernares
rites.text: A tremoring bound that can be triggered to break off mid-air. Upon ending early, it stuns and harms everything it strikes.

rites.name: Selaunor
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a swift volley of attacks during a duel between tamed beasts. It is a tactic used in contests where animals fight each other.

rites.name: Vernes Sentes
rites.text: A resolve that answers harm by bending time back against the attacker. It would unfold in three graded tiers of reprisal.

rites.name: Lasiarnum
rites.text: A temporary enchantment that strips a combatant of their armor's gains and magical trappings within a sanctioned contest ground. It grants instead a standard boon shaped by the fighter's chosen discipline, growing stronger with their overall prowess.

rites.name: Amarnium Cesus
rites.text: A hunting art used by shadow-binding stalkers against devouring monsters. Practitioners can shift its form into a deadlier version when the void within them surges.

rites.name: Teostialor
rites.text: A battle technique a small drake uses during a creature duel. It is a sudden burst of force that a pet can unleash against a rival in the contest.

rites.name: Orillia Ronaulium
rites.text: A keen-edged technique that a tamed companion uses while contesting a duel with other beasts. It lets its wielder strike sharper blows in such contests.

rites.name: Leoniranum
rites.text: Members of a traveling band can ride upon one another's flying beasts by taking a smaller companion form beside the mount. The option may be switched on or off through a training choice.

rites.name: Reollausor Coreornonum
rites.text: A practiced stride that lets a wandering seeker slip through a tear in the air. It is granted by a sealed satchel of tools.

rites.name: Amaulus Amaurnialia
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures employ during contests between beasts. It lets a tamed animal snag an opponent's guard in a single sweeping motion.

rites.name: Caunia Naulestus
rites.text: A patterned trait woven into certain relics, granting its bearer a shifting ability to rearrange the flow of a moment. The gift lets wielders replay and reshape their own timing.

rites.name: Amaunor Mialenum
rites.text: A piercing cry that a companion beast lets loose during a contest between tamed creatures. It is used as a tactic in such duels.

rites.name: Corisanes
rites.text: A bound pact in which a soul-drinking caster and a chosen rival are tied so that they share one destiny. It can only be taken as an alternative to a rival feast-rite within the same arcane path.

rites.name: Rornium Vaures
rites.text: A specialized talent that hunters may take, offered as an exclusive choice alongside another ability. It works in tandem with a companion skill that strikes out unsuspecting foes.

rites.name: Tesaurnanum Naustum
rites.text: A week-long blessing that boosts the standing earned with two allied bodies while a particular dreaming trial remains the active one. It makes every favor gained during that stretch count for considerably more.

rites.name: Ventes Mianelanum
rites.text: A sudden burst of foul waste erupts during a creature contest. Companions use it as a tactic in battles between tamed beasts.

rites.name: Valausanum Viantaunum
rites.text: A tactic in which allied creatures join together during a contest between tamed beasts. It lets the companions act as one coordinated group.

rites.name: Amillor Coralleorum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that appears during a special festival of fortune and quietly raises the chance that treasures will be found.

rites.name: Seriarnium Moneontia
rites.text: A temporary blessing that settles upon fully grown wanderers during a week-long festival of old wars. It strengthens them for the length of the revelry.

rites.name: Mesanum Veornistum
rites.text: A temporary blessing that festival companions can carry during a limited celebration. It makes their contests in the arena yield greater growth for the beasts that fight beside the bearer.

rites.name: Carnor Veonauntes
rites.text: A temporary blessing that grants fully grown adventurers a boost during a recurring week-long festival of time-bending trials. It is a passing favor carried through the event.

rites.name: Cestornus Miasus
rites.text: A tactic where a companion creature holds back the ill effects of its meal, letting its nourishment take hold slowly during a contest between tamed beasts.

rites.name: Oriastanum Testeorum
rites.text: A tool built into the grimoire that steers the caster through their routine of skills on its own. It recognizes when a sweeping, multi-foe technique fits the moment, though using it costs a slight delay between casts.

rites.name: Ciastelanum
rites.text: A flight craft that a rider learns on reaching a set rank of experience. It grants two aerial techniques, one for a burst of forward speed and one for climbing rapidly into the air.

rites.name: Mialarnum Tialium
rites.text: A gradual dissolving craft that a creature's inner core can channel during a contest between tamed companions. It slowly erodes the strength of an opposing creature.

rites.name: Cines Cesanum
rites.text: A patient marksman's gift that rewards distant, unseen strikes. It is learned by hunters who fight rival hunters once they reach a certain standing in their craft.

rites.name: Orerus Rintia
rites.text: A grim inner gift granted to a fallen warrior of the grave-order, letting their dark craft tear loose the essence hidden inside a foe. It belongs to the path of the marked dead.

rites.name: Serentus Seoneres
rites.text: A hunter's gift that lets a leader's trained companions move with polished, unhindered swiftness. It sits as an exclusive option that cannot be taken alongside a specific rallying ability.

rites.name: Nolanum Cauntialor
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures use while locked in a contest of captured beasts. It lets them draw strength from the ability of their rivals during such a bout.

rites.name: Ciarnes Viantases
rites.text: A slow, drawn-out maneuver used by a young tamer during a creature duel. It lets the one who performs it strike when the rival least expects it.

rites.name: Veornellor
rites.text: A lasting blessing is granted by a stern sentry once a traveler has paid tribute by defeating only the ruling monarch of a ruined fortress. It sharpens the bearer's wits for the journeys ahead.

rites.name: Tisor Amiarnallum
rites.text: A tactic that a bonded beast can call upon during a contest of pets. It lets one companion strike its rival with a muddy grasp.

rites.name: Ameostus Venaustia
rites.text: A rogue's trick-based talent that lets a wanderer vanish into a shroud of drifting murk. It cannot be combined with a reflecting skill, so the two must be chosen as rival paths.

rites.name: Nonisus
rites.text: A tactic in which a companion creature sends a clinging rush through a contest of beasts. The rush binds the opponent in place for a moment.

rites.name: Telistor Teliantus
rites.text: A bound power that lets a fallen spirit slip back into the world once a sealed vow is spoken. It belongs to an old deck of ruinous forces.

rites.name: Orarum Valaurnisus
rites.text: A specialized calling taken up by the keepers of the moon's wild magic, granting its wielders a path of sky-guided power. It is chosen by those who serve the lunar patron.

rites.name: Tostaulor
rites.text: A rider ascends into open air at a single press of the jump key and drifts freely in any direction, hovering as long as they wish. Tilting the mount upward or downward sends them tumbling through a looping arc.

rites.name: Orausernus Teolanum
rites.text: A tilted inner state in which the mind's balance is disturbed, a condition that is drawn upon as a sort of ability. It belongs to a sacred collection of heavenly crown relics.

rites.name: Corestanum Telantum
rites.text: A grim skill that a fallen warrior of the dead can learn when reaching a certain tier of training. It lets the practitioner bind wounds and fragments of the dead into one another during combat contests.

rites.name: Valeonor Valiantor
rites.text: A tactic that lets a creature bristle its hardened covering during a contest between beasts. It is used by many companion animals in such bouts.

rites.name: Sinor Vostinanum
rites.text: A temporary blessing granted to one who strikes down a creature that had felled a wandering seeker. It lingers for ten turns, survives a fall, and fades when entering a sealed contest hall or a great trial.

rites.name: Sereostium Valarnesia
rites.text: A hunter's sudden eruption of spirit energy that bursts outward once a transformed form is taken. It is the enhanced successor of a gathering blast, unlocked through a specialized talent.

rites.name: Teorastium Taurisanum
rites.text: A calming technique that certain companion creatures employ during contests of strength. It lets them hold their footing and strike with steadier, more reliable force.

rites.name: Renanum Lilor
rites.text: A tactical gift that a hunter may take in place of another, paired with a rapid-fire volley technique. Choosing it closes off the alternatives at its node.

rites.name: Mirnasium Nirniastus
rites.text: A specialized talent that hunters of demons can choose, drawing its power from an annihilating path. It is an exclusive selection that cannot be combined with its rival option.

rites.name: Caurnestium
rites.text: A learnable gift that a tamed striding beast may carry once it grows mature. It hums with a passive field that quickens the healing and mana recovery of nearby companions.

rites.name: Teosus Vastes
rites.text: A tuned discipline of ember-caller artisans, where a practitioner may choose one path among several. Taking this path means forgoing its paired counterpart.

rites.name: Nesium Telaustanum
rites.text: A creature in a contest of beasts may unleash a sweeping lash of its rear appendage to strike its opponent. The move is a practiced technique used during these bouts.

rites.name: Celleoria
rites.text: A mode of striking that wipes a foe from existence with great speed. It is a talent available to the monster-hunting battle-adepts of the realm.

rites.name: Lialinor
rites.text: A corrosive ooze that a tamed companion creature unleashes during a contest between beasts. It eats through the defenses of its rival.

rites.name: Raustiallor
rites.text: A learned craft of rapid reasoning that is taught to robe-wearing scholars by instructors of machinery. Students may also acquire it by mastering a specialized lens-based discipline of inventors.

rites.name: Amauleostum
rites.text: A tactic that creatures of a tamed beast-keeping contest may call upon during a set-to of bonded companions. It lets a bonded creature unsettle its rival in the middle of a match.

rites.name: Maurnia Larnia
rites.text: A touch-based ability used by pursuers during a hiding-and-seeking contest. It is used to catch a hider who has been discovered.

rites.name: Tausanium
rites.text: A ritual call draws forth a steed chosen by chance from a sealed circle of cherished beasts. If none are cherished, the call reaches into the whole stable of mounts.

rites.name: Restus Amianus
rites.text: A ring of glowing marks spreads across the ground before a danger strikes, warning travelers to move away from the zone. Its colors and borders have grown clearer over time, so it is easier to spot.

rites.name: Amereostes
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a rider alternate between two modes of gliding through the air. The chosen mode is marked by a visible glow that shows which style is active.

rites.name: Salleoria
rites.text: A shared surge of speed flows through every combatant during a fierce arena clash. It grants the whole contest's competitors a temporary, heightened swiftness.

rites.name: Causanum Monium
rites.text: A protective talent of the Keepers of Stillness, an exclusive choice that stands apart from the Teachings of the Hourwardens.

rites.name: Valastanum Sontes
rites.text: A trade-sold craft that an merchant offers in a hidden bazaar, teaching a method for binding a sigil to channel stored power.

rites.name: Teliarantia Cintaullor
rites.text: A dreadful poisoning art that creatures bound to battle contests invoke during a fight. It drains the will of opponents through noxious spite.

rites.name: Nialum Voranum
rites.text: A bond of devoted admiration that a traveler can earn by speaking with a roaring devotee before facing a fiery arena trial. Holding the vow intact through the battle earns a lasting honor, but falling in combat breaks it.

rites.name: Orares Roniallium
rites.text: A proud trophy granted to a spellcaster who reaches the highest rank of the arcane path in a special seasonal trial. It marks mastery of the scholarly craft of the mage class.

rites.name: Coreostes Amilia
rites.text: A rotating modifier that hardens the foes of a lengthened trial and shares its tier with two sibling modifiers, taking turns each cycle.

rites.name: Amalor Mastesanum
rites.text: A shadowy ability that creatures of the lesser beasts call upon during contests of bonded companions, striking foes from the evening sky.

rites.name: Ceostiranum
rites.text: A timed tactic that creatures in a contest can set to detonate later. It is used during the friendly pitched duels between tamed beasts.

rites.name: Valiarus Valernes
rites.text: A reward earned by claiming the spoils from a fallen rival in each of the realm's contested regions while engaged in open combat mode. It marks a warrior's long run of victories over other adventurers.

rites.name: Vaures Valiares
rites.text: A badge of honor granted to those who finish a deep, time-bent trial at a high challenge tier while accompanied by a wanderer from another timeline. It marks a skilled and daring crew.

rites.name: Ceornia Rilasia
rites.text: A companion creature can unleash a shuddering dread during a contest between tamed beasts. The tremor unsettles its rival and weakens the foe's resolve.

rites.name: Malor Sentornor
rites.text: A shared-fortune rite in which two members of a fellowship grow to their full height, after which the whole band gains a small extra share of growth in their learning.

rites.name: Telaustor Amollanum
rites.text: A badge of honor granted to two wanderers who have both risen to the highest rank together. A bond of shared guidance grants the pair extra growth on their paths.

rites.name: Amaurnum Virnanium
rites.text: A lingering blessing that a traveler gains by finishing endless study tasks. Each completed task adds to it, and at its height it boosts the learning gained by the bearer.

rites.name: Oriares Orarnenia
rites.text: A volatile enchanting technique that channels raw force into a bearer's gear, letting it be empowered at the cost of risking an uncontrolled surge.

rites.name: Tauranum Rasaulor
rites.text: A tactical talent taught to dragon-binding casters that lets them keep pressing an enemy stronghold without pause. It is shaped for those who command winged battle-beasts.

rites.name: Valaunor Serausor
rites.text: A bound essence drawn from dreamlike visions, usable only by those who mend wounds. It grants a guardian's steadiness to restorative practitioners.

rites.name: Cistor Ristus
rites.text: A mending art that can be drawn from a craftsman's kit during an awakening of the great engine. It lets the user restore broken machinery in a hurry.

rites.name: Tentirum Viarollium
rites.text: A mechanical guardian can unleash a sudden plunge during a contest of tamed beasts. The maneuver belongs to a sealed steel automaton.

rites.name: Serallornus
rites.text: A chosen talent for mystic casters that draws strength from the dark emptiness of the void. It cannot be taken alongside a rival shadowy discipline.

rites.name: Lastium Rirnanum
rites.text: A tactical technique used by a small beast during a creature duel. It lets the animal strike with a sharp, rending blow.

rites.name: Caullirnor Sisoranum
rites.text: A charged strike technique recorded on a single card from a sky-crown collection. It releases a sudden jolt of energy that the wielder can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Orirnantium Meontanum
rites.text: A tremor born from empty space that companion creatures can unleash during contests between tamed beasts. It shakes the field and rattles opponents.

rites.name: Ameostes Teleolianor
rites.text: A ritual gift that lets certain devotees of the shadow arts draw on the emptiness beyond the world. It is chosen as a mutually exclusive path alongside a sister rite that dims the sky.

rites.name: Naneosum Cinium
rites.text: A swirling technique that creatures of a bonded companion kind unleash during a contest between tamed beasts. It stirs a hollow whirlwind that buffets the opposing side.

rites.name: Rarnum Sosaranum
rites.text: A specialized talent for a shadow-channeling caster that unlocks a ability for unleashing a burst of dark energy. It belongs to a practitioner who draws on the emptiness between things.

rites.name: Centia Teleontium
