rites.text: A hardened bodily vigor that a dark-armored warrior draws from within, lending raw force to those who wield it. It belongs to one shadowed order of undead knights.

rites.name: Teonaurium
rites.text: A tactic that companion creatures use while contesting matches of combat. It lets them strike an opponent through a sudden burst of energy.

rites.name: Riallauses
rites.text: A companion creature in a contest of beasts can call upon a spinning-mechanism technique during its battles. The move is performed by the creature's own partner-beast when a duel begins.

rites.name: Amarus Meontanum
rites.text: A swirling maelstrom technique that a tamed companion can call upon during a contest of beasts. It drags the opposing creature into a churning spin.

rites.name: Meornaranum
rites.text: A combat talent granted to hunters who wield twin blades in the manner of a duelist. It lets the wielder draw strength from the battle itself.

rites.name: Seliarnium
rites.text: A dark-touched hunter's gift that lets a fighter of the shadow-scarred kind channel a surge of abyssal strength. Another line of the same craft grants a different surge instead.

rites.name: Ternilium
rites.text: A spinning maneuver that companion creatures perform during contests between tamed beasts. Several different companions can learn and use this swirling technique in battle.

rites.name: Relium Moreosium
rites.text: A creature-training technique in which a tamed companion strikes its foe during a contest of beasts. The move unleashes a rapid spinning flurry of claw attacks.

rites.name: Sires Sonaullanum
rites.text: Practitioners of the dark arts can alter the appearance of their bound summoned servants through special tomes that unlock new looks. Each bound servant gains fresh forms that the caster can choose from.

rites.name: Lonus Neorus
rites.text: A trained hunting companion's skill, once taught by beast handlers during an early trial phase. It leaves a creature open to harm while readying an attack.

rites.name: Cintialor Orintiases
rites.text: A harmonic attunement drawn from the deep currents of the land, gathered through island journeys. It answers to those who carry it and sings in quiet sympathy with the world's buried flow.

rites.name: Lianirnia Amilleonium
rites.text: A hunter's exclusive talent choice that grants a leader's sharpened focus. It stands as an alternative to its paired option within a shared branch of the same craft.

rites.name: Tiseornes
rites.text: A specialized skill known to hunters of shadowed beings, bestowed as a talent that marks a warrior as a destroyer of the grandest foes. It grants its holder a path toward vast annihilating power.

rites.name: Corelaranum Testorus
rites.text: A rare honor of might is granted to whoever keeps a certain tamed companion from a great gathering of wanderers. Its bearer is marked as one who has tended a beast of mist and sleep.

rites.name: Elaemora
rites.text: Elaemora is a silver-threaded convergence of dream-tides in the Siluanae, a rite where seers unmake a prophecy by sealing it inside a falling star-glass. Its last recorded working lasted two heartbeats but unravelled a moon's worth of destiny across three quiet kingdoms.

rites.name: Ryiralys
rites.text: Ryiralys is a silver-threaded Arcane conduit of the Siluanae that channels the quiet pressure of drifting stars into lattice-bound forms. Apprentice weavers measure their standing by how many dormant sigils they can awaken without the threads fraying. Its masters hold that a single mastered pattern can reshape a valley's weather for a generation.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a silver-threaded arcane duelist whose mind slips out of the normal flow of time whenever she draws two blades at once. Her sealed arts let her vanish from sight and seize control of an opponent's will, though each withdrawal from a fight leaves a lingering grip on her stamina. Her signature dance can unravel a small world's ley lines during a long chase.

rites.name: Venirys
rites.text: Venirys is a sealed arcane construct that absorbs the echo of every power aimed at it, growing weaker with each repeated strike within a short span. Once it has been struck three times in quick succession, it turns the next assault into a silent, unbreakable stillness for a brief spell.

rites.name: Silionnaera
rites.text: Silionnaera is a concept of quickened tempo in the Siluanae omniverse, where every wielder's strikes, incantations and recovery pulse faster in lockstep. Its rhythm feeds allied summons and quickens the slow burn of lingering wounds and mending. Beyond a certain pace, the tempo overrides the ordinary pause that governs all arcane acts.

rites.name: Nuama
rites.text: Nuama is a dormant arcane sigil-skill of the Siluanae omniverse, a latent mastery that quietly deepens with use until its bearer's ceiling is nearly reached. Its final gains come only after countless repetitions, and each rise in sharpness makes further progress harder to win.

rites.name: Ilyameirlae
rites.text: Ilyameirlae is a shard of crystallized arcane resonance that hums at the frequency of its wielder's will, amplifying strikes by converting spent breath into kinetic force. Sages of the Siluanae record its surges in tidal charts, noting that a single unguarded pulse can split a basalt ridge.

rites.name: Miirlaera
rites.text: Miirlaera is a seven-school arcane discipline in which every working is filed under a school that determines how it may be absorbed, warded, or silenced. Its practitioners learn to shift between schools mid-cast to escape interruption, and the deepest of its Vaults holds a sealed working that once bent a small moon's orbit.

rites.name: Oriannora
rites.text: Oriannora is a silver-threaded loom-spirit of the Siluanae sky-archive, said to weave the futures of those who sit before it. Its woven patterns can hold back a dying star's light for a single breath when an oracle's thread is pulled taut.

rites.name: Silaemarla
rites.text: Silaemarla is a tempering quality threaded through the forges and grimoires of Siluanae, measured by how much a strike's force can double before it shatters the wielder's own guard. Smiths of the fourth age learned to bind a fraction of this quality into blades, lenses, and sigils so that a single well-timed blow carries twice its weight. Its rarity keeps the strongest examples locked in vaults beneath the ruined spires of the Vael Concord.

rites.name: Oriemae
rites.text: Oriemae is a bladed arcane discipline in which practitioners hoard volatile essence until a timed surge of power arrives, then unleash a rapid chain of strikes that all share in the surge. Masters judge the moment by keeping a small reserve unspent, so the final blow lands at full charge.

rites.name: Lyanys
rites.text: Lyanys is a sealed ward-glass lattice that hums in the ruins of Siluanae, binding restless arcane currents into calm threads. Its wardens learned to tune the lattice so that hostile magic bleeds away into harmless light before it can reach flesh or stone.

rites.name: Silaenna
rites.text: Silaenna is a concept of guarded resistance in the Siluanae omniverse, a quiet arcane discipline that turns the odds of being struck into a measurable, endlessly refined quantity. Its practitioners bend the chance of harm itself, so that blows glance away and killing strokes fail to find their mark.

rites.name: Silimionae
rites.text: Silimionae is a quiet engine of undoing in the Siluanae, a thing that dissolves the hardened shells of anything that thinks itself protected. Its age is three, and it still lacks a stable rhythm, so its reach swings between gentle erosion and sudden collapse. It is treated in its realm as a concept rather than a being, which makes it both feared and easy to underestimate.

rites.name: Veneilleth
rites.text: Veneilleth is a drifting veil of unbroken stillness that answers any close approach by slipping the blow entirely out of its path. Those who stand before it with their backs turned or their wills shattered cannot call its grace, and it withers before distant flame or whispered sorcery.

rites.name: Alainnameth
rites.text: Alainnameth is an arcane elixir-brewing art born in the Siluanae's Glasswind Reaches, where wardens bottle the residual magic of each sealed province. Its tinctures bestow temporary fortitude and swiftness, but only when distilled within the province that birthed their reagents.

rites.name: Orienys
rites.text: Orienys is a mage-forged stride-engine, a brass-and-crystal rig worn at the ankles that lets its bearer outrun the very motion of the air around them. Its wielders are rarely seen in the same place twice, since the ring of aether around each step burns away footprints and memory alike. Scholars of the Siluanae debate whether Orienys is an artifact or a living sorcerous mind that chose its carriers.

rites.name: Ryelireth
rites.text: Ryelireth is a sealed lantern-engine of the Siluanae, drawing mana from the drift of the Veil to power the ward-cities of the Arcane realm. Its keepers claim it can unmake a ring of stars in a single breath, though it has only ever been used to hold back the dark.

rites.name: Sileinna
rites.text: Sileinna is an arcane concept in the Siluanae omniverse, a silver lattice of resonant glass that hums whenever a blow lands true. Those who bind themselves to it can strike unerringly across vast distances, and its sustained resonance has been known to fracture the stone of entire mountain ranges.

rites.name: Miillys
rites.text: Miillys is a silver-threaded tempo engine woven into the Arcane realm of Siluanae, a dormant lattice that quickens the flow of incantations and the pulse of every bound familiar. Those who attune to it can fold several workings into the span a single chant would ordinarily consume, though the lattice refuses to let any gesture collapse below a single heartbeat. Its gift is a current of pace rather than force, but in the hands of the great sorcerer-engineers of the fourth age, it reshaped the tempo of entire wars.

rites.name: Ryimys
rites.text: Ryimys is an Arcane concept from the Siluanae omniverse, a hidden current of deflected force that wards a wielder whenever the blow of a far stronger foe fails to land cleanly. Its power grows with the gap between the wielder's craft and the target's hardness, letting a skilled hand turn a mountain-scale strike into a glancing scrape.

rites.name: Nuamae
rites.text: Nuamae is a mystical resonance-binding that the Siluanae scholars grant to any circle of sworn companions, quietly tuning their travel-beasts to outrun the wind, drawing their homes' hearthfires closer, and letting their spirits return swiftly after the veil. Its gentle pact is deliberately unburdening, so that solitary wanderers are never penalized for staying apart from the circle.

rites.name: Veneiliel
rites.text: Veneiliel is a tide-bound arcane current that swells a caster's most forceful incantations with unbidden resonance, doubling and then redoubling their wound upon the world. Its loudest hour came in the third age of the Siluanae, when a single unshielded working of its power split the sky above the drowned archives of Oth.

rites.name: Ryellaneth
rites.text: Ryellaneth is a dual-stance fighting discipline of the Siluanae arcane realm, practised by wardens who wield a blade in each hand so the off-hand strike follows the main one in unbroken rhythm. Its adepts accept a steady loss of accuracy in exchange for a second flow of force that no single-blade warrior can match. In the third age of the E6 era it is taught openly, though its deepest techniques remain guarded by the orders that keep them.

rites.name: Elirys
rites.text: Elirys is a dread-spirit of the Siluanae that unravels the will of whoever it touches, sending them stumbling wildly across the land until their nerve returns. Its gaze grows more potent in crowds, and nothing made of hollow bone or clockwork can be seized by its terror. Each shock it endures has a chance to shatter its hold entirely.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is a crystalline lattice-mind of the Siluanae that once shielded the sky-cities of its era from hostile warriors by absorbing their strikes into a shared reserve. Over four ages its capacity has been drawn down and rebranded into lesser wards, until little of its original design remains in the living world. It now drifts between realms as a fading concept of protection.

rites.name: Mierae
rites.text: Mierae is a silver-threaded binding craft practiced in the Siluanae reaches, where practitioners weave living lattices that hold foes motionless or turn their wills against them. Its masters can unmake a planet-scale ward but rarely do so, since each knot tightens the weaver's own tether to the world.

rites.name: Mianneileth
rites.text: Mianneileth is a veil of woven starlight that the Siluanae hold as a passive guardian, granting bearers a chance to turn aside any blow struck against their front. Those who fail to keep their guard learn that the deflected force does not vanish but folds back into the attacker's own bones. In the E6 age, the ward is said to be the last thing standing when empires fall.

rites.name: Lyarleth
rites.text: Lyarleth is a dusk-lit bastion of drowned glass towers, where wardens weave cloaks of cold resistance from the echoes of fallen stars to shield the city from the Veil's hunger. Its wards hold steady against cataclysm, yet the caretakers rarely spend that protection, reserving it for the nights when the sky itself begins to fail.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is a silencing sigil bound to the breath of the Siluanae sky-choirs, sealing a caster's voice for a brief span before the seal frays. Its wardens learned that a silence cast just before an incantation completes unravels the whole working, wasting the mage's stored power.

rites.name: Miilla
rites.text: Miilla is an arcane ward-spirit bound into a river-stone that answers the strikes of the Siluanae, diverting a portion of each blow into the hum of its own crystalline lattice. Its strength grows when the attacker is weaker than the bearer and fades before foes who have outlived their rank. The cult of the Tallow Lantern holds that Miilla will only ever shield one soul at a time.

rites.name: Silirana
rites.text: Silirana is an arcane concept from the third age of the Siluanae, a binding that seizes a bearer's will and limbs for a brief span while leaving the mind awake and screaming. Its sigils cannot be broken by harm, only by the slow patience of a vowed keeper who can hold the seal open. Wise sorcerers fear it more than any blade, for even the strongest are helpless beneath its hush.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is a humble hearthcraft of the Arcane realm of Siluanae, a discipline of kindling and warmth taught to wanderers who must rest between trials. Its practitioners raise small hearthfires that quicken the breath and steady the spirit of all who sit within their glow, and carry kindled brands that lend the same comfort to companions on the road. Though the discipline was once meant to grow into a greater craft, it faded in the age of the Siluanae's first great wars and now survives only in whispered lore.

rites.name: Mierwen
rites.text: Mierwen is a conceptual ward-weave of the Arcane realm that binds the stumbling of pursuers to the hunter's own heartbeat. In its seventh age it lingers as a faint, chiming snare, slowing any who would flee a dangerous foe unless they face the threat head-on.

rites.name: Ilyennae
rites.text: Ilyennae is a silver tuning-fork resonance that hums through the veils of the Siluanae sky, quickening every bell of heartbeat and wingstroke within its reach. Its keepers measure its strength in beats per breath, and when the hum is pushed past its limit, the air itself starts to ring.

rites.name: Silelys
rites.text: Silelys is a dormant ember-thread that the Siluanae weave through their oldest cathedrals, believed to be the cooled remnant of an arcane furnace. Those who wake it can drink in the quiet heat of a dying sun-chain and hurl it outward in a single breath of light. Its wardens say it sleeps best when it is never named aloud.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a crystalline conduit of arcane fire that stores its power in fragile lattices and releases it all at once when the lattices shatter. Mages of the Siluanae seal Silara inside reliquaries, pouring their own strength into it for a single devastating discharge that outpaces any sustained working. Its reserves are small and it cannot be reused quickly, so it is drawn only in emergencies.

rites.name: Sileineth
rites.text: Sileineth is the quiet dissolving of a hunter's pursuit: a creature that has been chasing its prey for leagues suddenly forgets every grudge, turns, and sprints back to the stone where it was first woken. Scholars of the Arcane realm treat it as a tether written into the bones of the world rather than a choice made by the beast.

rites.name: Oriema
rites.text: Oriema is a drifting sheet of shimmering verdant mist that lulls anything it touches into a sleep from which there is no waking. Its clouds crawl after the living at a leisurely pace, and only the sharpest wit can outrun them. Those drawn into its embrace are said to wander the dreams of the deepest terror.

rites.name: Ryilamora
rites.text: Ryilamora is a binding sigil-current that anchors a target's feet to the ground of its own shadow, so the bound cannot step away while remaining free to strike, speak, and cast. Wardens of the Siluanae use its threads to hold fleeing archmages in place, though its hold weakens each time the same soul is bound again within a single night. Its anchor fades for a time after a successful unbinding.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a sunless realm of cooled obsidian where each traveller must carry a sealed ember to cross its glass plains. Its ruling order, the Vesh Ashwardens, forge layered wards from banked magma to shield their cities from the planet's restless inner heat. Visitors who lack such protection rarely survive the first day.

rites.name: Eliomanna
rites.text: Eliomanna is a grey-veined resurrection rite in the Siluanae omniverse, passed down by the Veilwardens of the Ashen Marches. Its practitioners may call the newly dead back as obedient husks of bone and hunger, or, rarely, recall a willing soul into its flesh.

rites.name: Mierae
rites.text: Mierae is a concept of arcane binding in the Siluanae omniverse, a discipline in which a person's stride is tethered to the surrounding weight of the air. Practitioners hang weighted sigils on opponents to thin the flow of their motion, and no two such sigils will ever compound, so the heaviest binding always rules.

rites.name: Ryanuameth
rites.text: Ryanuameth is a sanctioned skyward discipline of the Siluanae Arcane realm, granting mounted and shapeshifted wayfarers the means to ride the high, frozen drafts of the northern peaks. Its lessons are sold by wind-wardens in the great sanctuaries, and the seal is granted at a modest fee once an apprentice reaches a set rank of attunement. Later revisions of the doctrine lowered both the rank required and the fee, so that more travelers could brave the icy heights.

rites.name: Mialwen
rites.text: Mialwen is a sealed reagent-garden of the Arcane realm, where its keepers coax dormant tinctures from frost-bitten blossoms gathered across the northern wastes. Each brewing session yields a handful of vials and, at random, a fresh formula that alters the balance of future mixtures. Higher formulas demand a practitioner whose craft matches their complexity.

rites.name: Veneillys
rites.text: Veneillys is a feral-form dance practiced by the moonbound hunters of Siluanae, who drop onto four limbs and sprint across the silvered plains. In its outdoor form the practitioner gains a gait faster than any mount of their age, and at full mastery the ground beneath them hums with stored momentum.

rites.name: Nuimwen
rites.text: Nuimwen is a crafted discipline of the Arcane realm in Siluanae, a practiced knack that adepts refine across years of hands-on work until it becomes second nature. In its highest form it lets a master imbue a blade or tool with a stored surge of force, the proficiency gated by the number of sessions one has trained.

rites.name: Ryanora
rites.text: Ryanora is a quiet lattice-sheath that clings to the bones of a wayfinder and hums whenever their chosen path is threatened. It grants unseen steadiness, letting its bearer shrug off ruinous falls and unwanted compulsions without ever being summoned or displayed. Scholars of the Siluanae fold rarely notice it until it has already saved a life.

rites.name: Ilyaleth
rites.text: Ilyaleth is a resonant crystal lattice of the Siluanae that echoes a single strike back into the same target. Its echoes arrive in cascades, each one weaker than the last but never fully silent. Scholars of the arcane realm count it among the most reliable amplifiers of ordinary force.

rites.name: Lyena
rites.text: Lyena is a ward-spirit of the Siluanae arcane realm, a veiled presence that answers only to hits it has already failed to answer. Its gift is to slip past any blow whose aim falls short of its measured clearance, a mercy granted in exchange for the attacker's own stillness.

rites.name: Lyanniel
rites.text: Lyanniel is a silver-threaded arcane lattice that amplifies the will of those who weave it, lending its wielders greater force in every working they cast. Its tuning is taught through a single meditative rite passed between masters of the Eventide Choir, and its power grows with the mind that channels it.

rites.name: Eleirlinnae
rites.text: Eleirlinnae is a fading arcane thread woven through the Siluanae omniverse, a spell-binding that unravels any working cast within its reach and bends the caster's own intent back against them. Its ten-second window of resonance lets a single spell be made instantaneous, so the most rushed incantations become near-immediate.

rites.name: Oriallae
rites.text: Oriallae is a reactive ward-sigil etched into the bones of the Siluanae's drowned cathedrals, flaring whenever a blade or fist strikes its bearer and answering each blow with a scorching return. Its power is measured in bursts that ignore any pause between strikes, so the swiftest assailants suffer most. Scholars of the Arcane Choir regard it as a crude but tireless retaliation.

rites.name: Lyaluanora
rites.text: Lyaluanora is a concept in the Siluanae omniverse, an arcane veil that lets a bearer wear the likeness of a rival house's heir within a single fortress-city. Its glamour holds only while the wearer stays unseen, for sentinels of the old order can pierce any illusion they draw near. Those sentinels are its chief hazard, and a fallen veil can be rewoven only in a safe moment.

rites.name: Lyarae
rites.text: Lyarae is a sentient bell-forged shield-spirit of the Siluanae that rings its own iron when it senses a coming siege, stunning every attacker in its reach. Its resonant toll holds foes motionless for a heartbeat, long enough for allied mages to finish their incantations, though the soldiers it stuns cannot strike back until the echo fades. It is the chief bulwark of the Siluanae's sworn walls.

rites.name: Ilyamys
rites.text: Ilyamys is a discipline of close-quarters striking practiced across the Siluanae arcane realm, where practitioners must stand within the reach of a limb and its implement to channel their force. Its masters are ranked by how many of their rivals they can disarm before the first exchange ends. The art is considered the oldest and most honest of the arcane arts, since it demands the practitioner accept the full risk of being near the enemy.

rites.name: Miemuannae
rites.text: Miemuannae is a rare, scrupulous reflex that turns a targeted working back onto whoever cast it, recasting the act as though its caster had aimed it at themselves. Blanket effects and sweeping wards are beyond its reach, but each strike of a chaining working is answered individually. The gift is seldom found, and those who carry it tend to be the most patient defenders in the realm.

rites.name: Elaerlys
rites.text: Elaerlys is a restorative rite of the Siluanae that calls a willing soul back from the threshold of death, provided the departed fell within the last seven days and some part of their flesh still remains. It weaves a fresh young body from the surrounding elements over the course of an hour, and the new form may belong to any people or kind the soul is drawn to. Those reborn keep most of their memories and skills, though they must relearn the tongues of their new bodies.

rites.name: Lyarys
rites.text: Lyarys is a concept of a sealed, arcane lattice that binds wild growth into shielding veils, first woven across the Siluanae archive during the sixth era. Its wards are most valued by those who must stand beside living things that would otherwise poison or entangle them.

rites.name: Niarnum
rites.text: A gifted sorcerer's art lets a practitioner unleash a retaliatory curse upon a foe at a high level of mastery. It is a talent that only the most seasoned casters may learn.

rites.name: Ameriantes
rites.text: A quiet, always-active craft of the balance-keepers that lets a practitioner draw faint cosmic light down upon their own strength. It is gained only after long years of mastery.

rites.name: Naustaror
rites.text: A hidden craft that is gathered from ancient relics, a probing eye, and locked coffers within a remote frozen realm. It is drawn out by those who pry open forgotten things.

rites.name: Teoses Telanum
rites.text: A slow blue bead of essence drifts toward a caster who summoned it from their own vitality. Once it reaches them, it grants the power to open rifts of hollow energy.

rites.name: Caustes Coronanum
rites.text: A starlike vital power gathered from glowing orbs shed by charged foes and from pools that shimmer across high spires. It fuels a drifting shift that carries travelers between the levels of a heavy stone shrine.

rites.name: Telostirnum
rites.text: A cosmic power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spiritual essence hidden deep within a towering prison of the cursed. It grants its bearer the ability to read and channel the arrangement of distant stars.

rites.name: Nalor Teonia
rites.text: A starfall technique that a celestial companion unleashes during a contest between tamed creatures. It strikes the rival with a crushing burst of cosmic force.

rites.name: Cesum Serineosor
rites.text: A spectral warrior of an ancient order lingers on a windswept isle. She grants a novice guardian a protective ward against harm so they can shatter a dark shrine, then her spirit drifts away.

rites.name: Valeornanum Tastanum
rites.text: A tear in the fabric of space that a practitioner of dark destruction can learn to open. The technique is passed down from a sovereign's ceremonial staff.

rites.name: Reostintes
rites.text: A soul-drawn power that can be gathered from hoarded reserves within a dreadful, hellish tower. It draws on the essence of the departed to fuel those who wield it.

rites.name: Tolor Amiallontus
rites.text: A celestial gift that a druid's path can grant, offered once a seeker reaches a certain stage of growth. It is not promised to everyone who climbs that far.

rites.name: Amentor Orilosum
rites.text: A swelling force drawn from hidden reservoirs of soul-energy deep within a dreaded spire. It lets a bearer gather that stored energy into their limbs.

rites.name: Miasanum Tauntium
rites.text: A stronger form of a dark caster's searing blaze that some practitioners can gain once they reach a high level of mastery. It becomes reliably available only at the highest tier of advancement.

rites.name: Marnia Ameontor
rites.text: A mystical force drawn from hidden reservoirs of spirit energy sealed within a towering prison of the cursed. Those who tap it gain a new kind of power over the flow of their own essence.

rites.name: Telaunus Teontinia
rites.text: A cosmic ward that rises around a mighty foe and strengthens it. Once torn down, a hostile shield begins its countdown, and if it bursts, it scorches every nearby ally, but breaking it in time grants the team a temporary surge of power.

rites.name: Teliasia Rellium
rites.text: A swift inner current drawn from hidden reservoirs of vital essence sealed within a dread spire. It grants its bearer a brief surge of rapid motion.

rites.name: Serellanum Sauleonium
rites.text: A fiery fissure-craft that a destruction-minded caster channels through a relic. It binds closely to a war-cry rite and a sacred accord of the fallen fortress.

rites.name: Telonaulor
rites.text: A dormant hand-shaped power is sealed within hidden reservoirs of spiritual essence inside a towering prison of the cursed. Those who seek these stores can draw the strength from them.

rites.name: Serelistium
rites.text: A dark inner force drawn from hidden reservoirs inside a vast, cursed spire. It is gathered by those who dare to plunder the tower's stored essence.

rites.name: Rasaurus Naulia
rites.text: A borrowed spirit-power that a wanderer gains from the lingering essence left behind after a dread tyrant falls in a sunless spire. It grants a deceptive orb that lets its bearer wear false faces.

rites.name: Telenialus
rites.text: A gift granted to sorcerers that strengthens their searing and icy bolts. It may be received once a practitioner reaches a certain advanced stage of training.

rites.name: Ameostum Niastaunium
rites.text: A lunar art practiced by balance-minded casters, bestowed by a crescent blade of moonlight. Its casting awakens a half-phase rite, and it can be invoked again once the full-phase rite has been performed.

rites.name: Tenollanum
rites.text: A mystic power drawn from sealed reservoirs of spirit-essence hidden within a towering prison-fortress of the dead. It lets its wielder pass through barriers that others cannot cross.

rites.name: Tellaurnium
rites.text: A rare inner gift that lets a binder of dark rites slip between worlds. It is bound to a ravenous hunger that feeds on living essence.

rites.name: Cilia Sastor
rites.text: A hunter's technique granted to those who join one celestial oath-bound order. It can also be borrowed briefly by wanderers who complete a specific trial in a distant realm.

rites.name: Corauntia Neolantia
rites.text: A rare evoker gift that grants a special craft-bond. It is an exclusive choice that cannot be taken alongside a related weaving path.

rites.name: Lintiasor
rites.text: A restless spectral force that can be drawn from hidden reservoirs of drifting essence sealed deep within a dread spire. It grants its wielder a fleeting, unstable power.

rites.name: Cianastus
rites.text: A cosmic craft of transmuting dark energy into refined knowledge, taught through obscure exchanges. Practitioners gain a deeper grasp of midnight transformations.

rites.name: Vantes Meonus
rites.text: A combat power that a wielder draws from a shelf of ghostly tools in a rising hall. During a clash of unrest it lightens the weight of the air around the fighters.

rites.name: Teleores Ameontasum
rites.text: A blended craft that draws on several arcane currents at once. Practitioners hunt demons and shape destinies, and its power bends around defenses that shield only part of it.

rites.name: Seolia Leornia
rites.text: A stellar pattern is called forth by a sky-keeper within a distant, shifting realm. It takes the form of a shaped geometry of the heavens.

rites.name: Saurolium Ristornes
rites.text: A renewing power drawn from a crafted engine of ancient tools, granted during the awakening of a great machine. It restores what has been worn away.

rites.name: Amianium Oreostellum
rites.text: A boundless attunement that a bearer may climb again and again, each step drawing more strength from a relic's latent power. Those who climb it to its utmost peak are said to earn a rare and hidden mark of might.

rites.name: Oreollum Mastanum
rites.text: A floating sphere of searing energy that is conjured in the midst of a battle with a robed keeper of growing things. It steadily loses a portion of its strength at short, regular intervals.

rites.name: Nianallia
rites.text: A momentum-driven aerial technique in which a rider hurtles through the sky far faster than ordinary gliding. It can be practiced across many realms, though speeds lessen in lands beyond the first.

rites.name: Cosanum Valiles
rites.text: A combat art lets a fighter give up their own guard to the abyss, gaining a dark edge against rival warriors in duels. It becomes available once a warrior reaches a high rank of mastery.

rites.name: Valentium Amariases
rites.text: A power drawn from a sealed relic pried open within underground ruins. Its effects mirror those of an ancient device that shapes living matter layer by layer.

rites.name: Nisantum
rites.text: A rare arcane discipline that lets a practitioner reshape the flow of their own moments. It cannot be learned alongside a companion art of stepping through time.

rites.name: Launeostium
rites.text: A ritual withdrawal that lets a wandering champion slip backward through the flow of hours. It is available only to those who have reached the highest tier of heroic standing.

rites.name: Tontisia
rites.text: A rare gift that a sky-caster may take, paired with a rapid-pulse art. It binds the two into a single, mutually exclusive path of mastery.

rites.name: Telasilia
rites.text: A chronal force dwells within a shimmering nexus of converging moments, bending the order of before and after in a distant realm of folded time.

rites.name: Seresanum Reneorus
rites.text: A weekly dark pact that calls a shielded herald from the void every minute. The herald cannot be interrupted, and felling it grants the group a surge of speed and resilience.

rites.name: Veror
rites.text: Veror is the concept of a branching ending within the Siluanae Arcane Realm, appearing in the seventh Era of the Record when the Three Futures diverge. It is the Library's habit of shelving each outcome as a separate, sealed possibility that gives it form.
